title: Q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q776578
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q776578), "Artin-Wedderburn theorem":
  every semisimple ring carrying an algebra structure over an arbitrary
  commutative semiring is algebra-equivalent to a finite product of nonzero
  square matrix rings over division algebras. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q776578AlgebraMap K R A says that A is the central unital semiring
  homomorphism from the commutative semiring K to the ring R that specifies a
  K-algebra structure.

  Q776578Semisimple R says that every left ideal of R has a complementary left
  ideal: their intersection is the zero ideal and every ring element is a sum
  of one element from each ideal. Over ZFC this is bidirectionally equivalent
  to semisimplicity of the left regular module, which is Mathlib's
  IsSemisimpleRing condition.

  Q776578Target K n D d is the dependent product, indexed by 0 ..^ n, of the
  d(i)-by-d(i) matrix rings over D(i). The scalar slot K records the common
  base semiring; the final assertion explicitly specifies its induced central
  scalar map entry by entry.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful bidirectional definitions,
  and this root statement file contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q776578AlgebraMap Q776578Semisimple Q776578Target $.

q776578-algebra-map-syntax $a
  wff ( Q776578AlgebraMap K R A ) $.

q776578-semisimple-syntax $a
  wff ( Q776578Semisimple R ) $.

q776578-target-syntax $a
  class ( Q776578Target K n D d ) $.

${
  $d A K R a b x $.

  q776578-algebra-map-definition $a |-
    ( Q776578AlgebraMap K R A )
    <->
    (
      ( K e. CSRing /\ R e. Ring )
      /\
      (
        A : ( Base ` K ) --> ( Base ` R )
        /\
        (
          (
            ( A ` ( 0g ` K ) ) = ( 0g ` R )
            /\
            ( A ` ( 1r ` K ) ) = ( 1r ` R )
          )
          /\
          (
            A. a e. ( Base ` K ) A. b e. ( Base ` K )
              (
                (
                  A ` ( a ( +g ` K ) b )
                )
                =
                (
                  ( A ` a ) ( +g ` R ) ( A ` b )
                )
                /\
                (
                  A ` ( a ( .r ` K ) b )
                )
                =
                (
                  ( A ` a ) ( .r ` R ) ( A ` b )
                )
              )
            /\
            A. a e. ( Base ` K ) A. x e. ( Base ` R )
              (
                ( A ` a ) ( .r ` R ) x
              )
              =
              (
                x ( .r ` R ) ( A ` a )
              )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d I J R x y z $.

  q776578-semisimple-definition $a |-
    ( Q776578Semisimple R )
    <->
    (
      R e. Ring
      /\
      A. I e. ( LIdeal ` R )
        E. J e. ( LIdeal ` R )
          (
            ( I i^i J ) = { ( 0g ` R ) }
            /\
            A. x e. ( Base ` R )
              E. y e. I E. z e. J
                x = ( y ( +g ` R ) z )
          )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d D K d i n $.

  q776578-target-definition $a |-
    ( Q776578Target K n D d )
    =
    (
      K Xs_
      (
        i e. ( 0 ..^ n ) |->
          (
            ( 0 ..^ ( d ` i ) ) Mat ( D ` i )
          )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A B C D E K R a d i j k n $.

  thousand-theorems-q776578-artin-wedderburn-theorem $a |-
    A. K A. R A. A
      (
        (
          ( Q776578AlgebraMap K R A )
          /\
          ( Q776578Semisimple R )
        )
        ->
        E. n e. NN0 E. D E. d E. B E. C E. E
          (
            D : ( 0 ..^ n ) --> DivRing
            /\
            (
              d : ( 0 ..^ n ) --> NN
              /\
              (
                (
                  B Fn ( 0 ..^ n )
                  /\
                  A. i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                    ( Q776578AlgebraMap K ( D ` i ) ( B ` i ) )
                )
                /\
                (
                  (
                    ( Q776578AlgebraMap
                      K
                      ( Q776578Target K n D d )
                      C )
                    /\
                    A. a e. ( Base ` K ) A. i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                      A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( d ` i ) )
                        A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( d ` i ) )
                          (
                            j ( ( C ` a ) ` i ) k
                          )
                          =
                          if (
                            j = k
                            ,
                            ( ( B ` i ) ` a )
                            ,
                            ( 0g ` ( D ` i ) )
                          )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    E e. (
                      R RingIso ( Q776578Target K n D d )
                    )
                    /\
                    A. a e. ( Base ` K )
                      (
                        E ` ( A ` a )
                      )
                      =
                      ( C ` a )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q776578
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q776578), "Artin–Wedderburn theorem": every
% semisimple algebra over a commutative semiring is algebra-isomorphic to a
% finite product of positive-size matrix algebras over division algebras.
% This file contains no proof.

Q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem[
  K, A: TYPE+,
  zero_K, one_K: K,
  add_K, mul_K: [K, K -> K],
  zero_A, one_A: A,
  neg_A: [A -> A],
  add_A, mul_A: [A, A -> A],
  scalar_A: [K -> A]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  matrix_product: TYPE = [nat, nat, nat -> A]
  subset_A: TYPE = [A -> bool]

  commutative_semiring_laws_K: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      add_K(x, y) = add_K(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      add_K(add_K(x, y), z) =
        add_K(x, add_K(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      add_K(x, zero_K) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      mul_K(x, y) = mul_K(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      mul_K(mul_K(x, y), z) =
        mul_K(x, mul_K(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      mul_K(x, one_K) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      mul_K(x, zero_K) = zero_K)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      mul_K(x, add_K(y, z)) =
        add_K(mul_K(x, y), mul_K(x, z)))

  ring_laws_A: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      add_A(x, y) = add_A(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
      add_A(add_A(x, y), z) =
        add_A(x, add_A(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: A):
      add_A(x, zero_A) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: A):
      add_A(x, neg_A(x)) = zero_A)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
      mul_A(mul_A(x, y), z) =
        mul_A(x, mul_A(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: A):
      mul_A(x, one_A) = x
        AND mul_A(one_A, x) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: A):
      mul_A(x, zero_A) = zero_A
        AND mul_A(zero_A, x) = zero_A)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
      mul_A(x, add_A(y, z)) =
        add_A(mul_A(x, y), mul_A(x, z))
        AND
      mul_A(add_A(x, y), z) =
        add_A(mul_A(x, z), mul_A(y, z)))

  algebra_laws_A: bool =
    scalar_A(zero_K) = zero_A
      AND scalar_A(one_K) = one_A
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      scalar_A(add_K(x, y)) =
        add_A(scalar_A(x), scalar_A(y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      scalar_A(mul_K(x, y)) =
        mul_A(scalar_A(x), scalar_A(y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (k: K), (x: A):
      mul_A(scalar_A(k), x) =
        mul_A(x, scalar_A(k)))

  left_ideal(L: subset_A): bool =
    L(zero_A)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      L(x) AND L(y) IMPLIES L(add_A(x, y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: A):
      L(x) IMPLIES L(neg_A(x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, x: A):
      L(x) IMPLIES L(mul_A(a, x)))

  direct_sum_complements(L, C: subset_A): bool =
    left_ideal(L)
      AND left_ideal(C)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: A):
      L(x) AND C(x) IMPLIES x = zero_A)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: A):
      EXISTS (l, c: A):
        L(l) AND C(c) AND x = add_A(l, c))

  semisimple_ring_A: bool =
    FORALL (L: subset_A):
      left_ideal(L) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (C: subset_A):
          direct_sum_complements(L, C)

  component_sum(
      i: nat,
      values: [nat -> A],
      count: nat,
      component_zero: [nat -> A],
      component_add: [nat, A, A -> A]): RECURSIVE A =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      component_zero(i)
    ELSE
      component_add(
        i,
        component_sum(
          i,
          values,
          count - 1,
          component_zero,
          component_add),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  valid_matrix_product(
      M: matrix_product,
      n: nat,
      dimension: [nat -> nat],
      carrier: [nat, A -> bool]): bool =
    FORALL (i, row, column: nat):
      IF i < n
          AND row < dimension(i)
          AND column < dimension(i) THEN
        carrier(i, M(i, row, column))
      ELSE
        M(i, row, column) = zero_A
      ENDIF

  division_ring_family(
      n: nat,
      carrier: [nat, A -> bool],
      component_zero, component_one: [nat -> A],
      component_neg, component_inv: [nat, A -> A],
      component_add, component_mul: [nat, A, A -> A]): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i < n IMPLIES
        carrier(i, component_zero(i))
          AND carrier(i, component_one(i))
          AND component_zero(i) /= component_one(i)
          AND
        (FORALL (x: A):
          carrier(i, x) IMPLIES
            carrier(i, component_neg(i, x))
              AND carrier(i, component_inv(i, x)))
          AND
        component_inv(i, component_zero(i)) =
          component_zero(i)
          AND
        (FORALL (x, y: A):
          carrier(i, x) AND carrier(i, y) IMPLIES
            carrier(i, component_add(i, x, y))
              AND carrier(i, component_mul(i, x, y)))
          AND
        (FORALL (x, y: A):
          carrier(i, x) AND carrier(i, y) IMPLIES
            component_add(i, x, y) =
              component_add(i, y, x))
          AND
        (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
          carrier(i, x)
            AND carrier(i, y)
            AND carrier(i, z)
          IMPLIES
            component_add(
              i,
              component_add(i, x, y),
              z) =
            component_add(
              i,
              x,
              component_add(i, y, z)))
          AND
        (FORALL (x: A):
          carrier(i, x) IMPLIES
            component_add(i, x, component_zero(i)) = x
              AND
            component_add(
              i,
              x,
              component_neg(i, x)) =
                component_zero(i))
          AND
        (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
          carrier(i, x)
            AND carrier(i, y)
            AND carrier(i, z)
          IMPLIES
            component_mul(
              i,
              component_mul(i, x, y),
              z) =
            component_mul(
              i,
              x,
              component_mul(i, y, z)))
          AND
        (FORALL (x: A):
          carrier(i, x) IMPLIES
            component_mul(i, x, component_one(i)) = x
              AND
            component_mul(i, component_one(i), x) = x)
          AND
        (FORALL (x: A):
          carrier(i, x) IMPLIES
            component_mul(i, x, component_zero(i)) =
              component_zero(i)
              AND
            component_mul(i, component_zero(i), x) =
              component_zero(i))
          AND
        (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
          carrier(i, x)
            AND carrier(i, y)
            AND carrier(i, z)
          IMPLIES
            component_mul(
              i,
              x,
              component_add(i, y, z)) =
              component_add(
                i,
                component_mul(i, x, y),
                component_mul(i, x, z))
              AND
            component_mul(
              i,
              component_add(i, x, y),
              z) =
              component_add(
                i,
                component_mul(i, x, z),
                component_mul(i, y, z)))
          AND
        (FORALL (x: A):
          carrier(i, x)
            AND x /= component_zero(i)
          IMPLIES
            component_mul(
              i,
              component_inv(i, x),
              x) = component_one(i)
              AND
            component_mul(
              i,
              x,
              component_inv(i, x)) =
                component_one(i))

  division_algebra_family(
      n: nat,
      carrier: [nat, A -> bool],
      component_zero, component_one: [nat -> A],
      component_add, component_mul: [nat, A, A -> A],
      component_scalar: [nat, K -> A]): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i < n IMPLIES
        (FORALL (k: K):
          carrier(i, component_scalar(i, k)))
          AND
        component_scalar(i, zero_K) = component_zero(i)
          AND
        component_scalar(i, one_K) = component_one(i)
          AND
        (FORALL (x, y: K):
          component_scalar(i, add_K(x, y)) =
            component_add(
              i,
              component_scalar(i, x),
              component_scalar(i, y)))
          AND
        (FORALL (x, y: K):
          component_scalar(i, mul_K(x, y)) =
            component_mul(
              i,
              component_scalar(i, x),
              component_scalar(i, y)))
          AND
        (FORALL (k: K), (x: A):
          carrier(i, x) IMPLIES
            component_mul(
              i,
              component_scalar(i, k),
              x) =
            component_mul(
              i,
              x,
              component_scalar(i, k)))

  matrix_product_algebra_equivalence(
      n: nat,
      dimension: [nat -> nat],
      carrier: [nat, A -> bool],
      component_zero, component_one: [nat -> A],
      component_add, component_mul: [nat, A, A -> A],
      component_scalar: [nat, K -> A],
      equivalence: [A -> matrix_product]): bool =
    (FORALL (x: A):
      valid_matrix_product(
        equivalence(x),
        n,
        dimension,
        carrier))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      equivalence(x) = equivalence(y) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND
    (FORALL (M: matrix_product):
      valid_matrix_product(M, n, dimension, carrier)
      IMPLIES EXISTS (x: A): equivalence(x) = M)
      AND
    (FORALL (i, row, column: nat):
      equivalence(zero_A)(i, row, column) =
        IF i < n
            AND row < dimension(i)
            AND column < dimension(i) THEN
          component_zero(i)
        ELSE
          zero_A
        ENDIF)
      AND
    (FORALL (i, row, column: nat):
      equivalence(one_A)(i, row, column) =
        IF i < n
            AND row < dimension(i)
            AND column < dimension(i) THEN
          IF row = column THEN
            component_one(i)
          ELSE
            component_zero(i)
          ENDIF
        ELSE
          zero_A
        ENDIF)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: A), (i, row, column: nat):
      equivalence(add_A(x, y))(i, row, column) =
        IF i < n
            AND row < dimension(i)
            AND column < dimension(i) THEN
          component_add(
            i,
            equivalence(x)(i, row, column),
            equivalence(y)(i, row, column))
        ELSE
          zero_A
        ENDIF)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: A), (i, row, column: nat):
      equivalence(mul_A(x, y))(i, row, column) =
        IF i < n
            AND row < dimension(i)
            AND column < dimension(i) THEN
          component_sum(
            i,
            (LAMBDA (middle: nat):
              component_mul(
                i,
                equivalence(x)(i, row, middle),
                equivalence(y)(i, middle, column))),
            dimension(i),
            component_zero,
            component_add)
        ELSE
          zero_A
        ENDIF)
      AND
    (FORALL (k: K), (i, row, column: nat):
      equivalence(scalar_A(k))(i, row, column) =
        IF i < n
            AND row < dimension(i)
            AND column < dimension(i) THEN
          IF row = column THEN
            component_scalar(i, k)
          ELSE
            component_zero(i)
          ENDIF
        ELSE
          zero_A
        ENDIF)

  exists_algEquiv_pi_matrix_divisionRing: bool =
    (commutative_semiring_laws_K
      AND ring_laws_A
      AND algebra_laws_A
      AND semisimple_ring_A)
    IMPLIES
      EXISTS
        (n: nat),
        (dimension: [nat -> nat]),
        (carrier: [nat, A -> bool]),
        (component_zero, component_one: [nat -> A]),
        (component_neg, component_inv: [nat, A -> A]),
        (component_add, component_mul: [nat, A, A -> A]),
        (component_scalar: [nat, K -> A]),
        (equivalence: [A -> matrix_product]):
          (FORALL (i: nat):
            i < n IMPLIES dimension(i) > 0)
            AND
          division_ring_family(
            n,
            carrier,
            component_zero,
            component_one,
            component_neg,
            component_inv,
            component_add,
            component_mul)
            AND
          division_algebra_family(
            n,
            carrier,
            component_zero,
            component_one,
            component_add,
            component_mul,
            component_scalar)
            AND
          matrix_product_algebra_equivalence(
            n,
            dimension,
            carrier,
            component_zero,
            component_one,
            component_add,
            component_mul,
            component_scalar,
            equivalence)
END Q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem

variable (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

theorem equiv_free_prod_directSum_statement [Module.Finite R M] :

      (e : ι → ℕ), Nonempty <| M ≃ₗ[R] (Fin n →₀ R) × ⨁ i : ι, R ⧸ R ∙ p i ^ e i := sorry

    {R I : Type}

    {R M I : Type}
    {CR : q7888360_commutative_ring R}
    (SM : @q7888360_module R M CR)
    (n : nat)
    (p : I -> R)
    (e : I -> nat) : Type := {

    M -> q7888360_target_carrier R I n;
  q7888360_backward :
    q7888360_target_carrier R I n -> M;
  q7888360_backward_respects :
    forall x y : q7888360_target_carrier R I n,
      @q7888360_target_equiv R I CR n p e x y ->
      q7888360_backward x = q7888360_backward y;
  q7888360_left_inverse :
    forall x : M,
      q7888360_backward (q7888360_forward x) = x;
  q7888360_right_inverse :
    forall y : q7888360_target_carrier R I n,
      @q7888360_target_equiv R I CR n p e
        (q7888360_forward (q7888360_backward y)) y;
  q7888360_forward_add :
    forall x y : M,
      @q7888360_target_equiv R I CR n p e
        (q7888360_forward (q7888360_madd SM x y))
        (@q7888360_target_add R I CR n
          (q7888360_forward x) (q7888360_forward y));
  q7888360_forward_smul :
    forall (r : R) (x : M),
      @q7888360_target_equiv R I CR n p e
        (q7888360_forward (q7888360_smul SM r x))
        (@q7888360_target_smul R I CR n r (q7888360_forward x))
}.

Theorem Module_equiv_free_prod_directSum :
  forall (R M : Type)
         (CR : q7888360_commutative_ring R)
         (PID : q7888360_principal_ideal_ring CR)
         (domain : q7888360_integral_domain CR)
         (SM : @q7888360_module R M CR),
    q7888360_finitely_generated SM ->
    exists (n : nat)
           (I : Type)
           (finite_I : q7888360_finite_type I)
           (p : I -> R)
           (e : I -> nat),
      (forall i : I, @q7888360_irreducible R CR (p i)) /\
      exists equivalence :
        @q7888360_linear_equiv_decomposition
          R M I CR SM n p e,
        True.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7888360
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q7888360), "Structure theorem for finitely
  generated modules over a principal ideal domain": every finitely generated
  module over a PID is linearly equivalent to a finite free module times a
  finite direct sum of cyclic prime-power quotient modules. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory Q7888360_structure_theorem_for_finitely_generated_modules_over_a_prin
  imports Main
begin

definition q7888360_irreducible :: "'r::idom \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q7888360_irreducible p \<longleftrightarrow>
    p \<noteq> 0 \<and>
    \<not> p dvd 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. p = a * b \<longrightarrow> a dvd 1 \<or> b dvd 1)"

definition q7888360_ideal :: "'r::comm_ring_1 set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q7888360_ideal I \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<in> I \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> I. -x \<in> I) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> I. \<forall>y \<in> I. x + y \<in> I) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. \<forall>x \<in> I. a * x \<in> I)"

definition q7888360_principal_ideal :: "'r::comm_ring_1 \<Rightarrow> 'r set" where
  "q7888360_principal_ideal a = {x. \<exists>r. x = r * a}"

definition q7888360_pid :: "'r::idom itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q7888360_pid TYPE('r) \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>I :: 'r set. q7888360_ideal I \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>a. I = q7888360_principal_ideal a))"

definition q7888360_module ::
    "('r::idom \<Rightarrow> 'm::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q7888360_module scale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. scale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a * b) x = scale a (scale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a + b) x = scale a x + scale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. scale a (x + y) = scale a x + scale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. scale 0 x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. scale a 0 = 0)"

fun q7888360_linear_combination ::
    "('r::idom \<Rightarrow> 'm::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow>
      ('r \<times> 'm) list \<Rightarrow> 'm" where
  "q7888360_linear_combination scale [] = 0"
| "q7888360_linear_combination scale ((a, x) # xs) =
    scale a x + q7888360_linear_combination scale xs"

definition q7888360_finitely_generated ::
    "('r::idom \<Rightarrow> 'm::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q7888360_finitely_generated scale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>G :: 'm set. finite G \<and>
      (\<forall>x. \<exists>xs :: ('r \<times> 'm) list.
        set (map snd xs) \<subseteq> G \<and>
        q7888360_linear_combination scale xs = x))"

definition q7888360_coset ::
    "'r::idom \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r set" where
  "q7888360_coset g x =
    {y. \<exists>z \<in> q7888360_principal_ideal g. y = x + z}"

definition q7888360_quotient_carrier ::
    "'r::idom \<Rightarrow> 'r set set" where
  "q7888360_quotient_carrier g = q7888360_coset g ` UNIV"

definition q7888360_quotient_add ::
    "'r::idom set \<Rightarrow> 'r set \<Rightarrow> 'r set" where
  "q7888360_quotient_add A B =
    {z. \<exists>x \<in> A. \<exists>y \<in> B. z = x + y}"

definition q7888360_quotient_scale ::
    "'r::idom \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r set \<Rightarrow> 'r set" where
  "q7888360_quotient_scale g a A =
    {y. \<exists>x \<in> A. \<exists>z \<in> q7888360_principal_ideal g.
      y = a * x + z}"

definition q7888360_free_carrier :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'r list set" where
  "q7888360_free_carrier n = {xs. length xs = n}"

definition q7888360_torsion_carrier ::
    "'r::idom list \<Rightarrow> nat list \<Rightarrow> 'r set list set" where
  "q7888360_torsion_carrier ps es =
    {qs. length es = length ps \<and>
      length qs = length ps \<and>
      (\<forall>i<length ps.
        qs ! i \<in> q7888360_quotient_carrier ((ps ! i) ^ (es ! i)))}"

definition q7888360_target_carrier ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> 'r::idom list \<Rightarrow> nat list \<Rightarrow>
      ('r list \<times> 'r set list) set" where
  "q7888360_target_carrier n ps es =
    q7888360_free_carrier n \<times> q7888360_torsion_carrier ps es"

definition q7888360_target_add ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> 'r::idom list \<Rightarrow>
      ('r list \<times> 'r set list) \<Rightarrow>
      ('r list \<times> 'r set list) \<Rightarrow>
      ('r list \<times> 'r set list)" where
  "q7888360_target_add n ps x y =
    (map (\<lambda>i. fst x ! i + fst y ! i) [0..<n],
      map (\<lambda>i. q7888360_quotient_add (snd x ! i) (snd y ! i))
        [0..<length ps])"

definition q7888360_target_scale ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> 'r::idom list \<Rightarrow> nat list \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow>
      ('r list \<times> 'r set list) \<Rightarrow>
      ('r list \<times> 'r set list)" where
  "q7888360_target_scale n ps es a x =
    (map (\<lambda>i. a * (fst x ! i)) [0..<n],
      map (\<lambda>i.
        q7888360_quotient_scale ((ps ! i) ^ (es ! i)) a (snd x ! i))
        [0..<length ps])"

definition q7888360_linear_equiv ::
    "('r::idom \<Rightarrow> 'm::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> 'r list \<Rightarrow> nat list \<Rightarrow>
      ('m \<Rightarrow> ('r list \<times> 'r set list)) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q7888360_linear_equiv scale n ps es f \<longleftrightarrow>
    bij_betw f UNIV (q7888360_target_carrier n ps es) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y.
      f (x + y) = q7888360_target_add n ps (f x) (f y)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x.
      f (scale a x) = q7888360_target_scale n ps es a (f x))"

theorem q7888360_structure_theorem:
  fixes scale :: "'r::idom \<Rightarrow> 'm::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'm"
  assumes "q7888360_pid TYPE('r)"
    and "q7888360_module scale"
    and "q7888360_finitely_generated scale"
  shows "\<exists>n ps es f.
    length es = length ps \<and>
    (\<forall>p \<in> set ps. q7888360_irreducible p) \<and>
    q7888360_linear_equiv scale n ps es f"
  sorry

end

title: Q7888360_structure_theorem_for_finitely_generated_modules_over_a_prin
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7888360,
  "Structure theorem for finitely generated modules over a principal ideal
  domain": every finitely generated module over a commutative principal ideal
  domain is linearly isomorphic to a finite free module times a finite direct
  sum of cyclic modules by powers of irreducibles. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q7888360_STRUCTURE_THEOREM_FOR_FINITELY_GENERATED_MODULES_OVER_A_PID =
  `let is_commutative_ring =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R).
       (!a:R. addR zeroR a = a) /\
       (!a:R. addR (negR a) a = zeroR) /\
       (!a b:R. addR a b = addR b a) /\
       (!a b c:R. addR a (addR b c) = addR (addR a b) c) /\
       (!a:R. mulR oneR a = a) /\
       (!a b:R. mulR a b = mulR b a) /\
       (!a b c:R. mulR a (mulR b c) = mulR (mulR a b) c) /\
       (!a b c:R.
          mulR a (addR b c) = addR (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) in
   let is_integral_domain =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (mulR:R->R->R).
       ~(zeroR = oneR) /\
       (!a b:R. mulR a b = zeroR ==> a = zeroR \/ b = zeroR) in
   let is_ideal =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
      (ideal:R->bool).
       ideal zeroR /\
       (!a b:R. ideal a /\ ideal b ==> ideal (addR a b)) /\
       (!a:R. ideal a ==> ideal (negR a)) /\
       (!r a:R. ideal a ==> ideal (mulR r a)) in
   let is_principal_ideal_ring =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R).
       !ideal:R->bool.
         is_ideal zeroR addR mulR negR ideal
         ==> ?generator:R.
               !x:R.
                 (ideal x <=>
                  ?coefficient:R. x = mulR coefficient generator) in
   let is_module =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (zeroM:M) (addM:M->M->M) (negM:M->M) (smul:R->M->M).
       (!x:M. addM zeroM x = x) /\
       (!x:M. addM (negM x) x = zeroM) /\
       (!x y:M. addM x y = addM y x) /\
       (!x y z:M. addM x (addM y z) = addM (addM x y) z) /\
       (!x:M. smul oneR x = x) /\
       (!a b:R. !x:M.
          smul (mulR a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:R. !x:M.
          smul (addR a b) x = addM (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:R. !x y:M.
          smul a (addM x y) = addM (smul a x) (smul a y)) in
   let is_finitely_generated =
     \(zeroR:R) (addM:M->M->M) (smul:R->M->M).
       ?d:num. ?generators:num->M.
         !x:M.
           ?coefficients:num->R.
             (!i:num. d <= i ==> coefficients i = zeroR) /\
             x =
             iterate addM {i:num | i < d}
               (\i:num. smul (coefficients i) (generators i)) in
   let ring_power =
     \(oneR:R) (mulR:R->R->R) (a:R) (n:num).
       ITLIST mulR (REPLICATE n a) oneR in
   let is_unit =
     \(oneR:R) (mulR:R->R->R) (a:R).
       ?b:R. mulR a b = oneR in
   let is_irreducible =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (mulR:R->R->R) (p:R).
       ~(p = zeroR) /\
       ~(is_unit oneR mulR p) /\
       (!a b:R.
          p = mulR a b
          ==> is_unit oneR mulR a \/ is_unit oneR mulR b) in
   let congruent_mod =
     \(addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
      (generator:R) (x:R) (y:R).
       ?coefficient:R.
         addR x (negR y) = mulR coefficient generator in
   let quotient_class =
     \(addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
      (generator:R) (representative:R).
       \x:R.
         congruent_mod addR mulR negR generator x representative in
   let is_quotient_element =
     \(addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
      (generator:R) (coset:R->bool).
       ?representative:R.
         coset =
         quotient_class addR mulR negR generator representative in
   let quotient_add =
     \(addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
      (generator:R) (left:R->bool) (right:R->bool).
       \x:R.
         ?a b:R.
           left a /\ right b /\
           congruent_mod addR mulR negR generator x (addR a b) in
   let quotient_smul =
     \(addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
      (generator:R) (scalar:R) (coset:R->bool).
       \x:R.
         ?a:R.
           coset a /\
           congruent_mod addR mulR negR generator x (mulR scalar a) in
   let finite_free_tuple =
     \(zeroR:R) (n:num) (coordinates:num->R).
       !i:num. n <= i ==> coordinates i = zeroR in
   let finite_quotient_tuple =
     \(oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
      (k:num) (p:num->R) (e:num->num)
      (coordinates:num->(R->bool)).
       (!i:num.
          i < k
          ==> is_quotient_element addR mulR negR
                (ring_power oneR mulR (p i) (e i))
                (coordinates i)) /\
       (!i:num. k <= i ==> coordinates i = (\x:R. F)) in
   let decomposition_carrier =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (n:num) (k:num) (p:num->R) (e:num->num)
      (z:(num->R)#(num->(R->bool))).
       finite_free_tuple zeroR n (FST z) /\
       finite_quotient_tuple oneR addR mulR negR k p e (SND z) in
   let decomposition_add =
     \(addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
      (oneR:R) (k:num) (p:num->R) (e:num->num)
      (z:(num->R)#(num->(R->bool)))
      (w:(num->R)#(num->(R->bool))).
       ((\i:num. addR (FST z i) (FST w i)),
        (\i:num.
           if i < k then
             quotient_add addR mulR negR
               (ring_power oneR mulR (p i) (e i))
               (SND z i) (SND w i)
           else (\x:R. F))) in
   let decomposition_smul =
     \(addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
      (oneR:R) (k:num) (p:num->R) (e:num->num) (scalar:R)
      (z:(num->R)#(num->(R->bool))).
       ((\i:num. mulR scalar (FST z i)),
        (\i:num.
           if i < k then
             quotient_smul addR mulR negR
               (ring_power oneR mulR (p i) (e i))
               scalar (SND z i)
           else (\x:R. F))) in
   let is_linear_equivalence =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (addM:M->M->M) (smul:R->M->M)
      (n:num) (k:num) (p:num->R) (e:num->num)
      (equiv:M->((num->R)#(num->(R->bool)))).
       (!x:M.
          decomposition_carrier
            zeroR oneR addR mulR negR n k p e (equiv x)) /\
       (!x y:M.
          equiv (addM x y) =
          decomposition_add addR mulR negR oneR k p e
            (equiv x) (equiv y)) /\
       (!a:R. !x:M.
          equiv (smul a x) =
          decomposition_smul addR mulR negR oneR k p e a (equiv x)) /\
       (!z:(num->R)#(num->(R->bool)).
          decomposition_carrier zeroR oneR addR mulR negR n k p e z
          ==> ?!x:M. equiv x = z) in
   !zeroR oneR:R.
   !addR mulR:R->R->R.
   !negR:R->R.
   !zeroM:M.
   !addM:M->M->M.
   !negM:M->M.
   !smul:R->M->M.
     is_commutative_ring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
     is_integral_domain zeroR oneR mulR /\
     is_principal_ideal_ring zeroR addR mulR negR /\
     is_module zeroR oneR addR mulR zeroM addM negM smul /\
     is_finitely_generated zeroR addM smul
     ==> ?n k:num. ?p:num->R. ?e:num->num.
           (!i:num.
              i < k ==> is_irreducible zeroR oneR mulR (p i)) /\
           ?equiv:M->((num->R)#(num->(R->bool))).
             is_linear_equivalence
               zeroR oneR addR mulR negR addM smul n k p e equiv`;;

title: Q7888360_structure_theorem_for_finitely_generated_modules_over_a_prin
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7888360,
;; "Structure theorem for finitely generated modules over a principal ideal
;; domain": every finitely generated module over a commutative principal ideal
;; domain is R-linearly equivalent to a finite free module times a finite
;; direct sum of quotients by irreducible prime powers. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame function objects represent arbitrary ring and module carriers,
;; operations, and the internally existential linear equivalence. A finite
;; index type is represented by Fin k. Quotient elements are represented by
;; ring elements modulo the corresponding principal-ideal congruence.

(defun q7888360-app1 (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun q7888360-app2 (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun q7888360-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (q7888360-app1 carrier value) t nil))

(defun q7888360-ring-add (addition left right)
  (q7888360-app2 addition left right))

(defun q7888360-ring-mul (multiplication left right)
  (q7888360-app2 multiplication left right))

(defun q7888360-ring-neg (negation value)
  (q7888360-app1 negation value))

(defun q7888360-module-add (addition left right)
  (q7888360-app2 addition left right))

(defun q7888360-module-neg (negation value)
  (q7888360-app1 negation value))

(defun q7888360-smul (scalar-action scalar vector)
  (q7888360-app2 scalar-action scalar vector))

;; Commutative rings and integral domains.

(defun-sk q7888360-commutative-ring-laws-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q7888360-member-p carrier x)
      (and
       (q7888360-member-p
        carrier
        (q7888360-ring-neg negation x))
       (equal (q7888360-ring-add addition x zero) x)
       (equal (q7888360-ring-add addition zero x) x)
       (equal
        (q7888360-ring-add
         addition x (q7888360-ring-neg negation x))
        zero)
       (equal
        (q7888360-ring-add
         addition (q7888360-ring-neg negation x) x)
        zero)
       (equal (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication x one) x)
       (equal (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication one x) x)
       (equal (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication x zero) zero)
       (equal (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication zero x) zero)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q7888360-member-p carrier x)
       (q7888360-member-p carrier y))
      (and
       (q7888360-member-p
        carrier
        (q7888360-ring-add addition x y))
       (q7888360-member-p
        carrier
        (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication x y))
       (equal
        (q7888360-ring-add addition x y)
        (q7888360-ring-add addition y x))
       (equal
        (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication x y)
        (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q7888360-member-p carrier x)
       (q7888360-member-p carrier y)
       (q7888360-member-p carrier z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q7888360-ring-add
         addition
         (q7888360-ring-add addition x y)
         z)
        (q7888360-ring-add
         addition
         x
         (q7888360-ring-add addition y z)))
       (equal
        (q7888360-ring-mul
         multiplication
         (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication x y)
         z)
        (q7888360-ring-mul
         multiplication
         x
         (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication y z)))
       (equal
        (q7888360-ring-mul
         multiplication
         x
         (q7888360-ring-add addition y z))
        (q7888360-ring-add
         addition
         (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication x y)
         (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication x z)))
       (equal
        (q7888360-ring-mul
         multiplication
         (q7888360-ring-add addition x y)
         z)
        (q7888360-ring-add
         addition
         (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication x z)
         (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication y z))))))))

(defun q7888360-commutative-ring-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp addition)
   (tamep-functionp multiplication)
   (tamep-functionp negation)
   (q7888360-member-p carrier zero)
   (q7888360-member-p carrier one)
   (q7888360-commutative-ring-laws-p
    carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)))

(defun-sk q7888360-no-zero-divisors-p
    (carrier zero multiplication)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7888360-member-p carrier x)
      (q7888360-member-p carrier y)
      (equal
       (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication x y)
       zero))
     (or (equal x zero)
         (equal y zero)))))

(defun q7888360-domain-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)
  (and
   (q7888360-commutative-ring-p
    carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q7888360-no-zero-divisors-p
    carrier zero multiplication)))

;; Ideals and the principal-ideal condition.

(defun-sk q7888360-ideal-laws-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q7888360-member-p ideal x)
      (and
       (q7888360-member-p carrier x)
       (q7888360-member-p
        ideal
        (q7888360-ring-neg negation x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q7888360-member-p ideal x)
       (q7888360-member-p ideal y))
      (q7888360-member-p
       ideal
       (q7888360-ring-add addition x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q7888360-member-p carrier a)
       (q7888360-member-p ideal x))
      (q7888360-member-p
       ideal
       (q7888360-ring-mul multiplication a x))))))

(defun q7888360-ideal-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp ideal)
   (q7888360-member-p ideal zero)
   (q7888360-ideal-laws-p
    carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)))

(defun-sk q7888360-principal-member-p
    (carrier multiplication generator value)
  (exists (coefficient)
    (and
     (q7888360-member-p carrier coefficient)
     (equal
      value
      (q7888360-ring-mul
       multiplication coefficient generator)))))

(defun-sk q7888360-ideal-generated-by-p
    (carrier multiplication ideal generator)
  (forall (value)
    (iff
     (q7888360-member-p ideal value)
     (and
      (q7888360-member-p carrier value)
      (q7888360-principal-member-p
       carrier multiplication generator value)))))

(defun-sk q7888360-ideal-generator-exists-p
    (carrier multiplication ideal)
  (exists (generator)
    (and
     (q7888360-member-p carrier generator)
     (q7888360-ideal-generated-by-p
      carrier multiplication ideal generator))))

(defun-sk q7888360-principal-ideal-ring-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation)
  (forall (ideal)
    (implies
     (q7888360-ideal-p
      carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
     (q7888360-ideal-generator-exists-p
      carrier multiplication ideal))))

;; Additive commutative groups and modules.

(defun-sk q7888360-module-laws-p
    (ring-carrier
     ring-zero
     ring-one
     ring-addition
     ring-multiplication
     module-carrier
     module-zero
     module-addition
     module-negation
     scalar-action)
  (forall (a b x y z)

title: Q7888360_structure_theorem_for_finitely_generated_modules_over_a_prin
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7888360,
-- "Structure theorem for finitely generated modules over a principal ideal domain":
-- a finitely generated module over a PID is linearly equivalent to a finite free
-- module times a finite direct sum of cyclic prime-power quotients. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q7888360_structure_theorem_for_finitely_generated_modules_over_a_prin where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 4 _×_
infixr 3 _⊎_
infix 4 _≠_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
_≠_ {a} x y =
  x ≡ y → Bottom {a}

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not {a} A =
  A → Bottom {a}

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _⊎_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A → A ⊎ B
  right : B → A ⊎ B

record _↔_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

record Finite
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size        : Nat
    equivalence : Bijection A (Fin size)

record CommutativeRing
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set r where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R → R → R
    negateR : R → R

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) →
      addR zeroR x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) →
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : R) →
      addR (negateR x) x ≡ zeroR
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : R) →
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR oneR x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ≡
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)

record IntegralDomain
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) :
  Set r where

  field
    nontrivial :
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring ≠
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    no-zero-divisors :
      (x y : R) →
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring →
      x ≡ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring ⊎
      y ≡ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring

record Ideal
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    member : R → Set r
    membership-propositional :
      (x : R) →
      (u v : member x) →
      u ≡ v
    contains-zero :
      member (CommutativeRing.zeroR ring)
    closed-under-addition :
      (x y : R) →
      member x →
      member y →
      member (CommutativeRing.addR ring x y)
    closed-under-negation :
      (x : R) →
      member x →
      member (CommutativeRing.negateR ring x)
    absorbs-multiplication :
      (a x : R) →
      member x →
      member (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring a x)

IsPrincipal :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} →
  Ideal ring →
  Set r
IsPrincipal {R = R} {ring = ring} ideal =
  Σ R
    (λ generator →
      (x : R) →
      Ideal.member ideal x ↔
      Σ R
        (λ coefficient →
          x ≡
          CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring coefficient generator))

PrincipalIdealRing :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  Set (lsuc r)
PrincipalIdealRing ring =
  (ideal : Ideal ring) →
  IsPrincipal ideal

record Module
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (ring : CommutativeRing R)
  (M : Set m) :
  Set (r ⊔ m) where

  field
    zeroM : M
    addM  : M → M → M
    negateM : M → M
    scale : R → M → M

    add-associative :
      (x y z : M) →
      addM (addM x y) z ≡ addM x (addM y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : M) →
      addM x y ≡ addM y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : M) →
      addM zeroM x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : M) →
      addM x zeroM ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : M) →
      addM (negateM x) x ≡ zeroM
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : M) →
      addM x (negateM x) ≡ zeroM

    one-scale :
      (x : M) →
      scale (CommutativeRing.oneR ring) x ≡ x
    multiply-scale :
      (a b : R) (x : M) →
      scale (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring a b) x ≡
      scale a (scale b x)
    add-scale :
      (a b : R) (x : M) →
      scale (CommutativeRing.addR ring a b) x ≡
      addM (scale a x) (scale b x)
    scale-add :
      (a : R) (x y : M) →
      scale a (addM x y) ≡
      addM (scale a x) (scale a y)
    zero-scale :
      (x : M) →
      scale (CommutativeRing.zeroR ring) x ≡ zeroM
    scale-zero :
      (a : R) →
      scale a zeroM ≡ zeroM

sumFin :
  {r m : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {M : Set m} →
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} →
  Module ring M →
  (n : Nat) →
  (Fin n → M) →
  M
sumFin module-structure zero terms =
  Module.zeroM module-structure
sumFin module-structure (suc n) terms =
  Module.addM module-structure
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFin module-structure n (λ i → terms (fsuc i)))

FinitelyGenerated :
  {r m : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {M : Set m} →
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} →
  Module ring M →
  Set (r ⊔ m)
FinitelyGenerated {R = R} {M = M} module-structure =
  Σ Nat
    (λ number-of-generators →
      Σ (Fin number-of-generators → M)
        (λ generators →
          (x : M) →
          Σ (Fin number-of-generators → R)
            (λ coefficients →
              x ≡
              sumFin module-structure number-of-generators
                (λ i →
                  Module.scale module-structure
                    (coefficients i)
                    (generators i)))))

power :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  R →
  Nat →
  R
power ring x zero =
  CommutativeRing.oneR ring
power ring x (suc n) =
  CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x (power ring x n)

Unit :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  R →
  Set r
Unit {R = R} ring x =
  Σ R
    (λ inverse →
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x inverse ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring)

Irreducible :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  R →
  Set r
Irreducible {R = R} ring p =
  Not (Unit ring p) ×
  ((x y : R) →
    CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y ≡ p →
    Unit ring x ⊎ Unit ring y)

record Coordinates
  {r i : Level}
  (n : Nat)
  (Index : Set i)
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (r ⊔ i) where

  constructor coordinates
  field
    free-part    : Fin n → R
    torsion-part : Index → R

addCoordinates :
  {r i : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {Index : Set i} →
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) →
  {n : Nat} →
  Coordinates n Index R →
  Coordinates n Index R →
  Coordinates n Index R
addCoordinates ring left-coordinate right-coordinate =
  coordinates
    (λ j →
      CommutativeRing.addR ring
        (Coordinates.free-part left-coordinate j)
        (Coordinates.free-part right-coordinate j))
    (λ i →
      CommutativeRing.addR ring
        (Coordinates.torsion-part left-coordinate i)
        (Coordinates.torsion-part right-coordinate i))

scaleCoordinates :
  {r i : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {Index : Set i} →
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) →
  {n : Nat} →
  R →
  Coordinates n Index R →
  Coordinates n Index R
scaleCoordinates ring scalar coordinate =
  coordinates
    (λ j →
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring scalar
        (Coordinates.free-part coordinate j))
    (λ i →
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring scalar
        (Coordinates.torsion-part coordinate i))

PrincipalCongruent :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  R →
  R →
  R →
  Set r
PrincipalCongruent {R = R} ring generator x y =
  Σ R
    (λ coefficient →
      x ≡
      CommutativeRing.addR ring y
        (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring coefficient generator))

CoordinateEquivalent :
  {r i : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {Index : Set i} →
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) →
  {n : Nat} →
  (prime : Index → R) →
  (exponent : Index → Nat) →
  Coordinates n Index R →
  Coordinates n Index R →
  Set (r ⊔ i)
CoordinateEquivalent ring prime exponent left-coordinate right-coordinate =
  ((j : Fin _) →
    Coordinates.free-part left-coordinate j ≡
    Coordinates.free-part right-coordinate j) ×
  ((i : _) →
    PrincipalCongruent ring
      (power ring (prime i) (exponent i))
      (Coordinates.torsion-part left-coordinate i)
      (Coordinates.torsion-part right-coordinate i))

-- This record presents a linear equivalence to the quotient setoid of the
-- coordinates. For finite Index, all indexed families have finite support,
-- so the torsion coordinates are exactly the finite direct sum in the source.
record LinearEquivalenceToDecomposition
  {r m i : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  {Index : Set i}
  (ring : CommutativeRing R)
  (module-structure : Module ring M)
  (n : Nat)
  (prime : Index → R)
  (exponent : Index → Nat) :
  Set (r ⊔ m ⊔ i) where

  field
    map :
      M →
      Coordinates n Index R
    map-add :
      (x y : M) →
      CoordinateEquivalent ring prime exponent
        (map (Module.addM module-structure x y))
        (addCoordinates ring (map x) (map y))
    map-scale :
      (a : R) (x : M) →
      CoordinateEquivalent ring prime exponent
        (map (Module.scale module-structure a x))
        (scaleCoordinates ring a (map x))
    injective :
      (x y : M) →
      CoordinateEquivalent ring prime exponent (map x) (map y) →
      x ≡ y
    surjective :
      (coordinate : Coordinates n Index R) →
      Σ M
        (λ x →
          CoordinateEquivalent ring prime exponent
            (map x) coordinate)

-- Lean: Module.equiv_free_prod_directSum
structure-theorem-for-finitely-generated-modules-over-a-pid :
  (r m : Level) →
  Set (lsuc r ⊔ lsuc m)
structure-theorem-for-finitely-generated-modules-over-a-pid r m =
  {R : Set r} →
  {M : Set m} →
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) →
  IntegralDomain ring →
  PrincipalIdealRing ring →
  (module-structure : Module ring M) →
  FinitelyGenerated module-structure →
  Σ Nat
    (λ free-rank →
      Σ (Set r)
        (λ Index →
          Σ (Finite Index)
            (λ finite-index →
              Σ (Index → R)
                (λ prime →
                  ((i : Index) → Irreducible ring (prime i)) ×
                  Σ (Index → Nat)
                    (λ exponent →
                      LinearEquivalenceToDecomposition
                        ring module-structure free-rank
                        prime exponent)))))

$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7888360
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q7888360), "Structure theorem for finitely
  generated modules over a principal ideal domain": every finitely generated
  module over an arbitrary commutative principal ideal domain is linearly
  equivalent to the product of a finite-rank free module and a finite direct
  sum of cyclic quotients by powers of irreducible elements. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's PID is the class IDomn intersect LPIR, so it expresses precisely
  the commutative integral-domain and principal-ideal hypotheses on R.
  Q7888360FiniteModule M says that a finite subset of Base ` M spans M; this
  is bidirectionally equivalent to mathlib's Module.Finite R M.

  Q7888360Cyclic R a k is the quotient of the regular left R-module by the
  principal ideal generated by a^k. The group-multiple operation on mulGrp
  is ring exponentiation for k in NN0.

  Q7888360Target R n I p e is the two-factor module product of the free
  module on 0 ..^ n and the direct sum, indexed by the arbitrary finite set
  I, of R/(p(i)^e(i)). SetMM represents this binary product as a dependent
  product over { empty, 1 }; it is canonically linearly equivalent in both
  directions to Lean's module product. Thus nonemptiness of LMIso in the
  final assertion is equivalent to the source Nonempty linear equivalence.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement. All
  preceding root-file $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions.
  This root statement file contains no $p declaration; imported lib/set.mm
  supplies the independently verified standard-library proofs.
$)

$c Q7888360FiniteModule Q7888360Cyclic Q7888360Target $.

q7888360-finite-module-syntax $a
  wff ( Q7888360FiniteModule M ) $.

q7888360-cyclic-syntax $a
  class ( Q7888360Cyclic R a k ) $.

q7888360-target-syntax $a
  class ( Q7888360Target R n I p e ) $.

${
  $d M S $.

  q7888360-finite-module-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7888360FiniteModule M )
    <->
    E. S e. ( Fin i^i ~P ( Base ` M ) )
      ( ( LSpan ` M ) ` S ) = ( Base ` M )
  ) $.
$}

q7888360-cyclic-definition $a |- (
  Q7888360Cyclic R a k
) = (
  ( ringLMod ` R )
  /s
  (
    ( ringLMod ` R )
    ~QG
    (
      ( RSpan ` R )
      ` { ( k ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` R ) ) a ) }
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d I R e i n p $.

  q7888360-target-definition $a |- (
    Q7888360Target R n I p e
  ) = (
    R Xs_
    {
      <. (/) , ( R freeLMod ( 0 ..^ n ) ) >. ,
      <.
        1o
        ,
        (
          R (+)m
          (
            i e. I |->
              ( Q7888360Cyclic R ( p ` i ) ( e ` i ) )
          )
        )
      >.
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d I M R e i n p $.

  thousand-theorems-q7888360-structure-theorem-for-finitely-generated-modules-over-a-principal-ideal-domain
    $a |- (
      A. R A. M
        (
          (
            (
              R e. PID
              /\
              (
                M e. LMod
                /\
                ( Scalar ` M ) = R
              )
            )
            /\
            ( Q7888360FiniteModule M )
          )
          ->
          E. n e. NN0 E. I e. Fin E. p E. e
            (
              (
                p : I --> ( Base ` R )
                /\
                e : I --> NN0
              )
              /\
              (
                A. i e. I
                  ( p ` i ) e. ( Irred ` R )
                /\
                (
                  M
                  LMIso
                  ( Q7888360Target R n I p e )
                ) =/= (/)
              )
            )
        )
    ) $.
$}
