content:
:: Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7888360,
:: "Structure theorem for finitely generated modules over a principal ideal
:: domain": every finitely generated module over a PID is isomorphic to a
:: finite-rank free module times a finite direct sum of cyclic modules whose
:: moduli are powers of irreducible elements. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, CARD_1,
      XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, TARSKI, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, ALGSTR_1, RLVECT_1,
      VECTSP_1,
      VECTSP_2, MOD_3, GROUP_1, GROUP_4, GROUP_6, IDEAL_1, RING_1, RING_2,
      NEWTON, BINOM,
      PARTFUN1, ZFMISC_1, CARD_3, ARYTM_3, ARYTM_1, INT_1, XXREAL_0;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
      PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FINSET_1, CARD_1, ORDINAL1, DOMAIN_1, NUMBERS,
      XCMPLX_0, INT_1, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, ALGSTR_1,
      RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, GROUP_4, GROUP_6, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2, VECTSP_4,
      VECTSP_6, VECTSP_7, NEWTON, BINOM, IDEAL_1, RING_1, RING_2;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSET_1, NAT_1,
      FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, ALGSTR_1, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1,
      GROUP_4, GROUP_6, VECTSP_1, NEWTON, BINOM, VECTSP_2, VECTSP_4,
      VECTSP_6, VECTSP_7, IDEAL_1, RING_1, RING_2;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1,
      RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FINSET_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1,
      INT_1, CARD_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, ALGSTR_1, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1,
      GROUP_4, GROUP_6, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2, VECTSP_4, VECTSP_7, BINOM,
      IDEAL_1, RING_1, RING_2;
 requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1, ALGSTR_0, ALGSTR_1,
      VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2, VECTSP_6, VECTSP_7, BINOM, IDEAL_1, RING_1,
      RING_2;
 equalities STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, FINSEQ_1;
 expansions TARSKI, STRUCT_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for R being PID domRing, M being LeftMod of R
  st ex g being FinSequence of the carrier of M st
       for x being Vector of M holds
         ex a being FinSequence of the carrier of R,
            s being FinSequence of the carrier of M
         st
           len a = len g & len s = len g &
           (for i being Nat st i in dom s holds
             s/.i = (a/.i) * (g/.i)) &
           x = Sum(s)
  holds
    ex n,k being Nat,
       z,o being Element of R,
       u,v being FinSequence of the carrier of M,
       p being FinSequence of the carrier of R,
       e being FinSequence of NAT
    st
      (for r being Element of R holds z + r = r & o * r = r) &
      len u = n & len v = k & len p = k & len e = k &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom p holds
        p/.i <> z &
        not (ex q being Element of R st (p/.i) * q = o) &
        for a,b being Element of R st p/.i = a * b holds
          (ex c being Element of R st a * c = o) or
          (ex c being Element of R st b * c = o)) &
      (for x being Vector of M holds
        ex a,b being FinSequence of the carrier of R,
           s,t being FinSequence of the carrier of M
        st
          len a = n & len b = k & len s = n & len t = k &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom s holds
            s/.i = (a/.i) * (u/.i)) &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom t holds
            t/.i = (b/.i) * (v/.i)) &
          x = Sum(s) + Sum(t)) &
      (for a1,a2,b1,b2 being FinSequence of the carrier of R,
           s1,s2,t1,t2 being FinSequence of the carrier of M
        st
          len a1 = n & len a2 = n & len b1 = k & len b2 = k &
          len s1 = n & len s2 = n & len t1 = k & len t2 = k &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom s1 holds
            s1/.i = (a1/.i) * (u/.i)) &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom s2 holds
            s2/.i = (a2/.i) * (u/.i)) &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom t1 holds
            t1/.i = (b1/.i) * (v/.i)) &
          (for i being Nat st i in dom t2 holds
            t2/.i = (b2/.i) * (v/.i))
        holds
          (Sum(s1) + Sum(t1) = Sum(s2) + Sum(t2) iff
            (for i being Nat st i in dom a1 holds a1/.i = a2/.i) &
            (for i being Nat st i in dom b1 holds
              ex c being Element of R st
                b1/.i - b2/.i = c * ((p/.i) |^ (e/.i)))))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q7888360_structure_theorem_for_finitely_generated_modules_over_a_prin
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7888360
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q7888360), "Structure theorem for finitely generated
% modules over a principal ideal domain": every finitely generated module over a
% PID is linearly isomorphic to a finite-rank free module times a finite direct
% sum of quotients by ideals generated by prime powers. This file contains no proof.

Q7888360_structure_theorem_for_finitely_generated_modules_over_a_prin[
  R, M: TYPE+,
  zeroR, oneR: R,
  negR: [R -> R],
  addR, mulR: [R, R -> R],
  zeroM: M,
  negM: [M -> M],
  addM: [M, M -> M],
  smul: [R, M -> M]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  ideal: TYPE = [R -> bool]
  r_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> R]
  m_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> M]
  nat_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  commutative_integral_domain_laws: bool =
    oneR /= zeroR
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R):
        addR(a, b) = addR(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        addR(addR(a, b), c) = addR(a, addR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        addR(zeroR, a) = a
          AND addR(a, zeroR) = a
          AND addR(negR(a), a) = zeroR
          AND addR(a, negR(a)) = zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R):
        mulR(a, b) = mulR(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(mulR(a, b), c) = mulR(a, mulR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        mulR(oneR, a) = a
          AND mulR(a, oneR) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(a, addR(b, c)) =
          addR(mulR(a, b), mulR(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(addR(a, b), c) =
          addR(mulR(a, c), mulR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R):
        mulR(a, b) = zeroR
          IMPLIES a = zeroR OR b = zeroR)

  is_ideal(I: ideal): bool =
    I(zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        I(x) AND I(y) IMPLIES I(addR(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        I(x) IMPLIES I(negR(x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, x: R):
        I(x) IMPLIES I(mulR(a, x)))

  is_principal(I: ideal): bool =
    EXISTS (generator: R):
      FORALL (x: R):
        I(x) IFF
          EXISTS (coefficient: R):
            x = mulR(coefficient, generator)

  principal_ideal_domain_laws: bool =
    commutative_integral_domain_laws
      AND (FORALL (I: ideal):
        is_ideal(I) IMPLIES is_principal(I))

  module_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: M):
      addM(x, y) = addM(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: M):
        addM(addM(x, y), z) = addM(x, addM(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: M):
        addM(zeroM, x) = x
          AND addM(x, zeroM) = x
          AND addM(negM(x), x) = zeroM
          AND addM(x, negM(x)) = zeroM)
      AND (FORALL (a: R), (x, y: M):
        smul(a, addM(x, y)) =
          addM(smul(a, x), smul(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R), (x: M):
        smul(addR(a, b), x) =
          addM(smul(a, x), smul(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R), (x: M):
        smul(mulR(a, b), x) =
          smul(a, smul(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: M):
        smul(oneR, x) = x)

  finite_linear_combination(
      generators: m_sequence,
      coefficients: r_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE M =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroM
    ELSE
      addM(
        finite_linear_combination(
          generators, coefficients, count - 1),
        smul(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          generators(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  finitely_generated_module: bool =
    EXISTS (generator_count: nat),
           (generators: m_sequence):
      FORALL (x: M):
        EXISTS (coefficients: r_sequence):
          x = finite_linear_combination(
            generators, coefficients, generator_count)

  ring_power(a: R, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      oneR
    ELSE
      mulR(ring_power(a, exponent - 1), a)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  is_unit(a: R): bool =
    EXISTS (inverse: R):
      mulR(a, inverse) = oneR

  irreducible(a: R): bool =
    a /= zeroR
      AND NOT is_unit(a)
      AND (FORALL (left, right: R):
        a = mulR(left, right)
          IMPLIES is_unit(left) OR is_unit(right))

  zero_sequence: r_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): zeroR

  sequence_add(
      left, right: r_sequence): r_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      addR(left(index), right(index))

  sequence_scale(
      scalar: R,
      values: r_sequence): r_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      mulR(scalar, values(index))

  supported_below(
      count: nat,
      values: r_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      count <= index IMPLIES values(index) = zeroR

  same_residue_mod_prime_power(
      left, right, prime: R,
      exponent: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (coefficient: R):
      addR(left, negR(right)) =
        mulR(coefficient, ring_power(prime, exponent))

  torsion_coordinates_related(
      left, right: r_sequence,
      torsion_count: nat,
      primes: r_sequence,
      exponents: nat_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < torsion_count
        IMPLIES
          same_residue_mod_prime_power(
            left(index),
            right(index),
            primes(index),
            exponents(index))

  decomposition_equivalence(
      free_rank, torsion_count: nat,
      primes: r_sequence,
      exponents: nat_sequence,
      free_coordinates, torsion_coordinates:
        [M -> r_sequence],
      reconstruct: [r_sequence, r_sequence -> M]): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      index < torsion_count
        IMPLIES irreducible(primes(index)))
      AND (FORALL (x: M):
        supported_below(
          free_rank, free_coordinates(x))
          AND supported_below(
            torsion_count, torsion_coordinates(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: M):
        reconstruct(
          free_coordinates(x),
          torsion_coordinates(x)) = x)
      AND (FORALL
          (free_values: r_sequence),
          (left_torsion, right_torsion: r_sequence):
        supported_below(free_rank, free_values)
          AND supported_below(
            torsion_count, left_torsion)
          AND supported_below(
            torsion_count, right_torsion)
          AND torsion_coordinates_related(
            left_torsion,
            right_torsion,
            torsion_count,
            primes,
            exponents)
        IMPLIES
          reconstruct(free_values, left_torsion) =
            reconstruct(free_values, right_torsion))
      AND (FORALL
          (free_values, torsion_values: r_sequence):
        supported_below(free_rank, free_values)
          AND supported_below(
            torsion_count, torsion_values)
        IMPLIES
          free_coordinates(
            reconstruct(
              free_values, torsion_values)) =
              free_values
          AND torsion_coordinates_related(
            torsion_coordinates(
              reconstruct(
                free_values, torsion_values)),
            torsion_values,
            torsion_count,
            primes,
            exponents))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: M):
        free_coordinates(addM(x, y)) =
          sequence_add(
            free_coordinates(x),
            free_coordinates(y))
          AND torsion_coordinates_related(
            torsion_coordinates(addM(x, y)),
            sequence_add(
              torsion_coordinates(x),
              torsion_coordinates(y)),
            torsion_count,
            primes,
            exponents))
      AND (FORALL (a: R), (x: M):
        free_coordinates(smul(a, x)) =
          sequence_scale(
            a, free_coordinates(x))
          AND torsion_coordinates_related(
            torsion_coordinates(smul(a, x)),
            sequence_scale(
              a, torsion_coordinates(x)),
            torsion_count,
            primes,
            exponents))

  equiv_free_prod_directSum: bool =
    (principal_ideal_domain_laws
      AND module_laws
      AND finitely_generated_module)
    IMPLIES
      EXISTS
          (free_rank, torsion_count: nat),
          (primes: r_sequence),
          (exponents: nat_sequence),
          (free_coordinates, torsion_coordinates:
            [M -> r_sequence]),
          (reconstruct:
            [r_sequence, r_sequence -> M]):
        decomposition_equivalence(
          free_rank,
          torsion_count,
          primes,
          exponents,
          free_coordinates,
          torsion_coordinates,
          reconstruct)

END Q7888360_structure_theorem_for_finitely_generated_modules_over_a_prin

title: Q791663_beatty_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q791663
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q791663), "Beatty's theorem": for Holder-conjugate
-- real parameters, the complement of one two-sided Beatty sequence is the
-- ceiling variant of the other, and for irrational r the positive Beatty
-- sequences partition the positive integers. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Data.Real.ConjExponents
public import Mathlib.NumberTheory.Real.Irrational

@[expose] public section

/-- In the Beatty sequence for `r`, the term indexed by `k` is `floor (k * r)`. -/
noncomputable def beattySeq (r : ℝ) : ℤ → ℤ :=
  fun k ↦ ⌊k * r⌋

/-- This Beatty-sequence variant has term `ceil (k * r) - 1` at index `k`. -/
noncomputable def beattySeq' (r : ℝ) : ℤ → ℤ :=
  fun k ↦ ⌈k * r⌉ - 1

/-- The complement of one two-sided Beatty sequence is the conjugate ceiling variant. -/
theorem compl_beattySeq {r s : ℝ} (hrs : r.HolderConjugate s) :
    {beattySeq r k | k}ᶜ = {beattySeq' s k | k} := sorry

open scoped symmDiff

/-- Irrational conjugate positive Beatty sequences partition the positive integers. -/
theorem Irrational.beattySeq_symmDiff_beattySeq_pos {r s : ℝ}
    (hrs : r.HolderConjugate s) (hr : Irrational r) :
    {beattySeq r k | k > 0} ∆ {beattySeq s k | k > 0} = {n | 0 < n} := sorry

title: Q791663_beatty_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q791663
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q791663), "Beatty's theorem": conjugate real
  parameters give complementary two-sided Beatty sequences, and when the
  first parameter is irrational their positive Beatty sequences partition
  the positive integers. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals QArith ZArith.ZArith.

Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q791663_holder_conjugate (r s : R) : Prop :=
  0 < r /\ 0 < s /\ / r + / s = 1.

Definition q791663_irrational (r : R) : Prop :=
  ~ exists q : Q, r = Q2R q.

Definition q791663_is_floor (x : R) (n : Z) : Prop :=
  IZR n <= x < IZR (n + 1)%Z.

Definition q791663_is_ceil_minus_one (x : R) (n : Z) : Prop :=
  IZR n < x <= IZR (n + 1)%Z.

Definition q791663_beatty (r : R) (n : Z) : Prop :=
  exists k : Z,
    q791663_is_floor (IZR k * r) n.

Definition q791663_beatty_prime (r : R) (n : Z) : Prop :=
  exists k : Z,
    q791663_is_ceil_minus_one (IZR k * r) n.

Definition q791663_beatty_pos (r : R) (n : Z) : Prop :=
  exists k : Z,
    (0 < k)%Z /\
    q791663_is_floor (IZR k * r) n.

Theorem compl_beattySeq :
  forall r s : R,
    q791663_holder_conjugate r s ->
    forall n : Z,
      ~ q791663_beatty r n <-> q791663_beatty_prime s n.
Proof.
Admitted.

Module Irrational.

Theorem beattySeq_symmDiff_beattySeq_pos :
  forall r s : R,
    q791663_holder_conjugate r s ->
    q791663_irrational r ->
    forall n : Z,
      ((q791663_beatty_pos r n /\ ~ q791663_beatty_pos s n) \/
       (q791663_beatty_pos s n /\ ~ q791663_beatty_pos r n)) <->
      (0 < n)%Z.
Proof.
Admitted.

End Irrational.

title: Q791663_beatty_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q791663
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q791663), "Beatty's theorem": complementary
  floor and ceiling Beatty sets, and the partition of the positive integers by
  irrational conjugate Beatty sequences. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q791663_beatty_s_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q791663_holder_conjugate :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q791663_holder_conjugate r s \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 < r \<and> 0 < s \<and> inverse r + inverse s = 1"

definition q791663_beatty_seq :: "real \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "q791663_beatty_seq r k = floor (of_int k * r)"

definition q791663_beatty_seq' :: "real \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "q791663_beatty_seq' r k = ceiling (of_int k * r) - 1"

definition q791663_beatty_set :: "real \<Rightarrow> int set" where
  "q791663_beatty_set r = range (q791663_beatty_seq r)"

definition q791663_beatty_set' :: "real \<Rightarrow> int set" where
  "q791663_beatty_set' r = range (q791663_beatty_seq' r)"

definition q791663_positive_beatty_set :: "real \<Rightarrow> int set" where
  "q791663_positive_beatty_set r =
    q791663_beatty_seq r ` {k::int. 0 < k}"

definition q791663_symm_diff :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q791663_symm_diff A B = (A - B) \<union> (B - A)"

theorem compl_beattySeq:
  fixes r s :: real
  assumes "q791663_holder_conjugate r s"
  shows "UNIV - q791663_beatty_set r = q791663_beatty_set' s"
  sorry

theorem irrational_beattySeq_symmDiff_beattySeq_pos:
  fixes r s :: real
  assumes "q791663_holder_conjugate r s"
    and "r \<notin> \<rat>"
  shows "q791663_symm_diff
      (q791663_positive_beatty_set r)
      (q791663_positive_beatty_set s) =
    {n::int. 0 < n}"
  sorry

end

title: Q791663_beatty_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q791663,
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q791663), "Beatty's theorem":
  Holder-conjugate real parameters give complementary two-sided floor/ceiling
  Beatty sets, and with an irrational first parameter the positive floor
  Beatty sets partition the positive integers. This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/floor.ml";;

let Q791663_COMPL_BEATTYSEQ =
  `let ceil_int =
     \x:real. int_of_real (--(floor (--x))) in
   let beatty_seq =
     \r:real. \k:int.
       int_of_real (floor (real_of_int k * r)) in
   let beatty_seq_prime =
     \r:real. \k:int.
       ceil_int (real_of_int k * r) - &1 in
   let holder_conjugate =
     \r s:real.
       &1 < r /\ &1 < s /\ inv r + inv s = &1 in
   !r s:real.
     holder_conjugate r s
     ==> !j:int.
           (~(?k:int. j = beatty_seq r k) <=>
            ?k:int. j = beatty_seq_prime s k)`;;

let Q791663_IRRATIONAL_BEATTYSEQ_SYMMDIFF_POS =
  `let beatty_seq =
     \r:real. \k:int.
       int_of_real (floor (real_of_int k * r)) in
   let holder_conjugate =
     \r s:real.
       &1 < r /\ &1 < s /\ inv r + inv s = &1 in
   !r s:real.
     holder_conjugate r s /\ ~rational r
     ==> !n:int.
           (((?k:int. &0 < k /\ n = beatty_seq r k) /\
             ~(?k:int. &0 < k /\ n = beatty_seq s k)) \/
            ((?k:int. &0 < k /\ n = beatty_seq s k) /\
             ~(?k:int. &0 < k /\ n = beatty_seq r k))
            <=> &0 < n)`;;

title: Q791663_beatty_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q791663,
;; "Beatty's theorem": Holder-conjugate real slopes give complementary integer
;; Beatty sets, and irrational conjugate slopes partition the positive integers
;; by their positive-index Beatty sequences. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative interfaces present an arbitrary Archimedean ordered
;; field through its integer embedding and floor operation. Every such
;; presentation embeds into the real field, while the real field itself is one
;; such presentation. Integer indices and set membership witnesses are
;; quantified internally and are not represented by finite tables.

(defstub q791663-member-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub q791663-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub q791663-one (real-type) t)
(defstub q791663-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub q791663-multiply (real-type left right) t)
(defstub q791663-negate (real-type value) t)
(defstub q791663-inverse (real-type value) t)
(defstub q791663-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub q791663-integer-embedding (real-type integer) t)
(defstub q791663-floor (real-type value) t)

(defun q791663-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (q791663-less real-type right left)))

(defun q791663-r-add (real-type left right)
  (q791663-add real-type left right))

(defun q791663-r-multiply (real-type left right)
  (q791663-multiply real-type left right))

(defun q791663-r-negate (real-type value)
  (q791663-negate real-type value))

(defun q791663-r-inverse (real-type value)
  (q791663-inverse real-type value))

(defun-sk q791663-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q791663-member-p real-type x)
      (q791663-member-p real-type y)
      (q791663-member-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (q791663-zero real-type))
            (one (q791663-one real-type))
            (xy-add (q791663-r-add real-type x y))
            (yz-add (q791663-r-add real-type y z))
            (xy-mul (q791663-r-multiply real-type x y))
            (yz-mul (q791663-r-multiply real-type y z))
            (neg-x (q791663-r-negate real-type x))
            (inv-x (q791663-r-inverse real-type x)))
       (and
        (q791663-member-p real-type xy-add)
        (q791663-member-p real-type xy-mul)
        (q791663-member-p real-type neg-x)
        (q791663-member-p real-type inv-x)
        (equal
         (q791663-r-add real-type xy-add z)
         (q791663-r-add real-type x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q791663-r-add real-type y x))
        (equal (q791663-r-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (q791663-r-add real-type x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q791663-r-multiply real-type xy-mul z)
         (q791663-r-multiply real-type x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q791663-r-multiply real-type y x))
        (equal (q791663-r-multiply real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q791663-r-multiply real-type x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q791663-r-multiply real-type x yz-add)
         (q791663-r-add
          real-type
          (q791663-r-multiply real-type x y)
          (q791663-r-multiply real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk q791663-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q791663-member-p real-type x)
      (q791663-member-p real-type y)
      (q791663-member-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (q791663-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (q791663-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (q791663-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (q791663-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q791663-less real-type x y)
          (q791663-less real-type y z))
         (q791663-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (q791663-less real-type x y)
         (q791663-less
          real-type
          (q791663-r-add real-type x z)
          (q791663-r-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q791663-less real-type zero x)
          (q791663-less real-type zero y))
         (q791663-less
          real-type
          zero
          (q791663-r-multiply real-type x y))))))))

(defun-sk q791663-integer-embedding-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and (integerp m) (integerp n))
     (let ((embed-m
            (q791663-integer-embedding real-type m))
           (embed-n
            (q791663-integer-embedding real-type n)))
       (and
        (q791663-member-p real-type embed-m)
        (q791663-member-p real-type embed-n)
        (equal
         (q791663-integer-embedding real-type 0)
         (q791663-zero real-type))
        (equal
         (q791663-integer-embedding real-type 1)
         (q791663-one real-type))
        (equal
         (q791663-integer-embedding real-type (+ m n))
         (q791663-r-add real-type embed-m embed-n))
        (equal
         (q791663-integer-embedding real-type (* m n))
         (q791663-r-multiply real-type embed-m embed-n))
        (equal
         (q791663-integer-embedding real-type (- m))
         (q791663-r-negate real-type embed-m))
        (iff
         (< m n)
         (q791663-less real-type embed-m embed-n)))))))

(defun-sk q791663-floor-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q791663-member-p real-type x)
     (let* ((floor-x (q791663-floor real-type x))
            (embed-floor
             (q791663-integer-embedding real-type floor-x))
            (embed-next
             (q791663-integer-embedding real-type (+ floor-x 1))))
       (and
        (integerp floor-x)
        (q791663-leq real-type embed-floor x)
        (q791663-less real-type x embed-next))))))

(defun q791663-real-presentation-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (q791663-zero real-type))
        (one (q791663-one real-type)))
    (and
     (q791663-member-p real-type zero)
     (q791663-member-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q791663-less real-type zero one)
     (q791663-field-laws-p real-type)
     (q791663-order-laws-p real-type)
     (q791663-integer-embedding-laws-p real-type)
     (q791663-floor-laws-p real-type))))

;; Real.HolderConjugate r s: both slopes are positive and their reciprocals
;; sum to one.

(defun q791663-holder-conjugate-p (real-type r s)
  (let ((zero (q791663-zero real-type))
        (one (q791663-one real-type)))
    (and
     (q791663-member-p real-type r)
     (q791663-member-p real-type s)
     (q791663-less real-type zero r)
     (q791663-less real-type zero s)
     (equal
      (q791663-r-add
       real-type
       (q791663-r-inverse real-type r)
       (q791663-r-inverse real-type s))
      one))))

;; Irrationality is the absence of a ratio of embedded integers with nonzero
;; denominator.

(defun-sk q791663-irrational-p (real-type r)
  (forall (numerator denominator)
    (implies
     (and
      (integerp numerator)
      (integerp denominator)
      (not (equal denominator 0)))
     (not
      (equal
       (q791663-r-multiply
        real-type
        r
        (q791663-integer-embedding real-type denominator))
       (q791663-integer-embedding real-type numerator))))))

;; Membership in B_r = {floor(k*r) | k is an integer}.

(defun-sk q791663-beatty-member-p (real-type r j)
  (exists (k)
    (and
     (integerp j)
     (integerp k)
     (equal
      (q791663-floor
       real-type
       (q791663-r-multiply
        real-type
        (q791663-integer-embedding real-type k)
        r))
      j))))

;; Membership in B'_r = {ceil(k*r)-1 | k is an integer}, using
;; ceil(x) = -floor(-x).

(defun-sk q791663-beatty-prime-member-p (real-type r j)
  (exists (k)
    (and
     (integerp j)
     (integerp k)
     (equal
      (-
       (-
        (q791663-floor
         real-type
         (q791663-r-negate
          real-type
          (q791663-r-multiply
           real-type
           (q791663-integer-embedding real-type k)
           r))))
       1)
      j))))

;; Membership in B+_r = {floor(k*r) | k is a positive integer}.

(defun-sk q791663-positive-beatty-member-p (real-type r j)
  (exists (k)
    (and
     (integerp j)
     (integerp k)
     (< 0 k)
     (equal
      (q791663-floor
       real-type
       (q791663-r-multiply
        real-type
        (q791663-integer-embedding real-type k)
        r))
      j))))

;; compl_beattySeq: the complement of B_r in the integers is B'_s.

(defun-sk q791663-compl-beatty-seq-conclusion-p
    (real-type r s)
  (forall (j)
    (implies
     (integerp j)
     (iff
      (not (q791663-beatty-member-p real-type r j))
      (q791663-beatty-prime-member-p real-type s j)))))

;; Irrational.beattySeq_symmDiff_beattySeq_pos: the symmetric difference of
;; B+_r and B+_s is exactly the set of positive integers.

(defun-sk q791663-positive-partition-conclusion-p
    (real-type r s)
  (forall (j)
    (implies
     (integerp j)
     (iff
      (if (q791663-positive-beatty-member-p real-type r j)
          (not
           (q791663-positive-beatty-member-p real-type s j))
        (q791663-positive-beatty-member-p real-type s j))
      (< 0 j)))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q791663-compl-beatty-seq-statement
    (real-type r s)
  (implies
   (and
    (q791663-real-presentation-p real-type)
    (q791663-holder-conjugate-p real-type r s))
   (q791663-compl-beatty-seq-conclusion-p
    real-type r s)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q791663-beatty-s-theorem-statement
    (real-type r s)
  (implies
   (and
    (q791663-real-presentation-p real-type)
    (q791663-holder-conjugate-p real-type r s)
    (q791663-irrational-p real-type r))
   (q791663-positive-partition-conclusion-p
    real-type r s)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q791663_beatty_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q791663,
-- "Beatty's theorem": conjugate Beatty sequences complement one another, and
-- for an irrational parameter their positive parts partition the positive
-- integers. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q791663_beatty_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessThanR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR
    negate-involutive :
      (x : R) ->
      negateR (negateR x) == x

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-irreflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessThanR x x ->
      Bottom
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessThanR x y ->
      lessThanR y z ->
      lessThanR x z
    order-trichotomy :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessThanR x y or
      (x == y or lessThanR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessThanR x y ->
      lessThanR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-positive :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessThanR zeroR x ->
      lessThanR zeroR y ->
      lessThanR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessThanR zeroR oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) ==
      addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) ==
      multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessThanR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessThanR x upper or x == upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessThanR x supremum or x == supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessThanR x upper or x == upper) ->
            lessThanR supremum upper or supremum == upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

LessOrEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
LessOrEqual reals x y =
  lessThanR reals x y or x == y

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (inverseR reals y)

fromIntR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromIntR reals (pos n) =
  fromNatR reals n
fromIntR reals (negsuc n) =
  negateR reals (fromNatR reals (suc n))

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) :
  Set1 where

  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) ->
      forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) ->
      backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (inverseR source x) ==
      inverseR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) ==
      fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessThanR source x y)
        (lessThanR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set2 where

  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

successorInt : Int -> Int
successorInt (pos n) =
  pos (suc n)
successorInt (negsuc zero) =
  pos zero
successorInt (negsuc (suc n)) =
  negsuc n

predecessorInt : Int -> Int
predecessorInt (pos zero) =
  negsuc zero
predecessorInt (pos (suc n)) =
  pos n
predecessorInt (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc n)

negateInt : Int -> Int
negateInt (pos zero) =
  pos zero
negateInt (pos (suc n)) =
  negsuc n
negateInt (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

record IntegerFloor
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    floorR :
      R -> Int
    floor-lower :
      (x : R) ->
      LessOrEqual reals
        (fromIntR reals (floorR x))
        x
    floor-upper :
      (x : R) ->
      lessThanR reals x
        (fromIntR reals (successorInt (floorR x)))

open IntegerFloor

ceilingR :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  IntegerFloor reals ->
  R ->
  Int
ceilingR {reals = reals} floors x =
  negateInt (floorR floors (negateR reals x))

Region : Set -> Set1
Region A =
  A -> Set

Complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Region A ->
  Region A
Complement P x =
  Not (P x)

Intersection :
  {A : Set} ->
  Region A ->
  Region A ->
  Region A
Intersection P Q x =
  P x and Q x

Union :
  {A : Set} ->
  Region A ->
  Region A ->
  Region A
Union P Q x =
  P x or Q x

SymmetricDifference :
  {A : Set} ->
  Region A ->
  Region A ->
  Region A
SymmetricDifference P Q =
  Union
    (Intersection P (Complement Q))
    (Intersection Q (Complement P))

RegionEquality :
  {A : Set} ->
  Region A ->
  Region A ->
  Set
RegionEquality {A = A} P Q =
  (x : A) ->
  Iff (P x) (Q x)

HolderConjugate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
HolderConjugate reals r s =
  lessThanR reals (oneR reals) r
  and
  (lessThanR reals (oneR reals) s
  and
  addR reals
    (inverseR reals r)
    (inverseR reals s)
  == oneR reals)

Irrational :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Irrational reals x =
  (numerator denominator : Int) ->
  denominator != pos zero ->
  x !=
    divideR reals
      (fromIntR reals numerator)
      (fromIntR reals denominator)

IntPositive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  Set
IntPositive reals k =
  lessThanR reals
    (zeroR reals)
    (fromIntR reals k)

BeattySet :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  IntegerFloor reals ->
  R ->
  Region Int
BeattySet reals floors r j =
  Exists Int
    (\ k ->
      floorR floors
        (multiplyR reals (fromIntR reals k) r)
      == j)

BeattyPrimeSet :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  IntegerFloor reals ->
  R ->
  Region Int
BeattyPrimeSet reals floors r j =
  Exists Int
    (\ k ->
      predecessorInt
        (ceilingR floors
          (multiplyR reals (fromIntR reals k) r))
      == j)

PositiveBeattySet :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  IntegerFloor reals ->
  R ->
  Region Int
PositiveBeattySet reals floors r j =
  Exists Int
    (\ k ->
      IntPositive reals k
      and
      floorR floors
        (multiplyR reals (fromIntR reals k) r)
      == j)

compl-beatty-seq : Set2
compl-beatty-seq =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (floors : IntegerFloor reals) ->
  (r s : R) ->
  HolderConjugate reals r s ->
  RegionEquality
    (Complement (BeattySet reals floors r))
    (BeattyPrimeSet reals floors s)

beatty-s-theorem : Set2
beatty-s-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (floors : IntegerFloor reals) ->
  (r s : R) ->
  HolderConjugate reals r s ->
  Irrational reals r ->
  RegionEquality
    (SymmetricDifference
      (PositiveBeattySet reals floors r)
      (PositiveBeattySet reals floors s))
    (IntPositive reals)

title: Q791663_beatty_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q791663 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q791663), "Beatty's theorem":
  Holder-conjugate real parameters give complementary integer Beatty
  sequences, and with an irrational parameter their positive Beatty
  sequences partition the positive integers by symmetric difference.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open integerTheory pred_setTheory realTheory intrealTheory;

val q791663_beattySeq_def = new_definition (
  "q791663_beattySeq_def",
  ``q791663_beattySeq (r : real) (k : int) =
      INT_FLOOR (real_of_int k * r)``);

val q791663_beattySeq_prime_def = new_definition (
  "q791663_beattySeq_prime_def",
  ``q791663_beattySeq_prime (r : real) (k : int) =
      INT_CEILING (real_of_int k * r) - 1``);

val q791663_holder_conjugate_def = new_definition (
  "q791663_holder_conjugate_def",
  ``q791663_holder_conjugate (r : real) (s : real) <=>
      inv r + inv s = 1 /\ 0 < r /\ 0 < s``);

val q791663_irrational_def = new_definition (
  "q791663_irrational_def",
  ``q791663_irrational (r : real) <=>
      !a b : int.
        b <> 0 ==>
        r <> real_of_int a / real_of_int b``);

val compl_beattySeq =
  ``!r s : real.
      q791663_holder_conjugate r s
      ==>
      UNIV DIFF (IMAGE (q791663_beattySeq r) UNIV) =
        IMAGE (q791663_beattySeq_prime s) UNIV``;

val Irrational_beattySeq_symmDiff_beattySeq_pos =
  ``!r s : real.
      q791663_holder_conjugate r s /\
      q791663_irrational r
      ==>
      let Br =
        IMAGE (q791663_beattySeq r) {k : int | 0 < k}
      in
      let Bs =
        IMAGE (q791663_beattySeq s) {k : int | 0 < k}
      in
        (Br DIFF Bs) UNION (Bs DIFF Br) = {n : int | 0 < n}``;

title: Q791663_beatty_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q791663
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q791663), "Beatty's theorem": conjugate
  real Beatty sequences complement one another, and for an irrational
  parameter their positive-index sequences partition the positive integers.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q791663Beatty r is the set of all floor(k r) for integer k.
  Q791663BeattyPrime r is the set of all ceiling(k r) - 1 for integer k.
  Q791663BeattyPos r restricts the first construction to positive integer k.

  For real r and s, the displayed condition
    1 < r /\ 1 / r + 1 / s = 1
  is equivalent to Lean's r.HolderConjugate s.  Irrationality of the real r
  is written r e/ QQ.  Complement in the first assertion is relative to ZZ,
  matching the source set complement on the integer type, and /_\ is SetMM's
  symmetric difference.

  The last two $a declarations are the unproved corpus statements
  compl_beattySeq and Irrational.beattySeq_symmDiff_beattySeq_pos.  All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or explicit definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q791663Beatty Q791663BeattyPrime Q791663BeattyPos $.

q791663-beatty-syntax $a class ( Q791663Beatty r ) $.
q791663-beatty-prime-syntax $a class ( Q791663BeattyPrime r ) $.
q791663-beatty-pos-syntax $a class ( Q791663BeattyPos r ) $.

${
  $d k n r $.

  q791663-beatty-definition $a |- ( Q791663Beatty r ) =
    { n e. ZZ | E. k e. ZZ n = ( |_ ` ( k x. r ) ) } $.
$}

${
  $d k n r $.

  q791663-beatty-prime-definition $a |- ( Q791663BeattyPrime r ) =
    { n e. ZZ |
      E. k e. ZZ n = ( ( |^ ` ( k x. r ) ) - 1 ) } $.
$}

${
  $d k n r $.

  q791663-beatty-pos-definition $a |- ( Q791663BeattyPos r ) =
    { n e. ZZ |
      E. k e. ZZ
        ( 0 < k /\ n = ( |_ ` ( k x. r ) ) ) } $.
$}

${
  $d r s $.

  thousand-theorems-q791663-compl-beatty-seq $a |- A. r e. RR
    A. s e. RR
      (
        (
          1 < r
          /\
          ( ( 1 / r ) + ( 1 / s ) ) = 1
        )
        ->
        ( ZZ \ ( Q791663Beatty r ) ) = ( Q791663BeattyPrime s )
      ) $.
$}

${
  $d r s $.

  thousand-theorems-q791663-beatty-seq-symmetric-difference-pos $a
    |- A. r e. RR
      A. s e. RR
        (
          (
            (
              1 < r
              /\
              ( ( 1 / r ) + ( 1 / s ) ) = 1
            )
            /\
            r e/ QQ
          )
          ->
          (
            ( ( Q791663BeattyPos r ) /_\ ( Q791663BeattyPos s ) )
            =
            NN
          )
        ) $.
$}

title: Q791663_beatty_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q791663
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q791663), "Beatty's theorem": conjugate real
:: Beatty sequences satisfy the general complement identity, and for an
:: irrational parameter their positive parts partition the positive integers.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1,
    ARYTM_3, REAL_1, INT_1, NAT_1, VALUED_1, RAT_1, IRRAT_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1,
    COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, RAT_1, IRRAT_1;
  constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, INT_1,
    XXREAL_0, RAT_1, IRRAT_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, RAT_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for r,s being Real st
    0 < r & 0 < s & 1/r + 1/s = 1
  holds
    for j being Integer holds
      (not ex k being Integer st j = [\ k*r /]) iff
      (ex m being Integer st j = [/ m*s \] - 1)
proof
end;
::$P+

::$P-
theorem
  for r,s being Real st
    0 < r & 0 < s & 1/r + 1/s = 1 & r is irrational
  holds
    for j being Integer holds
      (((ex k being Integer st k > 0 & j = [\ k*r /]) &
          not (ex m being Integer st m > 0 & j = [\ m*s /])) or
       (not (ex k being Integer st k > 0 & j = [\ k*r /]) &
          (ex m being Integer st m > 0 & j = [\ m*s /])))
      iff j > 0
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q791663_beatty_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q791663
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q791663), "Beatty's theorem": complementary Beatty
% sets for Holder-conjugate real parameters, and the positive-index partition
% theorem for an irrational parameter. This file contains no proof.

Q791663_beatty_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  integer_set: TYPE = [int -> bool]

  holder_conjugate(r, s: real): bool =
    1 < r AND 1 < s AND 1 / r + 1 / s = 1

  irrational(r: real): bool =
    NOT rational?(r)

  integer_ceiling(x: real): int =
    -floor(-x)

  beatty_set(r: real): integer_set =
    LAMBDA (n: int):
      EXISTS (k: int):
        n = floor((k :: real) * r)

  beatty_prime_set(r: real): integer_set =
    LAMBDA (n: int):
      EXISTS (k: int):
        n = integer_ceiling((k :: real) * r) - 1

  positive_beatty_set(r: real): integer_set =
    LAMBDA (n: int):
      EXISTS (k: int):
        0 < k AND n = floor((k :: real) * r)

  symmetric_difference(A, B: integer_set): integer_set =
    LAMBDA (n: int):
      (A(n) AND NOT B(n)) OR (B(n) AND NOT A(n))

  compl_beattySeq: bool =
    FORALL (r, s: real):
      holder_conjugate(r, s)
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (n: int):
            (NOT beatty_set(r)(n)) IFF beatty_prime_set(s)(n)

  irrational_beattySeq_symmDiff_beattySeq_pos: bool =
    FORALL (r, s: real):
      (holder_conjugate(r, s) AND irrational(r))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (n: int):
            symmetric_difference(
              positive_beatty_set(r),
              positive_beatty_set(s))(n)
              IFF 0 < n

  beatty_s_theorem: bool =
    compl_beattySeq
      AND irrational_beattySeq_symmDiff_beattySeq_pos
END Q791663_beatty_s_theorem

title: Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem
content:
(**
  Statement-only formalization of corpus artifact Q8066795
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q8066795), catalogued as "Zariski's main
  theorem": a proper morphism of schemes whose fiber over a point is finite
  is finite after restriction to some open neighborhood of that point.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.
Import ListNotations.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Primitive Projections.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.

Definition q_set (A : Type) := A -> Prop.

Definition q_subset {A : Type} (U V : q_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x, U x -> V x.

Definition q_same_set {A : Type} (U V : q_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x, U x <-> V x.

Definition q_same_set_refl {A : Type} (U : q_set A) :
    q_same_set U U :=
  fun _ => conj (fun h => h) (fun h => h).

Definition q_same_set_symm {A : Type} {U V : q_set A}
    (h : q_same_set U V) : q_same_set V U :=
  fun x => conj (proj2 (h x)) (proj1 (h x)).

Definition q_same_set_trans {A : Type} {U V W : q_set A}
    (hUV : q_same_set U V) (hVW : q_same_set V W) :
    q_same_set U W :=
  fun x => conj
    (fun hx => proj1 (hVW x) (proj1 (hUV x) hx))
    (fun hx => proj2 (hUV x) (proj2 (hVW x) hx)).

Definition q_empty {A : Type} : q_set A := fun _ => False.
Definition q_full {A : Type} : q_set A := fun _ => True.

Definition q_inter {A : Type} (U V : q_set A) : q_set A :=
  fun x => U x /\ V x.

Definition q_compl {A : Type} (U : q_set A) : q_set A :=
  fun x => ~ U x.

Definition q_union {A I : Type} (U : I -> q_set A) : q_set A :=
  fun x => exists i, U i x.

Definition q_preimage {A B : Type} (f : A -> B) (V : q_set B) : q_set A :=
  fun x => V (f x).

Definition q_image {A B : Type} (f : A -> B) (U : q_set A) : q_set B :=
  fun y => exists x, U x /\ f x = y.

Definition q_finite_set {A : Type} (U : q_set A) : Prop :=
  exists l : list A, forall x, U x <-> In x l.

Definition q_subset_refl {A : Type} (U : q_set A) : q_subset U U :=
  fun _ h => h.

Definition q_inter_left {A : Type} (U V : q_set A) :
    q_subset (q_inter U V) U :=
  fun _ h => proj1 h.

Definition q_inter_right {A : Type} (U V : q_set A) :
    q_subset (q_inter U V) V :=
  fun _ h => proj2 h.

Record q_comm_ring (A : Type) := {
  q_zero : A;
  q_one : A;
  q_add : A -> A -> A;
  q_mul : A -> A -> A;
  q_neg : A -> A;
  q_add_assoc : forall a b c,
    q_add a (q_add b c) = q_add (q_add a b) c;
  q_add_comm : forall a b, q_add a b = q_add b a;
  q_add_zero : forall a, q_add a q_zero = a;
  q_add_neg : forall a, q_add a (q_neg a) = q_zero;
  q_mul_assoc : forall a b c,
    q_mul a (q_mul b c) = q_mul (q_mul a b) c;
  q_mul_comm : forall a b, q_mul a b = q_mul b a;
  q_mul_one : forall a, q_mul a q_one = a;
  q_left_distrib : forall a b c,
    q_mul a (q_add b c) = q_add (q_mul a b) (q_mul a c)
}.

Arguments q_zero {A} _.
Arguments q_one {A} _.
Arguments q_add {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q_mul {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q_neg {A} _ _.

Definition q_is_ring_hom {A B : Type}
    (RA : q_comm_ring A) (RB : q_comm_ring B) (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  f (q_zero RA) = q_zero RB /\
  f (q_one RA) = q_one RB /\
  (forall a b, f (q_add RA a b) = q_add RB (f a) (f b)) /\
  (forall a b, f (q_mul RA a b) = q_mul RB (f a) (f b)).

Record q_ideal {A : Type} (R : q_comm_ring A) := {
  q_ideal_contains : A -> Prop;
  q_ideal_zero : q_ideal_contains (q_zero R);
  q_ideal_add : forall a b,
    q_ideal_contains a ->
    q_ideal_contains b ->
    q_ideal_contains (q_add R a b);
  q_ideal_neg : forall a,
    q_ideal_contains a ->
    q_ideal_contains (q_neg R a);
  q_ideal_mul : forall a b,
    q_ideal_contains a ->
    q_ideal_contains (q_mul R a b)
}.

Arguments q_ideal_contains {A R} _ _.

Definition q_same_ideal {A : Type} {R : q_comm_ring A}
    (I J : q_ideal R) : Prop :=
  forall a, q_ideal_contains I a <-> q_ideal_contains J a.

Definition q_is_prime_ideal {A : Type} {R : q_comm_ring A}
    (I : q_ideal R) : Prop :=
  ~ q_ideal_contains I (q_one R) /\
  forall a b,
    q_ideal_contains I (q_mul R a b) ->
    q_ideal_contains I a \/ q_ideal_contains I b.

Definition q_is_unit {A : Type} (R : q_comm_ring A) (a : A) : Prop :=
  exists b, q_mul R a b = q_one R /\ q_mul R b a = q_one R.

Definition q_is_localization_at {A B : Type}
    (RA : q_comm_ring A) (RB : q_comm_ring B)
    (phi : A -> B) (r : A) : Prop :=
  q_is_ring_hom RA RB phi /\
  q_is_unit RB (phi r) /\
  forall (C : Type) (RC : q_comm_ring C) (psi : A -> C),
    q_is_ring_hom RA RC psi ->
    q_is_unit RC (psi r) ->
    exists theta : B -> C,
      q_is_ring_hom RB RC theta /\
      (forall a, theta (phi a) = psi a) /\
      forall theta' : B -> C,
        q_is_ring_hom RB RC theta' ->
        (forall a, theta' (phi a) = psi a) ->
        forall b, theta' b = theta b.

Fixpoint q_linear_combination {A B : Type}
    (RA : q_comm_ring A) (RB : q_comm_ring B) (phi : A -> B)
    (coefficients : list A) (generators : list B) : B :=
  match coefficients, generators with
  | a :: coefficients', b :: generators' =>
      q_add RB (q_mul RB (phi a) b)
        (q_linear_combination RA RB phi coefficients' generators')
  | _, _ => q_zero RB
  end.

Definition q_is_module_finite_algebra {A B : Type}
    (RA : q_comm_ring A) (RB : q_comm_ring B) (phi : A -> B) : Prop :=
  q_is_ring_hom RA RB phi /\
  exists generators : list B,
    forall b : B,
      exists coefficients : list A,
        length coefficients = length generators /\
        q_linear_combination RA RB phi coefficients generators = b.

Inductive q_generated_subalgebra {A B : Type}
    (RA : q_comm_ring A) (RB : q_comm_ring B) (phi : A -> B)
    (generators : list B) : B -> Prop :=
| q_generated_scalar : forall a,
    q_generated_subalgebra RA RB phi generators (phi a)
| q_generated_generator : forall b,
    In b generators ->
    q_generated_subalgebra RA RB phi generators b
| q_generated_zero :
    q_generated_subalgebra RA RB phi generators (q_zero RB)
| q_generated_one :
    q_generated_subalgebra RA RB phi generators (q_one RB)
| q_generated_add : forall b c,
    q_generated_subalgebra RA RB phi generators b ->
    q_generated_subalgebra RA RB phi generators c ->
    q_generated_subalgebra RA RB phi generators (q_add RB b c)
| q_generated_mul : forall b c,
    q_generated_subalgebra RA RB phi generators b ->
    q_generated_subalgebra RA RB phi generators c ->
    q_generated_subalgebra RA RB phi generators (q_mul RB b c)
| q_generated_neg : forall b,
    q_generated_subalgebra RA RB phi generators b ->
    q_generated_subalgebra RA RB phi generators (q_neg RB b).

Definition q_is_finite_type_algebra {A B : Type}
    (RA : q_comm_ring A) (RB : q_comm_ring B) (phi : A -> B) : Prop :=
  q_is_ring_hom RA RB phi /\
  exists generators : list B,
    forall b, q_generated_subalgebra RA RB phi generators b.

Record q_topological_space (P : Type) := {
  q_is_open : q_set P -> Prop;
  q_open_ext : forall U V,
    q_same_set U V -> q_is_open U -> q_is_open V;
  q_open_empty : q_is_open q_empty;
  q_open_full : q_is_open q_full;
  q_open_inter : forall U V,
    q_is_open U -> q_is_open V -> q_is_open (q_inter U V);
  q_open_union : forall (I : Type) (U : I -> q_set P),
    (forall i, q_is_open (U i)) ->
    q_is_open (q_union U)
}.

Arguments q_is_open {P} _ _.

Definition q_is_closed {P : Type} (T : q_topological_space P)
    (Z : q_set P) : Prop :=
  q_is_open T (q_compl Z).

Record q_open {P : Type} (T : q_topological_space P) := {
  q_open_carrier : q_set P;
  q_open_witness : q_is_open T q_open_carrier
}.

Arguments q_open_carrier {P T} _ _.
Arguments q_open_witness {P T} _.

Definition q_open_of_set {P : Type} (T : q_topological_space P)
    (U : q_set P) (hU : q_is_open T U) : q_open T :=
  {| q_open_carrier := U; q_open_witness := hU |}.

Definition q_open_subset {P : Type} {T : q_topological_space P}
    (U V : q_open T) : Prop :=
  q_subset (q_open_carrier U) (q_open_carrier V).

Definition q_open_meet {P : Type} {T : q_topological_space P}
    (U V : q_open T) : q_open T :=
  @q_open_of_set P T
    (q_inter (q_open_carrier U) (q_open_carrier V))
    (@q_open_inter P T _ _
      (q_open_witness U) (q_open_witness V)).

Record q_ringed_space := {
  q_points : Type;
  q_topology : q_topological_space q_points;
  q_sections : q_open q_topology -> Type;
  q_section_ring : forall U, q_comm_ring (q_sections U);
  q_reindex : forall U V,
    q_same_set (q_open_carrier U) (q_open_carrier V) ->
    q_sections U -> q_sections V;
  q_reindex_ring_hom : forall U V
      (h : q_same_set (q_open_carrier U) (q_open_carrier V)),
    q_is_ring_hom (q_section_ring U) (q_section_ring V)
      (@q_reindex U V h);
  q_reindex_proof_irrelevant : forall U V
      (h h' : q_same_set (q_open_carrier U) (q_open_carrier V))
      (s : q_sections U),
    @q_reindex U V h s = @q_reindex U V h' s;
  q_reindex_identity : forall U (s : q_sections U),
    @q_reindex U U
      (@q_same_set_refl q_points (q_open_carrier U)) s = s;
  q_reindex_inverse : forall U V
      (h : q_same_set (q_open_carrier U) (q_open_carrier V))
      (s : q_sections U),
    @q_reindex V U (q_same_set_symm h)
      (@q_reindex U V h s) = s;
  q_reindex_composition : forall U V W
      (hUV : q_same_set (q_open_carrier U) (q_open_carrier V))
      (hVW : q_same_set (q_open_carrier V) (q_open_carrier W))
      (s : q_sections U),
    @q_reindex V W hVW (@q_reindex U V hUV s) =
    @q_reindex U W (q_same_set_trans hUV hVW) s;
  q_restrict : forall U V,
    q_open_subset U V -> q_sections V -> q_sections U;
  q_restrict_ring_hom : forall U V (h : q_open_subset U V),
    q_is_ring_hom (q_section_ring V) (q_section_ring U)
      (@q_restrict U V h);
  q_restrict_proof_irrelevant : forall U V
      (h h' : q_open_subset U V) (s : q_sections V),
    @q_restrict U V h s = @q_restrict U V h' s;
  q_restrict_identity : forall U (s : q_sections U),
    @q_restrict U U
      (@q_subset_refl q_points (q_open_carrier U)) s = s;
  q_restrict_same_set : forall U V
      (hEq : q_same_set (q_open_carrier U) (q_open_carrier V))
      (hSub : q_open_subset U V) (s : q_sections V),
    @q_restrict U V hSub s =
    @q_reindex V U (q_same_set_symm hEq) s;
  q_restrict_composition : forall U V W
      (hUV : q_open_subset U V) (hVW : q_open_subset V W)
      (s : q_sections W),
    @q_restrict U V hUV (@q_restrict V W hVW s) =
    @q_restrict U W (fun x hx => hVW x (hUV x hx)) s;
  q_reindex_restrict : forall U U' V V'
      (hUU' : q_same_set (q_open_carrier U) (q_open_carrier U'))
      (hVV' : q_same_set (q_open_carrier V) (q_open_carrier V'))
      (hUV : q_open_subset U V) (hU'V' : q_open_subset U' V')
      (s : q_sections V),
    @q_reindex U U' hUU' (@q_restrict U V hUV s) =
    @q_restrict U' V' hU'V' (@q_reindex V V' hVV' s);
  q_sheaf_gluing : forall (I : Type) (U : q_open q_topology)
      (O : I -> q_open q_topology)
      (hOU : forall i, q_open_subset (O i) U)
      (hcover : forall x, q_open_carrier U x ->
        exists i, q_open_carrier (O i) x)
      (local : forall i, q_sections (O i)),
    (forall i j,
      @q_restrict (q_open_meet (O i) (O j)) (O i)
        (@q_inter_left q_points
          (q_open_carrier (O i)) (q_open_carrier (O j)))
        (local i) =
      @q_restrict (q_open_meet (O i) (O j)) (O j)
        (@q_inter_right q_points
          (q_open_carrier (O i)) (q_open_carrier (O j)))
        (local j)) ->
    exists global : q_sections U,
      (forall i, @q_restrict (O i) U (hOU i) global = local i) /\
      forall global' : q_sections U,
        (forall i, @q_restrict (O i) U (hOU i) global' = local i) ->
        global' = global
}.

Arguments q_points _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q_topology _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q_sections _ _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q_section_ring _ _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q_reindex _ _ _ _ _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q_restrict _ _ _ _ _ : clear implicits.

Definition q_unit_germ (R : q_ringed_space)
    (U : q_open (q_topology R)) (x : q_points R)
    (s : q_sections R U) : Prop :=
  exists (V : q_open (q_topology R)) (hVU : q_open_subset V U),
    q_open_carrier V x /\
    exists t : q_sections R V,
      q_mul (q_section_ring R V) (q_restrict R V U hVU s) t =
        q_one (q_section_ring R V) /\
      q_mul (q_section_ring R V) t (q_restrict R V U hVU s) =
        q_one (q_section_ring R V).

Arguments q_unit_germ _ _ _ _ : clear implicits.

Definition q_is_affine_open (R : q_ringed_space)
    (U : q_open (q_topology R)) : Prop :=
  exists point_prime :
      q_points R -> q_ideal (q_section_ring R U),
    (forall x, q_open_carrier U x ->
      q_is_prime_ideal (point_prime x)) /\
    (forall x (hx : q_open_carrier U x) (s : q_sections R U),
      q_ideal_contains (point_prime x) s <->
      ~ q_unit_germ R U x s) /\
    (forall x x',
      q_open_carrier U x -> q_open_carrier U x' ->
      q_same_ideal (point_prime x) (point_prime x') ->
      x = x') /\
    (forall p : q_ideal (q_section_ring R U),
      q_is_prime_ideal p ->
      exists x, q_open_carrier U x /\
        q_same_ideal (point_prime x) p) /\
    (forall W : q_open (q_topology R),
      q_open_subset W U ->
      forall x, q_open_carrier W x ->
        exists r : q_sections R U,
          let D := fun z =>
            q_open_carrier U z /\
            ~ q_ideal_contains (point_prime z) r in
          D x /\ q_subset D (q_open_carrier W)) /\
    forall r : q_sections R U,
      let D := fun x =>
        q_open_carrier U x /\
        ~ q_ideal_contains (point_prime x) r in
      exists hD : q_is_open (q_topology R) D,
        q_is_localization_at
          (q_section_ring R U)
          (q_section_ring R
            (@q_open_of_set (q_points R) (q_topology R) D hD))
          (q_restrict R
            (@q_open_of_set (q_points R) (q_topology R) D hD) U
            (fun x hx => proj1 hx))
          r.

Arguments q_is_affine_open _ _ : clear implicits.

Record q_scheme := {
  q_underlying_space : q_ringed_space;
  q_locally_affine : forall x : q_points q_underlying_space,
    exists U : q_open (q_topology q_underlying_space),
      q_open_carrier U x /\
      q_is_affine_open q_underlying_space U
}.

Definition q_scheme_points (X : q_scheme) : Type :=
  q_points (q_underlying_space X).

Definition q_scheme_open (X : q_scheme) : Type :=
  q_open (q_topology (q_underlying_space X)).

Definition q_scheme_sections (X : q_scheme)
    (U : q_scheme_open X) : Type :=
  q_sections (q_underlying_space X) U.

Arguments q_scheme_points _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q_scheme_open _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q_scheme_sections _ _ : clear implicits.

Record q_scheme_map (X Y : q_scheme) := {
  q_point_map : q_scheme_points X -> q_scheme_points Y;
  q_preimage_open : forall V : q_scheme_open Y,
    q_is_open (q_topology (q_underlying_space X))
      (q_preimage q_point_map (q_open_carrier V));
  q_pull_section : forall V : q_scheme_open Y,
    q_scheme_sections Y V ->
    q_scheme_sections X
      (@q_open_of_set (q_scheme_points X)
        (q_topology (q_underlying_space X))
        (q_preimage q_point_map (q_open_carrier V))
        (q_preimage_open V))
}.

Arguments q_point_map {X Y} _ _.
Arguments q_preimage_open {X Y} _ _.
Arguments q_pull_section {X Y} _ _ _.

Definition q_map_preimage_open {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) (V : q_scheme_open Y) :
    q_scheme_open X :=
  @q_open_of_set (q_scheme_points X)
    (q_topology (q_underlying_space X))
    (q_preimage (q_point_map f) (q_open_carrier V))
    (q_preimage_open f V).

Definition q_preimage_open_same_set {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) (U V : q_scheme_open Y)
    (h : q_same_set (q_open_carrier U) (q_open_carrier V)) :
    q_same_set
      (q_open_carrier (q_map_preimage_open f U))
      (q_open_carrier (q_map_preimage_open f V)) :=
  fun x => h (q_point_map f x).

Definition q_is_scheme_morphism {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) : Prop :=
  (forall V : q_scheme_open Y,
    q_is_ring_hom
      (q_section_ring (q_underlying_space Y) V)
      (q_section_ring (q_underlying_space X)
        (q_map_preimage_open f V))
      (q_pull_section f V)) /\
  (forall (U V : q_scheme_open Y) (hUV : q_open_subset U V)
      (s : q_scheme_sections Y V),
    q_restrict (q_underlying_space X)
      (q_map_preimage_open f U) (q_map_preimage_open f V)
      (fun x hx => hUV (q_point_map f x) hx)
      (q_pull_section f V s) =
    q_pull_section f U
      (q_restrict (q_underlying_space Y) U V hUV s)) /\
  (forall (U V : q_scheme_open Y)
      (h : q_same_set (q_open_carrier U) (q_open_carrier V))
      (s : q_scheme_sections Y U),
    q_reindex (q_underlying_space X)
      (q_map_preimage_open f U) (q_map_preimage_open f V)
      (@q_preimage_open_same_set X Y f U V h)
      (q_pull_section f U s) =
    q_pull_section f V
      (q_reindex (q_underlying_space Y) U V h s)) /\
  forall (V : q_scheme_open Y)
      (y : q_scheme_points Y) (s : q_scheme_sections Y V)
      (x : q_scheme_points X),
    q_point_map f x = y ->
    q_open_carrier V y ->
    q_unit_germ (q_underlying_space X)
      (q_map_preimage_open f V) x
      (q_pull_section f V s) ->
    q_unit_germ (q_underlying_space Y) V y s.

Definition q_identity_map (X : q_scheme) : q_scheme_map X X :=
  {| q_point_map := fun x => x;
     q_preimage_open := fun V => q_open_witness V;
     q_pull_section := fun V s =>
       q_reindex (q_underlying_space X) V
         (@q_open_of_set (q_scheme_points X)
           (q_topology (q_underlying_space X))
           (q_preimage (fun x => x) (q_open_carrier V))
           (q_open_witness V))
         (fun x => conj (fun hx => hx) (fun hx => hx)) s |}.

Definition q_compose_map {X Y Z : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) (g : q_scheme_map Y Z) :
    q_scheme_map X Z :=
  {| q_point_map := fun x => q_point_map g (q_point_map f x);
     q_preimage_open := fun V =>
       q_preimage_open f (q_map_preimage_open g V);
     q_pull_section := fun V s =>
       q_pull_section f (q_map_preimage_open g V)
         (q_pull_section g V s) |}.

Definition q_preimage_same_set {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f g : q_scheme_map X Y)
    (hpoints : forall x, q_point_map f x = q_point_map g x)
    (V : q_scheme_open Y) :
    q_same_set
      (q_open_carrier (q_map_preimage_open f V))
      (q_open_carrier (q_map_preimage_open g V)) :=
  fun x => conj
    (fun hx =>
      eq_ind (q_point_map f x)
        (fun y => q_open_carrier V y) hx
        (q_point_map g x) (hpoints x))
    (fun hx =>
      eq_ind (q_point_map g x)
        (fun y => q_open_carrier V y) hx
        (q_point_map f x) (eq_sym (hpoints x))).

Definition q_maps_agree {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f g : q_scheme_map X Y) : Prop :=
  exists hpoints : forall x, q_point_map f x = q_point_map g x,
    forall (V : q_scheme_open Y) (s : q_scheme_sections Y V),
      q_reindex (q_underlying_space X)
        (q_map_preimage_open f V) (q_map_preimage_open g V)
        (@q_preimage_same_set X Y f g hpoints V)
        (q_pull_section f V s) =
      q_pull_section g V s.

Record q_fiber_product {X Y Z : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) (g : q_scheme_map Z Y) := {
  q_pullback_scheme : q_scheme;
  q_pullback_fst : q_scheme_map q_pullback_scheme X;
  q_pullback_snd : q_scheme_map q_pullback_scheme Z;
  q_pullback_fst_morphism : q_is_scheme_morphism q_pullback_fst;
  q_pullback_snd_morphism : q_is_scheme_morphism q_pullback_snd;
  q_pullback_square :
    q_maps_agree
      (q_compose_map q_pullback_fst f)
      (q_compose_map q_pullback_snd g);
  q_pullback_universal : forall
      (W : q_scheme) (a : q_scheme_map W X) (b : q_scheme_map W Z),
    q_is_scheme_morphism a ->
    q_is_scheme_morphism b ->
    q_maps_agree (q_compose_map a f) (q_compose_map b g) ->
    exists u : q_scheme_map W q_pullback_scheme,
      q_is_scheme_morphism u /\
      q_maps_agree (q_compose_map u q_pullback_fst) a /\
      q_maps_agree (q_compose_map u q_pullback_snd) b /\
      forall u' : q_scheme_map W q_pullback_scheme,
        q_is_scheme_morphism u' ->
        q_maps_agree (q_compose_map u' q_pullback_fst) a ->
        q_maps_agree (q_compose_map u' q_pullback_snd) b ->
        q_maps_agree u' u
}.

Arguments q_pullback_scheme {X Y Z f g} _.
Arguments q_pullback_fst {X Y Z f g} _.
Arguments q_pullback_snd {X Y Z f g} _.

Definition q_is_closed_map {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) : Prop :=
  forall Z : q_set (q_scheme_points X),
    q_is_closed (q_topology (q_underlying_space X)) Z ->
    q_is_closed (q_topology (q_underlying_space Y))
      (q_image (q_point_map f) Z).

Definition q_is_ring_isomorphism {A B : Type}
    (RA : q_comm_ring A) (RB : q_comm_ring B) (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  q_is_ring_hom RA RB f /\
  exists g : B -> A,
    q_is_ring_hom RB RA g /\
    (forall a, g (f a) = a) /\
    forall b, f (g b) = b.

Definition q_is_closed_immersion {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) : Prop :=
  q_is_scheme_morphism f /\
  (forall x x', q_point_map f x = q_point_map f x' -> x = x') /\
  q_is_closed (q_topology (q_underlying_space Y))
    (q_image (q_point_map f) q_full) /\
  (forall U : q_scheme_open X,
    exists V : q_scheme_open Y,
      q_same_set (q_open_carrier U)
        (q_preimage (q_point_map f) (q_open_carrier V))) /\
  forall (V : q_scheme_open Y)
      (x : q_scheme_points X)
      (s : q_scheme_sections X (q_map_preimage_open f V)),
    q_open_carrier V (q_point_map f x) ->
    exists (W : q_scheme_open Y) (hWV : q_open_subset W V),
      q_open_carrier W (q_point_map f x) /\
      exists t : q_scheme_sections Y W,
        q_pull_section f W t =
        q_restrict (q_underlying_space X)
          (q_map_preimage_open f W) (q_map_preimage_open f V)
          (fun z hz => hWV (q_point_map f z) hz) s.

Definition q_is_quasi_compact_subset (X : q_scheme)
    (K : q_set (q_scheme_points X)) : Prop :=
  forall (I : Type) (O : I -> q_scheme_open X),
    (forall x, K x -> exists i, q_open_carrier (O i) x) ->
    exists finite_indices : list I,
      forall x, K x ->
      exists i, In i finite_indices /\ q_open_carrier (O i) x.

Arguments q_is_quasi_compact_subset _ _ : clear implicits.

Definition q_is_quasi_compact_morphism {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) : Prop :=
  forall K : q_set (q_scheme_points Y),
    q_is_quasi_compact_subset Y K ->
    q_is_quasi_compact_subset X (q_preimage (q_point_map f) K).

Definition q_induced_section_map {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y)
    (U : q_scheme_open X) (V : q_scheme_open Y)
    (hU : q_open_subset U (q_map_preimage_open f V))
    (s : q_scheme_sections Y V) : q_scheme_sections X U :=
  q_restrict (q_underlying_space X) U
    (q_map_preimage_open f V) hU
    (q_pull_section f V s).

Definition q_is_locally_finite_type {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) : Prop :=
  q_is_scheme_morphism f /\
  forall V : q_scheme_open Y,
    q_is_affine_open (q_underlying_space Y) V ->
    forall x : q_scheme_points X,
      q_open_carrier V (q_point_map f x) ->
      exists (U : q_scheme_open X)
          (hU : q_open_subset U (q_map_preimage_open f V)),
        q_open_carrier U x /\
        q_is_affine_open (q_underlying_space X) U /\
        q_is_finite_type_algebra
          (q_section_ring (q_underlying_space Y) V)
          (q_section_ring (q_underlying_space X) U)
          (@q_induced_section_map X Y f U V hU).

Definition q_is_finite_type_morphism {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) : Prop :=
  q_is_locally_finite_type f /\ q_is_quasi_compact_morphism f.

Definition q_is_finite_morphism {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) : Prop :=
  q_is_scheme_morphism f /\
  forall V : q_scheme_open Y,
    q_is_affine_open (q_underlying_space Y) V ->
    q_is_affine_open (q_underlying_space X)
      (q_map_preimage_open f V) /\
    q_is_module_finite_algebra
      (q_section_ring (q_underlying_space Y) V)
      (q_section_ring (q_underlying_space X)
        (q_map_preimage_open f V))
      (q_pull_section f V).

Definition q_is_finite_over_open {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) (V : q_scheme_open Y) : Prop :=
  q_is_scheme_morphism f /\
  forall W : q_scheme_open Y,
    q_open_subset W V ->
    q_is_affine_open (q_underlying_space Y) W ->
    q_is_affine_open (q_underlying_space X)
      (q_map_preimage_open f W) /\
    q_is_module_finite_algebra
      (q_section_ring (q_underlying_space Y) W)
      (q_section_ring (q_underlying_space X)
        (q_map_preimage_open f W))
      (q_pull_section f W).

Definition q_is_separated {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) : Prop :=
  q_is_scheme_morphism f /\
  forall PB : q_fiber_product f f,
    forall d : q_scheme_map X (q_pullback_scheme PB),
      q_is_scheme_morphism d ->
      q_maps_agree
        (q_compose_map d (q_pullback_fst PB))
        (q_identity_map X) ->
      q_maps_agree
        (q_compose_map d (q_pullback_snd PB))
        (q_identity_map X) ->
      q_is_closed_immersion d.

Definition q_is_universally_closed {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) : Prop :=
  q_is_scheme_morphism f /\
  forall (Z : q_scheme) (g : q_scheme_map Z Y),
    q_is_scheme_morphism g ->
    forall PB : q_fiber_product f g,
      q_is_closed_map (q_pullback_snd PB).

Definition q_is_proper {X Y : q_scheme}
    (f : q_scheme_map X Y) : Prop :=
  q_is_separated f /\
  q_is_universally_closed f /\
  q_is_locally_finite_type f.

Theorem Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem :
  forall (X Y : q_scheme) (f : q_scheme_map X Y)
    (y : q_scheme_points Y),
    q_is_proper f ->
    q_finite_set (fun x : q_scheme_points X => q_point_map f x = y) ->
    exists V : q_scheme_open Y,
      q_open_carrier V y /\
      q_is_finite_over_open f V.
Admitted.

title: Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q8066795
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q8066795), "Zariski's main theorem": a proper
  scheme morphism locally of finite type with finite fiber over a point becomes
  finite after restriction over an open neighborhood of that point. This file
  contains no proof.

  Carrier-independent encoding and bidirectional equivalence. Isabelle/ZF's
  object type i is the universe of sets, so each ring, topological space,
  scheme, and morphism code below contains its own carrier sets; no common
  ambient carrier, finite table, same-carrier index type, or selected code
  universe is used. A scheme code is a sheaf of commutative rings on a
  topological space, locally covered by opens identified with prime spectra.
  A morphism code is a continuous map with compatible maps on sections whose
  induced stalk maps are local. Thus ordinary schemes and scheme morphisms
  encode and decode without changing their carriers.

  The predicate q8066795_is_pullback is the categorical universal property,
  quantified over every set-coded source scheme and every compatible pair of
  set-coded morphisms. Consequently it supplies every base change directly;
  there is no pullback-closure or fullness assumption hidden in properness.
  Universal closedness quantifies over every base morphism and every object
  satisfying that pullback property. Separatedness is closedness of the
  diagonal. Hence q8066795_is_proper is definitionally exactly
  separated + universally closed + locally of finite type, the three fields
  of Mathlib's AlgebraicGeometry.IsProper. The affine coordinate-ring
  definitions of locally finite type and finite morphism, the literal finite
  point fiber, and the explicit open restriction are invariant under the
  encoding and decoding. These clauses give both directions of equivalence
  with the canonical Mathlib statement, including its (redundant but explicit)
  LocallyOfFiniteType assumption.
*)

theory Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem
  imports ZF.Cardinal
begin

subsection \<open>Set-coded commutative rings\<close>

definition q8066795_ring_carrier :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_ring_carrier(R) \<equiv> fst(R)"

definition q8066795_ring_zero :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_ring_zero(R) \<equiv> fst(snd(R))"

definition q8066795_ring_one :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_ring_one(R) \<equiv> fst(snd(snd(R)))"

definition q8066795_ring_add :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_ring_add(R) \<equiv> fst(snd(snd(snd(R))))"

definition q8066795_ring_mul :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_ring_mul(R) \<equiv> fst(snd(snd(snd(snd(R)))))"

definition q8066795_ring_neg :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_ring_neg(R) \<equiv> snd(snd(snd(snd(snd(R)))))"

definition q8066795_is_comm_ring :: "i \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_comm_ring(R) \<equiv>
    q8066795_ring_zero(R) \<in> q8066795_ring_carrier(R) \<and>
    q8066795_ring_one(R) \<in> q8066795_ring_carrier(R) \<and>
    q8066795_ring_neg(R) \<in>
      q8066795_ring_carrier(R) \<rightarrow> q8066795_ring_carrier(R) \<and>
    q8066795_ring_add(R) \<in>
      (q8066795_ring_carrier(R) \<times> q8066795_ring_carrier(R))
        \<rightarrow> q8066795_ring_carrier(R) \<and>
    q8066795_ring_mul(R) \<in>
      (q8066795_ring_carrier(R) \<times> q8066795_ring_carrier(R))
        \<rightarrow> q8066795_ring_carrier(R) \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(R).
      q8066795_ring_add(R)`\<langle>a,q8066795_ring_zero(R)\<rangle> = a \<and>
      q8066795_ring_add(R)`\<langle>a,q8066795_ring_neg(R)`a\<rangle> =
        q8066795_ring_zero(R) \<and>
      q8066795_ring_mul(R)`\<langle>a,q8066795_ring_one(R)\<rangle> = a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(R).
      \<forall>b\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(R).
        q8066795_ring_add(R)`\<langle>a,b\<rangle> =
          q8066795_ring_add(R)`\<langle>b,a\<rangle> \<and>
        q8066795_ring_mul(R)`\<langle>a,b\<rangle> =
          q8066795_ring_mul(R)`\<langle>b,a\<rangle>) \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(R).
      \<forall>b\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(R).
      \<forall>c\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(R).
        q8066795_ring_add(R)`\<langle>q8066795_ring_add(R)`\<langle>a,b\<rangle>,c\<rangle> =
          q8066795_ring_add(R)`\<langle>a,q8066795_ring_add(R)`\<langle>b,c\<rangle>\<rangle> \<and>
        q8066795_ring_mul(R)`\<langle>q8066795_ring_mul(R)`\<langle>a,b\<rangle>,c\<rangle> =
          q8066795_ring_mul(R)`\<langle>a,q8066795_ring_mul(R)`\<langle>b,c\<rangle>\<rangle> \<and>
        q8066795_ring_mul(R)`\<langle>a,q8066795_ring_add(R)`\<langle>b,c\<rangle>\<rangle> =
          q8066795_ring_add(R)`
            \<langle>q8066795_ring_mul(R)`\<langle>a,b\<rangle>,
             q8066795_ring_mul(R)`\<langle>a,c\<rangle>\<rangle>)"

definition q8066795_ring_hom :: "[i,i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_ring_hom(A,B,f) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_comm_ring(A) \<and> q8066795_is_comm_ring(B) \<and>
    f \<in> q8066795_ring_carrier(A) \<rightarrow> q8066795_ring_carrier(B) \<and>
    f`q8066795_ring_zero(A) = q8066795_ring_zero(B) \<and>
    f`q8066795_ring_one(A) = q8066795_ring_one(B) \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(A).
      f`(q8066795_ring_neg(A)`a) = q8066795_ring_neg(B)`(f`a)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(A).
      \<forall>b\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(A).
        f`(q8066795_ring_add(A)`\<langle>a,b\<rangle>) =
          q8066795_ring_add(B)`\<langle>f`a,f`b\<rangle> \<and>
        f`(q8066795_ring_mul(A)`\<langle>a,b\<rangle>) =
          q8066795_ring_mul(B)`\<langle>f`a,f`b\<rangle>)"

definition q8066795_is_unit :: "[i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_unit(R,a) \<equiv>
    a \<in> q8066795_ring_carrier(R) \<and>
    (\<exists>b\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(R).
      q8066795_ring_mul(R)`\<langle>a,b\<rangle> = q8066795_ring_one(R))"

definition q8066795_is_ideal :: "[i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_ideal(R,I) \<equiv>
    I \<subseteq> q8066795_ring_carrier(R) \<and>
    q8066795_ring_zero(R) \<in> I \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>I. q8066795_ring_neg(R)`a \<in> I) \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>I. \<forall>b\<in>I. q8066795_ring_add(R)`\<langle>a,b\<rangle> \<in> I) \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(R).
      \<forall>b\<in>I. q8066795_ring_mul(R)`\<langle>a,b\<rangle> \<in> I)"

definition q8066795_is_prime_ideal :: "[i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_prime_ideal(R,P) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_ideal(R,P) \<and> P \<noteq> q8066795_ring_carrier(R) \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(R).
      \<forall>b\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(R).
        q8066795_ring_mul(R)`\<langle>a,b\<rangle> \<in> P \<longrightarrow> a\<in>P \<or> b\<in>P)"

definition q8066795_generated_subalgebra :: "[i,i,i,i] \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_generated_subalgebra(A,B,f,G) \<equiv>
    \<Inter>{T\<in>Pow(q8066795_ring_carrier(B)).
      f``q8066795_ring_carrier(A) \<subseteq> T \<and> G \<subseteq> T \<and>
      q8066795_ring_zero(B) \<in> T \<and> q8066795_ring_one(B) \<in> T \<and>
      (\<forall>a\<in>T. q8066795_ring_neg(B)`a \<in> T) \<and>
      (\<forall>a\<in>T. \<forall>b\<in>T.
        q8066795_ring_add(B)`\<langle>a,b\<rangle> \<in> T \<and>
        q8066795_ring_mul(B)`\<langle>a,b\<rangle> \<in> T)}"

definition q8066795_finite_type_ring_hom :: "[i,i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_finite_type_ring_hom(A,B,f) \<equiv>
    q8066795_ring_hom(A,B,f) \<and>
    (\<exists>G\<in>Pow(q8066795_ring_carrier(B)).
