      Finite(G) \<and>
      q8066795_generated_subalgebra(A,B,f,G) = q8066795_ring_carrier(B))"

definition q8066795_generated_submodule :: "[i,i,i,i] \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_generated_submodule(A,B,f,G) \<equiv>
    \<Inter>{M\<in>Pow(q8066795_ring_carrier(B)).
      G \<subseteq> M \<and> q8066795_ring_zero(B) \<in> M \<and>
      (\<forall>x\<in>M. q8066795_ring_neg(B)`x \<in> M) \<and>
      (\<forall>x\<in>M. \<forall>y\<in>M. q8066795_ring_add(B)`\<langle>x,y\<rangle> \<in> M) \<and>
      (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(A).
        \<forall>x\<in>M. q8066795_ring_mul(B)`\<langle>f`a,x\<rangle> \<in> M)}"

definition q8066795_finite_ring_hom :: "[i,i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_finite_ring_hom(A,B,f) \<equiv>
    q8066795_ring_hom(A,B,f) \<and>
    (\<exists>G\<in>Pow(q8066795_ring_carrier(B)).
      Finite(G) \<and>
      q8066795_generated_submodule(A,B,f,G) = q8066795_ring_carrier(B))"

definition q8066795_localization_at :: "[i,i,i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_localization_at(A,B,f,s) \<equiv>
    q8066795_ring_hom(A,B,f) \<and> s\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(A) \<and>
    q8066795_is_unit(B,f`s) \<and>
    (\<forall>C. \<forall>g.
      q8066795_ring_hom(A,C,g) \<and> q8066795_is_unit(C,g`s) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>h. q8066795_ring_hom(B,C,h) \<and>
        (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(A). h`(f`a) = g`a) \<and>
        (\<forall>k. q8066795_ring_hom(B,C,k) \<and>
          (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(A). k`(f`a) = g`a)
          \<longrightarrow> k=h)))"

subsection \<open>Set-coded schemes\<close>

definition q8066795_points :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_points(X) \<equiv> fst(X)"

definition q8066795_opens :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_opens(X) \<equiv> fst(snd(X))"

definition q8066795_sections_map :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_sections_map(X) \<equiv> fst(snd(snd(X)))"

definition q8066795_restriction_map :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_restriction_map(X) \<equiv> snd(snd(snd(X)))"

definition q8066795_sections :: "[i,i] \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_sections(X,U) \<equiv> q8066795_sections_map(X)`U"

definition q8066795_restricts :: "[i,i,i] \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_restricts(X,U,V) \<equiv>
    q8066795_restriction_map(X)`\<langle>U,V\<rangle>"

definition q8066795_restriction_domain :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_restriction_domain(X) \<equiv>
    {\<langle>U,V\<rangle> \<in> q8066795_opens(X) \<times> q8066795_opens(X). V\<subseteq>U}"

definition q8066795_is_topology :: "[i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_topology(P,Opens) \<equiv>
    Opens \<subseteq> Pow(P) \<and> 0\<in>Opens \<and> P\<in>Opens \<and>
    (\<forall>C\<in>Pow(Opens). \<Union>C \<in> Opens) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>Opens. \<forall>V\<in>Opens. U\<inter>V \<in> Opens)"

definition q8066795_is_ringed_space :: "i \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_ringed_space(X) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_topology(q8066795_points(X),q8066795_opens(X)) \<and>
    q8066795_sections_map(X) \<in> q8066795_opens(X) \<rightarrow> range(q8066795_sections_map(X)) \<and>
    domain(q8066795_restriction_map(X)) = q8066795_restriction_domain(X) \<and>
    function(q8066795_restriction_map(X)) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(X). q8066795_is_comm_ring(q8066795_sections(X,U))) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(X). \<forall>V\<in>q8066795_opens(X).
      V\<subseteq>U \<longrightarrow>
      q8066795_ring_hom(q8066795_sections(X,U),q8066795_sections(X,V),
        q8066795_restricts(X,U,V))) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(X).
      \<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,U)).
        q8066795_restricts(X,U,U)`a = a) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(X). \<forall>V\<in>q8066795_opens(X).
      \<forall>W\<in>q8066795_opens(X).
      W\<subseteq>V \<and> V\<subseteq>U \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,U)).
        q8066795_restricts(X,V,W)`(q8066795_restricts(X,U,V)`a) =
          q8066795_restricts(X,U,W)`a)) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(X). \<forall>C\<in>Pow(q8066795_opens(X)).
      \<Union>C=U \<longrightarrow>
      ((\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,U)).
        \<forall>b\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,U)).
          (\<forall>V\<in>C. q8066795_restricts(X,U,V)`a =
            q8066795_restricts(X,U,V)`b) \<longrightarrow> a=b) \<and>
       (\<forall>t. function(t) \<and> domain(t)=C \<and>
          (\<forall>V\<in>C. t`V \<in> q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,V))) \<and>
          (\<forall>V\<in>C. \<forall>W\<in>C.
            q8066795_restricts(X,V,V\<inter>W)`(t`V) =
            q8066795_restricts(X,W,V\<inter>W)`(t`W))
          \<longrightarrow>
          (\<exists>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,U)).
            \<forall>V\<in>C. q8066795_restricts(X,U,V)`a=t`V))))"

definition q8066795_germ_equal :: "[i,i,i,i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_germ_equal(X,x,U,a,b) \<equiv>
    x\<in>U \<and> U\<in>q8066795_opens(X) \<and>
    a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,U)) \<and>
    b\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,U)) \<and>
    (\<exists>V\<in>q8066795_opens(X).
      x\<in>V \<and> V\<subseteq>U \<and>
      q8066795_restricts(X,U,V)`a = q8066795_restricts(X,U,V)`b)"

definition q8066795_germ_is_unit :: "[i,i,i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_germ_is_unit(X,x,U,a) \<equiv>
    x\<in>U \<and> U\<in>q8066795_opens(X) \<and>
    a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,U)) \<and>
    (\<exists>V\<in>q8066795_opens(X). \<exists>b.
      x\<in>V \<and> V\<subseteq>U \<and>
      b\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,V)) \<and>
      q8066795_ring_mul(q8066795_sections(X,V))`
        \<langle>q8066795_restricts(X,U,V)`a,b\<rangle> =
        q8066795_ring_one(q8066795_sections(X,V)))"

definition q8066795_is_locally_ringed_space :: "i \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_locally_ringed_space(X) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_ringed_space(X) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>q8066795_points(X). \<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(X).
      x\<in>U \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,U)).
        q8066795_germ_is_unit(X,x,U,a) \<or>
        q8066795_germ_is_unit(X,x,U,
          q8066795_ring_add(q8066795_sections(X,U))`
            \<langle>q8066795_ring_one(q8066795_sections(X,U)),
             q8066795_ring_neg(q8066795_sections(X,U))`a\<rangle>)))"

definition q8066795_prime_spectrum :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_prime_spectrum(R) \<equiv>
    {P\<in>Pow(q8066795_ring_carrier(R)). q8066795_is_prime_ideal(R,P)}"

definition q8066795_principal_points :: "[i,i,i,i] \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_principal_points(X,U,e,s) \<equiv>
    {x\<in>U. s \<notin> e`x}"

definition q8066795_is_affine_open :: "[i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_affine_open(X,U) \<equiv>
    U\<in>q8066795_opens(X) \<and>
    (\<exists>e. e \<in> bij(U,q8066795_prime_spectrum(q8066795_sections(X,U))) \<and>
      (\<forall>s\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,U)).
        q8066795_principal_points(X,U,e,s) \<in> q8066795_opens(X) \<and>
        q8066795_localization_at(
          q8066795_sections(X,U),
          q8066795_sections(X,q8066795_principal_points(X,U,e,s)),
          q8066795_restricts(X,U,q8066795_principal_points(X,U,e,s)),s)) \<and>
      (\<forall>W\<in>q8066795_opens(X). W\<subseteq>U \<longrightarrow>
        (\<forall>x\<in>W. \<exists>s\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,U)).
          x\<in>q8066795_principal_points(X,U,e,s) \<and>
          q8066795_principal_points(X,U,e,s)\<subseteq>W)))"

definition q8066795_is_scheme :: "i \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_scheme(X) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_locally_ringed_space(X) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>q8066795_points(X). \<exists>U\<in>q8066795_opens(X).
      x\<in>U \<and> q8066795_is_affine_open(X,U))"

subsection \<open>Carrier-independent morphism codes and pullbacks\<close>

definition q8066795_source :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_source(f) \<equiv> fst(f)"

definition q8066795_target :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_target(f) \<equiv> fst(snd(f))"

definition q8066795_point_map :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_point_map(f) \<equiv> fst(snd(snd(f)))"

definition q8066795_section_map :: "i \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_section_map(f) \<equiv> snd(snd(snd(f)))"

definition q8066795_preimage :: "[i,i] \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_preimage(f,U) \<equiv>
    {x\<in>q8066795_points(q8066795_source(f)). q8066795_point_map(f)`x \<in> U}"

definition q8066795_is_scheme_morphism :: "i \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(f) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_scheme(q8066795_source(f)) \<and>
    q8066795_is_scheme(q8066795_target(f)) \<and>
    q8066795_point_map(f) \<in>
      q8066795_points(q8066795_source(f)) \<rightarrow>
      q8066795_points(q8066795_target(f)) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)).
      q8066795_preimage(f,U) \<in> q8066795_opens(q8066795_source(f))) \<and>
    q8066795_section_map(f) \<in>
      q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)) \<rightarrow> range(q8066795_section_map(f)) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)).
      q8066795_ring_hom(
        q8066795_sections(q8066795_target(f),U),
        q8066795_sections(q8066795_source(f),q8066795_preimage(f,U)),
        q8066795_section_map(f)`U)) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)).
      \<forall>V\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)).
      V\<subseteq>U \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(q8066795_target(f),U)).
        q8066795_restricts(q8066795_source(f),
          q8066795_preimage(f,U),q8066795_preimage(f,V))`
          (q8066795_section_map(f)`U`a) =
        q8066795_section_map(f)`V`
          (q8066795_restricts(q8066795_target(f),U,V)`a))) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>q8066795_points(q8066795_source(f)).
      \<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)).
      q8066795_point_map(f)`x\<in>U \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(q8066795_target(f),U)).
        q8066795_germ_is_unit(q8066795_target(f),q8066795_point_map(f)`x,U,a)
        \<longleftrightarrow>
        q8066795_germ_is_unit(q8066795_source(f),x,q8066795_preimage(f,U),
          q8066795_section_map(f)`U`a)))"

definition q8066795_morphism_equiv :: "[i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_morphism_equiv(f,g) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(f) \<and> q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(g) \<and>
    q8066795_source(f)=q8066795_source(g) \<and>
    q8066795_target(f)=q8066795_target(g) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>q8066795_points(q8066795_source(f)).
      q8066795_point_map(f)`x=q8066795_point_map(g)`x) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)).
      \<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(q8066795_target(f),U)).
        q8066795_section_map(f)`U`a=q8066795_section_map(g)`U`a)"

definition q8066795_is_identity :: "[i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_identity(e,X) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(e) \<and>
    q8066795_source(e)=X \<and> q8066795_target(e)=X \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>q8066795_points(X). q8066795_point_map(e)`x=x) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(X).
      \<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(X,U)).
        q8066795_section_map(e)`U`a=a)"

definition q8066795_composes :: "[i,i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_composes(h,f,g) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(f) \<and> q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(g) \<and>
    q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(h) \<and>
    q8066795_target(f)=q8066795_source(g) \<and>
    q8066795_source(h)=q8066795_source(f) \<and>
    q8066795_target(h)=q8066795_target(g) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>q8066795_points(q8066795_source(f)).
      q8066795_point_map(h)`x =
        q8066795_point_map(g)`(q8066795_point_map(f)`x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(g)).
      \<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(q8066795_target(g),U)).
        q8066795_section_map(h)`U`a =
        q8066795_section_map(f)`q8066795_preimage(g,U)`
          (q8066795_section_map(g)`U`a))"

definition q8066795_is_pullback :: "[i,i,i,i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_pullback(f,g,p,q) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(f) \<and> q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(g) \<and>
    q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(p) \<and> q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(q) \<and>
    q8066795_target(f)=q8066795_target(g) \<and>
    q8066795_target(p)=q8066795_source(f) \<and>
    q8066795_target(q)=q8066795_source(g) \<and>
    q8066795_source(p)=q8066795_source(q) \<and>
    (\<exists>c d. q8066795_composes(c,p,f) \<and>
      q8066795_composes(d,q,g) \<and> q8066795_morphism_equiv(c,d)) \<and>
    (\<forall>T. \<forall>a. \<forall>b.
      q8066795_is_scheme(T) \<and>
      q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(a) \<and> q8066795_source(a)=T \<and>
      q8066795_target(a)=q8066795_source(f) \<and>
      q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(b) \<and> q8066795_source(b)=T \<and>
      q8066795_target(b)=q8066795_source(g) \<and>
      (\<exists>c d. q8066795_composes(c,a,f) \<and>
        q8066795_composes(d,b,g) \<and> q8066795_morphism_equiv(c,d))
      \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>u. q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(u) \<and>
        q8066795_source(u)=T \<and>
        q8066795_target(u)=q8066795_source(p) \<and>
        (\<exists>up uq. q8066795_composes(up,u,p) \<and>
          q8066795_composes(uq,u,q) \<and>
          q8066795_morphism_equiv(up,a) \<and>
          q8066795_morphism_equiv(uq,b)) \<and>
        (\<forall>v. q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(v) \<and>
          q8066795_source(v)=T \<and>
          q8066795_target(v)=q8066795_source(p) \<and>
          (\<exists>vp vq. q8066795_composes(vp,v,p) \<and>
            q8066795_composes(vq,v,q) \<and>
            q8066795_morphism_equiv(vp,a) \<and>
            q8066795_morphism_equiv(vq,b))
          \<longrightarrow> q8066795_morphism_equiv(v,u))))"

subsection \<open>Scheme-theoretic finiteness and properness\<close>

definition q8066795_is_closed_map :: "i \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_closed_map(f) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(f) \<and>
    (\<forall>C\<in>Pow(q8066795_points(q8066795_source(f))).
      q8066795_points(q8066795_source(f))-C \<in> q8066795_opens(q8066795_source(f))
      \<longrightarrow>
      q8066795_points(q8066795_target(f))-
        (q8066795_point_map(f)``C) \<in> q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)))"

definition q8066795_is_affine_morphism :: "i \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_affine_morphism(f) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(f) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)).
      q8066795_is_affine_open(q8066795_target(f),U) \<longrightarrow>
      q8066795_is_affine_open(q8066795_source(f),q8066795_preimage(f,U)))"

definition q8066795_is_closed_immersion :: "i \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_closed_immersion(f) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_affine_morphism(f) \<and> q8066795_is_closed_map(f) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)).
      q8066795_is_affine_open(q8066795_target(f),U) \<longrightarrow>
      q8066795_section_map(f)`U \<in>
        surj(q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(q8066795_target(f),U)),
          q8066795_ring_carrier(q8066795_sections(q8066795_source(f),
            q8066795_preimage(f,U)))))"

definition q8066795_is_separated :: "i \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_separated(f) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(f) \<and>
    (\<forall>p. \<forall>q.
      q8066795_is_pullback(f,f,p,q) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>d. q8066795_is_closed_immersion(d) \<and>
        q8066795_source(d)=q8066795_source(f) \<and>
        q8066795_target(d)=q8066795_source(p) \<and>
        (\<forall>x\<in>q8066795_points(q8066795_source(f)).
          q8066795_point_map(p)`(q8066795_point_map(d)`x)=x \<and>
          q8066795_point_map(q)`(q8066795_point_map(d)`x)=x) \<and>
        (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_source(f)).
          \<forall>a\<in>q8066795_ring_carrier(
            q8066795_sections(q8066795_source(f),U)).
            q8066795_section_map(d)`q8066795_preimage(p,U)`
              (q8066795_section_map(p)`U`a)=a \<and>
            q8066795_section_map(d)`q8066795_preimage(q,U)`
              (q8066795_section_map(q)`U`a)=a)))"

definition q8066795_is_universally_closed :: "i \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_universally_closed(f) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(f) \<and>
    (\<forall>g. q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(g) \<and>
      q8066795_target(g)=q8066795_target(f) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>p. \<forall>q. q8066795_is_pullback(f,g,p,q)
        \<longrightarrow> q8066795_is_closed_map(q)))"

definition q8066795_locally_of_finite_type :: "i \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_locally_of_finite_type(f) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(f) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)).
      \<forall>V\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_source(f)).
      q8066795_is_affine_open(q8066795_target(f),U) \<and>
      q8066795_is_affine_open(q8066795_source(f),V) \<and>
      V\<subseteq>q8066795_preimage(f,U) \<longrightarrow>
      q8066795_finite_type_ring_hom(
        q8066795_sections(q8066795_target(f),U),
        q8066795_sections(q8066795_source(f),V),
        q8066795_restricts(q8066795_source(f),q8066795_preimage(f,U),V)
          O (q8066795_section_map(f)`U)))"

definition q8066795_is_proper :: "i \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_proper(f) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_separated(f) \<and>
    q8066795_is_universally_closed(f) \<and>
    q8066795_locally_of_finite_type(f)"

definition q8066795_is_finite :: "i \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q8066795_is_finite(f) \<equiv>
    q8066795_is_affine_morphism(f) \<and>
    (\<forall>U\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)).
      q8066795_is_affine_open(q8066795_target(f),U) \<longrightarrow>
      q8066795_finite_ring_hom(
        q8066795_sections(q8066795_target(f),U),
        q8066795_sections(q8066795_source(f),q8066795_preimage(f,U)),
        q8066795_section_map(f)`U))"

subsection \<open>Explicit open restriction\<close>

definition q8066795_open_subscheme :: "[i,i] \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_open_subscheme(X,W) \<equiv>
    \<langle>W,
      {U\<in>q8066795_opens(X). U\<subseteq>W},
      restrict(q8066795_sections_map(X),{U\<in>q8066795_opens(X). U\<subseteq>W}),
      restrict(q8066795_restriction_map(X),
        {\<langle>U,V\<rangle>\<in>q8066795_restriction_domain(X). U\<subseteq>W})\<rangle>"

definition q8066795_restrict_to_open :: "[i,i] \<Rightarrow> i" where
  "q8066795_restrict_to_open(f,V) \<equiv>
    \<langle>q8066795_open_subscheme(q8066795_source(f),q8066795_preimage(f,V)),
      q8066795_open_subscheme(q8066795_target(f),V),
      restrict(q8066795_point_map(f),q8066795_preimage(f,V)),
      restrict(q8066795_section_map(f),
        {U\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)). U\<subseteq>V})\<rangle>"

theorem q8066795_zariski_main_local_finiteness:
  assumes morphism: "q8066795_is_scheme_morphism(f)"
    and finite_type: "q8066795_locally_of_finite_type(f)"
    and proper: "q8066795_is_proper(f)"
    and point: "y \<in> q8066795_points(q8066795_target(f))"
    and finite_fiber:
      "Finite({x\<in>q8066795_points(q8066795_source(f)).
        q8066795_point_map(f)`x = y})"
  shows "\<exists>V\<in>q8066795_opens(q8066795_target(f)).
    y\<in>V \<and> q8066795_is_finite(q8066795_restrict_to_open(f,V))"
  sorry

end

title: Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q8066795
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q8066795), "Zariski's main theorem": a proper
  morphism of schemes whose fiber over a point is finite is finite after
  restriction to some open neighborhood of that point. Schemes and morphisms
  are represented by complete structural records; each total-function
  component of a morphism is canonically fixed outside its mathematical
  dependent domain. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q8066795_ZARISKIS_MAIN_THEOREM =
  `!identity_morphism.
   !compose_morphism.
   !open_subscheme.
   !morphism_restrict.
   !fiber_product.
   !pullback_fst.
   !pullback_snd.
   !diagonal_morphism.
   let scheme_point = \X. FST X in
   let scheme_open = \X. FST (SND X) in
   let open_member = \X. FST (SND (SND X)) in
   let empty_open = \X. FST (SND (SND (SND X))) in
   let top_open = \X. FST (SND (SND (SND (SND X)))) in
   let open_inter =
     \X. FST (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND X))))) in
   let open_union =
     \X. FST (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND X)))))) in
   let section =
     \X. FST (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND X))))))) in
   let zero_section =
     \X. FST (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND X)))))))) in
   let one_section =
     \X. FST
       (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND X))))))))) in
   let add_section =
     \X. FST
       (SND
         (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND X)))))))))) in
   let mul_section =
     \X. FST
       (SND
         (SND
           (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND X))))))))))) in
   let neg_section =
     \X. FST
       (SND
         (SND
           (SND
             (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND X)))))))))))) in
   let restrict_section =
     \X. FST
       (SND
         (SND
           (SND
             (SND
               (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND X))))))))))))) in
   let point_prime =
     \X. FST
       (SND
         (SND
           (SND
             (SND
               (SND
                 (SND
                   (SND
                     (SND
                       (SND
                         (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND X)))))))))))))) in
   let principal_open =
     \X.
       SND
         (SND
           (SND
             (SND
               (SND
                 (SND
                   (SND
                     (SND
                       (SND
                         (SND
                           (SND (SND (SND (SND (SND X)))))))))))))) in
   let morphism_map = \X Y f. FST f in
   let inverse_open = \X Y f. FST (SND f) in
   let map_section = \X Y f. SND (SND f) in
   let open_le =
     \(X) (U:O) (V:O).
       scheme_open X U /\
       scheme_open X V /\
       !x:P.
         scheme_point X x /\ open_member X U x
         ==> open_member X V x in
   let is_commutative_ring =
     \(X) (U:O).
       section X U (zero_section X U) /\
       section X U (one_section X U) /\
       (!a:R.
          section X U a
          ==> section X U (neg_section X U a)) /\
       (!a b:R.
          section X U a /\ section X U b
          ==> section X U (add_section X U a b) /\
              section X U (mul_section X U a b)) /\
       (!a:R.
          section X U a
          ==> add_section X U (zero_section X U) a = a /\
              add_section X U (neg_section X U a) a =
                zero_section X U /\
              mul_section X U (one_section X U) a = a) /\
       (!a b:R.
          section X U a /\ section X U b
          ==> add_section X U a b = add_section X U b a /\
              mul_section X U a b = mul_section X U b a) /\
       (!a b c:R.
          section X U a /\ section X U b /\ section X U c
          ==> add_section X U a (add_section X U b c) =
                add_section X U (add_section X U a b) c /\
              mul_section X U a (mul_section X U b c) =
                mul_section X U (mul_section X U a b) c /\
              mul_section X U a (add_section X U b c) =
                add_section X U
                  (mul_section X U a b)
                  (mul_section X U a c)) in
   let is_ring_hom =
     \(X) (U:O) (Y) (V:O) (phi:R->R).
       (!a:R. section X U a ==> section Y V (phi a)) /\
       phi (zero_section X U) = zero_section Y V /\
       phi (one_section X U) = one_section Y V /\
       (!a:R.
          section X U a
          ==> phi (neg_section X U a) = neg_section Y V (phi a)) /\
       (!a b:R.
          section X U a /\ section X U b
          ==> phi (add_section X U a b) =
                add_section Y V (phi a) (phi b) /\
              phi (mul_section X U a b) =
                mul_section Y V (phi a) (phi b)) in
   let is_topological_space =
     \(X).
       scheme_open X (empty_open X) /\
       scheme_open X (top_open X) /\
       (!x:P.
          scheme_point X x
          ==> ~(open_member X (empty_open X) x) /\
              open_member X (top_open X) x) /\
       (!U V:O.
          scheme_open X U /\ scheme_open X V
          ==> scheme_open X (open_inter X U V) /\
              (!x:P.
                 scheme_point X x
                 ==> (open_member X (open_inter X U V) x <=>
                      open_member X U x /\ open_member X V x))) /\
       (!family:O->bool.
          (!U:O. family U ==> scheme_open X U)
          ==> scheme_open X (open_union X family) /\
              (!x:P.
                 scheme_point X x
                 ==> (open_member X (open_union X family) x <=>
                      ?U:O. family U /\ open_member X U x))) /\
       (!U V:O.
          scheme_open X U /\ scheme_open X V /\
          (!x:P.
             scheme_point X x
             ==> (open_member X U x <=> open_member X V x))
          ==> U = V) in
   let is_open_cover =
     \(X) (U:O) (family:O->bool).
       scheme_open X U /\
       (!V:O. family V ==> open_le X V U) /\
       (!x:P.
          scheme_point X x /\ open_member X U x
          ==> ?V:O. family V /\ open_member X V x) in
   let is_sheaf_of_rings =
     \(X).
       (!U:O.
          scheme_open X U
          ==> is_commutative_ring X U) /\
       (!U V:O.
          open_le X V U
          ==> is_ring_hom X U X V (restrict_section X U V)) /\
       (!U:O.
          scheme_open X U
          ==> !a:R.
                section X U a
                ==> restrict_section X U U a = a) /\
       (!U V W:O.
          open_le X V U /\ open_le X W V
          ==> !a:R.
                section X U a
                ==> restrict_section X V W
                      (restrict_section X U V a) =
                    restrict_section X U W a) /\
       (!U:O. !family:O->bool. !local_section:O->R.
          is_open_cover X U family /\
          (!V:O.
             family V ==> section X V (local_section V)) /\
          (!V W:O.
             family V /\ family W
             ==> restrict_section X V (open_inter X V W)
                   (local_section V) =
                 restrict_section X W (open_inter X V W)
                   (local_section W))
          ==> ?a:R.
                section X U a /\
                (!V:O.
                   family V
                   ==> restrict_section X U V a = local_section V) /\
                (!b:R.
                   section X U b /\
                   (!V:O.
                      family V
                      ==> restrict_section X U V b = local_section V)
                   ==> b = a)) in
   let is_prime_ideal =
     \(X) (U:O) (p:R->bool).
       (!a:R. p a ==> section X U a) /\
       p (zero_section X U) /\
       ~(p (one_section X U)) /\
       (!a:R.
          p a ==> p (neg_section X U a)) /\
       (!a b:R.
          p a /\ p b ==> p (add_section X U a b)) /\
       (!a b:R.
          section X U a /\ p b
          ==> p (mul_section X U a b)) /\
       (!a b:R.
          section X U a /\ section X U b /\
          p (mul_section X U a b)
          ==> p a \/ p b) in
   let ring_power =
     \(X) (U:O) (a:R) (n:num).
       ITLIST (mul_section X U) (REPLICATE n a)
         (one_section X U) in
   let is_localization_at =
     \(X) (U:O) (V:O) (phi:R->R) (a:R).
       is_ring_hom X U X V phi /\
       (?v:R.
          section X V v /\
          mul_section X V (phi a) v = one_section X V) /\
       (!b:R.
          section X V b
          ==> ?c:R. ?n:num. ?v:R.
                section X U c /\
                section X V v /\
                mul_section X V
                  (ring_power X V (phi a) n) v =
                    one_section X V /\
                b = mul_section X V (phi c) v) /\
       (!c:R.
          section X U c /\ phi c = zero_section X V
          ==> ?n:num.
                mul_section X U
                  (ring_power X U a n) c = zero_section X U) in
   let is_affine_open =
     \(X) (U:O).
       scheme_open X U /\
       (!x:P.
          scheme_point X x /\ open_member X U x
          ==> is_prime_ideal X U (point_prime X U x)) /\
       (!p:R->bool.
          is_prime_ideal X U p
          ==> ?x:P.
                scheme_point X x /\
                open_member X U x /\
                point_prime X U x = p /\
                (!y:P.
                   scheme_point X y /\
                   open_member X U y /\
                   point_prime X U y = p
                   ==> y = x)) /\
       (!a:R.
          section X U a
          ==> open_le X (principal_open X U a) U /\
              (!x:P.
                 scheme_point X x
                 ==> (open_member X (principal_open X U a) x <=>
                      open_member X U x /\ ~(point_prime X U x a))) /\
              is_localization_at
                X U (principal_open X U a)
                (restrict_section X U (principal_open X U a)) a) /\
       (!V:O. !x:P.
          open_le X V U /\
          scheme_point X x /\ open_member X V x
          ==> ?a:R.
                section X U a /\
                open_member X (principal_open X U a) x /\
                open_le X (principal_open X U a) V) in
   let is_scheme =
     \(X).
       is_topological_space X /\
       is_sheaf_of_rings X /\
       (!x:P.
          scheme_point X x
          ==> ?U:O.
                is_affine_open X U /\ open_member X U x) in
   let is_germ_unit =
     \(X) (U:O) (x:P) (a:R).
       scheme_point X x /\
       scheme_open X U /\
       open_member X U x /\
       section X U a /\
       ?V:O. ?b:R.
         open_le X V U /\
         open_member X V x /\
         section X V b /\
         mul_section X V (restrict_section X U V a) b =
           one_section X V in
   let is_scheme_morphism =
     \(X) (Y) (f).
       is_scheme X /\
       is_scheme Y /\
       (!x:P.
          ~(scheme_point X x)
          ==> morphism_map X Y f x = (@z:P. T)) /\
       (!U:O.
          ~(scheme_open Y U)
          ==> inverse_open X Y f U = empty_open X) /\
       (!U:O. !a:R.
          ~(scheme_open Y U /\ section Y U a)
          ==> map_section X Y f U a =
              zero_section X (inverse_open X Y f U)) /\
       (!x:P.
          scheme_point X x
          ==> scheme_point Y (morphism_map X Y f x)) /\
       (!U:O.
          scheme_open Y U
          ==> scheme_open X (inverse_open X Y f U) /\
              (!x:P.
                 scheme_point X x
                 ==> (open_member X (inverse_open X Y f U) x <=>
                      open_member Y U (morphism_map X Y f x))) /\
              is_ring_hom
                Y U X (inverse_open X Y f U)
                (map_section X Y f U)) /\
       (!U V:O.
          open_le Y V U
          ==> !a:R.
                section Y U a
                ==> restrict_section X
                      (inverse_open X Y f U)
                      (inverse_open X Y f V)
                      (map_section X Y f U a) =
                    map_section X Y f V
                      (restrict_section Y U V a)) /\
       (!x:P. !U:O. !a:R.
          scheme_point X x /\
          scheme_open Y U /\
          open_member Y U (morphism_map X Y f x) /\
          section Y U a /\
          is_germ_unit
            X (inverse_open X Y f U) x
            (map_section X Y f U a)
          ==> is_germ_unit
                Y U (morphism_map X Y f x) a) in
   let is_submodule =
     \(X) (U:O) (Y) (V:O) (phi:R->R) (N:R->bool).
       (!b:R. N b ==> section Y V b) /\
       N (zero_section Y V) /\
       (!b:R. N b ==> N (neg_section Y V b)) /\
       (!b c:R.
          N b /\ N c ==> N (add_section Y V b c)) /\
       (!a b:R.
          section X U a /\ N b
          ==> N (mul_section Y V (phi a) b)) in
   let is_finite_module =
     \(X) (U:O) (Y) (V:O) (phi:R->R).
       is_ring_hom X U Y V phi /\
       ?generators:R->bool.
         FINITE generators /\
         (!g:R. generators g ==> section Y V g) /\
         (!N:R->bool.
            is_submodule X U Y V phi N /\
            (!g:R. generators g ==> N g)
            ==> !b:R. section Y V b ==> N b) in
   let is_subalgebra =
     \(X) (U:O) (Y) (V:O) (phi:R->R) (A:R->bool).
       (!b:R. A b ==> section Y V b) /\
       (!a:R. section X U a ==> A (phi a)) /\
       A (zero_section Y V) /\
       A (one_section Y V) /\
       (!b:R. A b ==> A (neg_section Y V b)) /\
       (!b c:R.
          A b /\ A c
          ==> A (add_section Y V b c) /\
              A (mul_section Y V b c)) in
   let is_finite_type_algebra =
     \(X) (U:O) (Y) (V:O) (phi:R->R).
       is_ring_hom X U Y V phi /\
       ?generators:R->bool.
         FINITE generators /\
         (!g:R. generators g ==> section Y V g) /\
         (!A:R->bool.
            is_subalgebra X U Y V phi A /\
            (!g:R. generators g ==> A g)
            ==> !b:R. section Y V b ==> A b) in
   let is_closed_subset =
     \(X) (C:P->bool).
       (!x:P. C x ==> scheme_point X x) /\
       ?U:O.
         scheme_open X U /\
         !x:P.
           scheme_point X x
           ==> (C x <=> ~(open_member X U x)) in
   let is_closed_map =
     \(X) (Y) (f).
       is_scheme_morphism X Y f /\
       !C:P->bool.
         is_closed_subset X C
         ==> is_closed_subset Y
               (\y:P.
                  scheme_point Y y /\
                  ?x:P.
                    scheme_point X x /\
                    C x /\
                    morphism_map X Y f x = y) in
   let is_closed_immersion =
     \(X) (Y) (f).
       is_scheme_morphism X Y f /\
       !U:O.
         is_affine_open Y U
         ==> is_affine_open X (inverse_open X Y f U) /\
             (!b:R.
                section X (inverse_open X Y f U) b
                ==> ?a:R.
                      section Y U a /\
                      map_section X Y f U a = b) in
   let is_category_of_schemes =
     (T /\
     (!X.
        is_scheme X
        ==> is_scheme_morphism X X (identity_morphism X) /\
            (!x:P.
               scheme_point X x
               ==> morphism_map X X (identity_morphism X) x = x) /\
            (!U:O.
               scheme_open X U
               ==> inverse_open X X (identity_morphism X) U = U /\
                   (!a:R.
                      section X U a
                      ==> map_section X X (identity_morphism X) U a =
                          a))) /\
     (!X Y Z. !f g.
        is_scheme_morphism X Y f /\
        is_scheme_morphism Y Z g
        ==> is_scheme_morphism X Z
              (compose_morphism X Y Z f g) /\
            (!x:P.
               scheme_point X x
               ==> morphism_map X Z
                     (compose_morphism X Y Z f g) x =
                   morphism_map Y Z g
                     (morphism_map X Y f x)) /\
            (!U:O.
               scheme_open Z U
               ==> inverse_open X Z
                     (compose_morphism X Y Z f g) U =
                   inverse_open X Y f (inverse_open Y Z g U) /\
                   (!a:R.
                      section Z U a
                      ==> map_section X Z
                            (compose_morphism X Y Z f g) U a =
                          map_section X Y f
                            (inverse_open Y Z g U)
                            (map_section Y Z g U a)))) /\
     (!W X Y Z. !f g h.
        is_scheme_morphism W X f /\
        is_scheme_morphism X Y g /\
        is_scheme_morphism Y Z h
        ==> compose_morphism W Y Z
              (compose_morphism W X Y f g) h =
            compose_morphism W X Z f
              (compose_morphism X Y Z g h)) /\
     (!X Y. !f.
        is_scheme_morphism X Y f
        ==> compose_morphism X X Y (identity_morphism X) f = f /\
            compose_morphism X Y Y f (identity_morphism Y) = f) /\
     (!X Y. !f g.
        is_scheme_morphism X Y f /\
        is_scheme_morphism X Y g /\
        (!x:P.
           scheme_point X x
           ==> morphism_map X Y f x = morphism_map X Y g x) /\
        (!U:O. !a:R.
           scheme_open Y U /\ section Y U a
           ==> map_section X Y f U a = map_section X Y g U a)
        ==> f = g)) in
   let has_pullbacks =
     (!X Z Y. !f g.
       is_scheme_morphism X Y f /\
       is_scheme_morphism Z Y g
       ==> let W = fiber_product X Z Y f g in
           let p = pullback_fst X Z Y f g in
           let q = pullback_snd X Z Y f g in
             is_scheme W /\
             is_scheme_morphism W X p /\
             is_scheme_morphism W Z q /\
             compose_morphism W X Y p f =
               compose_morphism W Z Y q g /\
             (!A. !a b.
                is_scheme_morphism A X a /\
                is_scheme_morphism A Z b /\
                compose_morphism A X Y a f =
                  compose_morphism A Z Y b g
                ==> ?u.
                      is_scheme_morphism A W u /\
                      compose_morphism A W X u p = a /\
                      compose_morphism A W Z u q = b /\
                      (!v.
                         is_scheme_morphism A W v /\
                         compose_morphism A W X v p = a /\
                         compose_morphism A W Z v q = b
                         ==> v = u))) in
   let has_diagonals =
     (!X Y. !f.
       is_scheme_morphism X Y f
       ==> let W = fiber_product X X Y f f in
           let p = pullback_fst X X Y f f in
           let q = pullback_snd X X Y f f in
           let d = diagonal_morphism X Y f in
             is_scheme_morphism X W d /\
             compose_morphism X W X d p = identity_morphism X /\
             compose_morphism X W X d q = identity_morphism X) in
   let has_open_subschemes =
     (!X. !U:O.
       is_scheme X /\ scheme_open X U
       ==> let XU = open_subscheme X U in
             is_scheme XU /\
             (!x:P.
                scheme_point XU x <=>
                scheme_point X x /\ open_member X U x) /\
             (!V:O.
                scheme_open XU V <=>
                open_le X V U) /\
             (!V:O. !x:P.
                scheme_open XU V /\ scheme_point XU x
                ==> (open_member XU V x <=> open_member X V x)) /\
             empty_open XU = empty_open X /\
             top_open XU = U /\
             (!V W:O.
                scheme_open XU V /\ scheme_open XU W
                ==> open_inter XU V W = open_inter X V W) /\
             (!family:O->bool.
                (!V:O. family V ==> scheme_open XU V)
                ==> open_union XU family = open_union X family) /\
             (!V:O. !a:R.
                scheme_open XU V
                ==> (section XU V a <=> section X V a)) /\
             (!V:O.
                scheme_open XU V
                ==> zero_section XU V = zero_section X V /\
                    one_section XU V = one_section X V /\
                    add_section XU V = add_section X V /\
                    mul_section XU V = mul_section X V /\
                    neg_section XU V = neg_section X V /\
                    point_prime XU V = point_prime X V) /\
             (!V W:O.
                open_le XU W V
                ==> restrict_section XU V W =
                    restrict_section X V W) /\
             (!V:O. !a:R.
                scheme_open XU V /\ section XU V a
                ==> principal_open XU V a =
                    principal_open X V a)) in
   let has_morphism_restrictions =
     (!X Y. !f. !U:O.
       is_scheme_morphism X Y f /\ scheme_open Y U
       ==> let XU =
             open_subscheme X (inverse_open X Y f U) in
           let YU = open_subscheme Y U in
           let r = morphism_restrict X Y f U in
             is_scheme_morphism XU YU r /\
             (!x:P.
                scheme_point XU x
                ==> morphism_map XU YU r x =
                    morphism_map X Y f x) /\
             (!V:O.
                scheme_open YU V
                ==> inverse_open XU YU r V =
                    inverse_open X Y f V /\
                    (!a:R.
                       section YU V a
                       ==> map_section XU YU r V a =
                           map_section X Y f V a))) in
   let is_locally_of_finite_type =
     \(X) (Y) (f).
       is_scheme_morphism X Y f /\
       !U V:O.
         is_affine_open Y U /\
         is_affine_open X V /\
         open_le X V (inverse_open X Y f U)
         ==> is_finite_type_algebra
               Y U X V
               (\a:R.
                  restrict_section X
                    (inverse_open X Y f U) V
                    (map_section X Y f U a)) in
   let is_universally_closed =
     \(X) (Y) (f).
       is_scheme_morphism X Y f /\
       !Z. !g.
         is_scheme_morphism Z Y g
         ==> is_closed_map
               (fiber_product X Z Y f g) Z
               (pullback_snd X Z Y f g) in
   let is_separated =
     \(X) (Y) (f).
       is_scheme_morphism X Y f /\
       is_closed_immersion
         X (fiber_product X X Y f f)
         (diagonal_morphism X Y f) in
   let is_proper_morphism =
     \(X) (Y) (f).
       is_separated X Y f /\
       is_universally_closed X Y f /\
       is_locally_of_finite_type X Y f in
   let is_finite_morphism =
     \(X) (Y) (f).
       is_scheme_morphism X Y f /\
       !U:O.
         is_affine_open Y U
         ==> is_affine_open X (inverse_open X Y f U) /\
             is_finite_module
               Y U X (inverse_open X Y f U)
               (map_section X Y f U) in
   let is_scheme_geometry =
     (is_category_of_schemes /\
     has_pullbacks /\
     has_diagonals /\
     has_open_subschemes /\
     has_morphism_restrictions) in
   !X Y. !f. !y:P.
     is_scheme_geometry /\
     is_scheme X /\
     is_scheme Y /\
     is_scheme_morphism X Y f /\
     scheme_point Y y /\
     is_proper_morphism X Y f /\
     FINITE
       {x:P |
          scheme_point X x /\ morphism_map X Y f x = y}
     ==> ?V:O.
           scheme_open Y V /\
           open_member Y V y /\
           is_finite_morphism
             (open_subscheme X (inverse_open X Y f V))
             (open_subscheme Y V)
             (morphism_restrict X Y f V)`;;

title: Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q8066795,
;; "Zariski's main theorem": a proper morphism of schemes with finite fiber
;; over a point is finite over some open neighborhood of that point.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The geometry argument indexes an arbitrary universe of schemes. Predicates
;; represent the full, potentially infinite point and open-set carriers; no
;; carrier is enumerated or bounded. The coherence conditions below are the
;; many-sorted ACL2 presentation of scheme morphisms and base restriction.

(defstub q8066795-scheme-p (geometry scheme) t)
(defstub q8066795-point-p (geometry scheme point) t)
(defstub q8066795-open-p (geometry scheme open) t)
(defstub q8066795-open-member-p
  (geometry scheme open point)
  t)

(defstub q8066795-morphism-p
  (geometry source target morphism)
  t)
(defstub q8066795-morphism-apply
  (geometry source target morphism point)
  t)

(defstub q8066795-open-subscheme
  (geometry scheme open)
  t)
(defstub q8066795-preimage-open-subscheme
  (geometry source target morphism open)
  t)
(defstub q8066795-morphism-restrict
  (geometry source target morphism open)
  t)

;; These are the source predicates IsProper and IsFinite on scheme morphisms.
;; They are indexed by the complete typed morphism data, rather than being
;; untyped labels attached to an ACL2 object.

(defstub q8066795-proper-morphism-p
  (geometry source target morphism)
  t)
(defstub q8066795-finite-morphism-p
  (geometry source target morphism)
  t)

(defun-sk q8066795-point-and-open-typing-p (geometry)
  (forall (scheme open point)
    (and
     (implies
      (q8066795-point-p geometry scheme point)
      (q8066795-scheme-p geometry scheme))
     (implies
      (q8066795-open-p geometry scheme open)
      (q8066795-scheme-p geometry scheme))
     (implies
      (q8066795-open-member-p geometry scheme open point)
      (and
       (q8066795-open-p geometry scheme open)
       (q8066795-point-p geometry scheme point))))))

(defun-sk q8066795-morphism-typing-p (geometry)
  (forall (source target morphism point)
    (and
     (implies
      (q8066795-morphism-p geometry source target morphism)
      (and
       (q8066795-scheme-p geometry source)
       (q8066795-scheme-p geometry target)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q8066795-morphism-p geometry source target morphism)
       (q8066795-point-p geometry source point))
      (q8066795-point-p
       geometry
       target
       (q8066795-morphism-apply
        geometry source target morphism point))))))

(defun-sk q8066795-open-subscheme-coherence-p (geometry)
  (forall (scheme open point)
    (implies
     (q8066795-open-p geometry scheme open)
     (and
      (q8066795-scheme-p
       geometry
       (q8066795-open-subscheme geometry scheme open))
      (equal
       (if
        (q8066795-point-p
         geometry
         (q8066795-open-subscheme geometry scheme open)
         point)
        t
        nil)
       (if
        (and
         (q8066795-point-p geometry scheme point)
         (q8066795-open-member-p
          geometry scheme open point))
        t
        nil))))))

(defun-sk q8066795-preimage-subscheme-coherence-p (geometry)
  (forall (source target morphism open point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q8066795-morphism-p geometry source target morphism)
      (q8066795-open-p geometry target open))
     (and
      (q8066795-scheme-p
       geometry
       (q8066795-preimage-open-subscheme
        geometry source target morphism open))
      (equal
       (if
        (q8066795-point-p
         geometry
         (q8066795-preimage-open-subscheme
          geometry source target morphism open)
         point)
        t
        nil)
       (if
        (and
         (q8066795-point-p geometry source point)
         (q8066795-open-member-p
          geometry
          target
          open
          (q8066795-morphism-apply
           geometry source target morphism point)))
        t
        nil))))))

(defun-sk q8066795-restriction-coherence-p (geometry)
  (forall (source target morphism open point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q8066795-morphism-p geometry source target morphism)
      (q8066795-open-p geometry target open))
     (and
      (q8066795-morphism-p
       geometry
       (q8066795-preimage-open-subscheme
        geometry source target morphism open)
       (q8066795-open-subscheme geometry target open)
       (q8066795-morphism-restrict
        geometry source target morphism open))
      (implies
       (q8066795-point-p
        geometry
        (q8066795-preimage-open-subscheme
         geometry source target morphism open)
        point)
       (equal
        (q8066795-morphism-apply
         geometry
         (q8066795-preimage-open-subscheme
          geometry source target morphism open)
         (q8066795-open-subscheme geometry target open)
         (q8066795-morphism-restrict
          geometry source target morphism open)
         point)
        (q8066795-morphism-apply
         geometry source target morphism point)))))))

(defun-sk q8066795-morphism-property-typing-p (geometry)
  (forall (source target morphism)
    (and
     (implies
      (q8066795-proper-morphism-p
       geometry source target morphism)
      (q8066795-morphism-p geometry source target morphism))
     (implies
      (q8066795-finite-morphism-p
       geometry source target morphism)
      (q8066795-morphism-p geometry source target morphism)))))

(defun q8066795-scheme-geometry-p (geometry)
  (and
   (q8066795-point-and-open-typing-p geometry)
   (q8066795-morphism-typing-p geometry)
   (q8066795-open-subscheme-coherence-p geometry)
   (q8066795-preimage-subscheme-coherence-p geometry)
   (q8066795-restriction-coherence-p geometry)
   (q8066795-morphism-property-typing-p geometry)))

;; Set.Finite for the fiber f ⁻¹' {y} is represented exactly by a finite
;; duplicate-free list whose membership is equivalent, for every ACL2 object,
;; to being a source point mapped to y. The list is only an internal witness.

(defun q8066795-list-member-p (value values)
  (if (consp values)
      (or (equal value (car values))
          (q8066795-list-member-p value (cdr values)))
    nil))

(defun q8066795-no-duplicates-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (not
        (q8066795-list-member-p (car values) (cdr values)))
       (q8066795-no-duplicates-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun-sk q8066795-fiber-enumeration-p
    (geometry source target morphism point enumeration)
  (forall (source-point)
    (equal
     (if
      (and
       (q8066795-point-p geometry source source-point)
       (equal
        (q8066795-morphism-apply
         geometry source target morphism source-point)
        point))
      t
      nil)
     (if
      (q8066795-list-member-p source-point enumeration)
      t
      nil))))

(defun-sk q8066795-finite-fiber-p
    (geometry source target morphism point)
  (exists (enumeration)
    (and
     (true-listp enumeration)
     (q8066795-no-duplicates-p enumeration)
     (q8066795-fiber-enumeration-p
      geometry source target morphism point enumeration))))

(defun q8066795-finite-restriction-witness-p
    (geometry source target morphism point open)
  (and
   (q8066795-open-p geometry target open)
   (q8066795-open-member-p geometry target open point)
   (q8066795-finite-morphism-p
    geometry
    (q8066795-preimage-open-subscheme
     geometry source target morphism open)
    (q8066795-open-subscheme geometry target open)
    (q8066795-morphism-restrict
     geometry source target morphism open))))

(defun-sk q8066795-finite-restriction-exists-p
    (geometry source target morphism point)
  (exists (open)
    (q8066795-finite-restriction-witness-p
     geometry source target morphism point open)))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q8066795-zariski-s-main-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall (geometry source target morphism point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q8066795-scheme-geometry-p geometry)
      (q8066795-scheme-p geometry source)
      (q8066795-scheme-p geometry target)
      (q8066795-morphism-p geometry source target morphism)
      (q8066795-point-p geometry target point)
      (q8066795-proper-morphism-p
       geometry source target morphism)
      (q8066795-finite-fiber-p
       geometry source target morphism point))
     (q8066795-finite-restriction-exists-p
      geometry source target morphism point))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q8066795,
-- “Zariski's main theorem”: a proper scheme morphism with finite point-fiber
-- is finite over an open neighborhood of that point. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; Setω; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_; refl)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 4 _,_
infixr 3 _×_
infix  1 _↔_

record ⊥ : Set where

record ⊤ {a : Level} : Set a where
  constructor tt

¬_ : ∀ {a} → Set a → Set a
¬ A = A → ⊥

transport :
  ∀ {a b} {A : Set a}
  (P : A → Set b) {x y : A} →
  x ≡ y → P x → P y
transport P {x = x} {.x} refl px = px

record _×_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

-- A conventional disjoint sum, presented without importing a library.
data Either {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  left  : A → Either A B
  right : B → Either A B

record _↔_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

record Σ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : A → Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor _,_
  field
    fst : A
    snd : B fst

syntax Σ A (λ x → B) = Σ[ x ∈ A ] B

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record Bijection {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  field
    to       : A → B
    from     : B → A
    from-to  : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from  : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

record Finite {a : Level} (A : Set a) : Set a where
  field
    cardinality : Nat
    enumerate   : Bijection A (Fin cardinality)

record CommutativeRing (a : Level) : Set (lsuc a) where
  field
    Carrier : Set a
    0# 1#   : Carrier
    _+_ _*_ : Carrier → Carrier → Carrier
    -_      : Carrier → Carrier

    +-associative : (x y z : Carrier) → (x + y) + z ≡ x + (y + z)
    +-commutative : (x y : Carrier) → x + y ≡ y + x
    +-identity    : (x : Carrier) → x + 0# ≡ x
    +-inverse     : (x : Carrier) → x + (- x) ≡ 0#

    *-associative : (x y z : Carrier) → (x * y) * z ≡ x * (y * z)
    *-commutative : (x y : Carrier) → x * y ≡ y * x
    *-identity    : (x : Carrier) → x * 1# ≡ x
    *-distributes : (x y z : Carrier) → x * (y + z) ≡ (x * y) + (x * z)

open CommutativeRing

record RingHom {a b : Level}
               (R : CommutativeRing a)
               (S : CommutativeRing b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  field
    map       : Carrier R → Carrier S
    map-zero  : map (0# R) ≡ 0# S
    map-one   : map (1# R) ≡ 1# S
    map-add   : (x y : Carrier R) → map (_+_ R x y) ≡ _+_ S (map x) (map y)
    map-mul   : (x y : Carrier R) → map (_*_ R x y) ≡ _*_ S (map x) (map y)
    map-neg   : (x : Carrier R) → map (-_ R x) ≡ -_ S (map x)

open RingHom

record RingEquivalence {a b : Level}
                       (R : CommutativeRing a)
                       (S : CommutativeRing b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  field
    hom       : RingHom R S
    inverse   : RingHom S R
    left-law  : (x : Carrier R) → map inverse (map hom x) ≡ x
    right-law : (y : Carrier S) → map hom (map inverse y) ≡ y

record Unit {a : Level} (R : CommutativeRing a) (x : Carrier R) : Set a where
  field
    inverse       : Carrier R
    inverse-left  : _*_ R inverse x ≡ 1# R
    inverse-right : _*_ R x inverse ≡ 1# R

record LocalRing {a : Level} (R : CommutativeRing a) : Set a where
  field
    local-unit-law :
      (x : Carrier R) →
      Either (Unit R x) (Unit R (_+_ R (1# R) (-_ R x)))

record LocalRingHom {a b : Level}
                    {R : CommutativeRing a}
                    {S : CommutativeRing b}
                    (localR : LocalRing R)
                    (localS : LocalRing S)
                    (φ : RingHom R S) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  field
    reflects-units :
      (x : Carrier R) → Unit S (map φ x) → Unit R x

data GeneratedSubring {a b c : Level}
     {R : CommutativeRing a}
     {S : CommutativeRing b}
     (φ : RingHom R S)
     {I : Set c}
     (generators : I → Carrier S) : Carrier S → Set (a ⊔ b ⊔ c) where
  image     : (r : Carrier R) → GeneratedSubring φ generators (map φ r)
  generator : (i : I) → GeneratedSubring φ generators (generators i)
  add       : ∀ {x y} →
              GeneratedSubring φ generators x →
              GeneratedSubring φ generators y →
              GeneratedSubring φ generators (_+_ S x y)
  multiply  : ∀ {x y} →
              GeneratedSubring φ generators x →
              GeneratedSubring φ generators y →
              GeneratedSubring φ generators (_*_ S x y)
  negate    : ∀ {x} →
              GeneratedSubring φ generators x →
              GeneratedSubring φ generators (-_ S x)

record FiniteTypeRingHom {a b : Level}
                         {R : CommutativeRing a}
                         {S : CommutativeRing b}
                         (φ : RingHom R S) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  field
    generator-count : Nat
    generators      : Fin generator-count → Carrier S
    generates       :
      (s : Carrier S) → GeneratedSubring φ generators s

data ModuleSpan {a b c : Level}
     {R : CommutativeRing a}
     {S : CommutativeRing b}
     (φ : RingHom R S)
     {I : Set c}
     (generators : I → Carrier S) : Carrier S → Set (a ⊔ b ⊔ c) where
  zero      : ModuleSpan φ generators (0# S)
  generator : (i : I) → ModuleSpan φ generators (generators i)
  add       : ∀ {x y} →
              ModuleSpan φ generators x →
              ModuleSpan φ generators y →
              ModuleSpan φ generators (_+_ S x y)
  scale     : (r : Carrier R) → ∀ {x} →
              ModuleSpan φ generators x →
              ModuleSpan φ generators (_*_ S (map φ r) x)

record FiniteRingHom {a b : Level}
                     {R : CommutativeRing a}
                     {S : CommutativeRing b}
                     (φ : RingHom R S) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  field
    generator-count : Nat
    generators      : Fin generator-count → Carrier S
    spans           : (s : Carrier S) → ModuleSpan φ generators s

record Ideal {a : Level} (R : CommutativeRing a) : Set (lsuc a) where
  field
    member         : Carrier R → Set a
    contains-zero  : member (0# R)
    closed-add     : ∀ {x y} → member x → member y → member (_+_ R x y)
    closed-neg     : ∀ {x} → member x → member (-_ R x)
    absorbs        : (r : Carrier R) → ∀ {x} → member x → member (_*_ R r x)

record PrimeIdeal {a : Level} (R : CommutativeRing a) : Set (lsuc a) where
  field
    ideal      : Ideal R
    proper     : ¬ Ideal.member ideal (1# R)
    prime      : (x y : Carrier R) →
                 Ideal.member ideal (_*_ R x y) →
                 Either (Ideal.member ideal x) (Ideal.member ideal y)

record TopologicalSpace (a : Level) : Set (lsuc a) where
  field
    Point  : Set a
    IsOpen : (Point → Set a) → Set a

    open-extensional :
      (U V : Point → Set a) →
      ((x : Point) → U x ↔ V x) →
      IsOpen U → IsOpen V

    whole-open :
      IsOpen (λ _ → ⊤)

    intersection-open :
      ∀ {U V} → IsOpen U → IsOpen V →
      IsOpen (λ x → U x × V x)

    union-open :
      {I : Set a} (U : I → Point → Set a) →
      ((i : I) → IsOpen (U i)) →
      IsOpen (λ x → Σ[ i ∈ I ] U i x)

open TopologicalSpace

record OpenSubset {a : Level} (T : TopologicalSpace a) : Set (lsuc a) where
  field
    contains : Point T → Set a
    is-open  : IsOpen T contains

open OpenSubset

_∈_ : ∀ {a} {T : TopologicalSpace a} → Point T → OpenSubset T → Set a
x ∈ U = contains U x

record OpenSame {a : Level} {T : TopologicalSpace a}
                (U V : OpenSubset T) : Set a where
  field
    membership-equivalent :
      (x : Point T) → (x ∈ U) ↔ (x ∈ V)

openSame-reflexive :
  ∀ {a} {T : TopologicalSpace a}
  (U : OpenSubset T) → OpenSame U U
OpenSame.membership-equivalent (openSame-reflexive U) x =
  iff (λ u → u) (λ u → u)

openSame-transitive :
  ∀ {a} {T : TopologicalSpace a}
  {U V W : OpenSubset T} →
  OpenSame U V → OpenSame V W → OpenSame U W
OpenSame.membership-equivalent (openSame-transitive eUV eVW) x =
  iff
    (λ u → _↔_.forward
      (OpenSame.membership-equivalent eVW x)
      (_↔_.forward (OpenSame.membership-equivalent eUV x) u))
    (λ w → _↔_.backward
      (OpenSame.membership-equivalent eUV x)
      (_↔_.backward (OpenSame.membership-equivalent eVW x) w))

Included : ∀ {a} {T : TopologicalSpace a} → OpenSubset T → OpenSubset T → Set a
Included {T = T} U V = (x : Point T) → x ∈ U → x ∈ V

record OpenCover {a : Level}
                 {T : TopologicalSpace a}
                 (U : OpenSubset T) : Set (lsuc a) where
  field
    Index   : Set a
    member  : Index → OpenSubset T
    inside  : (i : Index) → Included (member i) U
    covers  : (x : Point T) →
              (x ∈ U) ↔ Σ[ i ∈ Index ] (x ∈ member i)

record SheafOfRings {a : Level} (T : TopologicalSpace a) : Setω where
  field
    Sections : OpenSubset T → CommutativeRing a

    sections-extensional :
      {U V : OpenSubset T} →
      OpenSame U V →
      RingEquivalence (Sections U) (Sections V)

    sections-extensional-independent :
      {U V : OpenSubset T}
      (e₁ e₂ : OpenSame U V)
      (s : Carrier (Sections U)) →
      map (RingEquivalence.hom (sections-extensional e₁)) s ≡
      map (RingEquivalence.hom (sections-extensional e₂)) s

    sections-extensional-reflexive :
      (U : OpenSubset T)
      (s : Carrier (Sections U)) →
      map
        (RingEquivalence.hom
          (sections-extensional (openSame-reflexive U))) s ≡ s

    sections-extensional-composition :
      {U V W : OpenSubset T}
      (eUV : OpenSame U V)
      (eVW : OpenSame V W)
      (s : Carrier (Sections U)) →
      map (RingEquivalence.hom (sections-extensional eVW))
          (map (RingEquivalence.hom (sections-extensional eUV)) s) ≡
      map
        (RingEquivalence.hom
          (sections-extensional (openSame-transitive eUV eVW))) s

    restrict :
      {U V : OpenSubset T} →
      Included U V →
      RingHom (Sections V) (Sections U)

    restrict-independent :
      {U V : OpenSubset T}
      (i j : Included U V)
      (s : Carrier (Sections V)) →
      map (restrict {U = U} {V = V} i) s ≡
      map (restrict {U = U} {V = V} j) s

    sections-extensional-restrict :
      {U U′ V V′ : OpenSubset T}
      (eU : OpenSame U U′)
      (eV : OpenSame V V′)
      (UV : Included U V)
      (U′V′ : Included U′ V′)
      (s : Carrier (Sections V)) →
      map (RingEquivalence.hom (sections-extensional eU))
          (map (restrict {U = U} {V = V} UV) s) ≡
      map (restrict {U = U′} {V = V′} U′V′)
          (map (RingEquivalence.hom (sections-extensional eV)) s)

    restrict-identity :
      (U : OpenSubset T) (s : Carrier (Sections U)) →
      map (restrict (λ _ u → u)) s ≡ s

    restrict-composition :
      {U V W : OpenSubset T}
      (UV : Included U V) (VW : Included V W)
      (s : Carrier (Sections W)) →
      map (restrict {U = U} {V = V} UV)
          (map (restrict {U = V} {V = W} VW) s) ≡
      map (restrict {U = U} {V = W}
             (λ x u → VW x (UV x u))) s

    glue :
      {U : OpenSubset T}
      (cover : OpenCover U)
      (local : (i : OpenCover.Index cover) →
               Carrier (Sections (OpenCover.member cover i))) →
      ((i j : OpenCover.Index cover) →
       (W : OpenSubset T) →
       (Wi : Included W (OpenCover.member cover i)) →
       (Wj : Included W (OpenCover.member cover j)) →
       map (restrict {U = W} {V = OpenCover.member cover i} Wi)
           (local i) ≡
       map (restrict {U = W} {V = OpenCover.member cover j} Wj)
           (local j)) →
      Carrier (Sections U)

    glue-restricts :
      {U : OpenSubset T}
      (cover : OpenCover U)
      (local : (i : OpenCover.Index cover) →
               Carrier (Sections (OpenCover.member cover i)))
      (compatible :
       (i j : OpenCover.Index cover) →
       (W : OpenSubset T) →
       (Wi : Included W (OpenCover.member cover i)) →
       (Wj : Included W (OpenCover.member cover j)) →
       map (restrict Wi) (local i) ≡
       map (restrict Wj) (local j)) →
      (i : OpenCover.Index cover) →
      map (restrict
             {U = OpenCover.member cover i} {V = U}
             (OpenCover.inside cover i))
          (glue cover local compatible)
        ≡ local i

    glue-unique :
      {U : OpenSubset T}
      (cover : OpenCover U)
      (s t : Carrier (Sections U)) →
      ((i : OpenCover.Index cover) →
       map (restrict
              {U = OpenCover.member cover i} {V = U}
              (OpenCover.inside cover i)) s ≡
       map (restrict
              {U = OpenCover.member cover i} {V = U}
              (OpenCover.inside cover i)) t) →
      s ≡ t

open SheafOfRings

record CommonRestriction {a : Level}
       {T : TopologicalSpace a}
       (O : SheafOfRings T)
       (x : Point T)
       (U V : OpenSubset T)
       (s : Carrier (Sections O U))
       (t : Carrier (Sections O V)) : Setω where
  field
    neighborhood : OpenSubset T
    at-point     : x ∈ neighborhood
    in-left      : Included neighborhood U
    in-right     : Included neighborhood V
    agrees       :
      map (restrict O {U = neighborhood} {V = U} in-left) s ≡
      map (restrict O {U = neighborhood} {V = V} in-right) t

record Stalk {a : Level}
             {T : TopologicalSpace a}
             (O : SheafOfRings T)
             (x : Point T) : Setω where
  field
    ring       : CommutativeRing a
    local-ring : LocalRing ring

    germ :
      (U : OpenSubset T) → x ∈ U →
      RingHom (Sections O U) ring

    germ-restricts :
      {U V : OpenSubset T}
      (UV : Included U V)
      (hx : x ∈ U)
      (s : Carrier (Sections O V)) →
      map (germ U hx)
          (map (restrict O {U = U} {V = V} UV) s) ≡
      map (germ V (UV x hx)) s

    represented :
      (z : Carrier ring) →
      Σ[ U ∈ OpenSubset T ]
        Σ[ hx ∈ (x ∈ U) ]
          Σ[ s ∈ Carrier (Sections O U) ]
            (map (germ U hx) s ≡ z)

    equal-locally :
      {U V : OpenSubset T}
      (hxU : x ∈ U) (hxV : x ∈ V)
      (s : Carrier (Sections O U))
      (t : Carrier (Sections O V)) →
      map (germ U hxU) s ≡ map (germ V hxV) t →
      CommonRestriction O x U V s t

record IsLocalizationAtElement {a : Level}
       {R S : CommutativeRing a}
       (φ : RingHom R S)
       (f : Carrier R) : Setω where
  field
    image-is-unit : Unit S (map φ f)

    factor :
      {b : Level} (T : CommutativeRing b)
      (ψ : RingHom R T) →
      Unit T (map ψ f) →
      RingHom S T

    factor-agrees :
      {b : Level} (T : CommutativeRing b)
      (ψ : RingHom R T)
      (unit-image : Unit T (map ψ f))
      (r : Carrier R) →
      map (factor T ψ unit-image) (map φ r) ≡ map ψ r

    factor-unique :
      {b : Level} (T : CommutativeRing b)
      (ψ : RingHom R T)
      (unit-image : Unit T (map ψ f))
      (h : RingHom S T) →
      ((r : Carrier R) → map h (map φ r) ≡ map ψ r) →
      (s : Carrier S) → map h s ≡ map (factor T ψ unit-image) s

record AffinePresentation {a : Level}
       {T : TopologicalSpace a}
       (O : SheafOfRings T)
       (U : OpenSubset T) : Setω where
  field
    point-prime :
      Bijection
        (Σ[ x ∈ Point T ] (x ∈ U))
        (PrimeIdeal (Sections O U))

    principal-open :
      Carrier (Sections O U) → OpenSubset T

    principal-inside :
      (f : Carrier (Sections O U)) →
      Included (principal-open f) U

    principal-membership :
      (f : Carrier (Sections O U))
      (p : Σ[ x ∈ Point T ] (x ∈ U)) →
      (Σ.fst p ∈ principal-open f) ↔
      ¬ Ideal.member
          (PrimeIdeal.ideal (Bijection.to point-prime p)) f

    principal-localization :
      (f : Carrier (Sections O U)) →
      IsLocalizationAtElement
        (restrict O {U = principal-open f} {V = U}
          (principal-inside f)) f

    principal-basis :
      (W : OpenSubset T) →
      Included W U →
      (x : Point T) → x ∈ W →
      Σ[ f ∈ Carrier (Sections O U) ]
        (x ∈ principal-open f × Included (principal-open f) W)

record AffineNeighborhood {a : Level}
       {T : TopologicalSpace a}
       (O : SheafOfRings T)
       (x : Point T) : Setω where
  field
    open-neighborhood : OpenSubset T
    contains-point    : x ∈ open-neighborhood
    is-affine         : AffinePresentation O open-neighborhood

record Scheme (a : Level) : Setω where
  field
    space          : TopologicalSpace a
    structureSheaf : SheafOfRings space
    stalk          : (x : Point space) → Stalk structureSheaf x
    stalk-extensional :
      {x y : Point space} →
      x ≡ y →
      RingEquivalence
        (Stalk.ring (stalk x))
        (Stalk.ring (stalk y))
    stalk-extensional-independent :
      {x y : Point space}
      (e₁ e₂ : x ≡ y)
      (z : Carrier (Stalk.ring (stalk x))) →
      map (RingEquivalence.hom (stalk-extensional e₁)) z ≡
      map (RingEquivalence.hom (stalk-extensional e₂)) z
    locally-affine :
      (x : Point space) →
      AffineNeighborhood structureSheaf x

open Scheme

MapsInto : ∀ {a} {X Y : Scheme a} →
           (Point (space X) → Point (space Y)) →
           OpenSubset (space X) → OpenSubset (space Y) → Set a
MapsInto {X = X} f U V =
  (x : Point (space X)) → x ∈ U → f x ∈ V

record SchemeHom {a : Level} (X Y : Scheme a) : Setω where
  field
    on-points : Point (space X) → Point (space Y)

    continuous :
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y)) →
      IsOpen (space X) (λ x → on-points x ∈ V)

    on-sections :
      (U : OpenSubset (space X))
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y)) →
      MapsInto {X = X} {Y = Y} on-points U V →
      RingHom (Sections (structureSheaf Y) V)
              (Sections (structureSheaf X) U)

    section-map-independent :
      (U : OpenSubset (space X))
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y))
      (h k : MapsInto {X = X} {Y = Y} on-points U V)
      (s : Carrier (Sections (structureSheaf Y) V)) →
      map (on-sections U V h) s ≡
      map (on-sections U V k) s

    section-naturality :
      {U₁ U₂ : OpenSubset (space X)}
      {V₁ V₂ : OpenSubset (space Y)}
      (U₁U₂ : Included U₁ U₂)
      (V₁V₂ : Included V₁ V₂)
      (h₁ : MapsInto {X = X} {Y = Y} on-points U₁ V₁)
      (h₂ : MapsInto {X = X} {Y = Y} on-points U₂ V₂)
      (s : Carrier (Sections (structureSheaf Y) V₂)) →
      map (restrict (structureSheaf X) U₁U₂)
          (map (on-sections U₂ V₂ h₂) s) ≡
      map (on-sections U₁ V₁ h₁)
          (map (restrict (structureSheaf Y) V₁V₂) s)

    on-stalks :
      (x : Point (space X)) →
      RingHom (Stalk.ring (stalk Y (on-points x)))
              (Stalk.ring (stalk X x))

    stalk-map-local :
      (x : Point (space X)) →
      LocalRingHom
        (Stalk.local-ring (stalk Y (on-points x)))
        (Stalk.local-ring (stalk X x))
        (on-stalks x)

    germ-compatible :
      (U : OpenSubset (space X))
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y))
      (h : MapsInto {X = X} {Y = Y} on-points U V)
      (x : Point (space X)) (hx : x ∈ U)
      (s : Carrier (Sections (structureSheaf Y) V)) →
      map (on-stalks x)
          (map (Stalk.germ (stalk Y (on-points x)) V (h x hx)) s) ≡
      map (Stalk.germ (stalk X x) U hx)
          (map (on-sections U V h) s)

open SchemeHom

record HomEquality {a : Level} {X Y : Scheme a}
                   (f g : SchemeHom X Y) : Setω where
  field
    points-agree :
      (x : Point (space X)) →
      on-points f x ≡ on-points g x

    sections-agree :
      (U : OpenSubset (space X))
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y))
      (hf : MapsInto {X = X} {Y = Y} (on-points f) U V)
      (hg : MapsInto {X = X} {Y = Y} (on-points g) U V)
      (s : Carrier (Sections (structureSheaf Y) V)) →
      map (on-sections f U V hf) s ≡
      map (on-sections g U V hg) s

inverseOpen : ∀ {a} {X Y : Scheme a} →
              SchemeHom X Y → OpenSubset (space Y) → OpenSubset (space X)
contains (inverseOpen f V) x = on-points f x ∈ V
is-open  (inverseOpen f V) = continuous f V

inverseMapsInto : ∀ {a} {X Y : Scheme a}
                  (f : SchemeHom X Y)
                  (V : OpenSubset (space Y)) →
                  MapsInto {X = X} {Y = Y}
                    (on-points f) (inverseOpen f V) V
inverseMapsInto f V x hx = hx

Image : ∀ {a b} {A : Set a} {B : Set b} →
        (A → B) → (A → Set a) → B → Set (a ⊔ b)
Image {A = A} f U y = Σ[ x ∈ A ] (U x × f x ≡ y)

IsClosed : ∀ {a} (T : TopologicalSpace a) →
           (Point T → Set a) → Set a
IsClosed T C = IsOpen T (λ x → ¬ C x)

record ClosedMap {a : Level}
                 {S T : TopologicalSpace a}
                 (f : Point S → Point T) : Setω where
  field
    maps-closed-to-closed :
      (C : Point S → Set a) →
      IsClosed S C →
      IsClosed T (Image f C)

record ClosedImmersion {a : Level}
                       {X Y : Scheme a}
                       (f : SchemeHom X Y) : Setω where
  field
    closed-image :
      IsClosed (space Y) (Image (on-points f) (λ _ → ⊤))

    point-injective :
      (x x′ : Point (space X)) →
      on-points f x ≡ on-points f x′ →
      x ≡ x′

    induced-topology :
      (U : OpenSubset (space X)) →
      Σ[ V ∈ OpenSubset (space Y) ]
        ((x : Point (space X)) →
         (x ∈ U) ↔ (on-points f x ∈ V))

    stalk-surjective :
      (x : Point (space X))
      (z : Carrier (Stalk.ring (stalk X x))) →
      Σ[ w ∈ Carrier
            (Stalk.ring (stalk Y (on-points f x))) ]
        (map (on-stalks f x) w ≡ z)

record OpenSubschemePresentation {a : Level}
       (X : Scheme a)
       (U : OpenSubset (space X))
       (XU : Scheme a)
       (inclusion : SchemeHom XU X) : Setω where
  field
    points :
      Bijection (Point (space XU))
                (Σ[ x ∈ Point (space X) ] (x ∈ U))

    inclusion-is-canonical :
      (x : Point (space XU)) →
      on-points inclusion x ≡ Σ.fst (Bijection.to points x)

    opens-from-ambient :
      (V : OpenSubset (space X)) →
      Included V U →
      OpenSubset (space XU)

    opens-to-ambient :
      OpenSubset (space XU) → OpenSubset (space X)

    ambient-open-inside :
      (W : OpenSubset (space XU)) →
      Included (opens-to-ambient W) U

    membership-agrees :
      (W : OpenSubset (space XU))
      (x : Point (space XU)) →
      (x ∈ W) ↔
      (Σ.fst (Bijection.to points x) ∈ opens-to-ambient W)

    ambient-opens-recovered :
      (V : OpenSubset (space X))
      (VU : Included V U)
      (x : Point (space XU)) →
      (x ∈ opens-from-ambient V VU) ↔
      (Σ.fst (Bijection.to points x) ∈ V)

    inclusion-maps-into :
      (W : OpenSubset (space XU)) →
      MapsInto {X = XU} {Y = X}
        (on-points inclusion) W (opens-to-ambient W)

    sections-agree :
      (W : OpenSubset (space XU)) →
      RingEquivalence
        (Sections (structureSheaf X)
                  (opens-to-ambient W))
        (Sections (structureSheaf XU) W)

    inclusion-sections-canonical :
      (W : OpenSubset (space XU))
      (s : Carrier
        (Sections (structureSheaf X) (opens-to-ambient W))) →
      map
        (on-sections inclusion W (opens-to-ambient W)
          (inclusion-maps-into W)) s ≡
      map (RingEquivalence.hom (sections-agree W)) s

    stalks-agree :
      (x : Point (space XU)) →
      RingEquivalence
        (Stalk.ring (stalk X (on-points inclusion x)))
        (Stalk.ring (stalk XU x))

    inclusion-stalks-canonical :
      (x : Point (space XU))
      (z : Carrier
        (Stalk.ring (stalk X (on-points inclusion x)))) →
      map (on-stalks inclusion x) z ≡
      map (RingEquivalence.hom (stalks-agree x)) z

record OpenSubschemeResult {a : Level}
       (X : Scheme a)
       (U : OpenSubset (space X)) : Setω where
  field
    object       : Scheme a
    inclusion    : SchemeHom object X
    presentation :
      OpenSubschemePresentation X U object inclusion

record SchemeCategory (a : Level) : Setω where
  field
    identity : (X : Scheme a) → SchemeHom X X
    compose  : {X Y Z : Scheme a} →
               SchemeHom Y Z → SchemeHom X Y → SchemeHom X Z

    identity-points :
      (X : Scheme a)
      (x : Point (space X)) →
      on-points (identity X) x ≡ x

    identity-sections :
      (X : Scheme a)
      (U V : OpenSubset (space X))
      (h : MapsInto {X = X} {Y = X}
        (on-points (identity X)) U V)
      (s : Carrier (Sections (structureSheaf X) V)) →
      map (on-sections (identity X) U V h) s ≡
      map
        (restrict (structureSheaf X)
          (λ x hx →
            transport
              (λ z → z ∈ V)
              (identity-points X x)
              (h x hx)))
        s

    identity-stalks :
      (X : Scheme a)
      (x : Point (space X))
      (z : Carrier
        (Stalk.ring
          (stalk X (on-points (identity X) x)))) →
      map (on-stalks (identity X) x) z ≡
      map
        (RingEquivalence.hom
          (stalk-extensional X (identity-points X x)))
        z

    compose-points :
      {X Y Z : Scheme a}
      (g : SchemeHom Y Z)
      (f : SchemeHom X Y)
      (x : Point (space X)) →
      on-points (compose g f) x ≡
      on-points g (on-points f x)

    compose-sections :
      {X Y Z : Scheme a}
      (g : SchemeHom Y Z)
      (f : SchemeHom X Y)
      (U : OpenSubset (space X))
      (W : OpenSubset (space Z))
      (h : MapsInto {X = X} {Y = Z}
        (on-points (compose g f)) U W)
      (s : Carrier (Sections (structureSheaf Z) W)) →
      map (on-sections (compose g f) U W h) s ≡
      map
        (on-sections f U (inverseOpen g W)
          (λ x hx →
            transport
              (λ z → z ∈ W)
              (compose-points g f x)
              (h x hx)))
        (map
          (on-sections g (inverseOpen g W) W
            (inverseMapsInto g W))
          s)

    compose-stalks :
      {X Y Z : Scheme a}
      (g : SchemeHom Y Z)
      (f : SchemeHom X Y)
      (x : Point (space X))
      (z : Carrier
        (Stalk.ring
          (stalk Z (on-points (compose g f) x)))) →
      map (on-stalks (compose g f) x) z ≡
      map (on-stalks f x)
        (map (on-stalks g (on-points f x))
          (map
            (RingEquivalence.hom
              (stalk-extensional Z (compose-points g f x)))
            z))

    left-identity  :
      {X Y : Scheme a} (f : SchemeHom X Y) →
      HomEquality (compose (identity Y) f) f
    right-identity :
      {X Y : Scheme a} (f : SchemeHom X Y) →
      HomEquality (compose f (identity X)) f
    associative :
      {W X Y Z : Scheme a}
      (h : SchemeHom Y Z)
      (g : SchemeHom X Y)
      (f : SchemeHom W X) →
      HomEquality (compose h (compose g f)) (compose (compose h g) f)

    pullback-object :
      {X Y Z : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Z)
      (g : SchemeHom Y Z) →
      Scheme a

    pullback-left :
      {X Y Z : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Z)
      (g : SchemeHom Y Z) →
      SchemeHom (pullback-object f g) X

    pullback-right :
      {X Y Z : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Z)
      (g : SchemeHom Y Z) →
      SchemeHom (pullback-object f g) Y

    pullback-commutes :
      {X Y Z : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Z)
      (g : SchemeHom Y Z) →
      HomEquality
        (compose f (pullback-left f g))
        (compose g (pullback-right f g))

    pullback-lift :
      {W X Y Z : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Z)
      (g : SchemeHom Y Z)
      (u : SchemeHom W X)
      (v : SchemeHom W Y) →
      HomEquality (compose f u) (compose g v) →
      SchemeHom W (pullback-object f g)

    pullback-lift-left :
      {W X Y Z : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Z)
      (g : SchemeHom Y Z)
      (u : SchemeHom W X)
      (v : SchemeHom W Y)
      (commutes : HomEquality (compose f u) (compose g v)) →
      HomEquality
        (compose (pullback-left f g)
                 (pullback-lift f g u v commutes))
        u

    pullback-lift-right :
      {W X Y Z : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Z)
      (g : SchemeHom Y Z)
      (u : SchemeHom W X)
      (v : SchemeHom W Y)
      (commutes : HomEquality (compose f u) (compose g v)) →
      HomEquality
        (compose (pullback-right f g)
                 (pullback-lift f g u v commutes))
        v

    pullback-unique :
      {W X Y Z : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Z)
      (g : SchemeHom Y Z)
      (u : SchemeHom W X)
      (v : SchemeHom W Y)
      (commutes : HomEquality (compose f u) (compose g v))
      (h : SchemeHom W (pullback-object f g)) →
      HomEquality (compose (pullback-left f g) h) u →
      HomEquality (compose (pullback-right f g) h) v →
      HomEquality h (pullback-lift f g u v commutes)

    diagonal :
      {X Y : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Y) →
      SchemeHom X (pullback-object f f)

    diagonal-left :
      {X Y : Scheme a} (f : SchemeHom X Y) →
      HomEquality
        (compose (pullback-left f f) (diagonal f))
        (identity X)

    diagonal-right :
      {X Y : Scheme a} (f : SchemeHom X Y) →
      HomEquality
        (compose (pullback-right f f) (diagonal f))
        (identity X)

    open-subscheme :
