      (X : Scheme a) (U : OpenSubset (space X)) →
      OpenSubschemeResult X U

    open-subscheme-compare :
      (X : Scheme a)
      (U : OpenSubset (space X))
      (A B : OpenSubschemeResult X U) →
      SchemeHom
        (OpenSubschemeResult.object A)
        (OpenSubschemeResult.object B)

    open-subscheme-compare-over :
      (X : Scheme a)
      (U : OpenSubset (space X))
      (A B : OpenSubschemeResult X U) →
      HomEquality
        (compose
          (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion B)
          (open-subscheme-compare X U A B))
        (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion A)

    open-subscheme-compare-left-inverse :
      (X : Scheme a)
      (U : OpenSubset (space X))
      (A B : OpenSubschemeResult X U) →
      HomEquality
        (compose
          (open-subscheme-compare X U B A)
          (open-subscheme-compare X U A B))
        (identity (OpenSubschemeResult.object A))

    open-subscheme-compare-right-inverse :
      (X : Scheme a)
      (U : OpenSubset (space X))
      (A B : OpenSubschemeResult X U) →
      HomEquality
        (compose
          (open-subscheme-compare X U A B)
          (open-subscheme-compare X U B A))
        (identity (OpenSubschemeResult.object B))

    open-subscheme-compare-unique :
      (X : Scheme a)
      (U : OpenSubset (space X))
      (A B : OpenSubschemeResult X U)
      (h : SchemeHom
        (OpenSubschemeResult.object A)
        (OpenSubschemeResult.object B)) →
      HomEquality
        (compose (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion B) h)
        (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion A) →
      HomEquality h (open-subscheme-compare X U A B)

    restriction-source-open :
      {X Y : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Y)
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y)) →
      OpenSubschemePresentation
        X
        (inverseOpen f V)
        (pullback-object f
          (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion (open-subscheme Y V)))
        (pullback-left f
          (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion (open-subscheme Y V)))

    restriction-source-compare :
      {X Y : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Y)
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y))
      (A B : OpenSubschemeResult Y V) →
      SchemeHom
        (pullback-object f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion A))
        (pullback-object f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion B))

    restriction-source-compare-over-source :
      {X Y : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Y)
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y))
      (A B : OpenSubschemeResult Y V) →
      HomEquality
        (compose
          (pullback-left f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion B))
          (restriction-source-compare f V A B))
        (pullback-left f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion A))

    restriction-arrows-compatible :
      {X Y : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Y)
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y))
      (A B : OpenSubschemeResult Y V) →
      HomEquality
        (compose
          (pullback-right f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion B))
          (restriction-source-compare f V A B))
        (compose
          (open-subscheme-compare Y V A B)
          (pullback-right f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion A)))

    restriction-source-compare-left-inverse :
      {X Y : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Y)
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y))
      (A B : OpenSubschemeResult Y V) →
      HomEquality
        (compose
          (restriction-source-compare f V B A)
          (restriction-source-compare f V A B))
        (identity
          (pullback-object f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion A)))

    restriction-source-compare-right-inverse :
      {X Y : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Y)
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y))
      (A B : OpenSubschemeResult Y V) →
      HomEquality
        (compose
          (restriction-source-compare f V A B)
          (restriction-source-compare f V B A))
        (identity
          (pullback-object f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion B)))

    restriction-source-compare-unique :
      {X Y : Scheme a}
      (f : SchemeHom X Y)
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y))
      (A B : OpenSubschemeResult Y V)
      (h : SchemeHom
        (pullback-object f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion A))
        (pullback-object f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion B))) →
      HomEquality
        (compose
          (pullback-left f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion B)) h)
        (pullback-left f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion A)) →
      HomEquality
        (compose
          (pullback-right f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion B)) h)
        (compose
          (open-subscheme-compare Y V A B)
          (pullback-right f (OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion A))) →
      HomEquality h (restriction-source-compare f V A B)

open SchemeCategory

restrictionTarget : ∀ {a} (C : SchemeCategory a)
                    {Y : Scheme a} →
                    OpenSubset (space Y) → Scheme a
restrictionTarget C {Y = Y} V =
  OpenSubschemeResult.object (open-subscheme C Y V)

restrictionInclusion : ∀ {a} (C : SchemeCategory a)
                       {Y : Scheme a}
                       (V : OpenSubset (space Y)) →
                       SchemeHom (restrictionTarget C V) Y
restrictionInclusion C {Y = Y} V =
  OpenSubschemeResult.inclusion (open-subscheme C Y V)

restrictionSource : ∀ {a} (C : SchemeCategory a)
                    {X Y : Scheme a} →
                    SchemeHom X Y →
                    (V : OpenSubset (space Y)) → Scheme a
restrictionSource C f V =
  pullback-object C f (restrictionInclusion C V)

restrictionArrow : ∀ {a} (C : SchemeCategory a)
                   {X Y : Scheme a}
                   (f : SchemeHom X Y)
                   (V : OpenSubset (space Y)) →
                   SchemeHom (restrictionSource C f V)
                             (restrictionTarget C V)
restrictionArrow C f V =
  pullback-right C f (restrictionInclusion C V)

record AffineFiniteTypeNeighborhood {a : Level}
       {X Y : Scheme a}
       (f : SchemeHom X Y)
       (x : Point (space X)) : Setω where
  field
    source-open     : OpenSubset (space X)
    target-open     : OpenSubset (space Y)
    source-contains : x ∈ source-open
    target-contains : on-points f x ∈ target-open
    maps-into       :
      MapsInto {X = X} {Y = Y}
        (on-points f) source-open target-open
    source-affine   :
      AffinePresentation (structureSheaf X) source-open
    target-affine   :
      AffinePresentation (structureSheaf Y) target-open
    finite-type-map :
      FiniteTypeRingHom
        (on-sections f source-open target-open maps-into)

record LocallyOfFiniteType {a : Level}
                           {X Y : Scheme a}
                           (f : SchemeHom X Y) : Setω where
  field
    affine-neighborhoods :
      (x : Point (space X)) →
      AffineFiniteTypeNeighborhood f x

IsSeparated : ∀ {a} (C : SchemeCategory a) {X Y : Scheme a} →
              SchemeHom X Y → Setω
IsSeparated C f = ClosedImmersion (diagonal C f)

UniversallyClosed : ∀ {a} (C : SchemeCategory a) {X Y : Scheme a} →
                    SchemeHom X Y → Setω
UniversallyClosed {a = a} C {Y = Y} f =
  (Y′ : Scheme a) →
  (g : SchemeHom Y′ Y) →
  ClosedMap
    {S = space (pullback-object C f g)}
    {T = space Y′}
    (on-points
      (pullback-right C f g))

record IsProper {a : Level}
                {X Y : Scheme a}
                (f : SchemeHom X Y) : Setω where
  field
    category            : SchemeCategory a
    locally-finite-type : LocallyOfFiniteType f
    separated           : IsSeparated category f
    universally-closed  : UniversallyClosed category f

record IsFinite {a : Level}
                {X Y : Scheme a}
                (f : SchemeHom X Y) : Setω where
  field
    affine-preimages :
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y)) →
      AffinePresentation (structureSheaf Y) V →
      AffinePresentation (structureSheaf X) (inverseOpen f V)

    finite-on-coordinate-rings :
      (V : OpenSubset (space Y))
      (affineV : AffinePresentation (structureSheaf Y) V) →
      FiniteRingHom
        (on-sections f (inverseOpen f V) V
          (inverseMapsInto f V))

Fiber : ∀ {a} {X Y : Scheme a} →
        SchemeHom X Y → Point (space Y) → Set a
Fiber {X = X} f y =
  Σ[ x ∈ Point (space X) ] (on-points f x ≡ y)

record FiniteNeighborhoodConclusion {a : Level}
       {X Y : Scheme a}
       (f : SchemeHom X Y)
       (proper : IsProper f)
       (y : Point (space Y)) : Setω where
  field
    neighborhood : OpenSubset (space Y)
    contains     : y ∈ neighborhood
    finite       :
      IsFinite
        (restrictionArrow
          (IsProper.category proper)
          f
          neighborhood)

ZariskiMainTheoremStatement : Setω
ZariskiMainTheoremStatement =
  {a : Level} →
  {X Y : Scheme a} →
  (f : SchemeHom X Y) →
  (proper : IsProper f) →
  (y : Point (space Y)) →
  Finite (Fiber f y) →
  FiniteNeighborhoodConclusion f proper y

title: Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q8066795 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q8066795), "Zariski's main theorem":
  a proper morphism of schemes with a finite fiber over a point is finite
  over an open neighborhood of that point. Schemes, scheme morphisms,
  properness, finiteness, open subschemes, and restrictions use complete
  extensional encodings below. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory topologyTheory arithmeticTheory;

val q8066795_comm_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q8066795_comm_ring_def",
  ``q8066795_comm_ring
      (carrier : 'a set) (z : 'a) (u : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (pow : 'a -> num -> 'a) <=>
      z IN carrier /\ u IN carrier /\
      (!a b. a IN carrier /\ b IN carrier ==>
        add a b IN carrier /\ mul a b IN carrier) /\
      (!a. a IN carrier ==> neg a IN carrier) /\
      (!a b c. a IN carrier /\ b IN carrier /\ c IN carrier ==>
        add (add a b) c = add a (add b c) /\
        mul (mul a b) c = mul a (mul b c)) /\
      (!a b. a IN carrier /\ b IN carrier ==>
        add a b = add b a /\ mul a b = mul b a) /\
      (!a. a IN carrier ==>
        add z a = a /\ mul u a = a /\ add (neg a) a = z) /\
      (!a b c. a IN carrier /\ b IN carrier /\ c IN carrier ==>
        mul a (add b c) = add (mul a b) (mul a c)) /\
      (!a. a IN carrier ==>
        pow a 0 = u /\ (!n. pow a (SUC n) = mul a (pow a n)))``);

val q8066795_ring_hom_def = new_definition (
  "q8066795_ring_hom_def",
  ``q8066795_ring_hom
      (ring_a : 'a set) (zA : 'a) (oA : 'a)
      (addA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mulA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (negA : 'a -> 'a) (powA : 'a -> num -> 'a)
      (ring_b : 'a set) (zB : 'a) (oB : 'a)
      (addB : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mulB : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (negB : 'a -> 'a) (powB : 'a -> num -> 'a)
      (phi : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      q8066795_comm_ring ring_a zA oA addA mulA negA powA /\
      q8066795_comm_ring ring_b zB oB addB mulB negB powB /\
      (!a. a IN ring_a ==> phi a IN ring_b) /\
      phi zA = zB /\ phi oA = oB /\
      (!a b. a IN ring_a /\ b IN ring_a ==>
        phi (addA a b) = addB (phi a) (phi b) /\
        phi (mulA a b) = mulB (phi a) (phi b) /\
        phi (negA a) = negB (phi a) /\
        (!n. phi (powA a n) = powB (phi a) n))``);

val q8066795_germ_eq_def = new_definition (
  "q8066795_germ_eq_def",
  ``q8066795_germ_eq
      (pts : 's -> 'p set) (top : 's -> 'p topology)
      (sections : 's -> 'p set -> 'a set)
      (res : 's -> 'p set -> 'p set -> 'a -> 'a)
      (sch : 's) (x : 'p) (u_open : 'p set) (a : 'a)
      (v_open : 'p set) (b : 'a) <=>
      x IN u_open /\ x IN v_open /\ a IN sections sch u_open /\ b IN sections sch v_open /\
      ?w_open. open_in (top sch) w_open /\ x IN w_open /\ w_open SUBSET u_open INTER v_open /\
          res sch u_open w_open a = res sch v_open w_open b``);

val q8066795_germ_unit_def = new_definition (
  "q8066795_germ_unit_def",
  ``q8066795_germ_unit
      (pts : 's -> 'p set) (top : 's -> 'p topology)
      (sections : 's -> 'p set -> 'a set)
      (ring_one : 's -> 'p set -> 'a)
      (mul : 's -> 'p set -> 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (res : 's -> 'p set -> 'p set -> 'a -> 'a)
      (sch : 's) (x : 'p) (u_open : 'p set) (a : 'a) <=>
      x IN u_open /\ a IN sections sch u_open /\
      ?v_open b c.
        open_in (top sch) v_open /\ x IN v_open /\ v_open SUBSET u_open /\
        b IN sections sch v_open /\ c IN sections sch v_open /\
        q8066795_germ_eq pts top sections res sch x u_open a v_open b /\
        mul sch v_open b c = ring_one sch v_open``);

val q8066795_prime_ideal_def = new_definition (
  "q8066795_prime_ideal_def",
  ``q8066795_prime_ideal
      (ring_a : 'a set) (z : 'a) (u : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (ideal : 'a set) <=>
      ideal SUBSET ring_a /\ z IN ideal /\ ~(u IN ideal) /\
      (!a. a IN ideal ==> neg a IN ideal) /\
      (!a b. a IN ideal /\ b IN ideal ==> add a b IN ideal) /\
      (!a b. a IN ring_a /\ b IN ideal ==> mul a b IN ideal) /\
      (!a b. a IN ring_a /\ b IN ring_a /\ mul a b IN ideal ==>
        a IN ideal \/ b IN ideal)``);

val q8066795_sheaf_of_local_rings_def = new_definition (
  "q8066795_sheaf_of_local_rings_def",
  ``q8066795_sheaf_of_local_rings
      (pts : 's -> 'p set) (top : 's -> 'p topology)
      (sections : 's -> 'p set -> 'a set)
      (zero : 's -> 'p set -> 'a) (ring_one : 's -> 'p set -> 'a)
      (add : 's -> 'p set -> 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (mul : 's -> 'p set -> 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 's -> 'p set -> 'a -> 'a)
      (pow : 's -> 'p set -> 'a -> num -> 'a)
      (res : 's -> 'p set -> 'p set -> 'a -> 'a)
      (sch : 's) <=>
      topspace (top sch) = pts sch /\
      (!u_open. open_in (top sch) u_open ==>
        q8066795_comm_ring
          (sections sch u_open) (zero sch u_open) (ring_one sch u_open)
          (add sch u_open) (mul sch u_open) (neg sch u_open) (pow sch u_open)) /\
      (!u_open v_open. open_in (top sch) u_open /\ open_in (top sch) v_open /\ v_open SUBSET u_open ==>

val q8066795_geometry_def = new_definition (

val q8066795_locally_finite_type_def = new_definition (

val exists_isFinite_morphismRestrict_of_finite_preimage_singleton =
  ``!(schemes : 's set) (morphisms : 'm set)
      (pts : 's -> 'p set) (top : 's -> 'p topology)
      (sections : 's -> 'p set -> 'a set)
      (zero : 's -> 'p set -> 'a) (ring_one : 's -> 'p set -> 'a)
      (add : 's -> 'p set -> 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (mul : 's -> 'p set -> 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 's -> 'p set -> 'a -> 'a)
      (pow : 's -> 'p set -> 'a -> num -> 'a)
      (res : 's -> 'p set -> 'p set -> 'a -> 'a)
      (dom : 'm -> 's) (cod : 'm -> 's)
      (base : 'm -> 'p -> 'p)
      (on_sec : 'm -> 'p set -> 'a -> 'a)
      (id_mor : 's -> 'm) (comp : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (open_obj : 's -> 'p set -> 's)
      (open_inclusion : 's -> 'p set -> 'm)
      (restrict : 'm -> 'p set -> 'm)
      (pullback_obj : 'm -> 'm -> 's)
      (pullback_fst : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (pullback_snd : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (pullback_lift : 'm -> 'm -> 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (diagonal : 'm -> 'm)
      (source : 's) (target : 's) (f : 'm) (y : 'p).
      q8066795_geometry
        schemes morphisms pts top sections zero ring_one add mul neg pow res
        dom cod base on_sec id_mor comp open_obj open_inclusion restrict
        pullback_obj pullback_fst pullback_snd pullback_lift diagonal /\
      f IN morphisms /\ dom f = source /\ cod f = target /\
      y IN pts target /\
      q8066795_proper_morphism
        morphisms pts top sections zero ring_one add mul neg pow res
        dom cod base on_sec comp diagonal f /\
      FINITE {x | x IN pts source /\ base f x = y}
      ==>

        q8066795_finite_morphism
          pts top sections zero ring_one add mul neg pow res
          dom cod base on_sec (restrict f v_open)``;

title: Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q8066795
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q8066795), "Zariski's main theorem": a proper
  morphism of schemes whose fiber over a point is finite is finite over some
  open neighborhood of that point. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A scheme X is encoded as a six-entry function. Its entries are respectively
  the point set, topology, rings of sections, restriction homomorphisms,
  point-prime maps on affine opens, and principal-open maps. Q8066795Scheme
  gives the sheaf axioms and an affine-open cover; Q8066795Affine identifies
  every affine open with the prime spectrum of its section ring, including
  the principal-open localization property.

  All stored map families have exact domains: restriction maps are indexed by
  nested open pairs, point-prime and principal-open data by their typed open
  pairs, and morphism section maps by the target topology. A morphism f is a
  five-entry function containing its source, target, continuous point map,
  inverse-image map on opens, and compatible local homomorphisms on sections.
  Properness is expanded as separatedness, universal closedness, and local
  finite type. Pullbacks are characterized by their categorical universal
  property, and finiteness is the affine-local finite-module condition.

  Q8066795FiniteOnOpen f V unfolds finiteness of the canonical restriction of
  f over V: affine opens of the open subscheme V are exactly the affine opens
  of the target contained in V, with the same section rings. Thus the final
  assertion preserves the source's internal existential neighborhood and its
  unrestricted scheme, point, and fiber domains. All declarations below are
  syntax or transparent definitions; the final $a is unproved and there is no
  $p proof statement in this file.
$)

$c Q8066795Localization Q8066795Affine Q8066795Scheme
   Q8066795GermUnit Q8066795Morphism
   Q8066795FiniteModule Q8066795FiniteType
   Q8066795Identity Q8066795Compose Q8066795ClosedMap
   Q8066795ClosedImmersion Q8066795Pullback
   Q8066795Separated Q8066795UniversallyClosed
   Q8066795LocallyFiniteType Q8066795Proper
   Q8066795FiniteOnOpen $.

q8066795-localization-syntax $a wff
  ( Q8066795Localization R S H a ) $.

  ( Q8066795GermUnit X U x a ) $.

  ( Q8066795FiniteType R S H ) $.

${
  $d H R S a b c n v $.

  q8066795-localization-definition $a |- (
    Q8066795Localization R S H a
    <->
    (
      R e. CRing
      /\
      S e. CRing
      /\
      H e. ( R RingHom S )
      /\
      a e. ( Base ` R )
      /\
      ( H ` a ) e. ( Unit ` S )
      /\
      A. b e. ( Base ` S )
        E. c e. ( Base ` R )
          E. n e. NN0
            E. v e. ( Unit ` S )
              (
                (
                  (
                    n
                    ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` S ) )
                    ( H ` a )
                  )
                  ( .r ` S )
                  v
                )
                =
                ( 1r ` S )
                /\
                b = ( ( H ` c ) ( .r ` S ) v )
              )
      /\
      A. c e. ( Base ` R )
        (
          ( H ` c ) = ( 0g ` S )
          ->
          E. n e. NN0
            (
              (
                n
                ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` R ) )
                a
              )
              ( .r ` R )

            ( 0g ` R )

$}

${
  $d D H J O P R U V X a x $.

  q8066795-affine-definition $a |- (
    Q8066795Affine X U
    <->
    E. J E. O E. R E. P E. D
      (
        J = ( X ` 1 )
        /\

        /\

        /\

        /\

        /\
        A. a e. ( Base ` ( O ` U ) )

            =

              -. a e. ( P ` <. U , x >. )

            /\

              ( O ` U )

              ( R ` <. U , ( D ` <. U , a >. ) >. )

        /\
        A. V e. J
          (
            V C_ U
            ->
            A. x e. V

$}

${
  $d A B D J O P R U V W X a b s $.

  q8066795-scheme-definition $a |- (
    Q8066795Scheme X
    <->
    E. B E. J E. O E. R E. P E. D
      (

        /\

        /\

        /\

        /\

          U_ U e. J
            ( { U } X. U )
        /\
        D Fn
          U_ U e. J
            (
              { U }
              X.
              ( Base ` ( O ` U ) )
            )
        /\
        A. U e. J
          A. V e. J
            (
              V C_ U
              ->
              ( R ` <. U , V >. )
              e.
              ( ( O ` U ) RingHom ( O ` V ) )
            )
        /\
        A. U e. J
          (
            R ` <. U , U >.
          )
          =
          ( _I |` ( Base ` ( O ` U ) ) )
        /\
        A. U e. J
          A. V e. J
            A. W e. J
              (
                (
                  W C_ V
                  /\
                  V C_ U
                )
                ->
                (
                  ( R ` <. V , W >. )
                  o.
                  ( R ` <. U , V >. )

                =
                ( R ` <. U , W >. )
              )
        /\
        A. U e. J
          A. A
            A. s
              (
                (
                  A C_ { V e. J | V C_ U }
                  /\
                  U = U. A
                  /\
                  s Fn A
                  /\
                  A. V e. A
                    ( s ` V ) e. ( Base ` ( O ` V ) )
                  /\
                  A. V e. A
                    A. W e. A
                      (
                        (
                          R
                          `
                          <. V , ( V i^i W ) >.
                        )
                        `
                        ( s ` V )
                      )
                      =
                      (
                        (
                          R
                          `
                          <. W , ( V i^i W ) >.
                        )
                        `
                        ( s ` W )
                      )
                )
                ->
                E! a e. ( Base ` ( O ` U ) )
                  A. V e. A
                    (
                      (
                        R ` <. U , V >.
                      )
                      `
                      a
                    )
                    =
                    ( s ` V )
              )
        /\
        A. x e. B
          E. U e. J
            (
              x e. U
              /\
              Q8066795Affine X U
            )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${

  q8066795-germ-unit-definition $a |- (
    Q8066795GermUnit X U x a
    <->
    E. J E. O E. R
      (

        /\

${
  $d F H I J K O R U V X Y a f x $.

  q8066795-morphism-definition $a |- (
    Q8066795Morphism f
    <->
    E. X E. Y E. F E. I E. H

${

${

${

  q8066795-compose-definition $a |- (
    Q8066795Compose f g h
    <->
    E. F E. G E. H E. I E. J E. K

${
  $d C F J X Y f $.

  q8066795-closed-map-definition $a |- (
    Q8066795ClosedMap f
    <->
    E. X E. Y E. F E. J
      (

        /\

title: Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q8066795
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q8066795), "Zariski's main theorem": a proper
:: morphism of schemes whose fiber over a point is finite becomes a finite
:: morphism after restriction over an open neighborhood. This file contains
:: no proof.

environ

 vocabularies XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, TARSKI, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, ZFMISC_1, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0, FINSET_1, NAT_1, NUMBERS,
      ORDINAL1, CARD_3, FUNCOP_1, STRUCT_0, PUA2MSS1, REWRITE1, GROEB_2,
      CAT_8, ANPROJ_2, LATTICE8;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1,
      PARTFUN1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, XTUPLE_0,
      MCART_1, FINSET_1, CARD_3, FUNCOP_1, STRUCT_0;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, XTUPLE_0, MCART_1, FINSET_1,
      CARD_3, FUNCOP_1, STRUCT_0;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FINSET_1,
      ORDINAL1, NAT_1, CARD_3, FUNCOP_1, STRUCT_0;
 requirements SUBSET, BOOLE, NUMERALS, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_1;
 equalities FUNCT_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_1;

begin

definition
  let R be set;
  let D be set;
  pred R is_a_normal_form_wrt D means
    ex A,Neg,Add,Mul being Function st
      R = A & dom A = {1,2} \/ {3,4} \/ {5,6} &
      A.4 = Neg & A.5 = Add & A.6 = Mul &
      A.1 <> {} & A.2 in A.1 & A.3 in A.1 &
      (for a being set st a in A.1 holds
        Neg.a in A.1 &
        Add.[a,A.2] = a & Add.[A.2,a] = a &
        Add.[a,Neg.a] = A.2 & Add.[Neg.a,a] = A.2 &
        Mul.[a,A.3] = a & Mul.[A.3,a] = a) &
      (for a,b being set st a in A.1 & b in A.1 holds
        Add.[a,b] in A.1 & Mul.[a,b] in A.1 &
        Add.[a,b] = Add.[b,a] & Mul.[a,b] = Mul.[b,a]) &
      for a,b,c being set st a in A.1 & b in A.1 & c in A.1
      holds
        Add.[Add.[a,b],c] = Add.[a,Add.[b,c]] &
        Mul.[Mul.[a,b],c] = Mul.[a,Mul.[b,c]] &
        Mul.[a,Add.[b,c]] = Add.[Mul.[a,b],Mul.[a,c]];
end;

definition
  let h be Function;
  let R,S be set;
  let D be set;
  pred h,R form_morphism_between S,D means
    ex A,B,NegA,AddA,MulA,NegB,AddB,MulB being Function st
      R = A & S = B &
      A.4 = NegA & A.5 = AddA & A.6 = MulA &
      B.4 = NegB & B.5 = AddB & B.6 = MulB &
      R is_a_normal_form_wrt {} & S is_a_normal_form_wrt {} &
      dom h = A.1 & rng h c= B.1 &
      h.(A.2) = B.2 & h.(A.3) = B.3 &
      (for a being set st a in A.1 holds
        h.(NegA.a) = NegB.(h.a)) &
      for a,b being set st a in A.1 & b in A.1 holds
        h.(AddA.[a,b]) = AddB.[h.a,h.b] &
        h.(MulA.[a,b]) = MulB.[h.a,h.b];
end;

definition
  let a,R,D be set;
  pred R reduces a,D means
    ex A,Mul being Function st
      R = A & A.6 = Mul & R is_a_normal_form_wrt {} & a in A.1 &
      ex b being set st b in A.1 &
        Mul.[a,b] = A.3 & Mul.[b,a] = A.3;
end;

definition
  let P,R be set;
  let D be set;
  pred P,D are_divergent_wrt R means
    ex A,Neg,Add,Mul being Function st
      R = A & A.4 = Neg & A.5 = Add & A.6 = Mul &
      R is_a_normal_form_wrt {} & P c= A.1 &
      A.2 in P & not A.3 in P &
      (for a being set st a in P holds Neg.a in P) &
      (for a,b being set st a in P & b in P holds Add.[a,b] in P) &
      (for a,b being set st a in A.1 & b in P holds Mul.[a,b] in P) &
      for a,b being set st a in A.1 & b in A.1 & Mul.[a,b] in P
      holds a in P or b in P;
end;

definition
  let h be Function;
  let R,S,a be set;
  let D be set;
  pred h is_Standard_Representation_of R,S,a,D means
    ex A being Function st R = A &
      h,R form_morphism_between S,{} &
      S reduces h.a,{} &
      for T being set, k being Function st
        T is_a_normal_form_wrt {} &
        k,R form_morphism_between T,{} &
        T reduces k.a,{}
      holds
        ex l being Function st
          l,S form_morphism_between T,{} &
          (for x being set st x in A.1 holds l.(h.x) = k.x) &
          for m being Function st
            m,S form_morphism_between T,{} &
            (for x being set st x in A.1 holds m.(h.x) = k.x)
          holds m = l;
end;

definition
  let h be Function;
  let R,S be set;
  let D be set;
  pred h has_a_Standard_Representation_of R,S,D means
    ex A,B,NegB,AddB,MulB being Function st
      R = A & S = B & B.4 = NegB & B.5 = AddB & B.6 = MulB &
      h,R form_morphism_between S,{} &
      ex E being finite set st E c= B.1 &
        for N being set st
          N c= B.1 & B.2 in N &
          (for b being set st b in N holds NegB.b in N) &
          (for b,c being set st b in N & c in N holds AddB.[b,c] in N) &
          (for a,b being set st a in A.1 & b in N holds
            MulB.[h.a,b] in N) &
          E c= N
        holds N = B.1;
end;

definition
  let h be Function;
  let R,S be set;
  let D be set;
  pred h can_be_characterized_by R,S,D means
    ex A,B,NegB,AddB,MulB being Function st
      R = A & S = B & B.4 = NegB & B.5 = AddB & B.6 = MulB &
      h,R form_morphism_between S,{} &
      ex E being finite set st E c= B.1 &
        for C being set st
          C c= B.1 & B.2 in C & B.3 in C &
          (for a being set st a in A.1 holds h.a in C) &
          (for b being set st b in C holds NegB.b in C) &
          (for b,c being set st b in C & c in C holds
            AddB.[b,c] in C & MulB.[b,c] in C) &
          E c= C
        holds C = B.1;
end;

definition
  let U,X be set;
  let D be set;
  pred U is_a_normal_form_of X,D means
    ex S,Sections,PrincipalOpen being Function,
       Restrictions being Function-yielding Function st
      X = S & S.3 = Sections & S.4 = Restrictions &
      U in S.2 & U c= S.1 & Sections.U is_a_normal_form_wrt {} &
      ex phi being Function st
        dom phi = U & phi is one-to-one &
        (for P being set holds
          P in rng phi iff P,{} are_divergent_wrt Sections.U) &
        (for a being set st
          ex A being Function st Sections.U = A & a in A.1
         holds
          PrincipalOpen.[U,a] in S.2 &
          PrincipalOpen.[U,a] c= U &
          PrincipalOpen.[U,a] =
            {x where x is Element of U : not a in phi.x} &
          Restrictions.[U,PrincipalOpen.[U,a]]
            is_Standard_Representation_of Sections.U,
              Sections.(PrincipalOpen.[U,a]),a,{}) &
        for V being set st V in S.2 & V c= U holds
          for x being set st x in V holds
            ex a being set st
              (ex A being Function st Sections.U = A & a in A.1) &
              x in PrincipalOpen.[U,a] &
              PrincipalOpen.[U,a] c= V;
end;

definition
  let X be set;
  let D be set;
  pred X has_a_normal_form_wrt D means
    ex S,Sections being Function,
       Restrictions being Function-yielding Function st
      X = S & dom S = {1,2} \/ {3,4} &
      S.3 = Sections & S.4 = Restrictions &
      {} in S.2 & S.1 in S.2 & union (S.2) = S.1 &
      (for U being set st U in S.2 holds U c= S.1) &
      (for A being set st A c= S.2 holds union A in S.2) &
      (for U,V being set st U in S.2 & V in S.2 holds U /\ V in S.2) &
      (for U being set st U in S.2 holds
        Sections.U is_a_normal_form_wrt {}) &
      (for U,V being set st U in S.2 & V in S.2 & V c= U holds
        Restrictions.[U,V],Sections.U
          form_morphism_between Sections.V,{}) &
      (for U being set st U in S.2 holds
        for a being set st
          ex R being Function st Sections.U = R & a in R.1
        holds Restrictions.[U,U].a = a) &
      (for U,V,W being set st
        U in S.2 & V in S.2 & W in S.2 & W c= V & V c= U
       holds
        for a being set st
          ex R being Function st Sections.U = R & a in R.1
        holds
          Restrictions.[V,W].(Restrictions.[U,V].a) =
            Restrictions.[U,W].a) &
      (for U,A being set, s being Function st
        U in S.2 & A c= S.2 & U = union A &
        dom s = A &
        (for V being set st V in A holds
          ex R being Function st Sections.V = R & s.V in R.1) &
        (for V,W being set st V in A & W in A holds
          Restrictions.[V,V/\W].(s.V) =
            Restrictions.[W,V/\W].(s.W))
       holds
        ex a being set st
          (ex R being Function st Sections.U = R & a in R.1) &
          (for V being set st V in A holds
            Restrictions.[U,V].a = s.V) &
          for b being set st
            (ex R being Function st Sections.U = R & b in R.1) &
            (for V being set st V in A holds
              Restrictions.[U,V].b = s.V)
          holds b = a) &
      for x being set st x in S.1 holds
        ex U being set st x in U & U is_a_normal_form_of X,{};
end;

definition
  let a,X,U,x be set;
  let D be set;
  pred a,X,U is_product_of x,D means
    ex S,Sections being Function,
       Restrictions being Function-yielding Function st
      X = S & S.3 = Sections & S.4 = Restrictions &
      U in S.2 & x in U &
      (ex R being Function st Sections.U = R & a in R.1) &
      ex V,b being set, RV,Mul being Function st
        V in S.2 & V c= U & x in V &
        Sections.V = RV & RV.6 = Mul & b in RV.1 &
        Mul.[Restrictions.[U,V].a,b] = RV.3;
end;

definition
  let f be Function;
  let D be set;
  pred f commutes_with D means
    ex X,Y,SectionsX,SectionsY being Function,
       RestrictionsX,RestrictionsY being Function-yielding Function,
       pm,io being Function, sm being Function-yielding Function st
      f.1 = X & f.2 = Y &
      X.3 = SectionsX & Y.3 = SectionsY &
      X.4 = RestrictionsX & Y.4 = RestrictionsY &
      f.3 = pm & f.4 = io & f.5 = sm &
      dom f = {1,2} \/ {3,4} \/ {5} &
      X has_a_normal_form_wrt {} & Y has_a_normal_form_wrt {} &
      dom pm = X.1 & rng pm c= Y.1 &
      dom io = Y.2 & dom sm = Y.2 &
      (for U being set st U in Y.2 holds
        io.U = {x where x is Element of X.1 : pm.x in U} &
        io.U in X.2 &
        sm.U,SectionsY.U
          form_morphism_between SectionsX.(io.U),{}) &
      (for U,V being set st U in Y.2 & V in Y.2 & V c= U holds
        for a being set st
          ex R being Function st SectionsY.U = R & a in R.1
        holds
          RestrictionsX.[io.U,io.V].(sm.U.a) =
            sm.V.(RestrictionsY.[U,V].a)) &
      for x,U,a being set st
        x in X.1 & U in Y.2 & pm.x in U &
        ex R being Function st SectionsY.U = R & a in R.1
      holds
        (sm.U.a,X,io.U is_product_of x,{})
        implies
        a,Y,U is_product_of pm.x,{};
end;

definition
  let i be Function;
  let X be set;
  let D be set;
  pred i,X are_convergent_wrt D means
    ex S,Sections,pm,io being Function,
       sm being Function-yielding Function st
      X = S & S.3 = Sections &
      i.1 = X & i.2 = X & i.3 = pm & i.4 = io & i.5 = sm &
      i commutes_with {} &
      (for x being set st x in S.1 holds pm.x = x) &
      (for U being set st U in S.2 holds
        io.U = U &
        for a being set st
          ex R being Function st Sections.U = R & a in R.1
        holds sm.U.a = a);
end;

definition
  let h,f,g be Function;
  let D be set;
  pred h is_Standard_Representation_of f,g,D means
    ex X,Y,Z,SectionsX,SectionsY,SectionsZ,
       pf,pg,ph,iof,iog,ioh being Function,
       sf,sg,sh being Function-yielding Function st
      f.1 = X & f.2 = Y & g.1 = Y & g.2 = Z &
      X.3 = SectionsX & Y.3 = SectionsY & Z.3 = SectionsZ &
      f.3 = pf & g.3 = pg & h.3 = ph &
      f.4 = iof & g.4 = iog & h.4 = ioh &
      f.5 = sf & g.5 = sg & h.5 = sh &
      f commutes_with {} & g commutes_with {} &
      h commutes_with {} & h.1 = X & h.2 = Z &
      (for x being set st x in X.1 holds ph.x = pg.(pf.x)) &
      for U being set st U in Z.2 holds
        ioh.U = iof.(iog.U) &
        for a being set st
          ex R being Function st SectionsZ.U = R & a in R.1
        holds sh.U.a = sf.(iog.U).(sg.U.a);
end;

definition
  let P,p,q,f,g be Function;
  let D,E be set;
  pred P,p,q,f,g,D,E are_perspective means
    f commutes_with {} & g commutes_with {} & f.2 = g.2 &
    P has_a_normal_form_wrt {} & p commutes_with {} & q commutes_with {} &
    p.1 = P & p.2 = f.1 & q.1 = P & q.2 = g.1 &
    (ex a,b being Function st
      a is_Standard_Representation_of p,f,{} &
      b is_Standard_Representation_of q,g,{} & a = b) &
    for T,u,v being Function st
      T has_a_normal_form_wrt {} & u commutes_with {} & v commutes_with {} &
      u.1 = T & v.1 = T & u.2 = f.1 & v.2 = g.1 &
      ex a,b being Function st
        a is_Standard_Representation_of u,f,{} &
        b is_Standard_Representation_of v,g,{} & a = b
    holds
      ex k being Function st
        k commutes_with {} & k.1 = T & k.2 = P &
        (ex a,b being Function st
          a is_Standard_Representation_of k,p,{} &
          b is_Standard_Representation_of k,q,{} &
          a = u & b = v) &
        for d being Function st
          d commutes_with {} & d.1 = T & d.2 = P &
          ex a,b being Function st
            a is_Standard_Representation_of d,p,{} &
            b is_Standard_Representation_of d,q,{} &
            a = u & b = v
        holds d = k;
end;

definition
  let d,P,p,q,f be Function;
  pred d is_Standard_Representation_of f,P,p,q means
    P,p,q,f,f,{},{} are_perspective &
    d commutes_with {} & d.1 = f.1 & d.2 = P &
    ex i,a,b being Function st
      i,f.1 are_convergent_wrt {} &
      a is_Standard_Representation_of d,p,{} &
      b is_Standard_Representation_of d,q,{} &
      a = i & b = i;
end;

definition
  let j be Function;
  let D be set;
  pred j,D are_disjoint means
    ex X,Y,SectionsX,pm,io being Function,
       sm being Function-yielding Function st
      j.1 = X & j.2 = Y & X.3 = SectionsX &
      j.3 = pm & j.4 = io & j.5 = sm &
      j commutes_with {} & pm is one-to-one &
      Y.1 \ rng pm in Y.2 &
      (for U being set st U in X.2 holds
        ex V being set st V in Y.2 & io.V = U) &
      for V being set st V is_a_normal_form_of Y,{} holds
        io.V is_a_normal_form_of X,{} &
        ex R being Function st
          SectionsX.(io.V) = R & rng (sm.V) = R.1;
end;

definition
  let f be Function;
  let D be set;
  pred f commutes-weakly_with D means
    ex X,Y,pm being Function st
      f.1 = X & f.2 = Y & f.3 = pm &
      f commutes_with {} &
      for C being set st C c= X.1 & X.1 \ C in X.2
      holds Y.1 \ (pm.:C) in Y.2;
end;

definition
  let f be Function;
  let D be set;
  pred f,D are_equivalent means
    f commutes_with {} &
    for g being Function st
      g commutes_with {} & g.2 = f.2
    holds
      ex P,p,q being Function st
        P,p,q,f,g,{},{} are_perspective &
        q commutes-weakly_with {};
end;

definition
  let f be Function;
  let D be set;
  pred f is_MonomialRepresentation_of D means
    f commutes_with {} &
    ex P,p,q,d being Function st
      P,p,q,f,f,{},{} are_perspective &
      d is_Standard_Representation_of f,P,p,q &
      d,{} are_disjoint;
end;

definition
  let f be Function;
  let D be set;
  pred f is_partitable_wrt D means
    ex X,Y,SectionsX,SectionsY,io being Function,
       sm,RestrictionsX being Function-yielding Function st
      f.1 = X & f.2 = Y &
      X.3 = SectionsX & Y.3 = SectionsY & X.4 = RestrictionsX &
      f.4 = io & f.5 = sm & f commutes_with {} &
      for y being set st y in Y.1 holds
        ex U,A being set st
          y in U & U is_a_normal_form_of Y,{} &
          A is finite & A c= X.2 & union A = io.U &
          for V being set st V in A holds
            V is_a_normal_form_of X,{} & V c= io.U &
            (RestrictionsX.[io.U,V] * sm.U)
              can_be_characterized_by SectionsY.U,SectionsX.V,{};
end;

definition
  let f be Function;
  let D be set;
  pred f is_exactly_partitable_wrt D means
    f commutes_with {} &
    f is_MonomialRepresentation_of {} &
    f is_partitable_wrt {} &
    f,{} are_equivalent;
end;

definition
  let f be Function;
  let D be set;
  pred D is_rougher_than f means
    ex X,Y,SectionsX,SectionsY,io being Function,
       sm being Function-yielding Function st
      f.1 = X & f.2 = Y & X.3 = SectionsX & Y.3 = SectionsY &
      f.4 = io & f.5 = sm & f commutes_with {} &
      for y being set st y in Y.1 holds
        ex U being set st
          y in U & U is_a_normal_form_of Y,{} &
          io.U is_a_normal_form_of X,{} &
          sm.U has_a_Standard_Representation_of SectionsY.U,
            SectionsX.(io.U),{};
end;

definition
  let T,X,W be set;
  let D be set;
  pred T,W is_extension2_of X,D means
    ex S,ST,SectionsX,SectionsT being Function,
       RestrictionsX,RestrictionsT being Function-yielding Function st
      X = S & T = ST & S.3 = SectionsX & ST.3 = SectionsT &
      S.4 = RestrictionsX & ST.4 = RestrictionsT &
      X has_a_normal_form_wrt {} & T has_a_normal_form_wrt {} & W in S.2 &
      ST.1 = W &
      ST.2 = {V where V is Element of S.2 : V c= W} &
      (for V being set st V in ST.2 holds SectionsT.V = SectionsX.V) &
      for U,V being set st U in ST.2 & V in ST.2 & V c= U
      holds RestrictionsT.[U,V] = RestrictionsX.[U,V];
end;

definition
  let g,f be Function;
  let V be set;
  pred g,V are_critical_wrt f means
    ex X,Y,XV,YV,pmf,pmg,iof,iog being Function,
       smf,smg being Function-yielding Function st
      f.1 = X & f.2 = Y & f.3 = pmf & f.4 = iof & f.5 = smf &
      g.1 = XV & g.2 = YV & g.3 = pmg & g.4 = iog & g.5 = smg &
      f commutes_with {} & g commutes_with {} & V in Y.2 &
      YV,V is_extension2_of Y,{} &
      XV,iof.V is_extension2_of X,{} &
      dom pmg = iof.V &
      (for x being set st x in iof.V holds pmg.x = pmf.x) &
      for U being set st U in YV.2 holds
        iog.U = iof.U & smg.U = smf.U;
end;

::$P-
theorem
  for X,Y,f,pm being Function, y being set st
    f.1 = X & f.2 = Y & f.3 = pm &
    f is_exactly_partitable_wrt {} &
    y in Y.1 &
    {x where x is Element of X.1 : pm.x = y} is finite
  holds
    ex V being set, g being Function st
      V in Y.2 & y in V &
      g,V are_critical_wrt f &
      {} is_rougher_than g
proof
end;

title: Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q8066795
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q8066795), "Zariski's main theorem": a proper
% scheme morphism with finite fiber over a point is finite over an open
% neighborhood of that point. This file contains no proof.

Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem[PointAtom, SectionAtom: TYPE+]: THEORY
BEGIN

  IMPORTING finite_sets[PointAtom], finite_sets[SectionAtom]

  scheme: TYPE = [#
    sch_points: [PointAtom -> bool],
    sch_sections: [SectionAtom -> bool],
    sch_open: [[(sch_points) -> bool] -> bool],
    sch_section: [[(sch_points) -> bool], (sch_sections) -> bool],
    sch_zero: [[(sch_points) -> bool] -> (sch_sections)],
    sch_one: [[(sch_points) -> bool] -> (sch_sections)],
    sch_neg: [[(sch_points) -> bool], (sch_sections) -> (sch_sections)],
    sch_add: [[(sch_points) -> bool], (sch_sections), (sch_sections)
      -> (sch_sections)],
    sch_mul: [[(sch_points) -> bool], (sch_sections), (sch_sections)
      -> (sch_sections)],
    sch_restrict: [[(sch_points) -> bool], [(sch_points) -> bool],
      (sch_sections) -> (sch_sections)]
  #]

  point(S: scheme): TYPE = (sch_points(S))
  section(S: scheme): TYPE = (sch_sections(S))
  point_set(S: scheme): TYPE = [point(S) -> bool]
  section_set(S: scheme): TYPE = [section(S) -> bool]
  ideal(S: scheme): TYPE = section_set(S)

  scheme_morphism(X, Y: scheme): TYPE = [#
    mor_base: [point(X) -> point(Y)],
    mor_map: [V: point_set(Y), section(Y) -> section(X)]
  #]

  subset(S: scheme, A, B: point_set(S)): bool =
    FORALL (x: point(S)): A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  same_set(S: scheme, A, B: point_set(S)): bool =
    subset(S, A, B) AND subset(S, B, A)

  empty_set(S: scheme): point_set(S) =
    LAMBDA (x: point(S)): FALSE

  full_set(S: scheme): point_set(S) =
    LAMBDA (x: point(S)): TRUE

  intersection(S: scheme, A, B: point_set(S)): point_set(S) =
    LAMBDA (x: point(S)): A(x) AND B(x)

  complement(S: scheme, A: point_set(S)): point_set(S) =
    LAMBDA (x: point(S)): NOT A(x)

  family_union(S: scheme, C: [point_set(S) -> bool]): point_set(S) =
    LAMBDA (x: point(S)):
      EXISTS (U: point_set(S)): C(U) AND U(x)

  preimage(X, Y: scheme, f: scheme_morphism(X, Y),
      V: point_set(Y)): point_set(X) =
    LAMBDA (x: point(X)): V(mor_base(f)(x))

  image(X, Y: scheme, f: scheme_morphism(X, Y),
      A: point_set(X)): point_set(Y) =
    LAMBDA (y: point(Y)):
      EXISTS (x: point(X)): A(x) AND mor_base(f)(x) = y

  finite_point_set(S: scheme, A: point_set(S)): bool =
    EXISTS (F: finite_set[point(S)]):
      FORALL (x: point(S)): A(x) IFF member(x, F)

  topology_laws(S: scheme): bool =
    sch_open(S)(empty_set(S))
      AND sch_open(S)(full_set(S))
      AND (FORALL (U, V: point_set(S)):
        sch_open(S)(U) AND sch_open(S)(V)
          IMPLIES sch_open(S)(intersection(S, U, V)))
      AND (FORALL (C: [point_set(S) -> bool]):
        (FORALL (U: point_set(S)): C(U) IMPLIES sch_open(S)(U))
          IMPLIES sch_open(S)(family_union(S, C)))

  ring_on(S: scheme, U: point_set(S)): bool =
    sch_section(S)(U, sch_zero(S)(U))
      AND sch_section(S)(U, sch_one(S)(U))
      AND (FORALL (a: section(S)):
        sch_section(S)(U, a)
          IMPLIES sch_section(S)(U, sch_neg(S)(U, a)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: section(S)):
        sch_section(S)(U, a) AND sch_section(S)(U, b)
          IMPLIES sch_section(S)(U, sch_add(S)(U, a, b))
            AND sch_section(S)(U, sch_mul(S)(U, a, b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: section(S)):
        sch_section(S)(U, a) AND sch_section(S)(U, b)
          AND sch_section(S)(U, c)
        IMPLIES
          sch_add(S)(U, sch_add(S)(U, a, b), c) =
            sch_add(S)(U, a, sch_add(S)(U, b, c))
          AND sch_mul(S)(U, sch_mul(S)(U, a, b), c) =
            sch_mul(S)(U, a, sch_mul(S)(U, b, c))
          AND sch_mul(S)(U, a, sch_add(S)(U, b, c)) =
            sch_add(S)(U, sch_mul(S)(U, a, b),
              sch_mul(S)(U, a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: section(S)):
        sch_section(S)(U, a) AND sch_section(S)(U, b)
          IMPLIES sch_add(S)(U, a, b) = sch_add(S)(U, b, a)
            AND sch_mul(S)(U, a, b) = sch_mul(S)(U, b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a: section(S)):
        sch_section(S)(U, a)
          IMPLIES sch_add(S)(U, sch_zero(S)(U), a) = a
            AND sch_add(S)(U, sch_neg(S)(U, a), a) = sch_zero(S)(U)
            AND sch_mul(S)(U, sch_one(S)(U), a) = a)

  ring_hom(A: scheme, U: point_set(A),
      B: scheme, V: point_set(B),
      phi: [section(A) -> section(B)]): bool =
    (FORALL (a: section(A)):
      sch_section(A)(U, a) IMPLIES sch_section(B)(V, phi(a)))
      AND phi(sch_zero(A)(U)) = sch_zero(B)(V)
      AND phi(sch_one(A)(U)) = sch_one(B)(V)
      AND (FORALL (a: section(A)):
        sch_section(A)(U, a)
          IMPLIES phi(sch_neg(A)(U, a)) = sch_neg(B)(V, phi(a)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: section(A)):
        sch_section(A)(U, a) AND sch_section(A)(U, b)
          IMPLIES phi(sch_add(A)(U, a, b)) =
              sch_add(B)(V, phi(a), phi(b))
            AND phi(sch_mul(A)(U, a, b)) =
              sch_mul(B)(V, phi(a), phi(b)))

  restriction_laws(S: scheme): bool =
    (FORALL (U, V: point_set(S)):
      sch_open(S)(U) AND sch_open(S)(V) AND subset(S, V, U)
        IMPLIES ring_hom(S, U, S, V,
          LAMBDA (a: section(S)): sch_restrict(S)(U, V, a)))
      AND (FORALL (U: point_set(S)), (a: section(S)):
        sch_open(S)(U) AND sch_section(S)(U, a)
          IMPLIES sch_restrict(S)(U, U, a) = a)
      AND (FORALL (U, V, W: point_set(S)), (a: section(S)):
        sch_open(S)(U) AND sch_open(S)(V) AND sch_open(S)(W)
          AND subset(S, W, V) AND subset(S, V, U)
          AND sch_section(S)(U, a)
        IMPLIES sch_restrict(S)(V, W, sch_restrict(S)(U, V, a)) =
          sch_restrict(S)(U, W, a))

  covers(S: scheme, U: point_set(S),
      C: [point_set(S) -> bool]): bool =
    same_set(S, U, family_union(S, C))

  compatible_family(S: scheme, U: point_set(S),
      C: [point_set(S) -> bool],
      a: [point_set(S) -> section(S)]): bool =
    (FORALL (V: point_set(S)):
      C(V) IMPLIES sch_open(S)(V) AND subset(S, V, U)
        AND sch_section(S)(V, a(V)))
      AND (FORALL (V, W: point_set(S)):
        C(V) AND C(W) IMPLIES
          sch_restrict(S)(V, intersection(S, V, W), a(V)) =
            sch_restrict(S)(W, intersection(S, V, W), a(W)))

  sheaf_laws(S: scheme): bool =
    FORALL (U: point_set(S)), (C: [point_set(S) -> bool]),
           (a: [point_set(S) -> section(S)]):
      sch_open(S)(U) AND covers(S, U, C)
        AND compatible_family(S, U, C, a)
      IMPLIES EXISTS (s: section(S)):
        sch_section(S)(U, s)
          AND (FORALL (V: point_set(S)):
            C(V) IMPLIES sch_restrict(S)(U, V, s) = a(V))
          AND (FORALL (t: section(S)):
            sch_section(S)(U, t)
              AND (FORALL (V: point_set(S)):
                C(V) IMPLIES sch_restrict(S)(U, V, t) = a(V))
            IMPLIES t = s)

  germ_equal(S: scheme, x: point(S),
      U: point_set(S), a: section(S),
      V: point_set(S), b: section(S)): bool =
    EXISTS (W: point_set(S)):
      sch_open(S)(W) AND W(x)
        AND subset(S, W, intersection(S, U, V))
        AND sch_restrict(S)(U, W, a) = sch_restrict(S)(V, W, b)

  germ_unit(S: scheme, x: point(S),
      U: point_set(S), a: section(S)): bool =
    EXISTS (W: point_set(S)), (b: section(S)):
      sch_open(S)(W) AND W(x) AND subset(S, W, U)
        AND sch_section(S)(W, b)
        AND sch_mul(S)(W, sch_restrict(S)(U, W, a), b) =
          sch_one(S)(W)

  local_ring_stalks(S: scheme): bool =
    FORALL (x: point(S)), (U: point_set(S)), (a: section(S)):
      sch_open(S)(U) AND U(x) AND sch_section(S)(U, a)
      IMPLIES germ_unit(S, x, U, a)
        OR germ_unit(S, x, U,
          sch_add(S)(U, sch_one(S)(U), sch_neg(S)(U, a)))

  is_ideal(S: scheme, U: point_set(S), I: ideal(S)): bool =
    I(sch_zero(S)(U))
      AND (FORALL (a: section(S)): I(a) IMPLIES sch_section(S)(U, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: section(S)):
        I(a) AND I(b) IMPLIES I(sch_add(S)(U, a, b)))
      AND (FORALL (a: section(S)): I(a) IMPLIES I(sch_neg(S)(U, a)))
      AND (FORALL (r, a: section(S)):
        sch_section(S)(U, r) AND I(a)
          IMPLIES I(sch_mul(S)(U, r, a)))

  is_prime_ideal(S: scheme, U: point_set(S), P: ideal(S)): bool =
    is_ideal(S, U, P) AND NOT P(sch_one(S)(U))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: section(S)):
        sch_section(S)(U, a) AND sch_section(S)(U, b)
          AND P(sch_mul(S)(U, a, b))
        IMPLIES P(a) OR P(b))

  point_prime(S: scheme, U: point_set(S), x: point(S)): ideal(S) =
    LAMBDA (a: section(S)):
      sch_section(S)(U, a) AND NOT germ_unit(S, x, U, a)

  principal_open(S: scheme, U: point_set(S),
      a: section(S)): point_set(S) =
    LAMBDA (x: point(S)): U(x) AND germ_unit(S, x, U, a)

  affine_open(S: scheme, U: point_set(S)): bool =
    sch_open(S)(U)
      AND (FORALL (x: point(S)):
        U(x) IMPLIES is_prime_ideal(S, U, point_prime(S, U, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: point(S)):
        U(x) AND U(y) AND point_prime(S, U, x) = point_prime(S, U, y)
          IMPLIES x = y)
      AND (FORALL (P: ideal(S)):
        is_prime_ideal(S, U, P)
          IMPLIES EXISTS (x: point(S)):
            U(x) AND P = point_prime(S, U, x))
      AND (FORALL (a: section(S)):
        sch_section(S)(U, a)
          IMPLIES sch_open(S)(principal_open(S, U, a)))
      AND (FORALL (W: point_set(S)), (x: point(S)):
        sch_open(S)(W) AND subset(S, W, U) AND W(x)
          IMPLIES EXISTS (a: section(S)):
            sch_section(S)(U, a) AND principal_open(S, U, a)(x)
              AND subset(S, principal_open(S, U, a), W))
      AND (FORALL (x: point(S)), (V: point_set(S)), (b: section(S)):
        U(x) AND sch_open(S)(V) AND V(x) AND subset(S, V, U)
          AND sch_section(S)(V, b)
        IMPLIES EXISTS (a, s: section(S)), (W: point_set(S)):
          sch_section(S)(U, a) AND sch_section(S)(U, s)
            AND germ_unit(S, x, U, s) AND sch_open(S)(W) AND W(x)
            AND subset(S, W, V)
            AND sch_mul(S)(W, b, sch_restrict(S)(U, W, s)) =
              sch_restrict(S)(U, W, a))
      AND (FORALL (x: point(S)), (a: section(S)):
        U(x) AND sch_section(S)(U, a)
          AND germ_equal(S, x, U, a, U, sch_zero(S)(U))
        IMPLIES EXISTS (s: section(S)):
          sch_section(S)(U, s) AND germ_unit(S, x, U, s)
            AND sch_mul(S)(U, s, a) = sch_zero(S)(U))

  is_scheme(S: scheme): bool =
    topology_laws(S)
      AND (FORALL (U: point_set(S)):
        sch_open(S)(U) IMPLIES ring_on(S, U))
      AND restriction_laws(S) AND sheaf_laws(S)
      AND local_ring_stalks(S)
      AND (FORALL (x: point(S)):
        EXISTS (U: point_set(S)): U(x) AND affine_open(S, U))

  is_scheme_morphism(X, Y: scheme,
      f: scheme_morphism(X, Y)): bool =
    is_scheme(X) AND is_scheme(Y)
      AND (FORALL (V: point_set(Y)):
        sch_open(Y)(V) IMPLIES sch_open(X)(preimage(X, Y, f, V)))
      AND (FORALL (V: point_set(Y)):
        sch_open(Y)(V) IMPLIES ring_hom(Y, V, X,
          preimage(X, Y, f, V),
          LAMBDA (a: section(Y)): mor_map(f)(V, a)))
      AND (FORALL (V, W: point_set(Y)), (a: section(Y)):
        sch_open(Y)(V) AND sch_open(Y)(W) AND subset(Y, W, V)
          AND sch_section(Y)(V, a)
        IMPLIES sch_restrict(X)(preimage(X, Y, f, V),
          preimage(X, Y, f, W), mor_map(f)(V, a)) =
            mor_map(f)(W, sch_restrict(Y)(V, W, a)))
      AND (FORALL (x: point(X)), (V: point_set(Y)), (a: section(Y)):
        sch_open(Y)(V) AND V(mor_base(f)(x)) AND sch_section(Y)(V, a)
          AND germ_unit(X, x, preimage(X, Y, f, V), mor_map(f)(V, a))
        IMPLIES germ_unit(Y, mor_base(f)(x), V, a))

  identity_morphism(S: scheme): scheme_morphism(S, S) =
    (# mor_base := LAMBDA (x: point(S)): x,
       mor_map := LAMBDA (U: point_set(S)), (a: section(S)): a #)

  compose(X, Y, Z: scheme, g: scheme_morphism(Y, Z),
      f: scheme_morphism(X, Y)): scheme_morphism(X, Z) =
    (# mor_base := LAMBDA (x: point(X)):
         mor_base(g)(mor_base(f)(x)),
       mor_map := LAMBDA (W: point_set(Z)), (a: section(Z)):
         mor_map(f)(preimage(Y, Z, g, W), mor_map(g)(W, a)) #)

  morphism_equal(X, Y: scheme,
      f, g: scheme_morphism(X, Y)): bool =
    (FORALL (x: point(X)): mor_base(f)(x) = mor_base(g)(x))
      AND (FORALL (U: point_set(Y)), (a: section(Y)):
        sch_open(Y)(U) AND sch_section(Y)(U, a)
          IMPLIES mor_map(f)(U, a) = mor_map(g)(U, a))

  is_scheme_isomorphism(X, Y: scheme, i: scheme_morphism(X, Y),
      j: scheme_morphism(Y, X)): bool =
    is_scheme_morphism(X, Y, i) AND is_scheme_morphism(Y, X, j)
      AND morphism_equal(X, X, compose(X, Y, X, j, i),
        identity_morphism(X))
      AND morphism_equal(Y, Y, compose(Y, X, Y, i, j),
        identity_morphism(Y))

  is_pullback(P, X, Z, Y: scheme, p: scheme_morphism(P, X),
      q: scheme_morphism(P, Z), f: scheme_morphism(X, Y),
      g: scheme_morphism(Z, Y)): bool =
    is_scheme_morphism(P, X, p) AND is_scheme_morphism(P, Z, q)
      AND is_scheme_morphism(X, Y, f) AND is_scheme_morphism(Z, Y, g)
      AND morphism_equal(P, Y, compose(P, X, Y, f, p),
        compose(P, Z, Y, g, q))
      AND (FORALL (T: scheme), (a: scheme_morphism(T, X)),
                  (b: scheme_morphism(T, Z)):
        is_scheme_morphism(T, X, a) AND is_scheme_morphism(T, Z, b)
          AND morphism_equal(T, Y, compose(T, X, Y, f, a),
            compose(T, Z, Y, g, b))
        IMPLIES EXISTS (u: scheme_morphism(T, P)):
          is_scheme_morphism(T, P, u)
            AND morphism_equal(T, X, compose(T, P, X, p, u), a)
            AND morphism_equal(T, Z, compose(T, P, Z, q, u), b)
            AND (FORALL (v: scheme_morphism(T, P)):
              is_scheme_morphism(T, P, v)
                AND morphism_equal(T, X, compose(T, P, X, p, v), a)
                AND morphism_equal(T, Z, compose(T, P, Z, q, v), b)
              IMPLIES morphism_equal(T, P, v, u)))

  pullback_presentations_equivalent(P, Pprime, X, Z: scheme,
      p: scheme_morphism(P, X), q: scheme_morphism(P, Z),
      pprime: scheme_morphism(Pprime, X),
      qprime: scheme_morphism(Pprime, Z)): bool =
    EXISTS (i: scheme_morphism(P, Pprime)),
           (j: scheme_morphism(Pprime, P)):
      is_scheme_isomorphism(P, Pprime, i, j)
        AND morphism_equal(P, X, compose(P, Pprime, X, pprime, i), p)
        AND morphism_equal(P, Z, compose(P, Pprime, Z, qprime, i), q)
        AND morphism_equal(Pprime, X,
          compose(Pprime, P, X, p, j), pprime)
        AND morphism_equal(Pprime, Z,
          compose(Pprime, P, Z, q, j), qprime)

  is_closed(S: scheme, C: point_set(S)): bool =
    sch_open(S)(complement(S, C))

  is_closed_map(X, Y: scheme, f: scheme_morphism(X, Y)): bool =
    is_scheme_morphism(X, Y, f)
      AND (FORALL (C: point_set(X)):
        is_closed(X, C) IMPLIES is_closed(Y, image(X, Y, f, C)))

  is_closed_immersion(X, Y: scheme,
      i: scheme_morphism(X, Y)): bool =
    is_scheme_morphism(X, Y, i)
      AND (FORALL (x, xprime: point(X)):
        mor_base(i)(x) = mor_base(i)(xprime) IMPLIES x = xprime)
      AND is_closed(Y, image(X, Y, i, full_set(X)))
      AND (FORALL (U: point_set(X)):
        sch_open(X)(U) IFF EXISTS (V: point_set(Y)):
          sch_open(Y)(V) AND same_set(Y, image(X, Y, i, U),
            intersection(Y, V, image(X, Y, i, full_set(X)))))
      AND (FORALL (x: point(X)), (U: point_set(X)), (a: section(X)):
        sch_open(X)(U) AND U(x) AND sch_section(X)(U, a)
        IMPLIES EXISTS (V: point_set(Y)), (b: section(Y)),
                       (W: point_set(X)):
          sch_open(Y)(V) AND V(mor_base(i)(x))
            AND sch_section(Y)(V, b) AND sch_open(X)(W) AND W(x)
            AND subset(X, W, intersection(X, U, preimage(X, Y, i, V)))
            AND sch_restrict(X)(U, W, a) =
              sch_restrict(X)(preimage(X, Y, i, V), W,
                mor_map(i)(V, b)))

  is_separated(X, Y: scheme, f: scheme_morphism(X, Y)): bool =
    is_scheme_morphism(X, Y, f)
      AND (EXISTS (P: scheme), (p1, p2: scheme_morphism(P, X)):
        is_pullback(P, X, X, Y, p1, p2, f, f))
      AND (FORALL (P: scheme), (p1, p2: scheme_morphism(P, X)):
        is_pullback(P, X, X, Y, p1, p2, f, f)
        IMPLIES EXISTS (diagonal: scheme_morphism(X, P)):
          is_scheme_morphism(X, P, diagonal)
            AND morphism_equal(X, X,
              compose(X, P, X, p1, diagonal), identity_morphism(X))
            AND morphism_equal(X, X,
              compose(X, P, X, p2, diagonal), identity_morphism(X))
            AND is_closed_immersion(X, P, diagonal))

  universally_closed(X, Y: scheme,
      f: scheme_morphism(X, Y)): bool =
    is_scheme_morphism(X, Y, f)
      AND (FORALL (Z: scheme), (g: scheme_morphism(Z, Y)):
        is_scheme_morphism(Z, Y, g)
        IMPLIES EXISTS (P: scheme), (p: scheme_morphism(P, X)),
                       (q: scheme_morphism(P, Z)):
          is_pullback(P, X, Z, Y, p, q, f, g))
      AND (FORALL (Z, P: scheme), (g: scheme_morphism(Z, Y)),
                  (p: scheme_morphism(P, X)),
                  (q: scheme_morphism(P, Z)):
        is_pullback(P, X, Z, Y, p, q, f, g)
          IMPLIES is_closed_map(P, Z, q))
      AND (FORALL (Z, P, Pprime: scheme),
                  (g: scheme_morphism(Z, Y)),
                  (p: scheme_morphism(P, X)),
                  (q: scheme_morphism(P, Z)),
                  (pprime: scheme_morphism(Pprime, X)),
                  (qprime: scheme_morphism(Pprime, Z)):
        is_pullback(P, X, Z, Y, p, q, f, g)
          AND is_pullback(Pprime, X, Z, Y, pprime, qprime, f, g)
        IMPLIES pullback_presentations_equivalent(P, Pprime, X, Z,
          p, q, pprime, qprime))

  induced_map(X, Y: scheme, f: scheme_morphism(X, Y),
      V: point_set(Y), U: point_set(X), a: section(Y)): section(X) =
    sch_restrict(X)(preimage(X, Y, f, V), U, mor_map(f)(V, a))

  is_subalgebra(A: scheme, U: point_set(A),
      B: scheme, V: point_set(B), phi: [section(A) -> section(B)],
      C: section_set(B)): bool =
    C(sch_zero(B)(V)) AND C(sch_one(B)(V))
      AND (FORALL (a: section(A)):
        sch_section(A)(U, a) IMPLIES C(phi(a)))
      AND (FORALL (b: section(B)):
        C(b) IMPLIES sch_section(B)(V, b))
      AND (FORALL (b: section(B)): C(b) IMPLIES C(sch_neg(B)(V, b)))
      AND (FORALL (b, c: section(B)):
        C(b) AND C(c) IMPLIES C(sch_add(B)(V, b, c))
          AND C(sch_mul(B)(V, b, c)))

  finite_type_ring_map(A: scheme, U: point_set(A),
      B: scheme, V: point_set(B),
      phi: [section(A) -> section(B)]): bool =
    ring_hom(A, U, B, V, phi)
      AND EXISTS (G: finite_set[section(B)]):
        (FORALL (b: section(B)):
          member(b, G) IMPLIES sch_section(B)(V, b))
          AND (FORALL (C: section_set(B)):
            is_subalgebra(A, U, B, V, phi, C)
              AND (FORALL (b: section(B)): member(b, G) IMPLIES C(b))
            IMPLIES FORALL (b: section(B)):
              sch_section(B)(V, b) IMPLIES C(b))

  locally_of_finite_type(X, Y: scheme,
      f: scheme_morphism(X, Y)): bool =
    is_scheme_morphism(X, Y, f)
      AND (FORALL (V: point_set(Y)), (U: point_set(X)):
        affine_open(Y, V) AND affine_open(X, U)
          AND subset(X, U, preimage(X, Y, f, V))
        IMPLIES finite_type_ring_map(Y, V, X, U,
          LAMBDA (a: section(Y)): induced_map(X, Y, f, V, U, a)))

  is_proper_morphism(X, Y: scheme,
      f: scheme_morphism(X, Y)): bool =
    is_separated(X, Y, f) AND universally_closed(X, Y, f)
      AND locally_of_finite_type(X, Y, f)

  is_affine_morphism(X, Y: scheme,
      f: scheme_morphism(X, Y)): bool =
    is_scheme_morphism(X, Y, f)
      AND (FORALL (V: point_set(Y)):
        affine_open(Y, V)
          IMPLIES affine_open(X, preimage(X, Y, f, V)))

  is_submodule(A: scheme, U: point_set(A),
      B: scheme, V: point_set(B), phi: [section(A) -> section(B)],
      M: section_set(B)): bool =
    M(sch_zero(B)(V))
      AND (FORALL (b: section(B)):
        M(b) IMPLIES sch_section(B)(V, b))
      AND (FORALL (b: section(B)): M(b) IMPLIES M(sch_neg(B)(V, b)))
      AND (FORALL (b, c: section(B)):
        M(b) AND M(c) IMPLIES M(sch_add(B)(V, b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: section(A)), (b: section(B)):
        sch_section(A)(U, a) AND M(b)
          IMPLIES M(sch_mul(B)(V, phi(a), b)))

  finite_module_ring_map(A: scheme, U: point_set(A),
      B: scheme, V: point_set(B),
      phi: [section(A) -> section(B)]): bool =
    ring_hom(A, U, B, V, phi)
      AND EXISTS (G: finite_set[section(B)]):
        (FORALL (b: section(B)):
          member(b, G) IMPLIES sch_section(B)(V, b))
          AND (FORALL (M: section_set(B)):
            is_submodule(A, U, B, V, phi, M)
              AND (FORALL (b: section(B)): member(b, G) IMPLIES M(b))
            IMPLIES FORALL (b: section(B)):
              sch_section(B)(V, b) IMPLIES M(b))

  is_finite_morphism(X, Y: scheme,
      f: scheme_morphism(X, Y)): bool =
    is_affine_morphism(X, Y, f)
      AND (FORALL (V: point_set(Y)):
        affine_open(Y, V) IMPLIES finite_module_ring_map(Y, V, X,
          preimage(X, Y, f, V),
          LAMBDA (a: section(Y)): mor_map(f)(V, a)))

  is_open_subscheme(T, S: scheme, U: point_set(S),
      j: scheme_morphism(T, S)): bool =
    sch_open(S)(U) AND is_scheme_morphism(T, S, j)
      AND same_set(S, image(T, S, j, full_set(T)), U)
      AND (FORALL (x, xprime: point(T)):
        mor_base(j)(x) = mor_base(j)(xprime) IMPLIES x = xprime)
      AND (FORALL (V: point_set(T)):
        sch_open(T)(V) IFF EXISTS (W: point_set(S)):
          sch_open(S)(W) AND subset(S, W, U)
            AND same_set(S, image(T, S, j, V), W))
      AND (FORALL (W: point_set(S)):
        sch_open(S)(W) AND subset(S, W, U)
        IMPLIES
          (FORALL (a: section(S)):
            sch_section(S)(W, a) IMPLIES
              sch_section(T)(preimage(T, S, j, W), mor_map(j)(W, a)))
          AND (FORALL (b: section(T)):
            sch_section(T)(preimage(T, S, j, W), b)
              IMPLIES EXISTS (a: section(S)):
                sch_section(S)(W, a) AND mor_map(j)(W, a) = b)
          AND (FORALL (a, b: section(S)):
            sch_section(S)(W, a) AND sch_section(S)(W, b)
              AND mor_map(j)(W, a) = mor_map(j)(W, b)
            IMPLIES a = b))

  is_morphism_restriction(X, Y: scheme, f: scheme_morphism(X, Y),
      V: point_set(Y), XV, YV: scheme,
      iX: scheme_morphism(XV, X), iY: scheme_morphism(YV, Y),
      r: scheme_morphism(XV, YV)): bool =
    is_open_subscheme(YV, Y, V, iY)
      AND is_open_subscheme(XV, X, preimage(X, Y, f, V), iX)
      AND is_pullback(XV, X, YV, Y, iX, r, f, iY)

  fiber(X, Y: scheme, f: scheme_morphism(X, Y),
      y: point(Y)): point_set(X) =
    LAMBDA (x: point(X)): mor_base(f)(x) = y

  zariski_s_main_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (X, Y: scheme), (f: scheme_morphism(X, Y)), (y: point(Y)):
      is_proper_morphism(X, Y, f)
        AND finite_point_set(X, fiber(X, Y, f, y))
      IMPLIES EXISTS (V: point_set(Y)), (XV, YV: scheme),
                     (iX: scheme_morphism(XV, X)),
                     (iY: scheme_morphism(YV, Y)),
                     (r: scheme_morphism(XV, YV)):
        sch_open(Y)(V) AND V(y)
          AND is_morphism_restriction(X, Y, f, V, XV, YV, iX, iY, r)
          AND is_finite_morphism(XV, YV, r)

END Q8066795_zariski_s_main_theorem

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q810431,
;; "Basel problem": the real series with n-th term 1 / n^2, whose zero-index
;; term is zero under real-field division, has sum pi^2 / 6. Exact rational
;; partial sums and a full Cauchy representative of pi encode the real limit.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Machin's arctangent series is an exact rational Cauchy representative of
;; pi. No finite prefix is identified with pi.

(defun q810431-arctan-prefix (z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (1- terms))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (unsigned-term (/ (expt z exponent) exponent))
           (term (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
                     unsigned-term
                   (- unsigned-term))))
      (+ (q810431-arctan-prefix z index)
         term))))

(defun q810431-pi-prefix (terms)
  (- (* 16 (q810431-arctan-prefix (/ 1 5) terms))
     (* 4 (q810431-arctan-prefix (/ 1 239) terms))))

;; This is the sum over indices 0 through TERMS - 1. ACL2 division, like real
;; field division in the source, gives 1 / 0 = 0, so the zero-index term is
;; represented exactly rather than deleted.

(defun q810431-reciprocal-square-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (1- terms)))
      (+ (q810431-reciprocal-square-prefix index)
         (/ 1 (* index index))))))

(defun q810431-basel-limit-prefix (pi-terms)
  (/ (expt (q810431-pi-prefix pi-terms) 2)
     6))

;; A strict inequality to the represented real limit is encoded using an
;; internal rational bound below EPSILON and tails of both the source partial
;; sums and the Cauchy representative of pi^2 / 6.

(defun-sk q810431-close-tail-p
    (bound series-cutoff pi-cutoff)
  (forall (terms pi-terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp pi-terms)
      (natp series-cutoff)
      (natp pi-cutoff)
      (<= series-cutoff terms)
      (<= pi-cutoff pi-terms))
     (< (abs
         (- (q810431-reciprocal-square-prefix terms)
            (q810431-basel-limit-prefix pi-terms)))
        bound))))

(defun-sk q810431-cutoffs-exist-p (epsilon)
  (exists (bound series-cutoff pi-cutoff)
    (and
     (rationalp bound)
     (< 0 bound)
     (< bound epsilon)
     (natp series-cutoff)
     (natp pi-cutoff)
     (q810431-close-tail-p
      bound series-cutoff pi-cutoff))))

;; Positive rational tolerances are cofinal among positive real tolerances.
;; Thus this is the full epsilon-N HasSum statement over the reals, with all
;; approximation and convergence witnesses quantified internally.

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q810431-basel-problem-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp epsilon)
      (< 0 epsilon))
     (q810431-cutoffs-exist-p epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q810431_basel_problem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q810431
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q810431), "Basel problem": the real series over
-- all natural n of 1 / n squared converges to pi squared divided by 6.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q810431_basel_problem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    negate inverse : R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set
    fromNat : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> add x y == add y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> add x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> add x (negate x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiply x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiply x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqual zeroR (multiply x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqual zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (suc n) == add (fromNat n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m + n) == add (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat (m * n) == multiply (fromNat m) (fromNat n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNat m == fromNat n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqual x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqual x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqual x upper) ->
              lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtract reals x y =
  add reals x (negate reals y)

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiply reals x (inverse reals y)

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiply reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqual reals x y) (x != y)

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals f x y =
  divide reals
    (subtract reals (f y) (f x))
    (subtract reals y x)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals f x derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
        ((y : R) ->
          StrictLess reals (subtract reals x delta) y ->
          StrictLess reals y (add reals x delta) ->
          y != x ->
          Both
            (StrictLess reals
              (subtract reals derivative epsilon)
              (differenceQuotient reals f x y))
            (StrictLess reals
              (differenceQuotient reals f x y)
              (add reals derivative epsilon))))

record StandardRealAnalysis (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    algebra : CompleteOrderedField R
    pi : R
    sine cosine : R -> R

    sine-zero :
      sine (zeroR algebra) == zeroR algebra
    cosine-zero :
      cosine (zeroR algebra) == oneR algebra
    sine-addition :
      (x y : R) ->
      sine (add algebra x y) ==
      add algebra
        (multiply algebra (sine x) (cosine y))
        (multiply algebra (cosine x) (sine y))
    cosine-addition :
      (x y : R) ->
      cosine (add algebra x y) ==
      subtract algebra
        (multiply algebra (cosine x) (cosine y))
        (multiply algebra (sine x) (sine y))
    sine-negate :
      (x : R) ->
      sine (negate algebra x) == negate algebra (sine x)
    cosine-negate :
      (x : R) ->
      cosine (negate algebra x) == cosine x
    pythagorean :
      (x : R) ->
      add algebra
        (square algebra (sine x))
        (square algebra (cosine x))
      == oneR algebra
    sine-derivative-at-zero :
      DerivativeAt algebra sine (zeroR algebra) (oneR algebra)

    pi-positive :
      StrictLess algebra (zeroR algebra) pi
    sine-pi :
      sine pi == zeroR algebra
    cosine-pi :
      cosine pi == negate algebra (oneR algebra)
    sine-positive-before-pi :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess algebra (zeroR algebra) x ->
      StrictLess algebra x pi ->
      StrictLess algebra (zeroR algebra) (sine x)

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals
          (subtract reals limit epsilon)
          (sequence n))
        (StrictLess reals
          (sequence n)
          (add reals limit epsilon)))

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero term =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) term =
  add reals
    (sumFirst reals n term)
    (term n)

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals term limit =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n term)
    limit

reciprocalSquareTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
reciprocalSquareTerm reals n =
  divide reals
    (oneR reals)
    (square reals (fromNat reals n))

module Statement
  {R : Set}
  (reals : StandardRealAnalysis R) where

  open StandardRealAnalysis reals

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    SeriesHasSum algebra
      (reciprocalSquareTerm algebra)
      (divide algebra
        (square algebra pi)
        (fromNat algebra 6))

basel-problem : Set1
basel-problem =
  (R : Set) ->

title: Q810431_basel_problem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q810431
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q810431), "Basel problem": the real reciprocal-square
% series over the natural numbers converges to pi squared divided by six.
% This file contains no proof.

Q810431_basel_problem: THEORY
BEGIN
  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN 0 ELSE numerator / denominator ENDIF

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index),
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  reciprocal_square_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        reciprocal_square_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(1, (index :: real) ^ 2)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(count) - value) < eps

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    converges_to(
      (LAMBDA (count: nat): 4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count)),
      value)

  pi: real =
    epsilon(LAMBDA (value: real): is_pi(value))

  hasSum_zeta_two: bool =
    converges_to(
      (LAMBDA (count: nat): reciprocal_square_partial_sum(count)),
      pi ^ 2 / 6)
END Q810431_basel_problem

-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q834025), "Cauchy integral theorem": for a complex-valued
-- function continuous on a closed disc and complex differentiable in its interior away
-- from a countable set, the circle integral of `f z / (z - w)` equals `2πi f(w)`.

module

@[expose] public section

open Set MeasureTheory Metric

namespace Complex.Q834025

/-- The Cauchy integral formula for a function differentiable off a countable set. -/
theorem cauchy_integral_theorem {R : ℝ} {c w : ℂ} {s : Set ℂ}
    (hs : s.Countable) (hw : w ∈ ball c R) {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hc : ContinuousOn f (closedBall c R))
    (hd : ∀ z ∈ ball c R \ s, DifferentiableAt ℂ f z) :
    (∮ z in C(c, R), f z / (z - w)) = 2 * π * I * f w := sorry
