title: Q834025_cauchy_integral_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q834025
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q834025), "Cauchy integral theorem": for a
  complex-valued function continuous on a closed disk and complex
  differentiable on its open disk outside a countable set, the circle
  integral of f(z)/(z-w) is 2*pi*i*f(w) at every interior point w.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalEpsilon RiemannInt.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q834025_complex : Type := (R * R)%type.
Definition q834025_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q834025_czero : q834025_complex := (0, 0).
Definition q834025_ci : q834025_complex := (0, 1).

Definition q834025_of_real (x : R) : q834025_complex :=
  (x, 0).

Definition q834025_cadd
    (z w : q834025_complex) : q834025_complex :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition q834025_cneg
    (z : q834025_complex) : q834025_complex :=
  (- fst z, - snd z).

Definition q834025_csub
    (z w : q834025_complex) : q834025_complex :=
  q834025_cadd z (q834025_cneg w).

Definition q834025_cmul
    (z w : q834025_complex) : q834025_complex :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Definition q834025_norm_sq
    (z : q834025_complex) : R :=
  fst z * fst z + snd z * snd z.

Definition q834025_cmodulus
    (z : q834025_complex) : R :=
  sqrt (q834025_norm_sq z).

Definition q834025_cinv
    (z : q834025_complex) : q834025_complex :=
  if Req_EM_T (q834025_norm_sq z) 0 then
    q834025_czero
  else
    (fst z / q834025_norm_sq z,
     - snd z / q834025_norm_sq z).

Definition q834025_cdiv
    (z w : q834025_complex) : q834025_complex :=
  q834025_cmul z (q834025_cinv w).

Definition q834025_open_ball
    (center : q834025_complex) (radius : R) :
    q834025_set q834025_complex :=
  fun z =>
    q834025_cmodulus (q834025_csub z center) < radius.

Definition q834025_closed_ball
    (center : q834025_complex) (radius : R) :
    q834025_set q834025_complex :=
  fun z =>
    q834025_cmodulus (q834025_csub z center) <= radius.

Definition q834025_countable
    {A : Type} (S : q834025_set A) : Prop :=
  exists encode : A -> nat,
    forall x y : A,
      S x ->
      S y ->
      encode x = encode y ->
      x = y.

Definition q834025_continuous_within_at
    (f : q834025_complex -> q834025_complex)
    (S : q834025_set q834025_complex)
    (z : q834025_complex) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall w : q834025_complex,
        S w ->
        q834025_cmodulus (q834025_csub w z) < delta ->
        q834025_cmodulus
          (q834025_csub (f w) (f z)) < epsilon.

Definition q834025_continuous_on
    (f : q834025_complex -> q834025_complex)
    (S : q834025_set q834025_complex) : Prop :=
  forall z : q834025_complex,
    S z -> q834025_continuous_within_at f S z.

Definition q834025_has_complex_derivative_at
    (f : q834025_complex -> q834025_complex)
    (z derivative : q834025_complex) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall h : q834025_complex,
        q834025_cmodulus h < delta ->
        q834025_cmodulus
          (q834025_csub
            (q834025_csub
              (f (q834025_cadd z h)) (f z))
            (q834025_cmul derivative h))
        <= epsilon * q834025_cmodulus h.

Definition q834025_complex_differentiable_at
    (f : q834025_complex -> q834025_complex)
    (z : q834025_complex) : Prop :=
  exists derivative : q834025_complex,
    q834025_has_complex_derivative_at f z derivative.

Definition q834025_circle_map
    (center : q834025_complex) (radius theta : R) :
    q834025_complex :=
  q834025_cadd center
    (radius * cos theta, radius * sin theta).

Definition q834025_circle_map_derivative
    (radius theta : R) : q834025_complex :=
  (- radius * sin theta, radius * cos theta).

Definition q834025_real_integral
    (g : R -> R) (a b : R) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits 0)
    (fun value : R =>
      exists integrable : Riemann_integrable g a b,
        value = RiemannInt integrable).

Definition q834025_complex_integral
    (g : R -> q834025_complex) (a b : R) :
    q834025_complex :=
  (q834025_real_integral (fun theta => fst (g theta)) a b,
   q834025_real_integral (fun theta => snd (g theta)) a b).

Definition q834025_circle_integral
    (g : q834025_complex -> q834025_complex)
    (center : q834025_complex) (radius : R) :
    q834025_complex :=
  q834025_complex_integral
    (fun theta =>
      q834025_cmul
        (q834025_circle_map_derivative radius theta)
        (g (q834025_circle_map center radius theta)))
    0 (2 * PI).

Theorem Complex_circleIntegral_div_sub_of_differentiable_on_off_countable :
  forall (R0 : R)
         (c w : q834025_complex)
         (s : q834025_set q834025_complex)
         (f : q834025_complex -> q834025_complex),
    q834025_countable s ->
    q834025_open_ball c R0 w ->
    q834025_continuous_on f (q834025_closed_ball c R0) ->
    (forall z : q834025_complex,
      q834025_open_ball c R0 z ->
      ~ s z ->
      q834025_complex_differentiable_at f z) ->
    q834025_circle_integral
      (fun z => q834025_cdiv (f z) (q834025_csub z w))
      c R0 =
    q834025_cmul
      (q834025_cmul (q834025_of_real (2 * PI)) q834025_ci)
      (f w).
Admitted.

title: Q834025_cauchy_integral_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q834025, "Cauchy integral theorem": the Cauchy integral formula for a
  complex-valued function continuous on a closed disc and complex
  differentiable in its interior outside a countable exceptional set. The
  positively oriented circle integral is represented by its standard
  parametrized Riemann sums. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q834025_cauchy_integral_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q834025_complex_differentiable_at ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q834025_complex_differentiable_at f z \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>d. ((\<lambda>h. (f (z + h) - f z) / h) \<longlongrightarrow> d) (at 0))"

definition q834025_circle_point ::
    "complex \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> complex"
  where
    "q834025_circle_point c R t =
      c + of_real R * exp (2 * of_real pi * \<i> * of_real t)"

definition q834025_circle_velocity ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> complex"
  where
    "q834025_circle_velocity R t =
      of_real R * (2 * of_real pi * \<i>) *
        exp (2 * of_real pi * \<i> * of_real t)"

definition q834025_circle_riemann_sum ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> complex"
  where
    "q834025_circle_riemann_sum n c R g =
      (if n = 0 then 0 else
        (\<Sum>k<n.
          g (q834025_circle_point c R (real k / real n)) *
          q834025_circle_velocity R (real k / real n) *
          of_real (1 / real n)))"

definition q834025_circle_integral ::
    "complex \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> complex"
  where
    "q834025_circle_integral c R g =
      Lim at_top (\<lambda>n. q834025_circle_riemann_sum n c R g)"

theorem q834025_cauchy_integral_formula_off_countable:
  fixes R :: real
    and c w :: complex
    and s :: "complex set"
    and f :: "complex \<Rightarrow> complex"
  assumes exceptional_set: "countable s"
    and interior_point: "w \<in> ball c R"
    and continuous_closed_disc: "continuous_on (cball c R) f"
    and differentiable_off_countable:
      "\<And>z. z \<in> ball c R - s \<Longrightarrow>
        q834025_complex_differentiable_at f z"
  shows
    "q834025_circle_integral c R (\<lambda>z. f z / (z - w)) =
      2 * of_real pi * \<i> * f w"
  oops

end

title: Q834025_cauchy_integral_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q834025
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q834025), "Cauchy integral theorem": the
  Cauchy integral formula on a circle for a complex-valued function continuous
  on the closed disc and complex differentiable in its interior outside a
  countable set. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q834025_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q834025_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q834025_output;;
let q834025_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q834025_formatter path);;
let q834025_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q834025_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q834025_previous_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q834025_formatter ();;
close_out q834025_output;;
if not q834025_loaded then failwith "Unable to load transcendental library";;

let Q834025_CAUCHY_INTEGRAL_THEOREM =
  `let cadd =
       \(z:real#real) (u:real#real).
         (FST z + FST u,SND z + SND u) in
   let csub =
       \(z:real#real) (u:real#real).
         (FST z - FST u,SND z - SND u) in
   let cmul =
       \(z:real#real) (u:real#real).
         (FST z * FST u - SND z * SND u,
          FST z * SND u + SND z * FST u) in
   let cinv =
       \(z:real#real).
         let q = FST z * FST z + SND z * SND z in
         (FST z / q,--(SND z) / q) in
   let cdiv =
       \(z:real#real) (u:real#real).
         cmul z (cinv u) in
   let cnorm =
       \(z:real#real).
         sqrt(FST z * FST z + SND z * SND z) in
   let open_disc =
       \(c:real#real) (R:real) (z:real#real).
         cnorm (csub z c) < R in
   let closed_disc =
       \(c:real#real) (R:real) (z:real#real).
         cnorm (csub z c) <= R in
   let continuous_on_closed_disc =
       \(c:real#real) (R:real) (f:(real#real)->real#real).
         !x:real#real.
           closed_disc c R x
           ==> !epsilon:real.
                 &0 < epsilon
                 ==> ?delta:real.
                       &0 < delta /\
                       !y:real#real.
                         closed_disc c R y /\
                         cnorm (csub y x) < delta
                         ==> cnorm (csub (f y) (f x)) < epsilon in
   let complex_differentiable_at =
       \(f:(real#real)->real#real) (x:real#real).
         ?d:real#real.
           !epsilon:real.
             &0 < epsilon
             ==> ?delta:real.
                   &0 < delta /\
                   !h:real#real.
                     cnorm h < delta
                     ==> cnorm
                           (csub
                             (csub (f (cadd x h)) (f x))
                             (cmul d h))
                         <= epsilon * cnorm h in
   let circle =
       \(c:real#real) (R:real) (theta:real).
         cadd c (R * cos theta,R * sin theta) in
   let circle_derivative =
       \(R:real) (theta:real).
         (--(R * sin theta),R * cos theta) in
   let cauchy_integrand =
       \(c:real#real) (R:real) (w:real#real)
        (f:(real#real)->real#real) (theta:real).
         cmul
           (cdiv (f (circle c R theta))
                 (csub (circle c R theta) w))
           (circle_derivative R theta) in
   let circle_integral =
       \(c:real#real) (R:real) (w:real#real)
        (f:(real#real)->real#real).
         (integral(&0,&2 * pi)
            (\theta. FST (cauchy_integrand c R w f theta)),
          integral(&0,&2 * pi)
            (\theta. SND (cauchy_integrand c R w f theta))) in
   !(R:real) (c:real#real) (w:real#real)
     (s:(real#real)->bool) (f:(real#real)->real#real).
       COUNTABLE s /\
       open_disc c R w /\
       continuous_on_closed_disc c R f /\
       (!z:real#real.
          open_disc c R z /\ ~(z IN s)
          ==> complex_differentiable_at f z)
       ==> circle_integral c R w f =
           cmul (cmul (&2 * pi,&0) (&0,&1)) (f w)`;;

            (yz-add (q834025-r-add real y z))

            (yz-mul (q834025-r-multiply real y z))

          real x (q834025-r-add real y z))

title: Q834025_cauchy_integral_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q834025,
-- "Cauchy integral theorem": the Cauchy integral formula for a complex-valued
-- function continuous on a closed disc and complex differentiable in its
-- interior outside a countable set. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q834025_cauchy_integral_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (zero; suc)
open import Support.CauchyIntegral

open CompleteOrderedField
open CanonicalComplexTranscendentals

cauchy-integral-theorem : Set2
cauchy-integral-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (transcendentals :
    CanonicalComplexTranscendentals reals complexNorm) ->
  (radius : R) ->
  (center point : Complex R) ->
  (exceptional : SetOf (Complex R)) ->
  CountableComplexSet exceptional ->
  OpenBall reals complexNorm center radius point ->
  (f : Complex R -> Complex R) ->
  ContinuousOn reals complexNorm f
    (ClosedBall reals complexNorm center radius) ->
  ((z : Complex R) ->
    OpenBall reals complexNorm center radius z ->
    Not (exceptional z) ->
    ComplexDifferentiableAt reals complexNorm f z) ->
  RiemannIntegralOn reals complexNorm
    (zeroR reals)
    (multiplyR reals
      (fromNatR reals (suc (suc zero)))
      (piR transcendentals))
    (\ theta ->
      circleIntegrand reals transcendentals
        center radius point f theta)
    (twoPiITimes reals transcendentals (f point))

title: Q834025_cauchy_integral_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q834025, "Cauchy integral theorem": the Cauchy integral formula on a
  complex circle for a function continuous on the closed disc and complex
  differentiable in its interior outside a countable set. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory complexTheory;
open integralTheory;

val q834025_countable_def = new_definition (
  "q834025_countable_def",
  ``q834025_countable (s : complex set) <=>
      ?encode : complex -> num.
        INJ encode s (UNIV : num set)``);

val q834025_open_ball_def = new_definition (
  "q834025_open_ball_def",
  ``q834025_open_ball (c : complex) (R : real) (z : complex) <=>
      modu (z - c) < R``);

val q834025_closed_ball_def = new_definition (
  "q834025_closed_ball_def",
  ``q834025_closed_ball (c : complex) (R : real) (z : complex) <=>
      modu (z - c) <= R``);

val q834025_continuous_on_closed_ball_def = new_definition (
  "q834025_continuous_on_closed_ball_def",
  ``q834025_continuous_on_closed_ball
      (f : complex -> complex) (c : complex) (R : real) <=>
      !x : complex.
        q834025_closed_ball c R x ==>
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !y : complex.
              q834025_closed_ball c R y /\
              modu (y - x) < delta
              ==>
              modu (f y - f x) < epsilon``);

val q834025_complex_differentiable_at_def = new_definition (
  "q834025_complex_differentiable_at_def",
  ``q834025_complex_differentiable_at
      (f : complex -> complex) (x : complex) <=>
      ?derivative : complex.
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !h : complex.
              0 < modu h /\ modu h < delta
              ==>
              modu
                (f (x + h) - f x - derivative * h) <
              epsilon * modu h``);

val q834025_circle_map_def = new_definition (
  "q834025_circle_map_def",
  ``q834025_circle_map
      (c : complex) (R : real) (theta : real) =
      c +
      complex_of_real R *
        complex_exp (complex_of_real theta * i)``);

val q834025_circle_velocity_def = new_definition (
  "q834025_circle_velocity_def",
  ``q834025_circle_velocity (R : real) (theta : real) =
      complex_of_real R * i *
        complex_exp (complex_of_real theta * i)``);

val q834025_circle_integrand_def = new_definition (
  "q834025_circle_integrand_def",
  ``q834025_circle_integrand
      (g : complex -> complex) (c : complex) (R : real) (theta : real) =
      g (q834025_circle_map c R theta) *
        q834025_circle_velocity R theta``);

val q834025_circle_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q834025_circle_integral_def",
  ``q834025_circle_integral
      (g : complex -> complex) (c : complex) (R : real) =
      ((integral (0,2 * pi)
          (\theta. RE (q834025_circle_integrand g c R theta)),
        integral (0,2 * pi)
          (\theta. IM (q834025_circle_integrand g c R theta))) :
        complex)``);

val circleIntegral_div_sub_of_differentiable_on_off_countable =
  ``!(R : real) (c : complex) (w : complex) (s : complex set)
      (f : complex -> complex).
      q834025_countable s /\
      q834025_open_ball c R w /\
      q834025_continuous_on_closed_ball f c R /\
      (!z : complex.
        q834025_open_ball c R z /\ ~(z IN s)
        ==>
        q834025_complex_differentiable_at f z)
      ==>
      q834025_circle_integral (\z. f z / (z - w)) c R =
        complex_of_real (2 * pi) * i * f w``;

title: Q834025_cauchy_integral_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q834025
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q834025), "Cauchy integral theorem": Cauchy's
  integral formula for a complex-valued function continuous on a closed disk
  and complex differentiable in its interior away from a countable set. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q834025OpenBall and Q834025ClosedBall are the open and closed disks in CC.
  Q834025ContinuousOn is relative epsilon-delta continuity. Membership of z
  in dom ( CC _D F ) is SetMM's native complex differentiability predicate,
  equivalent here to Lean's one-dimensional complex Frechet
  differentiability.

  Q834025CircleMap parametrizes the circle by
  c + R * exp(i*t), and Q834025CircleDeriv is its derivative.
  Q834025CircleIntegral is the directed totalized complex Lebesgue integral
  from 0 to 2*pi of F(z)/(z-w) times dz/dt. This is the SetMM rendering of
  Lean's circleIntegral, including its behavior for arbitrary real radii.

  The final $a assertion quantifies over the arbitrary real radius, complex
  center and interior point, countable exceptional set, and total complex
  function. Every preceding $a declaration is syntax or an explicit
  definition; there is no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q834025OpenBall Q834025ClosedBall Q834025ContinuousOn
   Q834025CircleMap Q834025CircleDeriv Q834025CircleIntegral $.

q834025-open-ball-syntax
  $a class ( Q834025OpenBall C R ) $.
q834025-closed-ball-syntax
  $a class ( Q834025ClosedBall C R ) $.
q834025-continuous-on-syntax
  $a wff ( Q834025ContinuousOn F S ) $.
q834025-circle-map-syntax
  $a class ( Q834025CircleMap C R T ) $.
q834025-circle-deriv-syntax
  $a class ( Q834025CircleDeriv R T ) $.
q834025-circle-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q834025CircleIntegral F C R W ) $.

${
  $d C R z $.

  q834025-open-ball-definition $a |- (
    Q834025OpenBall C R
  ) = {
    z e. CC |
      ( ( abs ` ( z - C ) ) < R )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d C R z $.

  q834025-closed-ball-definition $a |- (
    Q834025ClosedBall C R
  ) = {
    z e. CC |
      ( ( abs ` ( z - C ) ) <_ R )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d F S d e x y $.

  q834025-continuous-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q834025ContinuousOn F S )
    <->
    A. x e. S
      A. e e. RR+
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. S
            (
              ( ( abs ` ( y - x ) ) < d )
              ->
              (
                ( abs ` ( ( F ` y ) - ( F ` x ) ) )
                <
                e
              )
            )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C R T $.

  q834025-circle-map-definition $a |- (
    Q834025CircleMap C R T
  ) = (
    C
    +
    ( R x. ( exp ` ( _i x. T ) ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d R T $.

  q834025-circle-deriv-definition $a |- (
    Q834025CircleDeriv R T
  ) = (
    ( R x. _i )
    x.
    ( exp ` ( _i x. T ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C F R W t $.

  q834025-circle-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q834025CircleIntegral F C R W
  ) = (
    S_ [ 0 -> ( 2 x. _pi ) ]
      (
        (
          ( F ` ( Q834025CircleMap C R t ) )
          /
          ( ( Q834025CircleMap C R t ) - W )
        )
        x.
        ( Q834025CircleDeriv R t )
      )
    _d t
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C F R S W z $.

  thousand-theorems-q834025-cauchy-integral-formula $a |-
    A. R e. RR
      A. C e. CC
        A. W e. CC
          A. S e. ~P CC
            A. F e. ( CC ^m CC )
              (
                (
                  S ~<_ _om
                  /\
                  W e. ( Q834025OpenBall C R )
                  /\
                  (
                    Q834025ContinuousOn
                    F
                    ( Q834025ClosedBall C R )
                  )
                  /\
                  A. z e.
                    ( ( Q834025OpenBall C R ) \ S )
                    z e. dom ( CC _D F )
                )
                ->
                (
                  Q834025CircleIntegral F C R W
                )
                =
                (
                  (
                    ( 2 x. _pi )
                    x.
                    _i
                  )
                  x.
                  ( F ` W )
                )
              )
  $.
$}

title: Q834025_cauchy_integral_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q834025,
% "Cauchy integral theorem": Cauchy's circle integral formula for a complex
% function continuous on a closed disc and complex differentiable in its
% interior away from a countable set. This file contains no proof.

Q834025_cauchy_integral_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  complex_function: TYPE = [complex -> complex]
  complex_set: TYPE = [complex -> bool]
  complex_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> complex]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_i: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 1 #)

  complex_of_real(x: real): complex =
    (# real_part := x, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_neg(x: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(x),
       imag_part := -imag_part(x) #)

  complex_sub(x, y: complex): complex =
    complex_add(x, complex_neg(y))

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(x) * real_part(y)
           - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
           + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  complex_norm_squared(x: complex): real =
    real_part(x) ^ 2 + imag_part(x) ^ 2

  complex_norm(x: complex): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        0 <= value
          AND value ^ 2 = complex_norm_squared(x))

  complex_inv(x: complex): complex =
    IF complex_norm_squared(x) = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      (# real_part :=
           real_part(x) / complex_norm_squared(x),
         imag_part :=
           -imag_part(x) / complex_norm_squared(x) #)
    ENDIF

  complex_div(x, y: complex): complex =
    complex_mul(x, complex_inv(y))

  complex_power(x: complex, exponent: nat):
      RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(
        complex_power(x, exponent - 1),
        x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  complex_div_real(x: complex, denominator: real): complex =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      (# real_part := real_part(x) / denominator,
         imag_part := imag_part(x) / denominator #)
    ENDIF

  complex_exp_partial_sum(
      x: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          complex_exp_partial_sum(x, count - 1),
          complex_div_real(
            complex_power(x, index),
            (factorial(index) :: real)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_complex(
      values: complex_sequence,
      limit: complex): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            complex_norm(
              complex_sub(values(index), limit))
              < epsilon_value

  complex_exp(x: complex): complex =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: complex):
        converges_to_complex(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            complex_exp_partial_sum(x, count),
          value))

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + alternating_sign(index)
              / ((2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(
      values: real_sequence,
      limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    converges_to_real(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
      value)

  pi: real =
    epsilon(LAMBDA (value: real): is_pi(value))

  in_open_ball(
      z, center: complex,
      radius: real): bool =
    complex_norm(complex_sub(z, center)) < radius

  in_closed_ball(
      z, center: complex,
      radius: real): bool =
    complex_norm(complex_sub(z, center)) <= radius

  countable_set(s: complex_set): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: complex_sequence):
      FORALL (z: complex):
        s(z) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (index: nat):
            enumeration(index) = z

  continuous_on_closed_ball(
      f: complex_function,
      center: complex,
      radius: real): bool =
    FORALL (z: complex):
      in_closed_ball(z, center, radius) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (delta: posreal):
            FORALL (y: complex):
              (in_closed_ball(y, center, radius)
                AND complex_norm(complex_sub(y, z)) < delta)
              IMPLIES
                complex_norm(
                  complex_sub(f(y), f(z)))
                  < epsilon_value

  has_complex_derivative_at(
      f: complex_function,
      derivative: complex,
      z: complex): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: complex):
          (y /= z
            AND complex_norm(complex_sub(y, z)) < delta)
          IMPLIES
            complex_norm(
              complex_sub(
                complex_sub(f(y), f(z)),
                complex_mul(
                  derivative,
                  complex_sub(y, z))))
              < epsilon_value
                  * complex_norm(complex_sub(y, z))

  complex_differentiable_at(
      f: complex_function,
      z: complex): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: complex):
      has_complex_derivative_at(f, derivative, z)

  circle_map(
      center: complex,
      radius, theta: real): complex =
    complex_add(
      center,
      complex_mul(
        complex_of_real(radius),
        complex_exp(
          complex_mul(
            complex_i,
            complex_of_real(theta)))))

  circle_map_derivative(
      center: complex,
      radius, theta: real): complex =
    complex_mul(
      complex_i,
      complex_sub(
        circle_map(center, radius, theta),
        center))

  positive_gauge(gauge: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real): 0 < gauge(x)

  tagged_partition(
      left, right: real,
      count: nat,
      points, tags: real_sequence): bool =
    points(0) = left
      AND points(count) = right
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          (points(index) < points(index + 1)
            AND points(index) <= tags(index)
            AND tags(index) <= points(index + 1)))

  gauge_fine(
      gauge: real_function,
      count: nat,
      points, tags: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES
        (tags(index) - gauge(tags(index)) < points(index)
          AND points(index + 1)
            < tags(index) + gauge(tags(index)))

  complex_tagged_sum(
      integrand: [real -> complex],
      count: nat,
      points, tags: real_sequence): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      complex_add(
        complex_tagged_sum(
          integrand, count - 1, points, tags),
        complex_mul(
          integrand(tags(count - 1)),
          complex_of_real(
            points(count) - points(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_complex_interval_integral(
      integrand: [real -> complex],
      left, right: real,
      integral_value: complex): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (gauge: real_function):
        positive_gauge(gauge)
          AND (FORALL
              (count: nat),
              (points, tags: real_sequence):
            (tagged_partition(
                left, right, count, points, tags)
              AND gauge_fine(
                gauge, count, points, tags))
            IMPLIES
              complex_norm(
                complex_sub(
                  complex_tagged_sum(
                    integrand, count, points, tags),
                  integral_value))
                < epsilon_value)

  complex_interval_integral(
      integrand: [real -> complex],
      left, right: real): complex =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (integral_value: complex):
        has_complex_interval_integral(
          integrand, left, right, integral_value))

  circle_integrand(
      f: complex_function,
      center: complex,
      radius: real,
      w: complex): [real -> complex] =
    LAMBDA (theta: real):
      complex_mul(
        complex_div(
          f(circle_map(center, radius, theta)),
          complex_sub(
            circle_map(center, radius, theta),
            w)),
        circle_map_derivative(
          center, radius, theta))

  circle_integral(
      f: complex_function,
      center: complex,
      radius: real,
      w: complex): complex =
    complex_interval_integral(
      circle_integrand(f, center, radius, w),
      0,
      2 * pi)

  cauchy_integral_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (radius: real),
        (center, w: complex),
        (s: complex_set),
        (f: complex_function):
      (countable_set(s)
        AND in_open_ball(w, center, radius)
        AND continuous_on_closed_ball(
          f, center, radius)
        AND (FORALL (z: complex):
          (in_open_ball(z, center, radius)
            AND NOT s(z))
          IMPLIES complex_differentiable_at(f, z)))
      IMPLIES
        circle_integral(f, center, radius, w)
          = complex_mul(
              complex_mul(
                complex_of_real(2 * pi),
                complex_i),
              f(w))
END Q834025_cauchy_integral_theorem

title: Q842953_lebesgue_s_density_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q842953
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q842953), "Lebesgue's density theorem": in a
-- second-countable metric Borel space with the Besicovitch covering property,
-- almost every point of an arbitrary set is a density point for that set.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.BorelSpace.Basic
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Covering.VitaliFamily
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Defs

@[expose] public section

open Fin Metric Set Filter MeasureTheory TopologicalSpace
open scoped ENNReal MeasureTheory Topology

/-- A satellite configuration of `N + 1` balls with parameter `τ`. -/
structure Besicovitch.SatelliteConfig (α : Type*) [MetricSpace α] (N : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) where
  c : Fin N.succ → α
  r : Fin N.succ → ℝ
  rpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i
  h : Pairwise fun i j =>
    r i ≤ dist (c i) (c j) ∧ r j ≤ τ * r i ∨ r j ≤ dist (c j) (c i) ∧ r i ≤ τ * r j
  hlast : ∀ i < last N, r i ≤ dist (c i) (c (last N)) ∧ r (last N) ≤ τ * r i
  inter : ∀ i < last N, dist (c i) (c (last N)) ≤ r i + r (last N)

/-- The metric space excludes sufficiently large satellite configurations. -/
class HasBesicovitchCovering (α : Type*) [MetricSpace α] : Prop where
  no_satelliteConfig : ∃ (N : ℕ) (τ : ℝ), 1 < τ ∧
    IsEmpty (Besicovitch.SatelliteConfig α N τ)

namespace Q842953

variable {β : Type*} [MetricSpace β] [MeasurableSpace β] [BorelSpace β]
  [SecondCountableTopology β] [HasBesicovitchCovering β]

/-- Lebesgue's density theorem for an arbitrary set in a Besicovitch metric space. -/
theorem lebesgue_density_theorem (μ : Measure β) [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ] (s : Set β) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.restrict s,
      Tendsto (fun r => μ (s ∩ closedBall x r) / μ (closedBall x r))
        (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) := sorry

end Q842953

title: Q842953_lebesgue_s_density_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q842953
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q842953), "Lebesgue's density theorem": in a
  second-countable metric space with the Besicovitch covering property, almost
  every point of an arbitrary set, relative to a locally finite Borel measure
  restricted to that set, has density one in shrinking closed balls. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q842953_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q842953_empty {A : Type} : q842953_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q842953_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q842953_set A) : q842953_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q842953_intersection {A : Type}
    (E F : q842953_set A) : q842953_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ F x.

Definition q842953_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q842953_set A) : q842953_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q842953_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q842953_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q842953_subset {A : Type}
    (E F : q842953_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x -> F x.

Definition q842953_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q842953_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q842953_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q842953_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q842953_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Inductive q842953_ennreal : Type :=
| q842953_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q842953_ennreal
| q842953_ennreal_infinity : q842953_ennreal.

Arguments q842953_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q842953_ennreal_zero : q842953_ennreal :=
  q842953_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q842953_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q842953_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q842953_ennreal_finite a _,
    q842953_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q842953_ennreal_infinity,
    q842953_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q842953_ennreal_le
    (x y : q842953_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q842953_ennreal_finite a _,
    q842953_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q842953_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q842953_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q842953_ennreal_infinity,
    q842953_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q842953_ennreal_infinity,
    q842953_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q842953_ennreal_add
    (x y : q842953_ennreal) : q842953_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q842953_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q842953_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q842953_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q842953_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q842953_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q842953_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q842953_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q842953_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q842953_ennreal_add
        (q842953_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q842953_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q842953_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q842953_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q842953_ennreal,
      values value -> q842953_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q842953_ennreal,
      (forall value : q842953_ennreal,
        values value -> q842953_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q842953_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q842953_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q842953_ennreal)
    (sum : q842953_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q842953_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q842953_ennreal_eq value
          (q842953_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Definition q842953_ennreal_is_finite
    (x : q842953_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (value : R) (nonnegative : 0 <= value),
    q842953_ennreal_eq x
      (q842953_ennreal_finite value nonnegative).

Definition q842953_ennreal_div_value
    (numerator denominator : q842953_ennreal) : option R :=
  match numerator, denominator with
  | q842953_ennreal_finite a _,
    q842953_ennreal_finite b _ =>
      if Req_EM_T b 0 then
        if Req_EM_T a 0 then Some 0 else None
      else Some (a / b)
  | q842953_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q842953_ennreal_infinity => Some 0
  | q842953_ennreal_infinity,
    q842953_ennreal_finite _ _ => None
  | q842953_ennreal_infinity,
    q842953_ennreal_infinity => Some 0
  end.

Record q842953_metric_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q842953_dist : A -> A -> R;
  q842953_dist_nonnegative :
    forall x y : A, 0 <= q842953_dist x y;
  q842953_dist_eq_zero :
    forall x y : A, q842953_dist x y = 0 <-> x = y;
  q842953_dist_symmetric :
    forall x y : A, q842953_dist x y = q842953_dist y x;
  q842953_dist_triangle :
    forall x y z : A,
      q842953_dist x z <= q842953_dist x y + q842953_dist y z
}.

Arguments q842953_dist {A} _ _ _.

Definition q842953_open_ball {A : Type}
    (M : q842953_metric_space A)
    (center : A) (radius : R) : q842953_set A :=
  fun x => q842953_dist M x center < radius.

Definition q842953_closed_ball {A : Type}
    (M : q842953_metric_space A)
    (center : A) (radius : R) : q842953_set A :=
  fun x => q842953_dist M x center <= radius.

Definition q842953_open {A : Type}
    (M : q842953_metric_space A)
    (U : q842953_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A,
    U x ->
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      q842953_subset (q842953_open_ball M x radius) U.

Definition q842953_sigma_class {A : Type}
    (C : q842953_set (q842953_set A)) : Prop :=
  C q842953_empty /\
  (forall E F : q842953_set A,
    q842953_same_set E F ->
    C E ->
    C F) /\
  (forall E : q842953_set A,
    C E -> C (q842953_complement E)) /\
  (forall E : nat -> q842953_set A,
    (forall n : nat, C (E n)) ->
    C (q842953_countable_union E)).

Definition q842953_borel_set {A : Type}
    (M : q842953_metric_space A)
    (E : q842953_set A) : Prop :=
  forall C : q842953_set (q842953_set A),
    q842953_sigma_class C ->
    (forall U : q842953_set A, q842953_open M U -> C U) ->
    C E.

Record q842953_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q842953_measurable : q842953_set A -> Prop;
  q842953_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q842953_set A,
      q842953_same_set E F ->
      (q842953_measurable E <-> q842953_measurable F);
  q842953_measurable_empty :
    q842953_measurable q842953_empty;
  q842953_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q842953_set A,
      q842953_measurable E ->
      q842953_measurable (q842953_complement E);
  q842953_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q842953_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q842953_measurable (E n)) ->
      q842953_measurable (q842953_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q842953_measurable {A} _ _.

Definition q842953_borel_space {A : Type}
    (M : q842953_metric_space A)
    (m : q842953_measurable_space A) : Prop :=
  forall E : q842953_set A,
    q842953_measurable m E <-> q842953_borel_set M E.

Definition q842953_second_countable {A : Type}
    (M : q842953_metric_space A) : Prop :=
  exists basis : nat -> q842953_set A,
    (forall n : nat, q842953_open M (basis n)) /\
    forall (U : q842953_set A) (x : A),
      q842953_open M U ->
      U x ->
      exists n : nat,
        basis n x /\ q842953_subset (basis n) U.

Record q842953_measure (A : Type)
    (m : q842953_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q842953_measure_value : q842953_set A -> q842953_ennreal;
  q842953_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q842953_set A,
      q842953_same_set E F ->
      q842953_ennreal_eq
        (q842953_measure_value E)
        (q842953_measure_value F);
  q842953_measure_empty :
    q842953_ennreal_eq
      (q842953_measure_value q842953_empty)
      q842953_ennreal_zero;
  q842953_measure_monotone :
    forall E F : q842953_set A,
      q842953_subset E F ->
      q842953_ennreal_le
        (q842953_measure_value E)
        (q842953_measure_value F);
  q842953_measure_trim :
    forall E : q842953_set A,
      exists F : q842953_set A,
        q842953_measurable m F /\
        q842953_subset E F /\
        q842953_ennreal_eq
          (q842953_measure_value F)
          (q842953_measure_value E);
  q842953_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q842953_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q842953_measurable m (E n)) ->
      q842953_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q842953_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q842953_measure_value (E n))
        (q842953_measure_value (q842953_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q842953_measure_value {A m} _ _.

Definition q842953_locally_finite {A : Type}
    {m : q842953_measurable_space A}
    (M : q842953_metric_space A)
    (mu : q842953_measure m) : Prop :=
  forall x : A,
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      q842953_ennreal_is_finite
        (q842953_measure_value mu
          (q842953_open_ball M x radius)).

Definition q842953_satellite_configuration {A : Type}
    (M : q842953_metric_space A)
    (N : nat) (tau : R) : Prop :=
  exists (centers : nat -> A) (radii : nat -> R),
    (forall i : nat,
      (i <= N)%nat -> 0 < radii i) /\
    (forall i j : nat,
      (i <= N)%nat ->
      (j <= N)%nat ->
      i <> j ->
      ((radii i <= q842953_dist M (centers i) (centers j) /\
        radii j <= tau * radii i) \/
       (radii j <= q842953_dist M (centers j) (centers i) /\
        radii i <= tau * radii j))) /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < N)%nat ->
      radii i <= q842953_dist M (centers i) (centers N) /\
      radii N <= tau * radii i) /\
    forall i : nat,
      (i < N)%nat ->
      q842953_dist M (centers i) (centers N) <=
      radii i + radii N.

Definition q842953_has_besicovitch_covering {A : Type}
    (M : q842953_metric_space A) : Prop :=
  exists (N : nat) (tau : R),
    1 < tau /\
    ~ q842953_satellite_configuration M N tau.

Definition q842953_almost_everywhere_restrict {A : Type}
    {m : q842953_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q842953_measure m)
    (s : q842953_set A)
    (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q842953_set A,
    q842953_measurable m null_set /\
    q842953_ennreal_eq
      (q842953_measure_value mu
        (q842953_intersection null_set s))
      q842953_ennreal_zero /\
    forall x : A, ~ P x -> null_set x.

Definition q842953_density_tends_to_one {A : Type}
    {m : q842953_measurable_space A}
    (M : q842953_metric_space A)
    (mu : q842953_measure m)
    (s : q842953_set A)
    (x : A) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall radius : R,
        0 < radius ->
        radius < delta ->
        match
          q842953_ennreal_div_value
            (q842953_measure_value mu
              (q842953_intersection s
                (q842953_closed_ball M x radius)))
            (q842953_measure_value mu
              (q842953_closed_ball M x radius))
        with
        | Some quotient => Rabs (quotient - 1) < epsilon
        | None => False
        end.

Theorem Besicovitch_ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div :
  forall (Beta : Type)
         (M : q842953_metric_space Beta)
         (m : q842953_measurable_space Beta)
         (mu : q842953_measure m)
         (s : q842953_set Beta),
    q842953_borel_space M m ->
    q842953_second_countable M ->
    q842953_has_besicovitch_covering M ->
    q842953_locally_finite M mu ->
    q842953_almost_everywhere_restrict mu s
      (q842953_density_tends_to_one M mu s).
Admitted.

title: Q842953_lebesgue_s_density_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q842953,
  "Lebesgue's density theorem": in a second-countable metric space with the
  Besicovitch covering property, every set has density one almost everywhere
  with respect to the outer-measure restriction of any locally finite Borel
  measure, along closed balls whose positive radii tend to zero. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q842953_lebesgue_s_density_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Borel_Space" "HOL-Analysis.Measure_Space"
begin

definition q842953_satellite_configuration ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::metric_space) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q842953_satellite_configuration N tau c rad \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>i < Suc N. 0 < rad i) \<and>
      (\<forall>i < Suc N. \<forall>j < Suc N. i \<noteq> j \<longrightarrow>
        ((rad i \<le> dist (c i) (c j) \<and> rad j \<le> tau * rad i) \<or>
         (rad j \<le> dist (c j) (c i) \<and> rad i \<le> tau * rad j))) \<and>
      (\<forall>i < N.
        rad i \<le> dist (c i) (c N) \<and> rad N \<le> tau * rad i) \<and>
      (\<forall>i < N. dist (c i) (c N) \<le> rad i + rad N)"

definition q842953_has_besicovitch_covering ::
    "'a::metric_space itself \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q842953_has_besicovitch_covering _ \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>N tau. 1 < tau \<and>
        \<not> (\<exists>c rad.
          q842953_satellite_configuration N tau
            (c :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) rad))"

definition q842953_locally_finite_measure ::
    "'a::metric_space measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q842953_locally_finite_measure M \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x. \<exists>U. open U \<and> x \<in> U \<and> emeasure M U < \<infinity>)"

definition q842953_outer_measure ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> ennreal"
  where
    "q842953_outer_measure M A =
      Inf {emeasure M B | B. B \<in> sets M \<and> A \<subseteq> B}"

definition q842953_almost_everywhere_on ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q842953_almost_everywhere_on M s P \<longleftrightarrow>
      q842953_outer_measure M {x \<in> s. \<not> P x} = 0"

theorem lebesgue_s_density_theorem:
  fixes M :: "'a::{metric_space,second_countable_topology} measure"
    and s :: "'a set"
  assumes borel_measure:
      "sets M = sets borel"
    and locally_finite:
      "q842953_locally_finite_measure M"
    and besicovitch:
      "q842953_has_besicovitch_covering TYPE('a)"
  shows
      "q842953_almost_everywhere_on M s
        (\<lambda>x.
          filterlim
            (\<lambda>r.
              q842953_outer_measure M (s \<inter> cball x r) /
                q842953_outer_measure M (cball x r))
            (nhds 1)
            (at_right 0))"
  sorry

end

title: Q842953_lebesgue_s_density_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q842953,
  thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q842953, "Lebesgue's density theorem": in a
  second-countable Borel metric space with the Besicovitch covering property,
  almost every point of an arbitrary set has closed-ball measure density
  tending to one for a locally finite measure. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q842953_LEBESGUE_S_DENSITY_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let eone = (F,&1) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let emul =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if (~(FST x) /\ SND x = &0) \/
           (~(FST y) /\ SND y = &0)
        then ezero
        else if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x * SND y) in
   let einv =
      \(x:bool#real).
        if FST x
        then ezero
        else if SND x = &0
        then etop
        else (F,&1 / SND x) in
   let ediv =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real). emul x (einv y) in
   let eembed =
      \(z:bool#real).
        if FST z then &1 else SND z / (&1 + SND z) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let esum =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!n. partial (SUC n) = eadd (partial n) (u n)) /\
          esup_sequence partial z in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events carrier /\
        (!u:A->bool. events u ==> u SUBSET carrier) /\
        (!u:A->bool.
           events u ==> events (carrier DIFF u)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events
                 {x:A |
                    x IN carrier /\ ?n:num. x IN sets n}) in
   let outer_measure =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        (!u:A->bool. enonnegative (mu u)) /\
        (!u:A->bool. mu u = mu (u INTER carrier)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!u v:A->bool.
           u SUBSET v ==> ele (mu u) (mu v)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool total:bool#real.
           esum (\n. mu (sets n)) total
           ==> ele
                 (mu {x:A | x IN carrier /\ ?n:num. x IN sets n})
                 total) in
   let measure_space =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra carrier events /\
        outer_measure carrier mu /\
        (!u:A->bool.
           u SUBSET carrier
           ==> (!v:A->bool.
                  events v /\ u SUBSET v
                  ==> ele (mu u) (mu v)) /\
               (!w:bool#real.
                  enonnegative w /\
                  (!v:A->bool.
                     events v /\ u SUBSET v
                     ==> ele w (mu v))
                  ==> ele w (mu u))) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> esum
                 (\n. mu (sets n))
                 (mu {x:A |
                        x IN carrier /\ ?n:num. x IN sets n})) in
   let is_metric =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real).
        (!x y:A.
           x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier ==> &0 <= d x y) /\
        (!x y:A.
           x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier
           ==> (d x y = &0 <=> x = y)) /\
        (!x y:A.
           x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier ==> d x y = d y x) /\
        (!x y z:A.
           x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier
           ==> d x z <= d x y + d y z) in
   let open_ball =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real)
       (x:A) (radius:real).
        {y:A | y IN carrier /\ d y x < radius} in
   let closed_ball =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real)
       (x:A) (radius:real).
        {y:A | y IN carrier /\ d y x <= radius} in
   let metric_open =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real) (u:A->bool).
        u SUBSET carrier /\
        !x:A.
          x IN u
          ==> ?radius:real.
                &0 < radius /\
                open_ball carrier d x radius SUBSET u in
   let second_countable =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real).
        ?basis:(A->bool)->bool.
          COUNTABLE basis /\
          (!b:A->bool.
             b IN basis ==> metric_open carrier d b) /\
          (!u:A->bool x:A.
             metric_open carrier d u /\ x IN u
             ==> ?b:A->bool.
                   b IN basis /\ x IN b /\ b SUBSET u) in
   let borel_space =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        sigma_algebra carrier events /\
        (!u:A->bool.
           metric_open carrier d u ==> events u) /\
        (!other:(A->bool)->bool.
           sigma_algebra carrier other /\
           (!u:A->bool.
              metric_open carrier d u ==> other u)
           ==> !u:A->bool. events u ==> other u) in
   let locally_finite_measure =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        !x:A.
          x IN carrier
          ==> ?u:A->bool.
                metric_open carrier d u /\
                x IN u /\
                ~(FST (mu u)) in
   let satellite_configuration =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real)
       (N:num) (tau:real)
       (c:num->A) (radius:num->real).
        (!i:num.
           i <= N ==> c i IN carrier /\ &0 < radius i) /\
        (!i j:num.
           i <= N /\ j <= N /\ ~(i = j)
           ==> (radius i <= d (c i) (c j) /\
                radius j <= tau * radius i) \/
               (radius j <= d (c j) (c i) /\
                radius i <= tau * radius j)) /\
        (!i:num.
           i < N
           ==> radius i <= d (c i) (c N) /\
               radius N <= tau * radius i) /\
        (!i:num.
           i < N
           ==> d (c i) (c N) <= radius i + radius N) in
   let has_besicovitch_covering =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real).
        ?N:num tau:real.
          &1 < tau /\
          ~(?c:num->A radius:num->real.
              satellite_configuration
                carrier d N tau c radius) in
   let density_tends_to_one =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool) (x:A).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !radius:real.
                  &0 < radius /\ radius < delta
                  ==> abs
                        (eembed
                          (ediv
                            (mu
                              (s INTER
                               closed_ball
                                 carrier d x radius))
                            (mu
                              (closed_ball
                                carrier d x radius))) -
                         eembed eone) < epsilon in
   let almost_everywhere_restrict =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool) (p:A->bool).
        ?null_set:A->bool.
          events null_set /\
          {x:A | x IN carrier /\ ~(p x)} SUBSET null_set /\
          mu (null_set INTER s) = ezero in
   !carrier:A->bool
    d:A->A->real
    events:(A->bool)->bool
    mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
    s:A->bool.
      is_metric carrier d /\
      second_countable carrier d /\
      borel_space carrier d events /\
      measure_space carrier events mu /\
      locally_finite_measure carrier d mu /\
      has_besicovitch_covering carrier d /\
      s SUBSET carrier
      ==>
      almost_everywhere_restrict carrier events mu s
        (\x:A. density_tends_to_one carrier d mu s x)`;;

title: Q842953_lebesgue_s_density_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q842953,
;; "Lebesgue's density theorem": in a second-countable Borel metric space
;; with the Besicovitch covering property, almost every point of an arbitrary
;; set for a locally finite measure has density one in shrinking closed balls.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; The conservative interfaces range over unrestricted ACL2 objects.  The
;; predicates below explicitly impose the complete ordered real field,
;; extended-nonnegative-real, metric, Borel, outer-measure, local-finiteness,
;; and Besicovitch satellite laws used in the source statement.

(defstub q842953-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q842953-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q842953-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q842953-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q842953-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q842953-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q842953-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q842953-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q842953-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defstub q842953-domain-member-p (domain value) t)
(defstub q842953-set-member-p (set value) t)
(defstub q842953-function-value (function argument) t)
(defstub q842953-set-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q842953-measurable-set-p (measurable set) t)
(defstub q842953-measure-value (measure set) t)
(defstub q842953-distance-value (distance left right) t)
(defstub q842953-intersection-value (domain left right) t)
(defstub q842953-closed-ball-value
  (real domain distance center radius) t)

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a presentation of the reals.

(defun q842953-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q842953-r-less real right left)))

(defun q842953-r-subtract (real left right)
  (q842953-r-add real left (q842953-r-negate real right)))

(defun q842953-r-abs (real value)
  (if (q842953-r-less real value (q842953-r-zero real))
      (q842953-r-negate real value)
    value))

(defun-sk q842953-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-r-member-p real x)
      (q842953-r-member-p real y)
      (q842953-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q842953-r-zero real))
            (one (q842953-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q842953-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q842953-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q842953-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q842953-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q842953-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q842953-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q842953-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q842953-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q842953-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q842953-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q842953-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q842953-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q842953-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q842953-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q842953-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q842953-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q842953-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q842953-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q842953-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q842953-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q842953-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q842953-r-multiply
          real x (q842953-r-add real y z))
         (q842953-r-add
          real
          (q842953-r-multiply real x y)
          (q842953-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q842953-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-r-member-p real x)
      (q842953-r-member-p real y)
      (q842953-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q842953-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q842953-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q842953-r-less real x y)
         (q842953-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q842953-r-less real x y)
          (q842953-r-less real y z))
         (q842953-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q842953-r-less real x y)
         (q842953-r-less
          real
          (q842953-r-add real x z)
          (q842953-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q842953-r-less real zero x)
          (q842953-r-less real zero y))
         (q842953-r-less
          real zero
          (q842953-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q842953-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q842953-r-member-p real x)
     (q842953-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q842953-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-r-member-p real x)
      (q842953-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q842953-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q842953-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q842953-r-member-p real bound)
     (q842953-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q842953-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q842953-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q842953-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q842953-r-member-p real bound)
       (q842953-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q842953-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q842953-r-has-supremum-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q842953-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q842953-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q842953-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q842953-r-has-supremum-p real set))))

(defun q842953-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q842953-r-zero real))
        (one (q842953-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q842953-r-member-p real zero)
     (q842953-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q842953-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q842953-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q842953-r-less real zero one)
     (q842953-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Extended nonnegative reals with the source conventions 0 * infinity = 0,
;; 0 / 0 = 0, and infinity / infinity = 0.

(defun q842953-ennreal-p (real value)
  (or
   (equal value :q842953-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q842953-finite)
    (q842953-r-member-p real (cdr value))
    (q842953-r-leq
     real (q842953-r-zero real) (cdr value)))))

(defun q842953-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q842953-finite value))

(defun q842953-ennreal-zero (real)
  (q842953-ennreal-finite (q842953-r-zero real)))

(defun q842953-ennreal-less (real left right)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q842953-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q842953-top) t)
   (t (q842953-r-less real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q842953-ennreal-leq (real left right)
  (not (q842953-ennreal-less real right left)))

(defun q842953-ennreal-add (real left right)
  (if (or (equal left :q842953-top)
          (equal right :q842953-top))
      :q842953-top
    (q842953-ennreal-finite
     (q842953-r-add real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q842953-ennreal-multiply (real left right)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (q842953-ennreal-zero real))
        (equal right (q842953-ennreal-zero real)))
    (q842953-ennreal-zero real))
   ((or (equal left :q842953-top)
        (equal right :q842953-top))
    :q842953-top)
   (t
    (q842953-ennreal-finite
     (q842953-r-multiply real (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun q842953-ennreal-divide (real numerator denominator)
  (cond
   ((equal numerator (q842953-ennreal-zero real))
    (q842953-ennreal-zero real))
   ((equal denominator (q842953-ennreal-zero real))
    :q842953-top)
   ((equal denominator :q842953-top)
    (q842953-ennreal-zero real))
   ((equal numerator :q842953-top)
    :q842953-top)
   (t
    (q842953-ennreal-finite
     (q842953-r-multiply
      real
      (cdr numerator)
      (q842953-r-inverse real (cdr denominator)))))))

;; Arbitrary subsets, sigma algebras, and countably additive measures.

(defun-sk q842953-valid-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q842953-set-member-p set x)
     (q842953-domain-member-p domain x))))

(defun-sk q842953-set-equiv-p (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q842953-set-member-p left x)
      (q842953-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q842953-subset-p (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q842953-set-member-p left x))
     (q842953-set-member-p right x))))

(defun-sk q842953-intersection-set-p
    (domain left right intersection)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q842953-set-member-p intersection x)
     (and
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q842953-set-member-p left x)
      (q842953-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q842953-intersection-operation-p (domain)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-valid-set-p domain left)
      (q842953-valid-set-p domain right))
     (q842953-intersection-set-p
      domain left right
      (q842953-intersection-value domain left right)))))

(defun-sk q842953-empty-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
     (not (q842953-set-member-p set x)))))

(defun-sk q842953-complement-set-p (domain set complement)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q842953-set-member-p complement x)
      (not (q842953-set-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q842953-set-sequence-p (domain sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q842953-valid-set-p
      domain (q842953-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q842953-sequence-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q842953-set-member-p
      (q842953-set-sequence-value sequence n)
      x))))

(defun-sk q842953-sequence-union-set-p (domain sequence union)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q842953-set-member-p union x)
      (q842953-sequence-union-member-p sequence x)))))

(defun-sk q842953-measurable-sequence-p
    (measurable sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q842953-measurable-set-p
      measurable
      (q842953-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q842953-sigma-extensional-p
    (domain measurable)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q842953-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (iff
      (q842953-measurable-set-p measurable left)
      (q842953-measurable-set-p measurable right)))))

(defun-sk q842953-sigma-valid-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q842953-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q842953-valid-set-p domain set))))

(defun-sk q842953-measurable-empty-exists-p
    (domain measurable)
  (exists (empty)
    (and
     (q842953-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (q842953-measurable-set-p measurable empty))))

(defun-sk q842953-measurable-complement-exists-p
    (domain measurable set)
  (exists (complement)
    (and
     (q842953-complement-set-p domain set complement)
     (q842953-measurable-set-p measurable complement))))

(defun-sk q842953-measurable-complements-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q842953-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q842953-measurable-complement-exists-p
      domain measurable set))))

(defun-sk q842953-measurable-union-exists-p
    (domain measurable sequence)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q842953-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union)
     (q842953-measurable-set-p measurable union))))

(defun-sk q842953-measurable-unions-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q842953-measurable-sequence-p measurable sequence))
     (q842953-measurable-union-exists-p
      domain measurable sequence))))

(defun q842953-sigma-algebra-p (domain measurable)
  (and
   (q842953-sigma-extensional-p domain measurable)
   (q842953-sigma-valid-p domain measurable)
   (q842953-measurable-empty-exists-p domain measurable)
   (q842953-measurable-complements-p domain measurable)
   (q842953-measurable-unions-p domain measurable)))

(defun-sk q842953-disjoint-sets-p (left right)
  (forall (x)
    (not
     (and
      (q842953-set-member-p left x)
      (q842953-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q842953-pairwise-disjoint-sequence-p (sequence)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and (natp m) (natp n) (not (equal m n)))
     (q842953-disjoint-sets-p
      (q842953-set-sequence-value sequence m)
      (q842953-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun q842953-measure-prefix-sum
    (real measure sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q842953-ennreal-zero real)
    (q842953-ennreal-add
     real
     (q842953-measure-prefix-sum
      real measure sequence (1- count))
     (q842953-measure-value
      measure
      (q842953-set-sequence-value sequence (1- count))))))

(defun-sk q842953-sum-upper-bound-p
    (real measure sequence bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q842953-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q842953-measure-prefix-sum
       real measure sequence count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q842953-countable-sum-p
    (real measure sequence total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q842953-ennreal-p real total)
     (q842953-sum-upper-bound-p
      real measure sequence total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q842953-ennreal-p real bound)
       (q842953-sum-upper-bound-p
        real measure sequence bound))
      (q842953-ennreal-leq real total bound)))))

(defun-sk q842953-measure-extensional-p (domain measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q842953-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (equal
      (q842953-measure-value measure left)
      (q842953-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q842953-measure-values-p (real domain measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q842953-valid-set-p domain set)
     (q842953-ennreal-p
      real (q842953-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun-sk q842953-measure-empty-zero-p
    (real domain measure)
  (forall (empty)
    (implies
     (q842953-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (equal
      (q842953-measure-value measure empty)
      (q842953-ennreal-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q842953-measure-monotone-p
    (real domain measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-valid-set-p domain left)
      (q842953-valid-set-p domain right)
      (q842953-subset-p domain left right))
     (q842953-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q842953-measure-value measure left)
      (q842953-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q842953-countably-subadditive-p
    (real domain measure)
  (forall (sequence union total)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q842953-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union)
      (q842953-countable-sum-p real measure sequence total))
     (q842953-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q842953-measure-value measure union)
      total))))

(defun-sk q842953-countably-additive-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (forall (sequence union)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q842953-measurable-sequence-p measurable sequence)
      (q842953-pairwise-disjoint-sequence-p sequence)
      (q842953-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union))
     (q842953-countable-sum-p
      real measure sequence
      (q842953-measure-value measure union)))))

(defun-sk q842953-measurable-hull-exists-p
    (domain measurable measure set)
  (exists (hull)
    (and
     (q842953-measurable-set-p measurable hull)
     (q842953-subset-p domain set hull)
     (equal
      (q842953-measure-value measure hull)
      (q842953-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun-sk q842953-measurable-hulls-p
    (domain measurable measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q842953-valid-set-p domain set)
     (q842953-measurable-hull-exists-p
      domain measurable measure set))))

(defun q842953-measure-space-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (and
   (q842953-sigma-algebra-p domain measurable)
   (q842953-measure-extensional-p domain measure)
   (q842953-measure-values-p real domain measure)
   (q842953-measure-empty-zero-p real domain measure)
   (q842953-measure-monotone-p real domain measure)
   (q842953-countably-subadditive-p real domain measure)
   (q842953-countably-additive-p
    real domain measurable measure)
   (q842953-measurable-hulls-p
    domain measurable measure)))

;; Metric topology, second countability, its Borel sigma algebra, and
;; local finiteness.

(defun-sk q842953-pseudometric-laws-p
    (real domain distance)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain y)
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain z))
     (let ((dxy (q842953-distance-value distance x y))
           (dyz (q842953-distance-value distance y z))
           (dxz (q842953-distance-value distance x z)))
       (and
        (q842953-r-member-p real dxy)
        (q842953-r-member-p real dyz)
        (q842953-r-member-p real dxz)
        (q842953-r-leq real (q842953-r-zero real) dxy)
        (equal
         (q842953-distance-value distance x x)
         (q842953-r-zero real))
        (equal dxy (q842953-distance-value distance y x))
        (q842953-r-leq
         real dxz (q842953-r-add real dxy dyz)))))))

(defun-sk q842953-metric-separation-p
    (real domain distance)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain y))
     (iff
      (equal
       (q842953-distance-value distance x y)
       (q842953-r-zero real))
      (equal x y)))))

(defun q842953-metric-space-p (real domain distance)
  (and
   (q842953-pseudometric-laws-p real domain distance)
   (q842953-metric-separation-p real domain distance)))

(defun-sk q842953-open-ball-p
    (real domain distance center radius set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q842953-set-member-p set x)
      (q842953-r-less
       real
       (q842953-distance-value distance x center)
       radius)))))

(defun-sk q842953-closed-ball-subset-p
    (real domain distance center radius set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q842953-r-leq
       real
       (q842953-distance-value distance x center)
       radius))
     (q842953-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q842953-set-subset-closed-ball-p
    (real domain distance set center radius)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q842953-set-member-p set x))
     (q842953-r-leq
      real
      (q842953-distance-value distance x center)
      radius))))

(defun-sk q842953-open-radius-exists-p
    (real domain distance set x)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q842953-r-member-p real radius)
     (q842953-r-less
      real (q842953-r-zero real) radius)
     (q842953-closed-ball-subset-p
      real domain distance x radius set))))

(defun-sk q842953-metric-open-interior-p
    (real domain distance set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q842953-set-member-p set x))
     (q842953-open-radius-exists-p
      real domain distance set x))))

(defun q842953-metric-open-p (real domain distance set)
  (and
   (q842953-valid-set-p domain set)
   (q842953-metric-open-interior-p
    real domain distance set)))

(defun-sk q842953-basis-open-p
    (real domain distance basis)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q842953-metric-open-p
      real domain distance
      (q842953-set-sequence-value basis n)))))

(defun-sk q842953-basis-refinement-exists-p
    (domain basis set x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q842953-set-member-p
      (q842953-set-sequence-value basis n)
      x)
     (q842953-subset-p
      domain
      (q842953-set-sequence-value basis n)
      set))))

(defun-sk q842953-basis-refines-p
    (real domain distance basis)
  (forall (set x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-metric-open-p real domain distance set)
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q842953-set-member-p set x))
     (q842953-basis-refinement-exists-p
      domain basis set x))))

(defun q842953-second-countable-basis-p
    (real domain distance basis)
  (and
   (q842953-set-sequence-p domain basis)
   (q842953-basis-open-p real domain distance basis)
   (q842953-basis-refines-p real domain distance basis)))

(defun-sk q842953-second-countable-p
    (real domain distance)
  (exists (basis)
    (q842953-second-countable-basis-p
     real domain distance basis)))

(defun-sk q842953-all-opens-measurable-p
    (real domain distance measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q842953-metric-open-p real domain distance set)
     (q842953-measurable-set-p measurable set))))

(defun-sk q842953-borel-minimal-p
    (real domain distance measurable)
  (forall (other set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-sigma-algebra-p domain other)
      (q842953-all-opens-measurable-p
       real domain distance other)
      (q842953-measurable-set-p measurable set))
     (q842953-measurable-set-p other set))))

(defun q842953-borel-space-p
    (real domain distance measurable)
  (and
   (q842953-sigma-algebra-p domain measurable)
   (q842953-all-opens-measurable-p
    real domain distance measurable)
   (q842953-borel-minimal-p
    real domain distance measurable)))

(defun-sk q842953-finite-ball-exists-p
    (real domain distance measurable measure x)
  (exists (radius ball)
    (and
     (q842953-r-member-p real radius)
     (q842953-r-less
      real (q842953-r-zero real) radius)
     (q842953-open-ball-p
      real domain distance x radius ball)
     (q842953-measurable-set-p measurable ball)
     (not
      (equal
       (q842953-measure-value measure ball)
       :q842953-top)))))

(defun-sk q842953-locally-finite-measure-p
    (real domain distance measurable measure)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q842953-finite-ball-exists-p
      real domain distance measurable measure x))))

;; Exact closed balls.

(defun-sk q842953-closed-ball-set-p
    (real domain distance center radius ball)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q842953-set-member-p ball x)
     (and
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q842953-r-leq
       real
       (q842953-distance-value distance x center)
       radius)))))

(defun-sk q842953-closed-ball-operation-p
    (real domain distance)
  (forall (center radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain center)
      (q842953-r-member-p real radius))
     (q842953-closed-ball-set-p
      real domain distance center radius
      (q842953-closed-ball-value
       real domain distance center radius)))))

;; The source's HasBesicovitchCovering class: for some N and tau > 1,
;; no N+1 positive-radius satellite configuration exists.  Finite functions
;; on Fin (N+1) are represented exactly by lists of length N+1.

(defun-sk q842953-center-list-values-p
    (domain centers n)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (and (natp i) (<= i n))
     (q842953-domain-member-p domain (nth i centers)))))

(defun-sk q842953-radius-list-values-p
    (real radii n)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (and (natp i) (<= i n))
     (and
      (q842953-r-member-p real (nth i radii))
      (q842953-r-less
       real (q842953-r-zero real) (nth i radii))))))

(defun-sk q842953-satellite-pair-laws-p
    (real domain distance tau centers radii n)
  (forall (i j)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp i)
      (natp j)
      (<= i n)
      (<= j n)
      (not (equal i j)))
     (or
      (and
       (q842953-r-leq
        real
        (nth i radii)
        (q842953-distance-value
         distance (nth i centers) (nth j centers)))
       (q842953-r-leq
        real
        (nth j radii)
        (q842953-r-multiply real tau (nth i radii))))
      (and
       (q842953-r-leq
        real
        (nth j radii)
        (q842953-distance-value
         distance (nth j centers) (nth i centers)))
       (q842953-r-leq
        real
        (nth i radii)
