        (q842953-r-multiply real tau (nth j radii))))))))

(defun-sk q842953-satellite-last-laws-p
    (real distance tau centers radii n)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (and (natp i) (< i n))
     (and
      (q842953-r-leq
       real
       (nth i radii)
       (q842953-distance-value
        distance (nth i centers) (nth n centers)))
      (q842953-r-leq
       real
       (nth n radii)
       (q842953-r-multiply real tau (nth i radii)))
      (q842953-r-leq
       real
       (q842953-distance-value
        distance (nth i centers) (nth n centers))
       (q842953-r-add
        real (nth i radii) (nth n radii)))))))

(defun q842953-satellite-configuration-p
    (real domain distance n tau centers radii)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (true-listp centers)
   (true-listp radii)
   (equal (len centers) (+ 1 n))
   (equal (len radii) (+ 1 n))
   (q842953-center-list-values-p domain centers n)
   (q842953-radius-list-values-p real radii n)
   (q842953-satellite-pair-laws-p
    real domain distance tau centers radii n)
   (q842953-satellite-last-laws-p
    real distance tau centers radii n)))

(defun-sk q842953-satellite-configuration-exists-p
    (real domain distance n tau)
  (exists (centers radii)
    (q842953-satellite-configuration-p
     real domain distance n tau centers radii)))

(defun-sk q842953-has-besicovitch-covering-p
    (real domain distance)
  (exists (n tau)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q842953-r-member-p real tau)
     (q842953-r-less real (q842953-r-one real) tau)
     (not
      (q842953-satellite-configuration-exists-p
       real domain distance n tau)))))

;; Density quotient in extended nonnegative reals, using the source
;; conventions 0/0 = 0, infinity/infinity = 0, and positive/0 = infinity.

(defun q842953-density-ratio
    (real domain distance measure source point radius)
  (let* ((ball
          (q842953-closed-ball-value
           real domain distance point radius))
         (inside
          (q842953-intersection-value domain source ball)))
    (q842953-ennreal-divide
     real
     (q842953-measure-value measure inside)
     (q842953-measure-value measure ball))))

(defun-sk q842953-density-radii-close-p
    (real domain distance measure source point epsilon delta)
  (forall (radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-r-member-p real radius)
      (q842953-r-less
       real (q842953-r-zero real) radius)
      (q842953-r-less real radius delta))
     (let ((ratio
            (q842953-density-ratio
             real domain distance measure source point radius)))
       (and
        (q842953-ennreal-p real ratio)
        (not (equal ratio :q842953-top))
        (q842953-r-less
         real
         (q842953-r-abs
          real
          (q842953-r-subtract
           real
           (cdr ratio)
           (q842953-r-one real)))
         epsilon))))))

(defun-sk q842953-density-delta-exists-p
    (real domain distance measure source point epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (q842953-r-member-p real delta)
     (q842953-r-less
      real (q842953-r-zero real) delta)
     (q842953-density-radii-close-p
      real domain distance measure source point epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk q842953-density-tends-to-one-p
    (real domain distance measure source point)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-r-member-p real epsilon)
      (q842953-r-less
       real (q842953-r-zero real) epsilon))
     (q842953-density-delta-exists-p
      real domain distance measure source point epsilon))))

;; The failure set is intersected with the arbitrary source set.  Its
;; restricted-measure outer value is zero exactly when it has a measurable
;; cover whose intersection with the source has original outer measure zero.

(defun-sk q842953-bad-density-set-p
    (real domain distance measure source bad)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q842953-set-member-p bad x)
     (and
      (q842953-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q842953-set-member-p source x)
      (not
       (q842953-density-tends-to-one-p
        real domain distance measure source x))))))

(defun q842953-ae-density-data-p
    (real domain distance measurable measure source bad cover)
  (and
   (q842953-valid-set-p domain bad)
   (q842953-bad-density-set-p
    real domain distance measure source bad)
   (q842953-measurable-set-p measurable cover)
   (q842953-subset-p domain bad cover)
   (equal
    (q842953-measure-value
     measure
     (q842953-intersection-value domain cover source))
    (q842953-ennreal-zero real))))

(defun-sk q842953-ae-density-p
    (real domain distance measurable measure source)
  (exists (bad cover)
    (q842953-ae-density-data-p
     real domain distance measurable measure source bad cover)))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q842953-lebesgue-density-statement ()
  (forall (real domain distance measurable measure source)
    (implies
     (and
      (q842953-real-field-p real)
      (q842953-valid-set-p domain source)
      (q842953-intersection-operation-p domain)
      (q842953-metric-space-p real domain distance)
      (q842953-closed-ball-operation-p
       real domain distance)
      (q842953-second-countable-p
       real domain distance)
      (q842953-borel-space-p
       real domain distance measurable)
      (q842953-measure-space-p
       real domain measurable measure)
      (q842953-locally-finite-measure-p
       real domain distance measurable measure)
      (q842953-has-besicovitch-covering-p
       real domain distance))
     (q842953-ae-density-p
      real domain distance measurable measure source))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q842953_lebesgue_s_density_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q842953,
-- "Lebesgue's density theorem": in a second-countable Borel metric space with
-- the Besicovitch covering property, almost every point of an arbitrary set is
-- a density point for every locally finite measure. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q842953_lebesgue_s_density_theorem where

open import Support.Bochner
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

open CompleteOrderedField
open SigmaAlgebra
open ExtendedNonnegativeReals
open Measure

infix 4 _<N_

record Exists1 (A : Set1) (P : A -> Set) : Set1 where
  constructor witness1
  field
    value1 :
      A
    property1 :
      P value1

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

record NonnegativeReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    realValue :
      R
    realValue-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) realValue

open NonnegativeReal

finiteNN :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  NonnegativeReal reals ->
  M
finiteNN extended x =
  finiteM extended (realValue x) (realValue-nonnegative x)

data CanonicalENNReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  finite-ennreal :
    NonnegativeReal reals ->
    CanonicalENNReal reals
  infinity-ennreal :
    CanonicalENNReal reals

CanonicalENNRealLe :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  CanonicalENNReal reals ->
  CanonicalENNReal reals ->
  Set
CanonicalENNRealLe {reals = reals}
  (finite-ennreal x) (finite-ennreal y) =
  lessOrEqualR reals (realValue x) (realValue y)
CanonicalENNRealLe (finite-ennreal x) infinity-ennreal =
  Top
CanonicalENNRealLe infinity-ennreal (finite-ennreal y) =
  Bottom
CanonicalENNRealLe infinity-ennreal infinity-ennreal =
  Top

record ENNRealPresentation
  {R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) : Set1 where
  field
    toCanonicalENNReal :
      M -> CanonicalENNReal reals
    fromCanonicalENNReal :
      CanonicalENNReal reals -> M
    to-after-fromENNReal :
      (x : CanonicalENNReal reals) ->
      toCanonicalENNReal (fromCanonicalENNReal x) == x
    from-after-toENNReal :
      (x : M) ->
      fromCanonicalENNReal (toCanonicalENNReal x) == x
    finite-correspondenceENNReal :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      toCanonicalENNReal (finiteNN extended x) == finite-ennreal x
    infinity-correspondenceENNReal :
      toCanonicalENNReal (infinityM extended) == infinity-ennreal
    order-correspondenceENNReal :
      (x y : M) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualM extended x y)
        (CanonicalENNRealLe
          (toCanonicalENNReal x)
          (toCanonicalENNReal y))

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Fin (suc n)
  fsuc :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Fin n ->
    Fin (suc n)

finValue :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Nat
finValue fzero =
  zero
finValue (fsuc i) =
  suc (finValue i)

last :
  (n : Nat) ->
  Fin (suc n)
last zero =
  fzero
last (suc n) =
  fsuc (last n)

record MetricSpace
  {R : Set}
  (A : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    distance :
      A -> A -> R
    distance-nonnegative :
      (x y : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (distance x y)
    distance-self :
      (x : A) ->
      distance x x == zeroR reals
    distance-zero-only :
      (x y : A) ->
      distance x y == zeroR reals ->
      x == y
    distance-symmetric :
      (x y : A) ->
      distance x y == distance y x
    distance-triangle :
      (x y z : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (distance x z)
        (addR reals (distance x y) (distance y z))

open MetricSpace

MetricOpen :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  MetricSpace A reals ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
MetricOpen {A = A} {R = R} {reals = reals} metric U =
  (x : A) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ epsilon ->
      Both
        (Positive reals epsilon)
        ((y : A) ->
          StrictLess reals (distance metric y x) epsilon ->
          U y))

record SecondCountableMetric
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (metric : MetricSpace A reals) : Set1 where
  field
    basis :
      Nat -> Predicate A
    basis-open :
      (n : Nat) ->
      MetricOpen metric (basis n)
    basis-refines-open :
      (U : Predicate A) ->
      MetricOpen metric U ->
      (x : A) ->
      U x ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          Both
            (basis n x)
            (Subset (basis n) U))

data BorelGenerated
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (metric : MetricSpace A reals) :
  Predicate A -> Set1 where

  borel-open :
    {U : Predicate A} ->
    MetricOpen metric U ->
    BorelGenerated metric U

  borel-empty :
    BorelGenerated metric emptySet

  borel-complement :
    {S : Predicate A} ->
    BorelGenerated metric S ->
    BorelGenerated metric (complement S)

  borel-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
    ((n : Nat) -> BorelGenerated metric (sets n)) ->
    BorelGenerated metric (countableUnion sets)

  borel-congruent :
    {S T : Predicate A} ->
    ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
    BorelGenerated metric S ->
    BorelGenerated metric T

record BorelSpace
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (metric : MetricSpace A reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set2 where
  field
    borel-measurable :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      BorelGenerated metric S ->
      measurable events S
    measurable-borel :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      BorelGenerated metric S

ClosedBall :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  MetricSpace A reals ->
  A ->
  R ->
  Predicate A
ClosedBall {reals = reals} metric center radius point =
  lessOrEqualR reals (distance metric point center) radius

record SatelliteConfig
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (metric : MetricSpace A reals)
  (N : Nat)
  (tau : R) : Set1 where
  field
    center :
      Fin (suc N) -> A
    radius :
      Fin (suc N) -> R
    radius-positive :
      (i : Fin (suc N)) ->
      Positive reals (radius i)
    ordered :
      (i j : Fin (suc N)) ->
      i != j ->
      Either
        (Both
          (lessOrEqualR reals
            (radius i)
            (distance metric (center i) (center j)))
          (lessOrEqualR reals
            (radius j)
            (multiplyR reals tau (radius i))))
        (Both
          (lessOrEqualR reals
            (radius j)
            (distance metric (center j) (center i)))
          (lessOrEqualR reals
            (radius i)
            (multiplyR reals tau (radius j))))
    last-ordered :
      (i : Fin (suc N)) ->
      finValue i <N N ->
      Both
        (lessOrEqualR reals
          (radius i)
          (distance metric (center i) (center (last N))))
        (lessOrEqualR reals
          (radius (last N))
          (multiplyR reals tau (radius i)))
    intersects-last :
      (i : Fin (suc N)) ->
      finValue i <N N ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (distance metric (center i) (center (last N)))
        (addR reals (radius i) (radius (last N)))

record HasBesicovitchCovering
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (metric : MetricSpace A reals) : Set2 where
  field
    satellite-bound :
      Nat
    satellite-factor :
      R
    factor-greater-than-one :
      StrictLess reals
        (oneR reals)
        satellite-factor
    no-satellite-configuration :
      SatelliteConfig metric satellite-bound satellite-factor ->
      Bottom

record TrimmedMeasure
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended events) : Set2 where
  field
    measurable-envelope :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      Exists1 (Predicate A)
        (\ T ->
          Both
            (measurable events T)
            (Both
              (Subset S T)
              (outerMass measure S == outerMass measure T)))

IsLocallyFiniteMeasure :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  MetricSpace A reals ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Set
IsLocallyFiniteMeasure {A = A} {R = R} {reals = reals}
  {extended = extended} metric measure =
  (x : A) ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        (outerMass measure (ClosedBall metric x radius) !=
          infinityM extended))

record MeasureRestriction
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) : Set2 where
  field
    restrict :
      Measure extended events ->
      Predicate A ->
      Measure extended events
    restrict-on-measurable-test :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events T ->
      outerMass (restrict measure S) T ==
      outerMass measure (intersection T S)
    restrict-trimmed :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      TrimmedMeasure measure ->
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      TrimmedMeasure (restrict measure S)

open MeasureRestriction

record ENNRealReciprocal
  {R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) : Set1 where
  field
    reciprocalM :
      M -> M
    reciprocal-zero :
      reciprocalM (zeroM extended) == infinityM extended
    reciprocal-infinity :
      reciprocalM (infinityM extended) == zeroM extended
    reciprocal-finite-zero :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      realValue x == zeroR reals ->
      reciprocalM (finiteNN extended x) == infinityM extended
    reciprocal-finite-positive :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      realValue x != zeroR reals ->
      Exists (NonnegativeReal reals)
        (\ inverse ->
          Both
            (realValue inverse ==
              reciprocalR reals (realValue x))
            (reciprocalM (finiteNN extended x) ==
              finiteNN extended inverse))

open ENNRealReciprocal

divideM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealReciprocal extended ->
  M ->
  M ->
  M
divideM extended reciprocal x y =
  multiplyM extended x (reciprocalM reciprocal y)

StrictLessBy :
  {X : Set} ->
  (X -> X -> Set) ->
  X ->
  X ->
  Set
StrictLessBy le x y =
  Both (le x y) (Not (le y x))

data OrderRay (X : Set) : Set where
  above :
    X -> OrderRay X
  below :
    X -> OrderRay X

RayContains :
  {X : Set} ->
  (X -> X -> Set) ->
  OrderRay X ->
  X ->
  Set
RayContains le (above lower) x =
  StrictLessBy le lower x
RayContains le (below upper) x =
  StrictLessBy le x upper

All :
  {X : Set} ->
  (X -> Set) ->
  List X ->
  Set
All P [] =
  Top
All P (x ∷ xs) =
  Both (P x) (All P xs)

BasicContains :
  {X : Set} ->
  (X -> X -> Set) ->
  List (OrderRay X) ->
  X ->
  Set
BasicContains le rays x =
  All (\ ray -> RayContains le ray x) rays

RadiusTendstoM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (R -> M) ->
  M ->
  Set
RadiusTendstoM {R = R} {reals = reals} extended function limit =
  (rays : List (OrderRay _)) ->
  BasicContains (lessOrEqualM extended) rays limit ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((radius : R) ->
          Positive reals radius ->
          StrictLess reals radius delta ->
          BasicContains
            (lessOrEqualM extended)
            rays
            (function radius)))

lebesgue-density-theorem : Set2
lebesgue-density-theorem =
  (A R M : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (metric : MetricSpace A reals) ->
  SecondCountableMetric metric ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  BorelSpace metric events ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (reciprocal : ENNRealReciprocal extended) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (measure-trimmed : TrimmedMeasure measure) ->
  IsLocallyFiniteMeasure metric measure ->
  (restrictions : MeasureRestriction events extended) ->
  HasBesicovitchCovering metric ->
  (S : Predicate A) ->
  AlmostEverywhere (restrict restrictions measure S)
    (\ x ->
      RadiusTendstoM extended
        (\ radius ->
          divideM extended reciprocal
            (outerMass measure
              (intersection S (ClosedBall metric x radius)))
            (outerMass measure (ClosedBall metric x radius)))
        (oneM extended))

title: Q842953_lebesgue_s_density_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q842953, "Lebesgue's density theorem": in a second-countable metric space
  with the Besicovitch covering property, almost every point of an arbitrary
  set is a density point for every locally finite Borel measure. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory borelTheory;

val q842953_metric_space_def = new_definition (
  "q842953_metric_space_def",
  ``q842953_metric_space (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      (!x. d x x = 0) /\
      (!x y. 0 <= d x y) /\
      (!x y. d x y = d y x) /\
      (!x y. d x y = 0 <=> x = y) /\
      (!x y z. d x z <= d x y + d y z)``);

val q842953_open_def = new_definition (
  "q842953_open_def",
  ``q842953_open (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) (u : 'a set) <=>
      !x.
        x IN u ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y. d y x < epsilon ==> y IN u``);

val q842953_second_countable_def = new_definition (
  "q842953_second_countable_def",
  ``q842953_second_countable (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      ?basis : ('a set) set.
        COUNTABLE basis /\
        (!v. v IN basis ==> q842953_open d v) /\
        !u x.
          q842953_open d u /\ x IN u ==>
          ?v.
            v IN basis /\
            x IN v /\
            v SUBSET u``);

val q842953_borel_space_def = new_definition (
  "q842953_borel_space_def",
  ``q842953_borel_space
      (m : 'a m_space) (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      measurable_sets m =
        subsets
          (sigma (m_space m)
            {u : 'a set | q842953_open d u})``);

val q842953_outer_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q842953_outer_measure_def",
  ``q842953_outer_measure (m : 'a m_space) (s : 'a set) =
      inf
        {value : extreal |
          ?measurable_superset : 'a set.
            s SUBSET measurable_superset /\
            measurable_superset IN measurable_sets m /\
            measure m measurable_superset = value}``);

val q842953_locally_finite_def = new_definition (
  "q842953_locally_finite_def",
  ``q842953_locally_finite
      (m : 'a m_space) (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      !x.
        ?u : 'a set.
          q842953_open d u /\
          x IN u /\
          measure m u <> PosInf``);

val q842953_closed_ball_def = new_definition (
  "q842953_closed_ball_def",
  ``q842953_closed_ball
      (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) (x : 'a) (radius : real) =
      {y | d y x <= radius}``);

val q842953_satellite_config_def = new_definition (
  "q842953_satellite_config_def",
  ``q842953_satellite_config
      (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) (N : num) (tau : real)
      (c : num -> 'a) (r : num -> real) <=>
      (!i. i <= N ==> 0 < r i) /\
      (!i j.
        i <= N /\ j <= N /\ i <> j
        ==>
        ((r i <= d (c i) (c j) /\ r j <= tau * r i) \/
         (r j <= d (c j) (c i) /\ r i <= tau * r j))) /\
      (!i.
        i < N ==>
        r i <= d (c i) (c N) /\ r N <= tau * r i) /\
      (!i.
        i < N ==>
        d (c i) (c N) <= r i + r N)``);

val q842953_has_besicovitch_covering_def = new_definition (
  "q842953_has_besicovitch_covering_def",
  ``q842953_has_besicovitch_covering
      (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      ?N : num. ?tau : real.
        1 < tau /\
        ~(?c : num -> 'a. ?r : num -> real.
            q842953_satellite_config d N tau c r)``);

val q842953_ennreal_div_def = new_definition (
  "q842953_ennreal_div_def",
  ``q842953_ennreal_div (x : extreal) (y : extreal) =
      if y = PosInf then Normal 0
      else if y = Normal 0 then
        if x = Normal 0 then Normal 0 else PosInf
      else x / y``);

val q842953_tendsto_zero_right_one_def = new_definition (
  "q842953_tendsto_zero_right_one_def",
  ``q842953_tendsto_zero_right_one (f : real -> extreal) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !radius : real.
            0 < radius /\ radius < delta ==>
            Normal (1 - epsilon) < f radius /\
            f radius < Normal (1 + epsilon)``);

val q842953_restrict_def = new_definition (
  "q842953_restrict_def",
  ``q842953_restrict (m : 'a m_space) (s : 'a set) =
      (m_space m, measurable_sets m,
       \t. q842953_outer_measure m (t INTER s))``);

val lebesgue_density_theorem =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) (s : 'a set).
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      q842953_metric_space d /\
      q842953_second_countable d /\
      q842953_borel_space m d /\
      q842953_locally_finite m d /\
      q842953_has_besicovitch_covering d
      ==>
      (AE x::(q842953_restrict m s).
          q842953_tendsto_zero_right_one
            (\radius.
              q842953_ennreal_div
                (q842953_outer_measure m
                  (s INTER q842953_closed_ball d x radius))
                (q842953_outer_measure m
                  (q842953_closed_ball d x radius))))``;

title: Q842953_lebesgue_s_density_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q842953
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q842953), "Lebesgue's density theorem": in a
  second-countable Borel metric space with the Besicovitch covering property,
  almost every point of an arbitrary set for a locally finite measure is a
  density point, as measured by closed balls of radii tending to zero from
  above. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q842953ClosedBall is the metric closed ball. Q842953Measure evaluates the
  outer measure induced by a measure, so arbitrary subsets are retained.
  Q842953RestrictedOuter is exactly the outer-measure value of the restriction
  of M to S: it takes the infimum of M(T intersect S) over measurable
  supersets T.

  Q842953EDiv is extended-nonnegative division with Lean's total conventions.
  Q842953DensityTendsto expands convergence of the density quotient to one
  along positive real radii tending to zero. Q842953HasBesicovitch expands the
  source covering property by excluding a finite satellite configuration.

  All declarations below are syntax, bidirectional definitions, or the final
  unproved $a statement. There are no $p declarations in this file.
$)

$c Q842953ClosedBall Q842953Measure Q842953RestrictedOuter
   Q842953EDiv Q842953DensityTendsto Q842953Satellite
   Q842953HasBesicovitch Q842953LocallyFinite $.

q842953-closed-ball-syntax $a
  class ( Q842953ClosedBall D X x r ) $.
q842953-measure-syntax $a
  class ( Q842953Measure M A ) $.
q842953-restricted-outer-syntax $a
  class ( Q842953RestrictedOuter M S A ) $.
q842953-ediv-syntax $a
  class ( Q842953EDiv A B ) $.
q842953-density-tendsto-syntax $a
  wff ( Q842953DensityTendsto M D S x ) $.
q842953-satellite-syntax $a
  wff ( Q842953Satellite D X N t c r ) $.
q842953-has-besicovitch-syntax $a
  wff ( Q842953HasBesicovitch D X ) $.
q842953-locally-finite-syntax $a
  wff ( Q842953LocallyFinite M J ) $.

${
  $d D X r x y $.

  q842953-closed-ball-definition $a |- (
    Q842953ClosedBall D X x r
  ) =
    { y e. X | ( x D y ) <_ r }
  $.
$}

${
  $d A M $.

  q842953-measure-definition $a |- (
    Q842953Measure M A
  ) =
    ( ( toOMeas ` M ) ` A )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A M S T z $.

  q842953-restricted-outer-definition $a |- (
    Q842953RestrictedOuter M S A
  ) =
    inf
    (
      { z e. RR* |
        E. T e. dom M
          (
            A C_ T
            /\
            z = ( Q842953Measure M ( T i^i S ) )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A B $.

  q842953-ediv-definition $a |- (
    Q842953EDiv A B
  ) =
    if (
      B = 0 ,
      if ( A = 0 , 0 , +oo ) ,
      if (
        B = +oo ,
        0 ,
        if ( A = +oo , +oo , ( A / B ) )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A D M S U X e r x $.

  q842953-density-tendsto-definition $a |- (
    ( Q842953DensityTendsto M D S x )
    <->
    A. U e.
      ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
      (
        1 e. U
        ->
        E. e e. RR
          (
            0 < e
            /\
            A. r e. RR
              (
                ( 0 < r /\ r < e )
                ->
                (
                  Q842953EDiv
                  (
                    Q842953Measure
                    M
                    (
                      S i^i
                      (
                        Q842953ClosedBall
                        D
                        ( U. dom M )
                        x
                        r
                      )
                    )
                  )
                  (
                    Q842953Measure
                    M
                    (
                      Q842953ClosedBall
                      D
                      ( U. dom M )
                      x
                      r
                    )
                  )
                ) e. U
              )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D X N t c r i j $.

  q842953-satellite-definition $a |- (
    ( Q842953Satellite D X N t c r )
    <->
    (
      c e. ( X ^m ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) ) )
      /\
      (
        r e. ( RR ^m ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) ) )
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) )
            0 < ( r ` i )
          /\
          (
            A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) )
              A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) )
                (
                  i =/= j
                  ->
                  (
                    (
                      ( r ` i ) <_ ( ( c ` i ) D ( c ` j ) )
                      /\
                      ( r ` j ) <_ ( t x. ( r ` i ) )
                    )
                    \/
                    (
                      ( r ` j ) <_ ( ( c ` j ) D ( c ` i ) )
                      /\
                      ( r ` i ) <_ ( t x. ( r ` j ) )
                    )
                  )
                )
            /\
            (
              A. i e. ( 0 ..^ N )
                (
                  ( r ` i ) <_ ( ( c ` i ) D ( c ` N ) )
                  /\
                  ( r ` N ) <_ ( t x. ( r ` i ) )
                )
              /\
              A. i e. ( 0 ..^ N )
                (
                  ( ( c ` i ) D ( c ` N ) )
                  <_
                  ( ( r ` i ) + ( r ` N ) )
                )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D X N t c r $.

  q842953-has-besicovitch-definition $a |- (
    ( Q842953HasBesicovitch D X )
    <->
    E. N e. NN0
      E. t e. RR
        (
          1 < t
          /\
          -. E. c e. ( X ^m ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) ) )
            E. r e. ( RR ^m ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) ) )
              ( Q842953Satellite D X N t c r )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d J M U x $.

  q842953-locally-finite-definition $a |- (
    ( Q842953LocallyFinite M J )
    <->
    A. x e. U. dom M
      E. U e. J
        (
          x e. U
          /\
          ( M ` U ) < +oo
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B D J M N S T U X c e i j r s t x y z $.

  thousand-theorems-q842953-lebesgue-density-theorem $a |-
    A. M e. U. ran measures
      A. D
        A. s
          (
            (
              D e. ( Met ` ( U. dom M ) )
              /\
              (
                ( MetOpen ` D ) e. 2ndc
                /\
                (
                  dom M = ( sigaGen ` ( MetOpen ` D ) )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( Q842953LocallyFinite M ( MetOpen ` D ) )
                    /\
                    (
                      Q842953HasBesicovitch
                      D
                      ( U. dom M )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
            ->
            (
              s C_ ( U. dom M )
              ->
              (
                Q842953RestrictedOuter
                M
                s
                {
                  x e. ( U. dom M ) |
                    -. ( Q842953DensityTendsto M D s x )
                }
              ) = 0
            )
          )
  $.
$}

title: Q842953_lebesgue_s_density_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q842953,
:: "Lebesgue's density theorem": in a second-countable metric Borel space
:: with the Besicovitch covering property, the relative measure of a set in
:: shrinking closed balls tends to one at almost every point of the set.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, TARSKI, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, CARD_3, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, PCOMPS_1,
      METRIC_1, TOPMETR, WAYBEL23, TOPGEN_4, PROB_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE4,
      MEASURE8, SUPINF_2, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, NAT_1, REAL_1, ARYTM_1,
      ARYTM_3, SETFAM_1, ORDINAL1, AFINSQ_1, COMPLEX1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, CARD_3, ORDINAL1,
      NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, XXREAL_3, XREAL_0, REAL_1,
      COMPLEX1, EXTREAL1, NAT_1, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, PCOMPS_1, METRIC_1,
      TOPMETR, WAYBEL23, TOPGEN_4, PROB_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE4, MEASURE8,
      SUPINF_2, AFINSQ_1;
 constructors ZFMISC_1, RELSET_1, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, EXTREAL1, NAT_1,
      PRE_TOPC, METRIC_1, TOPMETR, PCOMPS_1, WAYBEL23, TOPGEN_4, PROB_1,
      MEASURE1, MEASURE4, MEASURE8, SUPINF_2, AFINSQ_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELSET_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0,
      NAT_1, CARD_1, CARD_3, MEMBERED, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, PCOMPS_1, METRIC_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, MEASURE1, MEASURE4, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_3,
      XCMPLX_0;
 requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  (for X being empty set,
       S being SigmaField of X,
       Mu being sigma_Measure of S,
       s being Subset of X
   holds
     ex Nu being sigma_Measure of S st
       (for A being Element of S holds
          Nu.A = (C_Meas Mu).(A /\ s)) &
       (C_Meas Nu).{} = 0)
  &
  (for M being PseudoMetricSpace,
       S being SigmaField of the carrier of M,
       Mu being sigma_Measure of S,
       s being Subset of M
   st
     (for x,y being Point of M st dist(x,y) = 0 holds x = y) &
     TopSpaceMetr M is second-countable &
     (for U being Subset of TopSpaceMetr M st
        U in the topology of TopSpaceMetr M holds U in S) &
     (for T being SigmaField of the carrier of M st
        (for U being Subset of TopSpaceMetr M st
           U in the topology of TopSpaceMetr M holds U in T)
      holds S c= T) &
     (for x being Point of M holds
        ex rho being Real, A being Element of S st
          0 < rho & A = Ball(x,rho) & Mu.A < +infty) &
     (ex N being Nat, tau being Real st
        1 < tau &
        for c being Function of Segm(N+1),the carrier of M,
            rad being Function of Segm(N+1),REAL holds
          not (
            (for i being Element of Segm(N+1) holds 0 < rad.i) &
            (for i,j being Element of Segm(N+1) st i <> j holds
               (rad.i <= dist(c.i,c.j) & rad.j <= tau * rad.i) or
               (rad.j <= dist(c.j,c.i) & rad.i <= tau * rad.j)) &
            (ex last being Element of Segm(N+1) st
               last = N &
               (for i being Element of Segm(N+1) st i <> last holds
                  rad.i <= dist(c.i,c.last) &
                  rad.last <= tau * rad.i) &
               (for i being Element of Segm(N+1) st i <> last holds
                  dist(c.i,c.last) <= rad.i + rad.last))))
   holds
     ex Nu being sigma_Measure of S st
       (for A being Element of S holds
          Nu.A = (C_Meas Mu).(A /\ s)) &
       (C_Meas Nu).
         {x where x is Point of M :
            not
              (for eps being Real st 0 < eps holds
                 ex delta being Real st
                   0 < delta &
                   for r being Real st 0 < r & r < delta holds
                     |. (C_Meas Mu).(s /\ cl_Ball(x,r)) /
                          (C_Meas Mu).(cl_Ball(x,r)) -
                          (1 qua ExtReal) .| < eps)} = 0)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q842953_lebesgue_s_density_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q842953,
% "Lebesgue's density theorem": in a second-countable Besicovitch metric space,
% almost every point of an arbitrary set has density one for every locally finite
% Borel measure. This file contains no proof.

lebesgue_s_density_theorem_Q842953[
  X: TYPE,
  distance: [X, X -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  center_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> X]
  radius_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  one_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 1 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_divide(
      numerator, denominator: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(numerator) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF measure_value_is_zero(denominator) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(denominator) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(numerator) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(numerator) / finite_part(denominator))
    ENDIF

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: X): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: X): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X): NOT E(x)

  event_intersection(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X): E(x) AND F(x)

  event_difference(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X): E(x) AND NOT F(x)

  event_subset(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      E(x) IMPLIES F(x)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(x)

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  countably_subadditive(M: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL
        (events: event_sequence),
        (total: measure_value):
      extended_nonnegative_sum(
        LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
        total)
      IMPLIES
        measure_value_le(M(countable_union(events)), total)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        event_intersection(
          events(left_index),
          events(right_index)) = empty_event

  countably_additive_on_sigma(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL
        (events: event_sequence),
        (total: measure_value):
      (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
        AND pairwise_disjoint(events)
        AND extended_nonnegative_sum(
          LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
          total)
      IMPLIES
        M(countable_union(events)) = total

  monotone_measure(M: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (E, F: event):
      event_subset(E, F) IMPLIES
        measure_value_le(M(E), M(F))

  canonical_outer_extension(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL
        (E: event),
        (lower_bound: measure_value):
      (canonical_measure_value(lower_bound)
        AND (FORALL (A: event):
          Sigma(A) AND event_subset(E, A)
            IMPLIES
              measure_value_le(lower_bound, M(A))))
      IMPLIES
        measure_value_le(lower_bound, M(E))

  caratheodory_measurable(
      M: measure_map,
      E: event): bool =
    FORALL (A: event):
      M(A)
        = measure_value_add(
            M(event_intersection(A, E)),
            M(event_difference(A, E)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND monotone_measure(M)
      AND countably_subadditive(M)
      AND countably_additive_on_sigma(M, Sigma)
      AND canonical_outer_extension(M, Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES caratheodory_measurable(M, E))

  metric_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: X):
      distance(x, y) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        distance(x, y) = 0 IFF x = y)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        distance(x, y) = distance(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: X):
        distance(x, z)
          <= distance(x, y) + distance(y, z))

  open_ball(center: X, radius: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      distance(x, center) < radius

  closed_ball(center: X, radius: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      distance(x, center) <= radius

  metric_open(U: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      U(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (epsilon_value: posreal):
          event_subset(
            open_ball(x, epsilon_value),
            U)

  second_countable_metric: bool =
    EXISTS (basis: event_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        metric_open(basis(index)))
        AND (FORALL (U: event), (x: X):
          metric_open(U) AND U(x)
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (index: nat):
                basis(index)(x)
                  AND event_subset(basis(index), U))

  generated_borel_sigma(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (U: event):
        metric_open(U) IMPLIES Sigma(U))
      AND (FORALL (other_sigma: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(other_sigma)
          AND (FORALL (U: event):
            metric_open(U) IMPLIES other_sigma(U)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (E: event):
            Sigma(E) IMPLIES other_sigma(E))

  locally_finite_measure(M: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      EXISTS (epsilon_value: posreal):
        NOT infinite_flag(M(open_ball(x, epsilon_value)))

  satellite_configuration(
      N: nat,
      tau: real,
      centers: center_sequence,
      radii: radius_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      index <= N IMPLIES
        0 < radii(index))
      AND (FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
        left_index <= N
          AND right_index <= N
          AND left_index /= right_index
        IMPLIES
          ((radii(left_index)
              <= distance(
                centers(left_index),
                centers(right_index))
            AND radii(right_index)
              <= tau * radii(left_index))
          OR
          (radii(right_index)
              <= distance(
                centers(right_index),
                centers(left_index))
            AND radii(left_index)
              <= tau * radii(right_index))))
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < N IMPLIES
          radii(index)
              <= distance(centers(index), centers(N))
            AND radii(N) <= tau * radii(index))
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < N IMPLIES
          distance(centers(index), centers(N))
            <= radii(index) + radii(N))

  has_besicovitch_covering: bool =
    EXISTS (N: nat), (tau: real):
      1 < tau
        AND NOT EXISTS
            (centers: center_sequence),
            (radii: radius_sequence):
          satellite_configuration(
            N, tau, centers, radii)

  almost_everywhere_restrict(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      source_set: event,
      property_value: [X -> bool]): bool =
    measure_value_is_zero(
      M(event_intersection(
        source_set,
        LAMBDA (x: X):
          NOT property_value(x))))

  density_ratio(
      M: measure_map,
      source_set: event,
      x: X,
      radius: real): measure_value =
    measure_value_divide(
      M(event_intersection(
        source_set,
        closed_ball(x, radius))),
      M(closed_ball(x, radius)))

  density_one_at(
      M: measure_map,
      source_set: event,
      x: X): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (radius: real):
          0 < radius AND radius < delta
            IMPLIES
              NOT infinite_flag(
                density_ratio(M, source_set, x, radius))
                AND abs(
                  finite_part(
                    density_ratio(
                      M, source_set, x, radius))
                    - finite_part(one_measure_value))
                  < epsilon_value

  lebesgue_s_density_theorem: bool =
    metric_space
      AND second_countable_metric
      AND has_besicovitch_covering
    IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M: measure_map),
          (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
          (source_set: event):
        (is_measure(M, Sigma)
          AND generated_borel_sigma(Sigma)
          AND locally_finite_measure(M))
        IMPLIES
          almost_everywhere_restrict(
            M,
            Sigma,
            source_set,
            LAMBDA (x: X):
              density_one_at(M, source_set, x))
END lebesgue_s_density_theorem_Q842953

title: Q848375_implicit_function_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q848375
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q848375), "Implicit function theorem": for general
-- implicit-function data on complete normed spaces, the implicit function is the curried inverse
-- of the associated local open partial homeomorphism. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.InverseFunctionTheorem.FDeriv

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace Q848375

structure ImplicitFunctionData (𝕜 : Type*) [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] (E : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E] (F : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace F] (G : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace 𝕜 G] [CompleteSpace G] where
  leftFun : E → F
  leftDeriv : E →L[𝕜] F
  rightFun : E → G
  rightDeriv : E →L[𝕜] G
  pt : E
  hasStrictFDerivAt_leftFun : HasStrictFDerivAt leftFun leftDeriv pt
  hasStrictFDerivAt_rightFun : HasStrictFDerivAt rightFun rightDeriv pt
  range_leftDeriv : leftDeriv.toLinearMap.range = ⊤
  range_rightDeriv : rightDeriv.toLinearMap.range = ⊤
  isCompl_ker : IsCompl leftDeriv.toLinearMap.ker rightDeriv.toLinearMap.ker

variable {𝕜 : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E]
variable {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [CompleteSpace F]
variable {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace 𝕜 G] [CompleteSpace G]

/-- A local product homeomorphism and its curried inverse implicit function. -/
structure ImplicitFunctionResult (φ : ImplicitFunctionData 𝕜 E F G) where
  toOpenPartialHomeomorph : OpenPartialHomeomorph E (F × G)
  coe_toOpenPartialHomeomorph :
    ⇑toOpenPartialHomeomorph = fun x ↦ (φ.leftFun x, φ.rightFun x)
  pt_mem_source : φ.pt ∈ toOpenPartialHomeomorph.source
  implicitFunction : F → G → E
  implicitFunction_eq :
    implicitFunction = Function.curry toOpenPartialHomeomorph.symm

/-- The general implicit function theorem, packaged with its local product homeomorphism. -/
def implicitFunction_statement (φ : ImplicitFunctionData 𝕜 E F G) :
    ImplicitFunctionResult φ := sorry

end Q848375

title: Q848375_implicit_function_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q848375
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q848375), "Implicit function theorem": two
  strictly Frechet-differentiable maps between complete normed spaces over an
  arbitrary nontrivially normed field, with surjective derivatives and
  complementary kernels, admit a local inverse whose curried form is the
  implicit function. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q848375_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Record q848375_nontrivially_normed_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q848375_zeroK : K;
  q848375_oneK : K;
  q848375_addK : K -> K -> K;
  q848375_mulK : K -> K -> K;
  q848375_negK : K -> K;
  q848375_invK : K -> K;
  q848375_normK : K -> R;
  q848375_zero_neq_oneK :
    q848375_zeroK <> q848375_oneK;
  q848375_addK_assoc :
    forall a b c : K,
      q848375_addK a (q848375_addK b c) =
      q848375_addK (q848375_addK a b) c;
  q848375_addK_comm :
    forall a b : K,
      q848375_addK a b = q848375_addK b a;
  q848375_addK_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q848375_addK a q848375_zeroK = a;
  q848375_addK_neg :
    forall a : K,
      q848375_addK a (q848375_negK a) = q848375_zeroK;
  q848375_mulK_assoc :
    forall a b c : K,
      q848375_mulK a (q848375_mulK b c) =
      q848375_mulK (q848375_mulK a b) c;
  q848375_mulK_comm :
    forall a b : K,
      q848375_mulK a b = q848375_mulK b a;
  q848375_mulK_one :
    forall a : K,
      q848375_mulK a q848375_oneK = a;
  q848375_mulK_add :
    forall a b c : K,
      q848375_mulK a (q848375_addK b c) =
      q848375_addK
        (q848375_mulK a b) (q848375_mulK a c);
  q848375_invK_zero :
    q848375_invK q848375_zeroK = q848375_zeroK;
  q848375_mulK_inv :
    forall a : K,
      a <> q848375_zeroK ->
      q848375_mulK a (q848375_invK a) = q848375_oneK;
  q848375_normK_nonnegative :
    forall a : K,
      0 <= q848375_normK a;
  q848375_normK_eq_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q848375_normK a = 0 <-> a = q848375_zeroK;
  q848375_normK_neg :
    forall a : K,
      q848375_normK (q848375_negK a) = q848375_normK a;
  q848375_normK_add_le :
    forall a b : K,
      q848375_normK (q848375_addK a b) <=
      q848375_normK a + q848375_normK b;
  q848375_normK_mul :
    forall a b : K,
      q848375_normK (q848375_mulK a b) =
      q848375_normK a * q848375_normK b;
  q848375_normK_nontrivial :
    exists a : K, 1 < q848375_normK a
}.

Arguments q848375_zeroK {K} _.
Arguments q848375_oneK {K} _.
Arguments q848375_addK {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q848375_mulK {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q848375_negK {K} _ _.
Arguments q848375_invK {K} _ _.
Arguments q848375_normK {K} _ _.

Record q848375_normed_space
    (K E : Type)
    (KF : q848375_nontrivially_normed_field K) : Type := {
  q848375_zeroV : E;
  q848375_addV : E -> E -> E;
  q848375_negV : E -> E;
  q848375_smulV : K -> E -> E;
  q848375_normV : E -> R;
  q848375_addV_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q848375_addV x (q848375_addV y z) =
      q848375_addV (q848375_addV x y) z;
  q848375_addV_comm :
    forall x y : E,
      q848375_addV x y = q848375_addV y x;
  q848375_addV_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q848375_addV x q848375_zeroV = x;
  q848375_addV_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q848375_addV x (q848375_negV x) = q848375_zeroV;
  q848375_one_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q848375_smulV (q848375_oneK KF) x = x;
  q848375_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q848375_smulV (q848375_mulK KF a b) x =
      q848375_smulV a (q848375_smulV b x);
  q848375_add_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q848375_smulV (q848375_addK KF a b) x =
      q848375_addV
        (q848375_smulV a x) (q848375_smulV b x);
  q848375_smul_add :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q848375_smulV a (q848375_addV x y) =
      q848375_addV
        (q848375_smulV a x) (q848375_smulV a y);
  q848375_zero_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q848375_smulV (q848375_zeroK KF) x = q848375_zeroV;
  q848375_smul_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q848375_smulV a q848375_zeroV = q848375_zeroV;
  q848375_normV_nonnegative :
    forall x : E,
      0 <= q848375_normV x;
  q848375_normV_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q848375_normV x = 0 <-> x = q848375_zeroV;
  q848375_normV_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q848375_normV (q848375_negV x) = q848375_normV x;
  q848375_normV_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q848375_normV (q848375_addV x y) <=
      q848375_normV x + q848375_normV y;
  q848375_normV_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : E),
      q848375_normV (q848375_smulV a x) =
      q848375_normK KF a * q848375_normV x
}.

Arguments q848375_zeroV {K E KF} _.
Arguments q848375_addV {K E KF} _ _ _.
Arguments q848375_negV {K E KF} _ _.
Arguments q848375_smulV {K E KF} _ _ _.
Arguments q848375_normV {K E KF} _ _.

Definition q848375_sub
    {K E : Type}
    {KF : q848375_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (V : @q848375_normed_space K E KF)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q848375_addV V x (q848375_negV V y).

Definition q848375_sequence_cauchy
    {K E : Type}
    {KF : q848375_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (V : @q848375_normed_space K E KF)
    (u : nat -> E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q848375_normV V
          (q848375_sub V (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

Definition q848375_sequence_converges
    {K E : Type}
    {KF : q848375_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (V : @q848375_normed_space K E KF)
    (u : nat -> E) (limit : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q848375_normV V
          (q848375_sub V (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q848375_complete
    {K E : Type}
    {KF : q848375_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (V : @q848375_normed_space K E KF) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> E,
    q848375_sequence_cauchy V u ->
    exists limit : E,
      q848375_sequence_converges V u limit.

Record q848375_continuous_linear_map
    (K E F : Type)
    (KF : q848375_nontrivially_normed_field K)
    (VE : @q848375_normed_space K E KF)
    (VF : @q848375_normed_space K F KF) : Type := {
  q848375_clm_fun : E -> F;
  q848375_clm_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q848375_clm_fun (q848375_addV VE x y) =
      q848375_addV VF
        (q848375_clm_fun x) (q848375_clm_fun y);
  q848375_clm_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : E),
      q848375_clm_fun (q848375_smulV VE a x) =
      q848375_smulV VF a (q848375_clm_fun x);
  q848375_clm_bounded :
    exists bound : R,
      0 <= bound /\
      forall x : E,
        q848375_normV VF (q848375_clm_fun x) <=
        bound * q848375_normV VE x
}.

Arguments q848375_clm_fun {K E F KF VE VF} _ _.

Definition q848375_has_strict_fderiv_at
    {K E F : Type}
    {KF : q848375_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (VE : @q848375_normed_space K E KF)
    (VF : @q848375_normed_space K F KF)
    (f : E -> F)
    (derivative :
      @q848375_continuous_linear_map K E F KF VE VF)
    (point : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall x y : E,
        q848375_normV VE (q848375_sub VE x point) < delta ->
        q848375_normV VE (q848375_sub VE y point) < delta ->
        q848375_normV VF
          (q848375_sub VF
            (q848375_sub VF (f x) (f y))
            (q848375_clm_fun derivative
              (q848375_sub VE x y))) <=
        epsilon * q848375_normV VE (q848375_sub VE x y).

Definition q848375_surjective
    {A B : Type} (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall y : B, exists x : A, f x = y.

Definition q848375_complementary_kernels
    {K E F G : Type}
    {KF : q848375_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (VE : @q848375_normed_space K E KF)
    (VF : @q848375_normed_space K F KF)
    (VG : @q848375_normed_space K G KF)
    (leftDeriv :
      @q848375_continuous_linear_map K E F KF VE VF)
    (rightDeriv :
      @q848375_continuous_linear_map K E G KF VE VG) : Prop :=
  (forall x : E,
    q848375_clm_fun leftDeriv x = q848375_zeroV VF ->
    q848375_clm_fun rightDeriv x = q848375_zeroV VG ->
    x = q848375_zeroV VE) /\
  forall x : E,
    exists u v : E,
      q848375_clm_fun leftDeriv u = q848375_zeroV VF /\
      q848375_clm_fun rightDeriv v = q848375_zeroV VG /\
      x = q848375_addV VE u v.

Definition q848375_open
    {K E : Type}
    {KF : q848375_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (V : @q848375_normed_space K E KF)
    (U : q848375_set E) : Prop :=
  forall x : E,
    U x ->
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall y : E,
        q848375_normV V (q848375_sub V y x) < radius ->
        U y.

Definition q848375_open_product
    {K F G : Type}
    {KF : q848375_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (VF : @q848375_normed_space K F KF)
    (VG : @q848375_normed_space K G KF)
    (U : q848375_set (F * G)) : Prop :=
  forall p : F * G,
    U p ->
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall q : F * G,
        q848375_normV VF
          (q848375_sub VF (fst q) (fst p)) < radius ->
        q848375_normV VG
          (q848375_sub VG (snd q) (snd p)) < radius ->
        U q.

Definition q848375_forward_continuous_on
    {K E F G : Type}
    {KF : q848375_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (VE : @q848375_normed_space K E KF)
    (VF : @q848375_normed_space K F KF)
    (VG : @q848375_normed_space K G KF)
    (leftFun : E -> F)
    (rightFun : E -> G)
    (source : q848375_set E) : Prop :=
  forall x : E,
    source x ->
    forall epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon ->
      exists delta : R,
        0 < delta /\
        forall y : E,
          source y ->
          q848375_normV VE
            (q848375_sub VE y x) < delta ->
          q848375_normV VF
            (q848375_sub VF (leftFun y) (leftFun x)) < epsilon /\
          q848375_normV VG
            (q848375_sub VG (rightFun y) (rightFun x)) < epsilon.

Definition q848375_inverse_continuous_on
    {K E F G : Type}
    {KF : q848375_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (VE : @q848375_normed_space K E KF)
    (VF : @q848375_normed_space K F KF)
    (VG : @q848375_normed_space K G KF)
    (implicitFunction : F -> G -> E)
    (target : q848375_set (F * G)) : Prop :=
  forall p : F * G,
    target p ->
    forall epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon ->
      exists delta : R,
        0 < delta /\
        forall q : F * G,
          target q ->
          q848375_normV VF
            (q848375_sub VF (fst q) (fst p)) < delta ->
          q848375_normV VG
            (q848375_sub VG (snd q) (snd p)) < delta ->
          q848375_normV VE
            (q848375_sub VE
              (implicitFunction (fst q) (snd q))
              (implicitFunction (fst p) (snd p))) < epsilon.

Theorem q848375_implicit_function_theorem :
  forall
    (K E F G : Type)
    (KF : q848375_nontrivially_normed_field K)
    (VE : @q848375_normed_space K E KF)
    (VF : @q848375_normed_space K F KF)
    (VG : @q848375_normed_space K G KF),
    q848375_complete VE ->
    q848375_complete VF ->
    q848375_complete VG ->
    forall
      (leftFun : E -> F)
      (leftDeriv :
        @q848375_continuous_linear_map K E F KF VE VF)
      (rightFun : E -> G)
      (rightDeriv :
        @q848375_continuous_linear_map K E G KF VE VG)
      (point : E),
      @q848375_has_strict_fderiv_at
        K E F KF VE VF leftFun leftDeriv point ->
      @q848375_has_strict_fderiv_at
        K E G KF VE VG rightFun rightDeriv point ->
      q848375_surjective (q848375_clm_fun leftDeriv) ->
      q848375_surjective (q848375_clm_fun rightDeriv) ->
      @q848375_complementary_kernels
        K E F G KF VE VF VG leftDeriv rightDeriv ->
      exists
        (implicitFunction : F -> G -> E)
        (source : q848375_set E)
        (target : q848375_set (F * G)),
        @q848375_open K E KF VE source /\
        @q848375_open_product K F G KF VF VG target /\
        source point /\
        target (leftFun point, rightFun point) /\
        @q848375_forward_continuous_on
          K E F G KF VE VF VG leftFun rightFun source /\
        @q848375_inverse_continuous_on
          K E F G KF VE VF VG implicitFunction target /\
        (forall x : E,
          source x ->
          target (leftFun x, rightFun x) /\
          implicitFunction (leftFun x) (rightFun x) = x) /\
        forall p : F * G,
          target p ->
          source (implicitFunction (fst p) (snd p)) /\
          leftFun (implicitFunction (fst p) (snd p)) = fst p /\
          rightFun (implicitFunction (fst p) (snd p)) = snd p.
Admitted.

title: Q848375_implicit_function_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q848375,
  "Implicit function theorem": for general implicit-function data on Banach
  spaces over an arbitrary nontrivially normed field, the implicit function is
  the curried inverse of the associated local product-map homeomorphism. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q848375_implicit_function_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q848375_nontrivially_normed_field ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q848375_nontrivially_normed_field knorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    knorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>a. 0 \<le> knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm a = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> a = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm (-a) = knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a + b) \<le> knorm a + knorm b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a * b) = knorm a * knorm b) \<and>
    (\<exists>a. 1 < knorm a)"

definition q848375_normed_space ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q848375_normed_space knorm enorm scale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. scale a (x + y) = scale a x + scale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a + b) x = scale a x + scale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a * b) x = scale a (scale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. scale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. enorm (scale a x) = knorm a * enorm x) \<and>
    enorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm (-x) = enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. enorm (x + y) \<le> enorm x + enorm y)"

definition q848375_complete_space ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q848375_complete_space enorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>u :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'e.
      (\<forall>epsilon>0. \<exists>N. \<forall>m\<ge>N. \<forall>n\<ge>N.
        enorm (u m - u n) < epsilon)
      \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>x. \<forall>epsilon>0. \<exists>N. \<forall>n\<ge>N.
        enorm (u n - x) < epsilon))"

definition q848375_continuous_linear ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q848375_continuous_linear enorm fnorm escale fscale L \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. L (x + y) = L x + L y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. L (escale a x) = fscale a (L x)) \<and>
    (\<exists>C\<ge>0. \<forall>x. fnorm (L x) \<le> C * enorm x)"

definition q848375_has_strict_fderiv_at ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q848375_has_strict_fderiv_at enorm fnorm escale fscale f D a \<longleftrightarrow>
    q848375_continuous_linear enorm fnorm escale fscale D \<and>
    (\<forall>epsilon>0. \<exists>delta>0. \<forall>x y.
      enorm (x - a) < delta \<longrightarrow>
      enorm (y - a) < delta \<longrightarrow>
      fnorm ((f x - f y) - D (x - y)) \<le> epsilon * enorm (x - y))"

definition q848375_complementary_kernels ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'f::zero) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e \<Rightarrow> 'g::zero) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q848375_complementary_kernels L R \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. \<exists>u v. L u = 0 \<and> R v = 0 \<and> x = u + v) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. L x = 0 \<longrightarrow> R x = 0 \<longrightarrow> x = 0)"

definition q848375_open_norm ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q848375_open_norm enorm U \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>U. \<exists>r>0. \<forall>y. enorm (y - x) < r \<longrightarrow> y \<in> U)"

definition q848375_open_product_norm ::
    "('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('g::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> ('f \<times> 'g) set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q848375_open_product_norm fnorm gnorm U \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>p\<in>U. \<exists>r>0. \<forall>q.
      fnorm (fst q - fst p) < r \<longrightarrow>
      gnorm (snd q - snd p) < r \<longrightarrow>
      q \<in> U)"

definition q848375_forward_continuous_on ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('g::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> ('e \<Rightarrow> 'g) \<Rightarrow> 'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q848375_forward_continuous_on enorm fnorm gnorm f g U \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>U. \<forall>epsilon>0. \<exists>delta>0. \<forall>y\<in>U.
      enorm (y - x) < delta \<longrightarrow>
      fnorm (f y - f x) < epsilon \<and>
      gnorm (g y - g x) < epsilon)"

definition q848375_inverse_continuous_on ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('g::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      (('f \<times> 'g) \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> ('f \<times> 'g) set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q848375_inverse_continuous_on enorm fnorm gnorm h U \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>p\<in>U. \<forall>epsilon>0. \<exists>delta>0. \<forall>q\<in>U.
      fnorm (fst q - fst p) < delta \<longrightarrow>
      gnorm (snd q - snd p) < delta \<longrightarrow>
      enorm (h q - h p) < epsilon)"

locale q848375_implicit_function_data =
  fixes knorm :: "'k::field \<Rightarrow> real"
    and enorm :: "'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and fnorm :: "'f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and gnorm :: "'g::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and escale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and fscale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and gscale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow> 'g"
    and leftFun :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and leftDeriv :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and rightFun :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'g"
    and rightDeriv :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'g"
    and pt :: 'e
  assumes scalar_field: "q848375_nontrivially_normed_field knorm"
    and domain_space: "q848375_normed_space knorm enorm escale"
    and left_space: "q848375_normed_space knorm fnorm fscale"
    and right_space: "q848375_normed_space knorm gnorm gscale"
    and domain_complete: "q848375_complete_space enorm"
    and left_complete: "q848375_complete_space fnorm"
    and right_complete: "q848375_complete_space gnorm"
    and left_strict_derivative:
      "q848375_has_strict_fderiv_at
        enorm fnorm escale fscale leftFun leftDeriv pt"
    and right_strict_derivative:
      "q848375_has_strict_fderiv_at
        enorm gnorm escale gscale rightFun rightDeriv pt"
    and left_surjective: "\<forall>y. \<exists>x. leftDeriv x = y"
    and right_surjective: "\<forall>z. \<exists>x. rightDeriv x = z"
    and complementary:
      "q848375_complementary_kernels leftDeriv rightDeriv"
begin

definition q848375_local_product_homeomorphism ::
    "'e set \<Rightarrow> ('f \<times> 'g) set \<Rightarrow>
      (('f \<times> 'g) \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q848375_local_product_homeomorphism source target invFun \<longleftrightarrow>
    q848375_open_norm enorm source \<and>
    q848375_open_product_norm fnorm gnorm target \<and>
    pt \<in> source \<and>
    (leftFun pt, rightFun pt) \<in> target \<and>
    q848375_forward_continuous_on
      enorm fnorm gnorm leftFun rightFun source \<and>
    q848375_inverse_continuous_on
      enorm fnorm gnorm invFun target \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>source.
      (leftFun x, rightFun x) \<in> target \<and>
      invFun (leftFun x, rightFun x) = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>p\<in>target.
      invFun p \<in> source \<and>
      leftFun (invFun p) = fst p \<and>
      rightFun (invFun p) = snd p)"

definition q848375_to_open_partial_homeomorph ::
    "'e set \<times> (('f \<times> 'g) set \<times> (('f \<times> 'g) \<Rightarrow> 'e))" where
  "q848375_to_open_partial_homeomorph =
    (SOME chart.
      q848375_local_product_homeomorphism
        (fst chart) (fst (snd chart)) (snd (snd chart)))"

definition q848375_implicit_function :: "'f \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q848375_implicit_function =
    curry (snd (snd q848375_to_open_partial_homeomorph))"

theorem q848375_to_open_partial_homeomorph_spec:
  "q848375_local_product_homeomorphism
    (fst q848375_to_open_partial_homeomorph)
    (fst (snd q848375_to_open_partial_homeomorph))
    (snd (snd q848375_to_open_partial_homeomorph))"
  sorry

end

end

title: Q848375_implicit_function_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q848375
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q848375), "Implicit function theorem":
  implicit-function data over complete normed spaces, with strict derivatives,
  surjective derivatives, and complementary kernels, determines an associated
  local open partial homeomorphism whose inverse curries to the implicit
  function. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q848375_IMPLICIT_FUNCTION =
 `let normed_field =
    \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
     (negK:K->K) (invK:K->K) (normK:K->real).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:K. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:K. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:K. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:K. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:K. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:K. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:K. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:K. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK a) a = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:K.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       normK zeroK = &0 /\
       (!a:K. &0 <= normK a) /\
       (!a:K. normK a = &0 <=> a = zeroK) /\
       (!a:K. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\
       (!a b:K. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
       (!a b:K. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
       (?a:K. &1 < normK a) in
  let normed_space_E =
    \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
     (normK:K->real) (zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A)
     (smulE:K->A->A) (normE:A->real).
       (!x y z:A. addE x (addE y z) = addE (addE x y) z) /\
       (!x y:A. addE x y = addE y x) /\
       (!x:A. addE zeroE x = x) /\
       (!x:A. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
       (!x:A. smulE oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:K. !x:A.
          smulE (mulK a b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
       (!a b:K. !x:A.
          smulE (addK a b) x = addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
       (!a:K. !x y:A.
          smulE a (addE x y) = addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
       (!x:A. smulE zeroK x = zeroE) /\
       (!a:K. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) /\
       normE zeroE = &0 /\
       (!x:A. &0 <= normE x) /\
       (!x:A. normE x = &0 <=> x = zeroE) /\
       (!x:A. normE (negE x) = normE x) /\
       (!x y:A. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) /\
       (!a:K. !x:A. normE (smulE a x) = normK a * normE x) in
  let normed_space_F =
    \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
     (normK:K->real) (zeroF:B) (addF:B->B->B) (negF:B->B)
     (smulF:K->B->B) (normF:B->real).
       (!x y z:B. addF x (addF y z) = addF (addF x y) z) /\
       (!x y:B. addF x y = addF y x) /\
       (!x:B. addF zeroF x = x) /\
       (!x:B. addF (negF x) x = zeroF) /\
       (!x:B. smulF oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:K. !x:B.
          smulF (mulK a b) x = smulF a (smulF b x)) /\
       (!a b:K. !x:B.
          smulF (addK a b) x = addF (smulF a x) (smulF b x)) /\
       (!a:K. !x y:B.
          smulF a (addF x y) = addF (smulF a x) (smulF a y)) /\
       (!x:B. smulF zeroK x = zeroF) /\
       (!a:K. smulF a zeroF = zeroF) /\
       normF zeroF = &0 /\
       (!x:B. &0 <= normF x) /\
       (!x:B. normF x = &0 <=> x = zeroF) /\
       (!x:B. normF (negF x) = normF x) /\
       (!x y:B. normF (addF x y) <= normF x + normF y) /\
       (!a:K. !x:B. normF (smulF a x) = normK a * normF x) in
  let normed_space_G =
    \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
     (normK:K->real) (zeroG:C) (addG:C->C->C) (negG:C->C)
     (smulG:K->C->C) (normG:C->real).
       (!x y z:C. addG x (addG y z) = addG (addG x y) z) /\
       (!x y:C. addG x y = addG y x) /\
       (!x:C. addG zeroG x = x) /\
       (!x:C. addG (negG x) x = zeroG) /\
       (!x:C. smulG oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:K. !x:C.
          smulG (mulK a b) x = smulG a (smulG b x)) /\
       (!a b:K. !x:C.
          smulG (addK a b) x = addG (smulG a x) (smulG b x)) /\
       (!a:K. !x y:C.
          smulG a (addG x y) = addG (smulG a x) (smulG a y)) /\
       (!x:C. smulG zeroK x = zeroG) /\
       (!a:K. smulG a zeroG = zeroG) /\
       normG zeroG = &0 /\
       (!x:C. &0 <= normG x) /\
       (!x:C. normG x = &0 <=> x = zeroG) /\
       (!x:C. normG (negG x) = normG x) /\
       (!x y:C. normG (addG x y) <= normG x + normG y) /\
       (!a:K. !x:C. normG (smulG a x) = normK a * normG x) in
  let complete_E =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A) (normE:A->real).
       !u:num->A.
         (!epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon
            ==> ?N:num.
                  !m n:num.
                    N <= m /\ N <= n
                    ==> normE (addE (u m) (negE (u n))) < epsilon)
         ==> ?x:A.
               !epsilon:real.
                 &0 < epsilon
                 ==> ?N:num.
                       !n:num.
                         N <= n
                         ==> normE (addE (u n) (negE x)) < epsilon in
  let complete_F =
    \(addF:B->B->B) (negF:B->B) (normF:B->real).
       !u:num->B.
         (!epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon
            ==> ?N:num.
                  !m n:num.
                    N <= m /\ N <= n
                    ==> normF (addF (u m) (negF (u n))) < epsilon)
         ==> ?x:B.
               !epsilon:real.
                 &0 < epsilon
                 ==> ?N:num.
                       !n:num.
                         N <= n
                         ==> normF (addF (u n) (negF x)) < epsilon in
  let complete_G =
    \(addG:C->C->C) (negG:C->C) (normG:C->real).
       !u:num->C.
         (!epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon
            ==> ?N:num.
                  !m n:num.
                    N <= m /\ N <= n
                    ==> normG (addG (u m) (negG (u n))) < epsilon)
         ==> ?x:C.
               !epsilon:real.
                 &0 < epsilon
                 ==> ?N:num.
                       !n:num.
                         N <= n
                         ==> normG (addG (u n) (negG x)) < epsilon in
  let subE =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A) (x:A) (y:A).
       addE x (negE y) in
  let subF =
    \(addF:B->B->B) (negF:B->B) (x:B) (y:B).
       addF x (negF y) in
  let subG =
    \(addG:C->C->C) (negG:C->C) (x:C) (y:C).
       addG x (negG y) in
  let continuous_linear_EF =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (smulE:K->A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (addF:B->B->B) (smulF:K->B->B) (normF:B->real)
     (L:A->B).
       (!x y:A. L (addE x y) = addF (L x) (L y)) /\
       (!a:K. !x:A. L (smulE a x) = smulF a (L x)) /\
       (?bound:real.
          &0 <= bound /\
          !x:A. normF (L x) <= bound * normE x) in
  let continuous_linear_EG =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (smulE:K->A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (addG:C->C->C) (smulG:K->C->C) (normG:C->real)
     (L:A->C).
       (!x y:A. L (addE x y) = addG (L x) (L y)) /\
       (!a:K. !x:A. L (smulE a x) = smulG a (L x)) /\
       (?bound:real.
          &0 <= bound /\
          !x:A. normG (L x) <= bound * normE x) in
  let has_strict_fderiv_left =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A) (smulE:K->A->A)
     (normE:A->real) (addF:B->B->B) (negF:B->B)
     (smulF:K->B->B) (normF:B->real)
     (f:A->B) (f':A->B) (a:A).
       continuous_linear_EF
         addE smulE normE addF smulF normF f' /\
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !x y:A.
                 normE (subE addE negE x a) < delta /\
                 normE (subE addE negE y a) < delta
                 ==> normF
                       (subF addF negF
                         (subF addF negF (f x) (f y))
                         (f' (subE addE negE x y)))
                     <= epsilon * normE (subE addE negE x y) in
  let has_strict_fderiv_right =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A) (smulE:K->A->A)
     (normE:A->real) (addG:C->C->C) (negG:C->C)
     (smulG:K->C->C) (normG:C->real)
     (g:A->C) (g':A->C) (a:A).
       continuous_linear_EG
         addE smulE normE addG smulG normG g' /\
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !x y:A.
                 normE (subE addE negE x a) < delta /\
                 normE (subE addE negE y a) < delta
                 ==> normG
                       (subG addG negG
                         (subG addG negG (g x) (g y))
