title: Q848375_implicit_function_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q848375
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q848375), "Implicit function theorem":
:: complementary surjective strict derivatives yield a local product inverse;
:: its curry is the implicit function with the characterized strict derivative.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1,
      TARSKI, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5, VECTSP_1, ARYTM_1,
      ARYTM_3, SUPINF_2, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, BINOP_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, CARD_1, XCMPLX_0,
      XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1, XXREAL_0,
      RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1, BINOP_1;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, NAT_1, XXREAL_0,
      REAL_1, COMPLEX1, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, BINOP_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1;
 requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for K being Field,
      E,F,G being VectSp of K,
      normK being Function of the carrier of K,REAL,
      normE being Function of the carrier of E,REAL,
      normF being Function of the carrier of F,REAL,
      normG being Function of the carrier of G,REAL,
      leftFun being Function of the carrier of E,the carrier of F,
      leftDeriv being Function of the carrier of E,the carrier of F,
      rightFun being Function of the carrier of E,the carrier of G,
      rightDeriv being Function of the carrier of E,the carrier of G,
      pt being Element of E
  st
    (for a being Element of K holds 0 <= normK.a) &
    (for a being Element of K holds
      (normK.a = 0 iff a = 0.K)) &
    (for a,b being Element of K holds
      normK.(a+b) <= normK.a + normK.b) &
    (for a,b being Element of K holds
      normK.(a*b) = normK.a * normK.b) &
    (ex a being Element of K st 1 < normK.a) &
    (for x being Element of E holds 0 <= normE.x) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      (normE.x = 0 iff x = 0.E)) &
    (for x,y being Element of E holds
      normE.(x+y) <= normE.x + normE.y) &
    (for a being Element of K, x being Element of E holds
      normE.(a*x) = normK.a * normE.x) &
    (for x being Element of F holds 0 <= normF.x) &
    (for x being Element of F holds
      (normF.x = 0 iff x = 0.F)) &
    (for x,y being Element of F holds
      normF.(x+y) <= normF.x + normF.y) &
    (for a being Element of K, x being Element of F holds
      normF.(a*x) = normK.a * normF.x) &
    (for x being Element of G holds 0 <= normG.x) &
    (for x being Element of G holds
      (normG.x = 0 iff x = 0.G)) &
    (for x,y being Element of G holds
      normG.(x+y) <= normG.x + normG.y) &
    (for a being Element of K, x being Element of G holds
      normG.(a*x) = normK.a * normG.x) &
    (for s being Function of NAT,the carrier of E st
      (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex N being Nat st
          for m,n being Nat st N <= m & N <= n holds
            normE.(s.m-s.n) < epsilon)
    holds
      ex x being Element of E st
        for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
          ex N being Nat st
            for n being Nat st N <= n holds
              normE.(s.n-x) < epsilon) &
    (for s being Function of NAT,the carrier of F st
      (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex N being Nat st
          for m,n being Nat st N <= m & N <= n holds
            normF.(s.m-s.n) < epsilon)
    holds
      ex x being Element of F st
        for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
          ex N being Nat st
            for n being Nat st N <= n holds
              normF.(s.n-x) < epsilon) &
    (for s being Function of NAT,the carrier of G st
      (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex N being Nat st
          for m,n being Nat st N <= m & N <= n holds
            normG.(s.m-s.n) < epsilon)
    holds
      ex x being Element of G st
        for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
          ex N being Nat st
            for n being Nat st N <= n holds
              normG.(s.n-x) < epsilon) &
    (for x,y being Element of E holds
      leftDeriv.(x+y) = leftDeriv.x + leftDeriv.y) &
    (for a being Element of K, x being Element of E holds
      leftDeriv.(a*x) = a * leftDeriv.x) &
    (ex C being Real st
      0 <= C &
      for x being Element of E holds
        normF.(leftDeriv.x) <= C * normE.x) &
    (for x,y being Element of E holds
      rightDeriv.(x+y) = rightDeriv.x + rightDeriv.y) &
    (for a being Element of K, x being Element of E holds
      rightDeriv.(a*x) = a * rightDeriv.x) &
    (ex C being Real st
      0 <= C &
      for x being Element of E holds
        normG.(rightDeriv.x) <= C * normE.x) &
    (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
      ex delta being Real st
        0 < delta &
        for x,y being Element of E st
          normE.(x-pt) < delta & normE.(y-pt) < delta
        holds
          normF.((leftFun.x-leftFun.y)-leftDeriv.(x-y))
            <= epsilon * normE.(x-y)) &
    (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
      ex delta being Real st
        0 < delta &
        for x,y being Element of E st
          normE.(x-pt) < delta & normE.(y-pt) < delta
        holds
          normG.((rightFun.x-rightFun.y)-rightDeriv.(x-y))
            <= epsilon * normE.(x-y)) &
    (for y being Element of F holds
      ex x being Element of E st leftDeriv.x = y) &
    (for z being Element of G holds
      ex x being Element of E st rightDeriv.x = z) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      ex u,v being Element of E st
        x = u+v & leftDeriv.u = 0.F & rightDeriv.v = 0.G) &
    (for x being Element of E st
      leftDeriv.x = 0.F & rightDeriv.x = 0.G
    holds x = 0.E)
  holds
    ex source being Subset of E,
       target being Subset of
         [:the carrier of F,the carrier of G:],
       inverse being Function of
         [:the carrier of F,the carrier of G:],the carrier of E,
       implicitFunction being Function of
         the carrier of F,Funcs(the carrier of G,the carrier of E),
       implicitDerivative being Function of
         the carrier of G,the carrier of E st
      pt in source &
      [leftFun.pt,rightFun.pt] in target &
      (for z,z1 being Element of G holds
        implicitDerivative.(z+z1) =
          implicitDerivative.z + implicitDerivative.z1) &
      (for a being Element of K, z being Element of G holds
        implicitDerivative.(a*z) = a * implicitDerivative.z) &
      (ex C being Real st
        0 <= C &
        for z being Element of G holds
          normE.(implicitDerivative.z) <= C * normG.z) &
      (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex delta being Real st
          0 < delta &
          for z,z1 being Element of G st
            normG.(z-rightFun.pt) < delta &
            normG.(z1-rightFun.pt) < delta
          holds

            holds

                <= epsilon * normG.(z-z1)) &
      (for z being Element of G holds
        rightDeriv.(implicitDerivative.z) = z &
        leftDeriv.(implicitDerivative.z) = 0.F) &

        ex r being Real st
          0 < r &
          for y being Element of E st normE.(y-x) < r holds
            y in source) &
      (for y being Element of F, z being Element of G st
        [y,z] in target
      holds

      (for x being Element of E st x in source holds
        for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
          ex delta being Real st
            0 < delta &
            for y being Element of E st
              y in source & normE.(y-x) < delta
            holds
              normF.(leftFun.y-leftFun.x) < epsilon &
              normG.(rightFun.y-rightFun.x) < epsilon) &
      (for y being Element of F, z being Element of G st
        [y,z] in target
      holds
        for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
          ex delta being Real st
            0 < delta &
            for y1 being Element of F, z1 being Element of G st
              [y1,z1] in target &
              normF.(y1-y) < delta & normG.(z1-z) < delta
            holds
              for x,x1 being Element of E st
                x = inverse.[y1,z1] & x1 = inverse.[y,z]

title: Q848375_implicit_function_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q848375,
% "Implicit function theorem": complementary surjective strict Frechet
% derivatives determine a local implicit inverse between Banach spaces.
% This file contains no proof.

Q848375_implicit_function_theorem[
  K: TYPE+,
  E: TYPE+,
  F: TYPE+,
  G: TYPE+,
  zeroK, oneK: K,
  addK, mulK: [K, K -> K],
  negK, invK: [K -> K],
  normK: [K -> real],
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [K, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  zeroF: F,
  addF: [F, F -> F],
  negF: [F -> F],
  smulF: [K, F -> F],
  normF: [F -> real],
  zeroG: G,
  addG: [G, G -> G],
  negG: [G -> G],
  smulG: [K, G -> G],
  normG: [G -> real],
  leftFun: [E -> F],
  leftDeriv: [E -> F],
  rightFun: [E -> G],
  rightDeriv: [E -> G],
  pt: E
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  fg_pair: TYPE =
    [# left_value: F, right_value: G #]

  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  f_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> F]
  g_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> G]
  e_set: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  fg_set: TYPE = [fg_pair -> bool]
  implicit_function_type: TYPE = [F -> [G -> E]]

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  subF(x, y: F): F =
    addF(x, negF(y))

  subG(x, y: G): G =
    addG(x, negG(y))

  max_real(x, y: real): real =
    IF x <= y THEN y ELSE x ENDIF

  pair_distance(p, q: fg_pair): real =
    max_real(
      normF(subF(left_value(p), left_value(q))),
      normG(subG(right_value(p), right_value(q))))

  prodFun(x: E): fg_pair =
    (# left_value := leftFun(x),
       right_value := rightFun(x) #)

  apply_implicit(
      candidate: implicit_function_type,
      p: fg_pair): E =
    candidate(left_value(p))(right_value(p))

  nontrivially_normed_field: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: K):
      addK(a, b) = addK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        addK(addK(a, b), c) = addK(a, addK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        addK(a, zeroK) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        addK(a, negK(a)) = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        mulK(a, b) = mulK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(mulK(a, b), c) = mulK(a, mulK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        mulK(a, oneK) = a)
      AND zeroK /= oneK
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(a, addK(b, c)) =
          addK(mulK(a, b), mulK(a, c)))
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        a /= zeroK IMPLIES
          mulK(a, invK(a)) = oneK)
      AND normK(zeroK) = 0
      AND normK(oneK) = 1
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        0 <= normK(a))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        normK(a) = 0 IFF a = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        normK(negK(a)) = normK(a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        normK(addK(a, b)) <= normK(a) + normK(b))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        normK(mulK(a, b)) = normK(a) * normK(b))
      AND (EXISTS (a: K):
        1 < normK(a))

  normed_space_E: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smulE(addK(a, b), x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smulE(mulK(a, b), x) =
          smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(oneK, x) = x)
      AND normE(zeroE) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) = normK(a) * normE(x))

  normed_space_F: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: F):
      addF(x, y) = addF(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
        addF(addF(x, y), z) = addF(x, addF(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        addF(x, zeroF) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        addF(x, negF(x)) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: F):
        smulF(a, addF(x, y)) =
          addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: F):
        smulF(addK(a, b), x) =
          addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: F):
        smulF(mulK(a, b), x) =
          smulF(a, smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        smulF(oneK, x) = x)
      AND normF(zeroF) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        0 <= normF(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        normF(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        normF(negF(x)) = normF(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: F):
        normF(addF(x, y)) <= normF(x) + normF(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: F):
        normF(smulF(a, x)) = normK(a) * normF(x))

  normed_space_G: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: G):
      addG(x, y) = addG(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        addG(addG(x, y), z) = addG(x, addG(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        addG(x, zeroG) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        addG(x, negG(x)) = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: G):
        smulG(a, addG(x, y)) =
          addG(smulG(a, x), smulG(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: G):
        smulG(addK(a, b), x) =
          addG(smulG(a, x), smulG(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: G):
        smulG(mulK(a, b), x) =
          smulG(a, smulG(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        smulG(oneK, x) = x)
      AND normG(zeroG) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        0 <= normG(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        normG(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        normG(negG(x)) = normG(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        normG(addG(x, y)) <= normG(x) + normG(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: G):
        normG(smulG(a, x)) = normK(a) * normG(x))

  cauchy_E(sequence: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (m, n: nat):
          cutoff <= m AND cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            normE(subE(sequence(m), sequence(n))) < epsilon_value

  converges_E(sequence: e_sequence, limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (n: nat):
          cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            normE(subE(sequence(n), limit)) < epsilon_value

  complete_E: bool =
    FORALL (sequence: e_sequence):
      cauchy_E(sequence) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: E):
          converges_E(sequence, limit)

  cauchy_F(sequence: f_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (m, n: nat):
          cutoff <= m AND cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            normF(subF(sequence(m), sequence(n))) < epsilon_value

  converges_F(sequence: f_sequence, limit: F): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (n: nat):
          cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            normF(subF(sequence(n), limit)) < epsilon_value

  complete_F: bool =
    FORALL (sequence: f_sequence):
      cauchy_F(sequence) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: F):
          converges_F(sequence, limit)

  cauchy_G(sequence: g_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (m, n: nat):
          cutoff <= m AND cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            normG(subG(sequence(m), sequence(n))) < epsilon_value

  converges_G(sequence: g_sequence, limit: G): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (n: nat):
          cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            normG(subG(sequence(n), limit)) < epsilon_value

  complete_G: bool =
    FORALL (sequence: g_sequence):
      cauchy_G(sequence) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: G):
          converges_G(sequence, limit)

  continuous_linear_EF(linear_map: [E -> F]): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      linear_map(addE(x, y)) =
        addF(linear_map(x), linear_map(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        linear_map(smulE(a, x)) =
          smulF(a, linear_map(x)))
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        0 <= bound
          AND FORALL (x: E):
            normF(linear_map(x)) <= bound * normE(x)

  continuous_linear_EG(linear_map: [E -> G]): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      linear_map(addE(x, y)) =
        addG(linear_map(x), linear_map(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        linear_map(smulE(a, x)) =
          smulG(a, linear_map(x)))
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        0 <= bound
          AND FORALL (x: E):
            normG(linear_map(x)) <= bound * normE(x)

  has_strict_fderiv_left: bool =
    continuous_linear_EF(leftDeriv)
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (x, y: E):
            (normE(subE(x, pt)) < radius
              AND normE(subE(y, pt)) < radius)
            IMPLIES
              normF(
                subF(
                  subF(leftFun(x), leftFun(y)),
                  leftDeriv(subE(x, y))))
                <= epsilon_value * normE(subE(x, y))

  has_strict_fderiv_right: bool =
    continuous_linear_EG(rightDeriv)
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (x, y: E):
            (normE(subE(x, pt)) < radius
              AND normE(subE(y, pt)) < radius)
            IMPLIES
              normG(
                subG(
                  subG(rightFun(x), rightFun(y)),
                  rightDeriv(subE(x, y))))
                <= epsilon_value * normE(subE(x, y))

  left_derivative_surjective: bool =
    FORALL (y: F):
      EXISTS (x: E):
        leftDeriv(x) = y

  right_derivative_surjective: bool =
    FORALL (z: G):
      EXISTS (x: E):
        rightDeriv(x) = z

  derivative_kernels_complementary: bool =
    (FORALL (x: E):
      leftDeriv(x) = zeroF
        AND rightDeriv(x) = zeroG
      IMPLIES x = zeroE)
      AND FORALL (x: E):
        EXISTS (left_kernel_part, right_kernel_part: E):
          leftDeriv(left_kernel_part) = zeroF
            AND rightDeriv(right_kernel_part) = zeroG
            AND addE(left_kernel_part, right_kernel_part) = x

  open_E_set(S: e_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      S(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (y: E):
            normE(subE(y, x)) < radius IMPLIES S(y)

  open_FG_set(S: fg_set): bool =
    FORALL (p: fg_pair):
      S(p) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (q: fg_pair):
            pair_distance(q, p) < radius IMPLIES S(q)

  prodFun_continuous_on(S: e_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      S(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (radius: posreal):
            FORALL (y: E):
              S(y)
                AND normE(subE(y, x)) < radius
              IMPLIES
                pair_distance(prodFun(y), prodFun(x)) < epsilon_value

  implicit_continuous_on(
      candidate: implicit_function_type,
      T: fg_set): bool =
    FORALL (p: fg_pair):
      T(p) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (radius: posreal):
            FORALL (q: fg_pair):
              T(q)
                AND pair_distance(q, p) < radius
              IMPLIES
                normE(
                  subE(
                    apply_implicit(candidate, q),
                    apply_implicit(candidate, p)))
                  < epsilon_value

  is_local_implicit_inverse(
      candidate: implicit_function_type): bool =
    EXISTS (source: e_set), (target: fg_set):
      open_E_set(source)
        AND open_FG_set(target)
        AND source(pt)
        AND target(prodFun(pt))
        AND prodFun_continuous_on(source)
        AND implicit_continuous_on(candidate, target)
        AND (FORALL (x: E):
          source(x) IMPLIES
            target(prodFun(x))
              AND apply_implicit(candidate, prodFun(x)) = x)
        AND (FORALL (p: fg_pair):
          target(p) IMPLIES
            source(apply_implicit(candidate, p))
              AND prodFun(apply_implicit(candidate, p)) = p)

  implicitFunction: implicit_function_type =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (candidate: implicit_function_type):
        is_local_implicit_inverse(candidate))

  implicit_function_data: bool =
    nontrivially_normed_field
      AND normed_space_E
      AND normed_space_F
      AND normed_space_G
      AND complete_E
      AND complete_F
      AND complete_G
      AND has_strict_fderiv_left
      AND has_strict_fderiv_right
      AND left_derivative_surjective
      AND right_derivative_surjective
      AND derivative_kernels_complementary

  ImplicitFunctionData_implicitFunction: bool =
    implicit_function_data IMPLIES
      is_local_implicit_inverse(implicitFunction)
END Q848375_implicit_function_theorem

title: Q853067_solutions_to_pell_s_equation
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q853067
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q853067), "Solutions to Pell's equation": every
-- natural-number solution of x^2 - (a^2 - 1)y^2 = 1 for a > 1 occurs in the
-- recursively generated Pell sequence. This file contains no proof.

module

public section

namespace Pell

/-- The coefficient `a^2 - 1` in this family of Pell equations. -/
def d {a : Nat} (_a1 : 1 < a) : Nat :=
  a * a - 1

/-- The recursively generated pairs of natural-number Pell solutions. -/
def pell {a : Nat} (a1 : 1 < a) : Nat → Nat × Nat
  | 0 => (1, 0)
  | n + 1 =>
      ((pell a1 n).1 * a + d a1 * (pell a1 n).2,
        (pell a1 n).1 + (pell a1 n).2 * a)

/-- The first coordinate of the Pell sequence. -/
def xn {a : Nat} (a1 : 1 < a) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  (pell a1 n).1

/-- The second coordinate of the Pell sequence. -/
def yn {a : Nat} (a1 : 1 < a) (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  (pell a1 n).2

/-- Every natural-number solution is a member of the recursively generated Pell sequence. -/
theorem eq_pell {a : Nat} (a1 : 1 < a) {x y : Nat}
    (hp : x * x - d a1 * y * y = 1) :
    ∃ n, x = xn a1 n ∧ y = yn a1 n := sorry

end Pell

title: Q853067_solutions_to_pell_s_equation

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q853067
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q853067), "Solutions to Pell's equation": every
  natural-number solution of x^2 - (a^2 - 1)y^2 = 1 for a > 1 occurs in the
  recursively defined Pell sequence. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Module Pell.

Fixpoint pell
    (a : nat) (_a1 : (1 < a)%nat) (n : nat) : (nat * nat)%type :=
  match n with
  | O => (1, 0)
  | S m =>
      let '(x, y) := pell a _a1 m in
      (x * a + (a * a - 1) * y, x + y * a)
  end.

Definition xn
    (a : nat) (a1 : (1 < a)%nat) (n : nat) : nat :=
  fst (pell a a1 n).

Definition yn
    (a : nat) (a1 : (1 < a)%nat) (n : nat) : nat :=
  snd (pell a a1 n).

Theorem eq_pell :
  forall (a : nat) (a1 : (1 < a)%nat) (x y : nat),
    x * x - (a * a - 1) * y * y = 1 ->
    exists n : nat,
      x = xn a a1 n /\ y = yn a a1 n.
Admitted.

End Pell.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q853067
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q853067), "Solutions to Pell's equation":
  every natural-number solution for coefficient a squared minus one occurs
  in the recursively defined Pell sequence. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q853067_solutions_to_pell_s_equation
  imports Main
begin

fun q853067_pell :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<times> nat" where
  "q853067_pell a 0 = (1, 0)"
| "q853067_pell a (Suc n) =
    (fst (q853067_pell a n) * a +
       (a * a - 1) * snd (q853067_pell a n),
     fst (q853067_pell a n) +
       snd (q853067_pell a n) * a)"

definition q853067_xn :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q853067_xn a n = fst (q853067_pell a n)"

definition q853067_yn :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q853067_yn a n = snd (q853067_pell a n)"

theorem q853067_eq_pell:
  fixes a x y :: nat
  assumes "1 < a"
    and "x * x - (a * a - 1) * y * y = 1"
  shows "\<exists>n::nat. x = q853067_xn a n \<and> y = q853067_yn a n"
  sorry

end

title: Q853067_solutions_to_pell_s_equation

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q853067,
  "Solutions to Pell's equation": every natural-number solution of
  x^2 - (a^2 - 1)y^2 = 1 for a > 1 occurs in the recursively generated Pell
  sequence starting at (1,0). This file contains no proof.
*)

let q853067_pell_pair = new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
  `(q853067_pell_pair a 0 = (1,0)) /\
   (!n. q853067_pell_pair a (SUC n) =
        (FST (q853067_pell_pair a n) * a +
           (a * a - 1) * SND (q853067_pell_pair a n),
         FST (q853067_pell_pair a n) +
           SND (q853067_pell_pair a n) * a))`;;

let q853067_pell_x = new_definition
  `q853067_pell_x a n = FST (q853067_pell_pair a n)`;;

let q853067_pell_y = new_definition
  `q853067_pell_y a n = SND (q853067_pell_pair a n)`;;

let Q853067_SOLUTIONS_TO_PELLS_EQUATION =
  `!a x y:num.
     1 < a
     ==> x * x - (a * a - 1) * y * y = 1
     ==> ?n:num.
           x = q853067_pell_x a n /\
           y = q853067_pell_y a n`;;

title: Q853067_solutions_to_pell_s_equation
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q853067,
;; "Solutions to Pell's equation": for every natural a greater than one,
;; every natural solution of x^2 - (a^2 - 1)*y^2 = 1 is a pair in the
;; recursively generated Pell sequence beginning with (1,0).
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Lean's subtraction on natural numbers is truncated at zero.
(defun q853067-nat-sub (left right)
  (if (and (natp left)
           (natp right))
      (if (< left right)
          0
        (- left right))
    0))

(defun q853067-pell-pair (a n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (and (natp a)
           (natp n))
      (if (zp n)
          (cons 1 0)
        (let* ((previous
                (q853067-pell-pair a (- n 1)))
               (previous-x (car previous))
               (previous-y (cdr previous))
               (d (q853067-nat-sub (* a a) 1)))
          (cons
           (+ (* previous-x a)
              (* d previous-y))
           (+ previous-x
              (* previous-y a)))))
    (cons 0 0)))

(defun-sk q853067-pell-index-exists-p (a x y)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (let ((pair (q853067-pell-pair a n)))
       (and
        (equal x (car pair))
        (equal y (cdr pair)))))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q853067-solutions-to-pell-s-equation-statement
    (a x y)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp a)
    (natp x)
    (natp y)
    (< 1 a)
    (equal
     (q853067-nat-sub
      (* x x)
      (* (q853067-nat-sub (* a a) 1)
         (* y y)))
     1))
   (q853067-pell-index-exists-p a x y)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q853067_solutions_to_pell_s_equation
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q853067
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q853067), "Solutions to Pell's equation": every
-- natural solution of the Pell equation with parameter a * a - 1 is generated
-- by the recursive Pell sequence. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q853067_solutions_to_pell_s_equation where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=_ _<_
infixr 3 _and_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n =
  suc m <= n

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

natSub : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
natSub n zero =
  n
natSub zero (suc n) =
  zero
natSub (suc m) (suc n) =
  natSub m n

record NatPair : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    pairX : Nat
    pairY : Nat

open NatPair

d : (a : Nat) -> one < a -> Nat
d a a1 =
  natSub (a * a) one

pell : (a : Nat) -> (a1 : one < a) -> Nat -> NatPair
pell a a1 zero =
  pair one zero
pell a a1 (suc n) with pell a a1 n
... | pair x y =
  pair
    (x * a + d a a1 * y)
    (x + y * a)

xn : (a : Nat) -> one < a -> Nat -> Nat
xn a a1 n =
  pairX (pell a a1 n)

yn : (a : Nat) -> one < a -> Nat -> Nat
yn a a1 n =
  pairY (pell a a1 n)

PellEquation : (a : Nat) -> one < a -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
PellEquation a a1 x y =
  natSub (x * x) (d a a1 * y * y) == one

SolutionsToPellsEquation : Set
SolutionsToPellsEquation =
  (a : Nat) ->
  (a1 : one < a) ->
  (x y : Nat) ->
  PellEquation a a1 x y ->
  Exists Nat
    (λ n ->
      (x == xn a a1 n) and
      (y == yn a a1 n))

title: Q853067_solutions_to_pell_s_equation
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q853067, "Solutions to Pell's equation": every natural-number solution of
  x^2 - (a^2 - 1)y^2 = 1 for a > 1 occurs in the recursively defined Pell
  sequence starting at (1,0). This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory;

val q853067_pell_def = Define`
  (q853067_pell (a : num) 0 = (1, 0)) /\
  (q853067_pell a (SUC n) =
     (FST (q853067_pell a n) * a +
        (a * a - 1) * SND (q853067_pell a n),
      FST (q853067_pell a n) +
        SND (q853067_pell a n) * a))`;

val q853067_xn_def = new_definition (
  "q853067_xn_def",
  ``q853067_xn (a : num) (n : num) = FST (q853067_pell a n)``);

val q853067_yn_def = new_definition (
  "q853067_yn_def",
  ``q853067_yn (a : num) (n : num) = SND (q853067_pell a n)``);

val solutions_to_pell_s_equation =
  ``!a x y : num.
      1 < a
      ==>
      x * x - (a * a - 1) * y * y = 1
      ==>
      ?n : num.
        x = q853067_xn a n /\
        y = q853067_yn a n``;

title: Q853067_solutions_to_pell_s_equation
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q853067
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q853067), "Solutions to Pell's equation":
  every natural-number solution of x^2 - (a^2 - 1)y^2 = 1 for a > 1 occurs
  in the Pell sequence recursively generated from (1,0). This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The source's proof-valued parameter a1 : 1 < a is represented by the
  antecedent 1 < a. For the internally existential index n, the functions f
  and g on 0 ... n are the finite graphs of Pell.xn and Pell.yn. Their initial
  values, mutual recurrence, and endpoint equalities exactly expand the Lean
  definitions. Existence of these finite graphs is bidirectionally equivalent
  to membership in the source's recursively defined Pell sequence.

  Q853067NatSub is Lean's truncated subtraction on natural numbers, used both
  in d = a*a-1 and in the Pell equation. All quantified values are in NN0.
  The auxiliary $a declarations are syntax and a faithful definition only.
  The final $a assertion is unproved, and this database contains no $p proof
  statement.
$)

$c Q853067NatSub $.

q853067-nat-sub-syntax
  $a class ( Q853067NatSub A B ) $.

q853067-nat-sub-definition $a |- (
  Q853067NatSub A B
) = if (
  A < B ,
  0 ,
  ( A - B )
) $.

${
  $d a f g n k x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q853067-solutions-to-pell-equation $a |-
    A. a e. NN0
      A. x e. NN0
        A. y e. NN0
          (
            (
              1 < a
              /\
              (
                Q853067NatSub
                  ( x x. x )
                  (
                    (
                      ( Q853067NatSub ( a x. a ) 1 )
                      x.
                      y
                    )
                    x.
                    y
                  )
                =
                1
              )
            )
            ->
            E. n e. NN0
              E. f e. ( NN0 ^m ( 0 ... n ) )
                E. g e. ( NN0 ^m ( 0 ... n ) )
                  (
                    (
                      (
                        ( f ` 0 ) = 1
                        /\
                        ( g ` 0 ) = 0
                      )
                      /\
                      A. k e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                        (
                          (
                            f ` ( k + 1 )
                          )
                          =
                          (
                            (
                              ( f ` k )
                              x.
                              a
                            )
                            +
                            (
                              ( Q853067NatSub ( a x. a ) 1 )
                              x.
                              ( g ` k )
                            )
                          )
                          /\
                          (
                            g ` ( k + 1 )
                          )
                          =
                          (
                            ( f ` k )
                            +
                            (
                              ( g ` k )
                              x.
                              a
                            )
                          )
                        )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( f ` n ) = x
                      /\
                      ( g ` n ) = y
                    )
                  )
          )
  $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q853067

:: every natural solution for parameter a^2 - 1 occurs in the Pell sequence
:: recursively generated from (1,0). This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      NUMBERS, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3,
      SQUARE_1, REAL_1, INT_1, INT_2, NAT_1, VALUED_1, NEWTON;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1,
      INT_2, COMPLEX1, SQUARE_1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NEWTON, NAT_D;
 constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, REAL_1, SQUARE_1, COMPLEX1,
      INT_1, INT_2, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NEWTON, NAT_D;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
      XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, SQUARE_1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, NEWTON;
 requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for a,x,y being Nat st
    1 < a &
    x * x -' ((a * a -' 1) * y * y) = 1
  holds
    ex X,Y being Function of NAT,NAT st
      X.0 = 1 & Y.0 = 0 &
      (for m being Nat holds
        X.(m + 1) = X.m * a + (a * a -' 1) * Y.m &
        Y.(m + 1) = X.m + Y.m * a) &
      ex n being Nat st X.n = x & Y.n = y
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q853067_solutions_to_pell_s_equation
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q853067
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q853067), "Solutions to Pell's equation": for each
% natural a greater than one, every natural solution of
% x^2 - (a^2 - 1)y^2 = 1 occurs in the recursively generated Pell sequence.
% This file contains no proof.

Q853067_solutions_to_pell_s_equation: THEORY
BEGIN
  pell_pair: TYPE = [# x_coord: nat, y_coord: nat #]

  nat_sub(left, right: nat): nat =
    IF right <= left THEN
      left - right
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  pell(a, n: nat): RECURSIVE pell_pair =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      (# x_coord := 1, y_coord := 0 #)
    ELSE
      LET previous: pell_pair = pell(a, n - 1) IN
        LET d: nat = nat_sub(a * a, 1) IN
          (# x_coord :=
               x_coord(previous) * a + d * y_coord(previous),
             y_coord :=
               x_coord(previous) + y_coord(previous) * a #)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  solutions_to_pell_s_equation: bool =
    FORALL (a, x, y: nat):
      a > 1 IMPLIES
        (nat_sub(x * x, nat_sub(a * a, 1) * y * y) = 1
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (n: nat):
              x = x_coord(pell(a, n))
                AND y = y_coord(pell(a, n)))
END Q853067_solutions_to_pell_s_equation
