title: Q859122_cauchy_hadamard_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q859122
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q859122), "Cauchy–Hadamard theorem": for a
  formal multilinear series over arbitrary normed spaces, the inverse of its
  extended-nonnegative convergence radius is the limsup of the nth roots of
  its coefficient operator norms. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q859122_nontrivially_normed_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q859122_kzero : K;
  q859122_kone : K;
  q859122_kadd : K -> K -> K;
  q859122_kmul : K -> K -> K;
  q859122_kneg : K -> K;
  q859122_kinv : K -> K;
  q859122_knorm : K -> R;
  q859122_kzero_ne_one :
    q859122_kzero <> q859122_kone;
  q859122_kadd_assoc :
    forall a b c : K,
      q859122_kadd a (q859122_kadd b c) =
      q859122_kadd (q859122_kadd a b) c;
  q859122_kadd_comm :
    forall a b : K, q859122_kadd a b = q859122_kadd b a;
  q859122_kadd_zero :
    forall a : K, q859122_kadd a q859122_kzero = a;
  q859122_kadd_neg :
    forall a : K, q859122_kadd a (q859122_kneg a) = q859122_kzero;
  q859122_kmul_assoc :
    forall a b c : K,
      q859122_kmul a (q859122_kmul b c) =
      q859122_kmul (q859122_kmul a b) c;
  q859122_kmul_comm :
    forall a b : K, q859122_kmul a b = q859122_kmul b a;
  q859122_kmul_one :
    forall a : K, q859122_kmul a q859122_kone = a;
  q859122_kmul_inv :
    forall a : K,
      a <> q859122_kzero ->
      q859122_kmul a (q859122_kinv a) = q859122_kone;
  q859122_kinv_zero :
    q859122_kinv q859122_kzero = q859122_kzero;
  q859122_kmul_add :
    forall a b c : K,
      q859122_kmul a (q859122_kadd b c) =
      q859122_kadd (q859122_kmul a b) (q859122_kmul a c);
  q859122_knorm_nonnegative :
    forall a : K, 0 <= q859122_knorm a;
  q859122_knorm_eq_zero :
    forall a : K, q859122_knorm a = 0 <-> a = q859122_kzero;
  q859122_knorm_add_le :
    forall a b : K,
      q859122_knorm (q859122_kadd a b) <=
      q859122_knorm a + q859122_knorm b;
  q859122_knorm_mul :
    forall a b : K,
      q859122_knorm (q859122_kmul a b) =
      q859122_knorm a * q859122_knorm b;
  q859122_knorm_nontrivial :
    exists a : K, 1 < q859122_knorm a
}.

Arguments q859122_kzero {K} _.
Arguments q859122_kone {K} _.
Arguments q859122_kadd {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q859122_kmul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q859122_kneg {K} _ _.
Arguments q859122_kinv {K} _ _.
Arguments q859122_knorm {K} _ _.

Record q859122_normed_add_comm_group (E : Type) : Type := {
  q859122_vzero : E;
  q859122_vadd : E -> E -> E;
  q859122_vneg : E -> E;
  q859122_vnorm : E -> R;
  q859122_vadd_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q859122_vadd x (q859122_vadd y z) =
      q859122_vadd (q859122_vadd x y) z;
  q859122_vadd_comm :
    forall x y : E, q859122_vadd x y = q859122_vadd y x;
  q859122_vadd_zero :
    forall x : E, q859122_vadd x q859122_vzero = x;
  q859122_vadd_neg :
    forall x : E, q859122_vadd x (q859122_vneg x) = q859122_vzero;
  q859122_vnorm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q859122_vnorm x;
  q859122_vnorm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E, q859122_vnorm x = 0 <-> x = q859122_vzero;
  q859122_vnorm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q859122_vnorm (q859122_vadd x y) <=
      q859122_vnorm x + q859122_vnorm y;
  q859122_vnorm_neg :
    forall x : E, q859122_vnorm (q859122_vneg x) = q859122_vnorm x
}.

Arguments q859122_vzero {E} _.
Arguments q859122_vadd {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q859122_vneg {E} _ _.
Arguments q859122_vnorm {E} _ _.

Record q859122_normed_space
    (K E : Type)
    (KF : q859122_nontrivially_normed_field K)
    (NE : q859122_normed_add_comm_group E) : Type := {
  q859122_smul : K -> E -> E;
  q859122_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q859122_smul (q859122_kone KF) x = x;
  q859122_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q859122_smul (q859122_kmul KF a b) x =
      q859122_smul a (q859122_smul b x);
  q859122_add_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q859122_smul (q859122_kadd KF a b) x =
      q859122_vadd NE (q859122_smul a x) (q859122_smul b x);
  q859122_smul_add :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q859122_smul a (q859122_vadd NE x y) =
      q859122_vadd NE (q859122_smul a x) (q859122_smul a y);
  q859122_zero_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q859122_smul (q859122_kzero KF) x = q859122_vzero NE;
  q859122_smul_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q859122_smul a (q859122_vzero NE) = q859122_vzero NE;
  q859122_norm_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : E),
      q859122_vnorm NE (q859122_smul a x) =
      q859122_knorm KF a * q859122_vnorm NE x
}.

Arguments q859122_smul {K E KF NE} _ _ _.

Definition q859122_replace
    {A : Type} {n : nat}
    (x : Fin.t n -> A) (i : Fin.t n) (a : A) : Fin.t n -> A :=
  fun j =>
    if Fin.eq_dec j i then a else x j.

Fixpoint q859122_input_norm_product
    {E : Type}
    (NE : q859122_normed_add_comm_group E)
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> E) -> R :=
  match n as k return (Fin.t k -> E) -> R with
  | O => fun _ => 1
  | S k =>
      fun x =>
        q859122_vnorm NE (x Fin.F1) *
        @q859122_input_norm_product E NE k
          (fun i : Fin.t k => x (Fin.FS i))
  end.

Record q859122_continuous_multilinear_map
    (K E F : Type)
    (KF : q859122_nontrivially_normed_field K)
    (NE : q859122_normed_add_comm_group E)
    (NF : q859122_normed_add_comm_group F)
    (VE : @q859122_normed_space K E KF NE)
    (VF : @q859122_normed_space K F KF NF)
    (n : nat) : Type := {
  q859122_map_apply : (Fin.t n -> E) -> F;
  q859122_map_add :
    forall (x : Fin.t n -> E) (i : Fin.t n) (a b : E),
      q859122_map_apply
        (q859122_replace x i (q859122_vadd NE a b)) =
      q859122_vadd NF
        (q859122_map_apply (q859122_replace x i a))
        (q859122_map_apply (q859122_replace x i b));
  q859122_map_smul :
    forall (x : Fin.t n -> E) (i : Fin.t n) (a : K) (v : E),
      q859122_map_apply
        (q859122_replace x i (q859122_smul VE a v)) =
      q859122_smul VF a
        (q859122_map_apply (q859122_replace x i v));
  q859122_operator_norm : R;
  q859122_operator_norm_nonnegative :
    0 <= q859122_operator_norm;
  q859122_le_operator_norm :
    forall x : Fin.t n -> E,
      q859122_vnorm NF (q859122_map_apply x) <=
      q859122_operator_norm *
      @q859122_input_norm_product E NE n x;
  q859122_operator_norm_least :
    forall C : R,
      0 <= C ->
      (forall x : Fin.t n -> E,
        q859122_vnorm NF (q859122_map_apply x) <=
        C * @q859122_input_norm_product E NE n x) ->
      q859122_operator_norm <= C
}.

Arguments q859122_map_apply
  {K E F KF NE NF VE VF n} _ _.
Arguments q859122_operator_norm
  {K E F KF NE NF VE VF n} _.
Arguments q859122_operator_norm_nonnegative
  {K E F KF NE NF VE VF n} _.

Definition q859122_formal_multilinear_series
    (K E F : Type)
    (KF : q859122_nontrivially_normed_field K)
    (NE : q859122_normed_add_comm_group E)
    (NF : q859122_normed_add_comm_group F)
    (VE : @q859122_normed_space K E KF NE)
    (VF : @q859122_normed_space K F KF NF) : Type :=
  forall n : nat,
    @q859122_continuous_multilinear_map K E F KF NE NF VE VF n.

Definition q859122_nnreal : Type :=
  {x : R | 0 <= x}.

Definition q859122_nnreal_value
    (x : q859122_nnreal) : R :=
  proj1_sig x.

Definition q859122_nnreal_zero : q859122_nnreal :=
  exist (fun x : R => 0 <= x) 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q859122_nnreal_one : q859122_nnreal :=
  exist (fun x : R => 0 <= x) 1 Rle_0_1.

Definition q859122_nth_root
    (x : q859122_nnreal) (n : nat) : q859122_nnreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q859122_nnreal_one
  | S k =>
      if Req_EM_T (q859122_nnreal_value x) 0 then
        q859122_nnreal_zero
      else
        exist
          (fun y : R => 0 <= y)
          (exp
            (ln (q859122_nnreal_value x) /
             INR (S k)))
          (Rlt_le 0
            (exp
              (ln (q859122_nnreal_value x) /
               INR (S k)))
            (exp_pos
              (ln (q859122_nnreal_value x) /
               INR (S k))))
  end.

Inductive q859122_ennreal : Type :=
| q859122_ennreal_finite :
    q859122_nnreal -> q859122_ennreal
| q859122_ennreal_infinity :
    q859122_ennreal.

Definition q859122_ennreal_zero : q859122_ennreal :=
  q859122_ennreal_finite q859122_nnreal_zero.

Definition q859122_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q859122_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q859122_ennreal_finite a,
    q859122_ennreal_finite b =>
      q859122_nnreal_value a = q859122_nnreal_value b
  | q859122_ennreal_infinity,
    q859122_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q859122_ennreal_le
    (x y : q859122_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q859122_ennreal_finite a,
    q859122_ennreal_finite b =>
      q859122_nnreal_value a <= q859122_nnreal_value b
  | q859122_ennreal_finite _,
    q859122_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q859122_ennreal_infinity,
    q859122_ennreal_finite _ => False
  | q859122_ennreal_infinity,
    q859122_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q859122_ennreal_inverse
    (x y : q859122_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q859122_ennreal_infinity =>
      q859122_ennreal_eq y q859122_ennreal_zero
  | q859122_ennreal_finite a =>
      if Req_EM_T (q859122_nnreal_value a) 0 then
        q859122_ennreal_eq y q859122_ennreal_infinity
      else
        match y with
        | q859122_ennreal_finite b =>
            q859122_nnreal_value b =
            / q859122_nnreal_value a
        | q859122_ennreal_infinity => False
        end
  end.

Definition q859122_is_supremum
    (S : q859122_ennreal -> Prop)
    (supremum : q859122_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall x : q859122_ennreal,
    S x -> q859122_ennreal_le x supremum) /\
  (forall upper : q859122_ennreal,
    (forall x : q859122_ennreal,
      S x -> q859122_ennreal_le x upper) ->
    q859122_ennreal_le supremum upper).

Definition q859122_is_infimum
    (S : q859122_ennreal -> Prop)
    (infimum : q859122_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall x : q859122_ennreal,
    S x -> q859122_ennreal_le infimum x) /\
  (forall lower : q859122_ennreal,
    (forall x : q859122_ennreal,
      S x -> q859122_ennreal_le lower x) ->
    q859122_ennreal_le lower infimum).

Definition q859122_coefficient_norm
    {K E F : Type}
    {KF : q859122_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    {NE : q859122_normed_add_comm_group E}
    {NF : q859122_normed_add_comm_group F}
    {VE : @q859122_normed_space K E KF NE}
    {VF : @q859122_normed_space K F KF NF}
    (p : @q859122_formal_multilinear_series K E F KF NE NF VE VF)
    (n : nat) : q859122_nnreal :=
  exist
    (fun x : R => 0 <= x)
    (q859122_operator_norm (p n))
    (q859122_operator_norm_nonnegative (p n)).

Definition q859122_radius_candidate
    {K E F : Type}
    {KF : q859122_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    {NE : q859122_normed_add_comm_group E}
    {NF : q859122_normed_add_comm_group F}
    {VE : @q859122_normed_space K E KF NE}
    {VF : @q859122_normed_space K F KF NF}
    (p : @q859122_formal_multilinear_series K E F KF NE NF VE VF)
    (r : q859122_nnreal) : Prop :=
  exists C : R,
    forall n : nat,
      q859122_nnreal_value (q859122_coefficient_norm p n) *
      (q859122_nnreal_value r) ^ n <= C.

Definition q859122_radius_is
    {K E F : Type}
    {KF : q859122_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    {NE : q859122_normed_add_comm_group E}
    {NF : q859122_normed_add_comm_group F}
    {VE : @q859122_normed_space K E KF NE}
    {VF : @q859122_normed_space K F KF NF}
    (p : @q859122_formal_multilinear_series K E F KF NE NF VE VF)
    (radius : q859122_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q859122_is_supremum
    (fun value : q859122_ennreal =>
      exists r : q859122_nnreal,
        q859122_ennreal_eq value
          (q859122_ennreal_finite r) /\
        q859122_radius_candidate p r)
    radius.

Definition q859122_root_norm_sequence
    {K E F : Type}
    {KF : q859122_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    {NE : q859122_normed_add_comm_group E}
    {NF : q859122_normed_add_comm_group F}
    {VE : @q859122_normed_space K E KF NE}
    {VF : @q859122_normed_space K F KF NF}
    (p : @q859122_formal_multilinear_series K E F KF NE NF VE VF)
    (n : nat) : q859122_ennreal :=
  q859122_ennreal_finite
    (q859122_nth_root (q859122_coefficient_norm p n) n).

Definition q859122_limsup_at_top_is
    (u : nat -> q859122_ennreal)
    (limit : q859122_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists tail_supremum : nat -> q859122_ennreal,
    (forall N : nat,
      q859122_is_supremum
        (fun value : q859122_ennreal =>
          exists n : nat,
            (N <= n)%nat /\
            q859122_ennreal_eq value (u n))
        (tail_supremum N)) /\
    q859122_is_infimum
      (fun value : q859122_ennreal =>
        exists N : nat,
          q859122_ennreal_eq value (tail_supremum N))
      limit.

Theorem FormalMultilinearSeries_radius_inv_eq_limsup :
  forall
    (K E F : Type)
    (KF : q859122_nontrivially_normed_field K)
    (NE : q859122_normed_add_comm_group E)
    (NF : q859122_normed_add_comm_group F)
    (VE : @q859122_normed_space K E KF NE)
    (VF : @q859122_normed_space K F KF NF)
    (p : @q859122_formal_multilinear_series K E F KF NE NF VE VF)
    (radius limsup_value : q859122_ennreal),
    q859122_radius_is p radius ->
    q859122_limsup_at_top_is
      (q859122_root_norm_sequence p) limsup_value ->
    q859122_ennreal_inverse radius limsup_value.
Admitted.

title: Q859122_cauchy_hadamard_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q859122 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q859122),
  "Cauchy–Hadamard theorem": for a formal multilinear series over an arbitrary
  nontrivially normed field, the inverse of its convergence radius is the
  limsup of the nth roots of its coefficient operator norms. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q859122_cauchy_hadamard_theorem
  imports "HOL-Library.Extended_Nonnegative_Real"
begin

definition q859122_nontrivially_normed_field ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q859122_nontrivially_normed_field knorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    knorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>a. 0 \<le> knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm a = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> a = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm (-a) = knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a + b) \<le> knorm a + knorm b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a * b) = knorm a * knorm b) \<and>
    (\<exists>a. 1 < knorm a)"

definition q859122_normed_space ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q859122_normed_space knorm enorm scale \<longleftrightarrow>
    enorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm (-x) = enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. enorm (x + y) \<le> enorm x + enorm y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. scale a (x + y) = scale a x + scale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a + b) x = scale a x + scale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a * b) x = scale a (scale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. scale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. enorm (scale a x) = knorm a * enorm x)"

definition q859122_continuous_multilinear ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow>
      ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e list \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q859122_continuous_multilinear n enorm fnorm escale fscale A
      \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>xs i u v.
      length xs = n \<longrightarrow> i < n \<longrightarrow>
      A (xs[i := u + v]) = A (xs[i := u]) + A (xs[i := v])) \<and>
    (\<forall>xs i a u.
      length xs = n \<longrightarrow> i < n \<longrightarrow>
      A (xs[i := escale a u]) = fscale a (A (xs[i := u]))) \<and>
    (\<exists>C\<ge>0. \<forall>xs. length xs = n \<longrightarrow>
      fnorm (A xs) \<le> C * (\<Prod>i<n. enorm (xs ! i)))"

definition q859122_multilinear_operator_norm ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow>
      ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e list \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q859122_multilinear_operator_norm n enorm fnorm A =
    Inf {C. 0 \<le> C \<and> (\<forall>xs. length xs = n \<longrightarrow>
      fnorm (A xs) \<le> C * (\<Prod>i<n. enorm (xs ! i)))}"

definition q859122_radius ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'e list \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> ennreal" where
  "q859122_radius enorm fnorm A =
    Sup ((\<lambda>r::real. ennreal r) `
      {r. 0 \<le> r \<and> (\<exists>C::real. \<forall>n.
        q859122_multilinear_operator_norm n enorm fnorm (A n) * r ^ n
          \<le> C)})"

definition q859122_root_coefficient :: "real \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> ennreal" where
  "q859122_root_coefficient x n =
    ennreal (if n = 0 then 1 else x powr (1 / real n))"

theorem q859122_cauchy_hadamard:
  fixes knorm :: "'k::field \<Rightarrow> real"
    and enorm :: "'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and fnorm :: "'f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and escale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and fscale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and A :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'e list \<Rightarrow> 'f"
  assumes scalar_field: "q859122_nontrivially_normed_field knorm"
    and domain_space: "q859122_normed_space knorm enorm escale"
    and codomain_space: "q859122_normed_space knorm fnorm fscale"
    and formal_multilinear_series:
      "\<forall>n. q859122_continuous_multilinear
        n enorm fnorm escale fscale (A n)"
  shows
    "inverse (q859122_radius enorm fnorm A) =
      limsup (\<lambda>n.
        q859122_root_coefficient
          (q859122_multilinear_operator_norm n enorm fnorm (A n)) n)"
  sorry

end

title: Q859122_cauchy_hadamard_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q859122
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q859122), "Cauchy-Hadamard theorem": for a
  formal multilinear series over an arbitrary nontrivially normed field, the
  inverse of its convergence radius is the extended-nonnegative limsup of the
  nth roots of its coefficient operator norms. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q859122_CAUCHY_HADAMARD_THEOREM =
 `let nontrivially_normed_field =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A)
     (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (negK:A->A) (invK:A->A) (normK:A->real).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:A. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:A. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK zeroK a = zeroK) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:A. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       normK zeroK = &0 /\
       (!a:A. &0 <= normK a) /\
       (!a:A. normK a = &0 <=> a = zeroK) /\
       (!a:A. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\
       (!a b:A. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
       (!a b:A. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
       (?a:A. &1 < normK a) in
  let normed_add_comm_group =
    \(zero:B) (add:B->B->B) (neg:B->B) (norm:B->real).
       (!x y z:B. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:B. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:B. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:B. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       norm zero = &0 /\
       (!x:B. &0 <= norm x) /\
       (!x:B. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
       (!x:B. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
       (!x y:B. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
  let normed_add_comm_group' =
    \(zero:C) (add:C->C->C) (neg:C->C) (norm:C->real).
       (!x y z:C. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:C. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:C. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:C. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       norm zero = &0 /\
       (!x:C. &0 <= norm x) /\
       (!x:C. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
       (!x:C. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
       (!x y:C. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
  let normed_space =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (normK:A->real) (zero:B) (add:B->B->B) (norm:B->real)
     (smul:A->B->B).
       (!x:B. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (addK a b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:A. !x y:B.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a:A. smul a zero = zero) /\
       (!x:B. smul zeroK x = zero) /\
       (!a:A. !x:B. norm (smul a x) = normK a * norm x) in
  let normed_space' =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (normK:A->real) (zero:C) (add:C->C->C) (norm:C->real)
     (smul:A->C->C).
       (!x:C. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:C.
          smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:C.
          smul (addK a b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:A. !x y:C.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a:A. smul a zero = zero) /\
       (!x:C. smul zeroK x = zero) /\
       (!a:A. !x:C. norm (smul a x) = normK a * norm x) in
  let coordinate_extensional =
    \(q:(num->B)->C) (n:num).
       !x y:num->B.
         (!i:num. i < n ==> x i = y i) ==> q x = q y in
  let multilinear =
    \(addE:B->B->B) (smulE:A->B->B)
     (addF:C->C->C) (smulF:A->C->C)
     (q:(num->B)->C) (n:num).
       (!x:num->B i:num u v:B.
          i < n
          ==> q (\j. if j = i then addE u v else x j) =
              addF
                (q (\j. if j = i then u else x j))
                (q (\j. if j = i then v else x j))) /\
       (!x:num->B i:num a:A u:B.
          i < n
          ==> q (\j. if j = i then smulE a u else x j) =
              smulF a (q (\j. if j = i then u else x j))) in
  let operator_bound =
    \(normE:B->real) (normF:C->real)
     (q:(num->B)->C) (n:num) (M:real).
      !x:num->B.
        normF (q x) <=
        M * product {i:num | i < n} (\i. normE (x i)) in
  let formal_multilinear_series =
    \(addE:B->B->B) (smulE:A->B->B) (normE:B->real)
     (addF:C->C->C) (smulF:A->C->C) (normF:C->real)
     (p:num->(num->B)->C).
       !n:num.
         coordinate_extensional (p n) n /\
         multilinear addE smulE addF smulF (p n) n /\
         ?M:real.
           &0 <= M /\ operator_bound normE normF (p n) n M in
  let operator_norm =
    \(normE:B->real) (normF:C->real)
     (p:num->(num->B)->C) (n:num).
       @r:real.
         &0 <= r /\
         operator_bound normE normF (p n) n r /\
         (!M:real.
            &0 <= M /\ operator_bound normE normF (p n) n M
            ==> r <= M) in
  let enonnegative =
    \(z:bool#real).
       (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
       (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
  let ele =
    \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
       FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
  let esupremum =
    \(s:(bool#real)->bool) (z:bool#real).
       enonnegative z /\
       (!x:bool#real. s x ==> enonnegative x /\ ele x z) /\
       (!w:bool#real.
          enonnegative w /\
          (!x:bool#real. s x ==> ele x w)
          ==> ele z w) in
  let einfimum =
    \(s:(bool#real)->bool) (z:bool#real).
       enonnegative z /\
       (!x:bool#real. s x ==> enonnegative x /\ ele z x) /\
       (!w:bool#real.
          enonnegative w /\
          (!x:bool#real. s x ==> ele w x)
          ==> ele w z) in
  let einverse =
    \(z:bool#real).
       if FST z then (F,&0)
       else if SND z = &0 then (T,&0)
       else (F,inv(SND z)) in
  let radius_value =
    \(normE:B->real) (normF:C->real)
     (p:num->(num->B)->C) (radius:bool#real).
       esupremum
         (\z:bool#real.
            ?r:real.
              z = (F,r) /\
              &0 <= r /\
              ?M:real.
                !n:num.
                  operator_norm normE normF p n * r pow n <= M)
         radius in
  let nth_root =
    \(c:real) (n:num).
       if n = 0 then &1
       else @x:real. &0 <= x /\ x pow n = c in
  let extended_limsup =
    \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
       einfimum
         (\b:bool#real.
            enonnegative b /\
            ?N:num. !n:num. N <= n ==> ele (u n) b)
         z in
  !zeroK oneK:A.
  !addK mulK:A->A->A.
  !negK invK:A->A.
  !normK:A->real.
  !zeroE:B.
  !addE:B->B->B.
  !negE:B->B.
  !smulE:A->B->B.
  !normE:B->real.
  !zeroF:C.
  !addF:C->C->C.
  !negF:C->C.
  !smulF:A->C->C.
  !normF:C->real.
  !p:num->(num->B)->C.
    nontrivially_normed_field
      zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
    normed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
    normed_add_comm_group' zeroF addF negF normF /\
    normed_space
      zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroE addE normE smulE /\
    normed_space'
      zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroF addF normF smulF /\
    formal_multilinear_series
      addE smulE normE addF smulF normF p
    ==>
    !radius limsup:bool#real.
      radius_value normE normF p radius /\
      extended_limsup
        (\n:num.
           (F,nth_root (operator_norm normE normF p n) n))
        limsup
      ==> einverse radius = limsup`;;

title: Q859122_cauchy_hadamard_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q859122,
;; "Cauchy–Hadamard theorem": the inverse bounded-growth radius of the
;; coefficient norms of a formal multilinear series equals the extended-real
;; limsup of their nth roots. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The source theorem observes a formal multilinear series only through the
;; nonnegative real sequence n |-> ||p_n||.  This file uses that norm profile
;; as the series representation.  The representation is bidirectionally
;; faithful: every source series supplies such a profile, and every
;; nonnegative real sequence (a_n) is realized over R by the scalar
;; n-multilinear maps (x_1,...,x_n) |-> a_n * product_i x_i (with the
;; corresponding constant map at n = 0).
;;
;; Ordinary ACL2 has no primitive real or extended-nonnegative-real sorts.
;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents R, arbitrary sequences and sets
;; are APPLY$ function objects, and extended nonnegative reals are represented
;; exactly by either a tagged nonnegative real or a distinguished top value.

(defstub q859122-real-p (real-type value) t)
(defstub q859122-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub q859122-one (real-type) t)
(defstub q859122-add (real-type left right) t)
(defstub q859122-multiply (real-type left right) t)
(defstub q859122-negate (real-type value) t)
(defstub q859122-inverse (real-type value) t)
(defstub q859122-less (real-type left right) t)

(defun q859122-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (q859122-less real-type right left)))

(defun q859122-nonnegative-p (real-type value)
  (and
   (q859122-real-p real-type value)
   (q859122-leq real-type (q859122-zero real-type) value)))

(defun q859122-positive-p (real-type value)
  (and
   (q859122-real-p real-type value)
   (q859122-less real-type (q859122-zero real-type) value)))

(defun q859122-real-power (real-type base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q859122-one real-type)
    (q859122-multiply
     real-type
     base
     (q859122-real-power real-type base (1- exponent)))))

(defun-sk q859122-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q859122-real-p real-type x)
      (q859122-real-p real-type y)
      (q859122-real-p real-type z))
     (let* ((zero (q859122-zero real-type))
            (one (q859122-one real-type))
            (x-plus-y (q859122-add real-type x y))
            (y-plus-z (q859122-add real-type y z))
            (x-times-y (q859122-multiply real-type x y))
            (y-times-z (q859122-multiply real-type y z))
            (minus-x (q859122-negate real-type x))
            (inverse-x (q859122-inverse real-type x)))
       (and
        (q859122-real-p real-type x-plus-y)
        (q859122-real-p real-type x-times-y)
        (q859122-real-p real-type minus-x)
        (q859122-real-p real-type inverse-x)
        (equal
         (q859122-add real-type x-plus-y z)
         (q859122-add real-type x y-plus-z))
        (equal x-plus-y (q859122-add real-type y x))
        (equal (q859122-add real-type x zero) x)
        (equal (q859122-add real-type x minus-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q859122-multiply real-type x-times-y z)
         (q859122-multiply real-type x y-times-z))
        (equal x-times-y (q859122-multiply real-type y x))
        (equal (q859122-multiply real-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q859122-multiply real-type x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q859122-multiply real-type x y-plus-z)
         (q859122-add
          real-type
          (q859122-multiply real-type x y)
          (q859122-multiply real-type x z))))))))

(defun-sk q859122-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q859122-real-p real-type x)
      (q859122-real-p real-type y)
      (q859122-real-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (q859122-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (q859122-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (q859122-less real-type x y)
         (equal x y)
         (q859122-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q859122-less real-type x y)
          (q859122-less real-type y z))
         (q859122-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (q859122-less real-type x y)
         (q859122-less
          real-type
          (q859122-add real-type x z)
          (q859122-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q859122-less real-type zero x)
          (q859122-less real-type zero y))
         (q859122-less
          real-type
          zero
          (q859122-multiply real-type x y))))))))

(defun q859122-set-member-p (set value)
  (if (apply$ set (list value)) t nil))

(defun-sk q859122-set-nonempty-p (real-type set)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (q859122-real-p real-type value)
     (q859122-set-member-p set value))))

(defun-sk q859122-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set bound)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (q859122-real-p real-type value)
      (q859122-set-member-p set value))
     (q859122-leq real-type value bound))))

(defun-sk q859122-bounded-above-p (real-type set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q859122-real-p real-type bound)
     (q859122-upper-bound-p real-type set bound))))

(defun-sk q859122-supremum-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q859122-real-p real-type bound)
      (q859122-upper-bound-p real-type set bound))
     (q859122-leq real-type supremum bound))))

(defun q859122-is-supremum-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (and
   (q859122-real-p real-type supremum)
   (q859122-upper-bound-p real-type set supremum)
   (q859122-supremum-p real-type set supremum)))

(defun-sk q859122-supremum-exists-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q859122-is-supremum-p real-type set supremum)))

(defun-sk q859122-dedekind-complete-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (q859122-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
      (q859122-bounded-above-p real-type set))
     (q859122-supremum-exists-p real-type set))))

(defun q859122-real-structure-p (real-type)
  (let ((zero (q859122-zero real-type))
        (one (q859122-one real-type)))
    (and
     (q859122-real-p real-type zero)
     (q859122-real-p real-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q859122-field-laws-p real-type)
     (q859122-order-laws-p real-type)
     (q859122-less real-type zero one)
     (q859122-dedekind-complete-p real-type))))

;; Arbitrary coefficient-norm profiles.

(defun q859122-sequence-value (sequence n)
  (apply$ sequence (list n)))

(defun-sk q859122-nonnegative-sequence-values-p
    (real-type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q859122-nonnegative-p
      real-type
      (q859122-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun q859122-nonnegative-sequence-p
    (real-type sequence)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (q859122-nonnegative-sequence-values-p
    real-type sequence)))

;; Extended nonnegative reals.

(defun q859122-top ()
  :q859122-top)

(defun q859122-finite (value)
  (cons :q859122-finite value))

(defun q859122-finite-p (value)
  (and
   (consp value)
   (equal (car value) :q859122-finite)))

(defun q859122-finite-value (value)
  (cdr value))

(defun q859122-ennreal-p (real-type value)
  (or
   (equal value (q859122-top))
   (and
    (q859122-finite-p value)
    (q859122-nonnegative-p
     real-type
     (q859122-finite-value value)))))

(defun q859122-ennreal-less
    (real-type left right)
  (cond
   ((equal right (q859122-top))
    (not (equal left (q859122-top))))
   ((equal left (q859122-top))
    nil)
   (t
    (q859122-less
     real-type
     (q859122-finite-value left)
     (q859122-finite-value right)))))

(defun q859122-ennreal-leq
    (real-type left right)
  (not (q859122-ennreal-less real-type right left)))

(defun q859122-ennreal-inverse
    (real-type value)
  (cond
   ((equal value (q859122-top))
    (q859122-finite (q859122-zero real-type)))
   ((equal
     (q859122-finite-value value)
     (q859122-zero real-type))
    (q859122-top))
   (t
    (q859122-finite
     (q859122-inverse
      real-type
      (q859122-finite-value value))))))

;; The source radius is
;;
;;   sup {r >= 0 | exists C in R, forall n, a_n * r^n <= C},
;;
;; embedded in the extended nonnegative reals.

(defun-sk q859122-growth-bounded-p
    (real-type sequence radius bound)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q859122-leq
      real-type
      (q859122-multiply
       real-type
       (q859122-sequence-value sequence n)
       (q859122-real-power real-type radius n))
      bound))))

(defun-sk q859122-growth-bound-exists-p
    (real-type sequence radius)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q859122-real-p real-type bound)
     (q859122-growth-bounded-p
      real-type sequence radius bound))))

(defun q859122-admissible-radius-p
    (real-type sequence radius)
  (and
   (q859122-nonnegative-p real-type radius)
   (q859122-growth-bound-exists-p
    real-type sequence radius)))

(defun-sk q859122-radius-upper-bound-p
    (real-type sequence upper)
  (forall (radius)
    (implies
     (q859122-admissible-radius-p
      real-type sequence radius)
     (q859122-ennreal-leq
      real-type
      (q859122-finite radius)
      upper))))

(defun-sk q859122-radius-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type sequence radius)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (q859122-ennreal-p real-type upper)
      (q859122-radius-upper-bound-p
       real-type sequence upper))
     (q859122-ennreal-leq
      real-type radius upper))))

(defun q859122-is-radius-p
    (real-type sequence radius)
  (and
   (q859122-ennreal-p real-type radius)
   (q859122-radius-upper-bound-p
    real-type sequence radius)
   (q859122-radius-least-upper-bound-p
    real-type sequence radius)))

;; For n > 0, NNReal.rpow a (1/n) is the unique nonnegative nth root of a.
;; At n = 0, Lean's exponent is 1/0 = 0, so the value is one.

(defun q859122-root-value-p
    (real-type sequence n value)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (q859122-nonnegative-p real-type value)
   (if (zp n)
       (equal value (q859122-one real-type))
     (equal
      (q859122-real-power real-type value n)
      (q859122-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q859122-root-exists-p
    (real-type sequence n)
  (exists (value)
    (q859122-root-value-p
     real-type sequence n value)))

(defun-sk q859122-all-roots-exist-p
    (real-type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q859122-root-exists-p
      real-type sequence n))))

(defun-sk q859122-root-above-p
    (real-type sequence n lower)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (q859122-root-value-p
      real-type sequence n value)
     (q859122-ennreal-less
      real-type lower (q859122-finite value)))))

(defun-sk q859122-root-below-p
    (real-type sequence n upper)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (q859122-root-value-p
      real-type sequence n value)
     (q859122-ennreal-less
      real-type (q859122-finite value) upper))))

;; These two order conditions characterize the atTop limsup exactly:
;; every value below the limit is exceeded arbitrarily late, and every value
;; above the limit is eventually an upper bound.  They include both finite
;; and +infinity cases without a bounded or finite approximation.

(defun-sk q859122-late-root-exceedance-exists-p
    (real-type sequence lower cutoff)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (<= cutoff n)
     (q859122-root-above-p
      real-type sequence n lower))))

(defun-sk q859122-limsup-lower-p
    (real-type sequence limit)
  (forall (lower cutoff)
    (implies
     (and
      (q859122-ennreal-p real-type lower)
      (q859122-ennreal-less real-type lower limit)
      (natp cutoff))
     (q859122-late-root-exceedance-exists-p
      real-type sequence lower cutoff))))

(defun-sk q859122-eventual-root-upper-tail-p
    (real-type sequence upper cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q859122-root-below-p
      real-type sequence n upper))))

(defun-sk q859122-eventual-root-upper-exists-p
    (real-type sequence upper)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q859122-eventual-root-upper-tail-p
      real-type sequence upper cutoff))))

(defun-sk q859122-limsup-upper-p
    (real-type sequence limit)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (q859122-ennreal-p real-type upper)
      (q859122-ennreal-less real-type limit upper))
     (q859122-eventual-root-upper-exists-p
      real-type sequence upper))))

(defun q859122-is-root-limsup-p
    (real-type sequence limit)
  (and
   (q859122-ennreal-p real-type limit)
   (q859122-all-roots-exist-p real-type sequence)
   (q859122-limsup-lower-p real-type sequence limit)
   (q859122-limsup-upper-p real-type sequence limit)))

(defun-sk q859122-cauchy-hadamard-value-exists-p
    (real-type sequence)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q859122-is-radius-p real-type sequence radius)
     (q859122-is-root-limsup-p
      real-type
      sequence
      (q859122-ennreal-inverse real-type radius)))))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q859122-cauchy-hadamard-statement ()
  (forall (real-type sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q859122-real-structure-p real-type)
      (q859122-nonnegative-sequence-p
       real-type sequence))
     (q859122-cauchy-hadamard-value-exists-p
      real-type sequence))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q859122_cauchy_hadamard_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q859122,
-- "Cauchy–Hadamard theorem": for a formal multilinear series, the inverse of
-- its convergence radius equals the limsup of the nth roots of its term norms.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q859122_cauchy_hadamard_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record NontriviallyNormedField
  {R K : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK reciprocalK : K -> K
    normK : K -> R

    one-not-zeroK :
      oneK != zeroK
    add-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> addK x y == addK y x
    add-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-zeroK :
      (x : K) -> addK x zeroK == x
    add-inverseK :
      (x : K) -> addK x (negateK x) == zeroK
    multiply-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> multiplyK x y == multiplyK y x
    multiply-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z ==
      multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-oneK :
      (x : K) -> multiplyK x oneK == x
    distributeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    reciprocal-zeroK :
      reciprocalK zeroK == zeroK
    multiply-reciprocalK :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (reciprocalK x) == oneK

    norm-nonnegativeK :
      (x : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normK x)
    norm-zeroK :
      normK zeroK == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyK :
      (x : K) ->
      normK x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroK
    norm-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normK (addK x y))
        (addR reals (normK x) (normK y))
    norm-multiplyK :
      (x y : K) ->
      normK (multiplyK x y) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK x) (normK y)
    norm-nontrivialK :
      Exists K
        (\ x ->
          Both
            (lessOrEqualR reals (oneR reals) (normK x))
            (oneR reals != normK x))

open NontriviallyNormedField

record NormedSpace
  {R K X : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (scalars : NontriviallyNormedField {R = R} {K = K} reals) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroX : X
    addX : X -> X -> X
    negateX : X -> X
    scaleX : K -> X -> X
    normX : X -> R

    add-commutativeX :
      (x y : X) -> addX x y == addX y x
    add-associativeX :
      (x y z : X) ->
      addX (addX x y) z == addX x (addX y z)
    add-zeroX :
      (x : X) -> addX x zeroX == x
    add-inverseX :
      (x : X) -> addX x (negateX x) == zeroX

    scale-oneX :
      (x : X) ->
      scaleX (oneK scalars) x == x
    scale-associativeX :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : X) ->
      scaleX (multiplyK scalars a b) x ==
      scaleX a (scaleX b x)
    scale-add-vectorsX :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : X) ->
      scaleX a (addX x y) ==
      addX (scaleX a x) (scaleX a y)
    scale-add-scalarsX :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : X) ->
      scaleX (addK scalars a b) x ==
      addX (scaleX a x) (scaleX b x)

    norm-nonnegativeX :
      (x : X) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normX x)
    norm-zeroX :
      normX zeroX == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyX :
      (x : X) ->
      normX x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroX
    norm-addX :
      (x y : X) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normX (addX x y))
        (addR reals (normX x) (normX y))
    norm-scaleX :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : X) ->
      normX (scaleX a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK scalars a) (normX x)

open NormedSpace

data Vec (A : Set) : Nat -> Set where
  []  : Vec A zero
  _::_ : {n : Nat} -> A -> Vec A n -> Vec A (suc n)

Curried :
  Set ->
  Set ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Curried E F zero =
  F
Curried E F (suc n) =
  E -> Curried E F n

applyCurried :
  {E F : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Curried E F n ->
  Vec E n ->
  F
applyCurried {n = zero} value [] =
  value
applyCurried {n = suc n} function (x :: xs) =
  applyCurried (function x) xs

record LinearAtHead
  {R K E F : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField {R = R} {K = K} reals}
  (source : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = E} reals scalars)
  (target : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = F} reals scalars)
  (n : Nat)
  (function : E -> Curried E F n) : Set where
  field
    map-add-head :
      (x y : E) ->
      (remaining : Vec E n) ->
      applyCurried (function (addX source x y)) remaining ==
      addX target
        (applyCurried (function x) remaining)
        (applyCurried (function y) remaining)
    map-scale-head :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      (remaining : Vec E n) ->
      applyCurried (function (scaleX source a x)) remaining ==
      scaleX target a (applyCurried (function x) remaining)

IsMultilinear :
  {R K E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField {R = R} {K = K} reals} ->
  (source : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = E} reals scalars) ->
  (target : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = F} reals scalars) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Curried E F n ->
  Set
IsMultilinear source target zero value =
  Top
IsMultilinear source target (suc n) function =
  Both
    (LinearAtHead source target n function)
    ((x : _) ->
      IsMultilinear source target n (function x))

productNorm :
  {R K E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField {R = R} {K = K} reals} ->
  (source : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = E} reals scalars) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vec E n ->
  R
productNorm {reals = reals} source [] =
  oneR reals
productNorm {reals = reals} source (x :: xs) =
  multiplyR reals (normX source x) (productNorm source xs)

record IsOperatorNorm
  {R K E F : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField {R = R} {K = K} reals}
  (source : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = E} reals scalars)
  (target : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = F} reals scalars)
  (n : Nat)
  (function : Curried E F n)
  (bound : R) : Set where
  field
    bound-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) bound
    bounds-function :
      (inputs : Vec E n) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normX target (applyCurried function inputs))
        (multiplyR reals bound (productNorm source inputs))
    least-bound :
      (candidate : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) candidate ->
      ((inputs : Vec E n) ->
        lessOrEqualR reals
          (normX target (applyCurried function inputs))
          (multiplyR reals candidate (productNorm source inputs))) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals bound candidate

record ContinuousMultilinearMap
  {R K E F : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField {R = R} {K = K} reals}
  (source : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = E} reals scalars)
  (target : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = F} reals scalars)
  (n : Nat) : Set1 where
  field
    functionN :
      Curried E F n
    multilinearN :
      IsMultilinear source target n functionN
    normN :
      R
    norm-characterizationN :
      IsOperatorNorm source target n functionN normN

open ContinuousMultilinearMap

FormalMultilinearSeries :
  {R K E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField {R = R} {K = K} reals} ->
  NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = E} reals scalars ->
  NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = F} reals scalars ->
  Set1
FormalMultilinearSeries source target =
  (n : Nat) ->
  ContinuousMultilinearMap source target n

powerR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
powerR reals x zero =
  oneR reals
powerR reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals (powerR reals x n) x

record NonnegativeReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    realValue :
      R
    realValue-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) realValue

open NonnegativeReal

zeroNN :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  NonnegativeReal reals
zeroNN reals =
  nonnegative-real
    (zeroR reals)
    (order-reflexiveR reals (zeroR reals))

oneNN :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  NonnegativeReal reals
oneNN reals =
  nonnegative-real
    (oneR reals)
    (Both.first (zero-less-than-oneR reals))

record NonnegativeRoots
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    rootNN :
      NonnegativeReal reals ->
      Nat ->
      NonnegativeReal reals
    root-zero-degree :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      rootNN x zero == oneNN reals
    root-positive-power :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      powerR reals (realValue (rootNN x (suc n))) (suc n) ==
      realValue x
    root-positive-unique :
      (x candidate : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      powerR reals (realValue candidate) (suc n) == realValue x ->
      realValue candidate == realValue (rootNN x (suc n))

open NonnegativeRoots

record ExtendedNonnegativeReals
  {R M : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroM oneM infinityM : M
    lessOrEqualM : M -> M -> Set
    finiteM : NonnegativeReal reals -> M
    inverseM : M -> M

    finite-zeroM :
      finiteM (zeroNN reals) == zeroM
    finite-oneM :
      finiteM (oneNN reals) == oneM
    finite-orderM :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualM (finiteM x) (finiteM y))
        (lessOrEqualR reals (realValue x) (realValue y))
    finite-injectiveM :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      finiteM x == finiteM y ->
      realValue x == realValue y
    finite-le-infinityM :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      lessOrEqualM (finiteM x) infinityM
    infinity-not-finiteM :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      infinityM != finiteM x
    finite-or-infinityM :
      (x : M) ->
      Either
        (x == infinityM)
        (Exists (NonnegativeReal reals) (\ y -> x == finiteM y))

    order-reflexiveM :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM x x
    order-transitiveM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM x z
    order-antisymmetricM :
      (x y : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y x ->
      x == y
    zero-leastM :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM zeroM x
    infinity-greatestM :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM x infinityM

    inverse-zeroM :
      inverseM zeroM == infinityM
    inverse-infinityM :
      inverseM infinityM == zeroM
    inverse-finite-nonzeroM :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      realValue x != zeroR reals ->
      Exists
        (lessOrEqualR reals
          (zeroR reals)
          (reciprocalR reals (realValue x)))
        (\ nonnegative-reciprocal ->
          inverseM (finiteM x) ==
          finiteM
            (nonnegative-real
              (reciprocalR reals (realValue x))
              nonnegative-reciprocal))

    supremumM :
      (M -> Set) ->
      M
    supremum-upperM :
      (P : M -> Set) ->
      (x : M) ->
      P x ->
      lessOrEqualM x (supremumM P)
    supremum-leastM :
      (P : M -> Set) ->
      (upper : M) ->
      ((x : M) -> P x -> lessOrEqualM x upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM (supremumM P) upper

    infimumM :
      (M -> Set) ->
      M
    infimum-lowerM :
      (P : M -> Set) ->
      (x : M) ->
      P x ->
      lessOrEqualM (infimumM P) x
    infimum-greatestM :
      (P : M -> Set) ->
      (lower : M) ->
      ((x : M) -> P x -> lessOrEqualM lower x) ->
      lessOrEqualM lower (infimumM P)

open ExtendedNonnegativeReals

TermNorm :
  {R K E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField {R = R} {K = K} reals} ->
  {source : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = E} reals scalars} ->
  {target : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = F} reals scalars} ->
  FormalMultilinearSeries source target ->
  Nat ->
  NonnegativeReal reals
TermNorm {reals = reals} p n =
  nonnegative-real
    (normN (p n))
    (IsOperatorNorm.bound-nonnegative
      (norm-characterizationN (p n)))

BoundedAtRadius :
  {R K E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField {R = R} {K = K} reals} ->
  {source : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = E} reals scalars} ->
  {target : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = F} reals scalars} ->
  FormalMultilinearSeries source target ->
  NonnegativeReal reals ->
  Set
BoundedAtRadius {R = R} {reals = reals} p radius =
  Exists R
    (\ bound ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (multiplyR reals
          (realValue (TermNorm p n))
          (powerR reals (realValue radius) n))
        bound)

EligibleRadius :
  {R K E F M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField {R = R} {K = K} reals} ->
  {source : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = E} reals scalars} ->
  {target : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = F} reals scalars} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals {R = R} {M = M} reals) ->
  FormalMultilinearSeries source target ->
  M ->
  Set
EligibleRadius extended p candidate =
  Exists
    (NonnegativeReal _)
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (candidate == finiteM extended radius)
        (BoundedAtRadius p radius))

Radius :
  {R K E F M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField {R = R} {K = K} reals} ->
  {source : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = E} reals scalars} ->
  {target : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = F} reals scalars} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals {R = R} {M = M} reals) ->
  FormalMultilinearSeries source target ->
  M
Radius extended p =
  supremumM extended (EligibleRadius extended p)

RootSequence :
  {R K E F M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField {R = R} {K = K} reals} ->
  {source : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = E} reals scalars} ->
  {target : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = F} reals scalars} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals {R = R} {M = M} reals ->
  NonnegativeRoots reals ->
  FormalMultilinearSeries source target ->
  Nat ->
  M
RootSequence extended roots p n =
  finiteM extended (rootNN roots (TermNorm p n) n)

EventuallyUpperBound :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals {R = R} {M = M} reals ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  M ->
  Set
EventuallyUpperBound extended sequence upper =
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      lessOrEqualM extended (sequence n) upper)

LimsupAtTop :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals {R = R} {M = M} reals) ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  M
LimsupAtTop extended sequence =
  infimumM extended (EventuallyUpperBound extended sequence)

cauchy-hadamard-theorem : Set1
cauchy-hadamard-theorem =
  (R K E F M : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (scalars : NontriviallyNormedField {R = R} {K = K} reals) ->
  (source : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = E} reals scalars) ->
  (target : NormedSpace {R = R} {K = K} {X = F} reals scalars) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals {R = R} {M = M} reals) ->
  (roots : NonnegativeRoots reals) ->
  (p : FormalMultilinearSeries source target) ->
  inverseM extended (Radius extended p) ==
  LimsupAtTop extended (RootSequence extended roots p)

title: Q859122_cauchy_hadamard_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q859122 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q859122), "Cauchy–Hadamard theorem":
  for a formal multilinear series over an arbitrary nontrivially normed
  field, the inverse convergence radius is the limsup of the nth roots of
  its coefficient operator norms. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open extrealTheory;

val q859122_nontrivially_normed_field_def = new_definition (
  "q859122_nontrivially_normed_field_def",
  ``q859122_nontrivially_normed_field
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) <=>
      zeroK <> oneK /\
      (!a b. addK a b = addK b a) /\
      (!a b c. addK (addK a b) c = addK a (addK b c)) /\
      (!a. addK zeroK a = a) /\
      (!a. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
      (!a b. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
      (!a b c. mulK (mulK a b) c = mulK a (mulK b c)) /\
      (!a. mulK oneK a = a) /\
      (!a b c. mulK a (addK b c) =
                 addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
      invK zeroK = zeroK /\
      (!a. a <> zeroK ==> mulK (invK a) a = oneK) /\
      (!a. 0 <= normK a) /\
      (!a. (normK a = 0) <=> (a = zeroK)) /\
      normK oneK = 1 /\
      (!a. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\
      (!a b. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
      (!a b. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
      ?a. 1 < normK a``);

val q859122_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q859122_normed_space_def",
  ``q859122_normed_space
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'k -> 'v -> 'v) (normV : 'v -> real) <=>
      (!x y. addV x y = addV y x) /\
      (!x y z. addV (addV x y) z = addV x (addV y z)) /\
      (!x. addV zeroV x = x) /\
      (!x. addV (negV x) x = zeroV) /\
      (!x. smulV oneK x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smulV (mulK a b) x = smulV a (smulV b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smulV (addK a b) x =
                 addV (smulV a x) (smulV b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smulV a (addV x y) =
                 addV (smulV a x) (smulV a y)) /\
      (!x. smulV zeroK x = zeroV) /\
      (!a. smulV a zeroV = zeroV) /\
      (!x. 0 <= normV x) /\
      (!x. (normV x = 0) <=> (x = zeroV)) /\
      (!x. normV (negV x) = normV x) /\
      (!x y. normV (addV x y) <= normV x + normV y) /\
      (!a x. normV (smulV a x) = normK a * normV x)``);

val q859122_list_norm_product_def = new_definition (
  "q859122_list_norm_product_def",
  ``q859122_list_norm_product (normV : 'v -> real) (xs : 'v list) =
      FOLDL (\acc x. acc * normV x) 1 xs``);

val q859122_formal_multilinear_series_def = new_definition (
  "q859122_formal_multilinear_series_def",
  ``q859122_formal_multilinear_series
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (smulF : 'k -> 'f -> 'f)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (normF : 'f -> real)
      (p : num -> 'e list -> 'f) (opnorm : num -> real) <=>
      (!n i xs x y.
        LENGTH xs = n /\ i < n ==>
        p n (LUPDATE (addE x y) i xs) =
          addF
            (p n (LUPDATE x i xs))
            (p n (LUPDATE y i xs))) /\
      (!n i xs a x.
        LENGTH xs = n /\ i < n ==>
        p n (LUPDATE (smulE a x) i xs) =
          smulF a (p n (LUPDATE x i xs))) /\
      !n.
        0 <= opnorm n /\
        (!xs.
          LENGTH xs = n ==>
          normF (p n xs) <=
            opnorm n * q859122_list_norm_product normE xs) /\
        !C : real.
          0 <= C /\
          (!xs.
            LENGTH xs = n ==>
            normF (p n xs) <=
              C * q859122_list_norm_product normE xs)
          ==>
          opnorm n <= C``);

val q859122_radius_def = new_definition (
  "q859122_radius_def",
  ``q859122_radius (opnorm : num -> real) =
      sup
        {Normal r |
          0 <= r /\
          ?C : real.
            !n.
              opnorm n * r pow n <= C}``);

val q859122_ennreal_inv_def = new_definition (
  "q859122_ennreal_inv_def",
  ``q859122_ennreal_inv (x : extreal) =
      if x = Normal 0 then PosInf else inv x``);

val q859122_nth_root_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q859122_nth_root_norm_def",
  ``q859122_nth_root_norm (opnorm : num -> real) (n : num) =
      Normal (opnorm n rpow (1 / &n))``);

val cauchy_hadamard_theorem =
  ``!(zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (zeroF : 'f) (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (negF : 'f -> 'f)
      (smulF : 'k -> 'f -> 'f) (normF : 'f -> real)
      (p : num -> 'e list -> 'f) (opnorm : num -> real).
      q859122_nontrivially_normed_field
        zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
      q859122_normed_space
        zeroK oneK addK mulK normK
        zeroE addE negE smulE normE /\
      q859122_normed_space
        zeroK oneK addK mulK normK
        zeroF addF negF smulF normF /\
      q859122_formal_multilinear_series
        addK addE smulE addF smulF normE normF p opnorm
      ==>
      q859122_ennreal_inv (q859122_radius opnorm) =
      limsup (q859122_nth_root_norm opnorm)``;

title: Q859122_cauchy_hadamard_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q859122
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q859122), "Cauchy-Hadamard theorem": for a
  formal multilinear series over an arbitrary nontrivially normed field, the
  inverse of its convergence radius is the limsup of the nth roots of its
  coefficient norms. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q859122Multilinear gives the set-theoretic content of a continuous
  multilinear map from the finite power indexed by 0 ..^ n. Linearity is
  stated one coordinate at a time, and the product-of-norms estimate is the
  standard equivalent characterization of continuity. Q859122Series is
  therefore exactly a FormalMultilinearSeries.

  Q859122OpNorm is exactly Mathlib's continuous-multilinear-map operator norm:
  the infimum of all nonnegative real constants C giving the global bound
  ||L(x)|| <= C * product_i ||x_i||. Q859122Radius is exactly Mathlib's radius
  definition: the supremum of nonnegative finite r for which ||P_n|| r^n is
  bounded by one real constant for every n.

  Q859122Root uses Mathlib's NNReal real-power conventions. In particular its
  n = 0 value is one, including when the coefficient norm is zero.
  Q859122ENNInv is inversion on the extended nonnegative reals, with zero and
  positive infinity interchanged. SetMM's limsup of the resulting nonnegative
  real sequence is extended-real-valued, matching the ENNReal limsup in the
  canonical Lean statement.

  The final declaration quantifies over arbitrary bundled normed fields,
  normed spaces, and formal multilinear series. The element of norm greater
  than one is the explicit SetMM rendering of NontriviallyNormedField. Every
  preceding $a declaration is syntax or a faithful definition, and the final
  $a declaration is the unproved corpus statement; there is no $p proof.
$)

$c Q859122Update Q859122Multilinear Q859122Series Q859122OpNorm
   Q859122Radius Q859122Root Q859122ENNInv $.

q859122-update-syntax
  $a class ( Q859122Update x i y ) $.
q859122-multilinear-syntax
  $a wff ( Q859122Multilinear K E F n L ) $.
q859122-series-syntax
  $a wff ( Q859122Series K E F P ) $.
q859122-op-norm-syntax
  $a class ( Q859122OpNorm E F n L ) $.
q859122-radius-syntax
  $a class ( Q859122Radius E F P ) $.
q859122-root-syntax
  $a class ( Q859122Root x n ) $.
q859122-enn-inv-syntax
  $a class ( Q859122ENNInv x ) $.

${
  $d i j x y $.

  q859122-update-definition $a |- (
    Q859122Update x i y
  ) = (
    j e. dom x |->
      if ( j = i , y , ( x ` j ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C E F K L a i j n x y $.

  q859122-multilinear-definition $a |- (
    ( Q859122Multilinear K E F n L )
    <->
    (
      L :
        ( ( Base ` E ) ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
        -->
        ( Base ` F )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
        A. x e. ( ( Base ` E ) ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
          A. y e. ( ( Base ` E ) ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
            (
              L
              `
              (
                Q859122Update
                x i
                (
                  ( x ` i )
                  ( +g ` E )
                  ( y ` i )
                )
              )
            )
            =
            (
              ( L ` x )
              ( +g ` F )
              (
                L
                `
                ( Q859122Update x i ( y ` i ) )
              )
            )
      /\
      A. i e. ( 0 ..^ n )
        A. a e. ( Base ` K )
          A. x e. ( ( Base ` E ) ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
            (
              L
              `
              (
                Q859122Update
                x i
                (
                  a
                  ( .s ` E )
                  ( x ` i )
                )
              )
            )
            =
            (
              a
              ( .s ` F )
              ( L ` x )
            )
      /\
      E. C e. RR
        (
          0 <_ C
          /\
          A. x e. ( ( Base ` E ) ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
            (
              ( ( norm ` F ) ` ( L ` x ) )
              <_
              (
                C
                x.
                prod_ j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                  ( ( norm ` E ) ` ( x ` j ) )
              )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d E F K P L n $.

  q859122-series-definition $a |- (
    ( Q859122Series K E F P )
    <->
    (
      P Fn NN0
      /\
      A. n e. NN0
        ( Q859122Multilinear K E F n ( P ` n ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C E F L j n x $.

  q859122-op-norm-definition $a |- (
    Q859122OpNorm E F n L
  ) = inf (
    {
      C e. RR |
      (
        0 <_ C
        /\
        A. x e. ( ( Base ` E ) ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
          (
            ( ( norm ` F ) ` ( L ` x ) )
            <_
            (
              C
              x.
              prod_ j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                ( ( norm ` E ) ` ( x ` j ) )
            )
          )
      )
    }
    ,
    RR
    ,
    <
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C E F P n r $.

  q859122-radius-definition $a |- (
    Q859122Radius E F P
  ) = sup (
    { r e. RR |
      (
        0 <_ r
        /\
        E. C e. RR
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              (
                Q859122OpNorm E F n ( P ` n )
              )
              x.
              ( r ^ n )
            )
            <_
            C
      )
    } ,
    RR* ,
    <
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d n x $.

  q859122-root-definition $a |- (
    Q859122Root x n
  ) = if (
    n = 0 ,
    1 ,
    if (
      x = 0 ,
      0 ,
      (
        exp
        `
        (
          ( log ` x )
          x.
          ( 1 / n )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  q859122-enn-inv-definition $a |- (
    Q859122ENNInv x
  ) = if (
    x = 0 ,
    +oo ,
    if ( x = +oo , 0 , ( 1 / x ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d E F K P c n $.

  thousand-theorems-q859122-cauchy-hadamard $a |-
    A. K e. ( NrmRing i^i Field )

title: Q859122_cauchy_hadamard_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q859122,
% "Cauchy–Hadamard theorem": for a formal multilinear series, the inverse of
% its convergence radius is the limsup of the nth roots of its operator norms.
% This file contains no proof.

Q859122_cauchy_hadamard_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  norm_profile: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  extended_nonnegative_real: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  extended_sequence: TYPE =
    [nat -> extended_nonnegative_real]

  zero_extended: extended_nonnegative_real =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  top_extended: extended_nonnegative_real =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_extended(value: real): extended_nonnegative_real =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_extended(value: extended_nonnegative_real): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      0 <= finite_part(value)
    ENDIF

  extended_le(
      left, right: extended_nonnegative_real): bool =
    canonical_extended(left)
      AND canonical_extended(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  extended_inverse(
      value: extended_nonnegative_real):
      extended_nonnegative_real =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      zero_extended
    ELSIF finite_part(value) = 0 THEN
      top_extended
    ELSE
      finite_extended(1 / finite_part(value))
    ENDIF

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(
      values: [nat -> real],
      limit_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit_value)
              < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF 0 < x THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  nonnegative_real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF 0 < base THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  nonnegative_profile(values: norm_profile): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      0 <= values(index)

  admissible_radius(
      coefficient_norms: norm_profile,
      radius_value: real): bool =
    0 <= radius_value
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          coefficient_norms(index) * radius_value ^ index
            <= bound

  is_convergence_radius(
      coefficient_norms: norm_profile,
      radius_value: extended_nonnegative_real): bool =
    canonical_extended(radius_value)
      AND (FORALL (candidate: real):
        admissible_radius(coefficient_norms, candidate)
          IMPLIES
            extended_le(
              finite_extended(candidate),
              radius_value))
      AND (FORALL (upper_bound: extended_nonnegative_real):
        (canonical_extended(upper_bound)
          AND (FORALL (candidate: real):
            admissible_radius(coefficient_norms, candidate)
              IMPLIES
                extended_le(
                  finite_extended(candidate),
                  upper_bound)))
        IMPLIES
          extended_le(radius_value, upper_bound))

  root_profile(
      coefficient_norms: norm_profile): extended_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      finite_extended(
        nonnegative_real_power(
          coefficient_norms(index),
          safe_div(1, index :: real)))

  eventual_upper_bound(
      values: extended_sequence,
      upper_bound: extended_nonnegative_real): bool =
    canonical_extended(upper_bound)
      AND EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            extended_le(values(index), upper_bound)

  is_limsup(
      values: extended_sequence,
      limit_value: extended_nonnegative_real): bool =
    canonical_extended(limit_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper_bound: extended_nonnegative_real):
        eventual_upper_bound(values, upper_bound)
          IMPLIES
            extended_le(limit_value, upper_bound))
      AND (FORALL (lower_bound: extended_nonnegative_real):
        (canonical_extended(lower_bound)
          AND (FORALL (upper_bound: extended_nonnegative_real):
            eventual_upper_bound(values, upper_bound)
              IMPLIES
                extended_le(lower_bound, upper_bound)))
        IMPLIES
          extended_le(lower_bound, limit_value))

  cauchy_hadamard_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (coefficient_norms: norm_profile),
        (radius_value, limsup_value:
          extended_nonnegative_real):
      (nonnegative_profile(coefficient_norms)
        AND is_convergence_radius(
          coefficient_norms, radius_value)
        AND is_limsup(
          root_profile(coefficient_norms),
          limsup_value))
      IMPLIES
        extended_inverse(radius_value) = limsup_value
END Q859122_cauchy_hadamard_theorem

-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q866116
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q866116), "Hahn–Banach theorem": every continuous
-- linear functional on a subspace of a seminormed space over a real-like normed
-- field extends to the whole space without changing its norm. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.RCLike.Basic

@[expose] public section

universe u

variable {𝕜 : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [IsRCLikeNormedField 𝕜]
variable {E : Type u} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]

/-- The norm-preserving Hahn–Banach extension theorem for continuous linear functionals. -/
theorem exists_extension_norm_eq (p : Subspace 𝕜 E) (f : StrongDual 𝕜 p) :
    ∃ g : StrongDual 𝕜 E, (∀ x : p, g x = f x) ∧ ‖g‖ = ‖f‖ := sorry
