content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q866116,
  "Hahn–Banach theorem": a continuous linear functional on a subspace of a
  seminormed space over a real-or-complex normed field extends to the whole
  space without changing its operator norm. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q866116_hahn_banach_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q866116_is_RCLike_normed_field ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q866116_is_RCLike_normed_field knorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>to_real :: 'k \<Rightarrow> real.
      bij to_real \<and>
      to_real 0 = 0 \<and>
      to_real 1 = 1 \<and>
      (\<forall>a b. to_real (a + b) = to_real a + to_real b) \<and>
      (\<forall>a b. to_real (a * b) = to_real a * to_real b) \<and>
      (\<forall>a. knorm a = abs (to_real a))) \<or>
    (\<exists>to_complex :: 'k \<Rightarrow> complex.
      bij to_complex \<and>
      to_complex 0 = 0 \<and>
      to_complex 1 = 1 \<and>
      (\<forall>a b. to_complex (a + b) = to_complex a + to_complex b) \<and>
      (\<forall>a b. to_complex (a * b) = to_complex a * to_complex b) \<and>
      (\<forall>a. knorm a = norm (to_complex a)))"

definition q866116_seminormed_space ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q866116_seminormed_space knorm enorm scale \<longleftrightarrow>
    enorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm (-x) = enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. enorm (x + y) \<le> enorm x + enorm y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. scale a (x + y) = scale a x + scale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a + b) x = scale a x + scale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a * b) x = scale a (scale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. scale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. enorm (scale a x) = knorm a * enorm x)"

definition q866116_subspace ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q866116_subspace scale p \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<in> p \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> p. \<forall>y \<in> p. x + y \<in> p) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. x \<in> p \<longrightarrow> scale a x \<in> p)"

definition q866116_continuous_linear_on ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     'e set \<Rightarrow> ('e \<Rightarrow> 'k) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q866116_continuous_linear_on knorm enorm scale p f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x \<in> p. \<forall>y \<in> p. f (x + y) = f x + f y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. x \<in> p \<longrightarrow> f (scale a x) = a * f x) \<and>
    (\<exists>C \<ge> 0. \<forall>x \<in> p. knorm (f x) \<le> C * enorm x)"

definition q866116_operator_norm_on ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     'e set \<Rightarrow> ('e \<Rightarrow> 'k) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q866116_operator_norm_on knorm enorm p f =
    Inf {C. 0 \<le> C \<and> (\<forall>x \<in> p. knorm (f x) \<le> C * enorm x)}"

theorem exists_extension_norm_eq:
  fixes knorm :: "'k::field \<Rightarrow> real"
    and enorm :: "'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and scale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and p :: "'e set"
    and f :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'k"
  assumes "q866116_is_RCLike_normed_field knorm"
    and "q866116_seminormed_space knorm enorm scale"
    and "q866116_subspace scale p"
    and "q866116_continuous_linear_on knorm enorm scale p f"
  shows "\<exists>g :: 'e \<Rightarrow> 'k.
    q866116_continuous_linear_on knorm enorm scale UNIV g \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> p. g x = f x) \<and>
    q866116_operator_norm_on knorm enorm UNIV g =
      q866116_operator_norm_on knorm enorm p f"
  sorry

end

    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).

  let cmul =
    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
       (FST z * FST w - SND z * SND w,
        FST z * SND w + SND z * FST w) in
  let cneg =
    \(z:real#real). (--(FST z),--(SND z)) in
  let czero = (&0,&0) in
  let cone = (&1,&0) in

    \(z:real#real). sqrt(FST z pow 2 + SND z pow 2) in

    \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)

         (!r:real. to_real (from_real r) = r) /\

         (!x y:K. to_real (mulK x y) = to_real x * to_real y) /\
         (!x:K. to_real (negK x) = --(to_real x)) /\
         (!x:K. normK x = abs(to_real x)) in

    \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
     (negK:K->K) (normK:K->real).
       ?to_complex:K->real#real. ?from_complex:(real#real)->K.
         (!x:K. from_complex (to_complex x) = x) /\

            to_complex (addK x y) =

            to_complex (mulK x y) =
            cmul (to_complex x) (to_complex y)) /\
         (!x:K. to_complex (negK x) = cneg (to_complex x)) /\
         (!x:K. normK x = cmod (to_complex x)) in
  let rclike_normed_field =
    \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
     (negK:K->K) (normK:K->real).
       real_field_equiv zeroK oneK addK mulK negK normK \/
       complex_field_equiv zeroK oneK addK mulK negK normK in
  let seminormed_space =
    \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
     (normK:K->real)
     (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
     (smul:K->E->E) (normE:E->real).
       (!x y z:E. addE x (addE y z) = addE (addE x y) z) /\
       (!x y:E. addE x y = addE y x) /\
       (!x:E. addE zeroE x = x) /\
       (!x:E. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
       normE zeroE = &0 /\
       (!x:E. &0 <= normE x) /\
       (!x:E. normE (negE x) = normE x) /\
       (!x y:E. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) /\
       (!x:E. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:K. !x:E. smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:K. !x:E.
          smul (addK a b) x = addE (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:K. !x y:E.
          smul a (addE x y) = addE (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a:K. smul a zeroE = zeroE) /\
       (!x:E. smul zeroK x = zeroE) /\
       (!a:K. !x:E. normE (smul a x) = normK a * normE x) in
  let subspace =
    \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (smul:K->E->E) (p:E->bool).
       zeroE IN p /\
       (!x y:E. x IN p /\ y IN p ==> addE x y IN p) /\
       (!a:K. !x:E. x IN p ==> smul a x IN p) in
  let continuous_linear_on =
    \(addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K) (normK:K->real)
     (addE:E->E->E) (smul:K->E->E) (normE:E->real)
     (p:E->bool) (f:E->K).
       (!x y:E.
          x IN p /\ y IN p ==> f (addE x y) = addK (f x) (f y)) /\
       (!a:K. !x:E.
          x IN p ==> f (smul a x) = mulK a (f x)) /\
       (?C:real.
          &0 <= C /\
          !x:E. x IN p ==> normK (f x) <= C * normE x) in
  let operator_norm =
    \(normK:K->real) (normE:E->real)
     (p:E->bool) (f:E->K) (r:real).
       &0 <= r /\
       (!x:E. x IN p ==> normK (f x) <= r * normE x) /\
       (!C:real.
          &0 <= C /\
          (!x:E. x IN p ==> normK (f x) <= C * normE x)
          ==> r <= C) in
  !zeroK oneK:K.
  !addK mulK:K->K->K.
  !negK:K->K.
  !normK:K->real.
  !zeroE:E.
  !addE:E->E->E.
  !negE:E->E.
  !smul:K->E->E.
  !normE:E->real.
  !p:E->bool.
  !f:E->K.
    rclike_normed_field zeroK oneK addK mulK negK normK /\
    seminormed_space
      zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroE addE negE smul normE /\
    subspace zeroE addE smul p /\
    continuous_linear_on
      addK mulK normK addE smul normE p f
    ==> ?g:E->K. ?r:real.
          continuous_linear_on
            addK mulK normK addE smul normE (UNIV:E->bool) g /\
          (!x:E. x IN p ==> g x = f x) /\
          operator_norm normK normE p f r /\
          operator_norm normK normE (UNIV:E->bool) g r`;;

title: Q866116_hahn_banach_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q866116,
;; "Hahn–Banach theorem": every continuous linear functional on a subspace of
;; a real or complex seminormed space extends to the whole space with exactly
;; the same operator norm. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A context tag presents the complete ordered real field, an RCLike scalar
;; field, and an arbitrary seminormed vector space. Subspaces and functionals
;; are arbitrary tags interpreted by conservative generic symbols. All
;; algebraic, order, norm, typing, subspace, linearity, and boundedness laws
;; are explicit. For linear maps over an RCLike field, a global action bound
;; is equivalent to continuity. The operator norm is characterized as the
;; least nonnegative action bound.

;; The complete ordered real field underlying the scalar norm.

(defstub q866116-real-member-p (ctx x) t)
(defstub q866116-real-zero (ctx) t)
(defstub q866116-real-one (ctx) t)
(defstub q866116-real-add (ctx x y) t)
(defstub q866116-real-mul (ctx x y) t)
(defstub q866116-real-neg (ctx x) t)
(defstub q866116-real-inv (ctx x) t)
(defstub q866116-real-lt (ctx x y) t)
(defstub q866116-real-set-member-p (ctx set-tag x) t)

(defun q866116-real-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (q866116-real-lt ctx y x)))

(defun-sk q866116-real-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q866116-real-member-p ctx x)
      (q866116-real-member-p ctx y)
      (q866116-real-member-p ctx z))
     (let ((zero (q866116-real-zero ctx))
           (one (q866116-real-one ctx)))
       (and
        (q866116-real-member-p
         ctx (q866116-real-add ctx x y))
        (q866116-real-member-p
         ctx (q866116-real-mul ctx x y))
        (q866116-real-member-p
         ctx (q866116-real-neg ctx x))
        (q866116-real-member-p
         ctx (q866116-real-inv ctx x))
        (equal
         (q866116-real-add
          ctx (q866116-real-add ctx x y) z)
         (q866116-real-add
          ctx x (q866116-real-add ctx y z)))
        (equal
         (q866116-real-add ctx x y)
         (q866116-real-add ctx y x))
        (equal (q866116-real-add ctx x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q866116-real-add
          ctx x (q866116-real-neg ctx x))
         zero)
        (equal
         (q866116-real-mul
          ctx (q866116-real-mul ctx x y) z)
         (q866116-real-mul
          ctx x (q866116-real-mul ctx y z)))
        (equal
         (q866116-real-mul ctx x y)
         (q866116-real-mul ctx y x))
        (equal (q866116-real-mul ctx x one) x)
        (equal (q866116-real-inv ctx zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q866116-real-mul
           ctx x (q866116-real-inv ctx x))
          one))
        (equal
         (q866116-real-mul
          ctx x (q866116-real-add ctx y z))
         (q866116-real-add
          ctx
          (q866116-real-mul ctx x y)
          (q866116-real-mul ctx x z))))))))

(defun-sk q866116-real-order-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q866116-real-member-p ctx x)
      (q866116-real-member-p ctx y)
      (q866116-real-member-p ctx z))
     (let ((zero (q866116-real-zero ctx)))
       (and
        (not (q866116-real-lt ctx x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q866116-real-lt ctx x y)
         (q866116-real-lt ctx y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q866116-real-lt ctx x y)
          (q866116-real-lt ctx y z))
         (q866116-real-lt ctx x z))
        (implies
         (q866116-real-lt ctx x y)
         (q866116-real-lt
          ctx
          (q866116-real-add ctx x z)
          (q866116-real-add ctx y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q866116-real-lt ctx zero x)
          (q866116-real-lt ctx zero y))
         (q866116-real-lt
          ctx zero (q866116-real-mul ctx x y))))))))

(defun-sk q866116-real-set-nonempty-p (ctx set-tag)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q866116-real-member-p ctx x)
     (q866116-real-set-member-p ctx set-tag x))))

(defun-sk q866116-real-upper-bound-p
    (ctx set-tag bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q866116-real-member-p ctx x)
      (q866116-real-set-member-p ctx set-tag x))
     (q866116-real-le-p ctx x bound))))

(defun-sk q866116-real-bounded-above-p (ctx set-tag)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q866116-real-member-p ctx bound)
     (q866116-real-upper-bound-p
      ctx set-tag bound))))

(defun-sk q866116-real-supremum-p
    (ctx set-tag supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q866116-real-member-p ctx supremum)
     (q866116-real-upper-bound-p
      ctx set-tag supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q866116-real-member-p ctx bound)
       (q866116-real-upper-bound-p
        ctx set-tag bound))
      (q866116-real-le-p ctx supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q866116-real-supremum-exists-p
    (ctx set-tag)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q866116-real-supremum-p
     ctx set-tag supremum)))

(defun-sk q866116-real-complete-p (ctx)
  (forall (set-tag)
    (implies
     (and
      (q866116-real-set-nonempty-p ctx set-tag)
      (q866116-real-bounded-above-p ctx set-tag))
     (q866116-real-supremum-exists-p
      ctx set-tag))))

(defun q866116-real-field-p (ctx)
  (let ((zero (q866116-real-zero ctx))
        (one (q866116-real-one ctx)))
    (and
     (q866116-real-member-p ctx zero)
     (q866116-real-member-p ctx one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q866116-real-lt ctx zero one)
     (q866116-real-field-laws-p ctx)
     (q866116-real-order-laws-p ctx)
     (q866116-real-complete-p ctx))))

;; An RCLike scalar field: either the real field or its quadratic complex
;; extension, together with the usual absolute-value norm.

(defstub q866116-complexp (ctx) t)
(defstub q866116-scalar-member-p (ctx x) t)
(defstub q866116-scalar-zero (ctx) t)
(defstub q866116-scalar-one (ctx) t)
(defstub q866116-scalar-add (ctx x y) t)
(defstub q866116-scalar-mul (ctx x y) t)
(defstub q866116-scalar-neg (ctx x) t)
(defstub q866116-scalar-inv (ctx x) t)
(defstub q866116-scalar-conj (ctx x) t)
(defstub q866116-of-real (ctx x) t)
(defstub q866116-real-part (ctx x) t)
(defstub q866116-imag-part (ctx x) t)
(defstub q866116-imaginary-unit (ctx) t)
(defstub q866116-scalar-norm (ctx x) t)

(defun-sk q866116-scalar-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx x)
      (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx y)
      (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx z))
     (let ((zero (q866116-scalar-zero ctx))
           (one (q866116-scalar-one ctx)))
       (and
        (q866116-scalar-member-p
         ctx (q866116-scalar-add ctx x y))
        (q866116-scalar-member-p
         ctx (q866116-scalar-mul ctx x y))
        (q866116-scalar-member-p
         ctx (q866116-scalar-neg ctx x))
        (q866116-scalar-member-p
         ctx (q866116-scalar-inv ctx x))
        (equal
         (q866116-scalar-add
          ctx (q866116-scalar-add ctx x y) z)
         (q866116-scalar-add
          ctx x (q866116-scalar-add ctx y z)))
        (equal
         (q866116-scalar-add ctx x y)
         (q866116-scalar-add ctx y x))
        (equal (q866116-scalar-add ctx x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q866116-scalar-add
          ctx x (q866116-scalar-neg ctx x))
         zero)
        (equal
         (q866116-scalar-mul
          ctx (q866116-scalar-mul ctx x y) z)
         (q866116-scalar-mul
          ctx x (q866116-scalar-mul ctx y z)))
        (equal
         (q866116-scalar-mul ctx x y)
         (q866116-scalar-mul ctx y x))
        (equal (q866116-scalar-mul ctx x one) x)
        (equal (q866116-scalar-inv ctx zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q866116-scalar-mul
           ctx x (q866116-scalar-inv ctx x))
          one))
        (equal
         (q866116-scalar-mul
          ctx x (q866116-scalar-add ctx y z))
         (q866116-scalar-add
          ctx
          (q866116-scalar-mul ctx x y)
          (q866116-scalar-mul ctx x z))))))))

(defun-sk q866116-real-embedding-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (r s)
    (implies
     (and
      (q866116-real-member-p ctx r)
      (q866116-real-member-p ctx s))
     (let ((of-r (q866116-of-real ctx r))
           (of-s (q866116-of-real ctx s)))
       (and
        (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx of-r)
        (equal (q866116-real-part ctx of-r) r)
        (equal
         (q866116-imag-part ctx of-r)
         (q866116-real-zero ctx))
        (equal
         (q866116-of-real
          ctx (q866116-real-add ctx r s))
         (q866116-scalar-add ctx of-r of-s))
        (equal
         (q866116-of-real
          ctx (q866116-real-mul ctx r s))
         (q866116-scalar-mul ctx of-r of-s))
        (equal
         (q866116-of-real
          ctx (q866116-real-neg ctx r))
         (q866116-scalar-neg ctx of-r)))))))

(defun-sk q866116-scalar-coordinate-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx x)
      (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx y))
     (let* ((re-x (q866116-real-part ctx x))
            (im-x (q866116-imag-part ctx x))
            (of-re-x (q866116-of-real ctx re-x))
            (of-im-x (q866116-of-real ctx im-x))
            (i (q866116-imaginary-unit ctx))
            (im-coordinate
             (q866116-scalar-mul ctx of-im-x i)))
       (and
        (q866116-real-member-p ctx re-x)
        (q866116-real-member-p ctx im-x)
        (q866116-scalar-member-p
         ctx (q866116-scalar-conj ctx x))
        (equal
         x
         (q866116-scalar-add
          ctx of-re-x im-coordinate))
        (equal
         (q866116-scalar-conj ctx x)
         (q866116-scalar-add
          ctx
          of-re-x
          (q866116-scalar-neg ctx im-coordinate)))
        (equal
         (q866116-scalar-conj
          ctx (q866116-scalar-add ctx x y))
         (q866116-scalar-add
          ctx
          (q866116-scalar-conj ctx x)
          (q866116-scalar-conj ctx y)))
        (equal
         (q866116-scalar-conj
          ctx (q866116-scalar-mul ctx x y))
         (q866116-scalar-mul
          ctx
          (q866116-scalar-conj ctx x)
          (q866116-scalar-conj ctx y)))
        (equal
         (q866116-scalar-conj
          ctx (q866116-scalar-conj ctx x))
         x)
        (if (q866116-complexp ctx)
            t
          (and
           (equal im-x (q866116-real-zero ctx))
           (equal x of-re-x)
           (equal (q866116-scalar-conj ctx x) x))))))))

(defun-sk q866116-scalar-norm-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx x)
      (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx y))
     (let* ((zero-r (q866116-real-zero ctx))
            (zero-k (q866116-scalar-zero ctx))
            (norm-x (q866116-scalar-norm ctx x))
            (norm-y (q866116-scalar-norm ctx y))
            (re-x (q866116-real-part ctx x))
            (im-x (q866116-imag-part ctx x)))
       (and
        (q866116-real-member-p ctx norm-x)
        (q866116-real-member-p ctx norm-y)
        (q866116-real-le-p ctx zero-r norm-x)
        (iff (equal norm-x zero-r)
             (equal x zero-k))
        (equal
         (q866116-scalar-norm
          ctx (q866116-scalar-neg ctx x))
         norm-x)
        (q866116-real-le-p
         ctx
         (q866116-scalar-norm
          ctx (q866116-scalar-add ctx x y))
         (q866116-real-add ctx norm-x norm-y))
        (equal
         (q866116-scalar-norm
          ctx (q866116-scalar-mul ctx x y))
         (q866116-real-mul ctx norm-x norm-y))
        (equal
         (q866116-real-mul ctx norm-x norm-x)
         (q866116-real-add
          ctx
          (q866116-real-mul ctx re-x re-x)
          (q866116-real-mul ctx im-x im-x))))))))

(defun-sk q866116-large-norm-scalar-exists-p (ctx)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx x)
     (q866116-real-lt
      ctx
      (q866116-real-one ctx)
      (q866116-scalar-norm ctx x)))))

(defun q866116-rclike-field-p (ctx)
  (let ((real-zero (q866116-real-zero ctx))
        (real-one (q866116-real-one ctx))
        (zero (q866116-scalar-zero ctx))
        (one (q866116-scalar-one ctx))
        (i (q866116-imaginary-unit ctx)))
    (and
     (booleanp (q866116-complexp ctx))
     (q866116-real-field-p ctx)
     (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx zero)
     (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx i)
     (equal (q866116-of-real ctx real-zero) zero)
     (equal (q866116-of-real ctx real-one) one)
     (equal (q866116-real-part ctx zero) real-zero)
     (equal (q866116-imag-part ctx zero) real-zero)
     (equal (q866116-real-part ctx one) real-one)
     (equal (q866116-imag-part ctx one) real-zero)
     (q866116-scalar-field-laws-p ctx)
     (q866116-real-embedding-laws-p ctx)
     (q866116-scalar-coordinate-laws-p ctx)
     (q866116-scalar-norm-laws-p ctx)
     (q866116-large-norm-scalar-exists-p ctx)
     (if (q866116-complexp ctx)
         (and
          (equal (q866116-real-part ctx i) real-zero)
          (equal (q866116-imag-part ctx i) real-one)
          (equal
           (q866116-scalar-mul ctx i i)
           (q866116-scalar-neg ctx one)))
       (equal i zero)))))

;; The arbitrary seminormed vector space over the RCLike field.

(defstub q866116-vector-member-p (ctx x) t)
(defstub q866116-vector-zero (ctx) t)
(defstub q866116-vector-add (ctx x y) t)
(defstub q866116-vector-neg (ctx x) t)
(defstub q866116-vector-smul (ctx scalar vector) t)

(defun-sk q866116-add-comm-group-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q866116-vector-member-p ctx x)
      (q866116-vector-member-p ctx y)
      (q866116-vector-member-p ctx z))
     (let ((zero (q866116-vector-zero ctx)))
       (and
        (q866116-vector-member-p
         ctx (q866116-vector-add ctx x y))
        (q866116-vector-member-p
         ctx (q866116-vector-neg ctx x))
        (equal
         (q866116-vector-add
          ctx (q866116-vector-add ctx x y) z)
         (q866116-vector-add
          ctx x (q866116-vector-add ctx y z)))
        (equal
         (q866116-vector-add ctx x y)
         (q866116-vector-add ctx y x))
        (equal (q866116-vector-add ctx x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q866116-vector-add
          ctx x (q866116-vector-neg ctx x))
         zero))))))

(defun-sk q866116-seminorm-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q866116-vector-member-p ctx x)
      (q866116-vector-member-p ctx y))
     (let ((zero-r (q866116-real-zero ctx))
           (norm-x (q866116-vector-norm ctx x))
           (norm-y (q866116-vector-norm ctx y)))
       (and
        (q866116-real-member-p ctx norm-x)
        (q866116-real-member-p ctx norm-y)
        (q866116-real-le-p ctx zero-r norm-x)
        (equal
         (q866116-vector-norm
          ctx (q866116-vector-zero ctx))
         zero-r)
        (equal
         (q866116-vector-norm
          ctx (q866116-vector-neg ctx x))
         norm-x)
        (q866116-real-le-p
         ctx
         (q866116-vector-norm
          ctx (q866116-vector-add ctx x y))
         (q866116-real-add ctx norm-x norm-y)))))))

(defun-sk q866116-vector-space-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (a b x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx a)
      (q866116-scalar-member-p ctx b)
      (q866116-vector-member-p ctx x)
      (q866116-vector-member-p ctx y))
     (and
      (q866116-vector-member-p
       ctx (q866116-vector-smul ctx a x))
      (equal
       (q866116-vector-smul
        ctx (q866116-scalar-one ctx) x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q866116-vector-smul
        ctx (q866116-scalar-mul ctx a b) x)
       (q866116-vector-smul
        ctx a (q866116-vector-smul ctx b x)))
      (equal
       (q866116-vector-smul
        ctx (q866116-scalar-add ctx a b) x)
       (q866116-vector-add
        ctx
        (q866116-vector-smul ctx a x)
        (q866116-vector-smul ctx b x)))
      (equal
       (q866116-vector-smul
        ctx a (q866116-vector-add ctx x y))
       (q866116-vector-add
        ctx
        (q866116-vector-smul ctx a x)
        (q866116-vector-smul ctx a y)))
      (equal
       (q866116-vector-smul
        ctx (q866116-scalar-zero ctx) x)
       (q866116-vector-zero ctx))
      (equal
       (q866116-vector-smul
        ctx a (q866116-vector-zero ctx))
       (q866116-vector-zero ctx))
      (equal
       (q866116-vector-norm
        ctx (q866116-vector-smul ctx a x))
       (q866116-real-mul
        ctx
        (q866116-scalar-norm ctx a)
        (q866116-vector-norm ctx x)))))))

(defun q866116-seminormed-space-p (ctx)
  (and
   (q866116-vector-member-p
    ctx (q866116-vector-zero ctx))
   (q866116-add-comm-group-laws-p ctx)
   (q866116-seminorm-laws-p ctx)
   (q866116-vector-space-laws-p ctx)))

;; Arbitrary linear subspaces and scalar-valued linear functionals.

(defstub q866116-subspace-member-p
  (ctx subspace-tag vector)

title: Q866116_hahn_banach_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q866116,
-- "Hahn–Banach theorem": every continuous linear functional on a linear
-- subspace of a seminormed space over the real or complex scalars extends to
-- the whole space without changing its operator norm. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q866116_hahn_banach_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} A =
  A -> Bottom {a}

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

-- A complete Archimedean ordered field presents the real scalar line.
record RealLine
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) -> Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNatR m == fromNatR n -> m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set r) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open RealLine

data ScalarKind : Set where
  realScalar    : ScalarKind
  complexScalar : ScalarKind

data CanonicalScalar
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  ScalarKind ->
  Set r where

  realValue :
    R ->
    CanonicalScalar R realScalar
  complexValue :
    R ->
    R ->
    CanonicalScalar R complexScalar

canonicalZero :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RealLine R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalZero reals realScalar =
  realValue (zeroR reals)
canonicalZero reals complexScalar =
  complexValue (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

canonicalOne :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RealLine R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalOne reals realScalar =
  realValue (oneR reals)
canonicalOne reals complexScalar =
  complexValue (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

canonicalAdd :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RealLine R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalAdd reals realScalar (realValue x) (realValue y) =
  realValue (addR reals x y)
canonicalAdd reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) (complexValue c d) =
  complexValue (addR reals a c) (addR reals b d)

canonicalMultiply :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RealLine R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalMultiply reals realScalar (realValue x) (realValue y) =
  realValue (multiplyR reals x y)
canonicalMultiply reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) (complexValue c d) =
  complexValue
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (negateR reals (multiplyR reals b d)))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

canonicalNegate :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RealLine R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalNegate reals realScalar (realValue x) =
  realValue (negateR reals x)
canonicalNegate reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) =
  complexValue (negateR reals a) (negateR reals b)

CanonicalNormValue :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  R ->
  Set r
CanonicalNormValue reals realScalar (realValue x) value =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) value)
    (multiplyR reals value value == multiplyR reals x x)
CanonicalNormValue reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) value =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) value)
    (multiplyR reals value value ==
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals a a)
        (multiplyR reals b b))

-- This packages exactly a real or complex scalar field, up to isomorphism.
record RCLike
  {k r : Level}
  (K : Set k)
  (R : Set r)
  (reals : RealLine R) :
  Set (lsuc (k ⊔ r)) where

  field
    scalar-kind :
      ScalarKind
    to-canonical :
      K -> CanonicalScalar R scalar-kind
    from-canonical :
      CanonicalScalar R scalar-kind -> K
    from-after-to-canonical :
      (x : K) ->
      from-canonical (to-canonical x) == x
    to-after-from-canonical :
      (x : CanonicalScalar R scalar-kind) ->
      to-canonical (from-canonical x) == x

    normK :
      K -> R
    norm-canonical :
      (x : K) ->
      CanonicalNormValue reals scalar-kind (to-canonical x) (normK x)

open RCLike

zeroK :
  {k r : Level} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  RCLike K R reals ->
  K
zeroK {reals = reals} scalars =
  from-canonical scalars (canonicalZero reals (scalar-kind scalars))

oneK :
  {k r : Level} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  RCLike K R reals ->
  K
oneK {reals = reals} scalars =
  from-canonical scalars (canonicalOne reals (scalar-kind scalars))

addK :
  {k r : Level} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  (scalars : RCLike K R reals) ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
addK {reals = reals} scalars x y =
  from-canonical scalars
    (canonicalAdd reals (scalar-kind scalars)
      (to-canonical scalars x)
      (to-canonical scalars y))

multiplyK :
  {k r : Level} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  (scalars : RCLike K R reals) ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
multiplyK {reals = reals} scalars x y =
  from-canonical scalars
    (canonicalMultiply reals (scalar-kind scalars)
      (to-canonical scalars x)
      (to-canonical scalars y))

negateK :
  {k r : Level} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  (scalars : RCLike K R reals) ->
  K ->
  K
negateK {reals = reals} scalars x =
  from-canonical scalars
    (canonicalNegate reals (scalar-kind scalars)
      (to-canonical scalars x))

record SeminormedSpace
  {k r v : Level}
  (K : Set k)
  (R : Set r)
  (V : Set v)
  (reals : RealLine R)
  (scalars : RCLike K R reals) :
  Set (lsuc (k ⊔ r ⊔ v)) where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : K -> V -> V
    normV : V -> R

    add-commutativeV :
      (x y : V) -> addV x y == addV y x
    add-associativeV :
      (x y z : V) ->
      addV (addV x y) z == addV x (addV y z)
    add-zeroV :
      (x : V) -> addV x zeroV == x
    add-inverseV :
      (x : V) -> addV x (negateV x) == zeroV

    scale-oneV :
      (x : V) -> scaleV (oneK scalars) x == x
    scale-associativeV :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyK scalars a b) x == scaleV a (scaleV b x)
    scale-add-vectorsV :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV x y) == addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV a y)
    scale-add-scalarsV :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scaleV (addK scalars a b) x == addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV b x)

    norm-nonnegativeV :
      (x : V) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normV x)
    norm-zeroV :
      normV zeroV == zeroR reals
    norm-negateV :
      (x : V) -> normV (negateV x) == normV x
    norm-addV :
      (x y : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (normV (addV x y))
        (addR reals (normV x) (normV y))
    norm-scaleV :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      normV (scaleV a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK scalars a) (normV x)

open SeminormedSpace

-- A bundled carrier with an isometric injective linear inclusion.
record LinearSubspace
  {k r e : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {R : Set r}
  {E : Set e}
  {reals : RealLine R}
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals}
  (ambient : SeminormedSpace K R E reals scalars) :
  Set (lsuc (k ⊔ r ⊔ e)) where

  field
    Carrier :
      Set e
    subspaceSpace :
      SeminormedSpace K R Carrier reals scalars
    include :
      Carrier -> E
    include-injective :
      (x y : Carrier) ->
      include x == include y ->
      x == y
    include-zero :
      include (zeroV subspaceSpace) == zeroV ambient
    include-add :
      (x y : Carrier) ->
      include (addV subspaceSpace x y) ==
      addV ambient (include x) (include y)
    include-scale :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : Carrier) ->
      include (scaleV subspaceSpace a x) ==
      scaleV ambient a (include x)
    include-norm :
      (x : Carrier) ->
      normV subspaceSpace x == normV ambient (include x)

open LinearSubspace

-- Bounded linear functionals carry the least nonnegative bound, their
-- operator norm, as data characterized by its universal property.
record ContinuousLinearFunctional
  {k r v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {R : Set r}
  {V : Set v}
  {reals : RealLine R}
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals}
  (domain : SeminormedSpace K R V reals scalars) :
  Set (lsuc (k ⊔ r ⊔ v)) where

  field
    apply :
      V -> K
    map-add :
      (x y : V) ->
      apply (addV domain x y) ==
      addK scalars (apply x) (apply y)
    map-scale :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      apply (scaleV domain a x) ==
      multiplyK scalars a (apply x)

    operatorNorm :
      R
    operatorNorm-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) operatorNorm
    operatorNorm-bounds :
      (x : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normK scalars (apply x))
        (multiplyR reals operatorNorm (normV domain x))
    operatorNorm-least :
      (bound : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) bound ->
      ((x : V) ->
        lessOrEqualR reals
          (normK scalars (apply x))
          (multiplyR reals bound (normV domain x))) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals operatorNorm bound

open ContinuousLinearFunctional

hahn-banach-theorem :
  {r k e : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ k ⊔ e))
hahn-banach-theorem {r} {k} {e} =
  (R : Set r) ->
  (K : Set k) ->
  (E : Set e) ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  (scalars : RCLike K R reals) ->
  (ambient : SeminormedSpace K R E reals scalars) ->
  (subspace : LinearSubspace ambient) ->
  (f : ContinuousLinearFunctional (subspaceSpace subspace)) ->
  Exists (ContinuousLinearFunctional ambient)
    (\ g ->
      Both
        ((x : Carrier subspace) ->
          apply g (include subspace x) == apply f x)
        (operatorNorm g == operatorNorm f))

title: Q866116_hahn_banach_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q866116 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q866116), "Hahn–Banach theorem": every
  continuous scalar-valued linear functional on a subspace of a seminormed
  space over a real-like normed field extends to the whole space with the
  same operator norm. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory complexTheory;

val q866116_nontrivially_normed_field_def = new_definition (
  "q866116_nontrivially_normed_field_def",
  ``q866116_nontrivially_normed_field
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) <=>
      zeroK <> oneK /\
      (!a b. addK a b = addK b a) /\
      (!a b c. addK (addK a b) c = addK a (addK b c)) /\
      (!a. addK a zeroK = a) /\
      (!a. addK a (negK a) = zeroK) /\
      (!a b. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
      (!a b c. mulK (mulK a b) c = mulK a (mulK b c)) /\
      (!a. mulK a oneK = a) /\
      (!a b c.
        mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
      invK zeroK = zeroK /\
      (!a. a <> zeroK ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
      (!a. 0 <= normK a) /\
      (!a. (normK a = 0) <=> (a = zeroK)) /\
      (!a. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\
      (!a b. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
      (!a b. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
      (?a. 1 < normK a)``);

val q866116_real_field_isometry_def = new_definition (
  "q866116_real_field_isometry_def",
  ``q866116_real_field_isometry
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (toReal : 'k -> real) (fromReal : real -> 'k) <=>
      toReal zeroK = 0 /\
      toReal oneK = 1 /\
      (!a b. toReal (addK a b) = toReal a + toReal b) /\
      (!a b. toReal (mulK a b) = toReal a * toReal b) /\
      (!a. normK a = abs (toReal a)) /\
      (!a. fromReal (toReal a) = a) /\
      (!r. toReal (fromReal r) = r)``);

val q866116_complex_field_isometry_def = new_definition (
  "q866116_complex_field_isometry_def",
  ``q866116_complex_field_isometry
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (toComplex : 'k -> complex) (fromComplex : complex -> 'k) <=>
      toComplex zeroK = 0 /\
      toComplex oneK = 1 /\
      (!a b. toComplex (addK a b) = toComplex a + toComplex b) /\
      (!a b. toComplex (mulK a b) = toComplex a * toComplex b) /\
      (!a. normK a = modu (toComplex a)) /\
      (!a. fromComplex (toComplex a) = a) /\
      (!z. toComplex (fromComplex z) = z)``);

val q866116_is_rclike_normed_field_def = new_definition (
  "q866116_is_rclike_normed_field_def",
  ``q866116_is_rclike_normed_field
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) <=>
      q866116_nontrivially_normed_field
        zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
      ((?toReal : 'k -> real. ?fromReal : real -> 'k.
          q866116_real_field_isometry
            zeroK oneK addK mulK normK toReal fromReal) \/
       (?toComplex : 'k -> complex. ?fromComplex : complex -> 'k.
          q866116_complex_field_isometry
            zeroK oneK addK mulK normK toComplex fromComplex))``);

val q866116_seminormed_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q866116_seminormed_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q866116_seminormed_add_comm_group
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. addE (addE x y) z = addE x (addE y z)) /\
      (!x y. addE x y = addE y x) /\
      (!x. addE zeroE x = x) /\
      (!x. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
      (!x. 0 <= normE x) /\
      normE zeroE = 0 /\
      (!x. normE (negE x) = normE x) /\
      (!x y. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y)``);

val q866116_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q866116_normed_space_def",
  ``q866116_normed_space
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x. smul oneK x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x.
        smul (addK a b) x = addE (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y.
        smul a (addE x y) = addE (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul zeroK x = zeroE) /\
      (!a. smul a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!a x. normE (smul a x) = normK a * normE x)``);

val q866116_subspace_def = new_definition (
  "q866116_subspace_def",
  ``q866116_subspace
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) (p : 'e set) <=>
      zeroE IN p /\
      (!x y. x IN p /\ y IN p ==> addE x y IN p) /\
      (!a x. x IN p ==> smul a x IN p)``);

val q866116_continuous_linear_functional_on_def = new_definition (
  "q866116_continuous_linear_functional_on_def",
  ``q866116_continuous_linear_functional_on
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (p : 'e set) (f : 'e -> 'k) <=>
      (!x y.
        x IN p /\ y IN p ==>
        f (addE x y) = addK (f x) (f y)) /\
      (!a x.
        x IN p ==>
        f (smul a x) = mulK a (f x)) /\
      ?C : real.
        0 <= C /\
        !x. x IN p ==> normK (f x) <= C * normE x``);

val q866116_is_operator_norm_on_def = new_definition (
  "q866116_is_operator_norm_on_def",
  ``q866116_is_operator_norm_on
      (normK : 'k -> real) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (p : 'e set) (f : 'e -> 'k) (n : real) <=>
      0 <= n /\
      (!x. x IN p ==> normK (f x) <= n * normE x) /\
      !C : real.
        0 <= C /\
        (!x. x IN p ==> normK (f x) <= C * normE x)
        ==>
        n <= C``);

val q866116_same_operator_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q866116_same_operator_norm_def",
  ``q866116_same_operator_norm
      (normK : 'k -> real) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (p : 'e set) (f : 'e -> 'k) (g : 'e -> 'k) <=>
      ?n : real.
        q866116_is_operator_norm_on normK normE p f n /\
        q866116_is_operator_norm_on normK normE UNIV g n``);

val exists_extension_norm_eq =
  ``!(zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smul : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (p : 'e set) (f : 'e -> 'k).
      q866116_is_rclike_normed_field
        zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
      q866116_seminormed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
      q866116_normed_space
        zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroE addE smul normE /\
      q866116_subspace zeroE addE smul p /\
      q866116_continuous_linear_functional_on
        addK mulK normK addE smul normE p f
      ==>
      ?g : 'e -> 'k.
        q866116_continuous_linear_functional_on
          addK mulK normK addE smul normE UNIV g /\
        (!x. x IN p ==> g x = f x) /\
        q866116_same_operator_norm normK normE p f g``;

title: Q866116_hahn_banach_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q866116
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q866116), "Hahn–Banach theorem": every
  continuous linear functional on a subspace of a seminormed space over a
  real- or complex-like normed field extends to the whole space without
  changing its operator norm. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q866116SeminormedSpace K V states exactly the additive seminorm and scalar
  laws for a seminormed vector space V over K; norm definiteness is not
  required. Q866116ContinuousLinear K V T says that T is a K-linear
  functional with a finite global seminorm bound, which is equivalent to
  continuity over the nontrivially normed fields RRfld and CCfld.
  Q866116OperatorNorm K V T is the infimum of all nonnegative global bounds,
  hence the usual operator norm of T.

  Mathlib's IsRCLikeNormedField parameter is represented by SetMM's canonical
  real and complex normed fields RRfld and CCfld. Every such mathlib field is
  isometrically isomorphic to one of these two canonical fields, and transport
  of the scalar field, vector space, subspace, and functional across that
  isomorphism preserves extension, restriction, and operator norm; conversely
  RRfld and CCfld instantiate the source field class.

  For p in LSubSp(V), V |`s p is the inherited vector-space structure on p.
  The final assertion retains the arbitrary space, subspace, and functional,
  and keeps the extending functional g internally existentially quantified.
  It is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All preceding $a
  declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this database contains
  no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q866116SeminormedSpace Q866116ContinuousLinear Q866116OperatorNorm $.

q866116-seminormed-space-syntax
  $a wff ( Q866116SeminormedSpace K V ) $.
q866116-continuous-linear-syntax
  $a wff ( Q866116ContinuousLinear K V T ) $.
q866116-operator-norm-syntax
  $a class ( Q866116OperatorNorm K V T ) $.

${
  $d K V a x y $.

  q866116-seminormed-space-definition $a |- (
    ( Q866116SeminormedSpace K V )
    <->
    (
      V e. LVec
      /\
      ( Scalar ` V ) = K
      /\
      ( norm ` V ) : ( Base ` V ) --> RR
      /\
      ( ( norm ` V ) ` ( 0g ` V ) ) = 0
      /\
      A. x e. ( Base ` V )
        0 <_ ( ( norm ` V ) ` x )
      /\
      A. x e. ( Base ` V )
        A. y e. ( Base ` V )
          (
            ( norm ` V )
            `
            ( x ( +g ` V ) y )
          )
          <_
          (
            ( ( norm ` V ) ` x )
            +
            ( ( norm ` V ) ` y )
          )
      /\
      A. a e. ( Base ` K )
        A. x e. ( Base ` V )
          (
            ( norm ` V )
            `
            ( a ( .s ` V ) x )
          )
          =
          (
            ( ( norm ` K ) ` a )
            x.
            ( ( norm ` V ) ` x )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C K T V x $.

  q866116-continuous-linear-definition $a |- (
    ( Q866116ContinuousLinear K V T )
    <->
    (
      T e. ( V LMHom ( ringLMod ` K ) )
      /\
      E. C e. RR
        (
          0 <_ C
          /\
          A. x e. ( Base ` V )
            (
              ( norm ` K )
              `
              ( T ` x )
            )
            <_
            (
              C
              x.
              ( ( norm ` V ) ` x )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C K T V x $.

  q866116-operator-norm-definition $a |- (
    Q866116OperatorNorm K V T
  ) = inf (
    {
      C e. RR |
      (
        0 <_ C
        /\
        A. x e. ( Base ` V )
          (
            ( norm ` K )
            `
            ( T ` x )
          )
          <_
          (
            C
            x.
            ( ( norm ` V ) ` x )
          )
      )
    }
    ,
    RR
    ,
    <
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d K V f g p x $.

  thousand-theorems-q866116-hahn-banach $a |-
    A. K e. { RRfld , CCfld }
      A. V
        (
          ( Q866116SeminormedSpace K V )
          ->
          A. p e. ( LSubSp ` V )
            A. f
              (
                ( Q866116ContinuousLinear K ( V |`s p ) f )
                ->
                E. g
                  (
                    ( Q866116ContinuousLinear K V g )
                    /\
                    A. x e. p
                      ( g ` x ) = ( f ` x )
                    /\
                    (
                      Q866116OperatorNorm K V g
                    )
                    =
                    (
                      Q866116OperatorNorm K ( V |`s p ) f
                    )
                  )
              )
        )
  $.
$}

title: Q866116_hahn_banach_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q866116
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q866116), "Hahn–Banach theorem": over a real or
:: complex seminormed vector space, every continuous scalar-valued linear
:: functional on a linear subspace extends continuously to the whole space
:: with unchanged operator norm. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies RLVECT_1, ALGSTR_0, VECTSP_1, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1,
      ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, SUPINF_2, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, NUMBERS, CARD_1,
      SQUARE_1, COMPLFLD, GROUP_1, REAL_1, STRUCT_0, HAHNBAN, FUNCT_1,
      FUNCOP_1, MSSUBFAM, UNIALG_1, BINOP_1, LATTICES, MESFUNC1, ZFMISC_1,
      XXREAL_0, RLSUB_1, TARSKI, REALSET1, POWER, HAHNBAN1, FUNCT_7, NAT_1;

      XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, REAL_1, NAT_1, SQUARE_1, POWER, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, RLSUB_1, VECTSP_4, FUNCT_1,
      FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, RELSET_1, NATTRA_1, FUNCOP_1, FUNCT_3, HAHNBAN,
      COMPLFLD, XXREAL_0, GRCAT_1, HAHNBAN1;

      COMPLFLD, VECTSP_4, NATTRA_1, BORSUK_1, HAHNBAN, SUPINF_1, FUNCOP_1,
      GRCAT_1, HAHNBAN1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
      MEMBERED, STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1, COMPLFLD, HAHNBAN, ALGSTR_0,
      SQUARE_1, HAHNBAN1;

      HAHNBAN1;

      ALGSTR_0, HAHNBAN1;
 expansions TARSKI, VECTSP_1, HAHNBAN1;

begin

:: Seminorm bounds encode continuity. Equality of operator norms is represented
:: by equality of the sets of nonnegative constants that bound the two
:: functionals relative to the seminorm.

::$P-
theorem
  (for V being RealLinearSpace,
       p being Function of the carrier of V,REAL,
       M being Subspace of V,
       f being linear-Functional of M st
    (for x being VECTOR of V holds 0 <= p.x) &
    (for x,y being VECTOR of V holds p.(x+y) <= p.x + p.y) &
    (for a being Real, x being VECTOR of V holds
      p.(a*x) = |.a.| * p.x) &
    (ex C being Real st
      0 <= C &
      for x being VECTOR of M, v being VECTOR of V st x = v holds
        |.f.x.| <= C * p.v)
  holds
    ex g being linear-Functional of V st
      g|the carrier of M = f &
      (ex C being Real st
        0 <= C &
        for v being VECTOR of V holds |.g.v.| <= C * p.v) &
      (for C being Real holds
        (0 <= C &
          (for v being VECTOR of V holds |.g.v.| <= C * p.v))
        iff
        (0 <= C &
          (for x being VECTOR of M, v being VECTOR of V st x = v holds
            |.f.x.| <= C * p.v)))) &
  (for V being non empty VectSp of F_Complex,
       p being Function of the carrier of V,REAL,
       M being Subspace of V,
       f being linear-Functional of M st
    (for x being Vector of V holds 0 <= p.x) &
    (for x,y being Vector of V holds p.(x+y) <= p.x + p.y) &
    (for a being Element of F_Complex, x being Vector of V holds
      p.(a*x) = |.a.| * p.x) &
    (ex C being Real st
      0 <= C &
      for x being Vector of M, v being Vector of V st x = v holds
        |.f.x.| <= C * p.v)
  holds
    ex g being linear-Functional of V st
      g|the carrier of M = f &
      (ex C being Real st
        0 <= C &
        for v being Vector of V holds |.g.v.| <= C * p.v) &
      (for C being Real holds
        (0 <= C &
          (for v being Vector of V holds |.g.v.| <= C * p.v))
        iff
        (0 <= C &
          (for x being Vector of M, v being Vector of V st x = v holds
            |.f.x.| <= C * p.v))))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q866116_hahn_banach_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q866116
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q866116), "Hahn–Banach theorem": a continuous linear
% functional on a subspace of a seminormed space over a real- or complex-like
% normed field has a norm-preserving continuous linear extension to the whole
% space. This file contains no proof.

Q866116_hahn_banach_theorem[
  K: TYPE+,
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroK, oneK: K,
  negK, invK: [K -> K],
  addK, mulK: [K, K -> K],
  normK: [K -> real],
  zeroE: E,
  negE: [E -> E],
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  smulE: [K, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  functional: TYPE = [E -> K]
  carrier: TYPE = [E -> bool]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(z, w: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(z) + real_part(w),
       imag_part := imag_part(z) + imag_part(w) #)

  complex_mul(z, w: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(z) * real_part(w)
           - imag_part(z) * imag_part(w),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(z) * imag_part(w)
           + imag_part(z) * real_part(w) #)

  complex_norm_squared(z: complex): real =
    real_part(z) ^ 2 + imag_part(z) ^ 2

  nontrivially_normed_field: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: K):
      addK(a, b) = addK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        addK(addK(a, b), c) = addK(a, addK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        addK(a, zeroK) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        addK(a, negK(a)) = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        mulK(a, b) = mulK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(mulK(a, b), c) = mulK(a, mulK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        mulK(a, oneK) = a)
      AND zeroK /= oneK
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(a, addK(b, c)) =
          addK(mulK(a, b), mulK(a, c)))
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        a /= zeroK IMPLIES mulK(a, invK(a)) = oneK)
      AND normK(zeroK) = 0
      AND normK(oneK) = 1
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        0 <= normK(a))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        normK(a) = 0 IFF a = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        normK(negK(a)) = normK(a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        normK(addK(a, b)) <= normK(a) + normK(b))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        normK(mulK(a, b)) = normK(a) * normK(b))
      AND (EXISTS (a: K):
        1 < normK(a))

  real_like: bool =
    EXISTS (to_real: [K -> real]), (from_real: [real -> K]):
      (FORALL (r: real):
        to_real(from_real(r)) = r)
        AND (FORALL (a: K):
          from_real(to_real(a)) = a)
        AND from_real(0) = zeroK
        AND from_real(1) = oneK
        AND (FORALL (r, s: real):
          from_real(r + s) =
            addK(from_real(r), from_real(s)))
        AND (FORALL (r, s: real):
          from_real(r * s) =
            mulK(from_real(r), from_real(s)))
        AND (FORALL (r: real):
          normK(from_real(r)) = abs(r))

  complex_like: bool =
    EXISTS (to_complex: [K -> complex]),
           (from_complex: [complex -> K]):
      (FORALL (z: complex):
        to_complex(from_complex(z)) = z)
        AND (FORALL (a: K):
          from_complex(to_complex(a)) = a)
        AND from_complex(complex_zero) = zeroK
        AND from_complex(complex_one) = oneK
        AND (FORALL (z, w: complex):
          from_complex(complex_add(z, w)) =
            addK(from_complex(z), from_complex(w)))
        AND (FORALL (z, w: complex):
          from_complex(complex_mul(z, w)) =
            mulK(from_complex(z), from_complex(w)))
        AND (FORALL (z: complex):
          normK(from_complex(z)) ^ 2 =
            complex_norm_squared(z))

  is_rclike_normed_field: bool =
    nontrivially_normed_field
      AND (real_like OR complex_like)

  seminormed_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND normE(zeroE) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smulE(addK(a, b), x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smulE(mulK(a, b), x) =
          smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(oneK, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(zeroK, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) = normK(a) * normE(x))

  full_space(x: E): bool = TRUE

  is_subspace(p: carrier): bool =
    p(zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        p(x) AND p(y) IMPLIES p(addE(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        p(x) IMPLIES p(smulE(a, x)))

  linear_on(p: carrier, f: functional): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      p(x) AND p(y) IMPLIES
        f(addE(x, y)) = addK(f(x), f(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        p(x) IMPLIES
          f(smulE(a, x)) = mulK(a, f(x)))

  bounded_by(
      p: carrier,
      f: functional,
      bound: real): bool =
    0 <= bound
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        p(x) IMPLIES
          normK(f(x)) <= bound * normE(x))

  continuous_linear_on(
      p: carrier,
      f: functional): bool =
    linear_on(p, f)
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        bounded_by(p, f, bound)

  is_operator_norm(
      p: carrier,
      f: functional,
      value: real): bool =
    bounded_by(p, f, value)
      AND (FORALL (bound: real):
        bounded_by(p, f, bound) IMPLIES value <= bound)

  same_operator_norm(
      p: carrier,
      f, g: functional): bool =
    EXISTS (value: real):
      is_operator_norm(p, f, value)
        AND is_operator_norm(full_space, g, value)

  extends(p: carrier, f, g: functional): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      p(x) IMPLIES g(x) = f(x)

  exists_extension_norm_eq: bool =
    (is_rclike_normed_field AND seminormed_space)
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (p: carrier), (f: functional):
          is_subspace(p)
            AND continuous_linear_on(p, f)
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (g: functional):
              continuous_linear_on(full_space, g)
                AND extends(p, f, g)
                AND same_operator_norm(p, f, g))
END Q866116_hahn_banach_theorem

definition q869647_is_partial_order ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<times> 'a) set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q869647_is_partial_order A r \<longleftrightarrow>
    r \<subseteq> A \<times> A \<and>

    q869647_is_partial_order A r \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>A. \<forall>y\<in>A. (x, y) \<in> r \<or> (y, x) \<in> r)"

  assumes "q869647_is_partial_order A r"

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q869647
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q869647), "Szpilrajn extension theorem": every
-- partial-order relation on an arbitrary type has a linear-order extension
-- containing the original relation. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q869647_szpilrajn_extension_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)

record HProp (p : Level) : Set (lsuc p) where
  constructor proposition
  field
    Carrier : Set p
    carrier-is-proposition :
      (left right : Carrier) →
      left ≡ right

open HProp using (Carrier)

Relation :
  {a : Level} →
  (p : Level) →
  Set a →
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Relation p A =
  A → A → HProp p

data Either
  {p q : Level}
  (P : Set p)
  (Q : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  left  : P → Either P Q
  right : Q → Either P Q

record IsPartialOrder
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (relation : Relation p A) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  field
    reflexive :
      (x : A) →
      Carrier (relation x x)
    transitive :
      (x y z : A) →
      Carrier (relation x y) →
      Carrier (relation y z) →
      Carrier (relation x z)
    antisymmetric :
      (x y : A) →
      Carrier (relation x y) →
      Carrier (relation y x) →
      x ≡ y

record IsLinearOrder
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (relation : Relation p A) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  field
    partial-order :
      IsPartialOrder relation
    total :
      (x y : A) →
      Either
        (Carrier (relation x y))
        (Carrier (relation y x))

Extends :
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a} →
  Relation p A →
  Relation p A →
  Set (a ⊔ p)
Extends original extension =
  (x y : _) →
  Carrier (original x y) →
  Carrier (extension x y)

record LinearExtension
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (original : Relation p A) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p) where

  constructor linear-extension
  field
    extension-relation :
      Relation p A
    extension-is-linear :
      IsLinearOrder extension-relation
    contains-original :
      Extends original extension-relation

szpilrajn-extension-theorem :
  {a p : Level} →
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ p))
szpilrajn-extension-theorem {a} {p} =
  (A : Set a) →
  (relation : Relation p A) →
  IsPartialOrder relation →
  LinearExtension relation

content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q869647,
% "Szpilrajn extension theorem": every partial order extends to a linear order.
% This file contains no proof.

szpilrajn_extension_theorem_Q869647[
  A: TYPE,
  r: [A, A -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  relation: TYPE = [A, A -> bool]

  is_partial_order(order: relation): bool =
    (FORALL (x: A):
      order(x, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
      order(x, y) AND order(y, z)
        IMPLIES order(x, z))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      order(x, y) AND order(y, x)
        IMPLIES x = y)

  is_linear_order(order: relation): bool =
    is_partial_order(order)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      order(x, y) OR order(y, x))

  relation_extends(
      smaller, larger: relation): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: A):
      smaller(x, y) IMPLIES larger(x, y)

  extend_partialOrder: bool =
    is_partial_order(r)
      IMPLIES
    EXISTS (s: relation):
      is_linear_order(s)
        AND relation_extends(r, s)
END szpilrajn_extension_theorem_Q869647

title: Q877489_apollonius_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q877489
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q877489), "Apollonius's theorem": in an arbitrary
  real inner-product affine space, the sum of the squared distances from a
  point to two endpoints equals twice the sum of the squared distance to their
  midpoint and the squared half-distance between the endpoints. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q877489_real_inner_product_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q877489_zero : V;
  q877489_add : V -> V -> V;
  q877489_neg : V -> V;
  q877489_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q877489_inner : V -> V -> R;

  q877489_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q877489_add x (q877489_add y z) =
      q877489_add (q877489_add x y) z;
  q877489_add_comm :
    forall x y : V, q877489_add x y = q877489_add y x;
  q877489_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q877489_add x q877489_zero = x;
  q877489_add_neg :
    forall x : V,
      q877489_add x (q877489_neg x) = q877489_zero;

  q877489_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q877489_smul 1 x = x;
  q877489_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q877489_smul (a * b) x =
      q877489_smul a (q877489_smul b x);
  q877489_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q877489_smul a (q877489_add x y) =
      q877489_add (q877489_smul a x) (q877489_smul a y);
  q877489_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q877489_smul (a + b) x =
      q877489_add (q877489_smul a x) (q877489_smul b x);

  q877489_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q877489_inner (q877489_add x y) z =
      q877489_inner x z + q877489_inner y z;
  q877489_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q877489_inner (q877489_smul a x) y =
      a * q877489_inner x y;
  q877489_inner_symm :
    forall x y : V, q877489_inner x y = q877489_inner y x;
  q877489_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : V, 0 <= q877489_inner x x;
  q877489_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : V,
      q877489_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q877489_zero
}.

Arguments q877489_zero {V} _.
Arguments q877489_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q877489_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q877489_smul {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q877489_inner {V} _ _ _.

Record q877489_affine_torsor
    (V P : Type)
    (E : q877489_real_inner_product_space V) : Type := {
  q877489_vadd : V -> P -> P;
  q877489_vsub : P -> P -> V;
  q877489_zero_vadd :
    forall p : P, q877489_vadd (q877489_zero E) p = p;
  q877489_add_vadd :
    forall (x y : V) (p : P),
      q877489_vadd (q877489_add E x y) p =
      q877489_vadd x (q877489_vadd y p);
  q877489_vsub_vadd :
    forall (x : V) (p : P),
      q877489_vsub (q877489_vadd x p) p = x;
  q877489_vadd_vsub :
    forall p q : P,
      q877489_vadd (q877489_vsub p q) q = p
}.

Arguments q877489_vadd {V P E} _ _ _.
Arguments q877489_vsub {V P E} _ _ _.

Definition q877489_norm
    {V : Type}
    (E : q877489_real_inner_product_space V)
    (x : V) : R :=
  sqrt (q877489_inner E x x).

Definition q877489_dist
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q877489_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q877489_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p q : P) : R :=
  q877489_norm E (q877489_vsub A p q).

Definition q877489_midpoint
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q877489_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q877489_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p q : P) : P :=
  q877489_vadd A
    (q877489_smul E (1 / 2) (q877489_vsub A q p))
    p.

Definition q877489_square (x : R) : R := x * x.

Theorem EuclideanGeometry_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_eq_two_mul_dist_midpoint_sq_add_half_dist_sq :
  forall (V P : Type)
         (E : q877489_real_inner_product_space V)
         (A : @q877489_affine_torsor V P E)
         (a b c : P),
    q877489_square (q877489_dist A a b) +
      q877489_square (q877489_dist A a c) =
    2 *
      (q877489_square
        (q877489_dist A a (q877489_midpoint A b c)) +
       q877489_square (q877489_dist A b c / 2)).
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q877489,
  "Apollonius's theorem": in an arbitrary real inner-product affine space,
  the sum of the squared distances to two points is determined by their
  midpoint and half their mutual distance. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q877489_APOLLONIUS_S_THEOREM =
 `let real_inner_product_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V)
     (smul:real->V->V) (inner:V->V->real).
       (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
       (!x y z:V.
          inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
       (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
       (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let affine_torsor =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V)
     (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V).
       (!p:P. vadd zero p = p) /\
       (!v w:V. !p:P.
          vadd (add v w) p = vadd v (vadd w p)) /\
       (!v:V. !p:P. vsub (vadd v p) p = v) /\
       (!p q:P. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) in
  let norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V). sqrt (inner x x) in
  let distance =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V) (p:P) (q:P).
       norm inner (vsub p q) in
  let midpoint =
    \(smul:real->V->V) (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (p:P) (q:P).
       vadd (smul (&1 / &2) (vsub q p)) p in
  !zero:V.
  !add:V->V->V.
  !neg:V->V.
  !smul:real->V->V.
  !inner:V->V->real.
  !vadd:V->P->P.
  !vsub:P->P->V.
  !a b c:P.
    real_inner_product_space zero add neg smul inner /\
    affine_torsor zero add vadd vsub
    ==>
    distance inner vsub a b pow 2 +
    distance inner vsub a c pow 2 =
    &2 *
    (distance inner vsub a (midpoint smul vadd vsub b c) pow 2 +
     (distance inner vsub b c / &2) pow 2)`;;

      (P : R -> Set r) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record RealInnerProductSpace
  {r v : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (V : Set v) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ v)) where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : R -> V -> V

    addV-commutative :
      (u w : V) ->
      addV u w == addV w u
    addV-associative :
      (u w z : V) ->
      addV (addV u w) z == addV u (addV w z)
    addV-zero :
      (u : V) ->
      addV u zeroV == u
    addV-inverse :
      (u : V) ->
      addV u (negateV u) == zeroV

    scale-addV :
      (a : R) ->
      (u w : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV u w) ==
      addV (scaleV a u) (scaleV a w)
    add-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (u : V) ->
      scaleV (addR reals a b) u ==
      addV (scaleV a u) (scaleV b u)
    multiply-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (u : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyR reals a b) u ==
      scaleV a (scaleV b u)
    one-scaleV :
      (u : V) ->
      scaleV (oneR reals) u == u

    inner : V -> V -> R
    inner-add-left :
      (u w z : V) ->
      inner (addV u w) z ==
      addR reals (inner u z) (inner w z)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (u w : V) ->
      inner (scaleV a u) w ==
      multiplyR reals a (inner u w)
    inner-symmetric :
      (u w : V) ->
      inner u w == inner w u
    inner-nonnegative :
      (u : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (inner u u)
    inner-definite :
      (u : V) ->
      inner u u == zeroR reals ->
      u == zeroV

    norm : V -> R
    norm-nonnegative :
      (u : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (norm u)
    norm-square :
      (u : V) ->
      multiplyR reals (norm u) (norm u) == inner u u
    norm-zero :
      (u : V) ->
      norm u == zeroR reals ->
      u == zeroV
    norm-negate :
      (u : V) ->
      norm (negateV u) == norm u

open RealInnerProductSpace

record AffineTorsor
  {r v p : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {V : Set v}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V)
  (P : Set p) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ v ⊔ p)) where

  field
    vadd : V -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> V

    zero-vadd :
      (x : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV space) x == x
    add-vadd :
      (u w : V) ->
      (x : P) ->
      vadd (addV space u w) x ==
      vadd u (vadd w x)
    vadd-vsub :
      (x y : P) ->
      vadd (vsub x y) y == x
    vsub-vadd :
      (u : V) ->
      (x : P) ->
      vsub (vadd u x) x == u

open AffineTorsor

twoR :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
twoR reals =
  fromNatR reals (suc (suc zero))

halfR :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R
halfR reals =
  inverseR reals (twoR reals)

square :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiplyR reals x x

distance :
  {r v p : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {V : Set v} ->
  {P : Set p} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
distance {space = space} affine x y =
  norm space (vsub affine x y)

midpoint :
  {r v p : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {V : Set v} ->
  {P : Set p} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P
midpoint {reals = reals} {space = space} affine b c =
  vadd affine
    (scaleV space (halfR reals) (vsub affine b c))
    c

apollonius-theorem : Setω
apollonius-theorem =
  {r v p : Level} ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (V : Set v) ->
  (P : Set p) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  (affine : AffineTorsor space P) ->
  (a b c : P) ->
  addR reals
    (square reals (distance affine a b))
    (square reals (distance affine a c))
  ==
  multiplyR reals
    (twoR reals)
    (addR reals
      (square reals (distance affine a (midpoint affine b c)))
      (square reals
        (multiplyR reals
          (distance affine b c)
          (halfR reals))))

  Q877489 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q877489), "Apollonius's theorem":
  in an arbitrary real inner-product affine space, the sum of the squared
  distances from a point to two endpoints equals twice the sum of its squared
  distance to their midpoint and the squared half-distance between them.
  This file contains no proof.

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val q877489_real_inner_affine_space_def = new_definition (
  "q877489_real_inner_affine_space_def",
  ``q877489_real_inner_affine_space
      (zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r * s) x = smul r (smul s x)) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r + s) x = add (smul r x) (smul s x)) /\
      (!r x y. smul r (add x y) = add (smul r x) (smul r y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!r. smul r zero = zero) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!r x y. inner (smul r x) y = r * inner x y) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0 <=> x = zero)) /\
      (!p. vadd zero p = p) /\
      (!u v p. vadd (add u v) p = vadd u (vadd v p)) /\
      (!p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
      (!v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v)``);

val q877489_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q877489_norm_def",
  ``q877489_norm (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real) (x : 'v) =
      sqrt (inner x x)``);

val q877489_dist_def = new_definition (
  "q877489_dist_def",
  ``q877489_dist
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p) =
      q877489_norm inner (vsub x y)``);

val q877489_midpoint_def = new_definition (
  "q877489_midpoint_def",
  ``q877489_midpoint
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p) =
      vadd (smul (1 / 2) (vsub x y)) y``);

val dist_sq_add_dist_sq_eq_two_mul_dist_midpoint_sq_add_half_dist_sq =
  ``!(zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (a b c : 'p).
      q877489_real_inner_affine_space
        zero add neg smul inner vadd vsub
      ==>
      q877489_dist inner vsub a b pow 2 +
          q877489_dist inner vsub a c pow 2 =
        2 *
          (q877489_dist inner vsub a
              (q877489_midpoint smul vadd vsub b c) pow 2 +
           (q877489_dist inner vsub b c / 2) pow 2)``;

  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, the sum of the squared distances
  from one point to two others equals twice the sum of the squared distance
  to their midpoint and the square of half their mutual distance. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  W ranges over arbitrary real inner-product spaces. The predicate
  W Q877489RealInnerProductSpace explicitly requires a generalized
  pre-Hilbert structure over RRfld, the normed-module laws, and the defining
  equality between the norm and the square root of the self inner product.
  It is therefore the SetMM rendering of the source NormedAddCommGroup and
  InnerProductSpace real typeclass package, without a finite-dimensionality
  restriction. Choosing any point as an affine origin identifies the source's
  normed affine torsor with Base ` W while preserving distances and affine
  midpoints; conversely, Base ` W is such a torsor.

  W Q877489Ray A B is the vector from B to A, W Q877489Dist A B is its norm,
  and W Q877489Mid B C is the affine midpoint of B and C.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or an explicit definition.
  The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus statement, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q877489RealInnerProductSpace Q877489Ray Q877489Dist Q877489Mid $.

q877489-real-inner-product-space-syntax
  $a wff ( W Q877489RealInnerProductSpace ) $.
q877489-ray-syntax $a class ( W Q877489Ray A B ) $.
q877489-distance-syntax $a class ( W Q877489Dist A B ) $.
q877489-midpoint-syntax $a class ( W Q877489Mid B C ) $.

${
  $d W x $.

  q877489-real-inner-product-space-definition $a |- (
    ( W Q877489RealInnerProductSpace )
    <->
    (
      (
        W e. PreHil
        /\
        W e. NrmMod
      )
      /\
      (
        ( Scalar ` W ) = RRfld
        /\
        (
          ( norm ` W )
          =
          (
            x e. ( Base ` W ) |->
              ( sqrt ` ( x ( .i ` W ) x ) )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

q877489-ray-definition $a |- (
  W Q877489Ray A B
) = (
  A ( -g ` W ) B
) $.

q877489-distance-definition $a |- (
  W Q877489Dist A B
) = (
  ( norm ` W ) ` ( W Q877489Ray A B )
) $.

q877489-midpoint-definition $a |- (
  W Q877489Mid B C
) = (
  ( 1 / 2 )
  ( .s ` W )
  ( B ( +g ` W ) C )
) $.

${
  $d A B C W $.

  thousand-theorems-q877489-apollonius-theorem $a |- A. W
    (
      ( W Q877489RealInnerProductSpace )
      ->
      A. A e. ( Base ` W )
        A. B e. ( Base ` W )
          A. C e. ( Base ` W )
            (
              (
                ( ( W Q877489Dist A B ) ^ 2 )
                +
                ( ( W Q877489Dist A C ) ^ 2 )
              )
              =
              (
                2
                x.
                (
                  ( ( W Q877489Dist A ( W Q877489Mid B C ) ) ^ 2 )
                  +
                  ( ( ( W Q877489Dist B C ) / 2 ) ^ 2 )
                )
              )
            )
    )
  $.
$}
