title: Q877489_apollonius_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q877489
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q877489), "Apollonius's theorem": in an arbitrary
% real inner-product affine space, squared distances to two endpoints equal
% twice the sum of the squared median and half-side lengths. This file contains no proof.

Q877489_apollonius_s_theorem[
  V: TYPE+,
  P: TYPE+,
  zero: V,
  vadd: [V, V -> V],
  vneg: [V -> V],
  scale: [real, V -> V],
  inner: [V, V -> real],
  point_vadd: [V, P -> P],
  vsub: [P, P -> V],
  distance: [P, P -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): vadd(u, v) = vadd(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        vadd(vadd(u, v), w) = vadd(u, vadd(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, zero) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, vneg(u)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        scale(a, vadd(u, v)) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a + b, u) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a * b, u) = scale(a, scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(1, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(0, u) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vneg(u) = scale(-1, u))

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      inner(vadd(u, v), w) = inner(u, w) + inner(v, w))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        inner(scale(a, u), v) = a * inner(u, v))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V): inner(u, v) = inner(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): 0 <= inner(u, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): inner(u, u) = 0 IFF u = zero)

  affine_torsor_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p: P): point_vadd(zero, p) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V), (p: P):
        point_vadd(vadd(u, v), p) =
          point_vadd(u, point_vadd(v, p)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        point_vadd(vsub(p, q), q) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u: V), (p: P):
        vsub(point_vadd(u, p), p) = u)

  distance_laws: bool =
    FORALL (p, q: P):
      0 <= distance(p, q)
        AND distance(p, q) ^ 2 =
          inner(vsub(p, q), vsub(p, q))

  euclidean_affine_space: bool =
    vector_space_laws
      AND inner_product_laws
      AND affine_torsor_laws
      AND distance_laws

  midpoint(b, c: P): P =
    point_vadd(scale(1 / 2, vsub(c, b)), b)

  apollonius_s_theorem: bool =
    euclidean_affine_space IMPLIES
      FORALL (a, b, c: P):
        distance(a, b) ^ 2 + distance(a, c) ^ 2
          =
        2 * (distance(a, midpoint(b, c)) ^ 2
          + (distance(b, c) / 2) ^ 2)
END Q877489_apollonius_s_theorem

  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- n d))))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp d)
           (<= 2 d)
           (< d n))
      (and (not (equal (mod n d) 0))
           (q914517-no-divisor-from-p n (+ d 1)))

       (< 1 n)
       (q914517-no-divisor-from-p n 2)))

  (exists (a b)
    (and (natp a)
         (natp b)
         (equal (+ (* a a) (* b b))
                p))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q914517-fermat-s-theorem-on-sums-of-two-squares-statement
    (p)
  (implies
   (and (q914517-primep p)
        (not (equal (mod p 4) 3)))
   (q914517-sum-of-two-squares-p p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

module Q914517_fermat_s_theorem_on_sums_of_two_squares where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; mod-helper)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _<=_ _divides_
infixr 2 _or_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where

    quotient : Nat

  left : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

data Empty : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Empty

one : Nat
one = suc zero

two : Nat
two = suc one

three : Nat
three = suc two

four : Nat
four = suc three

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where

% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q914517), "Fermat's theorem on sums of two squares":

Q914517_fermat_s_theorem_on_sums_of_two_squares: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat): value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  fermat_s_theorem_on_sums_of_two_squares: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      (prime_nat(p) AND mod(p, 4) /= 3)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (a, b: nat):
            a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = p

END Q914517_fermat_s_theorem_on_sums_of_two_squares

module

public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Basic

namespace Q918099

/-- The `r`-element finite subsets of a set. -/
@[reducible] def rset' (r : ℕ) {α : Type} (m : Set α) : Set (Finset α) :=
  {x | x.card = r ∧ ∀ t ∈ x, t ∈ m}

/-- Infinite Ramsey's theorem for colorings whose colors lie in a fixed finite set. -/
theorem ramsey_r {α : Type} (K : Finset α) {r : ℕ} {M₁ : Set ℕ}
    (hM₁ : M₁.Infinite) (c : Finset ℕ → α)
    (h : ∀ e ∈ rset' r M₁, c e ∈ K) :
    ∃ M₂ ⊆ M₁, M₂.Infinite ∧ ∃ col ∈ K, ∀ i ∈ rset' r M₂, c i = col := sorry

end Q918099

(*

  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q918099), "Ramsey's theorem": every finite
  coloring of the r-element subsets of an infinite subset of the natural
  numbers has an infinite monochromatic subset. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List Sorting.Sorted.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q918099_finset (A : Type) : Type := {
  q918099_elements : list A;
  q918099_elements_nodup : NoDup q918099_elements
}.

Arguments q918099_elements {A} _.

Definition q918099_mem
    {A : Type} (x : A) (s : q918099_finset A) : Prop :=
  In x (q918099_elements s).

Definition q918099_subset
    (M2 M1 : nat -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall x : nat, M2 x -> M1 x.

Definition q918099_infinite
    (M : nat -> Prop) : Prop :=
  ~ exists enumeration : list nat,
      forall x : nat, M x <-> In x enumeration.

Definition q918099_edge
    (r : nat) (M : nat -> Prop) (edge : list nat) : Prop :=
  StronglySorted Nat.lt edge /\
  length edge = r /\
  forall x : nat, In x edge -> M x.

Theorem ramsey_r :
  forall (A : Type)
         (K : q918099_finset A)
         (r : nat)
         (M1 : nat -> Prop),
    q918099_infinite M1 ->
    forall c : list nat -> A,
      (forall edge : list nat,
        q918099_edge r M1 edge ->
        q918099_mem (c edge) K) ->
      exists M2 : nat -> Prop,
        q918099_subset M2 M1 /\
        q918099_infinite M2 /\
        exists color : A,
          q918099_mem color K /\
          forall edge : list nat,
            q918099_edge r M2 edge ->
            c edge = color.
Admitted.

;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
;; thousand-theorems__acl2__Q918099, "Ramsey's theorem": every coloring of
;; the r-element subsets of an infinite subset of the natural numbers by a
;; finite palette has an infinite monochromatic subset. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative interfaces represent arbitrary subsets of the naturals and
;; an arbitrary coloring. Set and coloring tags are observed only through
;; membership and color evaluation, so no finite table replaces either
;; potentially infinite object.

(defstub q918099-set-member-p (set natural) t)
(defstub q918099-color (coloring edge) t)

;; A strictly increasing true list is the unique canonical representation of
;; a finite subset of the naturals. Consequently the arbitrary coloring is
;; applied once per finset, independently of list order.

(defun q918099-strictly-increasing-nat-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (natp (car values))
       (if (consp (cdr values))
           (and
            (< (car values) (cadr values))
            (q918099-strictly-increasing-nat-list-p
             (cdr values)))
         (equal (cdr values) nil)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q918099-all-members-of-set-p (values set)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q918099-set-member-p set (car values))
       (q918099-all-members-of-set-p (cdr values) set))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q918099-r-edge-of-set-p (r set edge)
  (and
   (natp r)
   (q918099-strictly-increasing-nat-list-p edge)
   (equal (len edge) r)
   (q918099-all-members-of-set-p edge set)))

;; Duplicate-free true lists represent exactly the source finset K of colors.
;; Colors themselves remain arbitrary ACL2 objects, matching the arbitrary
;; source type alpha on the only part of it used by the statement.

(defun q918099-finite-color-set-p (colors)
  (and
   (true-listp colors)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal colors)))

(defun-sk q918099-coloring-into-p
    (r set colors coloring)
  (forall (edge)
    (implies
     (q918099-r-edge-of-set-p r set edge)
     (member-equal
      (q918099-color coloring edge)
      colors))))

;; For a subset of the naturals, infinitude is equivalent to unboundedness.
;; Both the bound and the larger member remain internal quantifiers.

(defun-sk q918099-member-above-exists-p (set bound)
  (exists (natural)
    (and
     (natp natural)
     (< bound natural)
     (q918099-set-member-p set natural))))

(defun-sk q918099-infinite-nat-set-p (set)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (natp bound)
     (q918099-member-above-exists-p set bound))))

(defun-sk q918099-nat-set-subset-p (subset superset)
  (forall (natural)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp natural)
      (q918099-set-member-p subset natural))
     (q918099-set-member-p superset natural))))

(defun-sk q918099-monochromatic-on-p
    (r set coloring color)
  (forall (edge)
    (implies
     (q918099-r-edge-of-set-p r set edge)
     (equal
      (q918099-color coloring edge)
      color))))

;; The monochromatic subset and common color are existentially quantified
;; inside the conclusion, preserving the source theorem's quantifier scope.

(defun-sk q918099-infinite-monochromatic-subset-exists-p
    (r original-set colors coloring)
  (exists (monochromatic-set color)
    (and
     (q918099-nat-set-subset-p
      monochromatic-set original-set)
     (q918099-infinite-nat-set-p monochromatic-set)
     (member-equal color colors)
     (q918099-monochromatic-on-p
      r monochromatic-set coloring color))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q918099-ramseys-theorem-statement
    (r infinite-set colors coloring)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp r)
    (q918099-finite-color-set-p colors)
    (q918099-infinite-nat-set-p infinite-set)
    (q918099-coloring-into-p
     r infinite-set colors coloring))
   (q918099-infinite-monochromatic-subset-exists-p
    r infinite-set colors coloring)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q918099,
-- "Ramsey's theorem": every finite coloring of the r-element subsets of an
-- infinite subset of the natural numbers has an infinite monochromatic subset.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q918099_ramsey_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _<=_ _<_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n =
  suc m <= n

data Member
  {A : Set}
  (x : A) :
  List A ->
  Set where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

data NoDuplicates
  {A : Set} :
  List A ->
  Set where

  no-duplicates-empty :
    NoDuplicates []

  no-duplicates-cons :
    {x : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    Not (Member x xs) ->
    NoDuplicates xs ->
    NoDuplicates (x ∷ xs)

record FiniteSubset
  (A : Set) :
  Set where

  field
    elements      : List A
    no-duplicates : NoDuplicates elements

open FiniteSubset

length :
  {A : Set} ->
  List A ->
  Nat
length [] =
  zero
length (_ ∷ xs) =
  suc (length xs)

-- A nonempty code `finite-from first gaps` denotes the strictly increasing
-- sequence beginning at `first`, with each next entry one plus the preceding
-- entry and the corresponding gap. Thus every finite subset of Nat has a
-- unique code, so arbitrary colorings are genuinely colorings of finite sets.
data FiniteNatSet : Set where
  finite-empty :
    FiniteNatSet

  finite-from :
    Nat ->
    List Nat ->
    FiniteNatSet

cardinality :
  FiniteNatSet ->
  Nat
cardinality finite-empty =
  zero
cardinality (finite-from first gaps) =
  suc (length gaps)

AllFrom :
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  Nat ->
  List Nat ->
  Set
AllFrom member current [] =
  member current
AllFrom member current (gap ∷ gaps) =
  member current
  and
  AllFrom member (suc (current + gap)) gaps

AllElements :
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  FiniteNatSet ->
  Set
AllElements member finite-empty =
  Bottom -> Bottom
AllElements member (finite-from first gaps) =
  AllFrom member first gaps

SubsetOf :
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  Set
SubsetOf child parent =
  (n : Nat) ->
  child n ->
  parent n

Infinite :
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  Set
Infinite member =
  (bound : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ n ->
      member n
      and
      bound < n)

IsEdge :
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  FiniteNatSet ->
  Set
IsEdge r vertices edge =
  cardinality edge == r
  and
  AllElements vertices edge

ramsey-r : Set₁
ramsey-r =
  (A : Set) ->
  (colors : FiniteSubset A) ->
  (r : Nat) ->
  (M1 : Nat -> Set) ->
  Infinite M1 ->
  (coloring : FiniteNatSet -> A) ->
  ((edge : FiniteNatSet) ->
    IsEdge r M1 edge ->
    Member (coloring edge) (elements colors)) ->
  Exists (Nat -> Set)
    (\ M2 ->
      SubsetOf M2 M1
      and
      Infinite M2
      and
      Exists A
        (\ color ->
          Member color (elements colors)
          and
          ((edge : FiniteNatSet) ->
            IsEdge r M2 edge ->
            coloring edge == color)))

% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q918099,
% "Ramsey's theorem": every coloring of the r-element subsets of an infinite
% set of natural numbers into a finite color set has an infinite monochromatic
% subset. This file contains no proof.

Q918099_ramsey_s_theorem[Alpha: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[nat], finite_sets[Alpha]

  nat_set: TYPE = [nat -> bool]
  edge: TYPE = finite_set[nat]
  color_set: TYPE = finite_set[Alpha]

  subset_of(left, right: nat_set): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      left(n) IMPLIES right(n)

  infinite_set(S: nat_set): bool =
    FORALL (F: finite_set[nat]):
      EXISTS (n: nat):
        S(n) AND NOT member(n, F)

  r_edge_of(E: edge, r: nat, S: nat_set): bool =
    card(E) = r
      AND
    (FORALL (n: nat):
      member(n, E) IMPLIES S(n))

  ramsey_r: bool =
    FORALL
      (K: color_set),
      (r: nat),
      (M1: nat_set),
      (c: [edge -> Alpha]):
        infinite_set(M1)
          AND
        (FORALL (E: edge):
          r_edge_of(E, r, M1) IMPLIES member(c(E), K))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (M2: nat_set):
            subset_of(M2, M1)
              AND infinite_set(M2)
              AND
            (EXISTS (color: Alpha):
              member(color, K)
                AND
              (FORALL (E: edge):
                r_edge_of(E, r, M2) IMPLIES c(E) = color))
END Q918099_ramsey_s_theorem

title: Q931001_inverse_function_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q931001
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q931001), "Inverse function theorem": a function
-- with an invertible strict derivative has a local inverse whose strict derivative
-- is the inverse continuous linear equivalence. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.InverseFunctionTheorem.FDeriv

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace Q931001

variable {𝕜 : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E]
variable {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
variable {f : E → F} {f' : E ≃L[𝕜] F} {a : E}

/-- The local inverse of a function with an invertible strict derivative has the inverse
continuous linear equivalence as its strict derivative. -/
theorem inverse_function_theorem
    (hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f (f' : E →L[𝕜] F) a) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt (hf.localInverse f f' a) (f'.symm : F →L[𝕜] E) (f a) := sorry

end Q931001

title: Q931001_inverse_function_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q931001
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q931001), "Inverse function theorem": a map from a
  complete normed space over an arbitrary nontrivially normed field, with an
  invertible strict Frechet derivative at a point, has a local inverse whose
  strict derivative is the inverse continuous linear map. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q931001_nontrivially_normed_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q931001_zeroK : K;
  q931001_oneK : K;
  q931001_addK : K -> K -> K;
  q931001_mulK : K -> K -> K;
  q931001_negK : K -> K;
  q931001_invK : K -> K;
  q931001_normK : K -> R;
  q931001_zero_neq_oneK :
    q931001_zeroK <> q931001_oneK;
  q931001_addK_assoc :
    forall a b c : K,
      q931001_addK a (q931001_addK b c) =
      q931001_addK (q931001_addK a b) c;
  q931001_addK_comm :
    forall a b : K,
      q931001_addK a b = q931001_addK b a;
  q931001_addK_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q931001_addK a q931001_zeroK = a;
  q931001_addK_neg :
    forall a : K,
      q931001_addK a (q931001_negK a) = q931001_zeroK;
  q931001_mulK_assoc :
    forall a b c : K,
      q931001_mulK a (q931001_mulK b c) =
      q931001_mulK (q931001_mulK a b) c;
  q931001_mulK_comm :
    forall a b : K,
      q931001_mulK a b = q931001_mulK b a;
  q931001_mulK_one :
    forall a : K,
      q931001_mulK a q931001_oneK = a;
  q931001_mulK_add :
    forall a b c : K,
      q931001_mulK a (q931001_addK b c) =
      q931001_addK
        (q931001_mulK a b) (q931001_mulK a c);
  q931001_invK_zero :
    q931001_invK q931001_zeroK = q931001_zeroK;
  q931001_mulK_inv :
    forall a : K,
      a <> q931001_zeroK ->
      q931001_mulK a (q931001_invK a) = q931001_oneK;
  q931001_normK_nonnegative :
    forall a : K,
      0 <= q931001_normK a;
  q931001_normK_eq_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q931001_normK a = 0 <-> a = q931001_zeroK;
  q931001_normK_neg :
    forall a : K,
      q931001_normK (q931001_negK a) = q931001_normK a;
  q931001_normK_add_le :
    forall a b : K,
      q931001_normK (q931001_addK a b) <=
      q931001_normK a + q931001_normK b;
  q931001_normK_mul :
    forall a b : K,
      q931001_normK (q931001_mulK a b) =
      q931001_normK a * q931001_normK b;
  q931001_normK_nontrivial :
    exists a : K, 1 < q931001_normK a
}.

Arguments q931001_zeroK {K} _.
Arguments q931001_oneK {K} _.
Arguments q931001_addK {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q931001_mulK {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q931001_negK {K} _ _.
Arguments q931001_invK {K} _ _.
Arguments q931001_normK {K} _ _.

Record q931001_normed_space
    (K E : Type)
    (KF : q931001_nontrivially_normed_field K) : Type := {
  q931001_zeroV : E;
  q931001_addV : E -> E -> E;
  q931001_negV : E -> E;
  q931001_smulV : K -> E -> E;
  q931001_normV : E -> R;
  q931001_addV_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q931001_addV x (q931001_addV y z) =
      q931001_addV (q931001_addV x y) z;
  q931001_addV_comm :
    forall x y : E,
      q931001_addV x y = q931001_addV y x;
  q931001_addV_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q931001_addV x q931001_zeroV = x;
  q931001_addV_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q931001_addV x (q931001_negV x) = q931001_zeroV;
  q931001_one_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q931001_smulV (q931001_oneK KF) x = x;
  q931001_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q931001_smulV (q931001_mulK KF a b) x =
      q931001_smulV a (q931001_smulV b x);
  q931001_add_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q931001_smulV (q931001_addK KF a b) x =
      q931001_addV
        (q931001_smulV a x) (q931001_smulV b x);
  q931001_smul_add :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q931001_smulV a (q931001_addV x y) =
      q931001_addV
        (q931001_smulV a x) (q931001_smulV a y);
  q931001_zero_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q931001_smulV (q931001_zeroK KF) x = q931001_zeroV;
  q931001_smul_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q931001_smulV a q931001_zeroV = q931001_zeroV;
  q931001_normV_nonnegative :
    forall x : E,
      0 <= q931001_normV x;
  q931001_normV_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q931001_normV x = 0 <-> x = q931001_zeroV;
  q931001_normV_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q931001_normV (q931001_negV x) = q931001_normV x;
  q931001_normV_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q931001_normV (q931001_addV x y) <=
      q931001_normV x + q931001_normV y;
  q931001_normV_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : E),
      q931001_normV (q931001_smulV a x) =
      q931001_normK KF a * q931001_normV x
}.

Arguments q931001_zeroV {K E KF} _.
Arguments q931001_addV {K E KF} _ _ _.
Arguments q931001_negV {K E KF} _ _.
Arguments q931001_smulV {K E KF} _ _ _.
Arguments q931001_normV {K E KF} _ _.

Definition q931001_sub
    {K E : Type}
    {KF : q931001_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (V : @q931001_normed_space K E KF)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q931001_addV V x (q931001_negV V y).

Definition q931001_sequence_cauchy
    {K E : Type}
    {KF : q931001_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (V : @q931001_normed_space K E KF)
    (u : nat -> E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q931001_normV V
          (q931001_sub V (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

Definition q931001_sequence_converges
    {K E : Type}
    {KF : q931001_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (V : @q931001_normed_space K E KF)
    (u : nat -> E) (limit : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q931001_normV V
          (q931001_sub V (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q931001_complete
    {K E : Type}
    {KF : q931001_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (V : @q931001_normed_space K E KF) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> E,
    q931001_sequence_cauchy V u ->
    exists limit : E,
      q931001_sequence_converges V u limit.

Record q931001_continuous_linear_map
    (K E F : Type)
    (KF : q931001_nontrivially_normed_field K)
    (VE : @q931001_normed_space K E KF)
    (VF : @q931001_normed_space K F KF) : Type := {
  q931001_clm_fun : E -> F;
  q931001_clm_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q931001_clm_fun (q931001_addV VE x y) =
      q931001_addV VF
        (q931001_clm_fun x) (q931001_clm_fun y);
  q931001_clm_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : E),
      q931001_clm_fun (q931001_smulV VE a x) =
      q931001_smulV VF a (q931001_clm_fun x);
  q931001_clm_bounded :
    exists bound : R,
      0 <= bound /\
      forall x : E,
        q931001_normV VF (q931001_clm_fun x) <=
        bound * q931001_normV VE x
}.

Arguments q931001_clm_fun {K E F KF VE VF} _ _.

Record q931001_continuous_linear_equiv
    (K E F : Type)
    (KF : q931001_nontrivially_normed_field K)
    (VE : @q931001_normed_space K E KF)
    (VF : @q931001_normed_space K F KF) : Type := {
  q931001_cle_forward :
    @q931001_continuous_linear_map K E F KF VE VF;
  q931001_cle_inverse :
    @q931001_continuous_linear_map K F E KF VF VE;
  q931001_cle_left_inverse :
    forall x : E,
      q931001_clm_fun q931001_cle_inverse
        (q931001_clm_fun q931001_cle_forward x) = x;
  q931001_cle_right_inverse :
    forall y : F,
      q931001_clm_fun q931001_cle_forward
        (q931001_clm_fun q931001_cle_inverse y) = y
}.

Arguments q931001_cle_forward {K E F KF VE VF} _.
Arguments q931001_cle_inverse {K E F KF VE VF} _.

Definition q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at
    {K E F : Type}
    {KF : q931001_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (VE : @q931001_normed_space K E KF)
    (VF : @q931001_normed_space K F KF)
    (f : E -> F)
    (derivative :
      @q931001_continuous_linear_map K E F KF VE VF)
    (point : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall x y : E,
        q931001_normV VE (q931001_sub VE x point) < delta ->
        q931001_normV VE (q931001_sub VE y point) < delta ->
        q931001_normV VF
          (q931001_sub VF
            (q931001_sub VF (f x) (f y))
            (q931001_clm_fun derivative
              (q931001_sub VE x y))) <=
        epsilon * q931001_normV VE (q931001_sub VE x y).

Definition q931001_continuous_at
    {K E F : Type}
    {KF : q931001_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (VE : @q931001_normed_space K E KF)
    (VF : @q931001_normed_space K F KF)
    (g : F -> E) (source_point : F) (target_point : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y : F,
        q931001_normV VF
          (q931001_sub VF y source_point) < delta ->
        q931001_normV VE
          (q931001_sub VE (g y) target_point) < epsilon.

Definition q931001_is_local_inverse_at
    {K E F : Type}
    {KF : q931001_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (VE : @q931001_normed_space K E KF)
    (VF : @q931001_normed_space K F KF)
    (f : E -> F) (g : F -> E) (point : E) : Prop :=
  exists source_radius target_radius : R,
    0 < source_radius /\
    0 < target_radius /\
    (forall x : E,
      q931001_normV VE
        (q931001_sub VE x point) < source_radius ->
      g (f x) = x) /\
    (forall y : F,
      q931001_normV VF
        (q931001_sub VF y (f point)) < target_radius ->
      f (g y) = y) /\
    @q931001_continuous_at
      K E F KF VE VF g (f point) point.

Definition q931001_local_inverse
    {K E F : Type}
    {KF : q931001_nontrivially_normed_field K}
    (VE : @q931001_normed_space K E KF)
    (VF : @q931001_normed_space K F KF)
    (f : E -> F) (point : E) : F -> E :=
  epsilon
    (inhabits (fun _ : F => q931001_zeroV VE))
    (fun g : F -> E =>
      @q931001_is_local_inverse_at
        K E F KF VE VF f g point).

Theorem HasStrictFDerivAt_to_localInverse :
  forall
    (K E F : Type)
    (KF : q931001_nontrivially_normed_field K)
    (VE : @q931001_normed_space K E KF)
    (VF : @q931001_normed_space K F KF),
    q931001_complete VE ->
    forall
      (f : E -> F)
      (derivative :
        @q931001_continuous_linear_equiv K E F KF VE VF)
      (point : E),
      @q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at
        K E F KF VE VF f
        (q931001_cle_forward derivative) point ->
      @q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at
        K F E KF VF VE
        (@q931001_local_inverse K E F KF VE VF f point)
        (q931001_cle_inverse derivative) (f point).
Admitted.

title: Q931001_inverse_function_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q931001,
  "Inverse function theorem": a map between normed spaces over an arbitrary
  nontrivially normed field, with complete domain and an invertible strict
  Frechet derivative at a point, has a choice-constructed local inverse whose
  strict derivative is the inverse linear equivalence. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory Q931001_inverse_function_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q931001_nontrivially_normed_field ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q931001_nontrivially_normed_field knorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    knorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>a. 0 \<le> knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm a = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> a = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm (-a) = knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a + b) \<le> knorm a + knorm b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a * b) = knorm a * knorm b) \<and>
    (\<exists>a. 1 < knorm a)"

definition q931001_normed_space ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q931001_normed_space knorm enorm scale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. scale a (x + y) = scale a x + scale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a + b) x = scale a x + scale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a * b) x = scale a (scale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. scale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. enorm (scale a x) = knorm a * enorm x) \<and>
    enorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm (-x) = enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. enorm (x + y) \<le> enorm x + enorm y)"

definition q931001_complete_space ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q931001_complete_space enorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>u :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'e.
      (\<forall>epsilon>0. \<exists>N. \<forall>m\<ge>N. \<forall>n\<ge>N.
        enorm (u m - u n) < epsilon)
      \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>x. \<forall>epsilon>0. \<exists>N. \<forall>n\<ge>N.
        enorm (u n - x) < epsilon))"

definition q931001_continuous_linear ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q931001_continuous_linear enorm fnorm escale fscale L \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. L (x + y) = L x + L y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. L (escale a x) = fscale a (L x)) \<and>
    (\<exists>C\<ge>0. \<forall>x. fnorm (L x) \<le> C * enorm x)"

definition q931001_continuous_linear_equiv ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> ('f \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q931001_continuous_linear_equiv enorm fnorm escale fscale D Dinv
      \<longleftrightarrow>
    q931001_continuous_linear enorm fnorm escale fscale D \<and>
    q931001_continuous_linear fnorm enorm fscale escale Dinv \<and>
    (\<forall>x. Dinv (D x) = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>y. D (Dinv y) = y)"

definition q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
      'e \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at enorm fnorm escale fscale f D a
      \<longleftrightarrow>
    q931001_continuous_linear enorm fnorm escale fscale D \<and>
    (\<forall>epsilon>0. \<exists>delta>0. \<forall>x y.
      enorm (x - a) < delta \<longrightarrow>
      enorm (y - a) < delta \<longrightarrow>
      fnorm ((f x - f y) - D (x - y))
        \<le> epsilon * enorm (x - y))"

definition q931001_open_norm ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q931001_open_norm enorm U \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>U. \<exists>r>0. \<forall>y.
      enorm (y - x) < r \<longrightarrow> y \<in> U)"

definition q931001_continuous_on_norm ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      'e set \<Rightarrow> ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q931001_continuous_on_norm enorm fnorm U h \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>U. \<forall>epsilon>0. \<exists>delta>0. \<forall>y\<in>U.
      enorm (y - x) < delta \<longrightarrow>
      fnorm (h y - h x) < epsilon)"

definition q931001_open_partial_homeomorphism ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow>
      ('e set \<times> ('f set \<times> ('f \<Rightarrow> 'e))) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q931001_open_partial_homeomorphism enorm fnorm f a chart \<longleftrightarrow>
    (let source = fst chart;
         target = fst (snd chart);
         inverse = snd (snd chart)
     in q931001_open_norm enorm source \<and>
        q931001_open_norm fnorm target \<and>
        a \<in> source \<and>
        f a \<in> target \<and>
        q931001_continuous_on_norm enorm fnorm source f \<and>
        q931001_continuous_on_norm fnorm enorm target inverse \<and>
        (\<forall>x\<in>source. f x \<in> target \<and> inverse (f x) = x) \<and>
        (\<forall>y\<in>target. inverse y \<in> source \<and> f (inverse y) = y))"

definition q931001_to_open_partial_homeomorphism ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow>
      ('e set \<times> ('f set \<times> ('f \<Rightarrow> 'e)))" where
  "q931001_to_open_partial_homeomorphism
      knorm enorm fnorm escale fscale f D Dinv a =
    (SOME chart.
      q931001_nontrivially_normed_field knorm \<and>
      q931001_normed_space knorm enorm escale \<and>
      q931001_normed_space knorm fnorm fscale \<and>
      q931001_complete_space enorm \<and>
      q931001_continuous_linear_equiv
        enorm fnorm escale fscale D Dinv \<and>
      q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at
        enorm fnorm escale fscale f D a \<and>
      q931001_open_partial_homeomorphism enorm fnorm f a chart)"

definition q931001_local_inverse ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> ('f \<Rightarrow> 'e)" where
  "q931001_local_inverse knorm enorm fnorm escale fscale f D Dinv a =
    snd (snd (q931001_to_open_partial_homeomorphism
      knorm enorm fnorm escale fscale f D Dinv a))"

theorem q931001_inverse_function_theorem:
  fixes knorm :: "'k::field \<Rightarrow> real"
    and enorm :: "'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and fnorm :: "'f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and escale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and fscale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and f :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and D :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and Dinv :: "'f \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and a :: 'e
  assumes scalar_field: "q931001_nontrivially_normed_field knorm"
    and domain_space: "q931001_normed_space knorm enorm escale"
    and codomain_space: "q931001_normed_space knorm fnorm fscale"
    and domain_complete: "q931001_complete_space enorm"
    and derivative_equiv:
      "q931001_continuous_linear_equiv
        enorm fnorm escale fscale D Dinv"
    and strict_derivative:
      "q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at
        enorm fnorm escale fscale f D a"
  shows "q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at
    fnorm enorm fscale escale
    (q931001_local_inverse
      knorm enorm fnorm escale fscale f D Dinv a)
    Dinv (f a)"
  sorry

end

title: Q931001_inverse_function_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q931001
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q931001), "Inverse function theorem": a map
  between normed spaces whose strict derivative at a point is a continuous
  linear equivalence has a local two-sided inverse with the inverse strict
  derivative at the image point. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q931001_INVERSE_FUNCTION_THEOREM =
 `!zeroK oneK:A.
  !addK mulK:A->A->A.
  !negK invK:A->A.
  !normK:A->real.
  !zeroE:B.
  !addE:B->B->B.
  !negE:B->B.
  !smulE:A->B->B.
  !normE:B->real.
  !zeroF:C.
  !addF:C->C->C.
  !negF:C->C.
  !smulF:A->C->C.
  !normF:C->real.
  !f:B->C.
  !derivative:B->C.
  !inverse_derivative:C->B.
  !point:B.
  let nontrivially_normed_field =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A)
     (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (negK:A->A) (invK:A->A) (normK:A->real).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:A. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:A. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK zeroK a = zeroK) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:A. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       normK zeroK = &0 /\
       (!a:A. &0 <= normK a) /\
       (!a:A. normK a = &0 <=> a = zeroK) /\
       (!a:A. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\
       (!a b:A. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
       (!a b:A. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
       (?a:A. &1 < normK a) in
  let normed_space_E =
    \(zeroE:B) (addE:B->B->B) (negE:B->B)
     (smulE:A->B->B) (normE:B->real).
       (!x y z:B. addE x (addE y z) = addE (addE x y) z) /\
       (!x y:B. addE x y = addE y x) /\
       (!x:B. addE zeroE x = x) /\
       (!x:B. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
       (!x:B. smulE oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smulE (mulK a b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smulE (addK a b) x = addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
       (!a:A. !x y:B.
          smulE a (addE x y) = addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
       (!x:B. smulE zeroK x = zeroE) /\
       (!a:A. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) /\
       normE zeroE = &0 /\
       (!x:B. &0 <= normE x) /\
       (!x:B. normE x = &0 <=> x = zeroE) /\
       (!x:B. normE (negE x) = normE x) /\
       (!a:A. !x:B. normE (smulE a x) = normK a * normE x) /\
       (!x y:B. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) in
  let normed_space_F =
    \(zeroF:C) (addF:C->C->C) (negF:C->C)
     (smulF:A->C->C) (normF:C->real).
       (!x y z:C. addF x (addF y z) = addF (addF x y) z) /\
       (!x y:C. addF x y = addF y x) /\
       (!x:C. addF zeroF x = x) /\
       (!x:C. addF (negF x) x = zeroF) /\
       (!x:C. smulF oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:C.
          smulF (mulK a b) x = smulF a (smulF b x)) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:C.
          smulF (addK a b) x = addF (smulF a x) (smulF b x)) /\
       (!a:A. !x y:C.
          smulF a (addF x y) = addF (smulF a x) (smulF a y)) /\
       (!x:C. smulF zeroK x = zeroF) /\
       (!a:A. smulF a zeroF = zeroF) /\
       normF zeroF = &0 /\
       (!x:C. &0 <= normF x) /\
       (!x:C. normF x = &0 <=> x = zeroF) /\
       (!x:C. normF (negF x) = normF x) /\
       (!a:A. !x:C. normF (smulF a x) = normK a * normF x) /\
       (!x y:C. normF (addF x y) <= normF x + normF y) in
  let tends_E =
    \(u:num->B) (x:B).
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
               N <= n
               ==> normE (addE (u n) (negE x)) < epsilon in
  let complete_space_E =
    !u:num->B.
       (!epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                N <= m /\ N <= n
                ==> normE (addE (u m) (negE (u n))) < epsilon)
       ==> ?x:B. tends_E u x in
  let continuous_linear_map_EF =
    \l:B->C.
       (!x y:B. l (addE x y) = addF (l x) (l y)) /\
       (!a:A. !x:B. l (smulE a x) = smulF a (l x)) /\
       (?bound:real.
          &0 <= bound /\
          !x:B. normF (l x) <= bound * normE x) in
  let continuous_linear_map_FE =
    \l:C->B.
       (!x y:C. l (addF x y) = addE (l x) (l y)) /\
       (!a:A. !x:C. l (smulF a x) = smulE a (l x)) /\
       (?bound:real.
          &0 <= bound /\
          !x:C. normE (l x) <= bound * normF x) in
  let has_strict_fderiv_at_EF =
    \(f:B->C) (l:B->C) (point:B).
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?radius:real.
               &0 < radius /\
               !x y:B.
                 normE (addE x (negE point)) < radius /\
                 normE (addE y (negE point)) < radius
                 ==> normF
                       (addF
                         (addF (f x) (negF (f y)))
                         (negF (l (addE x (negE y)))))
                     <= epsilon * normE (addE x (negE y)) in
  let has_strict_fderiv_at_FE =
    \(g:C->B) (l:C->B) (point:C).
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?radius:real.
               &0 < radius /\
               !x y:C.
                 normF (addF x (negF point)) < radius /\
                 normF (addF y (negF point)) < radius
                 ==> normE
                       (addE
                         (addE (g x) (negE (g y)))
                         (negE (l (addF x (negF y)))))
                     <= epsilon * normF (addF x (negF y)) in
  let local_inverse_at =
    \(f:B->C) (g:C->B) (point:B).
       (?source_radius:real.
          &0 < source_radius /\
          !x:B.
            normE (addE x (negE point)) < source_radius
            ==> g (f x) = x) /\
       (?target_radius:real.
          &0 < target_radius /\
          !y:C.
            normF (addF y (negF (f point))) < target_radius
            ==> f (g y) = y) in
    nontrivially_normed_field
      zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
    normed_space_E zeroE addE negE smulE normE /\
    normed_space_F zeroF addF negF smulF normF /\
    complete_space_E /\
    continuous_linear_map_EF derivative /\
    continuous_linear_map_FE inverse_derivative /\
    (!x:B. inverse_derivative (derivative x) = x) /\
    (!y:C. derivative (inverse_derivative y) = y) /\
    has_strict_fderiv_at_EF f derivative point
    ==> ?local_inverse:C->B.
          local_inverse_at f local_inverse point /\
          has_strict_fderiv_at_FE
            local_inverse inverse_derivative (f point)`;;

title: Q931001_inverse_function_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q931001,
;; "Inverse function theorem": a function between normed spaces whose strict
;; derivative at a point is a continuous linear equivalence has a choice-built
;; local inverse with the inverse strict derivative. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Carriers, operations, sets, and functions are unrestricted ACL2 objects.
;; Conservative application interfaces interpret those objects, while native
;; DEFUN-SK forms keep all mathematical quantifiers internal. Norms are
;; represented by rational upper cuts, so no real norm is restricted to
;; rational values. Conservative choices below mirror the source definition's
;; Classical.choose and Function.invFunOn construction.

(defstub q931001-member-p (predicate object) t)

(defstub q931001-unary-value (function object) t)

(defstub q931001-binary-value (function left right) t)

(defun q931001-positive-rational-p (value)
  (and (rationalp value) (< 0 value)))

(defstub q931001-norm-lt-p (norm-lt object bound) t)

(defun-sk q931001-norm-finite-p (norm-lt object)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q931001-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt object bound))))

(defun-sk q931001-norm-positive-p (norm-lt object)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q931001-positive-rational-p bound)
     (not (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt object bound)))))

(defun-sk q931001-norm-rounded-p (norm-lt object bound)
  (exists (smaller)
    (and
     (q931001-positive-rational-p smaller)
     (rationalp bound)
     (< smaller bound)
     (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt object smaller))))

(defun-sk q931001-norm-product-lt-p
    (left-norm-lt right-norm-lt left right bound)
  (exists (left-bound right-bound)
    (and
     (q931001-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q931001-positive-rational-p left-bound)
     (q931001-positive-rational-p right-bound)
     (q931001-norm-lt-p left-norm-lt left left-bound)
     (q931001-norm-lt-p right-norm-lt right right-bound)
     (< (* left-bound right-bound) bound))))

;; A nontrivially normed field, presented without restricting its carrier.

(defun-sk q931001-field-closure-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p carrier x)
      (q931001-member-p carrier y))
     (and
      (q931001-member-p
       carrier (q931001-binary-value add x y))
      (q931001-member-p
       carrier (q931001-binary-value multiply x y))
      (q931001-member-p
       carrier (q931001-unary-value negate x))
      (q931001-member-p
       carrier (q931001-unary-value inverse x))))))

(defun-sk q931001-field-additive-laws-p
    (carrier add negate zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p carrier x)
      (q931001-member-p carrier y)
      (q931001-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (equal
       (q931001-binary-value
        add (q931001-binary-value add x y) z)
       (q931001-binary-value
        add x (q931001-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (q931001-binary-value add x y)
       (q931001-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (q931001-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (q931001-binary-value
        add x (q931001-unary-value negate x))
       zero)))))

(defun-sk q931001-field-multiplicative-laws-p
    (carrier multiply inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p carrier x)
      (q931001-member-p carrier y)
      (q931001-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (equal
       (q931001-binary-value
        multiply (q931001-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (q931001-binary-value
        multiply x (q931001-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (q931001-binary-value multiply x y)
       (q931001-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (q931001-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (q931001-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (q931001-binary-value
         multiply x (q931001-unary-value inverse x))
        one))))))

(defun-sk q931001-field-distributive-p
    (carrier add multiply)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p carrier x)
      (q931001-member-p carrier y)
      (q931001-member-p carrier z))
      (equal
       (q931001-binary-value
        multiply x (q931001-binary-value add y z))
       (q931001-binary-value
        add
        (q931001-binary-value multiply x y)
        (q931001-binary-value multiply x z))))))

(defun-sk q931001-norm-cut-laws-p (carrier norm-lt zero)
  (forall (x q r)
    (implies
     (q931001-member-p carrier x)
     (and
      (implies
       (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt x q)
       (q931001-positive-rational-p q))
      (implies
       (and
        (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt x q)
        (rationalp r)
        (< q r))
       (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt x r))
      (implies
       (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt x q)
       (q931001-norm-rounded-p norm-lt x q))
      (q931001-norm-finite-p norm-lt x)
      (iff
       (equal x zero)
       (not (q931001-norm-positive-p norm-lt x)))))))

(defun-sk q931001-field-norm-zero-one-p (norm-lt zero one)
  (forall (q)
    (and
      (iff
       (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt zero q)
       (q931001-positive-rational-p q))
      (iff
       (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt one q)
       (and (rationalp q) (< 1 q))))))

(defun-sk q931001-field-norm-negate-p
    (carrier negate norm-lt)
  (forall (x q)
    (implies
     (q931001-member-p carrier x)
      (iff
       (q931001-norm-lt-p
        norm-lt (q931001-unary-value negate x) q)
       (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt x q)))))

(defun-sk q931001-field-norm-add-p
    (carrier add norm-lt)
  (forall (x y r s)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p carrier x)
      (q931001-member-p carrier y))
      (implies
       (and
        (q931001-positive-rational-p r)
        (q931001-positive-rational-p s)
        (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt x r)
        (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt y s))
       (q931001-norm-lt-p
        norm-lt (q931001-binary-value add x y) (+ r s))))))

(defun-sk q931001-field-norm-multiply-p
    (carrier multiply norm-lt)
  (forall (x y q)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p carrier x)
      (q931001-member-p carrier y))
      (iff
       (q931001-norm-lt-p
        norm-lt (q931001-binary-value multiply x y) q)
       (q931001-norm-product-lt-p
        norm-lt norm-lt x y q)))))

(defun-sk q931001-field-norm-nontrivial-p
    (carrier norm-lt)
  (exists (x bound)
    (and
     (q931001-member-p carrier x)
     (q931001-positive-rational-p bound)
     (< 1 bound)
     (not (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt x bound)))))

(defun q931001-nontrivially-normed-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one norm-lt)
  (and
   (q931001-member-p carrier zero)
   (q931001-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q931001-field-closure-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse)
   (q931001-field-additive-laws-p carrier add negate zero)
   (q931001-field-multiplicative-laws-p
    carrier multiply inverse zero one)
   (q931001-field-distributive-p carrier add multiply)
   (q931001-norm-cut-laws-p carrier norm-lt zero)
   (q931001-field-norm-zero-one-p norm-lt zero one)
   (q931001-field-norm-negate-p carrier negate norm-lt)
   (q931001-field-norm-add-p carrier add norm-lt)
   (q931001-field-norm-multiply-p
    carrier multiply norm-lt)
   (q931001-field-norm-nontrivial-p carrier norm-lt)))

;; Normed vector spaces over the represented field.

(defun-sk q931001-space-closure-p
    (field-carrier carrier add negate scalar-multiply)
  (forall (a x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p field-carrier a)
      (q931001-member-p carrier x)
      (q931001-member-p carrier y))
     (and
      (q931001-member-p
       carrier (q931001-binary-value add x y))
      (q931001-member-p
       carrier (q931001-unary-value negate x))
      (q931001-member-p
       carrier (q931001-binary-value scalar-multiply a x))
      ))))

(defun-sk q931001-space-additive-laws-p
    (carrier add negate zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p carrier x)
      (q931001-member-p carrier y)
      (q931001-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (equal
       (q931001-binary-value
        add (q931001-binary-value add x y) z)
       (q931001-binary-value
        add x (q931001-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (q931001-binary-value add x y)
       (q931001-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (q931001-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (q931001-binary-value
        add x (q931001-unary-value negate x))
       zero)))))

(defun-sk q931001-space-module-laws-p
    (field-carrier field-add field-multiply field-one
     carrier add scalar-multiply)
  (forall (a b x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p field-carrier a)
      (q931001-member-p field-carrier b)
      (q931001-member-p carrier x)
      (q931001-member-p carrier y))
     (and
      (equal
       (q931001-binary-value scalar-multiply field-one x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q931001-binary-value
        scalar-multiply
        (q931001-binary-value field-multiply a b)
        x)
       (q931001-binary-value
        scalar-multiply
        a
        (q931001-binary-value scalar-multiply b x)))
      (equal
       (q931001-binary-value
        scalar-multiply
        (q931001-binary-value field-add a b)
        x)
       (q931001-binary-value
        add
        (q931001-binary-value scalar-multiply a x)
        (q931001-binary-value scalar-multiply b x)))
      (equal
       (q931001-binary-value
        scalar-multiply a (q931001-binary-value add x y))
       (q931001-binary-value
        add
        (q931001-binary-value scalar-multiply a x)
        (q931001-binary-value scalar-multiply a y)))
      ))))

(defun-sk q931001-space-norm-negate-p
    (carrier negate norm-lt)
  (forall (x q)
    (implies
     (q931001-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q931001-norm-lt-p
       norm-lt (q931001-unary-value negate x) q)
      (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt x q)))))

(defun-sk q931001-space-norm-add-p
    (carrier add norm-lt)
  (forall (x y r s)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p carrier x)
      (q931001-member-p carrier y))
     (implies
      (and
       (q931001-positive-rational-p r)
       (q931001-positive-rational-p s)
       (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt x r)
       (q931001-norm-lt-p norm-lt y s))
      (q931001-norm-lt-p
       norm-lt (q931001-binary-value add x y) (+ r s))))))

(defun-sk q931001-space-norm-smul-p
    (field-carrier field-norm-lt carrier scalar-multiply norm-lt)
  (forall (a x q)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p field-carrier a)
      (q931001-member-p carrier x))
     (iff
      (q931001-norm-lt-p
       norm-lt
       (q931001-binary-value scalar-multiply a x)
       q)
      (q931001-norm-product-lt-p
       field-norm-lt norm-lt a x q)))))

(defun q931001-space-laws-p
    (field-carrier field-add field-multiply field-one field-norm-lt
     carrier add negate zero scalar-multiply norm-lt)
  (and
   (q931001-space-closure-p
    field-carrier carrier add negate scalar-multiply)
   (q931001-space-additive-laws-p carrier add negate zero)
   (q931001-space-module-laws-p
    field-carrier field-add field-multiply field-one
    carrier add scalar-multiply)
   (q931001-norm-cut-laws-p carrier norm-lt zero)
   (q931001-space-norm-negate-p carrier negate norm-lt)
   (q931001-space-norm-add-p carrier add norm-lt)
   (q931001-space-norm-smul-p
    field-carrier field-norm-lt carrier scalar-multiply norm-lt)))

(defun q931001-normed-space-p
    (field-carrier field-add field-multiply field-one field-norm-lt
     carrier add negate zero scalar-multiply norm-lt)
  (and
   (q931001-member-p carrier zero)
   (q931001-space-laws-p
    field-carrier field-add field-multiply field-one field-norm-lt
    carrier add negate zero scalar-multiply norm-lt)))

(defun q931001-vector-difference (add negate left right)
  (q931001-binary-value
   add left (q931001-unary-value negate right)))

;; Sequential completeness is equivalent to metric completeness here.

(defun-sk q931001-sequence-values-p (carrier sequence)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (q931001-member-p
      carrier (q931001-unary-value sequence index)))))

(defun q931001-sequence-p (carrier sequence)
  (q931001-sequence-values-p carrier sequence))

(defun-sk q931001-cauchy-tail-p
    (carrier add negate norm-lt sequence epsilon start)
  (forall (left-index right-index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left-index)
      (natp right-index)
      (natp start)
      (<= start left-index)
      (<= start right-index))
     (q931001-norm-lt-p
      norm-lt
      (q931001-vector-difference
       add negate
       (q931001-unary-value sequence left-index)
       (q931001-unary-value sequence right-index))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q931001-cauchy-start-exists-p
    (carrier add negate norm-lt sequence epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q931001-cauchy-tail-p
      carrier add negate norm-lt sequence epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q931001-cauchy-p
    (carrier add negate norm-lt sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q931001-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (q931001-cauchy-start-exists-p
      carrier add negate norm-lt sequence epsilon))))

(defun-sk q931001-convergence-tail-p
    (carrier add negate norm-lt sequence limit epsilon start)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (natp start)
      (<= start index))
     (q931001-norm-lt-p
      norm-lt
      (q931001-vector-difference
       add negate
       (q931001-unary-value sequence index)
       limit)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q931001-convergence-start-exists-p
    (carrier add negate norm-lt sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q931001-convergence-tail-p
      carrier add negate norm-lt
      sequence limit epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q931001-converges-p
    (carrier add negate norm-lt sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q931001-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (q931001-convergence-start-exists-p
      carrier add negate norm-lt sequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q931001-limit-exists-p
    (carrier add negate norm-lt sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q931001-member-p carrier limit)
     (q931001-converges-p
      carrier add negate norm-lt sequence limit))))

(defun-sk q931001-complete-space-p
    (carrier add negate norm-lt)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-sequence-p carrier sequence)
      (q931001-cauchy-p
       carrier add negate norm-lt sequence))
     (q931001-limit-exists-p
      carrier add negate norm-lt sequence))))

(defun q931001-banach-space-p
    (field-carrier field-add field-multiply field-one field-norm-lt
     carrier add negate zero scalar-multiply norm-lt)
  (and
   (q931001-normed-space-p
    field-carrier field-add field-multiply field-one field-norm-lt
    carrier add negate zero scalar-multiply norm-lt)
   (q931001-complete-space-p carrier add negate norm-lt)))

(defun q931001-field-add (field) (nth 1 field))

(defun q931001-field-inverse (field) (nth 4 field))
(defun q931001-field-zero (field) (nth 5 field))

(defun q931001-space-zero (space) (nth 3 space))

    (q931001-field-one field)

;; Typed functions and continuous linear maps.

(defun-sk q931001-function-values-p
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q931001-member-p domain-carrier x)
     (q931001-member-p
      codomain-carrier (q931001-unary-value function x)))))

(defun q931001-function-p
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (q931001-function-values-p
   domain-carrier codomain-carrier function))

(defun-sk q931001-binary-function-values-p
    (left-carrier right-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p left-carrier left)
      (q931001-member-p right-carrier right))
     (q931001-member-p
      codomain-carrier
      (q931001-binary-value function left right)))))

(defun q931001-binary-function-p
    (left-carrier right-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (q931001-binary-function-values-p
   left-carrier right-carrier codomain-carrier function))

(defun-sk q931001-linear-map-laws-p
    (field-carrier domain-carrier codomain-carrier
     domain-add codomain-add domain-smul codomain-smul mapping)
  (forall (scalar left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p field-carrier scalar)
      (q931001-member-p domain-carrier left)
      (q931001-member-p domain-carrier right))
     (and
      (q931001-member-p
       codomain-carrier (q931001-unary-value mapping left))
      (equal
       (q931001-unary-value
        mapping (q931001-binary-value domain-add left right))
       (q931001-binary-value
        codomain-add
        (q931001-unary-value mapping left)
        (q931001-unary-value mapping right)))
      (equal
       (q931001-unary-value
        mapping (q931001-binary-value domain-smul scalar left))
       (q931001-binary-value
        codomain-smul scalar
        (q931001-unary-value mapping left)))))))

(defun q931001-linear-map-p
    (field-carrier domain-carrier codomain-carrier
     domain-add codomain-add domain-smul codomain-smul mapping)
  (q931001-linear-map-laws-p
   field-carrier domain-carrier codomain-carrier
   domain-add codomain-add domain-smul codomain-smul mapping))

(defun-sk q931001-continuity-at-zero-delta-p
    (domain-space codomain-space mapping epsilon delta)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p
       (q931001-space-carrier domain-space) x)
      (q931001-norm-lt-p
       (q931001-space-norm-lt domain-space) x delta))
     (q931001-norm-lt-p
      (q931001-space-norm-lt codomain-space)
      (q931001-unary-value mapping x)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q931001-continuity-at-zero-delta-exists-p
    (domain-space codomain-space mapping epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (q931001-positive-rational-p delta)
     (q931001-continuity-at-zero-delta-p
      domain-space codomain-space mapping epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk q931001-continuous-at-zero-p
    (domain-space codomain-space mapping)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q931001-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (q931001-continuity-at-zero-delta-exists-p
      domain-space codomain-space mapping epsilon))))

(defun q931001-continuous-linear-map-p
    (field domain-space codomain-space mapping)
  (and
   (q931001-linear-map-p
    (q931001-field-carrier field)
    (q931001-space-carrier domain-space)
    (q931001-space-carrier codomain-space)
    (q931001-space-add domain-space)
    (q931001-space-add codomain-space)
    (q931001-space-smul domain-space)
    (q931001-space-smul codomain-space)
    mapping)
   (q931001-continuous-at-zero-p
    domain-space codomain-space mapping)))

;; Exact upper-cut form of A <= epsilon * B.

(defun-sk q931001-scaled-norm-bound-p
    (codomain-norm-lt remainder domain-norm-lt increment epsilon)
  (forall (domain-bound codomain-bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-positive-rational-p domain-bound)
      (q931001-positive-rational-p codomain-bound)
      (q931001-norm-lt-p
       domain-norm-lt increment domain-bound)
      (< (* epsilon domain-bound) codomain-bound))
     (q931001-norm-lt-p
      codomain-norm-lt remainder codomain-bound))))

(defun-sk q931001-strict-derivative-points-p
    (domain-space codomain-space function derivative
     point epsilon radius)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p
       (q931001-space-carrier domain-space) x)
      (q931001-member-p
       (q931001-space-carrier domain-space) y)
      (q931001-norm-lt-p
       (q931001-space-norm-lt domain-space)
       (q931001-vector-difference
        (q931001-space-add domain-space)
        (q931001-space-negate domain-space)
        x point)
       radius)
      (q931001-norm-lt-p
       (q931001-space-norm-lt domain-space)
       (q931001-vector-difference
        (q931001-space-add domain-space)
        (q931001-space-negate domain-space)
        y point)
       radius))
     (q931001-scaled-norm-bound-p
      (q931001-space-norm-lt codomain-space)
      (q931001-vector-difference
       (q931001-space-add codomain-space)
       (q931001-space-negate codomain-space)
       (q931001-vector-difference
        (q931001-space-add codomain-space)
        (q931001-space-negate codomain-space)
        (q931001-unary-value function x)
        (q931001-unary-value function y))
       (q931001-unary-value
        derivative
        (q931001-vector-difference
         (q931001-space-add domain-space)
         (q931001-space-negate domain-space)
         x y)))
      (q931001-space-norm-lt domain-space)
      (q931001-vector-difference
       (q931001-space-add domain-space)
       (q931001-space-negate domain-space)
       x y)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q931001-strict-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (domain-space codomain-space function derivative point epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q931001-positive-rational-p radius)
     (q931001-strict-derivative-points-p
      domain-space codomain-space function derivative
      point epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q931001-has-strict-fderiv-at-p
    (domain-space codomain-space function derivative point)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q931001-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (q931001-strict-derivative-radius-exists-p
      domain-space codomain-space function derivative
      point epsilon))))

(defun q931001-strict-derivative-data-p
    (domain-space codomain-space function derivative point)
  (and
   (q931001-function-p
    (q931001-space-carrier domain-space)
    (q931001-space-carrier codomain-space)
    function)
   (q931001-has-strict-fderiv-at-p
    domain-space codomain-space function derivative point)))

;; A continuous linear equivalence and its inverse continuous linear map.

(defun q931001-equiv-forward (equiv)
  (nth 0 equiv))

(defun q931001-equiv-inverse (equiv)
  (nth 1 equiv))

(defun-sk q931001-equiv-inverse-laws-p
    (domain-space codomain-space equiv)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q931001-member-p
       (q931001-space-carrier domain-space) x)
      (equal
       (q931001-unary-value
        (q931001-equiv-inverse equiv)
        (q931001-unary-value
         (q931001-equiv-forward equiv) x))
       x))
     (implies
      (q931001-member-p
       (q931001-space-carrier codomain-space) y)
      (equal
       (q931001-unary-value
        (q931001-equiv-forward equiv)
        (q931001-unary-value
         (q931001-equiv-inverse equiv) y))
       y)))))

(defun q931001-continuous-linear-equiv-p
    (field domain-space codomain-space equiv)
  (and
   (true-listp equiv)
   (equal (len equiv) 2)
   (q931001-continuous-linear-map-p
    field domain-space codomain-space
    (q931001-equiv-forward equiv))
   (q931001-continuous-linear-map-p
    field codomain-space domain-space
    (q931001-equiv-inverse equiv))
   (q931001-equiv-inverse-laws-p
    domain-space codomain-space equiv)))

;; Open subsets of a normed space.

(defun-sk q931001-set-members-carrier-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q931001-member-p set x)
     (q931001-member-p carrier x))))

(defun q931001-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (q931001-set-members-carrier-p carrier set))

(defun-sk q931001-ball-subset-p
    (space set center radius)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p (q931001-space-carrier space) x)
      (q931001-norm-lt-p
       (q931001-space-norm-lt space)
       (q931001-vector-difference
        (q931001-space-add space)
        (q931001-space-negate space)
        x center)
       radius))
     (q931001-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q931001-open-radius-exists-p (space set center)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q931001-positive-rational-p radius)
     (q931001-ball-subset-p space set center radius))))

(defun-sk q931001-open-at-every-point-p (space set)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (q931001-member-p set center)
     (q931001-open-radius-exists-p space set center))))

(defun q931001-open-set-p (space set)
  (and
   (q931001-valid-set-p
    (q931001-space-carrier space) set)
   (q931001-open-at-every-point-p space set)))

;; Rational upper-cut presentation of the operator norm of the inverse map.

(defun-sk q931001-inverse-linear-bound-p
    (domain-space codomain-space equiv coefficient)
  (forall (input input-bound output-bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p
       (q931001-space-carrier codomain-space) input)
      (q931001-positive-rational-p coefficient)
      (q931001-positive-rational-p input-bound)
      (q931001-positive-rational-p output-bound)
      (q931001-norm-lt-p
       (q931001-space-norm-lt codomain-space)
       input input-bound)
      (< (* coefficient input-bound) output-bound))
     (q931001-norm-lt-p
      (q931001-space-norm-lt domain-space)
      (q931001-unary-value
       (q931001-equiv-inverse equiv) input)
      output-bound))))

(defun-sk q931001-inverse-operator-norm-lt-p
    (domain-space codomain-space equiv bound)
  (exists (coefficient)
    (and
     (q931001-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q931001-positive-rational-p coefficient)
     (< coefficient bound)
     (q931001-inverse-linear-bound-p
      domain-space codomain-space equiv coefficient))))

(defun-sk q931001-inverse-operator-norm-positive-p
    (domain-space codomain-space equiv)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q931001-positive-rational-p bound)
     (not
      (q931001-inverse-operator-norm-lt-p
       domain-space codomain-space equiv bound)))))

(defun-sk q931001-inverse-operator-norm-greater-p
    (domain-space codomain-space equiv threshold)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q931001-positive-rational-p threshold)
     (q931001-positive-rational-p bound)
     (< threshold bound)
     (not
      (q931001-inverse-operator-norm-lt-p
       domain-space codomain-space equiv bound)))))

;; This is the strict upper-cut relation
;; ||equiv.symm||_+^{-1} / 2 < epsilon.

(defun q931001-half-inverse-operator-norm-lt-p
    (domain-space codomain-space equiv epsilon)
  (and
   (q931001-positive-rational-p epsilon)
   (or
    (not
     (q931001-inverse-operator-norm-positive-p
      domain-space codomain-space equiv))
    (q931001-inverse-operator-norm-greater-p
     domain-space codomain-space equiv
     (/ 1 (* 2 epsilon))))))

(defun q931001-derivative-remainder
    (domain-space codomain-space function derivative x y)
  (q931001-vector-difference
   (q931001-space-add codomain-space)
   (q931001-space-negate codomain-space)
   (q931001-vector-difference
    (q931001-space-add codomain-space)
    (q931001-space-negate codomain-space)
    (q931001-unary-value function x)
    (q931001-unary-value function y))
   (q931001-unary-value
    derivative
    (q931001-vector-difference
     (q931001-space-add domain-space)
     (q931001-space-negate domain-space)
     x y))))

;; ApproximatesLinearOn f equiv.forward source
;; (||equiv.inverse||_+^{-1} / 2), represented by upper cuts.

(defun-sk q931001-approximates-derivative-on-p
    (domain-space codomain-space function equiv source)
  (forall (x y epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-member-p source x)
      (q931001-member-p source y)
      (q931001-half-inverse-operator-norm-lt-p
       domain-space codomain-space equiv epsilon))
     (q931001-scaled-norm-bound-p
      (q931001-space-norm-lt codomain-space)
      (q931001-derivative-remainder
       domain-space codomain-space function
       (q931001-equiv-forward equiv) x y)
      (q931001-space-norm-lt domain-space)
      (q931001-vector-difference
       (q931001-space-add domain-space)
       (q931001-space-negate domain-space)
       x y)
      epsilon))))

;; The source neighbourhood used by
;; HasStrictFDerivAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph is represented by a concrete open
;; ball.  Choosing its positive rational radius avoids quantifying over an
;; externally supplied family of set tags.

(defun q931001-in-open-ball-p
    (space center radius point)
  (and
   (q931001-member-p
    (q931001-space-carrier space) point)
   (q931001-positive-rational-p radius)
   (q931001-norm-lt-p
    (q931001-space-norm-lt space)
    (q931001-vector-difference
     (q931001-space-add space)
     (q931001-space-negate space)
     point center)
    radius)))

(defun-sk q931001-approximates-derivative-on-ball-p
    (domain-space codomain-space function equiv point radius)
  (forall (x y epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q931001-in-open-ball-p
       domain-space point radius x)
      (q931001-in-open-ball-p
       domain-space point radius y)
      (q931001-half-inverse-operator-norm-lt-p
       domain-space codomain-space equiv epsilon))
     (q931001-scaled-norm-bound-p
      (q931001-space-norm-lt codomain-space)
      (q931001-derivative-remainder
       domain-space codomain-space function
       (q931001-equiv-forward equiv) x y)
      (q931001-space-norm-lt domain-space)
      (q931001-vector-difference
       (q931001-space-add domain-space)
       (q931001-space-negate domain-space)
       x y)
      epsilon))))

(defun q931001-derived-radius-candidate-p
    (domain-space codomain-space function equiv point radius)
  (and
   (q931001-positive-rational-p radius)
   (q931001-approximates-derivative-on-ball-p
    domain-space codomain-space function equiv point radius)))

(defchoose q931001-derived-radius
    (radius)
    (domain-space codomain-space function equiv point)
  (q931001-derived-radius-candidate-p
   domain-space codomain-space function equiv point radius))

;; Function.invFunOn chooses a source preimage when one exists and otherwise
;; chooses an arbitrary element of the nonempty domain carrier.

(defun-sk q931001-source-preimage-exists-p
    (domain-space function point radius image)
  (exists (preimage)
    (and
     (q931001-in-open-ball-p
      domain-space point radius preimage)
     (equal
      (q931001-unary-value function preimage)
      image))))

(defchoose q931001-source-preimage
    (preimage)
    (domain-space function point radius image)
  (and
   (q931001-in-open-ball-p
    domain-space point radius preimage)
   (equal
    (q931001-unary-value function preimage)
    image)))

(defchoose q931001-carrier-default
    (element)
    (carrier)
  (q931001-member-p carrier element))

(defun q931001-local-inverse-value
    (domain-space codomain-space function equiv point image)
  (let ((radius
         (q931001-derived-radius
          domain-space codomain-space function equiv point)))
    (if
     (q931001-source-preimage-exists-p
      domain-space function point radius image)
     (q931001-source-preimage
      domain-space function point radius image)
     (q931001-carrier-default
      (q931001-space-carrier domain-space)))))

(defun-sk q931001-local-inverse-values-p
    (domain-space codomain-space function equiv point)
  (forall (image)
    (implies
     (q931001-member-p
      (q931001-space-carrier codomain-space) image)
     (q931001-member-p
      (q931001-space-carrier domain-space)
      (q931001-local-inverse-value
       domain-space codomain-space function equiv point image)))))

;; Strict derivative of the internally defined local inverse.

(defun q931001-local-inverse-remainder
    (domain-space codomain-space function equiv point x y)
  (q931001-vector-difference
   (q931001-space-add domain-space)
   (q931001-space-negate domain-space)
   (q931001-vector-difference
    (q931001-space-add domain-space)
    (q931001-space-negate domain-space)
    (q931001-local-inverse-value
     domain-space codomain-space function equiv point x)
    (q931001-local-inverse-value
     domain-space codomain-space function equiv point y))
   (q931001-unary-value
    (q931001-equiv-inverse equiv)
    (q931001-vector-difference
