title: Q931001_inverse_function_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q931001,
-- "Inverse function theorem": a map between normed spaces whose strict
-- derivative at a point is a continuous linear equivalence has a local inverse
-- with the inverse strict derivative at the image point. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q931001_inverse_function_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR x == zeroR -> x == zeroR
    absolute-negateR :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record NontriviallyNormedField
  (K R : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK reciprocalK : K -> K
    normK : K -> R

    one-not-zeroK :
      oneK != zeroK
    norm-nontrivialK :
      Exists K
        (\ x ->
          Both
            (lessOrEqualR reals (oneR reals) (normK x))
            (oneR reals != normK x))

    add-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> addK x y == addK y x
    add-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-zeroK :
      (x : K) -> addK x zeroK == x
    add-inverseK :
      (x : K) -> addK x (negateK x) == zeroK

    multiply-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> multiplyK x y == multiplyK y x
    multiply-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z ==
      multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-oneK :
      (x : K) -> multiplyK x oneK == x
    multiply-zeroK :
      (x : K) -> multiplyK x zeroK == zeroK
    distributeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    reciprocal-zeroK :
      reciprocalK zeroK == zeroK
    multiply-reciprocalK :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (reciprocalK x) == oneK

    norm-nonnegativeK :
      (x : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normK x)
    norm-zeroK :
      normK zeroK == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyK :
      (x : K) ->
      normK x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroK
    norm-negateK :
      (x : K) ->
      normK (negateK x) == normK x
    norm-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normK (addK x y))
        (addR reals (normK x) (normK y))
    norm-multiplyK :
      (x y : K) ->
      normK (multiplyK x y) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK x) (normK y)

open NontriviallyNormedField

record NormedSpace
  (K R E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : K -> E -> E
    normE : E -> R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) -> addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) -> addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) -> addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-oneE :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (oneK scalars) x == x
    scale-associativeE :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyK scalars a b) x ==
      scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectorsE :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalarsE :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addK scalars a b) x ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegativeE :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zeroE :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroE
    norm-negateE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-addE :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scaleE :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK scalars a) (normE x)

open NormedSpace

subtractE :
  {K R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R E reals scalars ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

distanceE :
  {K R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R E reals scalars ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
distanceE space x y =
  normE space (subtractE space x y)

SequentialLimit :
  {R E : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (E -> E -> R) ->
  (Nat -> E) ->
  E ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} reals distance sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distance (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {R E : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (E -> E -> R) ->
  (Nat -> E) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} reals distance sequence =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distance (sequence m) (sequence n)) epsilon)

Complete :
  {R E : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (E -> E -> R) ->
  Set
Complete {E = E} reals distance =
  (sequence : Nat -> E) ->
  CauchySequence reals distance sequence ->
  Exists E
    (\ limit ->
      SequentialLimit reals distance sequence limit)

record ContinuousLinearMap
  {K R E F : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals}
  (domain : NormedSpace K R E reals scalars)
  (codomain : NormedSpace K R F reals scalars) : Set where
  field
    apply : E -> F
    map-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      apply (addE domain x y) ==
      addE codomain (apply x) (apply y)
    map-scale :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      apply (scaleE domain a x) ==
      scaleE codomain a (apply x)
    operator-bound : R
    operator-bound-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) operator-bound
    bounded :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE codomain (apply x))
        (multiplyR reals operator-bound (normE domain x))

open ContinuousLinearMap

record ContinuousLinearEquivalence
  {K R E F : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals}
  (domain : NormedSpace K R E reals scalars)
  (codomain : NormedSpace K R F reals scalars) : Set where
  field
    forward :
      ContinuousLinearMap domain codomain
    inverse :
      ContinuousLinearMap codomain domain
    inverse-forward :
      (x : E) ->
      apply inverse (apply forward x) == x
    forward-inverse :
      (y : F) ->
      apply forward (apply inverse y) == y

open ContinuousLinearEquivalence

DerivativeRemainder :
  {K R E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  (domain : NormedSpace K R E reals scalars) ->
  (codomain : NormedSpace K R F reals scalars) ->
  (E -> F) ->
  ContinuousLinearMap domain codomain ->
  E ->
  E ->
  F
DerivativeRemainder domain codomain function derivative x y =
  subtractE codomain
    (subtractE codomain (function x) (function y))
    (apply derivative (subtractE domain x y))

HasStrictFDerivAt :
  {K R E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  (domain : NormedSpace K R E reals scalars) ->
  (codomain : NormedSpace K R F reals scalars) ->
  (E -> F) ->
  ContinuousLinearMap domain codomain ->
  E ->
  Set
HasStrictFDerivAt {R = R} {reals = reals}
  domain codomain function derivative point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((x y : _) ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceE domain x point) radius ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceE domain y point) radius ->
          lessOrEqualR reals
            (normE codomain
              (DerivativeRemainder
                domain codomain function derivative x y))
            (multiplyR reals epsilon
              (distanceE domain x y))))

LocallyLeftInverse :
  {K R E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R E reals scalars ->
  (E -> F) ->
  (F -> E) ->
  E ->
  Set
LocallyLeftInverse {R = R} {reals = reals}
  domain function localInverse point =
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((x : _) ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceE domain x point) radius ->
          localInverse (function x) == x))

LocallyRightInverse :
  {K R E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R F reals scalars ->
  (E -> F) ->
  (F -> E) ->
  E ->
  Set
LocallyRightInverse {R = R} {reals = reals}
  codomain function localInverse point =
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : _) ->
          StrictLess reals
            (distanceE codomain y (function point))
            radius ->
          function (localInverse y) == y))

inverse-function-theorem : Set1
inverse-function-theorem =
  (R K E F : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals) ->
  (domain : NormedSpace K R E reals scalars) ->
  Complete reals (distanceE domain) ->
  (codomain : NormedSpace K R F reals scalars) ->
  (function : E -> F) ->
  (derivative : ContinuousLinearEquivalence domain codomain) ->
  (point : E) ->
  HasStrictFDerivAt
    domain codomain function (forward derivative) point ->
  Exists (F -> E)
    (\ localInverse ->
      Both
        (LocallyLeftInverse domain function localInverse point)
        (Both
          (LocallyRightInverse codomain function localInverse point)
          (HasStrictFDerivAt
            codomain domain localInverse (inverse derivative)
            (function point))))

title: Q931001_inverse_function_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q931001 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q931001), "Inverse function theorem":
  over a nontrivially normed field, a map from a complete normed space with
  an invertible strict Frechet derivative at a point has a choice-constructed
  local inverse whose strict derivative at the image point is the inverse
  continuous linear map. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val q931001_nontrivially_normed_field_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_nontrivially_normed_field_def",
  ``q931001_nontrivially_normed_field
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) <=>
      zeroK <> oneK /\
      (!a b. addK a b = addK b a) /\
      (!a b c. addK (addK a b) c = addK a (addK b c)) /\
      (!a. addK a zeroK = a) /\
      (!a. addK a (negK a) = zeroK) /\
      (!a b. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
      (!a b c. mulK (mulK a b) c = mulK a (mulK b c)) /\
      (!a. mulK a oneK = a) /\
      (!a b c.
        mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
      invK zeroK = zeroK /\
      (!a. a <> zeroK ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
      (!a. 0 <= normK a) /\
      (!a. (normK a = 0) <=> (a = zeroK)) /\
      (!a. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\
      (!a b. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
      (!a b. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
      (?a. 1 < normK a)``);

val q931001_normed_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_normed_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q931001_normed_add_comm_group
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (neg : 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add x zero = x) /\
      (!x. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
      norm zero = 0 /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. (norm x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y)``);

val q931001_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_normed_space_def",
  ``q931001_normed_space
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x. smulE oneK x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (mulK a b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (addK a b) x = addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smulE a (addE x y) = addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
      (!x. smulE zeroK x = zeroE) /\
      (!a. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!a x. normE (smulE a x) = normK a * normE x)``);

val q931001_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_tendsto_def",
  ``q931001_tendsto
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) (x : 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon``);

val q931001_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_cauchy_def",
  ``q931001_cauchy
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !m n : num.
          N <= m /\ N <= n ==>
          norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon``);

val q931001_complete_space_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_complete_space_def",
  ``q931001_complete_space
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'e.
        q931001_cauchy add neg norm u ==>
        ?x : 'e. q931001_tendsto add neg norm u x``);

val q931001_continuous_linear_map_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_continuous_linear_map_def",
  ``q931001_continuous_linear_map
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (smulF : 'k -> 'f -> 'f)
      (normF : 'f -> real) (L : 'e -> 'f) <=>
      (!x y. L (addE x y) = addF (L x) (L y)) /\
      (!a x. L (smulE a x) = smulF a (L x)) /\
      ?C : real.
        0 <= C /\
        !x. normF (L x) <= C * normE x``);

val q931001_continuous_linear_equiv_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_continuous_linear_equiv_def",
  ``q931001_continuous_linear_equiv
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (smulF : 'k -> 'f -> 'f)
      (normF : 'f -> real)
      (forward : 'e -> 'f) (inverse : 'f -> 'e) <=>
      q931001_continuous_linear_map
        addE smulE normE addF smulF normF forward /\
      q931001_continuous_linear_map
        addF smulF normF addE smulE normE inverse /\
      (!x. inverse (forward x) = x) /\
      (!y. forward (inverse y) = y)``);

val q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at_def",
  ``q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (negF : 'f -> 'f)
      (smulF : 'k -> 'f -> 'f) (normF : 'f -> real)
      (f : 'e -> 'f) (f' : 'e -> 'f) (a : 'e) <=>
      q931001_continuous_linear_map
        addE smulE normE addF smulF normF f' /\
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !x y : 'e.
            normE (addE x (negE a)) < delta /\
            normE (addE y (negE a)) < delta
            ==>
            normF
              (addF
                (addF (f x) (negF (f y)))
                (negF (f' (addE x (negE y))))) <=
            epsilon * normE (addE x (negE y))``);

val q931001_open_set_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_open_set_def",
  ``q931001_open_set
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (s : 'a -> bool) <=>
      !x.
        x IN s ==>
        ?radius : real.
          0 < radius /\
          !y.
            norm (add y (neg x)) < radius ==>
            y IN s``);

val q931001_continuous_on_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_continuous_on_def",
  ``q931001_continuous_on
      (addA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (negA : 'a -> 'a)
      (normA : 'a -> real)
      (addB : 'b -> 'b -> 'b) (negB : 'b -> 'b)
      (normB : 'b -> real)
      (source : 'a -> bool) (f : 'a -> 'b) <=>
      !x.
        x IN source ==>
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !y.
              y IN source /\
              normA (addA y (negA x)) < delta
              ==>
              normB (addB (f y) (negB (f x))) < epsilon``);

val q931001_open_partial_homeomorph_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_open_partial_homeomorph_def",
  ``q931001_open_partial_homeomorph
      (addA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (negA : 'a -> 'a)
      (normA : 'a -> real)
      (addB : 'b -> 'b -> 'b) (negB : 'b -> 'b)
      (normB : 'b -> real)
      (forward : 'a -> 'b) (pt : 'a)
      (h : ('a -> bool) # (('b -> bool) # ('b -> 'a))) <=>
      let source = FST h in
      let target = FST (SND h) in
      let inverse = SND (SND h) in
        q931001_open_set addA negA normA source /\
        q931001_open_set addB negB normB target /\
        pt IN source /\
        forward pt IN target /\
        (!x.
          x IN source ==>
          forward x IN target /\ inverse (forward x) = x) /\
        (!y.
          y IN target ==>
          inverse y IN source /\ forward (inverse y) = y) /\
        q931001_continuous_on
          addA negA normA addB negB normB source forward /\
        q931001_continuous_on
          addB negB normB addA negA normA target inverse``);

val q931001_to_open_partial_homeomorph_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_to_open_partial_homeomorph_def",
  ``q931001_to_open_partial_homeomorph
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (negF : 'f -> 'f)
      (smulF : 'k -> 'f -> 'f) (normF : 'f -> real)
      (f : 'e -> 'f) (f' : 'e -> 'f) (f'inv : 'f -> 'e)
      (a : 'e) =
      @h : ('e -> bool) # (('f -> bool) # ('f -> 'e)).
        q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at
          addE negE smulE normE addF negF smulF normF f f' a /\
        q931001_continuous_linear_equiv
          addE smulE normE addF smulF normF f' f'inv /\
        q931001_open_partial_homeomorph
          addE negE normE addF negF normF f a h``);

val q931001_local_inverse_def = new_definition (
  "q931001_local_inverse_def",
  ``q931001_local_inverse
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (negF : 'f -> 'f)
      (smulF : 'k -> 'f -> 'f) (normF : 'f -> real)
      (f : 'e -> 'f) (f' : 'e -> 'f) (f'inv : 'f -> 'e)
      (a : 'e) =
      SND
        (SND
          (q931001_to_open_partial_homeomorph
            addE negE smulE normE
            addF negF smulF normF
            f f' f'inv a))``);

val HasStrictFDerivAt_to_localInverse =
  ``!(zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (zeroF : 'f) (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (negF : 'f -> 'f) (smulF : 'k -> 'f -> 'f)
      (normF : 'f -> real)
      (f : 'e -> 'f) (f' : 'e -> 'f) (f'inv : 'f -> 'e)
      (a : 'e).
      q931001_nontrivially_normed_field
        zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
      q931001_normed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
      q931001_normed_space
        zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroE addE smulE normE /\
      q931001_complete_space addE negE normE /\
      q931001_normed_add_comm_group zeroF addF negF normF /\
      q931001_normed_space
        zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroF addF smulF normF /\
      q931001_continuous_linear_equiv
        addE smulE normE addF smulF normF f' f'inv /\
      q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at
        addE negE smulE normE addF negF smulF normF f f' a
      ==>
      q931001_has_strict_fderiv_at
        addF negF smulF normF addE negE smulE normE
        (q931001_local_inverse
          addE negE smulE normE addF negF smulF normF
          f f' f'inv a)
        f'inv (f a)``;

title: Q931001_inverse_function_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q931001
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q931001), "Inverse function theorem": a
  function between arbitrary normed spaces over an arbitrary nontrivially
  normed field, with complete source space and an invertible strict Frechet
  derivative at a point, has a locally constructed inverse whose strict
  derivative at the image point is the inverse linear equivalence. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q931001HasStrictFDerivAt is the two-point epsilon-delta definition of a
  strict Frechet derivative between arbitrary normed spaces.
  Q931001ValidData explicitly unpacks the continuous linear equivalence into
  mutually inverse continuous linear maps L and M. This is equivalent to
  Lean's bundled E equivL[K] F object, with M representing its symm field.
  Completeness is required only of E, exactly as in the source theorem.

  Q931001OperatorNorm is the operator norm of M. Q931001ApproximatesOn and
  Q931001OpenApproxNeighborhoods expand the approximation neighborhood used
  by HasStrictFDerivAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph, with constant
  ||M||^-1 / 2. The constant is explicitly zero when ||M|| is zero, matching
  NNReal's totalized inverse in the degenerate zero-space case.

  The approximation neighborhood N, a default point d of E, and a choice
  function h are existentially scoped inside the final assertion. For each
  y, Q931001InverseFiber is its preimage in N when nonempty and the singleton
  {d} otherwise. Q931001InverseFiberFamily is the set-sized range of this
  family, and Q931001ChoiceFunction has exactly SetMM's ac5 form on that set.
  Thus Q931001InvFunOn expands Function.invFunOn without introducing a global
  choice selector, and Q931001LocalInverse is definitionally this total
  inverse function. The final unproved $a assertion renders
  HasStrictFDerivAt.to_localInverse and contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q931001HasStrictFDerivAt Q931001ValidData Q931001OperatorNorm
   Q931001ApproximatesOn Q931001OpenApproxNeighborhoods
   Q931001InverseFiber Q931001InverseFiberMap
   Q931001InverseFiberFamily Q931001ChoiceFunction
   Q931001InvFunOn Q931001LocalInverse $.

q931001-has-strict-fderiv-at-syntax $a wff
  ( Q931001HasStrictFDerivAt V W f L a ) $.
q931001-valid-data-syntax $a wff
  ( Q931001ValidData K E F f L M a ) $.
q931001-operator-norm-syntax $a class
  ( Q931001OperatorNorm E F M ) $.
q931001-approximates-on-syntax $a wff
  ( Q931001ApproximatesOn E F f L S c ) $.
q931001-open-approx-neighborhoods-syntax $a class
  ( Q931001OpenApproxNeighborhoods E F f L M a ) $.
q931001-inverse-fiber-syntax $a class
  ( Q931001InverseFiber E F f N d y ) $.
q931001-inverse-fiber-map-syntax $a class
  ( Q931001InverseFiberMap E F f N d ) $.
q931001-inverse-fiber-family-syntax $a class
  ( Q931001InverseFiberFamily E F f N d ) $.
q931001-choice-function-syntax $a wff
  ( Q931001ChoiceFunction E F f N d h ) $.
q931001-inv-fun-on-syntax $a class
  ( Q931001InvFunOn E F f N d h ) $.
q931001-local-inverse-syntax $a class
  ( Q931001LocalInverse E F f N d h ) $.

${
  $d L V W a d e f x y $.

  q931001-has-strict-fderiv-at-definition $a |- (
    ( Q931001HasStrictFDerivAt V W f L a )
    <->
    (
      (
        f e. ( ( Base ` W ) ^m ( Base ` V ) )
        /\
        a e. ( Base ` V )
        /\
        L e. ( V LMHom W )
        /\
        L e. ( ( TopOpen ` V ) Cn ( TopOpen ` W ) )
      )
      /\
      A. e e. RR+
        E. d e. RR+
          A. x e. ( Base ` V )
            A. y e. ( Base ` V )
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( norm ` V )
                    `
                    (
                      x
                      ( +g ` V )
                      ( ( -g ` V ) ` a )
                    )
                  )
                  <
                  d
                  /\
                  (
                    ( norm ` V )
                    `
                    (
                      y
                      ( +g ` V )
                      ( ( -g ` V ) ` a )
                    )
                  )
                  <
                  d
                )
                ->
                (
                  ( norm ` W )
                  `
                  (
                    (
                      ( f ` y )
                      ( +g ` W )
                      ( ( -g ` W ) ` ( f ` x ) )
                    )
                    ( +g ` W )
                    (
                      ( -g ` W )
                      `
                      (
                        L
                        `
                        (
                          y
                          ( +g ` V )
                          ( ( -g ` V ) ` x )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
                <_
                (
                  e
                  x.
                  (
                    ( norm ` V )
                    `
                    (
                      y
                      ( +g ` V )
                      ( ( -g ` V ) ` x )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d E F K L M a c f x y $.

  q931001-valid-data-definition $a |- (
    ( Q931001ValidData K E F f L M a )
    <->
    (
      K e. ( NrmRing i^i Field )
      /\
      E e. { x e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` x ) = K }
      /\
      F e. { y e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` y ) = K }
      /\
      E. c e. ( Base ` K )
        1 < ( ( norm ` K ) ` c )
      /\
      E e. CMetSp
      /\
      L e. ( E LMHom F )
      /\
      M e. ( F LMHom E )
      /\
      M e. ( ( TopOpen ` F ) Cn ( TopOpen ` E ) )
      /\
      A. x e. ( Base ` E )
        ( M ` ( L ` x ) ) = x
      /\
      A. y e. ( Base ` F )
        ( L ` ( M ` y ) ) = y
      /\
      ( Q931001HasStrictFDerivAt E F f L a )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C E F M y $.

  q931001-operator-norm-definition $a |- (
    Q931001OperatorNorm E F M
  ) = inf (
    {
      C e. RR |
      (
        0 <_ C
        /\
        A. y e. ( Base ` F )
          (
            ( norm ` E )
            `
            ( M ` y )
          )
          <_
          (
            C
            x.
            ( ( norm ` F ) ` y )
          )
      )
    }
    ,
    RR
    ,
    <
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d E F L S c f x y $.

  q931001-approximates-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q931001ApproximatesOn E F f L S c )
    <->
    A. x e. S
      A. y e. S
        (
          ( norm ` F )
          `
          (
            (
              ( f ` y )
              ( +g ` F )
              ( ( -g ` F ) ` ( f ` x ) )
            )
            ( +g ` F )
            (
              ( -g ` F )
              `
              (
                L
                `
                (
                  y
                  ( +g ` E )
                  ( ( -g ` E ) ` x )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        <_
        (
          c
          x.
          (
            ( norm ` E )
            `
            (
              y
              ( +g ` E )
              ( ( -g ` E ) ` x )
            )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d E F L M a f s $.

  q931001-open-approx-neighborhoods-definition $a |- (
    Q931001OpenApproxNeighborhoods E F f L M a
  ) =
    { s e. ~P ( Base ` E ) |
      (
        a e. s
        /\
        s e. ( TopOpen ` E )
        /\
        (
          Q931001ApproximatesOn E F f L s
          if (
            ( Q931001OperatorNorm E F M ) = 0
            ,
            0
            ,
            (
              (
                1
                /
                ( Q931001OperatorNorm E F M )
              )
              /
              2
            )
          )
        )
      )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d E F N d f x y $.

  q931001-inverse-fiber-definition $a |- (
    Q931001InverseFiber E F f N d y
  ) =
    if
    (
      { x e. N | ( f ` x ) = y } =/= (/) ,
      { x e. N | ( f ` x ) = y } ,
      { d }
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d E F N d f y $.

  q931001-inverse-fiber-map-definition $a |- (
    Q931001InverseFiberMap E F f N d
  ) =
    (
      y e. ( Base ` F ) |->
      ( Q931001InverseFiber E F f N d y )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d E F N d f $.

  q931001-inverse-fiber-family-definition $a |- (
    Q931001InverseFiberFamily E F f N d
  ) =
    ran ( Q931001InverseFiberMap E F f N d )
  $.
$}

${
  $d E F N S d f h $.

  q931001-choice-function-definition $a |- (
    Q931001ChoiceFunction E F f N d h
  )
  <->
    (
      h Fn ( Q931001InverseFiberFamily E F f N d )
      /\
      A. S e. ( Q931001InverseFiberFamily E F f N d )
        ( h ` S ) e. S
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d E F N d f h y $.

  q931001-inv-fun-on-definition $a |- (
    Q931001InvFunOn E F f N d h
  ) =
    (
      y e. ( Base ` F ) |->
      (
        h
        `
        ( Q931001InverseFiber E F f N d y )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d E F N d f h $.

  q931001-local-inverse-definition $a |- (
    Q931001LocalInverse E F f N d h
  ) =
    ( Q931001InvFunOn E F f N d h )
  $.
$}

${
  $d E F K L M N a d f h $.

  thousand-theorems-q931001-inverse-function-theorem $a |-
    A. K A. E A. F A. f A. L A. M A. a
      (
        (
          Q931001ValidData K E F f L M a
        )
        ->
        E. N e.
          ( Q931001OpenApproxNeighborhoods E F f L M a )
          E. d e. ( Base ` E )
            E. h
              (
                (
                  Q931001ChoiceFunction E F f N d h
                )
                /\
                (
                  Q931001HasStrictFDerivAt
                  F
                  E
                  ( Q931001LocalInverse E F f N d h )
                  M
                  ( f ` a )
                )
              )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q931001_inverse_function_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q931001
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q931001), "Inverse function theorem": a function
:: with an invertible strict derivative on a complete normed vector space has
:: a local inverse whose strict derivative is the inverse linear map. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1,
      TARSKI, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5, VECTSP_1, ARYTM_1,
      ARYTM_3, SUPINF_2, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, BINOP_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, CARD_1, XCMPLX_0,
      XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1, XXREAL_0,
      RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1, BINOP_1;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, NAT_1, XXREAL_0,
      REAL_1, COMPLEX1, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, BINOP_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1;
 requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for K being Field,
      E,F being VectSp of K,
      normK being Function of the carrier of K,REAL,
      normE being Function of the carrier of E,REAL,
      normF being Function of the carrier of F,REAL,
      f,deriv being Function of the carrier of E,the carrier of F,
      invDeriv being Function of the carrier of F,the carrier of E,
      pt being Element of E
  st
    (for a being Element of K holds 0 <= normK.a) &
    (for a being Element of K holds
      (normK.a = 0 iff a = 0.K)) &
    (for a,b being Element of K holds
      normK.(a+b) <= normK.a + normK.b) &
    (for a,b being Element of K holds
      normK.(a*b) = normK.a * normK.b) &
    (ex a being Element of K st 1 < normK.a) &
    (for x being Element of E holds 0 <= normE.x) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      (normE.x = 0 iff x = 0.E)) &
    (for x,y being Element of E holds
      normE.(x+y) <= normE.x + normE.y) &
    (for a being Element of K, x being Element of E holds
      normE.(a*x) = normK.a * normE.x) &
    (for y being Element of F holds 0 <= normF.y) &
    (for y being Element of F holds
      (normF.y = 0 iff y = 0.F)) &
    (for y,z being Element of F holds
      normF.(y+z) <= normF.y + normF.z) &
    (for a being Element of K, y being Element of F holds
      normF.(a*y) = normK.a * normF.y) &
    (for s being Function of NAT,the carrier of E st
      (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex N being Nat st
          for m,n being Nat st N <= m & N <= n holds
            normE.(s.m-s.n) < epsilon)
    holds
      ex x being Element of E st
        for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
          ex N being Nat st
            for n being Nat st N <= n holds
              normE.(s.n-x) < epsilon) &
    (for x,y being Element of E holds
      deriv.(x+y) = deriv.x + deriv.y) &
    (for a being Element of K, x being Element of E holds
      deriv.(a*x) = a * deriv.x) &
    (ex C being Real st
      0 <= C &
      for x being Element of E holds
        normF.(deriv.x) <= C * normE.x) &
    (for y,z being Element of F holds
      invDeriv.(y+z) = invDeriv.y + invDeriv.z) &
    (for a being Element of K, y being Element of F holds
      invDeriv.(a*y) = a * invDeriv.y) &
    (ex C being Real st
      0 <= C &
      for y being Element of F holds
        normE.(invDeriv.y) <= C * normF.y) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      invDeriv.(deriv.x) = x) &
    (for y being Element of F holds
      deriv.(invDeriv.y) = y) &
    (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
      ex delta being Real st
        0 < delta &
        for x,y being Element of E st
          normE.(x-pt) < delta & normE.(y-pt) < delta
        holds
          normF.((f.x-f.y)-deriv.(x-y))
            <= epsilon * normE.(x-y))
  holds
    ex localInverse being
         Function of the carrier of F,the carrier of E,
       radius being Real st
      0 < radius &
      (for x being Element of E st normE.(x-pt) < radius holds
        localInverse.(f.x) = x) &
      for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex delta being Real st
          0 < delta &
          for y,z being Element of F st
            normF.(y-f.pt) < delta & normF.(z-f.pt) < delta
          holds
            normE.((localInverse.y-localInverse.z)-invDeriv.(y-z))
              <= epsilon * normF.(y-z)
proof
end;

title: Q931001_inverse_function_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q931001,
% "Inverse function theorem": a map with an invertible strict Frechet derivative
% has a local inverse whose strict derivative is the inverse linear map. This file
% contains no proof.

Q931001_inverse_function_theorem[
  K: TYPE+,
  E: TYPE+,
  F: TYPE+,
  zeroK, oneK: K,
  addK, mulK: [K, K -> K],
  negK, invK: [K -> K],
  normK: [K -> real],
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [K, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  zeroF: F,
  addF: [F, F -> F],
  negF: [F -> F],
  smulF: [K, F -> F],
  normF: [F -> real],
  f: [E -> F],
  derivative: [E -> F],
  inverseDerivative: [F -> E],
  point: E
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  local_inverse_type: TYPE = [F -> E]

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  subF(x, y: F): F =
    addF(x, negF(y))

  nontrivially_normed_field: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: K):
      addK(a, b) = addK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        addK(addK(a, b), c) = addK(a, addK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        addK(a, zeroK) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        addK(a, negK(a)) = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        mulK(a, b) = mulK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(mulK(a, b), c) = mulK(a, mulK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        mulK(a, oneK) = a)
      AND zeroK /= oneK
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(a, addK(b, c)) =
          addK(mulK(a, b), mulK(a, c)))
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        a /= zeroK IMPLIES
          mulK(a, invK(a)) = oneK)
      AND normK(zeroK) = 0
      AND normK(oneK) = 1
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        0 <= normK(a))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        normK(a) = 0 IFF a = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        normK(negK(a)) = normK(a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        normK(addK(a, b)) <= normK(a) + normK(b))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        normK(mulK(a, b)) = normK(a) * normK(b))
      AND (EXISTS (a: K):
        1 < normK(a))

  normed_space_E: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smulE(addK(a, b), x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smulE(mulK(a, b), x) =
          smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(oneK, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(zeroK, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)
      AND normE(zeroE) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) = normK(a) * normE(x))

  normed_space_F: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: F):
      addF(x, y) = addF(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
        addF(addF(x, y), z) = addF(x, addF(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        addF(x, zeroF) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        addF(x, negF(x)) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: F):
        smulF(a, addF(x, y)) =
          addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: F):
        smulF(addK(a, b), x) =
          addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: F):
        smulF(mulK(a, b), x) =
          smulF(a, smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        smulF(oneK, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        smulF(zeroK, x) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        smulF(a, zeroF) = zeroF)
      AND normF(zeroF) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        0 <= normF(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        normF(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        normF(negF(x)) = normF(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: F):
        normF(addF(x, y)) <= normF(x) + normF(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: F):
        normF(smulF(a, x)) = normK(a) * normF(x))

  cauchy_E(sequence: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (m, n: nat):
          cutoff <= m AND cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            normE(subE(sequence(m), sequence(n))) < epsilon_value

  converges_E(sequence: e_sequence, limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (n: nat):
          cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            normE(subE(sequence(n), limit)) < epsilon_value

  complete_E: bool =
    FORALL (sequence: e_sequence):
      cauchy_E(sequence) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: E):
          converges_E(sequence, limit)

  continuous_linear_EF(linear_map: [E -> F]): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      linear_map(addE(x, y)) =
        addF(linear_map(x), linear_map(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        linear_map(smulE(a, x)) =
          smulF(a, linear_map(x)))
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        0 <= bound
          AND FORALL (x: E):
            normF(linear_map(x)) <= bound * normE(x)

  continuous_linear_FE(linear_map: [F -> E]): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: F):
      linear_map(addF(x, y)) =
        addE(linear_map(x), linear_map(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: F):
        linear_map(smulF(a, x)) =
          smulE(a, linear_map(x)))
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        0 <= bound
          AND FORALL (x: F):
            normE(linear_map(x)) <= bound * normF(x)

  continuous_linear_equivalence: bool =
    continuous_linear_EF(derivative)
      AND continuous_linear_FE(inverseDerivative)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        inverseDerivative(derivative(x)) = x)
      AND (FORALL (y: F):
        derivative(inverseDerivative(y)) = y)

  has_strict_fderiv_EF(
      function_value: [E -> F],
      linear_map: [E -> F],
      center: E): bool =
    continuous_linear_EF(linear_map)
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (x, y: E):
            (normE(subE(x, center)) < radius
              AND normE(subE(y, center)) < radius)
            IMPLIES
              normF(
                subF(
                  subF(function_value(x), function_value(y)),
                  linear_map(subE(x, y))))
                <= epsilon_value * normE(subE(x, y))

  has_strict_fderiv_FE(
      function_value: [F -> E],
      linear_map: [F -> E],
      center: F): bool =
    continuous_linear_FE(linear_map)
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (x, y: F):
            (normF(subF(x, center)) < radius
              AND normF(subF(y, center)) < radius)
            IMPLIES
              normE(
                subE(
                  subE(function_value(x), function_value(y)),
                  linear_map(subF(x, y))))
                <= epsilon_value * normF(subF(x, y))

  is_local_inverse(
      candidate: local_inverse_type): bool =
    (EXISTS (domain_radius: posreal):
      FORALL (x: E):
        normE(subE(x, point)) < domain_radius
          IMPLIES
            candidate(f(x)) = x)
      AND (EXISTS (codomain_radius: posreal):
        FORALL (y: F):
          normF(subF(y, f(point))) < codomain_radius
            IMPLIES f(candidate(y)) = y)

  inverse_function_theorem: bool =
    (nontrivially_normed_field
      AND normed_space_E
      AND normed_space_F
      AND complete_E
      AND continuous_linear_equivalence
      AND has_strict_fderiv_EF(f, derivative, point))
    IMPLIES
      EXISTS (local_inverse: local_inverse_type):
        is_local_inverse(local_inverse)
          AND has_strict_fderiv_FE(
            local_inverse,
            inverseDerivative,
            f(point))
END Q931001_inverse_function_theorem

title: Q939927_stone_weierstrass_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q939927
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q939927), "Stone–Weierstrass theorem": a real
  subalgebra of continuous functions on an arbitrary compact topological
  space that separates points is uniformly dense. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q939927_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Record q939927_topological_space (X : Type) : Type := {
  q939927_is_open : q939927_set X -> Prop;
  q939927_open_extensional :
    forall U V : q939927_set X,
      (forall x : X, U x <-> V x) ->
      (q939927_is_open U <-> q939927_is_open V);
  q939927_open_univ :
    q939927_is_open (fun _ : X => True);
  q939927_open_intersection :
    forall U V : q939927_set X,
      q939927_is_open U ->
      q939927_is_open V ->
      q939927_is_open (fun x : X => U x /\ V x);
  q939927_open_union :
    forall family : q939927_set (q939927_set X),
      (forall U : q939927_set X,
        family U -> q939927_is_open U) ->
      q939927_is_open
        (fun x : X =>
          exists U : q939927_set X, family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q939927_is_open {X} _ _.

Definition q939927_compact_space
    {X : Type} (T : q939927_topological_space X) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q939927_set (q939927_set X),
    (forall U : q939927_set X,
      cover U -> q939927_is_open T U) ->
    (forall x : X,
      exists U : q939927_set X, cover U /\ U x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q939927_set X),
      Forall cover finite_cover /\
      forall x : X,
        exists U : q939927_set X,
          In U finite_cover /\ U x.

Definition q939927_real_open
    (U : q939927_set R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : R,
        Rabs (y - x) < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q939927_continuous_real
    {X : Type}
    (T : q939927_topological_space X)
    (f : X -> R) : Prop :=
  forall U : q939927_set R,
    q939927_real_open U ->
    q939927_is_open T (fun x : X => U (f x)).

Record q939927_real_subalgebra
    (X : Type) (T : q939927_topological_space X) : Type := {
  q939927_carrier : q939927_set (X -> R);
  q939927_carrier_continuous :
    forall f : X -> R,
      q939927_carrier f ->
      q939927_continuous_real T f;
  q939927_zero_mem :
    q939927_carrier (fun _ : X => 0);
  q939927_one_mem :
    q939927_carrier (fun _ : X => 1);
  q939927_add_mem :
    forall f g : X -> R,
      q939927_carrier f ->
      q939927_carrier g ->
      q939927_carrier (fun x : X => f x + g x);
  q939927_mul_mem :
    forall f g : X -> R,
      q939927_carrier f ->
      q939927_carrier g ->
      q939927_carrier (fun x : X => f x * g x);
  q939927_neg_mem :
    forall f : X -> R,
      q939927_carrier f ->
      q939927_carrier (fun x : X => - f x);
  q939927_smul_mem :
    forall (c : R) (f : X -> R),
      q939927_carrier f ->
      q939927_carrier (fun x : X => c * f x)
}.

Arguments q939927_real_subalgebra X T : clear implicits.
Arguments q939927_carrier {X T} _ _.

Definition q939927_separates_points
    {X : Type}
    {T : q939927_topological_space X}
    (A : q939927_real_subalgebra X T) : Prop :=
  forall x y : X,
    x <> y ->
    exists f : X -> R,
      q939927_carrier A f /\
      f x <> f y.

Theorem
ContinuousMap_subalgebra_topologicalClosure_eq_top_of_separatesPoints :
  forall (X : Type)
         (T : q939927_topological_space X)
         (A : q939927_real_subalgebra X T),
    q939927_compact_space T ->
    q939927_separates_points A ->
    forall f : X -> R,
      q939927_continuous_real T f ->
      forall epsilon : R,
        0 < epsilon ->
        exists g : X -> R,
          q939927_carrier A g /\
          forall x : X,
            Rabs (g x - f x) < epsilon.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q939927,
  "Stone-Weierstrass theorem": a point-separating real subalgebra of continuous
  functions on a compact space is uniformly dense. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q939927_stone_weierstrass_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Weierstrass_Theorems"
begin

theorem q939927_stone_weierstrass_theorem:
  fixes K :: "'a::topological_space set"
    and A :: "('a \<Rightarrow> real) set"
  assumes compact_carrier: "compact K"
    and continuous_members: "\<And>g. g \<in> A \<Longrightarrow> continuous_on K g"
    and constants:
      "\<And>c::real. \<exists>g\<in>A. \<forall>x\<in>K. g x = c"
    and subtraction_closed:
      "\<And>g h. g \<in> A \<Longrightarrow> h \<in> A \<Longrightarrow>
        \<exists>k\<in>A. \<forall>x\<in>K. k x = g x - h x"
    and multiplication_closed:
      "\<And>g h. g \<in> A \<Longrightarrow> h \<in> A \<Longrightarrow>
        \<exists>k\<in>A. \<forall>x\<in>K. k x = g x * h x"
    and separates_points:
      "\<And>x y. x \<in> K \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> K \<Longrightarrow> x \<noteq> y \<Longrightarrow>
        \<exists>g\<in>A. g x \<noteq> g y"
  shows "\<forall>f. continuous_on K f \<longrightarrow>
    (\<forall>e>0. \<exists>g\<in>A. \<forall>x\<in>K. \<bar>g x - f x\<bar> < e)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q939927
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q939927), "Stone–Weierstrass theorem": on an
  arbitrary compact topological space, every real subalgebra of continuous
  functions that separates points is uniformly dense in all real-valued
  continuous functions. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q939927_STONE_WEIERSTRASS_THEOREM =
  `let is_topology =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool).
       opens {} /\
       opens carrier /\
       (!u:A->bool. opens u ==> u SUBSET carrier) /\
       (!family:(A->bool)->bool.
          (!u:A->bool. u IN family ==> opens u)
          ==> opens (UNIONS family)) /\
       (!u v:A->bool.
          opens u /\ opens v ==> opens (u INTER v)) in
   let real_open =
     \u:real->bool.
       !x:real.
         x IN u
         ==> ?epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon /\
               !y:real. abs(y - x) < epsilon ==> y IN u in
   let continuous_real =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (f:A->real).
       !u:real->bool.
         real_open u
         ==> opens {x:A | x IN carrier /\ f x IN u} in
   let compact_space =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool).
       !cover:(A->bool)->bool.
         (!u:A->bool. u IN cover ==> opens u) /\
         carrier SUBSET UNIONS cover
         ==> ?finite_cover:(A->bool)->bool.
               finite_cover SUBSET cover /\
               FINITE finite_cover /\
               carrier SUBSET UNIONS finite_cover in
   let agrees_on =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (f:A->real) (g:A->real).
       !x:A. x IN carrier ==> f x = g x in
   !carrier:A->bool.
   !opens:(A->bool)->bool.
   !alg:(A->real)->bool.
     is_topology carrier opens /\
     compact_space carrier opens /\
     (!f g:A->real.
        agrees_on carrier f g ==> (alg f <=> alg g)) /\
     (!f:A->real. alg f ==> continuous_real carrier opens f) /\
     (!c:real. alg (\x:A. c)) /\
     (!f g:A->real.
        alg f /\ alg g ==> alg (\x:A. f x + g x)) /\
     (!f g:A->real.
        alg f /\ alg g ==> alg (\x:A. f x * g x)) /\
     (!x y:A.
        x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ ~(x = y)
        ==> ?f:A->real. alg f /\ ~(f x = f y))
     ==> !f:A->real.
           continuous_real carrier opens f
           ==> !epsilon:real.
                 &0 < epsilon
                 ==> ?g:A->real.
                       alg g /\
                       !x:A.
                         x IN carrier
                         ==> abs(f x - g x) < epsilon`;;

-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
-- thousand-theorems__agda__Q939927, "Stone–Weierstrass theorem": a real
-- subalgebra of continuous functions on a compact topological space is
-- uniformly dense when it separates points. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q939927_stone_weierstrass_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

record Top {a : Level} : Set a where
  constructor top

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A ->
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

-- A complete Archimedean ordered field is a presentation of the real line.
record RealLine
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR :
      R

    addR multiplyR :
      R ->
      R ->
      R

    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR :
      R ->
      R

    lessOrEqualR :
      R ->
      R ->
      Set r

    fromNatR :
      Nat ->
      R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)

    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x

    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)

    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR

    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

    reciprocal-zero :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR

    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x

    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z

    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y

    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)

    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)

    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)

    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)

    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x

    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x

    absolute-zero-only :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR

    absolute-negate :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x

    absolute-add :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))

    absolute-multiply :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR

    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set r) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open RealLine

record RealLineEquivalence
  {r : Level}
  {R S : Set r}
  (source : RealLine R)
  (target : RealLine S) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    forwardR :
      R ->
      S

    backwardR :
      S ->
      R

    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) ->
      forwardR (backwardR y) == y

    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) ->
      backwardR (forwardR x) == x

    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target

    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target

    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)

    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)

    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)

    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)

    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)

    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) ==
      fromNatR target n

    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (reals : RealLine R) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    equivalent-real-line :
      (S : Set r) ->
      (other : RealLine S) ->
      RealLineEquivalence reals other

subtractR :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RealLine R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RealLine R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set r
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RealLine R ->
  R ->
  Set r
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

Subset :
  {a p : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Subset {p = p} X =
  X -> Set p

Empty :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset {p = p} X
Empty {p = p} _ =
  Bottom {p}

Whole :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset {p = p} X
Whole {p = p} _ =
  Top {p}

Union :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Subset {p = p} X
Union U V x =
  Either (U x) (V x)

Complement :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Subset {p = p} X
Complement U x =
  Not (U x)

SubsetOf :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ p)
SubsetOf {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) ->
  U x ->
  V x

SameSubset :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ p)
SameSubset {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) ->
  Iff (U x) (V x)

Family :
  {a p : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Family {p = p} X =
  Subset {p = p} X -> Set p

record TopologicalSpace
  {a p : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ p)) where

  field
    close :
      Subset {p = p} X ->
      Subset {p = p} X

    close-congruent :
      (U V : Subset {p = p} X) ->
      SameSubset U V ->
      SameSubset (close U) (close V)

    close-empty :
      SubsetOf (close Empty) Empty

    subset-close :
      (U : Subset {p = p} X) ->
      SubsetOf U (close U)

    close-monotone :
      (U V : Subset {p = p} X) ->
      SubsetOf U V ->
      SubsetOf (close U) (close V)

    close-union-forward :
      (U V : Subset {p = p} X) ->
      SubsetOf
        (close (Union U V))
        (Union (close U) (close V))

    close-union-backward :
      (U V : Subset {p = p} X) ->
      SubsetOf
        (Union (close U) (close V))
        (close (Union U V))

    close-idempotent :
      (U : Subset {p = p} X) ->
      SubsetOf (close (close U)) (close U)

open TopologicalSpace

IsClosed :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace {p = p} X ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ p)
IsClosed topology U =
  SubsetOf (close topology U) U

IsOpen :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace {p = p} X ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ p)
IsOpen topology U =
  IsClosed topology (Complement U)

Covers :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Family {p = p} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Covers {p = p} {X = X} U cover =
  (x : X) ->
  U x ->
  Exists (Subset {p = p} X)
    (\ V ->
      Both
        (cover V)
        (V x))

FiniteSubcover :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Family {p = p} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
FiniteSubcover {p = p} {X = X} U cover =
  Exists (List (Subset {p = p} X))
    (\ selected ->
      Both
        ((V : Subset {p = p} X) ->
          Member V selected ->
          cover V)
        ((x : X) ->
          U x ->
          Exists (Subset {p = p} X)
            (\ V ->
              Both
                (Member V selected)
                (V x))))

Compact :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace {p = p} X ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Compact {p = p} {X = X} topology U =
  (cover : Family {p = p} X) ->
  ((V : Subset {p = p} X) ->
    cover V ->
    IsOpen topology V) ->
  Covers U cover ->
  FiniteSubcover U cover

OrderOpen :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RealLine R ->
  Subset {p = r} R ->
  Set r
OrderOpen {R = R} reals U =
  (x : R) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ lower ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          Both
            (StrictLess reals lower x)
            (Both
              (StrictLess reals x upper)
              ((y : R) ->
                StrictLess reals lower y ->
                StrictLess reals y upper ->
                U y))))

ContinuousReal :
  {r x : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set x} ->
  RealLine R ->
  TopologicalSpace {p = r} X ->
  (X -> R) ->
  Set (lsuc r ⊔ x)
ContinuousReal {r} {R = R} reals topology function =
  (U : Subset {p = r} R) ->
  OrderOpen reals U ->
  IsOpen topology
    (\ x ->
      U (function x))

record RealSubalgebra
  {r x : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {X : Set x}
  (reals : RealLine R)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace {p = r} X) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ x)) where

  field
    contains :
      (X -> R) ->
      Set (r ⊔ x)

    member-congruent :
      (f g : X -> R) ->
      ((point : X) ->
        f point == g point) ->
      contains f ->
      contains g

    member-continuous :
      (f : X -> R) ->
      contains f ->
      ContinuousReal reals topology f

    constant-member :
      (constant : R) ->
      contains
        (\ _ ->
          constant)

    add-member :
      (f g : X -> R) ->
      contains f ->
      contains g ->
      contains
        (\ point ->
          addR reals (f point) (g point))

    negate-member :
      (f : X -> R) ->
      contains f ->
      contains
        (\ point ->
          negateR reals (f point))

    multiply-member :
      (f g : X -> R) ->
      contains f ->
      contains g ->
      contains
        (\ point ->
          multiplyR reals (f point) (g point))

open RealSubalgebra

SeparatesPoints :
  {r x : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set x} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  {topology : TopologicalSpace {p = r} X} ->
  RealSubalgebra reals topology ->
  Set (r ⊔ x)
SeparatesPoints {R = R} {X = X} algebra =
  (leftPoint rightPoint : X) ->
  leftPoint != rightPoint ->
  Exists (X -> R)
    (\ function ->
      Both
        (contains algebra function)
        (function leftPoint != function rightPoint))

UniformlyClose :
  {r x : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set x} ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  R ->
  (X -> R) ->
  (X -> R) ->
  Set (r ⊔ x)
UniformlyClose {X = X} reals epsilon f g =
  (point : X) ->
  StrictLess reals
    (absoluteR reals
      (subtractR reals (g point) (f point)))
    epsilon

InUniformClosure :
  {r x : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set x} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  {topology : TopologicalSpace {p = r} X} ->
  RealSubalgebra reals topology ->
  (X -> R) ->
  Set (r ⊔ x)
InUniformClosure {R = R} {X = X} {reals = reals} algebra f =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists (X -> R)
    (\ g ->
      Both
        (contains algebra g)
        (UniformlyClose reals epsilon f g))

stone-weierstrass-theorem :
  {r x : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ x))
stone-weierstrass-theorem {r} {x} =
  (R : Set r) ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (X : Set x) ->
  (topology : TopologicalSpace {p = r} X) ->
  Compact topology Whole ->
  (algebra : RealSubalgebra reals topology) ->
  SeparatesPoints algebra ->
  (function : X -> R) ->
  ContinuousReal reals topology function ->
  InUniformClosure algebra function

title: Q939927_stone_weierstrass_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q939927, "Stone–Weierstrass theorem": a real subalgebra of continuous
  functions on a compact topological space is uniformly dense when it
  separates points. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory topologyTheory real_topologyTheory;

val q939927_real_subalgebra_def = new_definition (
  "q939927_real_subalgebra_def",
  ``q939927_real_subalgebra
      (top : 'a topology) (A : ('a -> real) set) <=>
      (!f.
        f IN A
        ==>
        continuous_map (top,euclidean) f) /\
      (!c : real. (\x. c) IN A) /\
      (!f g.
        f IN A /\ g IN A
        ==>
        (\x. f x + g x) IN A) /\
      (!f g.
        f IN A /\ g IN A
        ==>
        (\x. f x * g x) IN A)``);

val q939927_separates_points_def = new_definition (
  "q939927_separates_points_def",
  ``q939927_separates_points (A : ('a -> real) set) <=>
      !x y.
        x <> y
        ==>
        ?f. f IN A /\ f x <> f y``);

val q939927_uniformly_dense_def = new_definition (
  "q939927_uniformly_dense_def",
  ``q939927_uniformly_dense
      (top : 'a topology) (A : ('a -> real) set) <=>
      !f.
        continuous_map (top,euclidean) f
        ==>
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon
          ==>
          ?g.
            g IN A /\
            !x. abs (g x - f x) < epsilon``);

val ContinuousMap_subalgebra_topologicalClosure_eq_top_of_separatesPoints =
  ``!(top : 'a topology) (A : ('a -> real) set).
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      compact_in top UNIV /\
      q939927_real_subalgebra top A /\
      q939927_separates_points A
      ==>
      q939927_uniformly_dense top A``;

title: Q939927_stone_weierstrass_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q939927
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q939927), "Stone-Weierstrass theorem": a
  point-separating unital real subalgebra of the continuous real-valued
  functions on an arbitrary compact topological space is uniformly dense.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM represents a compact topological space by a compact topology J, whose
  carrier is U. J. The class ( J Cn ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) ) is the full algebra
  of continuous real-valued functions on that carrier.

  The antecedent says that A is a unital real subalgebra: it contains every
  real constant function and is closed under pointwise addition and
  multiplication. These conditions also give scalar multiplication and
  additive inverses. It then states the source point-separation hypothesis.

  The conclusion is the positive-epsilon uniform approximation criterion for
  every continuous real-valued function. On a compact source this is
  equivalent to the source assertion that the topological closure of A in the
  uniform-norm topology is the whole continuous-function algebra.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. This
  root statement file contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d A E F J c f g h r t $.

  thousand-theorems-q939927-stone-weierstrass $a |-
    A. J A. A
      (
        (
          J e. Comp
          /\
          A C_ ( J Cn ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) )
          /\
          A. c e. RR
            ( t e. U. J |-> c ) e. A
          /\
          A. f e. A A. g e. A
            (
              (
                t e. U. J |->
                ( ( f ` t ) + ( g ` t ) )
              ) e. A
              /\
              (
                t e. U. J |->
                ( ( f ` t ) x. ( g ` t ) )
              ) e. A
            )
          /\
          A. r e. U. J A. t e. U. J
            (
              r =/= t
              ->
              E. h e. A
                ( h ` r ) =/= ( h ` t )
            )
        )
        ->
        A. F e. ( J Cn ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) )
          A. E e. RR+
            E. f e. A
              A. t e. U. J
                (
                  abs `
                  (
                    ( f ` t )
                    -
                    ( F ` t )
                  )
                )
                <
                E
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q939927_stone_weierstrass_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q939927,
% "Stone-Weierstrass theorem": a point-separating real subalgebra of continuous
% functions on a compact topological space is uniformly dense. This file contains no proof.

stone_weierstrass_theorem_Q939927[
  X: TYPE,
  openX: [[X -> bool] -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  point_set_family: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  point_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point_set]
  real_set: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_function: TYPE = [X -> real]
  real_subalgebra: TYPE = [real_function -> bool]

  empty_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): FALSE

  whole_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): TRUE

  intersection(U, V: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      U(x) AND V(x)

  union_of_family(F: point_set_family): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      EXISTS (U: point_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  subset_of(U, V: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      U(x) IMPLIES V(x)

  topology_laws: bool =
    openX(empty_set)
      AND openX(whole_set)
      AND
    (FORALL (U, V: point_set):
      openX(U) AND openX(V)
        IMPLIES openX(intersection(U, V)))
      AND
    (FORALL (F: point_set_family):
      (FORALL (U: point_set):
        F(U) IMPLIES openX(U))
      IMPLIES openX(union_of_family(F)))

  open_cover(F: point_set_family): bool =
    (FORALL (U: point_set):
      F(U) IMPLIES openX(U))
      AND subset_of(whole_set, union_of_family(F))

  finite_subcover(F: point_set_family): bool =
    EXISTS
        (count: nat),
        (chosen: point_set_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES F(chosen(index)))
        AND
      (FORALL (x: X):
        EXISTS (index: nat):
          index < count AND chosen(index)(x))

  compact_space: bool =
    FORALL (F: point_set_family):
      open_cover(F) IMPLIES finite_subcover(F)

  real_open(U: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (a: real):
      U(a) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: real):
          radius > 0
            AND FORALL (b: real):
              abs(b - a) < radius IMPLIES U(b)

  preimage(f: real_function, U: real_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      U(f(x))

  continuous(f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (U: real_set):
      real_open(U) IMPLIES openX(preimage(f, U))

  constant_function(c: real): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: X): c

  function_add(f, g: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      f(x) + g(x)

  function_neg(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      -f(x)

  function_mul(f, g: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: X):

  subalgebra_of_continuous_functions(A: real_subalgebra): bool =
    (FORALL (f: real_function):
      A(f) IMPLIES continuous(f))
      AND
    (FORALL (c: real):

      AND
    (FORALL (f, g: real_function):
      A(f) AND A(g) IMPLIES
        A(function_add(f, g))
          AND A(function_mul(f, g)))
      AND
    (FORALL (f: real_function):
      A(f) IMPLIES A(function_neg(f)))

  separates_points(A: real_subalgebra): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: X):
      x /= y IMPLIES

  uniformly_dense(A: real_subalgebra): bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function), (epsilon_value: real):
      continuous(f) AND epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (g: real_function):
          A(g)
            AND FORALL (x: X):

  stone_weierstrass_theorem: bool =
    (topology_laws AND compact_space)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (A: real_subalgebra):
          (subalgebra_of_continuous_functions(A)
            AND separates_points(A))

     \(zeroD:D) (oneD:D) (addD:D->D->D) (mulD:D->D->D)
      (negD:D->D) (invD:D->D).
       ~(zeroD = oneD) /\
       (!x:D. addD zeroD x = x /\ addD x zeroD = x) /\
       (!x y:D. addD x y = addD y x) /\

-- multiplication and hence is a field. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; _∷_)

data Empty : Set where

Not : {a : Level} → Set a → Set a
Not A = A → Empty

infix 4 _≠_

_≠_ : {a : Level} {A : Set a} → A → A → Set a
x ≠ y = Not (x ≡ y)

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A →
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} →
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x xs →
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

record Finite
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    enumeration : List A
    exhaustive  : (x : A) → Member x enumeration

record Ring
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zero one : A
    add multiply : A → A → A
    negate : A → A

    add-associative :
      (x y z : A) →
      add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : A) →
      add x y ≡ add y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : A) →
      add zero x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : A) →
      add x zero ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : A) →
      add (negate x) x ≡ zero
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : A) →
      add x (negate x) ≡ zero

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡ multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : A) →
      multiply one x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : A) →
      multiply x one ≡ x

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiply x (add y z) ≡ add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiply (add x y) z ≡ add (multiply x z) (multiply y z)

record DivisionRing
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    ring : Ring A
    inverse : A → A
    nontrivial : Ring.zero ring ≠ Ring.one ring
    inverse-zero :
      inverse (Ring.zero ring) ≡ Ring.zero ring
    inverse-left :
      (x : A) →
      x ≠ Ring.zero ring →
      Ring.multiply ring (inverse x) x ≡ Ring.one ring
    inverse-right :
      (x : A) →
      x ≠ Ring.zero ring →
      Ring.multiply ring x (inverse x) ≡ Ring.one ring

record IsField
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (division : DivisionRing A) :
  Set a where

  field
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : A) →
      Ring.multiply (DivisionRing.ring division) x y ≡
      Ring.multiply (DivisionRing.ring division) y x

littleWedderburn :
  (a : Level) →
  Set (lsuc a)
littleWedderburn a =
  (D : Set a) →
  (division : DivisionRing D) →
  Finite D →
  IsField division
