title: Q943246_wedderburn_s_little_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q943246
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q943246), "Wedderburn's little theorem": every
% finite division ring has commutative multiplication and hence is a field.
% This file contains no proof.

Q943246_wedderburn_s_little_theorem[
  D: TYPE+,
  zero_D, one_D: D,
  neg_D, inv_D: [D -> D],
  add_D, mul_D: [D, D -> D]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  division_ring_laws: bool =
    zero_D /= one_D
      AND (FORALL (x, y: D):
        add_D(x, y) = add_D(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: D):
        add_D(add_D(x, y), z) = add_D(x, add_D(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: D):
        add_D(x, zero_D) = x
          AND add_D(x, neg_D(x)) = zero_D)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: D):
        mul_D(mul_D(x, y), z) = mul_D(x, mul_D(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: D):
        mul_D(one_D, x) = x
          AND mul_D(x, one_D) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: D):
        mul_D(zero_D, x) = zero_D
          AND mul_D(x, zero_D) = zero_D)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: D):
        mul_D(x, add_D(y, z))
          = add_D(mul_D(x, y), mul_D(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: D):
        mul_D(add_D(x, y), z)
          = add_D(mul_D(x, z), mul_D(y, z)))
      AND inv_D(zero_D) = zero_D
      AND (FORALL (x: D):
        x /= zero_D IMPLIES
          mul_D(x, inv_D(x)) = one_D
            AND mul_D(inv_D(x), x) = one_D)

  wedderburn_s_little_theorem: bool =
    (is_finite_type[D] AND division_ring_laws)
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (x, y: D):
          mul_D(x, y) = mul_D(y, x))

END Q943246_wedderburn_s_little_theorem

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q944297
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q944297), "Open mapping theorem (functional
  analysis)": a surjective continuous semilinear map between Banach spaces
  over isometrically equivalent nontrivially normed fields is an open map.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q944297_normed_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q944297_nf_zero : K;
  q944297_nf_one : K;
  q944297_nf_add : K -> K -> K;
  q944297_nf_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q944297_nf_neg : K -> K;
  q944297_nf_inv : K -> K;
  q944297_nf_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q944297_nf_add x (q944297_nf_add y z) =
      q944297_nf_add (q944297_nf_add x y) z;
  q944297_nf_add_comm :
    forall x y : K, q944297_nf_add x y = q944297_nf_add y x;
  q944297_nf_add_zero :
    forall x : K, q944297_nf_add x q944297_nf_zero = x;
  q944297_nf_add_neg :
    forall x : K,
      q944297_nf_add x (q944297_nf_neg x) = q944297_nf_zero;
  q944297_nf_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q944297_nf_mul x (q944297_nf_mul y z) =
      q944297_nf_mul (q944297_nf_mul x y) z;
  q944297_nf_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K, q944297_nf_mul x y = q944297_nf_mul y x;
  q944297_nf_mul_one :
    forall x : K, q944297_nf_mul x q944297_nf_one = x;
  q944297_nf_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q944297_nf_mul x (q944297_nf_add y z) =
      q944297_nf_add
        (q944297_nf_mul x y) (q944297_nf_mul x z);
  q944297_nf_inv_zero :
    q944297_nf_inv q944297_nf_zero = q944297_nf_zero;
  q944297_nf_mul_inv :
    forall x : K, x <> q944297_nf_zero ->
      q944297_nf_mul x (q944297_nf_inv x) = q944297_nf_one;
  q944297_nf_nontrivial :
    q944297_nf_zero <> q944297_nf_one;
  q944297_nf_norm : K -> R;
  q944297_nf_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : K, 0 <= q944297_nf_norm x;
  q944297_nf_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : K,
      q944297_nf_norm x = 0 <-> x = q944297_nf_zero;
  q944297_nf_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : K,
      q944297_nf_norm (q944297_nf_add x y) <=
      q944297_nf_norm x + q944297_nf_norm y;
  q944297_nf_norm_mul :
    forall x y : K,
      q944297_nf_norm (q944297_nf_mul x y) =
      q944297_nf_norm x * q944297_nf_norm y;
  q944297_nf_norm_nontrivial :
    exists x : K, 1 < q944297_nf_norm x
}.

Arguments q944297_nf_zero {K} _.
Arguments q944297_nf_one {K} _.
Arguments q944297_nf_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q944297_nf_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q944297_nf_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q944297_nf_inv {K} _ _.

Record q944297_isometric_ring_equiv
    (K K' : Type)
    (scalar : q944297_normed_field K)
    (scalar' : q944297_normed_field K') : Type := {
  q944297_to_fun : K -> K';
  q944297_from_fun : K' -> K;
  q944297_to_zero :
    q944297_to_fun (q944297_nf_zero scalar) =
    q944297_nf_zero scalar';
  q944297_to_one :
    q944297_to_fun (q944297_nf_one scalar) =
    q944297_nf_one scalar';
  q944297_to_add :
    forall x y : K,
      q944297_to_fun (q944297_nf_add scalar x y) =
      q944297_nf_add scalar' (q944297_to_fun x) (q944297_to_fun y);
  q944297_to_mul :
    forall x y : K,
      q944297_to_fun (q944297_nf_mul scalar x y) =
      q944297_nf_mul scalar' (q944297_to_fun x) (q944297_to_fun y);
  q944297_from_zero :
    q944297_from_fun (q944297_nf_zero scalar') =
    q944297_nf_zero scalar;
  q944297_from_one :
    q944297_from_fun (q944297_nf_one scalar') =
    q944297_nf_one scalar;
  q944297_from_add :
    forall x y : K',
      q944297_from_fun (q944297_nf_add scalar' x y) =
      q944297_nf_add scalar (q944297_from_fun x) (q944297_from_fun y);
  q944297_from_mul :
    forall x y : K',
      q944297_from_fun (q944297_nf_mul scalar' x y) =
      q944297_nf_mul scalar (q944297_from_fun x) (q944297_from_fun y);
  q944297_from_to :
    forall x : K, q944297_from_fun (q944297_to_fun x) = x;
  q944297_to_from :
    forall y : K', q944297_to_fun (q944297_from_fun y) = y;
  q944297_to_isometric :
    forall x : K,
      q944297_nf_norm scalar' (q944297_to_fun x) =
      q944297_nf_norm scalar x;
  q944297_from_isometric :
    forall y : K',
      q944297_nf_norm scalar (q944297_from_fun y) =
      q944297_nf_norm scalar' y
}.

Arguments q944297_to_fun {K K' scalar scalar'} _ _.
Arguments q944297_from_fun {K K' scalar scalar'} _ _.

Record q944297_normed_vector_space
    (K : Type)
    (scalar : q944297_normed_field K)
    (E : Type) : Type := {
  q944297_nv_zero : E;
  q944297_nv_add : E -> E -> E;
  q944297_nv_neg : E -> E;
  q944297_nv_smul : K -> E -> E;
  q944297_nv_norm : E -> R;
  q944297_nv_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q944297_nv_add x (q944297_nv_add y z) =
      q944297_nv_add (q944297_nv_add x y) z;
  q944297_nv_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q944297_nv_add x y = q944297_nv_add y x;
  q944297_nv_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q944297_nv_add x q944297_nv_zero = x;
  q944297_nv_add_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q944297_nv_add x (q944297_nv_neg x) = q944297_nv_zero;
  q944297_nv_one_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q944297_nv_smul (q944297_nf_one scalar) x = x;
  q944297_nv_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q944297_nv_smul (q944297_nf_mul scalar a b) x =
      q944297_nv_smul a (q944297_nv_smul b x);
  q944297_nv_add_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q944297_nv_smul (q944297_nf_add scalar a b) x =
      q944297_nv_add
        (q944297_nv_smul a x) (q944297_nv_smul b x);
  q944297_nv_smul_add :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q944297_nv_smul a (q944297_nv_add x y) =
      q944297_nv_add
        (q944297_nv_smul a x) (q944297_nv_smul a y);
  q944297_nv_zero_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q944297_nv_smul (q944297_nf_zero scalar) x = q944297_nv_zero;
  q944297_nv_smul_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q944297_nv_smul a q944297_nv_zero = q944297_nv_zero;
  q944297_nv_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q944297_nv_norm x;
  q944297_nv_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q944297_nv_norm x = 0 <-> x = q944297_nv_zero;
  q944297_nv_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q944297_nv_norm (q944297_nv_add x y) <=
      q944297_nv_norm x + q944297_nv_norm y;
  q944297_nv_norm_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : E),
      q944297_nv_norm (q944297_nv_smul a x) =
      q944297_nf_norm scalar a * q944297_nv_norm x
}.

Arguments q944297_nv_zero {K scalar E} _.
Arguments q944297_nv_add {K scalar E} _ _ _.
Arguments q944297_nv_neg {K scalar E} _ _.
Arguments q944297_nv_smul {K scalar E} _ _ _.
Arguments q944297_nv_norm {K scalar E} _ _.

Definition q944297_sub
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q944297_normed_field K}
    (space : @q944297_normed_vector_space K scalar E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q944297_nv_add space x (q944297_nv_neg space y).

Definition q944297_dist
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q944297_normed_field K}
    (space : @q944297_normed_vector_space K scalar E)
    (x y : E) : R :=
  q944297_nv_norm space (q944297_sub space x y).

Definition q944297_sequence_cauchy
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q944297_normed_field K}
    (space : @q944297_normed_vector_space K scalar E)
    (u : nat -> E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat, forall m n : nat,
      (N <= m)%nat ->
      (N <= n)%nat ->
      q944297_dist space (u m) (u n) < epsilon.

Definition q944297_sequence_converges
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q944297_normed_field K}
    (space : @q944297_normed_vector_space K scalar E)
    (u : nat -> E) (limit : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat, forall n : nat, (N <= n)%nat ->
      q944297_dist space (u n) limit < epsilon.

Definition q944297_complete
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q944297_normed_field K}
    (space : @q944297_normed_vector_space K scalar E) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> E,
    q944297_sequence_cauchy space u ->
    exists limit : E, q944297_sequence_converges space u limit.

Definition q944297_metric_open
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q944297_normed_field K}
    (space : @q944297_normed_vector_space K scalar E)
    (U : E -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall x : E, U x ->
    exists radius : R, 0 < radius /\
      forall y : E, q944297_dist space y x < radius -> U y.

Record q944297_continuous_semilinear_map
    (K K' E F : Type)
    (scalar : q944297_normed_field K)
    (scalar' : q944297_normed_field K')
    (domain : @q944297_normed_vector_space K scalar E)
    (codomain : @q944297_normed_vector_space K' scalar' F)
    (sigma : q944297_isometric_ring_equiv scalar scalar') : Type := {
  q944297_map_fun : E -> F;
  q944297_map_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q944297_map_fun (q944297_nv_add domain x y) =
      q944297_nv_add codomain (q944297_map_fun x) (q944297_map_fun y);
  q944297_map_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : E),
      q944297_map_fun (q944297_nv_smul domain a x) =
      q944297_nv_smul codomain
        (q944297_to_fun sigma a) (q944297_map_fun x);
  q944297_map_continuous :
    forall x : E, forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
      exists delta : R, 0 < delta /\
        forall y : E,
          q944297_dist domain y x < delta ->
          q944297_dist codomain
            (q944297_map_fun y) (q944297_map_fun x) < epsilon
}.

Arguments q944297_map_fun
  {K K' E F scalar scalar' domain codomain sigma} _ _.

Definition q944297_is_open_map
    {K K' E F : Type}
    {scalar : q944297_normed_field K}
    {scalar' : q944297_normed_field K'}
    {domain : @q944297_normed_vector_space K scalar E}
    {codomain : @q944297_normed_vector_space K' scalar' F}
    {sigma : q944297_isometric_ring_equiv scalar scalar'}
    (f : @q944297_continuous_semilinear_map
      K K' E F scalar scalar' domain codomain sigma) : Prop :=
  forall U : E -> Prop,
    q944297_metric_open domain U ->
    q944297_metric_open codomain
      (fun y : F =>
        exists x : E, U x /\ q944297_map_fun f x = y).

Theorem ContinuousLinearMap_isOpenMap :
  forall (K K' E F : Type)
         (scalar : q944297_normed_field K)
         (scalar' : q944297_normed_field K')
         (domain : @q944297_normed_vector_space K scalar E)
         (codomain : @q944297_normed_vector_space K' scalar' F)
         (sigma : q944297_isometric_ring_equiv scalar scalar')
         (f : @q944297_continuous_semilinear_map
           K K' E F scalar scalar' domain codomain sigma),
    q944297_complete domain ->
    q944297_complete codomain ->
    (forall y : F, exists x : E, q944297_map_fun f x = y) ->
    q944297_is_open_map f.
Admitted.

title: Q944297_open_mapping_theorem_functional_analysis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q944297,
  "Open mapping theorem (functional analysis)": a surjective continuous
  semilinear map between Banach spaces over isometrically equivalent
  nontrivially normed fields is an open map. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q944297_open_mapping_theorem_functional_analysis
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q944297_nontrivially_normed_field ::
    "('k::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q944297_nontrivially_normed_field knorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    knorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>a. 0 \<le> knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm a = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> a = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm (-a) = knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a + b) \<le> knorm a + knorm b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a * b) = knorm a * knorm b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. dist a b = knorm (a - b)) \<and>
    (\<exists>a. 1 < knorm a)"

definition q944297_normed_space ::
    "('k::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::{ab_group_add,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q944297_normed_space knorm enorm scale \<longleftrightarrow>
    enorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm (-x) = enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. enorm (x + y) \<le> enorm x + enorm y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. dist x y = enorm (x - y)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. scale a (x + y) = scale a x + scale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a + b) x = scale a x + scale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a * b) x = scale a (scale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. scale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. enorm (scale a x) = knorm a * enorm x)"

definition q944297_isometric_ring_equivalence ::
    "('k::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('l::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow> ('l \<Rightarrow> 'k) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q944297_isometric_ring_equivalence knorm lnorm sigma sigma_inv \<longleftrightarrow>
    sigma 0 = 0 \<and>
    sigma 1 = 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. sigma (a + b) = sigma a + sigma b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. sigma (a * b) = sigma a * sigma b) \<and>
    sigma_inv 0 = 0 \<and>
    sigma_inv 1 = 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. sigma_inv (a + b) = sigma_inv a + sigma_inv b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. sigma_inv (a * b) = sigma_inv a * sigma_inv b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. sigma_inv (sigma a) = a) \<and>
    (\<forall>b. sigma (sigma_inv b) = b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. lnorm (sigma a) = knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>b. knorm (sigma_inv b) = lnorm b)"

definition q944297_continuous_semilinear ::
    "('k \<Rightarrow> 'e::{ab_group_add,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('l \<Rightarrow> 'f::{ab_group_add,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow> ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q944297_continuous_semilinear escale fscale sigma f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. f (x + y) = f x + f y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. f (escale a x) = fscale (sigma a) (f x)) \<and>
    continuous_on UNIV f"

theorem open_mapping_theorem:
  fixes knorm :: "'k::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real"
    and lnorm :: "'l::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real"
    and enorm :: "'e::{ab_group_add,metric_space,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> real"
    and fnorm :: "'f::{ab_group_add,metric_space,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> real"
    and escale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and fscale :: "'l \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and sigma :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'l"
    and sigma_inv :: "'l \<Rightarrow> 'k"
    and f :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'f"
  assumes "q944297_nontrivially_normed_field knorm"
    and "q944297_nontrivially_normed_field lnorm"
    and "q944297_normed_space knorm enorm escale"
    and "q944297_normed_space lnorm fnorm fscale"
    and "q944297_isometric_ring_equivalence knorm lnorm sigma sigma_inv"
    and "q944297_continuous_semilinear escale fscale sigma f"
    and "surj f"
  shows "\<forall>S. open S \<longrightarrow> open (f ` S)"
  sorry

end

(*

  "Open mapping theorem (functional analysis)": a surjective continuous
  semilinear map between Banach spaces over isometrically isomorphic
  nontrivially normed fields is an open map. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q944297_OPEN_MAPPING_THEOREM_FUNCTIONAL_ANALYSIS =
 `let nontrivially_normed_field =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A)
     (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (negK:A->A) (invK:A->A) (normK:A->real).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:A. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:A. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK zeroK a = zeroK) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:A. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       normK zeroK = &0 /\
       (!a:A. &0 <= normK a) /\
       (!a:A. normK a = &0 <=> a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b:A. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
       (!a b:A. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
       (?a:A. &1 < normK a) in
  let nontrivially_normed_field' =
    \(zeroK:D) (oneK:D)
     (addK:D->D->D) (mulK:D->D->D)
     (negK:D->D) (invK:D->D) (normK:D->real).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:D. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:D. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:D. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:D. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:D. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:D. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:D. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a:D. mulK zeroK a = zeroK) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:D. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:D.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       normK zeroK = &0 /\
       (!a:D. &0 <= normK a) /\
       (!a:D. normK a = &0 <=> a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b:D. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
       (!a b:D. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
       (?a:D. &1 < normK a) in
  let normed_add_comm_group =
    \(zero:B) (add:B->B->B) (neg:B->B) (norm:B->real).
       (!x y z:B. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:B. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:B. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:B. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       norm zero = &0 /\
       (!x:B. &0 <= norm x) /\
       (!x:B. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
       (!x:B. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
       (!x y:B. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
  let normed_add_comm_group' =
    \(zero:C) (add:C->C->C) (neg:C->C) (norm:C->real).
       (!x y z:C. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:C. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:C. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:C. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       norm zero = &0 /\
       (!x:C. &0 <= norm x) /\
       (!x:C. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
       (!x:C. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
       (!x y:C. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
  let normed_space =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (normK:A->real) (zero:B) (add:B->B->B) (norm:B->real)
     (smul:A->B->B).
       (!x:B. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (addK a b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:A. !x y:B.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a:A. smul a zero = zero) /\
       (!x:B. smul zeroK x = zero) /\
       (!a:A. !x:B. norm (smul a x) = normK a * norm x) in
  let normed_space' =
    \(zeroK:D) (oneK:D) (addK:D->D->D) (mulK:D->D->D)
     (normK:D->real) (zero:C) (add:C->C->C) (norm:C->real)
     (smul:D->C->C).
       (!x:C. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:D. !x:C.
          smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:D. !x:C.
          smul (addK a b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:D. !x y:C.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a:D. smul a zero = zero) /\
       (!x:C. smul zeroK x = zero) /\
       (!a:D. !x:C. norm (smul a x) = normK a * norm x) in
  let isometric_ring_hom =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (normK:A->real) (zeroL:D) (oneL:D)
     (addL:D->D->D) (mulL:D->D->D) (normL:D->real)
     (sigma:A->D).
       sigma zeroK = zeroL /\
       sigma oneK = oneL /\
       (!a b:A. sigma (addK a b) = addL (sigma a) (sigma b)) /\
       (!a b:A. sigma (mulK a b) = mulL (sigma a) (sigma b)) /\
       (!a:A. normL (sigma a) = normK a) in
  let isometric_ring_hom' =
    \(zeroK:D) (oneK:D) (addK:D->D->D) (mulK:D->D->D)
     (normK:D->real) (zeroL:A) (oneL:A)
     (addL:A->A->A) (mulL:A->A->A) (normL:A->real)
     (sigma:D->A).
       sigma zeroK = zeroL /\
       sigma oneK = oneL /\
       (!a b:D. sigma (addK a b) = addL (sigma a) (sigma b)) /\
       (!a b:D. sigma (mulK a b) = mulL (sigma a) (sigma b)) /\
       (!a:D. normL (sigma a) = normK a) in
  let ring_hom_inv_pair =
    \(sigma:A->D) (sigma':D->A).
       (!a:A. sigma' (sigma a) = a) /\
       (!b:D. sigma (sigma' b) = b) in
  let tends_to =
    \(add:B->B->B) (neg:B->B) (norm:B->real)
     (u:num->B) (x:B).
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
               N <= n
               ==> norm (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon in
  let tends_to' =
    \(add:C->C->C) (neg:C->C) (norm:C->real)
     (u:num->C) (x:C).
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
               N <= n
               ==> norm (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon in
  let complete_space =
    \(add:B->B->B) (neg:B->B) (norm:B->real).
       !u:num->B.
         (!epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon
            ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                  N <= m /\ N <= n
                  ==> norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon)
         ==> ?x:B. tends_to add neg norm u x in
  let complete_space' =
    \(add:C->C->C) (neg:C->C) (norm:C->real).
       !u:num->C.
         (!epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon
            ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                  N <= m /\ N <= n
                  ==> norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon)
         ==> ?x:C. tends_to' add neg norm u x in
  let continuous_semilinear_map =
    \(addE:B->B->B) (smulE:A->B->B) (normE:B->real)
     (addF:C->C->C) (smulF:D->C->C) (normF:C->real)
     (sigma:A->D) (f:B->C).
       (!x y:B. f (addE x y) = addF (f x) (f y)) /\
       (!a:A. !x:B. f (smulE a x) = smulF (sigma a) (f x)) /\
       (!epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !x:B. normE x < delta ==> normF (f x) < epsilon) in
  let norm_open =
    \(add:B->B->B) (neg:B->B) (norm:B->real) (s:B->bool).
       !x:B.
         x IN s
         ==> ?epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon /\
               !y:B.
                 norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN s in
  let norm_open' =
    \(add:C->C->C) (neg:C->C) (norm:C->real) (s:C->bool).
       !x:C.
         x IN s
         ==> ?epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon /\
               !y:C.
                 norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN s in
  let is_open_map =
    \(addE:B->B->B) (negE:B->B) (normE:B->real)
     (addF:C->C->C) (negF:C->C) (normF:C->real)
     (f:B->C).
       !s:B->bool.
         norm_open addE negE normE s
         ==> norm_open' addF negF normF (IMAGE f s) in
  !zeroK oneK:A.
  !addK mulK:A->A->A.
  !negK invK:A->A.
  !normK:A->real.
  !zeroL oneL:D.
  !addL mulL:D->D->D.
  !negL invL:D->D.
  !normL:D->real.
  !sigma:A->D.
  !sigma':D->A.
  !zeroE:B.
  !addE:B->B->B.
  !negE:B->B.
  !smulE:A->B->B.
  !normE:B->real.
  !zeroF:C.
  !addF:C->C->C.
  !negF:C->C.
  !smulF:D->C->C.
  !normF:C->real.
  !f:B->C.
    nontrivially_normed_field
      zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
    nontrivially_normed_field'
      zeroL oneL addL mulL negL invL normL /\
    normed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
    normed_add_comm_group' zeroF addF negF normF /\
    normed_space
      zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroE addE normE smulE /\
    normed_space'
      zeroL oneL addL mulL normL zeroF addF normF smulF /\
    isometric_ring_hom
      zeroK oneK addK mulK normK
      zeroL oneL addL mulL normL sigma /\
    isometric_ring_hom'
      zeroL oneL addL mulL normL
      zeroK oneK addK mulK normK sigma' /\
    ring_hom_inv_pair sigma sigma' /\
    complete_space addE negE normE /\
    complete_space' addF negF normF /\
    continuous_semilinear_map
      addE smulE normE addF smulF normF sigma f /\
    (!y:C. ?x:B. f x = y)
    ==> is_open_map addE negE normE addF negF normF f`;;

title: Q944297_open_mapping_theorem_functional_analysis
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q944297,
;; "Open mapping theorem (functional analysis)": every surjective continuous
;; semilinear map between Banach spaces over isometrically isomorphic
;; nontrivially normed fields is an open map. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Arbitrary carriers and their operations are presented conservatively.
;; Norms are rounded rational upper cuts: NORM-LT-P(type,x,q) means ||x|| < q.
;; These cuts represent arbitrary finite nonnegative real norms, including
;; irrational values, rather than rational-valued approximations.
;;
;; Sequences, the two field homomorphisms, and the semilinear map are directly
;; quantified tame APPLY$ function objects. No opaque set, sequence, or map
;; tags occur. The conclusion uses the local ball-image characterization of an
;; open map. Positive rational radii form a basis for every norm topology, so
;; this characterization is bidirectionally equivalent to IsOpenMap.

(defstub q944297-member-p (carrier-type value) t)
(defstub q944297-zero (carrier-type) t)
(defstub q944297-one (carrier-type) t)
(defstub q944297-add (carrier-type left right) t)
(defstub q944297-multiply (carrier-type left right) t)
(defstub q944297-negate (carrier-type value) t)
(defstub q944297-inverse (carrier-type value) t)
(defstub q944297-smul
  (field-type vector-type scalar vector)
  t)
(defstub q944297-norm-lt-p
  (carrier-type value rational-bound)
  t)

(defun q944297-function-value (function argument)
  (apply$ function (list argument)))

(defun q944297-sequence-value (sequence index)
  (apply$ sequence (list index)))

(defun q944297-positive-rational-p (q)
  (and (rationalp q) (< 0 q)))

(defun q944297-subtract (carrier-type left right)
  (q944297-add
   carrier-type
   left
   (q944297-negate carrier-type right)))

(defun q944297-norm-difference-lt-p
    (carrier-type left right epsilon)
  (q944297-norm-lt-p
   carrier-type
   (q944297-subtract carrier-type left right)
   epsilon))

;; Rounded upper cuts for genuine finite nonnegative real norms.

(defun-sk q944297-norm-finite-p
    (carrier-type value)
  (exists (q)
    (and
     (q944297-positive-rational-p q)
     (q944297-norm-lt-p carrier-type value q))))

(defun-sk q944297-norm-positive-p
    (carrier-type value)
  (exists (q)
    (and
     (q944297-positive-rational-p q)
     (not
      (q944297-norm-lt-p carrier-type value q)))))

(defun-sk q944297-norm-rounded-p
    (carrier-type value q)
  (exists (r)
    (and
     (q944297-positive-rational-p r)
     (rationalp q)
     (< r q)
     (q944297-norm-lt-p carrier-type value r))))

(defun-sk q944297-norm-cut-laws-p
    (carrier-type)
  (forall (x q r)
    (implies
     (q944297-member-p carrier-type x)
     (and
      (implies
       (q944297-norm-lt-p carrier-type x q)
       (q944297-positive-rational-p q))
      (implies
       (and
        (q944297-norm-lt-p carrier-type x q)
        (rationalp r)
        (< q r))
       (q944297-norm-lt-p carrier-type x r))
      (implies
       (q944297-norm-lt-p carrier-type x q)
       (q944297-norm-rounded-p carrier-type x q))
      (q944297-norm-finite-p carrier-type x)
      (implies
       (equal x (q944297-zero carrier-type))
       (iff
        (q944297-norm-lt-p carrier-type x q)
        (q944297-positive-rational-p q)))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q944297-zero carrier-type)))
       (q944297-norm-positive-p carrier-type x))))))

;; Normed additive commutative groups.

(defun-sk q944297-normed-add-comm-group-laws-p
    (carrier-type)
  (forall (x y z q r)
    (implies
     (and
      (q944297-member-p carrier-type x)
      (q944297-member-p carrier-type y)
      (q944297-member-p carrier-type z))
     (and
      (q944297-member-p
       carrier-type
       (q944297-add carrier-type x y))
      (q944297-member-p
       carrier-type
       (q944297-negate carrier-type x))
      (equal
       (q944297-add
        carrier-type
        (q944297-add carrier-type x y)
        z)
       (q944297-add
        carrier-type
        x
        (q944297-add carrier-type y z)))
      (equal
       (q944297-add carrier-type x y)
       (q944297-add carrier-type y x))
      (equal
       (q944297-add
        carrier-type x (q944297-zero carrier-type))
       x)
      (equal
       (q944297-add
        carrier-type x (q944297-negate carrier-type x))
       (q944297-zero carrier-type))
      (iff
       (q944297-norm-lt-p
        carrier-type
        (q944297-negate carrier-type x)
        q)
       (q944297-norm-lt-p carrier-type x q))
      (implies
       (and
        (q944297-positive-rational-p q)
        (q944297-positive-rational-p r)
        (q944297-norm-lt-p carrier-type x q)
        (q944297-norm-lt-p carrier-type y r))
       (q944297-norm-lt-p
        carrier-type
        (q944297-add carrier-type x y)
        (+ q r)))))))

(defun q944297-normed-add-comm-group-p
    (carrier-type)
  (and
   (q944297-member-p
    carrier-type (q944297-zero carrier-type))
   (q944297-norm-cut-laws-p carrier-type)
   (q944297-normed-add-comm-group-laws-p carrier-type)))

;; Nontrivially normed fields.

(defun-sk q944297-product-norm-lt-p
    (field-type x y q)
  (exists (r s)
    (and
     (q944297-positive-rational-p q)
     (q944297-positive-rational-p r)
     (q944297-positive-rational-p s)
     (q944297-norm-lt-p field-type x r)
     (q944297-norm-lt-p field-type y s)
     (< (* r s) q))))

(defun-sk q944297-field-laws-p
    (field-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q944297-member-p field-type x)
      (q944297-member-p field-type y)
      (q944297-member-p field-type z))
     (and
      (q944297-member-p
       field-type (q944297-multiply field-type x y))
      (q944297-member-p
       field-type (q944297-inverse field-type x))
      (equal
       (q944297-multiply
        field-type
        (q944297-multiply field-type x y)
        z)
       (q944297-multiply
        field-type
        x
        (q944297-multiply field-type y z)))
      (equal
       (q944297-multiply field-type x y)
       (q944297-multiply field-type y x))
      (equal
       (q944297-multiply
        field-type x (q944297-one field-type))
       x)
      (equal
       (q944297-inverse
        field-type (q944297-zero field-type))
       (q944297-zero field-type))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q944297-zero field-type)))
       (equal
        (q944297-multiply
         field-type
         x
         (q944297-inverse field-type x))
        (q944297-one field-type)))
      (equal
       (q944297-multiply
        field-type
        x
        (q944297-add field-type y z))
       (q944297-add
        field-type
        (q944297-multiply field-type x y)
        (q944297-multiply field-type x z)))))))

(defun-sk q944297-field-norm-laws-p
    (field-type)
  (forall (x y q)
    (implies
     (and
      (q944297-member-p field-type x)
      (q944297-member-p field-type y))
     (iff
      (q944297-norm-lt-p
       field-type
       (q944297-multiply field-type x y)
       q)
      (q944297-product-norm-lt-p
       field-type x y q)))))

(defun-sk q944297-large-norm-element-exists-p
    (field-type)
  (exists (x q)
    (and
     (q944297-member-p field-type x)
     (rationalp q)
     (< 1 q)
     (not (q944297-norm-lt-p field-type x q)))))

(defun q944297-nontrivially-normed-field-p
    (field-type)
  (and
   (q944297-normed-add-comm-group-p field-type)
   (q944297-member-p
    field-type (q944297-one field-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q944297-zero field-type)
     (q944297-one field-type)))
   (q944297-field-laws-p field-type)
   (q944297-field-norm-laws-p field-type)
   (q944297-large-norm-element-exists-p field-type)))

;; Normed vector spaces.

(defun-sk q944297-scaled-norm-lt-p
    (field-type vector-type scalar vector q)
  (exists (r s)
    (and
     (q944297-positive-rational-p q)
     (q944297-positive-rational-p r)
     (q944297-positive-rational-p s)
     (q944297-norm-lt-p field-type scalar r)
     (q944297-norm-lt-p vector-type vector s)
     (< (* r s) q))))

(defun-sk q944297-normed-space-laws-p
    (field-type vector-type)
  (forall (a b x y q)
    (implies
     (and
      (q944297-member-p field-type a)
      (q944297-member-p field-type b)
      (q944297-member-p vector-type x)
      (q944297-member-p vector-type y))
     (and
      (q944297-member-p
       vector-type
       (q944297-smul field-type vector-type a x))
      (equal
       (q944297-smul
        field-type vector-type (q944297-one field-type) x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q944297-smul
        field-type
        vector-type
        (q944297-multiply field-type a b)
        x)
       (q944297-smul
        field-type
        vector-type
        a
        (q944297-smul field-type vector-type b x)))
      (equal
       (q944297-smul
        field-type
        vector-type
        (q944297-add field-type a b)
        x)
       (q944297-add
        vector-type
        (q944297-smul field-type vector-type a x)
        (q944297-smul field-type vector-type b x)))
      (equal
       (q944297-smul
        field-type
        vector-type
        a
        (q944297-add vector-type x y))
       (q944297-add
        vector-type
        (q944297-smul field-type vector-type a x)
        (q944297-smul field-type vector-type a y)))
      (iff
       (q944297-norm-lt-p
        vector-type

(defun q944297-normed-space-p

        mapping
        (q944297-smul source-field domain-type a x))

        (q944297-function-value forward-hom a)

title: Q944297_open_mapping_theorem_functional_analysis
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q944297,
-- "Open mapping theorem (functional analysis)": a surjective continuous semilinear map
-- between complete normed spaces over isometrically isomorphic nontrivially normed
-- fields maps every open set to an open set. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q944297OpenMappingTheoremFunctionalAnalysis where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) -> Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR x == zeroR -> x == zeroR
    absolute-negateR :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNatR m == fromNatR n -> m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record NontriviallyNormedField
  (K R : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK reciprocalK : K -> K
    normK : K -> R

    one-not-zeroK :
      oneK != zeroK
    norm-greater-than-oneK :
      Exists K
        (\ x ->
          StrictLess reals (oneR reals) (normK x))

    add-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> addK x y == addK y x
    add-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-zeroK :
      (x : K) -> addK x zeroK == x
    add-inverseK :
      (x : K) -> addK x (negateK x) == zeroK

    multiply-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> multiplyK x y == multiplyK y x
    multiply-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z == multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-oneK :
      (x : K) -> multiplyK x oneK == x
    multiply-zeroK :
      (x : K) -> multiplyK x zeroK == zeroK
    distributeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    reciprocal-zeroK :
      reciprocalK zeroK == zeroK
    multiply-reciprocalK :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (reciprocalK x) == oneK

    norm-nonnegativeK :
      (x : K) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normK x)
    norm-zeroK :
      normK zeroK == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyK :
      (x : K) -> normK x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroK
    norm-negateK :
      (x : K) -> normK (negateK x) == normK x
    norm-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normK (addK x y))
        (addR reals (normK x) (normK y))
    norm-multiplyK :
      (x y : K) ->
      normK (multiplyK x y) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK x) (normK y)

open NontriviallyNormedField

record IsometricRingHom
  {K K2 R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (source : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals)
  (target : NontriviallyNormedField K2 R reals) : Set where
  field
    mapScalar : K -> K2
    map-zero :
      mapScalar (zeroK source) == zeroK target
    map-one :
      mapScalar (oneK source) == oneK target
    map-add :
      (a b : K) ->
      mapScalar (addK source a b) ==
      addK target (mapScalar a) (mapScalar b)
    map-multiply :
      (a b : K) ->
      mapScalar (multiplyK source a b) ==
      multiplyK target (mapScalar a) (mapScalar b)
    map-isometry :
      (a : K) ->
      normK target (mapScalar a) == normK source a

open IsometricRingHom

record InverseRingHomPair
  {K K2 R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {source : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals}
  {target : NontriviallyNormedField K2 R reals}
  (forward : IsometricRingHom source target)
  (backward : IsometricRingHom target source) : Set where
  field
    backward-after-forward :
      (a : K) ->
      mapScalar backward (mapScalar forward a) == a
    forward-after-backward :
      (b : K2) ->
      mapScalar forward (mapScalar backward b) == b

record NormedSpace
  (K R V : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : K -> V -> V
    normV : V -> R

    add-commutativeV :
      (x y : V) -> addV x y == addV y x
    add-associativeV :
      (x y z : V) ->
      addV (addV x y) z == addV x (addV y z)
    add-zeroV :
      (x : V) -> addV x zeroV == x
    add-inverseV :
      (x : V) -> addV x (negateV x) == zeroV

    scale-oneV :
      (x : V) -> scaleV (oneK scalars) x == x
    scale-associativeV :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyK scalars a b) x == scaleV a (scaleV b x)
    scale-add-vectorsV :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV x y) == addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV a y)
    scale-add-scalarsV :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scaleV (addK scalars a b) x ==
      addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV b x)

    norm-nonnegativeV :
      (x : V) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normV x)
    norm-zeroV :
      normV zeroV == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyV :
      (x : V) -> normV x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroV
    norm-negateV :
      (x : V) -> normV (negateV x) == normV x
    norm-addV :
      (x y : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normV (addV x y))
        (addR reals (normV x) (normV y))
    norm-scaleV :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      normV (scaleV a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK scalars a) (normV x)

open NormedSpace

subtractV :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  V ->
  V ->
  V
subtractV space x y =
  addV space x (negateV space y)

distanceV :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  V ->
  V ->
  R
distanceV space x y =
  normV space (subtractV space x y)

SequentialLimit :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  V ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distanceV space (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (distanceV space (sequence m) (sequence n))
        epsilon)

Complete :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  Set
Complete {V = V} space =
  (sequence : Nat -> V) ->
  CauchySequence space sequence ->
  Exists V (\ limit -> SequentialLimit space sequence limit)

record ContinuousSemilinearMap
  {K K2 R E F : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {sourceScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals}
  {targetScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K2 R reals}
  (scalarHom : IsometricRingHom sourceScalars targetScalars)
  (domain : NormedSpace K R E reals sourceScalars)
  (codomain : NormedSpace K2 R F reals targetScalars) : Set where
  field
    apply : E -> F
    map-add-vector :
      (x y : E) ->
      apply (addV domain x y) ==
      addV codomain (apply x) (apply y)
    map-scale-vector :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      apply (scaleV domain a x) ==
      scaleV codomain (mapScalar scalarHom a) (apply x)
    continuous-map :
      (x : E) ->
      (epsilon : R) ->
      Positive reals epsilon ->
      Exists R
        (\ delta ->
          Both
            (Positive reals delta)
            ((y : E) ->
              StrictLess reals (distanceV domain y x) delta ->
              StrictLess reals
                (distanceV codomain (apply y) (apply x))
                epsilon))

open ContinuousSemilinearMap

Subset : Set -> Set1
Subset X =
  X -> Set

Image :
  {K K2 R E F : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {sourceScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals}
  {targetScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K2 R reals}
  {scalarHom : IsometricRingHom sourceScalars targetScalars}
  {domain : NormedSpace K R E reals sourceScalars}
  {codomain : NormedSpace K2 R F reals targetScalars} ->
  ContinuousSemilinearMap scalarHom domain codomain ->
  Subset E ->
  Subset F
Image {E = E} linear U y =
  Exists E
    (\ x ->
      Both
        (U x)
        (apply linear x == y))

IsOpen :
  {K R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  Subset V ->
  Set
IsOpen {R = R} {V = V} {reals = reals} space U =
  (x : V) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : V) ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceV space y x) radius ->
          U y))

Surjective :
  {K K2 R E F : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {sourceScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals}
  {targetScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K2 R reals}
  {scalarHom : IsometricRingHom sourceScalars targetScalars}
  {domain : NormedSpace K R E reals sourceScalars}
  {codomain : NormedSpace K2 R F reals targetScalars} ->
  ContinuousSemilinearMap scalarHom domain codomain ->
  Set
Surjective {E = E} {F = F} linear =
  (y : F) ->
  Exists E (\ x -> apply linear x == y)

IsOpenMap :
  {K K2 R E F : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {sourceScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals}
  {targetScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K2 R reals}
  {scalarHom : IsometricRingHom sourceScalars targetScalars}
  (domain : NormedSpace K R E reals sourceScalars)
  (codomain : NormedSpace K2 R F reals targetScalars) ->
  ContinuousSemilinearMap scalarHom domain codomain ->
  Set1
IsOpenMap domain codomain linear =
  (U : Subset _) ->
  IsOpen domain U ->
  IsOpen codomain (Image linear U)

open-mapping-theorem-functional-analysis : Set1
open-mapping-theorem-functional-analysis =
  (R K K2 E F : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (sourceScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals) ->
  (targetScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K2 R reals) ->
  (scalarHom : IsometricRingHom sourceScalars targetScalars) ->
  (inverseScalarHom : IsometricRingHom targetScalars sourceScalars) ->
  InverseRingHomPair scalarHom inverseScalarHom ->
  (domain : NormedSpace K R E reals sourceScalars) ->
  (codomain : NormedSpace K2 R F reals targetScalars) ->
  Complete domain ->
  Complete codomain ->
  (linear : ContinuousSemilinearMap scalarHom domain codomain) ->
  Surjective linear ->
  IsOpenMap domain codomain linear

title: Q944297_open_mapping_theorem_functional_analysis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q944297 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q944297), "Open mapping theorem
  (functional analysis)": a surjective continuous semilinear map between
  Banach spaces over isometrically isomorphic nontrivially normed fields is
  an open map. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory pred_setTheory;

val q944297_nontrivially_normed_field_def = new_definition (
  "q944297_nontrivially_normed_field_def",
  ``q944297_nontrivially_normed_field
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) <=>
      zeroK <> oneK /\
      (!a b. addK a b = addK b a) /\
      (!a b c. addK (addK a b) c = addK a (addK b c)) /\
      (!a. addK a zeroK = a) /\
      (!a. addK a (negK a) = zeroK) /\
      (!a b. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
      (!a b c. mulK (mulK a b) c = mulK a (mulK b c)) /\
      (!a. mulK a oneK = a) /\
      (!a b c.
        mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
      invK zeroK = zeroK /\
      (!a. a <> zeroK ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
      (!a. 0 <= normK a) /\
      (!a. (normK a = 0) <=> (a = zeroK)) /\
      (!a. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\
      (!a b. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
      (!a b. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
      (?a. 1 < normK a)``);

val q944297_normed_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q944297_normed_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q944297_normed_add_comm_group
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (norm : 'a -> real) <=>
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add x zero = x) /\
      (!x. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. (norm x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y)``);

val q944297_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q944297_normed_space_def",
  ``q944297_normed_space
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x. smulE oneK x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (mulK a b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (addK a b) x =
                 addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smulE a (addE x y) =
                 addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
      (!x. smulE zeroK x = zeroE) /\
      (!a. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!a x. normE (smulE a x) = normK a * normE x)``);

val q944297_ring_hom_def = new_definition (
  "q944297_ring_hom_def",
  ``q944297_ring_hom
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (zeroL : 'l) (oneL : 'l)
      (addL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (mulL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (sigma : 'k -> 'l) <=>
      sigma zeroK = zeroL /\
      sigma oneK = oneL /\
      (!a b. sigma (addK a b) = addL (sigma a) (sigma b)) /\
      (!a b. sigma (mulK a b) = mulL (sigma a) (sigma b))``);

val q944297_isometric_ring_hom_inv_pair_def = new_definition (
  "q944297_isometric_ring_hom_inv_pair_def",
  ``q944297_isometric_ring_hom_inv_pair
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroL : 'l) (oneL : 'l)
      (addL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (mulL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (normL : 'l -> real)
      (sigma : 'k -> 'l) (sigma' : 'l -> 'k) <=>
      q944297_ring_hom
        zeroK oneK addK mulK zeroL oneL addL mulL sigma /\
      q944297_ring_hom
        zeroL oneL addL mulL zeroK oneK addK mulK sigma' /\
      (!a. sigma' (sigma a) = a) /\
      (!b. sigma (sigma' b) = b) /\
      (!a. normL (sigma a) = normK a) /\
      (!b. normK (sigma' b) = normL b)``);

val q944297_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q944297_tendsto_def",
  ``q944297_tendsto
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (u : num -> 'a) (x : 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon``);

val q944297_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q944297_cauchy_def",
  ``q944297_cauchy
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (u : num -> 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !m n : num.
          N <= m /\ N <= n ==>
          norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon``);

val q944297_complete_space_def = new_definition (
  "q944297_complete_space_def",
  ``q944297_complete_space
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'a.
        q944297_cauchy add neg norm u ==>
        ?x : 'a. q944297_tendsto add neg norm u x``);

val q944297_continuous_semilinear_map_def = new_definition (
  "q944297_continuous_semilinear_map_def",
  ``q944297_continuous_semilinear_map
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (negF : 'f -> 'f)
      (smulF : 'l -> 'f -> 'f) (normF : 'f -> real)
      (sigma : 'k -> 'l) (g : 'e -> 'f) <=>
      (!x y. g (addE x y) = addF (g x) (g y)) /\
      (!a x. g (smulE a x) = smulF (sigma a) (g x)) /\
      (!x : 'e. !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !y : 'e.
            normE (addE y (negE x)) < delta ==>
            normF (addF (g y) (negF (g x))) < epsilon)``);

val q944297_is_open_def = new_definition (
  "q944297_is_open_def",
  ``q944297_is_open
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (s : 'a set) <=>
      !x : 'a.
        x IN s ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y : 'a.
            norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN s``);

val q944297_is_open_map_def = new_definition (
  "q944297_is_open_map_def",
  ``q944297_is_open_map
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (negF : 'f -> 'f)
      (normF : 'f -> real) (g : 'e -> 'f) <=>
      !s : 'e set.
        q944297_is_open addE negE normE s ==>
        q944297_is_open addF negF normF (IMAGE g s)``);

val ContinuousLinearMap_isOpenMap =
  ``!(zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroL : 'l) (oneL : 'l)
      (addL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (mulL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (negL : 'l -> 'l) (invL : 'l -> 'l)
      (normL : 'l -> real)
      (sigma : 'k -> 'l) (sigma' : 'l -> 'k)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (zeroF : 'f) (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (negF : 'f -> 'f) (smulF : 'l -> 'f -> 'f)
      (normF : 'f -> real) (g : 'e -> 'f).
      q944297_nontrivially_normed_field
        zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
      q944297_nontrivially_normed_field
        zeroL oneL addL mulL negL invL normL /\
      q944297_isometric_ring_hom_inv_pair
        zeroK oneK addK mulK normK
        zeroL oneL addL mulL normL sigma sigma' /\
      q944297_normed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
      q944297_normed_space
        zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroE addE smulE normE /\
      q944297_complete_space addE negE normE /\
      q944297_normed_add_comm_group zeroF addF negF normF /\
      q944297_normed_space
        zeroL oneL addL mulL normL zeroF addF smulF normF /\
      q944297_complete_space addF negF normF /\
      q944297_continuous_semilinear_map
        addE negE smulE normE addF negF smulF normF sigma g /\
      (!y : 'f. ?x : 'e. g x = y)
      ==>
      q944297_is_open_map
        addE negE normE addF negF normF g``;

title: Q944297_open_mapping_theorem_functional_analysis
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q944297
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q944297),
  "Open mapping theorem (functional analysis)": a surjective continuous
  semilinear map between complete normed vector spaces over isometrically
  inverse nontrivially normed fields is an open map. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's NrmVec class supplies the additive group, scalar action, norm,
  norm-induced metric, and norm topology of a normed vector space. Membership
  in CMetSp is completeness for that metric.

  Q944297IsometricInvPair K L S R expands the two isometric ring
  homomorphisms and both inverse identities of Lean's RingHomInvPair S R,
  RingHomIsometric S, and RingHomIsometric R assumptions.
  Q944297ContinuousSemilinear K L S V W T says that T is additive,
  S-semilinear, and continuous for the two norm topologies.
  Q944297Surjective and Q944297OpenMap are the direct set-theoretic
  renderings of Function.Surjective and IsOpenMap.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q944297IsometricInvPair Q944297ContinuousSemilinear
   Q944297Surjective Q944297OpenMap $.

q944297-isometric-inv-pair-syntax
  $a wff ( Q944297IsometricInvPair K L S R ) $.
q944297-continuous-semilinear-syntax
  $a wff ( Q944297ContinuousSemilinear K L S V W T ) $.
q944297-surjective-syntax
  $a wff ( Q944297Surjective V W T ) $.
q944297-open-map-syntax
  $a wff ( Q944297OpenMap V W T ) $.

${
  $d K L R S a b $.

  q944297-isometric-inv-pair-definition $a |- (
    ( Q944297IsometricInvPair K L S R )
    <->
    (
      S e. ( K RingHom L )
      /\
      R e. ( L RingHom K )
      /\
      A. a e. ( Base ` K )
        ( R ` ( S ` a ) ) = a
      /\
      A. b e. ( Base ` L )
        ( S ` ( R ` b ) ) = b
      /\
      A. a e. ( Base ` K )
        (
          ( norm ` L )
          `
          ( S ` a )
        )
        =
        ( ( norm ` K ) ` a )
      /\
      A. b e. ( Base ` L )
        (
          ( norm ` K )
          `
          ( R ` b )
        )
        =
        ( ( norm ` L ) ` b )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d K L S T V W a x $.

  q944297-continuous-semilinear-definition $a |- (
    ( Q944297ContinuousSemilinear K L S V W T )
    <->
    (
      T e. ( V GrpHom W )
      /\
      A. a e. ( Base ` K )
        A. x e. ( Base ` V )
          (
            T
            `
            ( a ( .s ` V ) x )
          )
          =
          (
            ( S ` a )
            ( .s ` W )
            ( T ` x )
          )
      /\
      T e. (
        ( TopOpen ` V )
        Cn
        ( TopOpen ` W )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d T V W x y $.

  q944297-surjective-definition $a |- (
    ( Q944297Surjective V W T )
    <->
    A. y e. ( Base ` W )
      E. x e. ( Base ` V )
        ( T ` x ) = y
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d O T V W $.

  q944297-open-map-definition $a |- (
    ( Q944297OpenMap V W T )
    <->
    A. O e. ( TopOpen ` V )
      ( T " O ) e. ( TopOpen ` W )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d K L R S T V W c v w $.

  thousand-theorems-q944297-open-mapping-theorem $a |-
    A. K e. ( NrmRing i^i Field )
      A. L e. ( NrmRing i^i Field )
        A. V e. { v e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` v ) = K }
          A. W e. { w e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` w ) = L }
            A. S
              A. R
                A. T
                  (
                    (
                      E. c e. ( Base ` K )
                        1 < ( ( norm ` K ) ` c )
                      /\
                      E. c e. ( Base ` L )
                        1 < ( ( norm ` L ) ` c )
                      /\
                      V e. CMetSp
                      /\
                      W e. CMetSp
                      /\
                      ( Q944297IsometricInvPair K L S R )
                      /\
                      ( Q944297ContinuousSemilinear K L S V W T )
                    )
                    ->
                    (
                      ( Q944297Surjective V W T )
                      ->
                      ( Q944297OpenMap V W T )
                    )
                  )
  $.
$}

title: Q944297_open_mapping_theorem_functional_analysis
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q944297
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q944297), "Open mapping theorem (functional
:: analysis)": a surjective continuous semilinear map between Banach spaces
:: over isometrically isomorphic nontrivially normed fields is open. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, RELAT_1,
    ZFMISC_1, BINOP_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3,
    NAT_1, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, ORDINAL2;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1;
  constructors ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, CARD_1,
    REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, BINOP_2;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1,
    NAT_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for R,S,E,F being non empty set,
      zeroR,oneR being Element of R,
      addR,mulR being BinOp of R,
      oppR,invR being UnOp of R,
      normR being Function of R,REAL,
      zeroS,oneS being Element of S,
      addS,mulS being BinOp of S,
      oppS,invS being UnOp of S,
      normS being Function of S,REAL,
      sigma being Function of R,S,
      sigmaInv being Function of S,R,
      zeroE being Element of E,
      addE being BinOp of E,
      oppE being UnOp of E,
      smulE being Function of [:R,E:],E,
      normE being Function of E,REAL,
      zeroF being Element of F,
      addF being BinOp of F,
      oppF being UnOp of F,
      smulF being Function of [:S,F:],F,
      normF being Function of F,REAL,
      g being Function of E,F
  st
    zeroR <> oneR &
    (for a,b being Element of R holds
      addR.(a,b) = addR.(b,a)) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of R holds
      addR.(addR.(a,b),c) = addR.(a,addR.(b,c))) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      addR.(a,zeroR) = a) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      addR.(a,oppR.a) = zeroR) &
    (for a,b being Element of R holds
      mulR.(a,b) = mulR.(b,a)) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of R holds
      mulR.(mulR.(a,b),c) = mulR.(a,mulR.(b,c))) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      mulR.(a,oneR) = a) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      mulR.(a,zeroR) = zeroR) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of R holds
      mulR.(a,addR.(b,c)) =
        addR.(mulR.(a,b),mulR.(a,c))) &
    (for a being Element of R st a <> zeroR holds
      mulR.(a,invR.a) = oneR) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      0 <= normR.a) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      (normR.a = 0 iff a = zeroR)) &
    (for a,b being Element of R holds
      normR.(addR.(a,b)) <= normR.a + normR.b) &
    (for a,b being Element of R holds
      normR.(mulR.(a,b)) = normR.a * normR.b) &
    (ex a being Element of R st 1 < normR.a) &
    zeroS <> oneS &
    (for a,b being Element of S holds
      addS.(a,b) = addS.(b,a)) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of S holds
      addS.(addS.(a,b),c) = addS.(a,addS.(b,c))) &
    (for a being Element of S holds
      addS.(a,zeroS) = a) &

    (for x,y being Element of E holds

title: Q944297_open_mapping_theorem_functional_analysis
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q944297,
% "Open mapping theorem (functional analysis)": a surjective continuous
% semilinear map between Banach spaces over isometrically isomorphic
% nontrivially normed fields is an open map. This file contains no proof.

Q944297_open_mapping_theorem_functional_analysis[
  K: TYPE+,
  L: TYPE+,
  E: TYPE+,
  F: TYPE+,
  zeroK: K,
  oneK: K,
  addK: [K, K -> K],
  mulK: [K, K -> K],
  negK: [K -> K],
  invK: [K -> K],
  normK: [K -> real],
  zeroL: L,
  oneL: L,
  addL: [L, L -> L],
  mulL: [L, L -> L],
  negL: [L -> L],
  invL: [L -> L],
  normL: [L -> real],
  sigma: [K -> L],
  sigma_inv: [L -> K],
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [K, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  zeroF: F,
  addF: [F, F -> F],
  negF: [F -> F],
  smulF: [L, F -> F],
  normF: [F -> real],
  f: [E -> F]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  e_set: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  f_set: TYPE = [F -> bool]
  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  f_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> F]

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  subF(x, y: F): F =
    addF(x, negF(y))

  nontrivially_normed_field_K: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: K):
      addK(a, b) = addK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        addK(addK(a, b), c) = addK(a, addK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        addK(a, zeroK) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        addK(a, negK(a)) = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        mulK(a, b) = mulK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(mulK(a, b), c) = mulK(a, mulK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        mulK(a, oneK) = a)
      AND zeroK /= oneK
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(a, addK(b, c)) =
          addK(mulK(a, b), mulK(a, c)))
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        a /= zeroK IMPLIES mulK(a, invK(a)) = oneK)
      AND normK(zeroK) = 0
      AND normK(oneK) = 1
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        0 <= normK(a))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        normK(a) = 0 IFF a = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        normK(negK(a)) = normK(a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        normK(addK(a, b)) <= normK(a) + normK(b))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        normK(mulK(a, b)) = normK(a) * normK(b))
      AND (EXISTS (a: K):
        1 < normK(a))

  nontrivially_normed_field_L: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: L):
      addL(a, b) = addL(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: L):
        addL(addL(a, b), c) = addL(a, addL(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: L):
        addL(a, zeroL) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: L):
        addL(a, negL(a)) = zeroL)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: L):
        mulL(a, b) = mulL(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: L):
        mulL(mulL(a, b), c) = mulL(a, mulL(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: L):
        mulL(a, oneL) = a)
      AND zeroL /= oneL
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: L):
        mulL(a, addL(b, c)) =
          addL(mulL(a, b), mulL(a, c)))
      AND invL(zeroL) = zeroL
      AND (FORALL (a: L):
        a /= zeroL IMPLIES mulL(a, invL(a)) = oneL)
      AND normL(zeroL) = 0
      AND normL(oneL) = 1
      AND (FORALL (a: L):
        0 <= normL(a))
      AND (FORALL (a: L):
        normL(a) = 0 IFF a = zeroL)
      AND (FORALL (a: L):
        normL(negL(a)) = normL(a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: L):
        normL(addL(a, b)) <= normL(a) + normL(b))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: L):
        normL(mulL(a, b)) = normL(a) * normL(b))
      AND (EXISTS (a: L):
        1 < normL(a))

  isometric_ring_homomorphism_pair: bool =
    sigma(zeroK) = zeroL
      AND sigma(oneK) = oneL
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        sigma(addK(a, b)) = addL(sigma(a), sigma(b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        sigma(mulK(a, b)) = mulL(sigma(a), sigma(b)))
      AND sigma_inv(zeroL) = zeroK
      AND sigma_inv(oneL) = oneK
      AND (FORALL (a, b: L):
        sigma_inv(addL(a, b)) =
          addK(sigma_inv(a), sigma_inv(b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: L):
        sigma_inv(mulL(a, b)) =
          mulK(sigma_inv(a), sigma_inv(b)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        sigma_inv(sigma(a)) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: L):
        sigma(sigma_inv(a)) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        normL(sigma(a)) = normK(a))
      AND (FORALL (a: L):
        normK(sigma_inv(a)) = normL(a))

  normed_space_E: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND normE(zeroE) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smulE(addK(a, b), x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smulE(mulK(a, b), x) = smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(oneK, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(zeroK, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) = normK(a) * normE(x))

  normed_space_F: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: F):
      addF(x, y) = addF(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
        addF(addF(x, y), z) = addF(x, addF(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        addF(x, zeroF) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        addF(x, negF(x)) = zeroF)
      AND normF(zeroF) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        0 <= normF(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        normF(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        normF(negF(x)) = normF(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: F):
        normF(addF(x, y)) <= normF(x) + normF(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: L), (x, y: F):
        smulF(a, addF(x, y)) =
          addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: L), (x: F):
        smulF(addL(a, b), x) =
          addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: L), (x: F):
        smulF(mulL(a, b), x) = smulF(a, smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        smulF(oneL, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        smulF(zeroL, x) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (a: L):
        smulF(a, zeroF) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (a: L), (x: F):
        normF(smulF(a, x)) = normL(a) * normF(x))

  cauchy_E(values: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
      0 < epsilon_value IMPLIES
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
            cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index
              IMPLIES
                normE(
                  subE(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
                  < epsilon_value

  converges_E(values: e_sequence, limit_value: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
      0 < epsilon_value IMPLIES
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (index: nat):
            cutoff <= index IMPLIES
              normE(subE(values(index), limit_value))
                < epsilon_value

  complete_E: bool =
    FORALL (values: e_sequence):
      cauchy_E(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit_value: E):
          converges_E(values, limit_value)

  cauchy_F(values: f_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
      0 < epsilon_value IMPLIES
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
            cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index
              IMPLIES
                normF(
                  subF(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
                  < epsilon_value

  converges_F(values: f_sequence, limit_value: F): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
      0 < epsilon_value IMPLIES
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (index: nat):
            cutoff <= index IMPLIES
              normF(subF(values(index), limit_value))
                < epsilon_value

  complete_F: bool =
    FORALL (values: f_sequence):
      cauchy_F(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit_value: F):
          converges_F(values, limit_value)

  continuous_semilinear_map: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      f(addE(x, y)) = addF(f(x), f(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        f(smulE(a, x)) = smulF(sigma(a), f(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E), (epsilon_value: real):
        0 < epsilon_value IMPLIES
          EXISTS (delta: real):
            0 < delta
              AND FORALL (y: E):
                normE(subE(y, x)) < delta IMPLIES
                  normF(subF(f(y), f(x))) < epsilon_value)

  surjective_map: bool =
    FORALL (y: F):
      EXISTS (x: E):
        f(x) = y

  open_E(U: e_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      U(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: real):
          0 < radius
            AND FORALL (y: E):
              normE(subE(y, x)) < radius IMPLIES U(y)

  open_F(U: f_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: F):
      U(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: real):
          0 < radius
            AND FORALL (y: F):
              normF(subF(y, x)) < radius IMPLIES U(y)

  image_f(U: e_set): f_set =
    LAMBDA (y: F):
      EXISTS (x: E):
        U(x) AND f(x) = y

  is_open_map: bool =
    FORALL (U: e_set):
      open_E(U) IMPLIES open_F(image_f(U))

  open_mapping_theorem: bool =
    (nontrivially_normed_field_K
      AND nontrivially_normed_field_L
      AND isometric_ring_homomorphism_pair
      AND normed_space_E
      AND normed_space_F
      AND complete_E
      AND complete_F
      AND continuous_semilinear_map
      AND surjective_map)
    IMPLIES is_open_map
END Q944297_open_mapping_theorem_functional_analysis
