title: Q966837_cramer_wold_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q966837
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q966837), "Cramér–Wold theorem": convergence in
  distribution of random variables in a finite-dimensional real inner-product
  space is equivalent to convergence in distribution of every scalar
  projection. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals PeanoNat.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q966837_event (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q966837_empty {A : Type} : q966837_event A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q966837_full {A : Type} : q966837_event A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q966837_complement {A : Type}
    (U : q966837_event A) : q966837_event A :=
  fun x => ~ U x.

Definition q966837_countable_union {A : Type}
    (U : nat -> q966837_event A) : q966837_event A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, U n x.

Definition q966837_preimage {A B : Type}
    (f : A -> B) (U : q966837_event B) : q966837_event A :=
  fun x => U (f x).

Definition q966837_same_event {A : Type}
    (U W : q966837_event A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, U x <-> W x.

Definition q966837_subset {A : Type}
    (U W : q966837_event A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, U x -> W x.

Definition q966837_disjoint {A : Type}
    (U W : q966837_event A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (U x /\ W x).

Definition q966837_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (U : nat -> q966837_event A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    i <> j -> q966837_disjoint (U i) (U j).

Record q966837_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q966837_measurable : q966837_event A -> Prop;
  q966837_measurable_extensional :
    forall U W : q966837_event A,
      q966837_same_event U W ->
      (q966837_measurable U <-> q966837_measurable W);
  q966837_measurable_empty :
    q966837_measurable q966837_empty;
  q966837_measurable_complement :
    forall U : q966837_event A,
      q966837_measurable U ->
      q966837_measurable (q966837_complement U);
  q966837_measurable_countable_union :
    forall U : nat -> q966837_event A,
      (forall n : nat, q966837_measurable (U n)) ->
      q966837_measurable (q966837_countable_union U)
}.

Arguments q966837_measurable {A} _ _.

Definition q966837_measurable_function {A B : Type}
    (MA : q966837_measurable_space A)
    (MB : q966837_measurable_space B)
    (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall U : q966837_event B,
    q966837_measurable MB U ->
    q966837_measurable MA (q966837_preimage f U).

Fixpoint q966837_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => q966837_partial_sum u k + u k
  end.

Definition q966837_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition q966837_infimum
    (values : R -> Prop) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  (forall value : R, values value -> bound <= value) /\
  (forall lower : R,
    (forall value : R, values value -> lower <= value) ->
    lower <= bound).

Record q966837_probability_measure
    (A : Type) (M : q966837_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q966837_mass : q966837_event A -> R;
  q966837_mass_extensional :
    forall U W : q966837_event A,
      q966837_same_event U W ->
      q966837_mass U = q966837_mass W;
  q966837_mass_nonnegative :
    forall U : q966837_event A, 0 <= q966837_mass U;
  q966837_mass_empty :
    q966837_mass q966837_empty = 0;
  q966837_mass_full :
    q966837_mass q966837_full = 1;
  q966837_mass_monotone :
    forall U W : q966837_event A,
      q966837_subset U W ->
      q966837_mass U <= q966837_mass W;
  q966837_mass_trimmed :
    forall U : q966837_event A,
      q966837_infimum
        (fun value : R =>
          exists W : q966837_event A,
            q966837_measurable M W /\
            q966837_subset U W /\
            value = q966837_mass W)
        (q966837_mass U);
  q966837_mass_countably_additive :
    forall U : nat -> q966837_event A,
      (forall n : nat, q966837_measurable M (U n)) ->
      q966837_pairwise_disjoint U ->
      q966837_sequence_converges
        (fun n =>
          q966837_partial_sum
            (fun k => q966837_mass (U k)) n)
        (q966837_mass (q966837_countable_union U))
}.

Arguments q966837_probability_measure A M : clear implicits.
Arguments q966837_mass {A M} _ _.

Definition q966837_ae_equal {A B : Type}
    {M : q966837_measurable_space A}
    (P : q966837_probability_measure A M)
    (f g : A -> B) : Prop :=
  exists N : q966837_event A,
    q966837_mass P N = 0 /\
    forall x : A, ~ N x -> f x = g x.

Definition q966837_ae_measurable {A B : Type}
    (MA : q966837_measurable_space A)
    (MB : q966837_measurable_space B)
    (P : q966837_probability_measure A MA)
    (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  exists g : A -> B,
    q966837_measurable_function MA MB g /\
    q966837_ae_equal P f g.

Record q966837_real_inner_product_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q966837_zero : E;
  q966837_add : E -> E -> E;
  q966837_neg : E -> E;
  q966837_smul : R -> E -> E;
  q966837_inner : E -> E -> R;
  q966837_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q966837_add x (q966837_add y z) =
      q966837_add (q966837_add x y) z;
  q966837_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q966837_add x y = q966837_add y x;
  q966837_zero_add :
    forall x : E, q966837_add q966837_zero x = x;
  q966837_neg_add :
    forall x : E,
      q966837_add (q966837_neg x) x = q966837_zero;
  q966837_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q966837_smul 1 x = x;
  q966837_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q966837_smul (a * b) x =
      q966837_smul a (q966837_smul b x);
  q966837_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q966837_smul (a + b) x =
      q966837_add (q966837_smul a x) (q966837_smul b x);
  q966837_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : E),
      q966837_smul a (q966837_add x y) =
      q966837_add (q966837_smul a x) (q966837_smul a y);
  q966837_zero_smul :
    forall x : E, q966837_smul 0 x = q966837_zero;
  q966837_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q966837_smul a q966837_zero = q966837_zero;
  q966837_neg_eq_smul :
    forall x : E, q966837_neg x = q966837_smul (-1) x;
  q966837_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : E,
      q966837_inner (q966837_add x y) z =
      q966837_inner x z + q966837_inner y z;
  q966837_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : E),
      q966837_inner (q966837_smul a x) y =
      a * q966837_inner x y;
  q966837_inner_symm :
    forall x y : E, q966837_inner x y = q966837_inner y x;
  q966837_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q966837_inner x x;
  q966837_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q966837_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q966837_zero;
  q966837_finite_orthonormal_basis :
    exists (dimension : nat) (basis : nat -> E),
      (forall i j : nat,
        (i < dimension)%nat ->
        (j < dimension)%nat ->
        q966837_inner (basis i) (basis j) =
          if Nat.eq_dec i j then 1 else 0) /\
      forall x : E,
        x =
        (fix sum (n : nat) : E :=
          match n with
          | O => q966837_zero
          | S k =>
              q966837_add
                (sum k)
                (q966837_smul
                  (q966837_inner x (basis k))
                  (basis k))
          end) dimension
}.

Arguments q966837_zero {E} _.
Arguments q966837_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q966837_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q966837_smul {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q966837_inner {E} _ _ _.

Definition q966837_sub {E : Type}
    (V : q966837_real_inner_product_space E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q966837_add V x (q966837_neg V y).

Definition q966837_norm {E : Type}
    (V : q966837_real_inner_product_space E)
    (x : E) : R :=
  sqrt (q966837_inner V x x).

Definition q966837_metric_open {E : Type}
    (V : q966837_real_inner_product_space E)
    (U : q966837_event E) : Prop :=
  forall x : E,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : E,
        q966837_norm V (q966837_sub V y x) < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q966837_metric_closed {E : Type}
    (V : q966837_real_inner_product_space E)
    (F : q966837_event E) : Prop :=
  q966837_metric_open V (q966837_complement F).

Inductive q966837_borel {E : Type}
    (V : q966837_real_inner_product_space E)
    : q966837_event E -> Prop :=
| q966837_borel_open :
    forall U : q966837_event E,
      q966837_metric_open V U ->
      q966837_borel V U
| q966837_borel_empty :
    q966837_borel V q966837_empty
| q966837_borel_extensional :
    forall U W : q966837_event E,
      q966837_borel V U ->
      q966837_same_event U W ->
      q966837_borel V W
| q966837_borel_complement :
    forall U : q966837_event E,
      q966837_borel V U ->
      q966837_borel V (q966837_complement U)
| q966837_borel_countable_union :
    forall U : nat -> q966837_event E,
      (forall n : nat, q966837_borel V (U n)) ->
      q966837_borel V (q966837_countable_union U).

Definition q966837_borel_space {E : Type}
    (V : q966837_real_inner_product_space E)
    : q966837_measurable_space E :=
  {|
    q966837_measurable := q966837_borel V;
    q966837_measurable_extensional :=
      fun U W h =>
        conj
          (fun hU =>
            @q966837_borel_extensional E V U W hU h)
          (fun hW =>
            @q966837_borel_extensional E V W U hW
              (fun x => iff_sym (h x)));
    q966837_measurable_empty := @q966837_borel_empty E V;
    q966837_measurable_complement :=
      @q966837_borel_complement E V;
    q966837_measurable_countable_union :=
      @q966837_borel_countable_union E V
  |}.

Definition q966837_real_open
    (U : q966837_event R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : R,
        Rabs (y - x) < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q966837_real_closed
    (F : q966837_event R) : Prop :=
  q966837_real_open (q966837_complement F).

Inductive q966837_real_borel : q966837_event R -> Prop :=
| q966837_real_borel_open :
    forall U : q966837_event R,
      q966837_real_open U ->
      q966837_real_borel U
| q966837_real_borel_empty :
    q966837_real_borel q966837_empty
| q966837_real_borel_extensional :
    forall U W : q966837_event R,
      q966837_real_borel U ->
      q966837_same_event U W ->
      q966837_real_borel W
| q966837_real_borel_complement :
    forall U : q966837_event R,
      q966837_real_borel U ->
      q966837_real_borel (q966837_complement U)
| q966837_real_borel_countable_union :
    forall U : nat -> q966837_event R,
      (forall n : nat, q966837_real_borel (U n)) ->
      q966837_real_borel (q966837_countable_union U).

Definition q966837_real_borel_space : q966837_measurable_space R :=
  {|
    q966837_measurable := q966837_real_borel;
    q966837_measurable_extensional :=
      fun U W h =>
        conj
          (fun hU =>
            @q966837_real_borel_extensional U W hU h)
          (fun hW =>
            @q966837_real_borel_extensional W U hW
              (fun x => iff_sym (h x)));
    q966837_measurable_empty := q966837_real_borel_empty;
    q966837_measurable_complement :=
      @q966837_real_borel_complement;
    q966837_measurable_countable_union :=
      @q966837_real_borel_countable_union
  |}.

Definition q966837_limsup_le
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        u n <= limit + epsilon.

Definition q966837_vector_tendsto_in_distribution
    {E Omega Omega' : Type}
    (V : q966837_real_inner_product_space E)
    (MOmega : q966837_measurable_space Omega)
    (MOmega' : q966837_measurable_space Omega')
    (P : q966837_probability_measure Omega MOmega)
    (P' : q966837_probability_measure Omega' MOmega')
  (X : nat -> Omega -> E)
    (X' : Omega' -> E) : Prop :=
  (forall n : nat,
    @q966837_ae_measurable
      Omega E MOmega (q966837_borel_space V) P (X n)) /\
  @q966837_ae_measurable
    Omega' E MOmega' (q966837_borel_space V) P' X' /\
  forall F : q966837_event E,
    q966837_metric_closed V F ->
    q966837_limsup_le
      (fun n => q966837_mass P (q966837_preimage (X n) F))
      (q966837_mass P' (q966837_preimage X' F)).

Definition q966837_scalar_tendsto_in_distribution
    {Omega Omega' : Type}
    (MOmega : q966837_measurable_space Omega)
    (MOmega' : q966837_measurable_space Omega')
    (P : q966837_probability_measure Omega MOmega)
    (P' : q966837_probability_measure Omega' MOmega')
    (Y : nat -> Omega -> R)
    (Y' : Omega' -> R) : Prop :=
  (forall n : nat,
    @q966837_ae_measurable
      Omega R MOmega q966837_real_borel_space P (Y n)) /\
  @q966837_ae_measurable
    Omega' R MOmega' q966837_real_borel_space P' Y' /\
  forall F : q966837_event R,
    q966837_real_closed F ->
    q966837_limsup_le
      (fun n => q966837_mass P (q966837_preimage (Y n) F))
      (q966837_mass P' (q966837_preimage Y' F)).

Theorem q966837_cramer_wold_theorem :
  forall (E Omega Omega' : Type)
         (V : q966837_real_inner_product_space E)
         (MOmega : q966837_measurable_space Omega)
         (MOmega' : q966837_measurable_space Omega')
         (P : q966837_probability_measure Omega MOmega)
         (P' : q966837_probability_measure Omega' MOmega')
         (X : nat -> Omega -> E)
         (X' : Omega' -> E),
    @q966837_ae_measurable
      Omega' E MOmega' (q966837_borel_space V) P' X' ->
    (forall n : nat,
      @q966837_ae_measurable
        Omega E MOmega (q966837_borel_space V) P (X n)) ->
    @q966837_vector_tendsto_in_distribution
      E Omega Omega' V MOmega MOmega' P P' X X' <->
    forall t : E,
      @q966837_scalar_tendsto_in_distribution
        Omega Omega' MOmega MOmega' P P'
        (fun n omega => q966837_inner V (X n omega) t)
        (fun omega => q966837_inner V (X' omega) t).
Admitted.

title: Q966837_cramer_wold_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q966837
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q966837), "Cramér–Wold theorem": random
  variables valued in an arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space
  converge in distribution exactly when all of their real scalar projections
  converge in distribution. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q966837_cramer_wold_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q966837_sigma_algebra :: "'a set set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q966837_sigma_algebra S \<longleftrightarrow>
      {} \<in> S \<and>
      UNIV \<in> S \<and>
      (\<forall>A \<in> S. - A \<in> S) \<and>
      (\<forall>A :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set.
        (\<forall>n. A n \<in> S) \<longrightarrow> (\<Union>n. A n) \<in> S)"

definition q966837_generated_sigma_algebra ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set"
  where
    "q966837_generated_sigma_algebra G =
      \<Inter>{S. q966837_sigma_algebra S \<and> G \<subseteq> S}"

definition q966837_borel_sets ::
    "'a::topological_space set set"
  where
    "q966837_borel_sets =
      q966837_generated_sigma_algebra {U. open U}"

definition q966837_probability_space ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> ('a set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q966837_probability_space S P \<longleftrightarrow>
      q966837_sigma_algebra S \<and>
      P {} = 0 \<and>
      P UNIV = 1 \<and>
      (\<forall>A \<in> S. 0 \<le> P A) \<and>
      (\<forall>A :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set.
        (\<forall>n. A n \<in> S) \<and>
        (\<forall>i j. i \<noteq> j \<longrightarrow> A i \<inter> A j = {})
        \<longrightarrow>
          summable (\<lambda>n. P (A n)) \<and>
          P (\<Union>n. A n) = (\<Sum>n. P (A n)))"

definition q966837_measurable ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::topological_space) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q966837_measurable S f \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>B \<in> q966837_borel_sets. f -` B \<in> S)"

definition q966837_measurable_representative ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> ('a set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::topological_space) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q966837_measurable_representative S P f g \<longleftrightarrow>
      q966837_measurable S g \<and>
      (\<exists>N \<in> S. P N = 0 \<and> (\<forall>x. x \<notin> N \<longrightarrow> f x = g x))"

definition q966837_tendsto_in_distribution ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> ('a set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b::topological_space) \<Rightarrow>
      'c set set \<Rightarrow> ('c set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('c \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q966837_tendsto_in_distribution S P X S' P' X' \<longleftrightarrow>
      q966837_probability_space S P \<and>
      q966837_probability_space S' P' \<and>
      (\<exists>Y Y'.
        (\<forall>n. q966837_measurable_representative S P (X n) (Y n)) \<and>
        q966837_measurable_representative S' P' X' Y' \<and>
        (\<forall>C. closed C \<longrightarrow>
          (\<forall>epsilon > 0. \<exists>N. \<forall>n \<ge> N.
            P {omega. Y n omega \<in> C}
              \<le> P' {omega. Y' omega \<in> C} + epsilon)))"

definition q966837_real_inner_product_space ::
    "('a::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q966837_real_inner_product_space inner_product \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x y. inner_product x y = inner_product y x) \<and>
      (\<forall>x y z.
        inner_product (x + y) z =
          inner_product x z + inner_product y z) \<and>
      (\<forall>r x y.
        inner_product (r *\<^sub>R x) y = r * inner_product x y) \<and>
      (\<forall>x. inner_product x x = norm x ^ 2)"

definition q966837_finite_dimensional ::
    "('a::real_vector) itself \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q966837_finite_dimensional _ \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>B :: 'a set. finite B \<and> span B = UNIV)"

theorem cramer_wold_theorem:
  fixes S :: "'omega set set"
    and P :: "'omega set \<Rightarrow> real"
    and S' :: "'omega' set set"
    and P' :: "'omega' set \<Rightarrow> real"
    and X :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'omega \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector"
    and X' :: "'omega' \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and inner_product :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes inner_product_space:
      "q966837_real_inner_product_space inner_product"
    and finite_dimensional:
      "q966837_finite_dimensional TYPE('e)"
    and P_probability: "q966837_probability_space S P"
    and P'_probability: "q966837_probability_space S' P'"
    and X'_ae_measurable:
      "\<exists>Y'. q966837_measurable_representative S' P' X' Y'"
    and X_ae_measurable:
      "\<And>n. \<exists>Y. q966837_measurable_representative S P (X n) Y"
  shows
    "q966837_tendsto_in_distribution S P X S' P' X' \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>t :: 'e.
        q966837_tendsto_in_distribution S P
          (\<lambda>n omega. inner_product (X n omega) t)
          S' P'
          (\<lambda>omega. inner_product (X' omega) t))"
  sorry

end

title: Q966837_cramer_wold_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q966837
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q966837), "Cramér–Wold theorem":
  convergence in distribution of finite-dimensional real inner-product-space
  valued random variables is equivalent to convergence in distribution of
  every scalar inner-product projection. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q966837_sequence_tends = new_definition
 `q966837_sequence_tends (u:num->real) (z:real) <=>
    !epsilon:real.
      &0 < epsilon
      ==> ?N:num. !n:num. N <= n ==> abs(u n - z) < epsilon`;;

let q966837_sigma_algebra = new_definition
 `q966837_sigma_algebra (events:(A->bool)->bool) <=>
    events {} /\
    events (:A) /\
    (!s:A->bool. events s ==> events ((:A) DIFF s)) /\
    (!sets:num->A->bool.
       (!n:num. events (sets n))
       ==> events {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n})`;;

let q966837_probability_measure = new_definition
 `q966837_probability_measure
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real) <=>
    q966837_sigma_algebra events /\
    mu {} = &0 /\
    mu (:A) = &1 /\
    (!s:A->bool. events s ==> &0 <= mu s) /\
    (!sets:num->A->bool.
       (!n:num. events (sets n)) /\
       (!m n:num. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
       ==> q966837_sequence_tends
             (\N:num. sum {k:num | k < N} (\k. mu (sets k)))
             (mu {x:A | ?k:num. x IN sets k}))`;;

let q966837_borel_event = new_definition
 `q966837_borel_event
    (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (s:A->bool) <=>
    !events:(A->bool)->bool.
      q966837_sigma_algebra events /\
      (!u:A->bool. opens u ==> events u)
      ==> events s`;;

let q966837_borel_space = new_definition
 `q966837_borel_space
    (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool) <=>
    !s:A->bool. events s <=> q966837_borel_event opens s`;;

let q966837_measurable = new_definition
 `q966837_measurable
    (eventsA:(A->bool)->bool) (eventsB:(B->bool)->bool)
    (f:A->B) <=>
    !s:B->bool. eventsB s ==> eventsA {x:A | f x IN s}`;;

let q966837_ae_equal = new_definition
 `q966837_ae_equal
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real)
    (f:A->B) (g:A->B) <=>
    ?null:A->bool.
      events null /\
      mu null = &0 /\
      {x:A | ~(f x = g x)} SUBSET null`;;

let q966837_ae_measurable = new_definition
 `q966837_ae_measurable
    (eventsA:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real)
    (eventsB:(B->bool)->bool) (f:A->B) <=>
    ?version:A->B.
      q966837_measurable eventsA eventsB version /\
      q966837_ae_equal eventsA mu f version`;;

let q966837_map_measure = new_definition
 `q966837_map_measure
    (eventsA:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real)
    (eventsB:(B->bool)->bool) (f:A->B)
    (law:(B->bool)->real) <=>
    q966837_probability_measure eventsB law /\
    ?version:A->B.
      q966837_measurable eventsA eventsB version /\
      q966837_ae_equal eventsA mu f version /\
      (!s:B->bool.
         eventsB s ==> law s = mu {x:A | version x IN s})`;;

let q966837_simple_nonnegative = new_definition
 `q966837_simple_nonnegative
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (s:A->real) <=>
    (!x:A. &0 <= s x) /\
    FINITE (IMAGE s (:A)) /\
    (!c:real. events {x:A | s x = c})`;;

let q966837_simple_integral = new_definition
 `q966837_simple_integral
    (mu:(A->bool)->real) (s:A->real) =
    sum (IMAGE s (:A)) (\c:real. mu {x:A | s x = c} * c)`;;

let q966837_lintegral_upper = new_definition
 `q966837_lintegral_upper
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real)
    (h:A->real) (upper:real) <=>
    !s:A->real.
      q966837_simple_nonnegative events s /\
      (!x:A. s x <= h x)
      ==> q966837_simple_integral mu s <= upper`;;

let q966837_has_lintegral = new_definition
 `q966837_has_lintegral
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real)
    (h:A->real) (z:real) <=>
    &0 <= z /\
    q966837_lintegral_upper events mu h z /\
    (!upper:real.
       &0 <= upper /\
       q966837_lintegral_upper events mu h upper
       ==> z <= upper)`;;

let q966837_lintegral = new_definition
 `q966837_lintegral
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real) (h:A->real) =
    @z:real. q966837_has_lintegral events mu h z`;;

let q966837_integral = new_definition
 `q966837_integral
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real) (h:A->real) =
    q966837_lintegral events mu
      (\x:A. if &0 <= h x then h x else &0) -
    q966837_lintegral events mu
      (\x:A. if h x < &0 then --(h x) else &0)`;;

let q966837_real_open = new_definition
 `q966837_real_open (u:real->bool) <=>
    !x:real.
      x IN u
      ==> ?epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon /\
            !y:real. abs(y - x) < epsilon ==> y IN u`;;

let q966837_continuous_real = new_definition
 `q966837_continuous_real
    (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (h:A->real) <=>
    !u:real->bool.
      q966837_real_open u ==> opens {x:A | h x IN u}`;;

let q966837_bounded_continuous = new_definition
 `q966837_bounded_continuous
    (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (h:A->real) <=>
    q966837_continuous_real opens h /\
    ?bound:real. !x:A. abs(h x) <= bound`;;

let q966837_weak_tends = new_definition
 `q966837_weak_tends
    (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool)
    (laws:num->(A->bool)->real) (limit:(A->bool)->real) <=>
    !h:A->real.
      q966837_bounded_continuous opens h
      ==> q966837_sequence_tends
            (\n:num. q966837_integral events (laws n) h)
            (q966837_integral events limit h)`;;

let q966837_tends_in_distribution = new_definition
 `q966837_tends_in_distribution
    (eventsO:(O->bool)->bool) (muO:(O->bool)->real)
    (eventsL:(L->bool)->bool) (muL:(L->bool)->real)
    (target_events:(E->bool)->bool)
    (target_opens:(E->bool)->bool)
    (X:num->O->E) (Z:L->E) <=>
    (!n:num.
       q966837_ae_measurable eventsO muO target_events (X n)) /\
    q966837_ae_measurable eventsL muL target_events Z /\
    ?laws:num->(E->bool)->real limit_law:(E->bool)->real.
      (!n:num.
         q966837_map_measure
           eventsO muO target_events (X n) (laws n)) /\
      q966837_map_measure
        eventsL muL target_events Z limit_law /\
      q966837_weak_tends
        target_opens target_events laws limit_law`;;

let q966837_real_inner_product_space = new_definition
 `q966837_real_inner_product_space
    (zero:E) (add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E)
    (smul:real->E->E) (inner:E->E->real) (norm:E->real) <=>
    (!x y z:E. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
    (!x y:E. add x y = add y x) /\
    (!x:E. add zero x = x) /\
    (!x:E. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
    (!x:E. smul (&1) x = x) /\
    (!x:E. smul (&0) x = zero) /\
    (!a:real. smul a zero = zero) /\
    (!a b:real. !x:E. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
    (!a b:real. !x:E.
       smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
    (!a:real. !x y:E.
       smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
    (!x y:E. inner x y = inner y x) /\
    (!x y z:E. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
    (!a:real. !x y:E. inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
    (!x:E. &0 <= inner x x) /\
    (!x:E. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
    (!x:E. norm x = sqrt(inner x x))`;;

let q966837_finite_dimensional = new_definition
 `q966837_finite_dimensional
    (zero:E) (add:E->E->E) (smul:real->E->E) <=>
    ?d:num basis:num->E.
      !x:E.
        ?coeff:num->real partial:num->E.
          partial 0 = zero /\
          (!i:num.
             i < d
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 add (partial i) (smul (coeff i) (basis i))) /\
          partial d = x`;;

let q966837_norm_open = new_definition
 `q966837_norm_open
    (add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (norm:E->real) (u:E->bool) <=>
    !x:E.
      x IN u
      ==> ?epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon /\
            !y:E.
              norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN u`;;

let Q966837_CRAMER_WOLD_THEOREM =
 `!eventsO:(O->bool)->bool
    muO:(O->bool)->real
    eventsL:(L->bool)->bool
    muL:(L->bool)->real
    eventsE:(E->bool)->bool
    zero:E
    add:E->E->E
    neg:E->E
    smul:real->E->E
    inner:E->E->real
    norm:E->real
    X:num->O->E
    Z:L->E.
      q966837_probability_measure eventsO muO /\
      q966837_probability_measure eventsL muL /\
      q966837_real_inner_product_space
        zero add neg smul inner norm /\
      q966837_finite_dimensional zero add smul /\
      q966837_borel_space
        (q966837_norm_open add neg norm) eventsE /\
      (!n:num.
         q966837_ae_measurable eventsO muO eventsE (X n)) /\
      q966837_ae_measurable eventsL muL eventsE Z
      ==>
      (q966837_tends_in_distribution
         eventsO muO eventsL muL eventsE
         (q966837_norm_open add neg norm) X Z
       <=>
       !t:E.
         q966837_tends_in_distribution
           eventsO muO eventsL muL
           (q966837_borel_event q966837_real_open)
           q966837_real_open
           (\n:num x:O. inner (X n x) t)
           (\x:L. inner (Z x) t))`;;

title: Q966837_cramer_wold_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q966837,
;; "Cramér–Wold theorem": convergence in distribution in a finite-dimensional
;; real inner-product space is equivalent to convergence in distribution of
;; every scalar inner-product projection. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; The source theorem is generic over two probability spaces and a
;; finite-dimensional real inner-product space.  The conservative interfaces
;; below represent arbitrary carriers, subsets, functions, sigma-algebras,
;; and measures.  Their mathematical laws are explicit in the statement
;; predicate; no carrier, set, function, or measure is replaced by a finite
;; table.

;; Carriers, arbitrary subsets, and arbitrary functions.

(defstub q966837-member-p (space value) t)
(defstub q966837-set-member-p (space set value) t)
(defstub q966837-empty-set (space) t)
(defstub q966837-full-set (space) t)
(defstub q966837-complement-set (space set) t)
(defstub q966837-set-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q966837-countable-union-set (space sequence) t)

(defstub q966837-function-value (function argument) t)
(defstub q966837-sequence-function (sequence index) t)
(defstub q966837-preimage-set
  (source-space target-space function target-set)
  t)
(defstub q966837-disagreement-set
  (source-space target-space left-function right-function)
  t)

(defun-sk q966837-valid-set-p (space set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q966837-set-member-p space set x)
     (q966837-member-p space x))))

(defun-sk q966837-set-ext-equal-p (space left right)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q966837-set-member-p space left x)
     (q966837-set-member-p space right x))))

(defun-sk q966837-subset-p (space left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q966837-set-member-p space left x)
     (q966837-set-member-p space right x))))

(defun-sk q966837-union-member-exists-p
    (space sequence value)
  (exists (index)
    (and
     (natp index)
     (q966837-set-member-p
      space
      (q966837-set-sequence-value sequence index)
      value))))

(defun-sk q966837-set-sequence-valid-p (space sequence)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (q966837-valid-set-p
      space
      (q966837-set-sequence-value sequence index)))))

(defun-sk q966837-function-p
    (source-space target-space function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q966837-member-p source-space x)
     (q966837-member-p
      target-space
      (q966837-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q966837-functions-ext-equal-p
    (source-space left-function right-function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q966837-member-p source-space x)
     (equal
      (q966837-function-value left-function x)
      (q966837-function-value right-function x)))))

(defun-sk q966837-set-representation-laws-p ()
  (forall (space set left right sequence value)
    (and
     (q966837-valid-set-p
      space (q966837-empty-set space))
     (q966837-valid-set-p
      space (q966837-full-set space))
     (q966837-valid-set-p
      space (q966837-complement-set space set))
     (q966837-valid-set-p
      space (q966837-countable-union-set space sequence))
     (not
      (q966837-set-member-p
       space (q966837-empty-set space) value))
     (iff
      (q966837-set-member-p
       space (q966837-full-set space) value)
      (q966837-member-p space value))
     (iff
      (q966837-set-member-p
       space (q966837-complement-set space set) value)
      (and
       (q966837-member-p space value)
       (not (q966837-set-member-p space set value))))
     (iff
      (q966837-set-member-p
       space (q966837-countable-union-set space sequence) value)
      (and
       (q966837-member-p space value)
       (q966837-union-member-exists-p
        space sequence value)))
     (implies
      (q966837-set-ext-equal-p space left right)
      (equal left right)))))

(defun-sk q966837-function-representation-laws-p ()
  (forall
      (source-space target-space function target-set
       left-function right-function value)
    (and
     (iff
      (q966837-set-member-p
       source-space
       (q966837-preimage-set
        source-space target-space function target-set)
       value)
      (and
       (q966837-member-p source-space value)
       (q966837-set-member-p
        target-space target-set
        (q966837-function-value function value))))
     (iff
      (q966837-set-member-p
       source-space
       (q966837-disagreement-set
        source-space target-space
        left-function right-function)
       value)
      (and
       (q966837-member-p source-space value)
       (not
        (equal
         (q966837-function-value left-function value)
         (q966837-function-value right-function value)))))
     (implies
      (q966837-functions-ext-equal-p
       source-space left-function right-function)
      (equal left-function right-function)))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers.

(defstub q966837-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q966837-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q966837-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q966837-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q966837-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q966837-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q966837-r-less (real left right) t)

(defun q966837-r-subtract (real left right)
  (q966837-r-add
   real left (q966837-r-negate real right)))

(defun q966837-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q966837-r-less real right left)))

(defun q966837-r-positive-p (real value)
  (and
   (q966837-member-p real value)
   (q966837-r-less
    real (q966837-r-zero real) value)))

(defun q966837-r-abs (real value)
  (if (q966837-r-less
       real value (q966837-r-zero real))
      (q966837-r-negate real value)
    value))

(defun q966837-r-distance (real left right)
  (q966837-r-abs
   real (q966837-r-subtract real left right)))

(defun-sk q966837-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-member-p real x)
      (q966837-member-p real y)
      (q966837-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q966837-r-zero real))
            (one (q966837-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q966837-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q966837-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q966837-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q966837-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q966837-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q966837-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q966837-member-p real xy-add)
        (q966837-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q966837-member-p real neg-x)
        (q966837-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q966837-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q966837-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q966837-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q966837-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q966837-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q966837-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q966837-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q966837-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q966837-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q966837-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q966837-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q966837-r-multiply
          real x (q966837-r-add real y z))
         (q966837-r-add
          real
          (q966837-r-multiply real x y)
          (q966837-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q966837-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-member-p real x)
      (q966837-member-p real y)
      (q966837-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q966837-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q966837-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q966837-r-less real x y)
         (q966837-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q966837-r-less real x y)
          (q966837-r-less real y z))
         (q966837-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q966837-r-less real x y)
         (q966837-r-less
          real
          (q966837-r-add real x z)
          (q966837-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q966837-r-less real zero x)
          (q966837-r-less real zero y))
         (q966837-r-less
          real zero
          (q966837-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q966837-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q966837-member-p real x)
     (q966837-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q966837-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-member-p real x)
      (q966837-set-member-p real set x))
     (q966837-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q966837-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q966837-member-p real bound)
     (q966837-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q966837-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q966837-member-p real supremum)
     (q966837-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q966837-member-p real bound)
       (q966837-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q966837-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q966837-r-supremum-exists-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q966837-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q966837-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-valid-set-p real set)
      (q966837-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q966837-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q966837-r-supremum-exists-p real set))))

(defun q966837-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q966837-r-zero real))
        (one (q966837-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q966837-member-p real zero)
     (q966837-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q966837-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q966837-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q966837-r-less real zero one)
     (q966837-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; A normed real inner-product space.

(defstub q966837-v-zero (space) t)
(defstub q966837-v-add (space left right) t)
(defstub q966837-v-negate (space value) t)
(defstub q966837-v-smul (real space scalar vector) t)
(defstub q966837-v-inner (real space left right) t)
(defstub q966837-v-norm (real space vector) t)

(defun q966837-v-subtract (space left right)
  (q966837-v-add
   space left (q966837-v-negate space right)))

(defun q966837-v-distance (real space left right)
  (q966837-v-norm
   real space (q966837-v-subtract space left right)))

(defun-sk q966837-vector-add-norm-inner-laws-p (real space)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-member-p space x)
      (q966837-member-p space y)
      (q966837-member-p space z))
     (let* ((zero-v (q966837-v-zero space))
            (zero-r (q966837-r-zero real))
            (xy-add (q966837-v-add space x y))
            (yz-add (q966837-v-add space y z))
            (neg-x (q966837-v-negate space x))
            (norm-x (q966837-v-norm real space x))
            (norm-y (q966837-v-norm real space y))
            (inner-xx (q966837-v-inner real space x x)))
       (and
        (q966837-member-p space xy-add)
        (q966837-member-p space neg-x)
        (q966837-member-p real norm-x)
        (q966837-member-p real norm-y)
        (q966837-member-p real inner-xx)
        (q966837-member-p
         real
         (q966837-v-inner real space x y))
        (equal
         (q966837-v-add space xy-add z)
         (q966837-v-add space x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q966837-v-add space y x))
        (equal (q966837-v-add space x zero-v) x)
        (equal (q966837-v-add space x neg-x) zero-v)
        (q966837-r-leq real zero-r norm-x)
        (iff (equal norm-x zero-r)
             (equal x zero-v))
        (equal
         (q966837-v-norm real space neg-x)
         norm-x)
        (q966837-r-leq
         real
         (q966837-v-norm real space xy-add)
         (q966837-r-add real norm-x norm-y))
        (q966837-r-leq real zero-r inner-xx)
        (iff (equal inner-xx zero-r)
             (equal x zero-v))
        (equal
         (q966837-r-multiply real norm-x norm-x)
         inner-xx)
        (equal
         (q966837-v-inner real space x y)
         (q966837-v-inner real space y x))
        (equal
         (q966837-v-inner
          real space (q966837-v-add space x y) z)
         (q966837-r-add
          real
          (q966837-v-inner real space x z)
          (q966837-v-inner real space y z))))))))

(defun-sk q966837-vector-scalar-inner-laws-p (real space)
  (forall (a b x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-member-p real a)
      (q966837-member-p real b)
      (q966837-member-p space x)
      (q966837-member-p space y))
     (let ((zero-r (q966837-r-zero real))
           (one-r (q966837-r-one real))
           (zero-v (q966837-v-zero space)))
       (and
        (q966837-member-p
         space (q966837-v-smul real space a x))
        (equal
         (q966837-v-smul real space one-r x)
         x)
        (equal
         (q966837-v-smul
          real space
          (q966837-r-multiply real a b)
          x)
         (q966837-v-smul
          real space a
          (q966837-v-smul real space b x)))
        (equal
         (q966837-v-smul
          real space
          (q966837-r-add real a b)
          x)
         (q966837-v-add
          space
          (q966837-v-smul real space a x)
          (q966837-v-smul real space b x)))
        (equal
         (q966837-v-smul
          real space a
          (q966837-v-add space x y))
         (q966837-v-add
          space
          (q966837-v-smul real space a x)
          (q966837-v-smul real space a y)))
        (equal
         (q966837-v-smul real space zero-r x)
         zero-v)
        (equal
         (q966837-v-smul real space a zero-v)
         zero-v)
        (equal
         (q966837-v-inner
          real space
          (q966837-v-smul real space a x)
          y)
         (q966837-r-multiply
          real a
          (q966837-v-inner real space x y)))
        (equal
         (q966837-v-norm
          real space
          (q966837-v-smul real space a x))
         (q966837-r-multiply
          real
          (q966837-r-abs real a)
          (q966837-v-norm real space x))))))))

(defun q966837-real-inner-product-space-p (real space)
  (and
   (q966837-member-p
    space (q966837-v-zero space))
   (q966837-vector-add-norm-inner-laws-p real space)
   (q966837-vector-scalar-inner-laws-p real space)))

;; Finite dimensionality is represented by an arbitrary finite spanning
;; coordinate family, not by making the vector carrier finite.

(defstub q966837-basis-vector (space basis index) t)
(defstub q966837-coordinate
  (real space basis vector index)
  t)

(defun q966837-linear-combination
    (real space basis vector count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q966837-v-zero space)
    (let ((index (- count 1)))
      (q966837-v-add
       space
       (q966837-linear-combination
        real space basis vector index)
       (q966837-v-smul
        real space
        (q966837-coordinate
         real space basis vector index)
        (q966837-basis-vector

(defun-sk q966837-spanning-family-typed-p
    (real space dimension basis)
  (forall (index vector)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (natp index)
       (< index dimension))
      (q966837-member-p
       space
       (q966837-basis-vector space basis index)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q966837-member-p space vector)
       (natp index)
       (< index dimension))
      (q966837-member-p
       real
       (q966837-coordinate
        real space basis vector index))))))

(defun-sk q966837-spanning-family-expands-p
    (real space dimension basis)
  (forall (vector)
    (implies
     (q966837-member-p space vector)
     (equal
      (q966837-linear-combination
       real space basis vector dimension)
      vector))))

(defun q966837-finite-spanning-family-p
    (real space dimension basis)
  (and
   (natp dimension)
   (q966837-spanning-family-typed-p
    real space dimension basis)

    real space dimension basis)))

(defun-sk q966837-finite-dimensional-p (real space)
  (exists (dimension basis)
    (q966837-finite-spanning-family-p
     real space dimension basis)))

;; Metric open sets, sigma-algebras, and the Borel measurable structures.

(defstub q966837-measurable-set-p (sigma set) t)

(defun-sk q966837-r-ball-contained-p

  (forall (point)
    (implies

    (real set center)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q966837-r-positive-p real radius)
     (q966837-r-ball-contained-p
      real set center radius))))

(defun-sk q966837-r-open-set-p (real set)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (q966837-set-member-p real set center)
     (q966837-r-open-radius-exists-p
      real set center))))

(defun-sk q966837-v-ball-contained-p
    (real space set center radius)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-member-p space point)
      (q966837-r-less
       real
       (q966837-v-distance real space point center)
       radius))
     (q966837-set-member-p space set point))))

(defun-sk q966837-v-open-radius-exists-p
    (real space set center)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q966837-r-positive-p real radius)
     (q966837-v-ball-contained-p
      real space set center radius))))

(defun-sk q966837-v-open-set-p (real space set)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (q966837-set-member-p space set center)
     (q966837-v-open-radius-exists-p
      real space set center))))

(defun q966837-r-closed-set-p (real set)
  (and
   (q966837-valid-set-p real set)
   (q966837-r-open-set-p
    real (q966837-complement-set real set))))

(defun q966837-v-closed-set-p (real space set)
  (and
   (q966837-valid-set-p space set)
   (q966837-v-open-set-p
    real space
    (q966837-complement-set space set))))

(defun-sk q966837-sigma-valid-p (space sigma)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q966837-measurable-set-p sigma set)
     (q966837-valid-set-p space set))))

(defun-sk q966837-sigma-complement-closed-p
    (space sigma)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q966837-measurable-set-p sigma set)
     (q966837-measurable-set-p
      sigma
      (q966837-complement-set space set)))))

(defun-sk q966837-measurable-set-sequence-p
    (sigma sequence)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (q966837-measurable-set-p
      sigma
      (q966837-set-sequence-value sequence index)))))

(defun-sk q966837-sigma-union-closed-p (space sigma)

(defun q966837-sigma-algebra-p (space sigma)
  (and
   (q966837-sigma-valid-p space sigma)

    sigma (q966837-empty-set space))

(defun-sk q966837-sigma-contains-r-opens-p
    (real sigma)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-valid-set-p real set)
      (q966837-r-open-set-p real set))
     (q966837-measurable-set-p sigma set))))

(defun-sk q966837-sigma-contains-v-opens-p
    (real space sigma)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-valid-set-p space set)
      (q966837-v-open-set-p real space set))
     (q966837-measurable-set-p sigma set))))

(defun-sk q966837-r-borel-minimal-p
    (real borel)
  (forall (alternate set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-sigma-algebra-p real alternate)
      (q966837-sigma-contains-r-opens-p
       real alternate)
      (q966837-measurable-set-p borel set))

(defun-sk q966837-v-borel-minimal-p
    (real space borel)
  (forall (alternate set)

(defun q966837-r-borel-space-p (real borel)

(defun q966837-v-borel-space-p

   (q966837-sigma-contains-v-opens-p

   (q966837-v-borel-minimal-p
    real space borel)))

;; Probability measures are real-valued because every probability measure is
;; finite. Countable additivity is expressed by convergence of finite partial
;; sums, exactly preserving arbitrary countable measurable unions.

(defstub q966837-measure-value (real measure set) t)

(defun q966837-finite-measure-sum
    (real measure sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q966837-r-zero real)
    (let ((index (- count 1)))
      (q966837-r-add
       real
       (q966837-finite-measure-sum
        real measure sequence index)
       (q966837-measure-value
        real measure
        (q966837-set-sequence-value
         sequence index))))))

(defun-sk q966837-set-sequence-pairwise-disjoint-p
    (space sequence)
  (forall (left-index right-index value)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left-index)
      (natp right-index)
      (not (equal left-index right-index)))
     (not
      (and
       (q966837-set-member-p
        space
        (q966837-set-sequence-value
         sequence left-index)
        value)
       (q966837-set-member-p
        space
        (q966837-set-sequence-value
         sequence right-index)
        value))))))

(defun-sk q966837-measure-values-p
    (real space measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q966837-valid-set-p space set)
     (let ((value
            (q966837-measure-value real measure set)))
       (and
        (q966837-member-p real value)
        (q966837-r-leq
         real (q966837-r-zero real) value)
        (q966837-r-leq
         real value (q966837-r-one real)))))))

(defun-sk q966837-measure-monotone-p
    (real space measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-valid-set-p space left)
      (q966837-valid-set-p space right)
      (q966837-subset-p space left right))
     (q966837-r-leq
      real
      (q966837-measure-value real measure left)
      (q966837-measure-value real measure right)))))

(defun-sk q966837-measurable-hull-exists-p
    (real space sigma measure set)
  (exists (hull)
    (and
     (q966837-measurable-set-p sigma hull)
     (q966837-subset-p space set hull)
     (equal
      (q966837-measure-value real measure set)
      (q966837-measure-value real measure hull)))))

(defun-sk q966837-measure-trimmed-p
    (real space sigma measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q966837-valid-set-p space set)
     (q966837-measurable-hull-exists-p
      real space sigma measure set))))

(defun-sk q966837-measure-sum-tail-p
    (real measure sequence total epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp count)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff count))
     (q966837-r-less
      real
      (q966837-r-distance
       real
       (q966837-finite-measure-sum
        real measure sequence count)
       total)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q966837-measure-sum-cutoff-exists-p
    (real measure sequence total epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q966837-measure-sum-tail-p
      real measure sequence total epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q966837-measure-series-converges-p
    (real measure sequence total)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q966837-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q966837-measure-sum-cutoff-exists-p
      real measure sequence total epsilon))))

(defun-sk q966837-measure-countably-additive-p
    (real space sigma measure)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-measurable-set-sequence-p
       sigma sequence)
      (q966837-set-sequence-pairwise-disjoint-p
       space sequence))
     (q966837-measure-series-converges-p
      real measure sequence
      (q966837-measure-value
       real measure
       (q966837-countable-union-set
        space sequence))))))

(defun q966837-probability-measure-p
    (real space sigma measure)
  (and
   (q966837-sigma-algebra-p space sigma)
   (q966837-measure-values-p real space measure)
   (equal
    (q966837-measure-value
     real measure (q966837-empty-set space))
    (q966837-r-zero real))
   (equal
    (q966837-measure-value
     real measure (q966837-full-set space))
    (q966837-r-one real))
   (q966837-measure-monotone-p
    real space measure)
   ;; Values on arbitrary sets are the induced outer measure: every set has
   ;; a measurable hull of exactly the same mass.
   (q966837-measure-trimmed-p
    real space sigma measure)
   (q966837-measure-countably-additive-p
    real space sigma measure)))

;; Measurable and almost-everywhere measurable functions.

(defun-sk q966837-measurable-function-p
    (source-space source-sigma
     target-space target-sigma function)

    (real source-space source-sigma measure

     (q966837-function-p
      source-space target-space function)
     (q966837-measurable-function-p
      source-space source-sigma
      target-space target-sigma
      measurable-version)
     (q966837-ae-equal-p
      real source-space target-space measure

(defun-sk q966837-sequence-functions-p
    (source-space target-space sequence)
  (forall (index)
    (implies

      source-space target-space

(defun-sk q966837-sequence-aemeasurable-p
    (real source-space source-sigma measure

      target-space target-sigma
      (q966837-sequence-function

(defstub q966837-projection-function

(defstub q966837-projection-sequence

(defun-sk q966837-projection-representation-laws-p

;; Portmanteau closed-set convergence.  For probability measures on the
;; finite-dimensional metric spaces above, this is bidirectionally equivalent
;; to Mathlib's weak topology on ProbabilityMeasure and hence to the source
;; TendstoInDistribution structure.

(defun-sk q966837-portmanteau-tail-p
    (real source-space target-space source-measure
     limit-source-space limit-measure sequence limit-function
     closed-set epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (index)

      (natp index)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff index))

        (q966837-sequence-function sequence index)

      (q966837-r-add

        real limit-measure
        (q966837-preimage-set

    (real source-space target-space source-measure
     limit-source-space limit-measure sequence limit-function
     closed-set epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q966837-portmanteau-tail-p
      real source-space target-space source-measure
      limit-source-space limit-measure sequence limit-function
      closed-set epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q966837-v-weak-convergence-p
    (real source-space target-space source-measure

      (q966837-v-closed-set-p

(defun-sk q966837-r-weak-convergence-p
    (real source-space source-measure
     limit-source-space limit-measure sequence limit-function)
  (forall (closed-set epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-r-closed-set-p real closed-set)
      (q966837-r-positive-p real epsilon))
     (q966837-portmanteau-cutoff-exists-p
      real source-space real source-measure
      limit-source-space limit-measure sequence limit-function
      closed-set epsilon))))

(defun q966837-v-tendsto-in-distribution-p
    (real source-space source-sigma source-measure
     target-space target-borel
     limit-source-space limit-source-sigma limit-measure
     sequence limit-function)
  (and
   (q966837-sequence-aemeasurable-p
    real source-space source-sigma source-measure
    target-space target-borel sequence)
   (q966837-aemeasurable-p
    real limit-source-space limit-source-sigma limit-measure
    target-space target-borel limit-function)

    real source-space target-space source-measure

(defun q966837-r-tendsto-in-distribution-p
    (real real-borel
     source-space source-sigma source-measure
     limit-source-space limit-source-sigma limit-measure
     sequence limit-function)
  (and
   (q966837-sequence-aemeasurable-p
    real source-space source-sigma source-measure
    real real-borel sequence)
   (q966837-aemeasurable-p
    real limit-source-space limit-source-sigma limit-measure
    real real-borel limit-function)

     target-space
     limit-source-space limit-source-sigma limit-measure

      source-space source-sigma source-measure

    thousand-theorems-q966837-cramer-wold-theorem-statement

  (forall
      (real real-borel
       vector-space vector-borel
       sample-space sample-sigma probability
       limit-sample-space limit-sample-sigma limit-probability
       random-sequence limit-random-variable)
    (implies
     (and
      (q966837-set-representation-laws-p)
      (q966837-function-representation-laws-p)
      (q966837-real-field-p real)
      (q966837-r-borel-space-p real real-borel)
      (q966837-real-inner-product-space-p
       real vector-space)
      (q966837-finite-dimensional-p
       real vector-space)
      (q966837-v-borel-space-p
       real vector-space vector-borel)
      (q966837-sigma-algebra-p
       sample-space sample-sigma)
      (q966837-sigma-algebra-p
       limit-sample-space limit-sample-sigma)
      (q966837-probability-measure-p
       real sample-space sample-sigma probability)
      (q966837-probability-measure-p
       real limit-sample-space limit-sample-sigma
       limit-probability)
      (q966837-sequence-functions-p
       sample-space vector-space random-sequence)
      (q966837-function-p
       limit-sample-space vector-space
       limit-random-variable)
      (q966837-projection-representation-laws-p
       real vector-space)
      ;; These are exactly hX and hX' in the canonical Lean declaration.
      (q966837-sequence-aemeasurable-p
       real sample-space sample-sigma probability
       vector-space vector-borel random-sequence)
      (q966837-aemeasurable-p
       real
       limit-sample-space limit-sample-sigma limit-probability
       vector-space vector-borel limit-random-variable))
     (iff
      (q966837-v-tendsto-in-distribution-p
       real sample-space sample-sigma probability
       vector-space vector-borel
       limit-sample-space limit-sample-sigma limit-probability
       random-sequence limit-random-variable)
      (q966837-all-projections-converge-p
       real real-borel
       sample-space sample-sigma probability
       vector-space
       limit-sample-space limit-sample-sigma limit-probability
       random-sequence limit-random-variable)))))

title: Q966837_cramer_wold_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q966837,
-- "Cramér–Wold theorem": convergence in distribution of finite-dimensional
-- real inner-product-space-valued random variables is equivalent to convergence
-- in distribution of every scalar inner-product projection. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q966837_cramer_wold_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Support.SlutskyProbabilityBase

open CompleteOrderedField
open RealPresentation
open Filter
open ProbabilitySpace

record Iff₂ (A B : Set2) : Set2 where
  constructor equivalence₂
  field
    forward₂  : A -> B
    backward₂ : B -> A

record AtTopFilter (sourceFilter : Filter Nat) : Set1 where
  field
    eventually-at-top :
      (P : Predicate Nat) ->
      Iff
        (eventually sourceFilter P)
        (Exists Nat
          (\ cutoff ->
            (n : Nat) ->
            cutoff <=N n ->
            P n))

record NormedRealInnerProductSpace
  (R E : Set)
  (real : RealPresentation R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE :
      E
    addE :
      E -> E -> E
    negateE :
      E -> E
    scaleE :
      R -> E -> E
    normE :
      E -> R
    innerE :
      E -> E -> R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) ->
      addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-oneE :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (oneR (reals real)) x == x
    scale-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (zeroR (reals real)) x == zeroE
    scale-associativeE :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyR (reals real) a b) x ==
      scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-scalarsE :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addR (reals real) a b) x ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectorsE :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)

    inner-add-left :
      (x y z : E) ->
      innerE (addE x y) z ==
      addR (reals real) (innerE x z) (innerE y z)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      innerE (scaleE a x) y ==
      multiplyR (reals real) a (innerE x y)
    inner-symmetric :
      (x y : E) ->
      innerE x y == innerE y x
    inner-nonnegative :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR (reals real)
        (zeroR (reals real))
        (innerE x x)
    inner-definite :
      (x : E) ->
      innerE x x == zeroR (reals real) ->
      x == zeroE

    norm-nonnegative :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR (reals real)
        (zeroR (reals real))
        (normE x)
    norm-square :
      (x : E) ->
      multiplyR (reals real) (normE x) (normE x) ==
      innerE x x
    norm-triangle :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR (reals real)
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR (reals real) (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) ==
      multiplyR (reals real)
        (absoluteR (reals real) a)
        (normE x)

open NormedRealInnerProductSpace

subtractE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {real : RealPresentation R} ->
  NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E real ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

distanceE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {real : RealPresentation R} ->
  NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E real ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
distanceE space x y =
  normE space (subtractE space x y)

NormMetricOpen :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {real : RealPresentation R} ->
  NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E real ->
  Predicate E ->
  Set
NormMetricOpen {R = R} {E = E} {real = real} space U =
  (x : E) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive (reals real) radius)
        (Subset
          (\ y ->
            StrictLess (reals real)
              (distanceE space y x)
              radius)
          U))

record NormTopologyPresentation
  {R E : Set}
  {real : RealPresentation R}
  (space : NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E real)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace E) : Set1 where
  field
    topology-is-norm-metric :
      (U : Predicate E) ->
      Iff
        (openSet topology U)
        (NormMetricOpen space U)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Vector :
  Set ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Vector R n =
  Fin n -> R

VectorEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
VectorEqual {n = n} x y =
  (i : Fin n) ->
  x i == y i

sumVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Vector R n ->
  R
sumVector reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumVector reals (suc n) terms =
  addR reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumVector reals n (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

record FiniteDimensional
  {R E : Set}
  {real : RealPresentation R}
  (space : NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E real) : Set1 where
  field
    dimension :
      Nat
    toCoordinates :
      E ->
      Vector R dimension
    fromCoordinates :
      Vector R dimension ->
      E
    coordinates-after-vector :
      (coordinates : Vector R dimension) ->
      VectorEqual
        (toCoordinates (fromCoordinates coordinates))
        coordinates
    vector-after-coordinates :
      (x : E) ->
      fromCoordinates (toCoordinates x) == x
    coordinates-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      VectorEqual
        (toCoordinates (addE space x y))
        (\ i ->
          addR (reals real)
            (toCoordinates x i)
            (toCoordinates y i))
    coordinates-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      VectorEqual
        (toCoordinates (scaleE space a x))
        (\ i ->
          multiplyR (reals real) a (toCoordinates x i))
    coordinates-orthonormal :
      (x y : E) ->
      innerE space x y ==
      sumVector (reals real) dimension
        (\ i ->
          multiplyR (reals real)
            (toCoordinates x i)
            (toCoordinates y i))

cramer-wold-theorem : Set2
cramer-wold-theorem =
  (R E Omega OmegaPrime : Set) ->
  (real : RealPresentation R) ->
  (space : NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E real) ->
  FiniteDimensional space ->
  (topologyE : TopologicalSpace E) ->
  NormTopologyPresentation space topologyE ->
  (eventsE : SigmaAlgebra E) ->
  BorelSpace topologyE eventsE ->
  (sourceEvents : SigmaAlgebra Omega) ->
  (limitEvents : SigmaAlgebra OmegaPrime) ->
  (sourceProbability :
    ProbabilitySpace real sourceEvents) ->
  (limitProbability :
    ProbabilitySpace real limitEvents) ->
  (sourceFilter : Filter Nat) ->
  AtTopFilter sourceFilter ->
  (X : Nat -> Omega -> E) ->
  (XPrime : OmegaPrime -> E) ->
  AEMeasurable
    limitEvents
    eventsE
    (probabilityMeasure limitProbability)
    XPrime ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    AEMeasurable
      sourceEvents
      eventsE
      (probabilityMeasure sourceProbability)
      (X n)) ->
  Iff₂
    (TendstoInDistribution
      real
      (\ _ -> Omega)
      (\ _ -> sourceEvents)
      topologyE
      eventsE
      X
      sourceFilter
      XPrime
      limitEvents
      (\ _ -> sourceProbability)
      limitProbability)
    ((t : E) ->
      TendstoInDistribution
        real
        (\ _ -> Omega)
        (\ _ -> sourceEvents)
        (topologyR real)
        (borelR real)
        (\ n omega -> innerE space (X n omega) t)
        sourceFilter
        (\ omega -> innerE space (XPrime omega) t)
        limitEvents
        (\ _ -> sourceProbability)
        limitProbability)

title: Q966837_cramer_wold_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q966837 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q966837), "Cramér–Wold theorem":
  convergence in distribution in a finite-dimensional real inner-product
  space is equivalent to convergence in distribution of every scalar
  inner-product projection. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory iterateTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory extrealTheory sigma_algebraTheory;
open measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory probabilityTheory;

val q966837_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q966837_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q966837_add_comm_group
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero)``);

val q966837_finite_real_inner_product_space_def = new_definition (
  "q966837_finite_real_inner_product_space_def",
  ``q966837_finite_real_inner_product_space
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (norm : 'v -> real) <=>
      q966837_add_comm_group zero add neg /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x. neg x = smul (-1) x) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a x y. inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm x = sqrt (inner x x)) /\
      ?d : num.
        ?basis : num -> 'v.
          (!j k.
            j IN count d /\ k IN count d ==>
            inner (basis j) (basis k) =
              if j = k then 1 else 0) /\
          !x.
            x =
              ITSET
                (\k acc. add (smul (inner x (basis k)) (basis k)) acc)
                (count d) zero``);

val q966837_norm_topology_def = new_definition (
  "q966837_norm_topology_def",
  ``q966837_norm_topology
      (top : 'v topology)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (norm : 'v -> real) <=>
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      !u. open_in top u <=>
        !x. x IN u ==>
          ?epsilon : real.
            0 < epsilon /\
            !y. norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN u``);

val q966837_borel_space_def = new_definition (
  "q966837_borel_space_def",
  ``q966837_borel_space
      (top : 'v topology) (a : 'v algebra) <=>
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      a = general_borel top``);

val q966837_ae_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q966837_ae_measurable_def",
  ``q966837_ae_measurable
      (m : 'a m_space) (a : 'b algebra) (f : 'a -> 'b) <=>
      ?h.
        h IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) a /\
        almost_everywhere m (\x. f x = h x)``);

val q966837_measurable_rep_def = new_definition (
  "q966837_measurable_rep_def",
  ``q966837_measurable_rep
      (m : 'a m_space) (a : 'b algebra) (f : 'a -> 'b) =
      @h.
        h IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) a /\
        almost_everywhere m (\x. f x = h x)``);

val q966837_law_def = new_definition (
  "q966837_law_def",
  ``q966837_law
      (m : 'a m_space) (a : 'b algebra) (f : 'a -> 'b) =
      (space a,subsets a,distr m (q966837_measurable_rep m a f))``);

val q966837_real_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q966837_real_integral_def",
  ``q966837_real_integral
      (m : 'a m_space) (f : 'a -> real) =
      real (integral m (Normal o f))``);

val q966837_tendsto_real_def = new_definition (
  "q966837_tendsto_real_def",
  ``q966837_tendsto_real (u : num -> real) (ell : real) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !n : num.
            N <= n ==> abs (u n - ell) < epsilon``);

val q966837_weak_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q966837_weak_tendsto_def",
  ``q966837_weak_tendsto
      (top : 'b topology)
      (nu : num -> 'b m_space) (nu0 : 'b m_space) <=>
      !f : 'b -> real.
        f IN bounded_continuous top ==>
        q966837_tendsto_real
          (\n. q966837_real_integral (nu n) f)
          (q966837_real_integral nu0 f)``);

val q966837_tendsto_in_distribution_def = new_definition (
  "q966837_tendsto_in_distribution_def",
  ``q966837_tendsto_in_distribution
      (top : 'b topology) (a : 'b algebra)
      (m : 'w m_space) (m' : 'w2 m_space)
      (X : num -> 'w -> 'b) (X' : 'w2 -> 'b) <=>
      (!n. q966837_ae_measurable m a (X n)) /\
      q966837_ae_measurable m' a X' /\
      q966837_weak_tendsto top
        (\n. q966837_law m a (X n))
        (q966837_law m' a X')``);

val cramer_wold_theorem =
  ``!(top : 'v topology) (a : 'v algebra)
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (norm : 'v -> real)
      (P : 'w m_space) (P' : 'w2 m_space)
      (X : num -> 'w -> 'v) (X' : 'w2 -> 'v).
      q966837_finite_real_inner_product_space
        zero add neg smul inner norm /\
      q966837_norm_topology top add neg norm /\
      q966837_borel_space top a /\
      prob_space P /\
      m_space P = UNIV /\
      prob_space P' /\
      m_space P' = UNIV /\
      q966837_ae_measurable P' a X' /\
      (!n. q966837_ae_measurable P a (X n))
      ==>
      (q966837_tendsto_in_distribution top a P P' X X' <=>
       !t : 'v.
         q966837_tendsto_in_distribution euclidean borel P P'
           (\n w. inner (X n w) t)
           (\w. inner (X' w) t))``;

$(

  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q966837), "Cramér–Wold theorem":
  convergence in distribution of finite-dimensional real-inner-product-space
  valued random variables is equivalent to convergence in distribution of
  every scalar inner-product projection. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  V ranges over arbitrary SetMM real pre-Hilbert spaces of finite dimension,
  exactly the finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces in the Lean
  statement. Its measurable space is the Borel sigma-algebra generated by the
  norm topology. M and N are arbitrary probability measures, so their sample
  spaces and sigma-algebras remain unrelated and unrestricted.

  Q966837AEMeasurable says that a function agrees outside a measurable null
  set with a measurable function. Q966837Map is its pushforward probability
  law. Q966837Integral defines real expectations as limits of SetMM simple
  integrals along L1-approximating measurable finite-range functions.
  Q966837WeakTendsto uses convergence of these integrals against all bounded
  continuous real-valued functions, the bounded-continuous-test-function
  characterization of weak convergence. Q966837TendstoInDistribution combines
  the source's almost-everywhere measurability data with weak convergence of
  the pushforward laws along the nonnegative integers tending to infinity.

  Q966837Inner and Q966837InnerSequence are the scalar projections by an
  arbitrary vector t. The final assertion retains the source's explicit
  almost-everywhere measurability assumptions and states the bidirectional
  Cramer-Wold characterization. Every declaration before the final one is
  syntax or a faithful definition. The final $a is the single unproved corpus
  statement, and this root file has no $p declaration.
$)

$c Q966837AEMeasurable Q966837Map Q966837BoundedContinuous

title: Q966837_cramer_wold_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q966837,
:: "Cramér–Wold theorem": convergence in distribution of random variables in
:: an arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space is equivalent to
:: convergence in distribution of every scalar inner-product projection. This

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, TARSKI, ZFMISC_1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, CARD_1, ARYTM_1,

      PROB_1, PROB_4, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MEASURE6, MESFUNC1,
      MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, INTEGRA5, SUPINF_1, SUPINF_2, SETFAM_1,
      TOPS_1, TOPS_2, TOPGEN_4, MEMBERED, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2,
      RANDOM_3, FUNCOP_1, FRECHET, TOPMETR;
