      FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, ORDINAL1,
      CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_3, XREAL_0,
      COMPLEX1, REAL_1, NAT_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, SEQ_1, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC, TOPS_1, TOPS_2, TOPGEN_4, RLVECT_1,
      RLVECT_5, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, NORMSP_2, BHSP_1, DUALSP04,
      PROB_1, PROB_2, PROB_4, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MEASURE6,
      EXTREAL1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6, SUPINF_2,
      RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3, TOPMETR;
 constructors ZFMISC_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, REAL_1, COMPLEX1,
      SEQ_1, SEQ_2, TOPS_1, TOPS_2, TOPGEN_4, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5,
      NORMSP_1, NORMSP_2, BHSP_1, DUALSP04, PROB_1, PROB_2, PROB_3,
      PROB_4, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MEASURE6, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2,
      MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6, EXTREAL1, SUPINF_1, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2,
      RANDOM_3, TOPMETR;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
      XXREAL_3, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0,
      RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, NORMSP_2, PRE_TOPC,
      TOPS_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, PROB_1, PROB_4, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2,
      RANDOM_3, FUNCOP_1, TOPMETR;
 requirements NUMERALS, BOOLE, SUBSET, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0,
      NORMSP_1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1,
      NORMSP_0, DUALSP04, PROB_1, PROB_4;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2, RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1,
      DUALSP04;

begin

definition
  let E be non empty TopSpace;
  let SigmaE be SigmaField of the carrier of E;
  let Omega,Omega1 be non empty set;
  let Sigma be SigmaField of Omega;
  let Sigma1 be SigmaField of Omega1;
  let P be Probability of Sigma;
  let P1 be Probability of Sigma1;
  let X be Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,the carrier of E);
  let X1 be Function of Omega1,the carrier of E;
  pred X,P,E,SigmaE is_convergent_to X1,P1 means
    ex XM being Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,the carrier of E),
       X1M being random_variable of Sigma1,SigmaE,
       N1 being Element of Sigma1
    st
      P1.N1 = 0 &
      (for w being Element of Omega1 st not w in N1 holds
        X1.w = X1M.w) &
      (for n being Nat holds
        ex XMn being random_variable of Sigma,SigmaE,
           Nn being Element of Sigma
        st
          XMn = XM.n &
          P.Nn = 0 &
          for w being Element of Omega st not w in Nn holds
            X.n.w = XMn.w) &
      for u being Function of E,R^1
        st
          (for U being Subset of R^1 st U in the topology of R^1 holds
            u"U in the topology of E) &
          (ex C being Real st
            for x being Point of E holds |.u.x.| <= C)
        holds
          ex uR being Function of the carrier of E,REAL,
             a being Real_Sequence,
             b being Real
          st
            uR = u &
            (for n being Nat holds
              ex XMn being random_variable of Sigma,SigmaE
              st
                XMn = XM.n &
                a.n = Integral(P2M(probability(XMn,P)),uR)) &
            b = Integral(P2M(probability(X1M,P1)),uR) &
            for e being Real st 0 < e holds
              ex N being Nat st
                for n being Nat st N <= n holds |.a.n-b.| < e;
end;

definition
  let Omega,Omega1 be non empty set;
  let Sigma be SigmaField of Omega;
  let Sigma1 be SigmaField of Omega1;
  let P be Probability of Sigma;
  let P1 be Probability of Sigma1;
  let Y be Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,REAL);
  let Y1 be Function of Omega1,REAL;
  pred Y,P is_convergent_to Y1,P1 means
    ex YM being Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,REAL),
       Y1M being random_variable of Sigma1,Borel_Sets,
       N1 being Element of Sigma1
    st
      P1.N1 = 0 &
      (for w being Element of Omega1 st not w in N1 holds
        Y1.w = Y1M.w) &
      (for n being Nat holds
        ex YMn being random_variable of Sigma,Borel_Sets,
           Nn being Element of Sigma
        st
          YMn = YM.n &
          P.Nn = 0 &
          for w being Element of Omega st not w in Nn holds
            Y.n.w = YMn.w) &
      for g being Function of REAL,REAL
        st
          (for x,e being Real st 0 < e holds
            ex d being Real st 0 < d &
              for y being Real st |.y-x.| < d holds
                |.g.y-g.x.| < e) &
          (ex C being Real st
            for x being Real holds |.g.x.| <= C)
        holds
          ex a being Real_Sequence,
             b being Real
          st
            (for n being Nat holds
              ex YMn being random_variable of Sigma,Borel_Sets
              st
                YMn = YM.n &
                a.n = Integral(P2M(probability(YMn,P)),g)) &
            b = Integral(P2M(probability(Y1M,P1)),g) &
            for e being Real st 0 < e holds
              ex N being Nat st
                for n being Nat st N <= n holds |.a.n-b.| < e;
end;

::$P-
theorem
  for V being RealUnitarySpace,
      E being non empty TopSpace,
      S being SigmaField of the carrier of E,
      Omega,Omega1 being non empty set,
      Sigma being SigmaField of Omega,
      Sigma1 being SigmaField of Omega1,
      P being Probability of Sigma,
      P1 being Probability of Sigma1,
      X being Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,the carrier of E),
      X1 being Function of Omega1,the carrier of E
  st
    E = TopSpaceNorm RUSp2RNSp V &
    S = BorelSets E &
    V is finite-dimensional &
    (ex X1M being random_variable of Sigma1,S,
        N1 being Element of Sigma1
      st
        P1.N1 = 0 &
        for w being Element of Omega1 st not w in N1 holds
          X1.w = X1M.w) &
    (for n being Nat holds
      ex XMn being random_variable of Sigma,S,
         Nn being Element of Sigma
      st
        P.Nn = 0 &
        for w being Element of Omega st not w in Nn holds
          X.n.w = XMn.w)
  holds
    (X,P,E,S is_convergent_to X1,P1
      iff
      for t being Point of V holds
        ex Y being Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,REAL),
           Y1 being Function of Omega1,REAL
        st
          (for n being Nat, w being Element of Omega holds
            Y.n.w = (the scalar of V).[X.n.w,t]) &
          (for w being Element of Omega1 holds
            Y1.w = (the scalar of V).[X1.w,t]) &
          Y,P is_convergent_to Y1,P1)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q966837_cramer_wold_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q966837,
% "Cramér–Wold theorem": convergence in distribution of finite-dimensional
% real inner-product-space-valued random variables is equivalent to convergence
% in distribution of every scalar inner-product projection. This file contains no proof.

Q966837_cramer_wold_theorem[
  E: TYPE+,
  Source: TYPE+,
  LimitSource: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [real, E -> E],
  innerE: [E, E -> real],
  normE: [E -> real],
  source_sigma: [[Source -> bool] -> bool],
  limit_sigma: [[LimitSource -> bool] -> bool],
  source_measure: [[Source -> bool] -> real],
  limit_measure: [[LimitSource -> bool] -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  source_event: TYPE = [Source -> bool]
  source_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> source_event]
  limit_event: TYPE = [LimitSource -> bool]
  limit_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> limit_event]
  e_event: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  e_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> e_event]
  real_event: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_event]

  e_probability_measure: TYPE = [e_event -> real]
  e_probability_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> e_probability_measure]
  real_probability_measure: TYPE = [real_event -> real]
  real_probability_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_probability_measure]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  coefficient_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  vector_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  e_random_variable: TYPE = [Source -> E]
  e_random_variable_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> e_random_variable]
  limit_e_random_variable: TYPE = [LimitSource -> E]
  real_random_variable: TYPE = [Source -> real]
  limit_real_random_variable: TYPE = [LimitSource -> real]

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  finite_linear_combination(
      basis: vector_sequence,
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE E =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroE
    ELSE
      addE(
        finite_linear_combination(
          basis, coefficients, count - 1),
        smulE(coefficients(count - 1), basis(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_inner_product_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a * b, x) = smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a + b, x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(0, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: real):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        negE(x) = smulE(-1, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        innerE(x, y) = innerE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        innerE(addE(x, y), z) =
          innerE(x, z) + innerE(y, z))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
        innerE(smulE(a, x), y) =
          a * innerE(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= innerE(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        innerE(x, x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) * normE(x) = innerE(x, x))

  finite_dimensional: bool =
    EXISTS (dimension: nat), (basis: vector_sequence):
      FORALL (x: E):
        EXISTS (coefficients: coefficient_sequence):
          finite_linear_combination(
            basis, coefficients, dimension) = x

  source_full: source_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Source): TRUE

  source_empty: source_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Source): FALSE

  source_complement(A: source_event): source_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Source): NOT A(omega)

  source_countable_union(
      events: source_event_sequence): source_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Source):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  source_subset(A, B: source_event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: Source):
      A(omega) IMPLIES B(omega)

  source_pairwise_disjoint(
      events: source_event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: Source):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  limit_full: limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): TRUE

  limit_empty: limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): FALSE

  limit_complement(A: limit_event): limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): NOT A(omega)

  limit_countable_union(
      events: limit_event_sequence): limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  limit_subset(A, B: limit_event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: LimitSource):
      A(omega) IMPLIES B(omega)

  limit_pairwise_disjoint(
      events: limit_event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: LimitSource):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  e_full: e_event =
    LAMBDA (x: E): TRUE

  e_empty: e_event =
    LAMBDA (x: E): FALSE

  e_complement(A: e_event): e_event =
    LAMBDA (x: E): NOT A(x)

  e_countable_union(events: e_event_sequence): e_event =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(x)

  e_pairwise_disjoint(events: e_event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: E):
          NOT (events(left_index)(x)
            AND events(right_index)(x))

  real_full: real_event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): TRUE

  real_empty: real_event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): FALSE

  real_complement(A: real_event): real_event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): NOT A(x)

  real_countable_union(
      events: real_event_sequence): real_event =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(x)

  real_pairwise_disjoint(
      events: real_event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          NOT (events(left_index)(x)
            AND events(right_index)(x))

  e_open(A: e_event): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      A(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (epsilon_value: posreal):
          FORALL (y: E):
            normE(subE(y, x)) < epsilon_value IMPLIES A(y)

  real_open(A: real_event): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      A(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (epsilon_value: posreal):
          FORALL (y: real):
            abs(y - x) < epsilon_value IMPLIES A(y)

  is_source_sigma_algebra: bool =
    source_sigma(source_full)
      AND (FORALL (A: source_event):
        source_sigma(A) IMPLIES
          source_sigma(source_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: source_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          source_sigma(events(index)))
        IMPLIES
          source_sigma(source_countable_union(events)))

  is_limit_sigma_algebra: bool =
    limit_sigma(limit_full)
      AND (FORALL (A: limit_event):
        limit_sigma(A) IMPLIES
          limit_sigma(limit_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: limit_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          limit_sigma(events(index)))
        IMPLIES
          limit_sigma(limit_countable_union(events)))

  e_sigma_algebra(Sigma: [e_event -> bool]): bool =
    Sigma(e_full)
      AND (FORALL (A: e_event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(e_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: e_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
        IMPLIES Sigma(e_countable_union(events)))

  real_sigma_algebra(Sigma: [real_event -> bool]): bool =
    Sigma(real_full)
      AND (FORALL (A: real_event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(real_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: real_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
        IMPLIES Sigma(real_countable_union(events)))

  e_borel(A: e_event): bool =
    FORALL (Sigma: [e_event -> bool]):
      (e_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
        AND (FORALL (U: e_event):
          e_open(U) IMPLIES Sigma(U)))
      IMPLIES Sigma(A)

  real_borel(A: real_event): bool =
    FORALL (Sigma: [real_event -> bool]):
      (real_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
        AND (FORALL (U: real_event):
          real_open(U) IMPLIES Sigma(U)))
      IMPLIES Sigma(A)

  finite_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  source_probability_space: bool =
    is_source_sigma_algebra
      AND source_measure(source_empty) = 0
      AND source_measure(source_full) = 1
      AND (FORALL (A: source_event):
        source_sigma(A) IMPLIES 0 <= source_measure(A))
      AND (FORALL (events: source_event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            source_sigma(events(index)))
          AND source_pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              finite_sum(
                LAMBDA (index: nat):
                  source_measure(events(index)),
                count),
            source_measure(source_countable_union(events))))

  limit_probability_space: bool =
    is_limit_sigma_algebra
      AND limit_measure(limit_empty) = 0
      AND limit_measure(limit_full) = 1
      AND (FORALL (A: limit_event):
        limit_sigma(A) IMPLIES 0 <= limit_measure(A))
      AND (FORALL (events: limit_event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            limit_sigma(events(index)))
          AND limit_pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              finite_sum(
                LAMBDA (index: nat):
                  limit_measure(events(index)),
                count),
            limit_measure(limit_countable_union(events))))

  is_e_probability_measure(
      measure_value: e_probability_measure): bool =
    measure_value(e_empty) = 0
      AND measure_value(e_full) = 1
      AND (FORALL (A: e_event):
        e_borel(A) IMPLIES 0 <= measure_value(A))
      AND (FORALL (events: e_event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            e_borel(events(index)))
          AND e_pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              finite_sum(
                LAMBDA (index: nat):
                  measure_value(events(index)),
                count),
            measure_value(e_countable_union(events))))

  is_real_probability_measure(
      measure_value: real_probability_measure): bool =
    measure_value(real_empty) = 0
      AND measure_value(real_full) = 1
      AND (FORALL (A: real_event):
        real_borel(A) IMPLIES 0 <= measure_value(A))
      AND (FORALL (events: real_event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            real_borel(events(index)))
          AND real_pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              finite_sum(
                LAMBDA (index: nat):
                  measure_value(events(index)),
                count),
            measure_value(real_countable_union(events))))

  source_null(A: source_event): bool =
    EXISTS (N: source_event):
      source_sigma(N)
        AND source_measure(N) = 0
        AND source_subset(A, N)

  limit_null(A: limit_event): bool =
    EXISTS (N: limit_event):
      limit_sigma(N)
        AND limit_measure(N) = 0
        AND limit_subset(A, N)

  source_measurable_e(f: e_random_variable): bool =
    FORALL (A: e_event):
      e_borel(A) IMPLIES
        source_sigma(
          LAMBDA (omega: Source): A(f(omega)))

  limit_measurable_e(f: limit_e_random_variable): bool =
    FORALL (A: e_event):
      e_borel(A) IMPLIES
        limit_sigma(
          LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): A(f(omega)))

  source_measurable_real(f: real_random_variable): bool =
    FORALL (A: real_event):
      real_borel(A) IMPLIES
        source_sigma(
          LAMBDA (omega: Source): A(f(omega)))

  limit_measurable_real(
      f: limit_real_random_variable): bool =
    FORALL (A: real_event):
      real_borel(A) IMPLIES
        limit_sigma(
          LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): A(f(omega)))

  source_ae_equal_e(
      f, g: e_random_variable): bool =
    source_null(
      LAMBDA (omega: Source): f(omega) /= g(omega))

  limit_ae_equal_e(
      f, g: limit_e_random_variable): bool =
    limit_null(
      LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): f(omega) /= g(omega))

  source_ae_equal_real(
      f, g: real_random_variable): bool =
    source_null(
      LAMBDA (omega: Source): f(omega) /= g(omega))

  limit_ae_equal_real(
      f, g: limit_real_random_variable): bool =
    limit_null(
      LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): f(omega) /= g(omega))

  source_aemeasurable_e(f: e_random_variable): bool =
    EXISTS (g: e_random_variable):
      source_measurable_e(g) AND source_ae_equal_e(f, g)

  limit_aemeasurable_e(f: limit_e_random_variable): bool =
    EXISTS (g: limit_e_random_variable):
      limit_measurable_e(g) AND limit_ae_equal_e(f, g)

  source_aemeasurable_real(f: real_random_variable): bool =
    EXISTS (g: real_random_variable):
      source_measurable_real(g)
        AND source_ae_equal_real(f, g)

  limit_aemeasurable_real(
      f: limit_real_random_variable): bool =
    EXISTS (g: limit_real_random_variable):
      limit_measurable_real(g)
        AND limit_ae_equal_real(f, g)

  source_has_e_law(
      f: e_random_variable,
      distribution: e_probability_measure): bool =
    is_e_probability_measure(distribution)
      AND EXISTS (g: e_random_variable):
        source_measurable_e(g)
          AND source_ae_equal_e(f, g)
          AND (FORALL (A: e_event):
            e_borel(A) IMPLIES
              distribution(A) =
                source_measure(
                  LAMBDA (omega: Source): A(g(omega))))

  limit_has_e_law(
      f: limit_e_random_variable,
      distribution: e_probability_measure): bool =
    is_e_probability_measure(distribution)
      AND EXISTS (g: limit_e_random_variable):
        limit_measurable_e(g)
          AND limit_ae_equal_e(f, g)
          AND (FORALL (A: e_event):
            e_borel(A) IMPLIES
              distribution(A) =
                limit_measure(
                  LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): A(g(omega))))

  source_has_real_law(
      f: real_random_variable,
      distribution: real_probability_measure): bool =
    is_real_probability_measure(distribution)
      AND EXISTS (g: real_random_variable):
        source_measurable_real(g)
          AND source_ae_equal_real(f, g)
          AND (FORALL (A: real_event):
            real_borel(A) IMPLIES
              distribution(A) =
                source_measure(
                  LAMBDA (omega: Source): A(g(omega))))

  limit_has_real_law(
      f: limit_real_random_variable,
      distribution: real_probability_measure): bool =
    is_real_probability_measure(distribution)
      AND EXISTS (g: limit_real_random_variable):
        limit_measurable_real(g)
          AND limit_ae_equal_real(f, g)
          AND (FORALL (A: real_event):
            real_borel(A) IMPLIES
              distribution(A) =
                limit_measure(
                  LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): A(g(omega))))

  e_weakly_converges(
      laws: e_probability_sequence,
      limit_law: e_probability_measure): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      is_e_probability_measure(laws(index)))
      AND is_e_probability_measure(limit_law)
      AND (FORALL (U: e_event), (lower_bound: real):
        (e_open(U) AND lower_bound < limit_law(U))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
            FORALL (index: nat):
              cutoff <= index IMPLIES
                lower_bound < laws(index)(U))

  real_weakly_converges(
      laws: real_probability_sequence,
      limit_law: real_probability_measure): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      is_real_probability_measure(laws(index)))
      AND is_real_probability_measure(limit_law)
      AND (FORALL (U: real_event), (lower_bound: real):
        (real_open(U) AND lower_bound < limit_law(U))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
            FORALL (index: nat):
              cutoff <= index IMPLIES
                lower_bound < laws(index)(U))

  tendsto_in_distribution_e(
      X: e_random_variable_sequence,
      Xprime: limit_e_random_variable): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      source_aemeasurable_e(X(index)))
      AND limit_aemeasurable_e(Xprime)
      AND EXISTS
          (laws: e_probability_sequence),
          (limit_law: e_probability_measure):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          source_has_e_law(X(index), laws(index)))
          AND limit_has_e_law(Xprime, limit_law)
          AND e_weakly_converges(laws, limit_law)

  project_sequence(
      X: e_random_variable_sequence,
      t: E): [nat -> real_random_variable] =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      LAMBDA (omega: Source):
        innerE(X(index)(omega), t)

  project_limit(
      Xprime: limit_e_random_variable,
      t: E): limit_real_random_variable =
    LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource):
      innerE(Xprime(omega), t)

  tendsto_in_distribution_projection(
      X: e_random_variable_sequence,
      Xprime: limit_e_random_variable,
      t: E): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      source_aemeasurable_real(
        project_sequence(X, t)(index)))
      AND limit_aemeasurable_real(project_limit(Xprime, t))
      AND EXISTS
          (laws: real_probability_sequence),
          (limit_law: real_probability_measure):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          source_has_real_law(
            project_sequence(X, t)(index),
            laws(index)))
          AND limit_has_real_law(
            project_limit(Xprime, t),
            limit_law)
          AND real_weakly_converges(laws, limit_law)

  cramer_wold_theorem: bool =
    (real_inner_product_space
      AND finite_dimensional
      AND source_probability_space
      AND limit_probability_space)
    IMPLIES
      (FORALL
          (X: e_random_variable_sequence),
          (Xprime: limit_e_random_variable):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            source_aemeasurable_e(X(index)))
          AND limit_aemeasurable_e(Xprime))
        IMPLIES
          (tendsto_in_distribution_e(X, Xprime)
            IFF
              (FORALL (t: E):
                tendsto_in_distribution_projection(
                  X, Xprime, t))))
END Q966837_cramer_wold_theorem

-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q967972
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q967972), "Open mapping theorem (complex analysis)":
-- an analytic complex-valued function on a preconnected set is constant there or maps
-- every open subset of that set to an open set. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Analytic.Uniqueness
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Trigonometric

@[expose] public section

open Set

-- Restore the canonical complex normed-field instances omitted by the reduced module graph.
noncomputable local instance : NormedField ℂ where
  dist_eq _ _ := rfl
  norm_mul := Complex.norm_mul

noncomputable local instance : NontriviallyNormedField ℂ where
  non_trivial := ⟨2, Complex.norm_two.symm ▸ one_lt_two⟩

namespace Q967972

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
variable {U : Set E} {g : E → ℂ}

/-- The global open mapping dichotomy for an analytic complex-valued function on a
preconnected set. -/
theorem open_mapping_theorem_complex_analysis
    (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g U) (hU : IsPreconnected U) :
    (∃ w, ∀ z ∈ U, g z = w) ∨ ∀ s ⊆ U, IsOpen s → IsOpen (g '' s) := sorry

end Q967972

title: Q967972_open_mapping_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q967972
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q967972), "Open mapping theorem (complex
  analysis)": an analytic complex-valued function on a preconnected subset
  of a complex normed vector space is either constant there or maps every
  ambient-open set contained in that subset to an open subset of the complex
  plane.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q967972_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q967972_complex : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition q967972_czero : q967972_complex := (0, 0).
Definition q967972_cone : q967972_complex := (1, 0).

Definition q967972_cadd
    (z w : q967972_complex) : q967972_complex :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition q967972_cneg
    (z : q967972_complex) : q967972_complex :=
  (- fst z, - snd z).

Definition q967972_csub
    (z w : q967972_complex) : q967972_complex :=
  q967972_cadd z (q967972_cneg w).

Definition q967972_cmul
    (z w : q967972_complex) : q967972_complex :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Definition q967972_cmodulus
    (z : q967972_complex) : R :=
  sqrt (fst z * fst z + snd z * snd z).

Record q967972_normed_complex_vector_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q967972_zero : E;
  q967972_add : E -> E -> E;
  q967972_neg : E -> E;
  q967972_smul : q967972_complex -> E -> E;
  q967972_norm : E -> R;

  q967972_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q967972_add x (q967972_add y z) =
      q967972_add (q967972_add x y) z;
  q967972_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q967972_add x y = q967972_add y x;
  q967972_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q967972_add x q967972_zero = x;
  q967972_add_neg :
    forall x : E, q967972_add x (q967972_neg x) = q967972_zero;

  q967972_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q967972_smul q967972_cone x = x;
  q967972_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : q967972_complex) (x : E),
      q967972_smul (q967972_cmul a b) x =
      q967972_smul a (q967972_smul b x);
  q967972_add_smul :
    forall (a b : q967972_complex) (x : E),
      q967972_smul (q967972_cadd a b) x =
      q967972_add
        (q967972_smul a x) (q967972_smul b x);
  q967972_smul_add :
    forall (a : q967972_complex) (x y : E),
      q967972_smul a (q967972_add x y) =
      q967972_add
        (q967972_smul a x) (q967972_smul a y);
  q967972_zero_smul :
    forall x : E, q967972_smul q967972_czero x = q967972_zero;
  q967972_smul_zero :
    forall a : q967972_complex,
      q967972_smul a q967972_zero = q967972_zero;

  q967972_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q967972_norm x;
  q967972_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E, q967972_norm x = 0 <-> x = q967972_zero;
  q967972_norm_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q967972_norm (q967972_neg x) = q967972_norm x;
  q967972_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q967972_norm (q967972_add x y) <=
      q967972_norm x + q967972_norm y;
  q967972_norm_smul :
    forall (a : q967972_complex) (x : E),
      q967972_norm (q967972_smul a x) =
      q967972_cmodulus a * q967972_norm x
}.

Arguments q967972_zero {E} _.
Arguments q967972_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q967972_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q967972_smul {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q967972_norm {E} _ _.

Definition q967972_sub
    {E : Type}
    (V : q967972_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q967972_add V x (q967972_neg V y).

Record q967972_continuous_complex_linear_map
    {E : Type}
    (V : q967972_normed_complex_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q967972_linear_apply : E -> q967972_complex;
  q967972_linear_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q967972_linear_apply (q967972_add V x y) =
      q967972_cadd
        (q967972_linear_apply x) (q967972_linear_apply y);
  q967972_linear_smul :
    forall (a : q967972_complex) (x : E),
      q967972_linear_apply (q967972_smul V a x) =
      q967972_cmul a (q967972_linear_apply x);
  q967972_linear_bounded :
    exists bound : R,
      0 <= bound /\
      forall x : E,
        q967972_cmodulus (q967972_linear_apply x) <=
        bound * q967972_norm V x
}.

Arguments q967972_linear_apply {E V} _ _.

Definition q967972_has_frechet_derivative_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q967972_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : E -> q967972_complex)
    (x : E)
    (D : q967972_continuous_complex_linear_map V) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall h : E,
        q967972_norm V h < delta ->
        q967972_cmodulus
          (q967972_csub
            (q967972_csub
              (f (q967972_add V x h)) (f x))
            (q967972_linear_apply D h)) <=
        epsilon * q967972_norm V h.

Definition q967972_complex_differentiable_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q967972_normed_complex_vector_space E)
  (f : E -> q967972_complex)
  (x : E) : Prop :=
  exists D : q967972_continuous_complex_linear_map V,
    @q967972_has_frechet_derivative_at E V f x D.

Definition q967972_analytic_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q967972_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : E -> q967972_complex)
    (x : E) : Prop :=
  exists radius : R,
    0 < radius /\
    forall y : E,
      q967972_norm V (q967972_sub V y x) < radius ->
      q967972_complex_differentiable_at V f y.

Definition q967972_analytic_on_nhd
    {E : Type}
    (V : q967972_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : E -> q967972_complex)
    (U : q967972_set E) : Prop :=
  forall x : E, U x -> q967972_analytic_at V f x.

Definition q967972_open
    {E : Type}
    (V : q967972_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (S : q967972_set E) : Prop :=
  forall x : E,
    S x ->
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall y : E,
        q967972_norm V (q967972_sub V y x) < radius ->
        S y.

Definition q967972_complex_open
    (S : q967972_set q967972_complex) : Prop :=
  forall z : q967972_complex,
    S z ->
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall w : q967972_complex,
        q967972_cmodulus (q967972_csub w z) < radius ->
        S w.

Definition q967972_relatively_open
    {E : Type}
    (V : q967972_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (U S : q967972_set E) : Prop :=
  exists ambient : q967972_set E,
    q967972_open V ambient /\
    forall x : E, S x <-> U x /\ ambient x.

Definition q967972_is_preconnected
    {E : Type}
    (V : q967972_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (U : q967972_set E) : Prop :=
  forall left right : q967972_set E,
    q967972_relatively_open V U left ->
    q967972_relatively_open V U right ->
    (forall x : E, U x <-> left x \/ right x) ->
    (forall x : E, ~ (left x /\ right x)) ->
    (forall x : E, ~ left x) \/ (forall x : E, ~ right x).

Definition q967972_included
    {A : Type}
    (S T : q967972_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x -> T x.

Definition q967972_image
    {A B : Type}
    (f : A -> B)
    (S : q967972_set A) : q967972_set B :=
  fun y => exists x : A, S x /\ f x = y.

Theorem AnalyticOnNhd_is_constant_or_isOpen :
  forall (E : Type)
         (V : q967972_normed_complex_vector_space E)
         (U : q967972_set E)
         (g : E -> q967972_complex),
    q967972_analytic_on_nhd V g U ->
    q967972_is_preconnected V U ->
    (exists w : q967972_complex,
      forall z : E, U z -> g z = w) \/
    (forall s : q967972_set E,
      q967972_included s U ->
      q967972_open V s ->
      q967972_complex_open (q967972_image g s)).
Admitted.

title: Q967972_open_mapping_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q967972,
  "Open mapping theorem (complex analysis)": an analytic complex-valued
  function on a preconnected subset of an arbitrary complex normed vector
  space is either constant there or maps every open subset to an open set.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q967972_open_mapping_theorem_complex_analysis
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Complex_Analysis_Basics"
begin

definition q967972_complex_normed_vector ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q967972_complex_normed_vector cscale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. cscale a (x + y) = cscale a x + cscale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a + b) x = cscale a x + cscale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a * b) x = cscale a (cscale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. cscale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. cscale (of_real r) x = scaleR r x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. norm (cscale a x) = norm a * norm x)"

definition q967972_continuous_complex_multilinear ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e list \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q967972_continuous_complex_multilinear k cscale A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>xs i u v.
      length xs = k \<longrightarrow> i < k \<longrightarrow>
      A (xs[i := u + v]) = A (xs[i := u]) + A (xs[i := v])) \<and>
    (\<forall>xs i a u.
      length xs = k \<longrightarrow> i < k \<longrightarrow>
      A (xs[i := cscale a u]) = a * A (xs[i := u])) \<and>
    (\<exists>C\<ge>0. \<forall>xs. length xs = k \<longrightarrow>
      norm (A xs) \<le> C * (\<Prod>i<k. norm (xs ! i)))"

definition q967972_multilinear_operator_norm ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> ('e::real_normed_vector list \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q967972_multilinear_operator_norm k A =
    Inf {C. 0 \<le> C \<and> (\<forall>xs. length xs = k \<longrightarrow>
      norm (A xs) \<le> C * (\<Prod>i<k. norm (xs ! i)))}"

definition q967972_analytic_at ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q967972_analytic_at cscale g z0 \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>A r. 0 < r \<and>
      (\<forall>n. q967972_continuous_complex_multilinear n cscale (A n)) \<and>
      summable (\<lambda>n.
        q967972_multilinear_operator_norm n (A n) * r ^ n) \<and>
      (\<forall>z. dist z z0 < r \<longrightarrow>
        ((\<lambda>n. A n (replicate n (z - z0))) sums g z)))"

definition q967972_analytic_on_nhd ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> 'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q967972_analytic_on_nhd cscale g U \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>z \<in> U. q967972_analytic_at cscale g z)"

theorem q967972_open_mapping_theorem:
  fixes cscale :: "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and g :: "'e \<Rightarrow> complex"
    and U :: "'e set"
  assumes complex_space: "q967972_complex_normed_vector cscale"
    and analytic: "q967972_analytic_on_nhd cscale g U"
    and preconnected: "connected U"
  shows "(\<exists>w. \<forall>z \<in> U. g z = w) \<or>
    (\<forall>s. s \<subseteq> U \<longrightarrow> open s \<longrightarrow> open (g ` s))"
  sorry

end

title: Q967972_open_mapping_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q967972 (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q967972), "Open mapping theorem
  (complex analysis)": an analytic function from an arbitrary complex normed
  vector space to the complex numbers, on a preconnected set, is constant
  there or maps every open subset of that set to an open set. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q967972_OPEN_MAPPING_THEOREM_COMPLEX_ANALYSIS =
 `let czero = ((&0:real),(&0:real)) in
  let cone = ((&1:real),(&0:real)) in
  let cadd =
    \(a:real#real) (b:real#real).
      (FST a + FST b,SND a + SND b) in
  let cneg =
    \(a:real#real). (--(FST a),--(SND a)) in
  let csub =
    \(a:real#real) (b:real#real).
      cadd a (cneg b) in
  let cmul =
    \(a:real#real) (b:real#real).
      (FST a * FST b - SND a * SND b,
       FST a * SND b + SND a * FST b) in
  let cnorm =
    \(a:real#real).
      sqrt(FST a * FST a + SND a * SND a) in
  let normed_add_comm_group =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A)
     (normE:A->real).
      (!x y z:A.
         addE x (addE y z) = addE (addE x y) z) /\
      (!x y:A. addE x y = addE y x) /\
      (!x:A. addE zeroE x = x) /\
      (!x:A. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
      normE zeroE = &0 /\
      (!x:A. &0 <= normE x) /\
      (!x:A. normE x = &0 <=> x = zeroE) /\
      (!x:A. normE (negE x) = normE x) /\
      (!x y:A. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) in
  let complex_normed_space =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (smulE:(real#real)->A->A).
      (!x:A. smulE cone x = x) /\
      (!a b:real#real. !x:A.
         smulE (cmul a b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a b:real#real. !x:A.
         smulE (cadd a b) x =
         addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x y:A.
         smulE a (addE x y) =
         addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
      (!a:real#real. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!x:A. smulE czero x = zeroE) /\
      (!x:A. negE x = smulE (cneg cone) x) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x:A.
         normE (smulE a x) = cnorm a * normE x) in
  let subE =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A) (x:A) (y:A).
      addE x (negE y) in
  let continuous_complex_linear =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (smulE:(real#real)->A->A) (L:A->real#real).
      (!x y:A. L (addE x y) = cadd (L x) (L y)) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x:A.
         L (smulE a x) = cmul a (L x)) /\
      (?C:real.
         &0 <= C /\
         !x:A. cnorm (L x) <= C * normE x) in
  let complex_frechet_differentiable_at =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (smulE:(real#real)->A->A)
     (f:A->real#real) (x:A).
      ?L:A->real#real.
        continuous_complex_linear addE normE smulE L /\
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !h:A.
                  &0 < normE h /\ normE h < delta
                  ==> cnorm
                        (csub
                          (csub (f (addE x h)) (f x))
                          (L h))
                      < epsilon * normE h in
  let analytic_on_nhd =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (smulE:(real#real)->A->A)
     (f:A->real#real) (U:A->bool).
      !x:A.
        x IN U
        ==> ?radius:real.
              &0 < radius /\
              !y:A.
                normE (subE addE negE y x) < radius
                ==> complex_frechet_differentiable_at
                      addE normE smulE f y in
  let norm_open =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (s:A->bool).
      !x:A.
        x IN s
        ==> ?epsilon:real.
              &0 < epsilon /\
              !y:A.
                normE (subE addE negE y x) < epsilon
                ==> y IN s in
  let complex_open =
    \(s:(real#real)->bool).
      !z:real#real.
        z IN s
        ==> ?epsilon:real.
              &0 < epsilon /\
              !w:real#real.
                cnorm (csub w z) < epsilon
                ==> w IN s in
  let preconnected =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (U:A->bool).
      !s t:A->bool.
        norm_open addE negE normE s /\
        norm_open addE negE normE t /\
        U SUBSET (s UNION t) /\
        DISJOINT (U INTER s) (U INTER t)
        ==> U INTER s = {} \/ U INTER t = {} in
  !zeroE:A.
  !addE:A->A->A.
  !negE:A->A.
  !normE:A->real.
  !smulE:(real#real)->A->A.
  !f:A->real#real.
  !U:A->bool.
    normed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
    complex_normed_space zeroE addE negE normE smulE /\
    analytic_on_nhd addE negE normE smulE f U /\
    preconnected addE negE normE U
    ==> ((?w:real#real. !z:A. z IN U ==> f z = w) \/
         (!s:A->bool.
            s SUBSET U /\
            norm_open addE negE normE s
            ==> complex_open (IMAGE f s)))`;;

title: Q967972_open_mapping_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q967972,
;; "Open mapping theorem (complex analysis)": a complex-analytic function from
;; a normed complex vector space to the complex numbers, on a preconnected set,
;; is constant there or maps every open subset of that set to an open set.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Conservative interfaces present arbitrary carriers, operations, subsets,
;; functions, and continuous linear maps.  A Dedekind-complete ordered field
;; presents the real numbers, and explicit real/imaginary coordinates present
;; the usual complex field with its Euclidean norm.  All algebraic, normed
;; vector-space, topological, differentiability, and typing laws used by the
;; source statement are explicit below.

;; The real numbers.

(defstub q967972-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q967972-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q967972-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q967972-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q967972-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q967972-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q967972-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q967972-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q967972-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defun q967972-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q967972-r-less real right left)))

(defun q967972-r-positive-p (real value)
  (and
   (q967972-r-member-p real value)
   (q967972-r-less
    real (q967972-r-zero real) value)))

(defun-sk q967972-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-r-member-p real x)
      (q967972-r-member-p real y)
      (q967972-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q967972-r-zero real))
            (one (q967972-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q967972-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q967972-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q967972-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q967972-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q967972-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q967972-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q967972-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q967972-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q967972-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q967972-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q967972-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q967972-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q967972-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q967972-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q967972-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q967972-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q967972-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q967972-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q967972-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q967972-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q967972-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q967972-r-multiply
          real x (q967972-r-add real y z))
         (q967972-r-add
          real
          (q967972-r-multiply real x y)
          (q967972-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q967972-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-r-member-p real x)
      (q967972-r-member-p real y)
      (q967972-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q967972-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q967972-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q967972-r-less real x y)
         (q967972-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q967972-r-less real x y)
          (q967972-r-less real y z))
         (q967972-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q967972-r-less real x y)
         (q967972-r-less
          real
          (q967972-r-add real x z)
          (q967972-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q967972-r-less real zero x)
          (q967972-r-less real zero y))
         (q967972-r-less
          real zero
          (q967972-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q967972-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q967972-r-member-p real x)
     (q967972-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q967972-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-r-member-p real x)
      (q967972-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q967972-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q967972-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q967972-r-member-p real bound)
     (q967972-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q967972-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q967972-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q967972-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q967972-r-member-p real bound)
       (q967972-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q967972-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q967972-r-has-supremum-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q967972-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q967972-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q967972-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q967972-r-has-supremum-p real set))))

(defun q967972-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q967972-r-zero real))
        (one (q967972-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q967972-r-member-p real zero)
     (q967972-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q967972-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q967972-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q967972-r-less real zero one)
     (q967972-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; The complex numbers as an isometric real-coordinate field.

(defstub q967972-c-member-p (complex value) t)
(defstub q967972-c-zero (complex) t)
(defstub q967972-c-one (complex) t)
(defstub q967972-c-add (complex left right) t)
(defstub q967972-c-multiply (complex left right) t)
(defstub q967972-c-negate (complex value) t)

(defstub q967972-c-im (real complex value) t)
(defstub q967972-c-I (complex) t)

(defun q967972-c-subtract (complex left right)
  (q967972-c-add
   complex left (q967972-c-negate complex right)))

(defun-sk q967972-c-field-laws-p (complex)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-c-member-p complex x)
      (q967972-c-member-p complex y)
      (q967972-c-member-p complex z))
     (let* ((zero (q967972-c-zero complex))
            (one (q967972-c-one complex))
            (xy-add (q967972-c-add complex x y))
            (yz-add (q967972-c-add complex y z))
            (xy-mul (q967972-c-multiply complex x y))
            (yz-mul (q967972-c-multiply complex y z))
            (neg-x (q967972-c-negate complex x))
            (inv-x (q967972-c-inverse complex x)))
       (and
        (q967972-c-member-p complex xy-add)
        (q967972-c-member-p complex xy-mul)
        (q967972-c-member-p complex neg-x)
        (q967972-c-member-p complex inv-x)
        (equal
         (q967972-c-add complex xy-add z)
         (q967972-c-add complex x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q967972-c-add complex y x))
        (equal (q967972-c-add complex x zero) x)
        (equal (q967972-c-add complex x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q967972-c-multiply complex xy-mul z)
         (q967972-c-multiply complex x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q967972-c-multiply complex y x))
        (equal (q967972-c-multiply complex x one) x)
        (equal (q967972-c-inverse complex zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q967972-c-multiply complex x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q967972-c-multiply
          complex x (q967972-c-add complex y z))
         (q967972-c-add
          complex
          (q967972-c-multiply complex x y)
          (q967972-c-multiply complex x z))))))))

(defun-sk q967972-c-norm-laws-p (real complex)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-c-member-p complex x)
      (q967972-c-member-p complex y))
     (let ((zero-c (q967972-c-zero complex))
           (zero-r (q967972-r-zero real))
           (norm-x (q967972-c-norm real complex x))
           (norm-y (q967972-c-norm real complex y)))
       (and
        (q967972-r-member-p real norm-x)
        (q967972-r-member-p real norm-y)
        (q967972-r-leq real zero-r norm-x)
        (iff (equal norm-x zero-r)
             (equal x zero-c))
        (equal
         (q967972-c-norm
          real complex (q967972-c-negate complex x))
         norm-x)
        (q967972-r-leq
         real
         (q967972-c-norm
          real complex (q967972-c-add complex x y))
         (q967972-r-add real norm-x norm-y))
        (equal
         (q967972-c-norm
          real complex (q967972-c-multiply complex x y))
         (q967972-r-multiply real norm-x norm-y)))))))

(defun-sk q967972-c-coordinate-laws-p (real complex)
  (forall (a b z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-r-member-p real a)
      (q967972-r-member-p real b)
      (q967972-c-member-p complex z))
     (let* ((zero-r (q967972-r-zero real))
            (one-r (q967972-r-one real))
            (zero-c (q967972-c-zero complex))
            (one-c (q967972-c-one complex))
            (imaginary-unit (q967972-c-I complex))
            (of-a (q967972-c-of-real real complex a))
            (of-b (q967972-c-of-real real complex b))
            (re-z (q967972-c-re real complex z))
            (im-z (q967972-c-im real complex z))
            (norm-z (q967972-c-norm real complex z)))
       (and
        (q967972-c-member-p complex imaginary-unit)
        (q967972-c-member-p complex of-a)
        (q967972-r-member-p real re-z)
        (q967972-r-member-p real im-z)
        (equal
         (q967972-c-of-real real complex zero-r)
         zero-c)
        (equal
         (q967972-c-of-real real complex one-r)
         one-c)
        (equal
         (q967972-c-of-real
          real complex (q967972-r-add real a b))
         (q967972-c-add complex of-a of-b))
        (equal
         (q967972-c-of-real
          real complex (q967972-r-multiply real a b))
         (q967972-c-multiply complex of-a of-b))
        (equal
         (q967972-c-of-real
          real complex (q967972-r-negate real a))
         (q967972-c-negate complex of-a))
        (equal
         (q967972-c-re real complex of-a)
         a)
        (equal
         (q967972-c-im real complex of-a)
         zero-r)
        (equal
         (q967972-c-re real complex imaginary-unit)
         zero-r)
        (equal
         (q967972-c-im real complex imaginary-unit)
         one-r)
        (equal
         (q967972-c-multiply
          complex imaginary-unit imaginary-unit)
         (q967972-c-negate complex one-c))
        (equal
         z
         (q967972-c-add
          complex
          (q967972-c-of-real real complex re-z)
          (q967972-c-multiply
           complex
           (q967972-c-of-real real complex im-z)
           imaginary-unit)))
        (equal
         (q967972-r-multiply real norm-z norm-z)
         (q967972-r-add
          real
          (q967972-r-multiply real re-z re-z)
          (q967972-r-multiply real im-z im-z))))))))

(defun q967972-complex-field-p (real complex)
  (let ((zero (q967972-c-zero complex))
        (one (q967972-c-one complex)))
    (and
     (q967972-real-field-p real)
     (q967972-c-member-p complex zero)
     (q967972-c-member-p complex one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q967972-c-field-laws-p complex)
     (q967972-c-norm-laws-p real complex)
     (q967972-c-coordinate-laws-p real complex))))

;; An arbitrary normed vector space over the represented complex field.

(defstub q967972-e-member-p (space value) t)
(defstub q967972-e-zero (space) t)
(defstub q967972-e-add (space left right) t)
(defstub q967972-e-negate (space value) t)

(defun q967972-e-subtract (space left right)
  (q967972-e-add
   space left (q967972-e-negate space right)))

(defun-sk q967972-normed-space-laws-p
    (real complex space)
  (forall (x y z a b)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q967972-e-member-p space x)
       (q967972-e-member-p space y)
       (q967972-e-member-p space z))
      (let* ((zero-e (q967972-e-zero space))
             (zero-r (q967972-r-zero real))
             (xy-add (q967972-e-add space x y))
             (yz-add (q967972-e-add space y z))
             (neg-x (q967972-e-negate space x))
             (norm-x (q967972-e-norm real space x))
             (norm-y (q967972-e-norm real space y)))
        (and
         (q967972-e-member-p space xy-add)
         (q967972-e-member-p space neg-x)
         (q967972-r-member-p real norm-x)
         (q967972-r-member-p real norm-y)
         (equal
          (q967972-e-add space xy-add z)
          (q967972-e-add space x yz-add))
         (equal xy-add (q967972-e-add space y x))
         (equal (q967972-e-add space x zero-e) x)
         (equal (q967972-e-add space x neg-x) zero-e)
         (q967972-r-leq real zero-r norm-x)
         (iff (equal norm-x zero-r)
              (equal x zero-e))
         (equal
          (q967972-e-norm real space neg-x)
          norm-x)
         (q967972-r-leq
          real
          (q967972-e-norm real space xy-add)
          (q967972-r-add real norm-x norm-y)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q967972-c-member-p complex a)
       (q967972-c-member-p complex b)
       (q967972-e-member-p space x)
       (q967972-e-member-p space y))
      (let ((zero-c (q967972-c-zero complex))
            (one-c (q967972-c-one complex))
            (zero-e (q967972-e-zero space)))
        (and
         (q967972-e-member-p
          space (q967972-e-smul complex space a x))
         (equal
          (q967972-e-smul complex space one-c x)
          x)
         (equal
          (q967972-e-smul
           complex space
           (q967972-c-multiply complex a b) x)
          (q967972-e-smul
           complex space a
           (q967972-e-smul complex space b x)))
         (equal
          (q967972-e-smul
           complex space
           (q967972-c-add complex a b) x)
          (q967972-e-add
           space
           (q967972-e-smul complex space a x)
           (q967972-e-smul complex space b x)))
         (equal
          (q967972-e-smul
           complex space a
           (q967972-e-add space x y))
          (q967972-e-add
           space
           (q967972-e-smul complex space a x)
           (q967972-e-smul complex space a y)))
         (equal
          (q967972-e-smul complex space zero-c x)
          zero-e)
         (equal
          (q967972-e-smul complex space a zero-e)
          zero-e)
         (equal
          (q967972-e-norm
           real space
           (q967972-e-smul complex space a x))
          (q967972-r-multiply
           real
           (q967972-c-norm real complex a)
           (q967972-e-norm real space x)))))))))

(defun q967972-normed-complex-space-p
    (real complex space)
  (and
   (q967972-e-member-p
    space (q967972-e-zero space))
   (q967972-normed-space-laws-p
    real complex space)))

;; Arbitrary subsets, functions E -> C, and continuous C-linear maps E -> C.

(defstub q967972-set-member-p (set value) t)

(defun-sk q967972-valid-e-set-p (space set)

(defun-sk q967972-function-p
    (space complex function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q967972-e-member-p space x)

      complex
      (q967972-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q967972-linear-laws-p
    (complex space linear-map)
  (forall (a x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-c-member-p complex a)
      (q967972-e-member-p space x)
      (q967972-e-member-p space y))
     (and
      (q967972-c-member-p
       complex (q967972-linear-value linear-map x))

       (q967972-linear-value
        linear-map (q967972-e-add space x y))

        complex
        (q967972-linear-value linear-map x)
        (q967972-linear-value linear-map y)))

       (q967972-linear-value
        linear-map
        (q967972-e-smul complex space a x))

(defun-sk q967972-linear-bound-p
    (real complex space linear-map bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q967972-e-member-p space x)
     (q967972-r-leq
      real
      (q967972-c-norm
       real complex
       (q967972-linear-value linear-map x))
      (q967972-r-multiply
       real bound

(defun-sk q967972-linear-bound-exists-p
    (real complex space linear-map)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q967972-r-member-p real bound)
     (q967972-r-leq
      real (q967972-r-zero real) bound)
     (q967972-linear-bound-p
      real complex space linear-map bound))))

(defun q967972-continuous-linear-map-p
    (real complex space linear-map)
  (and
   (q967972-linear-laws-p
    complex space linear-map)
   (q967972-linear-bound-exists-p
    real complex space linear-map)))

;; Over a complex normed domain with complete codomain C, analyticity at a
;; point is equivalent to complex Frechet differentiability throughout some
;; neighborhood of that point.  The next predicates use this bidirectionally
;; equivalent characterization of AnalyticAt and AnalyticOnNhd.

(defun-sk q967972-derivative-nearby-p
    (real complex space function center linear-map epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-e-member-p space y)
      (q967972-r-less
       real
       (q967972-e-norm
        real space
        (q967972-e-subtract space y center))
       radius))
     (q967972-r-leq
      real
      (q967972-c-norm
       real complex
       (q967972-c-subtract
        complex
        (q967972-c-subtract
         complex
         (q967972-function-value function y)
         (q967972-function-value function center))
        (q967972-linear-value
         linear-map
         (q967972-e-subtract space y center))))
      (q967972-r-multiply
       real epsilon
       (q967972-e-norm
        real space
        (q967972-e-subtract space y center)))))))

(defun-sk q967972-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (real complex space function center linear-map epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q967972-r-positive-p real radius)
     (q967972-derivative-nearby-p
      real complex space function center
      linear-map epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q967972-has-derivative-at-p
    (real complex space function center linear-map)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q967972-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q967972-derivative-radius-exists-p
      real complex space function center
      linear-map epsilon))))

(defun-sk q967972-differentiable-at-p
    (real complex space function center)
  (exists (linear-map)
    (and
     (q967972-continuous-linear-map-p
      real complex space linear-map)
     (q967972-has-derivative-at-p
      real complex space function center linear-map))))

(defun-sk q967972-differentiable-on-ball-p
    (real complex space function center radius)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-e-member-p space point)
      (q967972-r-less
       real
       (q967972-e-norm
        real space
        (q967972-e-subtract space point center))
       radius))
     (q967972-differentiable-at-p
      real complex space function point))))

(defun-sk q967972-analytic-radius-exists-p
    (real complex space function center)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q967972-r-positive-p real radius)
     (q967972-differentiable-on-ball-p
      real complex space function center radius))))

(defun-sk q967972-analytic-on-neighborhood-p
    (real complex space function set)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (q967972-set-member-p set center)
     (q967972-analytic-radius-exists-p
      real complex space function center))))

;; Norm topologies and preconnectedness of U.

(defun-sk q967972-e-ball-contained-p
    (real space set center radius)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-e-member-p space point)
      (q967972-r-less
       real
       (q967972-e-norm
        real space
        (q967972-e-subtract space point center))
       radius))
     (q967972-set-member-p set point))))

(defun-sk q967972-e-open-radius-exists-p
    (real space set center)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q967972-r-positive-p real radius)
     (q967972-e-ball-contained-p
      real space set center radius))))

(defun-sk q967972-e-open-p (real space set)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (q967972-set-member-p set center)
     (q967972-e-open-radius-exists-p
      real space set center))))

(defun-sk q967972-cover-p (set left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q967972-set-member-p set x)
     (or
      (q967972-set-member-p left x)
      (q967972-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q967972-intersects-p (left right)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q967972-set-member-p left x)
     (q967972-set-member-p right x))))

(defun-sk q967972-triple-intersects-p
    (set left right)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q967972-set-member-p set x)
     (q967972-set-member-p left x)
     (q967972-set-member-p right x))))

(defun-sk q967972-preconnected-p
    (real space set)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-valid-e-set-p space left)
      (q967972-valid-e-set-p space right)
      (q967972-e-open-p real space left)
      (q967972-e-open-p real space right)
      (q967972-cover-p set left right)
      (q967972-intersects-p set left)
      (q967972-intersects-p set right))
     (q967972-triple-intersects-p
      set left right))))

;; The two alternatives in the source conclusion.

(defun-sk q967972-constant-on-p
    (set function value)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (q967972-set-member-p set z)
     (equal
      (q967972-function-value function z)
      value))))

(defun-sk q967972-constant-value-exists-p
    (complex set function)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (q967972-c-member-p complex value)
     (q967972-constant-on-p
      set function value))))

(defun-sk q967972-subset-p (left right)

    (implies

(defun-sk q967972-image-preimage-exists-p

  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q967972-e-member-p space x)
     (q967972-set-member-p set x)
     (equal
      (q967972-function-value function x)
      value))))

(defun-sk q967972-image-ball-covered-p
    (real complex space set function center radius)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-c-member-p complex value)
      (q967972-r-less
       real
       (q967972-c-norm
        real complex
        (q967972-c-subtract complex value center))
       radius))

(defun-sk q967972-image-open-radius-exists-p

(defun-sk q967972-image-open-p

  (forall (center)
    (implies

      (q967972-c-member-p complex center)

(defun-sk q967972-open-on-subsets-p

  (forall (subset)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-valid-e-set-p space subset)
      (q967972-subset-p subset set)
      (q967972-e-open-p real space subset))
     (q967972-image-open-p

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q967972-open-mapping-theorem-complex-analysis-statement
    ()
  (forall (real complex space set function)
    (implies
     (and
      (q967972-complex-field-p real complex)
      (q967972-normed-complex-space-p

      (q967972-valid-e-set-p space set)
      (q967972-function-p space complex function)

title: Q967972_open_mapping_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q967972
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q967972), "Open mapping theorem (complex
-- analysis)": a complex-valued function analytic on a preconnected subset of
-- a complex normed space is constant there or maps every open subset contained
-- in it to an open subset of the complex plane. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q967972OpenMappingTheoremComplexAnalysis where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Support.OpenMapping

open-mapping-theorem-complex-analysis : Set2
open-mapping-theorem-complex-analysis =
  (R E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (complexSpace :
    NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm (Complex R)) ->
  ComplexSpacePresentation reals complexNorm complexSpace ->
  (source : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (U : SetOf E) ->
  (function : E -> Complex R) ->
  AnalyticOnNeighborhood
    reals complexNorm source complexSpace function U ->
  Preconnected reals source U ->
  MixedEither
    (Exists (Complex R)
      (\ value ->
        (z : E) ->
        U z ->
        function z == value))
    ((S : SetOf E) ->
      Subset S U ->
      OpenInNormedSpace reals source S ->
      OpenInNormedSpace reals complexSpace (Image function S))

title: Q967972_open_mapping_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q967972 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q967972), "Open mapping theorem (complex
  analysis)": a complex-analytic function from a complex normed space to the
  complex numbers is either constant on a preconnected set or maps every open
  subset of that set to an open subset of the complex plane. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory complexTheory;

val q967972_normed_complex_space_def = new_definition (
  "q967972_normed_complex_space_def",
  ``q967972_normed_complex_space
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. addE (addE x y) z = addE x (addE y z)) /\
      (!x y. addE x y = addE y x) /\
      (!x. addE zeroE x = x) /\
      (!x. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
      (!x. smulE 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (a * b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (a + b) x = addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smulE a (addE x y) = addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
      (!x. smulE 0 x = zeroE) /\
      (!a. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!x. negE x = smulE (-1) x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= normE x) /\
      (!x. (normE x = 0) <=> (x = zeroE)) /\
      (!x. normE (negE x) = normE x) /\
      (!x y. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) /\
      (!a x. normE (smulE a x) = modu a * normE x)``);

val q967972_bounded_complex_linear_def = new_definition (
  "q967972_bounded_complex_linear_def",
  ``q967972_bounded_complex_linear
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (L : 'e -> complex) <=>
      (!x y. L (addE x y) = L x + L y) /\
      (!a x. L (smulE a x) = a * L x) /\
      ?C : real.
        0 <= C /\ !x. modu (L x) <= C * normE x``);

val q967972_complex_frechet_differentiable_at_def = new_definition (
  "q967972_complex_frechet_differentiable_at_def",
  ``q967972_complex_frechet_differentiable_at
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (g : 'e -> complex) (x : 'e) <=>
      ?L : 'e -> complex.
        q967972_bounded_complex_linear addE smulE normE L /\
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !h : 'e.
              0 < normE h /\ normE h < delta
              ==>
              modu (g (addE x h) - g x - L h) <
                epsilon * normE h``);

val q967972_analytic_on_nhd_def = new_definition (
  "q967972_analytic_on_nhd_def",
  ``q967972_analytic_on_nhd
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (g : 'e -> complex) (U : 'e -> bool) <=>
      !x : 'e.
        U x ==>
        ?radius : real.
          0 < radius /\
          !y : 'e.
            normE (addE y (negE x)) < radius
            ==>
            q967972_complex_frechet_differentiable_at
              addE smulE normE g y``);

val q967972_is_open_def = new_definition (
  "q967972_is_open_def",
  ``q967972_is_open
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (s : 'a -> bool) <=>
      !x : 'a.
        s x ==>
        ?radius : real.
          0 < radius /\
          !y : 'a.
            norm (add y (neg x)) < radius ==> s y``);

val q967972_preconnected_def = new_definition (
  "q967972_preconnected_def",
  ``q967972_preconnected
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (U : 'e -> bool) <=>
      !u v : 'e -> bool.
        q967972_is_open addE negE normE u /\
        q967972_is_open addE negE normE v /\
        (!x. U x ==> u x \/ v x) /\
        (?x. U x /\ u x) /\
        (?x. U x /\ v x)
        ==>
        ?x. U x /\ u x /\ v x``);

val AnalyticOnNhd_is_constant_or_isOpen =
  ``!(zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (U : 'e -> bool)
      (g : 'e -> complex).
      q967972_normed_complex_space zeroE addE negE smulE normE /\
      q967972_analytic_on_nhd addE negE smulE normE g U /\
      q967972_preconnected addE negE normE U
      ==>
      (?w : complex. !z : 'e. U z ==> g z = w) \/
      !s : 'e -> bool.
        (!z. s z ==> U z) /\
        q967972_is_open addE negE normE s
        ==>
        q967972_is_open
          (\z w. z + w) (\z. -z) modu
          (\w : complex. ?z : 'e. s z /\ g z = w)``;

title: Q967972_open_mapping_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q967972
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q967972), "Open mapping theorem (complex
  analysis)": a complex-valued function analytic on neighborhoods of a
  preconnected subset of an arbitrary complex normed vector space is either
  constant on that subset or maps every open subset of it to an open subset
  of the complex plane. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q967972Sub is subtraction in the domain normed vector space, and
  Q967972OpenBall is its norm-open ball. Q967972ContinuousLinear gives an
  algebraic complex-linear map together with a global operator bound.
  Q967972HasFDerivAt is the epsilon-delta Frechet remainder estimate.

  Q967972AnalyticOnNhd says that every point of U has a positive-radius
  neighborhood on which F is complex Frechet differentiable. For maps from
  an arbitrary complex normed vector space to the complete complex field,
  local complex Frechet differentiability is equivalent to the
  AnalyticOnNhd power-series formulation in the Lean source.

  Preconnectedness is rendered as connectedness of the subspace topology.
  The final $a assertion preserves the source alternative verbatim at the
  set-theoretic level: either one complex value is taken throughout U, or
  every ambient-open subset S of U has ambient-open image F " S. All $a
  declarations before the final assertion are syntax or explicit faithful
  definitions; the database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q967972Sub Q967972OpenBall Q967972ContinuousLinear
   Q967972HasFDerivAt Q967972AnalyticOnNhd $.

q967972-sub-syntax $a class ( Q967972Sub V x y ) $.
q967972-open-ball-syntax $a class ( Q967972OpenBall V x r ) $.
q967972-continuous-linear-syntax
  $a wff ( Q967972ContinuousLinear V L ) $.
q967972-has-fderiv-at-syntax
  $a wff ( Q967972HasFDerivAt V F x L ) $.
q967972-analytic-on-nhd-syntax
  $a wff ( Q967972AnalyticOnNhd V F U ) $.

${
  $d V x y $.

  q967972-sub-definition $a |- (
    Q967972Sub V x y
  ) = (
    x
    ( +g ` V )
    ( ( -g ` V ) ` y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d V r x y $.

  q967972-open-ball-definition $a |- (
    Q967972OpenBall V x r
  ) = {
    y e. ( Base ` V ) |
      (
        ( ( norm ` V ) ` ( Q967972Sub V y x ) )
        <
        r
      )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d C L V u $.

  q967972-continuous-linear-definition $a |- (
    ( Q967972ContinuousLinear V L )
    <->
    (
      L e. ( V LMHom ( ringLMod ` CCfld ) )
      /\
      E. C e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
        A. u e. ( Base ` V )
          (
            ( abs ` ( L ` u ) )
            <_
            (
              C
              x.
              ( ( norm ` V ) ` u )
            )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F L V d e x y $.

  q967972-has-fderiv-at-definition $a |- (
    ( Q967972HasFDerivAt V F x L )
    <->
    A. e e. RR+
      E. d e. RR+
        A. y e. ( Base ` V )
          (
            (
              ( ( norm ` V ) ` ( Q967972Sub V y x ) )
              <
              d
            )
            ->
            (
              (
                abs
                `
                (
                  (
                    ( F ` y )
                    -
                    ( F ` x )
                  )
                  -
                  ( L ` ( Q967972Sub V y x ) )
                )
              )
              <_
              (
                e
                x.
                ( ( norm ` V ) ` ( Q967972Sub V y x ) )
              )
            )
          )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F L U V r x y $.

  q967972-analytic-on-nhd-definition $a |- (
    ( Q967972AnalyticOnNhd V F U )
    <->
    A. x e. U
      E. r e. RR+
        A. y e. ( Q967972OpenBall V x r )
          E. L
            (
              ( Q967972ContinuousLinear V L )
              /\
              ( Q967972HasFDerivAt V F y L )
            )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F S U V v w z $.

  thousand-theorems-q967972-open-mapping-theorem $a |-
    A. V e. { v e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` v ) = CCfld }
      A. F e. ( CC ^m ( Base ` V ) )
        A. U e. ~P ( Base ` V )
          (
            (
              ( Q967972AnalyticOnNhd V F U )
              /\
              ( ( TopOpen ` V ) |`t U ) e. Conn
            )
            ->
            (
              E. w e. CC
                A. z e. U
                  ( F ` z ) = w
              \/
              A. S e. ~P ( Base ` V )
                (
                  S C_ U
                  ->
                  (
                    S e. ( TopOpen ` V )
                    ->
                    ( F " S ) e. ( TopOpen ` CCfld )
                  )
                )
            )
          )
  $.
$}

content:

environ

      CSSPACE3, SEQ_4, RELSET_1, BINOP_2, SEQ_2, COMSEQ_2, FUNCT_3,
      SEQ_1, CLOPBAN1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS,
      XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, MEMBERED, STRUCT_0, MONOID_0, CLVECT_1,
      CSSPACE3, VALUED_1, VALUED_0, SEQ_4, FUNCT_1, NAT_1, SEQ_1, SEQ_2,

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for E being ComplexNormSpace,
      U being Subset of E,
      g being Function of the carrier of E,COMPLEX st
    (for x being Point of E st x in U holds
      ex radius being Real st
        0 < radius &
        for z being Point of E st ||.z-x.|| < radius holds
          ex L being Function of the carrier of E,COMPLEX st
            (for u,v being Point of E holds
              L.(u+v) = L.u + L.v) &
            (for a being Complex, u being Point of E holds
              L.(a*u) = a*L.u) &
            (ex C being Real st
              0 <= C &
              for u being Point of E holds
                |.L.u.| <= C*||.u.||) &
            for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
              ex delta being Real st
                0 < delta &
                for h being Point of E st
                  h <> 0.E & ||.h.|| < delta
                holds
                  |.g.(z+h) - g.z - L.h.| < epsilon*||.h.||) &
    not ex A,B being Subset of E st
      A c= U & B c= U & U = A \/ B & A misses B &
      A <> {} & B <> {} &
      (for x being Point of E st x in A holds
        ex radius being Real st
          0 < radius &
          for y being Point of E st
            y in U & ||.y-x.|| < radius
          holds
            y in A) &
      (for x being Point of E st x in B holds
        ex radius being Real st
          0 < radius &
          for y being Point of E st
            y in U & ||.y-x.|| < radius

            y in s)
    holds
