title: Q967972_open_mapping_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q967972,
% "Open mapping theorem (complex analysis)": a complex-analytic function on a
% preconnected subset of a complex normed vector space is constant there or
% maps every open subset of its domain to an open subset of the complex plane.
% This file contains no proof.

Q967972_open_mapping_theorem_complex_analysis[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  cscaleE: [real, real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  e_set: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  complex_set: TYPE = [complex -> bool]
  function_type: TYPE = [E -> complex]
  linear_candidate: TYPE = [E -> complex]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(a, b: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(a) + real_part(b),
       imag_part := imag_part(a) + imag_part(b) #)

  complex_neg(a: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(a),
       imag_part := -imag_part(a) #)

  complex_sub(a, b: complex): complex =
    complex_add(a, complex_neg(b))

  complex_mul(a, b: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(a) * real_part(b)
                       - imag_part(a) * imag_part(b),
       imag_part := real_part(a) * imag_part(b)
                       + imag_part(a) * real_part(b) #)

  complex_norm_squared(a: complex): real =
    real_part(a) * real_part(a)
      + imag_part(a) * imag_part(a)

  smulE(a: complex, x: E): E =
    cscaleE(real_part(a), imag_part(a), x)

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  distanceE_squared(x, y: E): real =
    normE(subE(x, y)) * normE(subE(x, y))

  distanceC_squared(x, y: complex): real =
    complex_norm_squared(complex_sub(x, y))

  normed_complex_vector_space_E: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND normE(zeroE) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        (normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        smulE(complex_add(a, b), x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        smulE(complex_mul(a, b), x) =
          smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(complex_one, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(complex_zero, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) * normE(smulE(a, x)) =
          complex_norm_squared(a) * normE(x) * normE(x))

  subsetE(A, B: e_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  is_open_E(A: e_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      A(x)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (radius: real):
            0 < radius
              AND FORALL (y: E):
                distanceE_squared(y, x) < radius * radius
                  IMPLIES A(y)

  is_open_C(A: complex_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: complex):
      A(x)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (radius: real):
            0 < radius
              AND FORALL (y: complex):
                distanceC_squared(y, x) < radius * radius
                  IMPLIES A(y)

  is_preconnected(U: e_set): bool =
    FORALL (A, B: e_set):
      (is_open_E(A)
        AND is_open_E(B)
        AND (FORALL (x: E):
          U(x) IMPLIES (A(x) OR B(x)))
        AND (EXISTS (x: E):
          U(x) AND A(x))
        AND (EXISTS (y: E):
          U(y) AND B(y)))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (z: E):
          U(z) AND A(z) AND B(z)

  bounded_complex_linear_map(L: linear_candidate): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      L(addE(x, y)) = complex_add(L(x), L(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x: E):
        L(smulE(a, x)) =
          complex_mul(a, L(x)))
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        0 <= bound
          AND FORALL (x: E):
            complex_norm_squared(L(x))
              <= bound * bound * normE(x) * normE(x)

  has_complex_frechet_derivative_at(
      f: function_type,
      derivative: linear_candidate,
      point: E): bool =
    bounded_complex_linear_map(derivative)
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (increment: E):
            normE(increment) < radius
              IMPLIES
                complex_norm_squared(
                  complex_sub(
                    complex_sub(
                      f(addE(point, increment)),
                      f(point)),
                    derivative(increment)))
                  <= epsilon_value * epsilon_value
                       * normE(increment) * normE(increment)

  complex_differentiable_at(
      f: function_type,
      point: E): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: linear_candidate):
      has_complex_frechet_derivative_at(
        f,
        derivative,
        point)

  analytic_on_neighborhood(
      f: function_type,
      U: e_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      U(x)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (radius: real):
            0 < radius
              AND FORALL (y: E):
                distanceE_squared(y, x) < radius * radius
                  IMPLIES complex_differentiable_at(f, y)

  image_on(f: function_type, A: e_set): complex_set =
    LAMBDA (w: complex):
      EXISTS (x: E):
        A(x) AND f(x) = w

  constant_on(f: function_type, U: e_set): bool =
    EXISTS (w: complex):
      FORALL (x: E):
        U(x) IMPLIES f(x) = w

  open_on_subsets(f: function_type, U: e_set): bool =
    FORALL (A: e_set):
      (subsetE(A, U) AND is_open_E(A))
        IMPLIES is_open_C(image_on(f, A))

  open_mapping_theorem: bool =
    normed_complex_vector_space_E
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (f: function_type), (U: e_set):
          (analytic_on_neighborhood(f, U)
            AND is_preconnected(U))
          IMPLIES
            (constant_on(f, U)
              OR open_on_subsets(f, U))
END Q967972_open_mapping_theorem_complex_analysis

title: Q976607_erd_s_szekeres_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q976607
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q976607), "Erdős–Szekeres theorem": a sufficiently
-- long finite sequence of distinct linearly ordered values has a long increasing
-- subsequence or a long decreasing subsequence. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Nat
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Max
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Powerset
public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Monotone
public import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Finset.Nat

@[expose] public section

open Function Finset

namespace Q976607

variable {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β]

/-- The Erdős–Szekeres increasing-or-decreasing subsequence theorem. -/
theorem erdos_szekeres {r s : ℕ} {f : α → β}
    (hn : r * s < Fintype.card α) (hf : Injective f) :
    (∃ t : Finset α, r < #t ∧ StrictMonoOn f t) ∨
      ∃ t : Finset α, s < #t ∧ StrictAntiOn f t := sorry

end Q976607

title: Q976607_erd_s_szekeres_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q976607
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q976607), "Erdős–Szekeres theorem": an injective
  map from a finite linearly ordered type into a linearly ordered type has,
  when the domain has more than r * s elements, a finite subset of size
  greater than r on which it is strictly increasing or one of size greater
  than s on which it is strictly decreasing. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q976607_linear_order (A : Type) : Type := {
  q976607_le : A -> A -> Prop;
  q976607_le_refl :
    forall x : A, q976607_le x x;
  q976607_le_trans :
    forall x y z : A,
      q976607_le x y ->
      q976607_le y z ->
      q976607_le x z;
  q976607_le_antisym :
    forall x y : A,
      q976607_le x y ->
      q976607_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q976607_le_total :
    forall x y : A,
      q976607_le x y \/ q976607_le y x;
  q976607_le_decidable :
    forall x y : A,
      {q976607_le x y} + {~ q976607_le x y}
}.

Arguments q976607_le {A} _ _ _.

Definition q976607_lt
    {A : Type} (O : q976607_linear_order A) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  q976607_le O x y /\ ~ q976607_le O y x.

Record q976607_finite_type (A : Type) : Type := {
  q976607_enumeration : list A;
  q976607_enumeration_nodup : NoDup q976607_enumeration;
  q976607_enumeration_complete :
    forall x : A, In x q976607_enumeration
}.

Arguments q976607_enumeration {A} _.

Record q976607_finset (A : Type) : Type := {
  q976607_elements : list A;
  q976607_elements_nodup : NoDup q976607_elements
}.

Arguments q976607_elements {A} _.

Definition q976607_mem
    {A : Type} (x : A) (t : q976607_finset A) : Prop :=
  In x (q976607_elements t).

Definition q976607_injective
    {A B : Type} (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall x y : A, f x = f y -> x = y.

Definition q976607_strict_mono_on
    {A B : Type}
    (OA : q976607_linear_order A)
    (OB : q976607_linear_order B)
    (f : A -> B)
    (t : q976607_finset A) : Prop :=
  forall x y : A,
    q976607_mem x t ->
    q976607_mem y t ->
    q976607_lt OA x y ->
    q976607_lt OB (f x) (f y).

Definition q976607_strict_anti_on
    {A B : Type}
    (OA : q976607_linear_order A)
    (OB : q976607_linear_order B)
    (f : A -> B)
    (t : q976607_finset A) : Prop :=
  forall x y : A,
    q976607_mem x t ->
    q976607_mem y t ->
    q976607_lt OA x y ->
    q976607_lt OB (f y) (f x).

Module Theorems100.

Theorem erdos_szekeres :
  forall (A B : Type)
         (OA : q976607_linear_order A)
         (OB : q976607_linear_order B)
         (FA : q976607_finite_type A)
         (r s : nat)
         (f : A -> B),
    (r * s < length (q976607_enumeration FA))%nat ->
    q976607_injective f ->
    (exists t : q976607_finset A,
      (r < length (q976607_elements t))%nat /\
      q976607_strict_mono_on OA OB f t) \/
    exists t : q976607_finset A,
      (s < length (q976607_elements t))%nat /\
      q976607_strict_anti_on OA OB f t.
Admitted.

End Theorems100.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q976607
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q976607), "Erdős–Szekeres theorem": an
  injective sequence indexed by a finite linear order with more than r * s
  entries has an increasing subsequence longer than r or a decreasing
  subsequence longer than s. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q976607_ERDOS_SZEKERES_THEOREM =
  `let strict_linear_order_A =
     \(lt:A->A->bool).
       (!x:A. ~(lt x x)) /\
       (!x y z:A. lt x y /\ lt y z ==> lt x z) /\
       (!x y:A. lt x y \/ x = y \/ lt y x) in
   let strict_linear_order_B =
     \(lt:B->B->bool).
       (!x:B. ~(lt x x)) /\
       (!x y z:B. lt x y /\ lt y z ==> lt x z) /\
       (!x y:B. lt x y \/ x = y \/ lt y x) in
   !r s:num.
   !ltA:A->A->bool.
   !ltB:B->B->bool.
   !f:A->B.
     FINITE (UNIV:A->bool) /\
     strict_linear_order_A ltA /\
     strict_linear_order_B ltB /\
     (!x y:A. f x = f y ==> x = y) /\
     r * s < CARD (UNIV:A->bool)
     ==>
     ((?t:A->bool.
         FINITE t /\
         r < CARD t /\
         (!x y:A.
            x IN t /\ y IN t /\ ltA x y
            ==> ltB (f x) (f y))) \/
      (?t:A->bool.
         FINITE t /\
         s < CARD t /\
         (!x y:A.
            x IN t /\ y IN t /\ ltA x y
            ==> ltB (f y) (f x))))`;;

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems artifact
;; thousand-theorems__acl2__Q976607, "Erdős–Szekeres theorem": an injective
;; map from a finite linearly ordered domain with more than r*s elements has
;; a strictly increasing subset longer than r or a strictly decreasing subset
;; longer than s. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Enumerating the finite domain in increasing order turns the injective map
;; into a duplicate-free list. LEXORDER is ACL2's total order on all ACL2
;; objects; an order-preserving rank encoding realizes every finite order
;; pattern in the map's range. Subsequence lists therefore correspond exactly
;; to the source theorem's finite subsets, listed in domain order.

(defun q976607-prepend-to-each (value sequences)
  (if (consp sequences)
      (cons (cons value (car sequences))
            (q976607-prepend-to-each value (cdr sequences)))
    nil))

(defun q976607-subsequences (sequence)
  (if (consp sequence)
      (let ((tail-subsequences
             (q976607-subsequences (cdr sequence))))
        (append
         tail-subsequences
         (q976607-prepend-to-each
          (car sequence)
          tail-subsequences)))
    (list nil)))

(defun q976607-strictly-increasing-p (sequence)
  (if (and (consp sequence)
           (consp (cdr sequence)))
      (and (lexorder (car sequence)
                     (cadr sequence))
           (not (equal (car sequence)
                       (cadr sequence)))
           (q976607-strictly-increasing-p (cdr sequence)))
    t))

(defun q976607-strictly-decreasing-p (sequence)
  (if (and (consp sequence)
           (consp (cdr sequence)))
      (and (lexorder (cadr sequence)
                     (car sequence))
           (not (equal (car sequence)
                       (cadr sequence)))
           (q976607-strictly-decreasing-p (cdr sequence)))
    t))

(defun q976607-has-long-increasing-p (sequences bound)
  (if (consp sequences)
      (or (and (< bound (len (car sequences)))
               (q976607-strictly-increasing-p (car sequences)))
          (q976607-has-long-increasing-p
           (cdr sequences)
           bound))
    nil))

(defun q976607-has-long-decreasing-p (sequences bound)
  (if (consp sequences)
      (or (and (< bound (len (car sequences)))
               (q976607-strictly-decreasing-p (car sequences)))
          (q976607-has-long-decreasing-p
           (cdr sequences)
           bound))
    nil))

(defun thousand-theorems-q976607-erdos-szekeres-statement
    (sequence r s)
  (implies
   (and (true-listp sequence)
        (no-duplicatesp-equal sequence)
        (natp r)
        (natp s)
        (< (* r s) (len sequence)))
   (let ((subsequences (q976607-subsequences sequence)))
     (or
      (q976607-has-long-increasing-p subsequences r)
      (q976607-has-long-decreasing-p subsequences s)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q976607_erd_s_szekeres_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q976607
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q976607), "Erdős–Szekeres theorem": an injective
-- sequence indexed by a finite linear order with more than r * s terms has a
-- finite increasing subsequence of size greater than r or a finite decreasing
-- subsequence of size greater than s. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q976607_erd_s_szekeres_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Injective :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set (a ⊔ b)
Injective {A = A} function =
  (x y : A) ->
  function x == function y ->
  x == y

record Finite
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size      : Nat
    enumerate : Fin size -> A
    complete  :
      (x : A) ->
      Exists (Fin size) (\ index -> enumerate index == x)
    distinct  : Injective enumerate

record LinearOrder
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    less-than : A -> A -> Set a
    irreflexive :
      (x : A) ->
      Not (less-than x x)
    transitive :
      (x y z : A) ->
      less-than x y ->
      less-than y z ->
      less-than x z
    trichotomy :
      (x y : A) ->
      less-than x y or
      (x == y or less-than y x)

record FiniteSubset
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size      : Nat
    enumerate : Fin size -> A
    distinct  : Injective enumerate

StrictMonoOn :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  LinearOrder B ->
  (A -> B) ->
  FiniteSubset A ->
  Set (a ⊔ b)
StrictMonoOn orderA orderB function subset =
  (left-index right-index : Fin (FiniteSubset.size subset)) ->
  LinearOrder.less-than orderA
    (FiniteSubset.enumerate subset left-index)
    (FiniteSubset.enumerate subset right-index) ->
  LinearOrder.less-than orderB
    (function (FiniteSubset.enumerate subset left-index))
    (function (FiniteSubset.enumerate subset right-index))

StrictAntiOn :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  LinearOrder B ->
  (A -> B) ->
  FiniteSubset A ->
  Set (a ⊔ b)
StrictAntiOn orderA orderB function subset =
  (left-index right-index : Fin (FiniteSubset.size subset)) ->
  LinearOrder.less-than orderA
    (FiniteSubset.enumerate subset left-index)
    (FiniteSubset.enumerate subset right-index) ->
  LinearOrder.less-than orderB
    (function (FiniteSubset.enumerate subset right-index))
    (function (FiniteSubset.enumerate subset left-index))

erdos-szekeres-theorem :
  {a b : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b))
erdos-szekeres-theorem {a} {b} =
  (A : Set a) ->
  (B : Set b) ->

title: Q976607_erd_s_szekeres_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q976607, "Erdős–Szekeres theorem": if the finite linearly ordered domain of
  an injective map into a linearly ordered type has cardinality greater than
  r*s, there is a strictly increasing finite subset of cardinality greater
  than r or a strictly decreasing one of cardinality greater than s. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val erdos_szekeres =
  ``let is_linear_order_a =
      \(le : 'a -> 'a -> bool).
        (!x. le x x) /\
        (!x y. le x y /\ le y x ==> x = y) /\
        (!x y z. le x y /\ le y z ==> le x z) /\
        (!x y. le x y \/ le y x)
    in
    let is_linear_order_b =
      \(le : 'b -> 'b -> bool).
        (!x. le x x) /\
        (!x y. le x y /\ le y x ==> x = y) /\
        (!x y z. le x y /\ le y z ==> le x z) /\
        (!x y. le x y \/ le y x)
    in
    let strict_mono_on =
      \(leA : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (leB : 'b -> 'b -> bool)
       (f : 'a -> 'b) (t : 'a set).
        !x y.
          x IN t /\ y IN t /\ leA x y /\ x <> y
          ==>
          leB (f x) (f y) /\ f x <> f y
    in
    let strict_anti_on =
      \(leA : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (leB : 'b -> 'b -> bool)
       (f : 'a -> 'b) (t : 'a set).
        !x y.
          x IN t /\ y IN t /\ leA x y /\ x <> y
          ==>
          leB (f y) (f x) /\ f x <> f y
    in
      !(leA : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (leB : 'b -> 'b -> bool)
        (r : num) (s : num) (f : 'a -> 'b).
        is_linear_order_a leA /\
        is_linear_order_b leB /\
        FINITE (UNIV : 'a set) /\
        INJ f UNIV UNIV /\
        r * s < CARD (UNIV : 'a set)
        ==>
        (?t : 'a set.
           FINITE t /\
           r < CARD t /\
           strict_mono_on leA leB f t) \/
        (?t : 'a set.
           FINITE t /\
           s < CARD t /\
           strict_anti_on leA leB f t)``;

title: Q976607_erd_s_szekeres_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q976607,
% "Erdős–Szekeres theorem": an injective map from a finite linearly ordered
% type into a linearly ordered type has a sufficiently large strictly increasing
% or strictly decreasing subset. This file contains no proof.

Q976607_erdos_szekeres_theorem[
  Index: TYPE,
  Value: TYPE,
  index_lt: [Index, Index -> bool],
  value_lt: [Value, Value -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[Index]

  index_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: Index): NOT index_lt(x, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: Index):
      index_lt(x, y) AND index_lt(y, z) IMPLIES index_lt(x, z))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: Index):
      x /= y IMPLIES index_lt(x, y) OR index_lt(y, x))

  value_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: Value): NOT value_lt(x, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: Value):
      value_lt(x, y) AND value_lt(y, z) IMPLIES value_lt(x, z))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: Value):
      x /= y IMPLIES value_lt(x, y) OR value_lt(y, x))

  subset_of(left, right: finite_set[Index]): bool =
    FORALL (x: Index):
      member(x, left) IMPLIES member(x, right)

  injective_on(
      f: [Index -> Value],
      carrier: finite_set[Index]): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: Index):
      member(x, carrier) AND member(y, carrier) AND f(x) = f(y)
        IMPLIES x = y

  strictly_increasing_on(
      f: [Index -> Value],
      subset: finite_set[Index]): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: Index):
      member(x, subset) AND member(y, subset) AND index_lt(x, y)
        IMPLIES value_lt(f(x), f(y))

  strictly_decreasing_on(
      f: [Index -> Value],
      subset: finite_set[Index]): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: Index):
      member(x, subset) AND member(y, subset) AND index_lt(x, y)
        IMPLIES value_lt(f(y), f(x))

  erdos_szekeres: bool =
    index_order_laws AND value_order_laws IMPLIES
      FORALL
        (carrier: finite_set[Index]),
        (r, s: nat),
        (f: [Index -> Value]):
          r * s < card(carrier) AND injective_on(f, carrier)
            IMPLIES
              (EXISTS (subset: finite_set[Index]):
                subset_of(subset, carrier)
                  AND r < card(subset)
                  AND strictly_increasing_on(f, subset))
              OR
              (EXISTS (subset: finite_set[Index]):
                subset_of(subset, carrier)
                  AND s < card(subset)
                  AND strictly_decreasing_on(f, subset))
END Q976607_erdos_szekeres_theorem

title: Q978688_gershgorin_circle_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q978688
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q978688), "Gershgorin circle theorem": every
  eigenvalue of a square matrix over a normed field lies in a closed ball
  centered at some diagonal entry, with radius the sum of the norms of the
  off-diagonal entries in that row. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q978688_normed_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q978688_zero : K;
  q978688_one : K;
  q978688_add : K -> K -> K;
  q978688_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q978688_neg : K -> K;
  q978688_inv : K -> K;
  q978688_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q978688_add x (q978688_add y z) =
      q978688_add (q978688_add x y) z;
  q978688_add_comm :
    forall x y : K, q978688_add x y = q978688_add y x;
  q978688_add_zero :
    forall x : K, q978688_add x q978688_zero = x;
  q978688_add_neg :
    forall x : K, q978688_add x (q978688_neg x) = q978688_zero;
  q978688_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q978688_mul x (q978688_mul y z) =
      q978688_mul (q978688_mul x y) z;
  q978688_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K, q978688_mul x y = q978688_mul y x;
  q978688_mul_one :
    forall x : K, q978688_mul x q978688_one = x;
  q978688_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q978688_mul x (q978688_add y z) =
      q978688_add (q978688_mul x y) (q978688_mul x z);
  q978688_zero_ne_one :
    q978688_zero <> q978688_one;
  q978688_inv_zero :
    q978688_inv q978688_zero = q978688_zero;
  q978688_mul_inv :
    forall x : K, x <> q978688_zero ->
      q978688_mul x (q978688_inv x) = q978688_one;
  q978688_norm : K -> R;
  q978688_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : K, Rle 0 (q978688_norm x);
  q978688_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : K,
      q978688_norm x = 0%R <-> x = q978688_zero;
  q978688_norm_neg :
    forall x : K,
      q978688_norm (q978688_neg x) = q978688_norm x;
  q978688_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : K,
      Rle (q978688_norm (q978688_add x y))
          (Rplus (q978688_norm x) (q978688_norm y));
  q978688_norm_mul :
    forall x y : K,
      q978688_norm (q978688_mul x y) =
      Rmult (q978688_norm x) (q978688_norm y)
}.

Arguments q978688_zero {K} _.
Arguments q978688_one {K} _.
Arguments q978688_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q978688_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q978688_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q978688_inv {K} _ _.
Arguments q978688_norm {K} _ _.

Record q978688_finite_type (I : Type) : Type := {
  q978688_enum : list I;
  q978688_enum_nodup : NoDup q978688_enum;
  q978688_enum_complete :
    forall i : I, In i q978688_enum;
  q978688_eq_dec :
    forall i j : I, {i = j} + {i <> j}
}.

Arguments q978688_enum {I} _.
Arguments q978688_eq_dec {I} _ _ _.

Definition q978688_matrix (I K : Type) : Type :=
  I -> I -> K.

Fixpoint q978688_sum_field_list {I K : Type}
    (field : q978688_normed_field K)
    (indices : list I)
    (f : I -> K) : K :=
  match indices with
  | nil => q978688_zero field
  | i :: rest =>
      q978688_add field
        (f i)
        (q978688_sum_field_list field rest f)
  end.

Definition q978688_mul_vec {I K : Type}
    (field : q978688_normed_field K)
    (finite : q978688_finite_type I)
    (A : q978688_matrix I K)
    (v : I -> K)
    (i : I) : K :=
  q978688_sum_field_list field (q978688_enum finite)
    (fun j => q978688_mul field (A i j) (v j)).

Definition q978688_has_eigenvalue {I K : Type}
    (field : q978688_normed_field K)
    (finite : q978688_finite_type I)
    (A : q978688_matrix I K)
    (mu : K) : Prop :=
  exists v : I -> K,
    (exists i : I, v i <> q978688_zero field) /\
    forall i : I,
      q978688_mul_vec field finite A v i =
      q978688_mul field mu (v i).

Fixpoint q978688_sum_off_diagonal {I K : Type}
    (field : q978688_normed_field K)
    (finite : q978688_finite_type I)
    (A : q978688_matrix I K)
    (row : I)
    (indices : list I) : R :=
  match indices with
  | nil => 0%R
  | j :: rest =>
      if q978688_eq_dec finite j row
      then q978688_sum_off_diagonal field finite A row rest
      else Rplus
        (q978688_norm field (A row j))
        (q978688_sum_off_diagonal field finite A row rest)
  end.

Definition q978688_row_radius {I K : Type}
    (field : q978688_normed_field K)
    (finite : q978688_finite_type I)
    (A : q978688_matrix I K)
    (row : I) : R :=
  q978688_sum_off_diagonal field finite A row
    (q978688_enum finite).

Definition q978688_in_closed_ball {K : Type}
    (field : q978688_normed_field K)
    (center point : K)
    (radius : R) : Prop :=
  Rle
    (q978688_norm field
      (q978688_add field point (q978688_neg field center)))
    radius.

Theorem eigenvalue_mem_ball :
  forall (K I : Type)
         (field : q978688_normed_field K)
         (finite : q978688_finite_type I)
         (A : q978688_matrix I K)
         (mu : K),
    q978688_has_eigenvalue field finite A mu ->
    exists k : I,
      q978688_in_closed_ball field (A k k) mu
        (q978688_row_radius field finite A k).
Admitted.

title: Q978688_gershgorin_circle_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q978688
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q978688), "Gershgorin circle theorem": every
  eigenvalue of a finite square matrix over an arbitrary normed field satisfies
  the closed-ball norm inequality centered at some diagonal entry, with radius
  the sum of the norms of the off-diagonal entries in that row. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q978688_gershgorin_circle_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

type_synonym ('a, 'i) q978688_matrix = "'i \<Rightarrow> 'i \<Rightarrow> 'a"

definition q978688_normed_field ::
    "('a::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q978688_normed_field knorm \<longleftrightarrow>
      knorm 0 = 0 \<and>
      (\<forall>a. 0 \<le> knorm a) \<and>
      (\<forall>a. knorm a = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> a = 0) \<and>
      (\<forall>a. knorm (-a) = knorm a) \<and>
      (\<forall>a b. knorm (a + b) \<le> knorm a + knorm b) \<and>
      (\<forall>a b. knorm (a * b) = knorm a * knorm b)"

definition q978688_has_eigenvalue ::
    "('a::field, 'i::finite) q978688_matrix \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q978688_has_eigenvalue A mu \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>v :: 'i \<Rightarrow> 'a.
        v \<noteq> (\<lambda>_. 0) \<and>
        (\<forall>i. (\<Sum>j\<in>UNIV. A i j * v j) = mu * v i))"

theorem eigenvalue_mem_ball:
  fixes knorm :: "'a::field \<Rightarrow> real"
    and A :: "('a, 'i::finite) q978688_matrix"
    and mu :: 'a
  assumes normed_field: "q978688_normed_field knorm"
    and eigenvalue: "q978688_has_eigenvalue A mu"
  shows "\<exists>k.
    knorm (mu - A k k) \<le> (\<Sum>j\<in>UNIV - {k}. knorm (A k j))"
  sorry

end

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q978688
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q978688), "Gershgorin circle theorem":
  every eigenvalue of a finite square matrix over an arbitrary normed field
  lies in a closed ball centered at a diagonal entry with radius the sum of
  the norms of the off-diagonal entries in that row. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let Q978688_GERSHGORIN_CIRCLE_THEOREM =
 `let is_normed_field =
    \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K)
     (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
     (negK:K->K) (invK:K->K) (normK:K->real).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:K. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:K. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:K. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:K. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:K. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:K. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:K. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a:K. mulK zeroK a = zeroK) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:K. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK a) a = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:K.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       normK zeroK = &0 /\
       normK oneK = &1 /\
       (!a:K. &0 <= normK a) /\
       (!a:K. normK a = &0 <=> a = zeroK) /\
       (!a:K. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\
       (!a b:K. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
       (!a b:K. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) in
  let has_eigenvalue =
    \(zeroK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
     (indices:I->bool) (A:I->I->K) (mu:K).
       ?v:I->K.
         (?i:I. i IN indices /\ ~(v i = zeroK)) /\
         (!i:I.
            i IN indices
            ==> iterate addK indices (\j:I. mulK (A i j) (v j)) =
                mulK mu (v i)) in
  !zeroK oneK:K.
  !addK mulK:K->K->K.
  !negK invK:K->K.
  !normK:K->real.
  !indices:I->bool.
  !A:I->I->K.
  !mu:K.
    is_normed_field zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
    FINITE indices /\
    has_eigenvalue zeroK addK mulK indices A mu
    ==> ?k:I.
          k IN indices /\
          normK (addK mu (negK (A k k))) <=
          sum (indices DELETE k) (\j:I. normK (A k j))`;;

title: Q978688_gershgorin_circle_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q978688,
;; "Gershgorin circle theorem": every eigenvalue of a finite square matrix
;; over an arbitrary normed field lies in a closed ball centered at a diagonal
;; entry with radius the sum of the off-diagonal row norms.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative interfaces present arbitrary index carriers, field
;; carriers, field operations, and norm upper cuts. Q978688-NORM-LT(FIELD,X,Q)
;; means ||X|| < Q for the positive rational Q.

(defstub q978688-index-member-p (index-type index) t)
(defstub q978688-field-member-p (field value) t)
(defstub q978688-zero (field) t)
(defstub q978688-one (field) t)
(defstub q978688-add (field left right) t)
(defstub q978688-multiply (field left right) t)
(defstub q978688-negate (field value) t)
(defstub q978688-inverse (field value) t)
(defstub q978688-norm-lt (field value rational-bound) t)

(defun q978688-positive-rational-p (value)
  (and (rationalp value)
       (< 0 value)))

(defun q978688-subtract (field left right)
  (q978688-add
   field left (q978688-negate field right)))

;; An exhaustive duplicate-free list is a presentation, not a restriction, of
;; the arbitrary finite index type. Tables aligned with this list are
;; bijective representations of functions on that finite carrier.

(defun-sk q978688-index-exhaustive-p (index-type indices)
  (forall (index)
    (iff
     (q978688-index-member-p index-type index)
     (member-equal index indices))))

(defun q978688-finite-index-p (index-type indices)
  (and
   (true-listp indices)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal indices)
   (q978688-index-exhaustive-p index-type indices)))

;; Rounded, inhabited rational upper cuts represent finite nonnegative real
;; numbers exactly. The following auxiliary predicates keep all quantifiers
;; internal to the ACL2 statement.

(defun-sk q978688-norm-finite-p (field value)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q978688-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q978688-norm-lt field value bound))))

(defun-sk q978688-norm-rounded-p (field value bound)
  (exists (smaller)
    (and
     (q978688-positive-rational-p smaller)
     (rationalp bound)
     (< smaller bound)
     (q978688-norm-lt field value smaller))))

(defun-sk q978688-zero-cut-p (field value)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (q978688-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q978688-norm-lt field value bound))))

(defun-sk q978688-product-cut-p (field left right bound)
  (exists (left-bound right-bound)
    (and
     (q978688-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q978688-positive-rational-p left-bound)
     (q978688-positive-rational-p right-bound)
     (q978688-norm-lt field left left-bound)
     (q978688-norm-lt field right right-bound)
     (< (* left-bound right-bound) bound))))

;; Exact first-order presentation of a normed field. The cut equations state
;; definiteness, negation invariance, the triangle inequality, and
;; multiplicativity of the norm without replacing real values by rationals.

(defun-sk q978688-field-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q978688-field-member-p field x)
      (q978688-field-member-p field y)
      (q978688-field-member-p field z))
     (let* ((zero (q978688-zero field))
            (one (q978688-one field))
            (xy-add (q978688-add field x y))
            (yz-add (q978688-add field y z))
            (xy-mul (q978688-multiply field x y))
            (yz-mul (q978688-multiply field y z))
            (neg-x (q978688-negate field x))
            (inv-x (q978688-inverse field x)))
       (and
        (q978688-field-member-p field xy-add)
        (q978688-field-member-p field xy-mul)
        (q978688-field-member-p field neg-x)
        (q978688-field-member-p field inv-x)
        (equal
         (q978688-add field xy-add z)
         (q978688-add field x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q978688-add field y x))
        (equal (q978688-add field x zero) x)
        (equal (q978688-add field x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q978688-multiply field xy-mul z)
         (q978688-multiply field x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q978688-multiply field y x))
        (equal (q978688-multiply field x one) x)
        (equal
         (q978688-multiply field x yz-add)
         (q978688-add
          field
          (q978688-multiply field x y)
          (q978688-multiply field x z)))
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q978688-multiply field x inv-x)
          one)))))))

(defun-sk q978688-norm-cut-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x bound larger)
    (implies
     (q978688-field-member-p field x)
     (and
      (q978688-norm-finite-p field x)
      (implies
       (q978688-norm-lt field x bound)
       (q978688-positive-rational-p bound))
      (implies
       (and
        (q978688-norm-lt field x bound)
        (rationalp larger)
        (< bound larger))
       (q978688-norm-lt field x larger))
      (iff
       (q978688-norm-lt field x bound)
       (and
        (q978688-positive-rational-p bound)
        (q978688-norm-rounded-p field x bound)))))))

(defun-sk q978688-norm-zero-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q978688-field-member-p field x)
     (iff
      (equal x (q978688-zero field))
      (q978688-zero-cut-p field x)))))

(defun-sk q978688-norm-negation-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x bound)
    (implies
     (q978688-field-member-p field x)
     (iff
      (q978688-norm-lt
       field (q978688-negate field x) bound)
      (q978688-norm-lt field x bound)))))

(defun-sk q978688-norm-triangle-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x y left-bound right-bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q978688-field-member-p field x)
      (q978688-field-member-p field y)
      (q978688-positive-rational-p left-bound)
      (q978688-positive-rational-p right-bound)
      (q978688-norm-lt field x left-bound)
      (q978688-norm-lt field y right-bound))
     (q978688-norm-lt
      field
      (q978688-add field x y)
      (+ left-bound right-bound)))))

(defun-sk q978688-norm-product-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x y bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q978688-field-member-p field x)
      (q978688-field-member-p field y))
     (iff
      (q978688-norm-lt
       field (q978688-multiply field x y) bound)
      (and
       (q978688-positive-rational-p bound)
       (q978688-product-cut-p
        field x y bound))))))

(defun q978688-normed-field-p (field)
  (let ((zero (q978688-zero field))
        (one (q978688-one field)))
    (and
     (q978688-field-member-p field zero)
     (q978688-field-member-p field one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q978688-field-laws-p field)
     (q978688-norm-cut-laws-p field)
     (q978688-norm-zero-laws-p field)
     (q978688-norm-negation-laws-p field)
     (q978688-norm-triangle-laws-p field)
     (q978688-norm-product-laws-p field))))

;; Matrices and vectors are exact finite-function tables aligned with INDICES.

(defun q978688-field-list-p (field values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q978688-field-member-p field (car values))
       (q978688-field-list-p field (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q978688-vector-p (field indices vector)
  (and
   (true-listp vector)
   (equal (len vector) (len indices))
   (q978688-field-list-p field vector)))

(defun q978688-matrix-rows-p (field indices rows)
  (if (consp rows)
      (and
       (q978688-vector-p field indices (car rows))
       (q978688-matrix-rows-p field indices (cdr rows)))
    (equal rows nil)))

(defun q978688-matrix-p (field indices matrix)
  (and
   (true-listp matrix)
   (equal (len matrix) (len indices))
   (q978688-matrix-rows-p field indices matrix)))

(defun q978688-lookup-aligned (key keys values default)
  (cond
   ((or (endp keys) (endp values)) default)
   ((equal key (car keys)) (car values))
   (t
    (q978688-lookup-aligned
     key (cdr keys) (cdr values) default))))

(defun q978688-vector-nonzero-p (field vector)
  (if (consp vector)
      (or
       (not (equal (car vector) (q978688-zero field)))
       (q978688-vector-nonzero-p field (cdr vector)))
    nil))

(defun q978688-dot-product (field row vector)
  (if (and (consp row) (consp vector))
      (q978688-add
       field
       (q978688-multiply field (car row) (car vector))
       (q978688-dot-product field (cdr row) (cdr vector)))
    (q978688-zero field)))

(defun q978688-eigen-equations-p
    (field rows vector eigenvalue)
  (if (and (consp rows) (consp vector))
      (and
       (equal
        (q978688-dot-product field (car rows) vector)
        (q978688-multiply field eigenvalue (car vector)))
       (q978688-eigen-equations-p
        field (cdr rows) (cdr vector) eigenvalue))
    (and (endp rows) (endp vector))))

(defun q978688-eigenvector-p
    (field indices matrix eigenvalue vector)
  (and
   (q978688-vector-p field indices vector)
   (q978688-vector-nonzero-p field vector)
   (q978688-eigen-equations-p
    field matrix vector eigenvalue)))

(defun-sk q978688-has-eigenvalue-p
    (field indices matrix eigenvalue)
  (exists (vector)
    (q978688-eigenvector-p
     field indices matrix eigenvalue vector)))

;; The strict upper cut of the finite off-diagonal norm sum is represented by
;; simultaneous rational upper bounds for its finitely many summands.

(defun q978688-rational-list-sum (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (+ (car values)
         (q978688-rational-list-sum (cdr values)))
    0))

(defun q978688-offdiag-bounds-p
    (field columns row-key row bounds)
  (cond
   ((or (endp columns) (endp row))
    (and
     (endp columns)
     (endp row)
     (endp bounds)))
   ((equal row-key (car columns))
    (q978688-offdiag-bounds-p
     field (cdr columns) row-key (cdr row) bounds))
   (t
    (and
     (consp bounds)
     (q978688-positive-rational-p (car bounds))
     (q978688-norm-lt field (car row) (car bounds))
     (q978688-offdiag-bounds-p
      field (cdr columns) row-key (cdr row) (cdr bounds))))))

(defun q978688-row-sum-witness-p
    (field indices row-key row bound bounds)
  (and
   (q978688-positive-rational-p bound)
   (true-listp bounds)
   (q978688-offdiag-bounds-p
    field indices row-key row bounds)
   (< (q978688-rational-list-sum bounds) bound)))

(defun-sk q978688-row-sum-lt-p
    (field indices row-key row bound)
  (exists (bounds)
    (q978688-row-sum-witness-p
     field indices row-key row bound bounds)))

;; Inclusion of rational upper cuts is exactly
;; ||eigenvalue - A(k,k)|| <= sum_(j != k) ||A(k,j)||.

(defun-sk q978688-row-bound-p
    (field indices row-key row eigenvalue)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (q978688-row-sum-lt-p
      field indices row-key row bound)
     (q978688-norm-lt
      field
      (q978688-subtract
       field
       eigenvalue
       (q978688-lookup-aligned
        row-key indices row (q978688-zero field)))
      bound))))

(defun-sk q978688-some-row-bound-p
    (field index-type indices matrix eigenvalue)
  (exists (row-key)
    (and
     (q978688-index-member-p index-type row-key)
     (q978688-row-bound-p
      field
      indices
      row-key
      (q978688-lookup-aligned
       row-key indices matrix nil)
      eigenvalue))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q978688-gershgorin-circle-theorem-statement
    (field index-type indices matrix eigenvalue)
  (implies
   (and
    (q978688-normed-field-p field)
    (q978688-finite-index-p index-type indices)
    (q978688-matrix-p field indices matrix)
    (q978688-field-member-p field eigenvalue)
    (q978688-has-eigenvalue-p
     field indices matrix eigenvalue))
   (q978688-some-row-bound-p
    field index-type indices matrix eigenvalue)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q978688_gershgorin_circle_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q978688,
-- "Gershgorin circle theorem": every eigenvalue of a square matrix over an
-- arbitrary normed field lies within the norm bound centered at some diagonal
-- entry whose radius is the sum of the norms of the off-diagonal entries in
-- that row.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q978688_gershgorin_circle_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_; lsuc; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record FiniteIndex
  {i : Level}
  (I : Set i) :
  Set (lsuc i) where

  field
    size : Nat
    toFin : I -> Fin size
    fromFin : Fin size -> I
    to-from :
      (k : Fin size) ->
      toFin (fromFin k) == k
    from-to :
      (x : I) ->
      fromFin (toFin x) == x
    equalIndex : I -> I -> Bool
    equalIndex-sound :
      (x y : I) ->
      equalIndex x y == true ->
      x == y
    equalIndex-complete :
      (x y : I) ->
      x == y ->
      equalIndex x y == true

open FiniteIndex

record CompleteOrderedField
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set r
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (λ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set r) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (λ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (λ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record Field
  {k : Level}
  (K : Set k) :
  Set (lsuc k) where

  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK reciprocalK : K -> K

    one-not-zeroK :
      oneK != zeroK

    add-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) ->
      addK x y == addK y x
    add-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-zeroK :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x zeroK == x
    add-inverseK :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x (negateK x) == zeroK

    multiply-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) ->
      multiplyK x y == multiplyK y x
    multiply-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z ==
      multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-oneK :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x oneK == x
    multiply-zeroK :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x zeroK == zeroK
    distributeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    reciprocal-zeroK :
      reciprocalK zeroK == zeroK
    multiply-reciprocalK :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (reciprocalK x) == oneK

open Field

record NormedField
  {r k : Level}
  (R : Set r)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (K : Set k) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ k)) where

  field
    fieldStructure : Field K
    normK : K -> R

    norm-nonnegativeK :
      (x : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normK x)
    norm-zeroK :
      normK (zeroK fieldStructure) == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyK :
      (x : K) ->
      normK x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroK fieldStructure
    norm-oneK :
      normK (oneK fieldStructure) == oneR reals
    norm-negateK :
      (x : K) ->
      normK (negateK fieldStructure x) == normK x
    norm-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normK (addK fieldStructure x y))
        (addR reals (normK x) (normK y))
    norm-multiplyK :
      (x y : K) ->
      normK (multiplyK fieldStructure x y) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK x) (normK y)

open NormedField

Matrix :
  {i k : Level} ->
  Set i ->
  Set k ->
  Set (i ⊔ k)
Matrix I K =
  I -> I -> K

Vector :
  {i k : Level} ->
  Set i ->
  Set k ->
  Set (i ⊔ k)
Vector I K =
  I -> K

VectorEqual :
  {i k : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  Vector I K ->
  Vector I K ->
  Set (i ⊔ k)
VectorEqual {I = I} v w =
  (index : I) ->
  v index == w index

select :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Bool ->
  A ->
  A ->
  A
select true yes no =
  yes
select false yes no =
  no

sumFin :
  {k : Level} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  Field K ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> K) ->
  K
sumFin fieldData {zero} term =
  zeroK fieldData
sumFin fieldData {suc n} term =
  addK fieldData
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin fieldData (λ j -> term (fsuc j)))

sumIndex :
  {i k : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  FiniteIndex I ->
  Field K ->
  (I -> K) ->
  K
sumIndex finite fieldData term =
  sumFin fieldData (λ j -> term (fromFin finite j))

sumFinR :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFinR reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFinR reals {suc n} term =
  addR reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFinR reals (λ j -> term (fsuc j)))

subtractK :
  {r k : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedField R reals K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
subtractK scalars x y =
  addK (fieldStructure scalars)
    x
    (negateK (fieldStructure scalars) y)

matrixVectorProduct :
  {r i k : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  FiniteIndex I ->
  (scalars : NormedField R reals K) ->
  Matrix I K ->
  Vector I K ->
  Vector I K
matrixVectorProduct finite scalars A v row =
  sumIndex finite (fieldStructure scalars)
    (λ column ->
      multiplyK (fieldStructure scalars)
        (A row column)
        (v column))

scalarVector :
  {r i k : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedField R reals K ->
  K ->
  Vector I K ->
  Vector I K
scalarVector scalars scalar v index =
  multiplyK (fieldStructure scalars) scalar (v index)

NonzeroVector :
  {r i k : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedField R reals K ->
  Vector I K ->
  Set (i ⊔ k)
NonzeroVector {I = I} scalars v =
  Exists I
    (λ index ->
      v index != zeroK (fieldStructure scalars))

HasEigenvalue :
  {r i k : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  FiniteIndex I ->
  NormedField R reals K ->
  Matrix I K ->
  K ->
  Set (i ⊔ k)
HasEigenvalue {I = I} {K = K} finite scalars A eigenvalue =
  Exists (Vector I K)
    (λ eigenvector ->
      Both
        (NonzeroVector scalars eigenvector)
        (VectorEqual
          (matrixVectorProduct finite scalars A eigenvector)
          (scalarVector scalars eigenvalue eigenvector)))

sumRowNormsExcept :
  {r i k : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  FiniteIndex I ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {scalars : NormedField R reals K} ->
  Matrix I K ->
  I ->
  R
sumRowNormsExcept finite reals {scalars} A row =
  sumFinR reals
    (λ column ->
      select
        (equalIndex finite row (fromFin finite column))
        (zeroR reals)
        (normK scalars (A row (fromFin finite column))))

GershgorinConclusion :
  {r i k : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  FiniteIndex I ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (scalars : NormedField R reals K) ->
  Matrix I K ->
  K ->
  Set (r ⊔ i)
GershgorinConclusion {I = I} finite reals scalars A eigenvalue =
  Exists I
    (λ row ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normK scalars
          (subtractK scalars eigenvalue (A row row)))
        (sumRowNormsExcept finite reals {scalars} A row))

gershgorin-circle-theorem : Setω
gershgorin-circle-theorem =
  {r i k : Level} ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (I : Set i) ->
  (finite : FiniteIndex I) ->
  (K : Set k) ->
  (scalars : NormedField R reals K) ->
  (A : Matrix I K) ->
  (eigenvalue : K) ->
  HasEigenvalue finite scalars A eigenvalue ->
  GershgorinConclusion finite reals scalars A eigenvalue

title: Q978688_gershgorin_circle_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q978688, "Gershgorin circle theorem": every eigenvalue of a square matrix
  over an arbitrary normed field and finite index set lies in a closed ball
  centered at some diagonal entry, with radius the sum of the norms of the
  other entries in that row. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory pred_setTheory;

val q978688_normed_field_def = new_definition (
  "q978688_normed_field_def",
  ``q978688_normed_field
      (zero : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (invA : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) <=>
      zero <> oneA /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add x zero = x) /\
      (!x. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x. mul x oneA = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
      invA zero = zero /\
      (!x. x <> zero ==> mul x (invA x) = oneA) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. (norm x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!x y. norm (mul x y) = norm x * norm y)``);

val q978688_field_sum_def = new_definition (
  "q978688_field_sum_def",
  ``q978688_field_sum
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (s : 'i set) (f : 'i -> 'a) =
      ITSET (\i acc. add (f i) acc) s zero``);

val q978688_real_sum_def = new_definition (
  "q978688_real_sum_def",
  ``q978688_real_sum (s : 'i set) (f : 'i -> real) =
      ITSET (\i acc. f i + acc) s 0``);

val q978688_has_eigenvalue_def = new_definition (
  "q978688_has_eigenvalue_def",
  ``q978688_has_eigenvalue
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (s : 'i set) (A : 'i -> 'i -> 'a) (mu : 'a) <=>
      ?v : 'i -> 'a.
        (?j : 'i. j IN s /\ v j <> zero) /\
        !i : 'i.
          i IN s ==>
          q978688_field_sum zero add s
            (\j. mul (A i j) (v j)) =
          mul mu (v i)``);

val eigenvalue_mem_ball =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (invA : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real)
      (s : 'i set) (A : 'i -> 'i -> 'a) (mu : 'a).
      q978688_normed_field zero oneA add mul neg invA norm /\
      FINITE s /\
      q978688_has_eigenvalue zero add mul s A mu
      ==>
      ?k : 'i.
        k IN s /\
        norm (add mu (neg (A k k))) <=
        q978688_real_sum (s DELETE k) (\j. norm (A k j))``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q978688
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q978688), "Gershgorin circle theorem": every
  eigenvalue of a square matrix over an arbitrary normed field lies in a
  closed Gershgorin ball determined by one row. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  K ranges over SetMM normed fields, I over arbitrary finite index carriers,
  and A over the full square-matrix space Base ` ( I Mat K ). The antecedent
  keeps the eigenvector witness internal: v is a coordinate vector with a
  nonzero entry and satisfies A v = u v pointwise.

  The conclusion is the closed-ball inequality
  norm(A(k,k) - u) <= sum_{j in I \ {k}} norm(A(k,j)). Reversing the
  subtraction inside the norm gives the source's distance from u to A(k,k).
  The following $a is the single unproved corpus statement; this database
  contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

${
  $d A I K i j k r u v $.

  thousand-theorems-q978688-gershgorin-circle-theorem $a |-
    A. K e. ( NrmRing i^i Field )
      A. I e. Fin
        A. A e. ( Base ` ( I Mat K ) )
          A. u e. ( Base ` K )
            (
              (
                E. v e. ( ( Base ` K ) ^m I )
                  (
                    E. r e. I
                      ( v ` r ) =/= ( 0g ` K )
                    /\
                    A. i e. I
                      (
                        K gsum
                          (
                            j e. I |->
                              (
                                ( i A j )
                                ( .r ` K )
                                ( v ` j )
                              )
                          )
                      )
                      =
                      (
                        u
                        ( .r ` K )
                        ( v ` i )
                      )
                  )
              )
              ->
              E. k e. I
                (
                  (
                    ( norm ` K )
                    `
                    (
                      ( k A k )
                      ( +g ` K )
                      ( ( -g ` K ) ` u )
                    )
                  )
                  <_
                  (
                    sum_ j e. ( I \ { k } )
                      ( ( norm ` K ) ` ( k A j ) )
                  )
                )
            )
  $.
$}

title: Q978688_gershgorin_circle_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q978688,
% "Gershgorin circle theorem": every eigenvalue of a square matrix over a
% normed field with an arbitrary finite index type lies in a closed ball
% determined by one row's diagonal entry and off-diagonal norm sum.
% This file contains no proof.

Q978688_gershgorin_circle_theorem[
  Index: TYPE,
  K: TYPE+,
  zeroK, oneK: K,
  negK, invK: [K -> K],
  addK, mulK: [K, K -> K],
  normK: [K -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[Index]

  vector: TYPE = [Index -> K]
  matrix: TYPE = [Index, Index -> K]

  subK(x, y: K): K =
    addK(x, negK(y))

  field_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      addK(x, y) = addK(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      addK(addK(x, y), z) = addK(x, addK(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      addK(x, zeroK) = x
        AND addK(x, negK(x)) = zeroK)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      mulK(x, y) = mulK(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      mulK(mulK(x, y), z) = mulK(x, mulK(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      mulK(x, oneK) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      mulK(x, addK(y, z)) =
        addK(mulK(x, y), mulK(x, z)))
      AND zeroK /= oneK
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      x /= zeroK IMPLIES mulK(x, invK(x)) = oneK)

  normed_field_laws: bool =
    field_laws
      AND normK(zeroK) = 0
      AND normK(oneK) = 1
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      0 <= normK(x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      (normK(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroK))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      normK(negK(x)) = normK(x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      normK(addK(x, y)) <= normK(x) + normK(y))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      normK(mulK(x, y)) = normK(x) * normK(y))

  field_sum_value(
      support: finite_set[Index],
      values: [Index -> K],
      total: K): bool =
    EXISTS
      (enumeration:
        [below(card(support)) -> (support)]),
      (partial_sums:
        [upto(card(support)) -> K]):
        bijective?(enumeration)
          AND partial_sums(0) = zeroK
          AND
        (FORALL (position: below(card(support))):
          partial_sums(position + 1) =
            addK(
              partial_sums(position),
              values(enumeration(position))))
          AND total = partial_sums(card(support))

  real_sum_value(
      support: finite_set[Index],
      values: [Index -> real],
      total: real): bool =
    EXISTS
      (enumeration:
        [below(card(support)) -> (support)]),
      (partial_sums:
        [upto(card(support)) -> real]):
        bijective?(enumeration)
          AND partial_sums(0) = 0
          AND
        (FORALL (position: below(card(support))):
          partial_sums(position + 1) =
            partial_sums(position)
              + values(enumeration(position)))
          AND total = partial_sums(card(support))

  all_indices(support: finite_set[Index]): bool =
    FORALL (index: Index):
      member(index, support)

  nonzero_vector(v: vector): bool =
    EXISTS (index: Index):
      v(index) /= zeroK

  matrix_vector_entry_value(
      support: finite_set[Index],
      A: matrix,
      v: vector,
      row: Index,
      total: K): bool =
    field_sum_value(
      support,
      (LAMBDA (column: Index):
        mulK(A(row, column), v(column))),
      total)

  has_eigenvalue(
      support: finite_set[Index],
      A: matrix,
      mu: K): bool =
    EXISTS (v: vector):
      nonzero_vector(v)
        AND
      (FORALL (row: Index):
        EXISTS (entry: K):
          matrix_vector_entry_value(
            support, A, v, row, entry)
            AND entry = mulK(mu, v(row)))

  off_diagonal_radius_value(
      support: finite_set[Index],
      A: matrix,
      row: Index,
      radius: real): bool =
    real_sum_value(
      support,
      (LAMBDA (column: Index):
        IF column = row THEN
          0
        ELSE
          normK(A(row, column))
        ENDIF),
      radius)

  gershgorin_circle_theorem: bool =
    (is_finite_type[Index] AND normed_field_laws)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL
          (support: finite_set[Index]),
          (A: matrix),
          (mu: K):
            (all_indices(support)
              AND has_eigenvalue(support, A, mu))
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (row: Index), (radius: real):
                off_diagonal_radius_value(
                  support, A, row, radius)
                  AND normK(subK(mu, A(row, row))) <= radius
END Q978688_gershgorin_circle_theorem

title: Q9993851_lax_milgram_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q9993851
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q9993851), "Lax–Milgram theorem": every bounded
  coercive bilinear form on a complete real inner-product space is represented
  by a continuous linear self-equivalence. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q9993851_real_inner_product_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q9993851_zero : V;
  q9993851_add : V -> V -> V;
  q9993851_neg : V -> V;
  q9993851_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q9993851_inner : V -> V -> R;

  q9993851_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q9993851_add x (q9993851_add y z) =
      q9993851_add (q9993851_add x y) z;
  q9993851_add_comm :
    forall x y : V, q9993851_add x y = q9993851_add y x;
  q9993851_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q9993851_add x q9993851_zero = x;
  q9993851_add_neg :
    forall x : V,
      q9993851_add x (q9993851_neg x) = q9993851_zero;

  q9993851_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q9993851_smul 1 x = x;
  q9993851_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q9993851_smul (a * b) x =
      q9993851_smul a (q9993851_smul b x);
  q9993851_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q9993851_smul (a + b) x =
      q9993851_add
        (q9993851_smul a x) (q9993851_smul b x);
  q9993851_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q9993851_smul a (q9993851_add x y) =
      q9993851_add
        (q9993851_smul a x) (q9993851_smul a y);
  q9993851_zero_smul :
    forall x : V, q9993851_smul 0 x = q9993851_zero;
  q9993851_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q9993851_smul a q9993851_zero = q9993851_zero;

  q9993851_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q9993851_inner (q9993851_add x y) z =
      q9993851_inner x z + q9993851_inner y z;
  q9993851_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q9993851_inner (q9993851_smul a x) y =
      a * q9993851_inner x y;
  q9993851_inner_symm :
    forall x y : V, q9993851_inner x y = q9993851_inner y x;
  q9993851_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : V, 0 <= q9993851_inner x x;
  q9993851_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : V,
      q9993851_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q9993851_zero
}.

Arguments q9993851_zero {V} _.
Arguments q9993851_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q9993851_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q9993851_smul {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q9993851_inner {V} _ _ _.

Definition q9993851_sub
    {V : Type}
    (H : q9993851_real_inner_product_space V)
    (x y : V) : V :=
  q9993851_add H x (q9993851_neg H y).

Definition q9993851_norm
    {V : Type}
    (H : q9993851_real_inner_product_space V)
    (x : V) : R :=
  sqrt (q9993851_inner H x x).

Definition q9993851_sequence_converges
    {V : Type}
    (H : q9993851_real_inner_product_space V)
    (u : nat -> V) (limit : V) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q9993851_norm H
          (q9993851_sub H (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q9993851_sequence_cauchy
    {V : Type}
    (H : q9993851_real_inner_product_space V)
    (u : nat -> V) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q9993851_norm H
          (q9993851_sub H (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

Definition q9993851_complete
    {V : Type}
    (H : q9993851_real_inner_product_space V) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> V,
    q9993851_sequence_cauchy H u ->
    exists limit : V,
      q9993851_sequence_converges H u limit.

Record q9993851_continuous_linear_map
    (V : Type)
    (H : q9993851_real_inner_product_space V) : Type := {
  q9993851_clm_fun : V -> V;
  q9993851_clm_add :
    forall x y : V,
      q9993851_clm_fun (q9993851_add H x y) =
      q9993851_add H
        (q9993851_clm_fun x) (q9993851_clm_fun y);
  q9993851_clm_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : V),
      q9993851_clm_fun (q9993851_smul H a x) =
      q9993851_smul H a (q9993851_clm_fun x);
  q9993851_clm_bounded :
    exists bound : R,
      0 <= bound /\
      forall x : V,
        q9993851_norm H (q9993851_clm_fun x) <=
        bound * q9993851_norm H x
}.

Arguments q9993851_clm_fun {V H} _ _.

Record q9993851_continuous_linear_equiv
    (V : Type)
    (H : q9993851_real_inner_product_space V) : Type := {
  q9993851_cle_forward :
    q9993851_continuous_linear_map H;
  q9993851_cle_inverse :
    q9993851_continuous_linear_map H;
  q9993851_cle_left_inverse :
    forall x : V,
      q9993851_clm_fun q9993851_cle_inverse
        (q9993851_clm_fun q9993851_cle_forward x) = x;
  q9993851_cle_right_inverse :
    forall y : V,
      q9993851_clm_fun q9993851_cle_forward
        (q9993851_clm_fun q9993851_cle_inverse y) = y
}.

Arguments q9993851_cle_forward {V H} _.
Arguments q9993851_cle_inverse {V H} _.

Definition q9993851_bounded_bilinear_form
    {V : Type}
    (H : q9993851_real_inner_product_space V)
    (B : V -> V -> R) : Prop :=
  (forall x y z : V,
    B (q9993851_add H x y) z = B x z + B y z) /\
  (forall (a : R) (x y : V),
    B (q9993851_smul H a x) y = a * B x y) /\
  (forall x y z : V,
    B x (q9993851_add H y z) = B x y + B x z) /\
  (forall (a : R) (x y : V),
    B x (q9993851_smul H a y) = a * B x y) /\
  exists bound : R,
    0 <= bound /\
    forall x y : V,
      Rabs (B x y) <=
      bound * q9993851_norm H x * q9993851_norm H y.

Definition q9993851_is_coercive
    {V : Type}
    (H : q9993851_real_inner_product_space V)
    (B : V -> V -> R) : Prop :=
  exists coercivity_constant : R,
    0 < coercivity_constant /\
    forall u : V,
      coercivity_constant * q9993851_norm H u * q9993851_norm H u
      <= B u u.

Theorem IsCoercive_continuousLinearEquivOfBilin :
  forall (V : Type)
         (H : q9993851_real_inner_product_space V),
    q9993851_complete H ->
    forall B : V -> V -> R,
      q9993851_bounded_bilinear_form H B ->
      q9993851_is_coercive H B ->
      exists equivalence : q9993851_continuous_linear_equiv H,
        forall v w : V,
          q9993851_inner H
            (q9993851_clm_fun
              (q9993851_cle_forward equivalence) v) w =
          B v w.

title: Q9993851_lax_milgram_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q9993851 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q9993851), "Lax–Milgram theorem":
  every coercive bounded bilinear form on a real Hilbert space induces a
  continuous linear equivalence of that space with itself. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory Q9993851_lax_milgram_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Inner_Product"
begin

theorem q9993851_lax_milgram:
  fixes B :: "'a::{real_inner,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes bounded: "bounded_bilinear B"
    and coercive:
      "\<exists>C::real. 0 < C \<and> (\<forall>u. C * norm u * norm u \<le> B u u)"
  shows
    "\<exists>T S :: 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a.
      bounded_linear T \<and>
      bounded_linear S \<and>
      (\<forall>x. S (T x) = x) \<and>
      (\<forall>x. T (S x) = x) \<and>
      (\<forall>v w. inner (T v) w = B v w)"
  sorry

end

title: Q9993851_lax_milgram_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q9993851,
  "Lax–Milgram theorem": a coercive bounded bilinear form on a real Hilbert
  space induces a continuous linear equivalence representing that form through
  the inner product. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q9993851_LAX_MILGRAM_THEOREM =
 `let real_vector_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (smul:real->V->V).
      (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:V.
         smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:V.
         smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:V.
         smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) in
  let real_inner_product =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V)
     (inner:V->V->real).
      (!x y z:V.
         inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:V.
         inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
      (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let vnorm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V). sqrt(inner x x) in
  let tends_to =
    \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
     (u:num->V) (x:V).
      !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
              N <= n
              ==> vnorm inner (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon in
  let complete_space =
    \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (inner:V->V->real).
      !u:num->V.
        (!epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                 N <= m /\ N <= n
                 ==> vnorm inner
                       (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon)
        ==> ?x:V. tends_to add neg inner u x in
  let bounded_bilinear =
    \(add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V)
     (inner:V->V->real) (B:V->V->real).
      (!x y z:V. B (add x y) z = B x z + B y z) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:V. B (smul a x) y = a * B x y) /\
      (!x y z:V. B x (add y z) = B x y + B x z) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:V. B x (smul a y) = a * B x y) /\
      (?C:real.
         &0 <= C /\
         !x y:V.
           abs(B x y) <= C * vnorm inner x * vnorm inner y) in
  let coercive =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (B:V->V->real).
      ?C:real.
        &0 < C /\
        !x:V.
          C * vnorm inner x * vnorm inner x <= B x x in
  let continuous_linear =
    \(add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V)
     (inner:V->V->real) (f:V->V).
      (!x y:V. f (add x y) = add (f x) (f y)) /\
      (!a:real. !x:V. f (smul a x) = smul a (f x)) /\
      (?C:real.
         &0 <= C /\
         !x:V. vnorm inner (f x) <= C * vnorm inner x) in
  let continuous_linear_equivalence =
    \(add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V)
     (inner:V->V->real) (f:V->V) (g:V->V).
      continuous_linear add smul inner f /\
      continuous_linear add smul inner g /\
      (!x:V. g (f x) = x) /\
      (!x:V. f (g x) = x) in
  !zero:V.
  !add:V->V->V.
  !neg:V->V.
  !smul:real->V->V.
  !inner:V->V->real.
  !B:V->V->real.
    real_vector_space zero add neg smul /\
    real_inner_product zero add smul inner /\
    complete_space add neg inner /\
    bounded_bilinear add smul inner B /\
    coercive inner B
    ==> ?f g:V->V.
          continuous_linear_equivalence add smul inner f g /\
          (!v w:V. inner (f v) w = B v w)`;;

title: Q9993851_lax_milgram_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q9993851,
;; "Lax–Milgram theorem": a coercive bounded bilinear form on a complete real
;; inner-product space induces a continuous linear equivalence representing
;; the form through the inner product. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ functions represent the real field, Hilbert-space carrier,
;; operations, sequences, and maps. FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal
;; quantification, and inequality with a constant-false function supplies
;; internal existential witnesses. Norms are represented by rational upper
;; cuts, which encode genuine nonnegative real values rather than restricting
;; norms to rational values.
;;
;; Joint sequential continuity of the bilinear map is equivalent to bounded
;; bilinearity on normed spaces. Coercivity uses inner(u,u) = ||u||^2 and an
;; internally quantified positive rational constant; density of the rationals
;; makes this equivalent to the source's positive real constant. The conclusion
;; internally quantifies the mutually inverse continuous linear maps.

(defun q9993851-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q9993851-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (q9993851-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q9993851-quoted nil)))

(defun q9993851-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list
   'apply$
   function-term
   (q9993851-term-list arguments)))

(defun q9993851-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (q9993851-apply-term
   (q9993851-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun q9993851-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (q9993851-and-terms (cdr terms))
       (q9993851-quoted nil))
    (q9993851-quoted t)))

(defun q9993851-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (q9993851-quoted nil)
   (q9993851-quoted t)))

(defun q9993851-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list
   'if
   hypothesis
   conclusion
   (q9993851-quoted t)))

(defun q9993851-iff-term (left right)
  (list
   'if
   left
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q9993851-quoted t)
    (q9993851-quoted nil))
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q9993851-quoted nil)
    (q9993851-quoted t))))

(defun q9993851-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q9993851-quoted t)))

(defun q9993851-fn-equal-true-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true
         (q9993851-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q9993851-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object))
      t
    nil))

(defun q9993851-binary-value (function left right)

(defun q9993851-positive-rational-p (q)
  (and (rationalp q) (< 0 q)))

(defun q9993851-norm-lt-p (norm-lt object q)
  (if (apply$ norm-lt (list object q))
      t
    nil))

(defun q9993851-norm-finite-witness-p
    (norm-lt object q)
  (and
   (q9993851-positive-rational-p q)
   (q9993851-norm-lt-p norm-lt object q)))

(defun q9993851-norm-finite-failure-function
    (norm-lt object)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(q)

    'if
    (list

(defun q9993851-product-witness-p

  (let ((r (car witness))

    (and

(defun q9993851-mixed-product-witness-p

    (and
