    real-add real-multiply real-one real-norm-lt
    carrier add negate zero smul norm-lt)
   (tamep-functionp inner)
   (q9993851-fn-equal-true-p
    (q9993851-inner-product-laws-function
     real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less
     carrier add zero smul norm-lt inner)
    '(a x y z q))))

;; The source space is complete as well as an inner-product space.

(defun q9993851-hilbert-space-p
    (real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less real-norm-lt
     carrier add negate zero smul norm-lt inner)
  (and
   (q9993851-inner-product-space-p
    real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
    real-zero real-one real-less real-norm-lt
    carrier add negate zero smul norm-lt inner)
   (q9993851-fn-equal-true-p
    (q9993851-completeness-function
     carrier add negate norm-lt)
    '(sequence))))

;; Linear maps and sequential continuity.

(defun q9993851-linear-map-function
    (field-carrier domain-carrier codomain-carrier
     domain-add codomain-add domain-smul codomain-smul mapping)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(a x y)
   (q9993851-implies-term
    (q9993851-and-terms
     (list
      (q9993851-static-apply-term field-carrier '(a))
      (q9993851-static-apply-term domain-carrier '(x))
      (q9993851-static-apply-term domain-carrier '(y))))
    (q9993851-and-terms
     (list
      (q9993851-static-apply-term
       codomain-carrier
       (list
        (q9993851-static-apply-term mapping '(x))))
      (list
       'equal
       (q9993851-static-apply-term
        mapping
        (list
         (q9993851-static-apply-term domain-add '(x y))))
       (q9993851-static-apply-term
        codomain-add
        (list
         (q9993851-static-apply-term mapping '(x))
         (q9993851-static-apply-term mapping '(y)))))
      (list
       'equal
       (q9993851-static-apply-term
        mapping
        (list
         (q9993851-static-apply-term domain-smul '(a x))))
       (q9993851-static-apply-term
        codomain-smul
        (list
         'a
         (q9993851-static-apply-term mapping '(x))))))))))

(defun q9993851-linear-map-p
    (field-carrier domain-carrier codomain-carrier
     domain-add codomain-add domain-smul codomain-smul mapping)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp mapping)
   (q9993851-fn-equal-true-p
    (q9993851-linear-map-function
     field-carrier domain-carrier codomain-carrier
     domain-add codomain-add domain-smul codomain-smul mapping)
    '(a x y))))

(defun q9993851-compose-sequence
    (mapping sequence)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(n)
   (q9993851-static-apply-term
    mapping
    (list
     (q9993851-static-apply-term sequence '(n))))))

(defun q9993851-continuity-function
    (domain-carrier domain-add domain-negate domain-norm-lt
     codomain-carrier codomain-add codomain-negate codomain-norm-lt
     mapping)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(sequence x)
   (q9993851-implies-term
    (list
     'q9993851-converges-p
     (q9993851-quoted domain-carrier)
     (q9993851-quoted domain-add)
     (q9993851-quoted domain-negate)
     (q9993851-quoted domain-norm-lt)
     'sequence
     'x)
    (list
     'q9993851-converges-p
     (q9993851-quoted codomain-carrier)
     (q9993851-quoted codomain-add)
     (q9993851-quoted codomain-negate)
     (q9993851-quoted codomain-norm-lt)
     (list
      'q9993851-compose-sequence
      (q9993851-quoted mapping)
      'sequence)
     (q9993851-static-apply-term mapping '(x))))))

(defun q9993851-continuous-p
    (domain-carrier domain-add domain-negate domain-norm-lt
     codomain-carrier codomain-add codomain-negate codomain-norm-lt
     mapping)
  (q9993851-fn-equal-true-p
   (q9993851-continuity-function
    domain-carrier domain-add domain-negate domain-norm-lt
    codomain-carrier codomain-add codomain-negate codomain-norm-lt
    mapping)
   '(sequence x)))

(defun q9993851-continuous-linear-map-p
    (real-carrier
     carrier add negate smul norm-lt mapping)
  (and
   (q9993851-linear-map-p
    real-carrier carrier carrier
    add add smul smul mapping)
   (q9993851-continuous-p
    carrier add negate norm-lt
    carrier add negate norm-lt
    mapping)))

;; A bounded real bilinear form is represented as a bilinear map that is
;; jointly sequentially continuous.

(defun q9993851-bilinear-laws-function
    (real-carrier real-add real-multiply
     carrier add smul bilinear)
  (let ((bxy
         (q9993851-static-apply-term bilinear '(x y))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(a x y z)
     (q9993851-implies-term
      (q9993851-and-terms
       (list
        (q9993851-static-apply-term real-carrier '(a))
        (q9993851-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q9993851-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q9993851-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q9993851-and-terms
       (list
        (q9993851-static-apply-term
         real-carrier
         (list bxy))
        (list
         'equal
         (q9993851-static-apply-term
          bilinear
          (list
           (q9993851-static-apply-term add '(x y))
           'z))
         (q9993851-static-apply-term
          real-add
          (list
           (q9993851-static-apply-term bilinear '(x z))
           (q9993851-static-apply-term bilinear '(y z)))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q9993851-static-apply-term
          bilinear
          (list
           (q9993851-static-apply-term smul '(a x))
           'z))
         (q9993851-static-apply-term
          real-multiply
          (list
           'a
           (q9993851-static-apply-term bilinear '(x z)))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q9993851-static-apply-term
          bilinear
          (list
           'x
           (q9993851-static-apply-term add '(y z))))
         (q9993851-static-apply-term
          real-add
          (list
           bxy
           (q9993851-static-apply-term bilinear '(x z)))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q9993851-static-apply-term
          bilinear
          (list
           'x
           (q9993851-static-apply-term smul '(a y))))
         (q9993851-static-apply-term
          real-multiply
          (list 'a bxy)))))))))

(defun q9993851-bilinear-map-p
    (real-carrier real-add real-multiply
     carrier add smul bilinear)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp bilinear)
   (q9993851-fn-equal-true-p
    (q9993851-bilinear-laws-function
     real-carrier real-add real-multiply
     carrier add smul bilinear)
    '(a x y z))))

(defun q9993851-compose-bilinear-sequence
    (bilinear left-sequence right-sequence)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(n)
   (q9993851-static-apply-term
    bilinear
    (list
     (q9993851-static-apply-term left-sequence '(n))
     (q9993851-static-apply-term right-sequence '(n))))))

(defun q9993851-bilinear-continuity-function
    (real-carrier real-add real-negate real-norm-lt
     carrier add negate norm-lt bilinear)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(left-sequence right-sequence left right)
   (q9993851-implies-term
    (q9993851-and-terms
     (list
      (list
       'q9993851-converges-p
       (q9993851-quoted carrier)
       (q9993851-quoted add)
       (q9993851-quoted negate)
       (q9993851-quoted norm-lt)
       'left-sequence
       'left)
      (list
       'q9993851-converges-p
       (q9993851-quoted carrier)
       (q9993851-quoted add)
       (q9993851-quoted negate)
       (q9993851-quoted norm-lt)
       'right-sequence
       'right)))
    (list
     'q9993851-converges-p
     (q9993851-quoted real-carrier)
     (q9993851-quoted real-add)
     (q9993851-quoted real-negate)
     (q9993851-quoted real-norm-lt)
     (list
      'q9993851-compose-bilinear-sequence
      (q9993851-quoted bilinear)
      'left-sequence
      'right-sequence)
     (q9993851-static-apply-term
      bilinear '(left right))))))

(defun q9993851-bounded-bilinear-form-p
    (real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-norm-lt
     carrier add negate smul norm-lt bilinear)
  (and
   (q9993851-bilinear-map-p
    real-carrier real-add real-multiply
    carrier add smul bilinear)
   (q9993851-fn-equal-true-p
    (q9993851-bilinear-continuity-function
     real-carrier real-add real-negate real-norm-lt
     carrier add negate norm-lt bilinear)
    '(left-sequence right-sequence left right))))

;; Coercivity. The rational witness remains existential inside the predicate.

(defun q9993851-real-le-p
    (real-less left right)
  (not (q9993851-binary-value
        real-less right left)))

(defun q9993851-coercivity-row-function
    (real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less
     carrier inner bilinear constant)
  (let* ((cast-constant
          (list
           'q9993851-rational-cast
           (q9993851-quoted constant)
           (q9993851-quoted real-zero)
           (q9993851-quoted real-one)
           (q9993851-quoted real-add)
           (q9993851-quoted real-multiply)
           (q9993851-quoted real-negate)
           (q9993851-quoted real-inverse)))
         (scaled-square
          (q9993851-static-apply-term
           real-multiply
           (list
            cast-constant
            (q9993851-static-apply-term inner '(u u))))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(u)
     (q9993851-implies-term
      (q9993851-static-apply-term carrier '(u))
      (list
       'q9993851-real-le-p
       (q9993851-quoted real-less)
       scaled-square
       (q9993851-static-apply-term bilinear '(u u)))))))

(defun q9993851-coercivity-witness-p
    (real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less
     carrier inner bilinear constant)
  (and
   (q9993851-positive-rational-p constant)
   (q9993851-fn-equal-true-p
    (q9993851-coercivity-row-function
     real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less
     carrier inner bilinear constant)
    '(u))))

(defun q9993851-coercivity-witness-function
    (real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less
     carrier inner bilinear)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(constant)
   (list
    'q9993851-coercivity-witness-p
    (q9993851-quoted real-add)
    (q9993851-quoted real-multiply)
    (q9993851-quoted real-negate)
    (q9993851-quoted real-inverse)
    (q9993851-quoted real-zero)
    (q9993851-quoted real-one)
    (q9993851-quoted real-less)
    (q9993851-quoted carrier)
    (q9993851-quoted inner)
    (q9993851-quoted bilinear)
    'constant)))

(defun q9993851-coercive-p
    (real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less
     carrier inner bilinear)
  (q9993851-exists-p
   (q9993851-coercivity-witness-function
    real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
    real-zero real-one real-less
    carrier inner bilinear)
   '(constant)))

;; A continuous linear equivalence whose forward map is the Riesz
;; representative of v |-> B(v,-).

(defun q9993851-equivalence-laws-function
    (carrier forward inverse)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q9993851-implies-term
    (q9993851-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (q9993851-and-terms
     (list
      (list
       'equal
       (q9993851-static-apply-term
        inverse
        (list
         (q9993851-static-apply-term forward '(x))))
       'x)
      (list
       'equal
       (q9993851-static-apply-term
        forward
        (list
         (q9993851-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
       'x))))))

(defun q9993851-representation-function
    (carrier inner bilinear forward)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(v w)
   (q9993851-implies-term
    (q9993851-and-terms
     (list
      (q9993851-static-apply-term carrier '(v))
      (q9993851-static-apply-term carrier '(w))))
    (list
     'equal
     (q9993851-static-apply-term
      inner
      (list
       (q9993851-static-apply-term forward '(v))
       'w))
     (q9993851-static-apply-term bilinear '(v w))))))

(defun q9993851-equivalence-witness-p
    (real-carrier
     carrier add negate smul norm-lt
     inner bilinear witness)
  (let ((forward (nth 0 witness))
        (inverse (nth 1 witness)))
    (and
     (true-listp witness)
     (equal (len witness) 2)
     (q9993851-continuous-linear-map-p
      real-carrier
      carrier add negate smul norm-lt forward)
     (q9993851-continuous-linear-map-p
      real-carrier
      carrier add negate smul norm-lt inverse)
     (q9993851-fn-equal-true-p
      (q9993851-equivalence-laws-function
       carrier forward inverse)
      '(x))
     (q9993851-fn-equal-true-p
      (q9993851-representation-function
       carrier inner bilinear forward)
      '(v w)))))

(defun q9993851-equivalence-witness-function
    (real-carrier
     carrier add negate smul norm-lt inner bilinear)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(witness)
   (list
    'q9993851-equivalence-witness-p
    (q9993851-quoted real-carrier)
    (q9993851-quoted carrier)
    (q9993851-quoted add)
    (q9993851-quoted negate)
    (q9993851-quoted smul)
    (q9993851-quoted norm-lt)
    (q9993851-quoted inner)
    (q9993851-quoted bilinear)
    'witness)))

(defun q9993851-has-lax-milgram-equivalence-p
    (real-carrier
     carrier add negate smul norm-lt inner bilinear)
  (q9993851-exists-p
   (q9993851-equivalence-witness-function
    real-carrier
    carrier add negate smul norm-lt inner bilinear)
   '(witness)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q9993851-lax-milgram-theorem-statement
    (real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less real-norm-lt
     carrier add negate zero smul norm-lt inner bilinear)
  (implies
   (and
    (q9993851-real-field-p
     real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less real-norm-lt)
    (q9993851-hilbert-space-p
     real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less real-norm-lt
     carrier add negate zero smul norm-lt inner)
    (q9993851-bounded-bilinear-form-p
     real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-norm-lt
     carrier add negate smul norm-lt bilinear)
    (q9993851-coercive-p
     real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less
     carrier inner bilinear))
   (q9993851-has-lax-milgram-equivalence-p
    real-carrier
    carrier add negate smul norm-lt inner bilinear)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q9993851_lax_milgram_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q9993851,
-- "Lax-Milgram theorem": every bounded coercive bilinear form on a real Hilbert
-- space induces a continuous linear equivalence characterized by the form.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q9993851_lax_milgram_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Exists1 (A : Set1) (P : A -> Set) : Set1 where
  constructor witness1
  field
    value1    : A
    property1 : P value1

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) -> Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR x == zeroR -> x == zeroR
    absolute-negateR :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNatR m == fromNatR n -> m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record RealInnerProductSpace
  (R V : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : R -> V -> V
    normV : V -> R
    inner : V -> V -> R

    add-commutativeV :
      (x y : V) -> addV x y == addV y x
    add-associativeV :
      (x y z : V) ->
      addV (addV x y) z == addV x (addV y z)
    add-zeroV :
      (x : V) -> addV x zeroV == x
    add-inverseV :
      (x : V) -> addV x (negateV x) == zeroV

    scale-oneV :
      (x : V) -> scaleV (oneR reals) x == x
    scale-associativeV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyR reals a b) x == scaleV a (scaleV b x)
    scale-add-vectorsV :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV x y) == addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV a y)
    scale-add-scalarsV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scaleV (addR reals a b) x == addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV b x)

    norm-nonnegativeV :
      (x : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normV x)
    norm-zeroV :
      normV zeroV == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyV :
      (x : V) -> normV x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroV
    norm-negateV :
      (x : V) -> normV (negateV x) == normV x
    norm-addV :
      (x y : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normV (addV x y))
        (addR reals (normV x) (normV y))
    norm-scaleV :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : V) ->
      normV (scaleV a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (absoluteR reals a) (normV x)

    inner-add-left :
      (x y z : V) ->
      inner (addV x y) z ==
      addR reals (inner x z) (inner y z)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : V) ->
      inner (scaleV a x) y ==
      multiplyR reals a (inner x y)
    inner-add-right :
      (x y z : V) ->
      inner x (addV y z) ==
      addR reals (inner x y) (inner x z)
    inner-scale-right :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : V) ->
      inner x (scaleV a y) ==
      multiplyR reals a (inner x y)
    inner-symmetric :
      (x y : V) ->
      inner x y == inner y x
    inner-nonnegative :
      (x : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (inner x x)
    inner-definite :
      (x : V) ->
      inner x x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroV
    inner-norm-square :
      (x : V) ->
      multiplyR reals (normV x) (normV x) == inner x x

open RealInnerProductSpace

distanceV :
  {R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealInnerProductSpace R V reals ->
  V ->
  V ->
  R
distanceV space x y =
  normV space (addV space x (negateV space y))

SequentialLimit :
  {R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealInnerProductSpace R V reals ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  V ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distanceV space (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealInnerProductSpace R V reals ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (distanceV space (sequence m) (sequence n))
        epsilon)

Complete :
  {R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealInnerProductSpace R V reals ->
  Set
Complete {V = V} space =
  (sequence : Nat -> V) ->
  CauchySequence space sequence ->
  Exists V (\ limit -> SequentialLimit space sequence limit)

record ContinuousBilinearForm
  {R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace R V reals) : Set1 where
  field
    apply : V -> V -> R
    map-add-left :
      (x y z : V) ->
      apply (addV space x y) z ==
      addR reals (apply x z) (apply y z)
    map-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : V) ->
      apply (scaleV space a x) y ==
      multiplyR reals a (apply x y)
    map-add-right :
      (x y z : V) ->
      apply x (addV space y z) ==
      addR reals (apply x y) (apply x z)
    map-scale-right :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : V) ->
      apply x (scaleV space a y) ==
      multiplyR reals a (apply x y)

    operator-bound : R
    operator-bound-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) operator-bound
    operator-bound-property :
      (x y : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (absoluteR reals (apply x y))
        (multiplyR reals operator-bound
          (multiplyR reals (normV space x) (normV space y)))

open ContinuousBilinearForm

Coercive :
  {R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductSpace R V reals} ->
  ContinuousBilinearForm space ->
  Set
Coercive {R = R} {V = V} {reals = reals} {space = space} form =
  Exists R
    (\ constant ->
      Both
        (Positive reals constant)
        ((x : V) ->
          lessOrEqualR reals
            (multiplyR reals constant
              (multiplyR reals (normV space x) (normV space x)))
            (apply form x x)))

record ContinuousLinearEquivalence
  {R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace R V reals) : Set1 where
  field
    forward backward : V -> V

    forward-map-add :
      (x y : V) ->
      forward (addV space x y) ==
      addV space (forward x) (forward y)
    forward-map-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : V) ->
      forward (scaleV space a x) ==
      scaleV space a (forward x)
    backward-map-add :
      (x y : V) ->
      backward (addV space x y) ==
      addV space (backward x) (backward y)
    backward-map-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : V) ->
      backward (scaleV space a x) ==
      scaleV space a (backward x)

    forward-bound backward-bound : R
    forward-bound-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) forward-bound
    backward-bound-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) backward-bound
    forward-bounded :
      (x : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normV space (forward x))
        (multiplyR reals forward-bound (normV space x))
    backward-bounded :
      (x : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normV space (backward x))
        (multiplyR reals backward-bound (normV space x))

    backward-after-forward :
      (x : V) -> backward (forward x) == x
    forward-after-backward :
      (x : V) -> forward (backward x) == x

open ContinuousLinearEquivalence

lax-milgram-theorem : Set1
lax-milgram-theorem =
  (R V : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace R V reals) ->
  Complete space ->
  (form : ContinuousBilinearForm space) ->
  Coercive form ->
  Exists1 (ContinuousLinearEquivalence space)
    (\ equivalence ->
      (v w : V) ->
      inner space (forward equivalence v) w == apply form v w)

title: Q9993851_lax_milgram_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q9993851 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q9993851), "Lax–Milgram theorem":
  every bounded coercive bilinear form on a complete real inner-product space
  induces a continuous linear equivalence representing the form through the
  inner product. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val q9993851_real_inner_product_space_def = new_definition (
  "q9993851_real_inner_product_space_def",
  ``q9993851_real_inner_product_space
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a x y. inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0) <=> (x = zero))``);

val q9993851_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q9993851_norm_def",
  ``q9993851_norm (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) (x : 'e) =
      sqrt (inner x x)``);

val q9993851_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q9993851_cauchy_def",
  ``q9993851_cauchy
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !m n : num.
          N <= m /\ N <= n ==>
          q9993851_norm inner
            (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon``);

val q9993851_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q9993851_tendsto_def",
  ``q9993851_tendsto
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) (x : 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==>
          q9993851_norm inner
            (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon``);

val q9993851_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q9993851_complete_def",
  ``q9993851_complete
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'e.
        q9993851_cauchy add neg inner u ==>
        ?x : 'e. q9993851_tendsto add neg inner u x``);

val q9993851_bounded_bilinear_form_def = new_definition (
  "q9993851_bounded_bilinear_form_def",
  ``q9993851_bounded_bilinear_form
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) (B : 'e -> 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. B (add x y) z = B x z + B y z) /\
      (!a x y. B (smul a x) y = a * B x y) /\
      (!x y z. B x (add y z) = B x y + B x z) /\
      (!a x y. B x (smul a y) = a * B x y) /\
      ?M : real.
        0 <= M /\
        !x y.
          abs (B x y) <=
          M * q9993851_norm inner x * q9993851_norm inner y``);

val q9993851_coercive_def = new_definition (
  "q9993851_coercive_def",
  ``q9993851_coercive
      (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) (B : 'e -> 'e -> real) <=>
      ?C : real.
        0 < C /\
        !u.
          C * q9993851_norm inner u * q9993851_norm inner u <=
          B u u``);

val q9993851_continuous_linear_map_def = new_definition (
  "q9993851_continuous_linear_map_def",
  ``q9993851_continuous_linear_map
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) (L : 'e -> 'e) <=>
      (!x y. L (add x y) = add (L x) (L y)) /\
      (!a x. L (smul a x) = smul a (L x)) /\
      ?K : real.
        0 <= K /\
        !x.
          q9993851_norm inner (L x) <=
          K * q9993851_norm inner x``);

val q9993851_continuous_linear_equiv_def = new_definition (
  "q9993851_continuous_linear_equiv_def",
  ``q9993851_continuous_linear_equiv
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real)
      (forward : 'e -> 'e) (inverse : 'e -> 'e) <=>
      q9993851_continuous_linear_map add smul inner forward /\
      q9993851_continuous_linear_map add smul inner inverse /\
      (!x. inverse (forward x) = x) /\
      (!x. forward (inverse x) = x)``);

val IsCoercive_continuousLinearEquivOfBilin =
  ``!(zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real)
      (B : 'e -> 'e -> real).
      q9993851_real_inner_product_space zero add neg smul inner /\
      q9993851_complete add neg inner /\
      q9993851_bounded_bilinear_form add smul inner B /\
      q9993851_coercive inner B
      ==>
      ?forward inverse : 'e -> 'e.
        q9993851_continuous_linear_equiv
          add smul inner forward inverse /\
        !v w. inner (forward v) w = B v w``;

title: Q9993851_lax_milgram_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q9993851
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q9993851), "Lax-Milgram theorem": every
  coercive bounded bilinear form on an arbitrary real Hilbert space induces a
  continuous linear equivalence characterized by the corresponding
  inner-product identity. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q9993851BoundedBilinear W B is the uncurried form of a bounded real
  bilinear map on W. The two additive and homogeneous laws give linearity in
  each argument, and the global product-of-norms bound is equivalent to
  continuity of the corresponding curried bilinear map.

  Q9993851Coercive W B is exactly the source IsCoercive predicate: a strictly
  positive real constant bounds B(x,x) below by that constant times the
  square of the norm.

  SetMM's inner product is linear in its first slot, opposite to mathlib's
  convention, so y ( .i ` W ) ( T ` x ) renders mathlib's inner product of
  T x with y. Q9993851Associated W B T therefore states that T is precisely
  InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin B.

  Q9993851ContinuousLinearEquiv W T requires T and its inverse to be bounded
  linear maps and T to be a bijection of the full carrier. This is exactly a
  continuous linear equivalence from W to W. The final declaration is the
  single unproved corpus statement. All preceding $a declarations are syntax
  or faithful bidirectional definitions. This root artifact has no $p
  declaration; the included lib/set.mm supplies proved statements.
$)

$c Q9993851BoundedBilinear Q9993851Coercive Q9993851Associated
   Q9993851ContinuousLinearEquiv $.

q9993851-bounded-bilinear-syntax
  $a wff ( Q9993851BoundedBilinear W B ) $.
q9993851-coercive-syntax
  $a wff ( Q9993851Coercive W B ) $.
q9993851-associated-syntax
  $a wff ( Q9993851Associated W B T ) $.
q9993851-continuous-linear-equiv-syntax
  $a wff ( Q9993851ContinuousLinearEquiv W T ) $.

${
  $d B C W a x y z $.

  q9993851-bounded-bilinear-definition $a |- (
    ( Q9993851BoundedBilinear W B )
    <->
    (
      B : ( ( Base ` W ) X. ( Base ` W ) ) --> RR
      /\
      (
        A. x e. ( Base ` W )
          A. y e. ( Base ` W )
            A. z e. ( Base ` W )
              (
                B ` <. ( x ( +g ` W ) y ) , z >.
              )
              =
              (
                ( B ` <. x , z >. )
                +
                ( B ` <. y , z >. )
              )
        /\
        (
          A. a e. RR
            A. x e. ( Base ` W )
              A. y e. ( Base ` W )
                (
                  B ` <. ( a ( .s ` W ) x ) , y >.
                )
                =
                (
                  a
                  x.
                  ( B ` <. x , y >. )
                )
          /\
          (
            A. x e. ( Base ` W )
              A. y e. ( Base ` W )
                A. z e. ( Base ` W )
                  (
                    B ` <. x , ( y ( +g ` W ) z ) >.
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    ( B ` <. x , y >. )
                    +
                    ( B ` <. x , z >. )
                  )
            /\
            (
              A. a e. RR
                A. x e. ( Base ` W )
                  A. y e. ( Base ` W )
                    (
                      B ` <. x , ( a ( .s ` W ) y ) >.
                    )
                    =
                    (
                      a
                      x.
                      ( B ` <. x , y >. )
                    )
              /\
              E. C e. RR
                (
                  0 <_ C
                  /\
                  A. x e. ( Base ` W )
                    A. y e. ( Base ` W )
                      (
                        abs
                        `
                        ( B ` <. x , y >. )
                      )
                      <_
                      (
                        (
                          C
                          x.
                          ( ( norm ` W ) ` x )
                        )
                        x.
                        ( ( norm ` W ) ` y )
                      )
                )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B C W x $.

  q9993851-coercive-definition $a |- (
    ( Q9993851Coercive W B )
    <->
    E. C e. RR
      (
        0 < C
        /\
        A. x e. ( Base ` W )
          (
            (
              C
              x.
              ( ( norm ` W ) ` x )
            )
            x.
            ( ( norm ` W ) ` x )
          )
          <_
          ( B ` <. x , x >. )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B T W x y $.

  q9993851-associated-definition $a |- (
    ( Q9993851Associated W B T )
    <->
    A. x e. ( Base ` W )
      A. y e. ( Base ` W )
        (
          y
          ( .i ` W )
          ( T ` x )
        )
        =
        ( B ` <. x , y >. )
  ) $.
$}

q9993851-continuous-linear-equiv-definition $a |- (
  ( Q9993851ContinuousLinearEquiv W T )
  <->
  (
    T e. ( W NMHom W )
    /\
    (
      T : ( Base ` W ) -1-1-onto-> ( Base ` W )
      /\
      `' T e. ( W NMHom W )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d B T W $.

  thousand-theorems-q9993851-lax-milgram $a |-
    A. W e. CHil
      (
        ( Scalar ` W ) = RRfld
        ->
        A. B
          (
            (
              ( Q9993851BoundedBilinear W B )
              /\
              ( Q9993851Coercive W B )
            )
            ->
            E. T
              (
                ( Q9993851ContinuousLinearEquiv W T )
                /\
                ( Q9993851Associated W B T )
              )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q9993851_lax_milgram_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q9993851
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q9993851), "Lax–Milgram theorem": a coercive bounded
% bilinear form on an arbitrary real Hilbert space induces a continuous linear
% equivalence characterized by the inner product. This file contains no proof.

lax_milgram_theorem_Q9993851[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  innerE: [E, E -> real],
  B: [E, E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  linear_map: TYPE = [E -> E]

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  additive_group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)

  real_module_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
      smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
        addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a + b, x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a * b, x) = smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(0, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: real):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)

  norm_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: E):
      0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) = abs(a) * normE(x))

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
      innerE(addE(x, y), z) =
        innerE(x, z) + innerE(y, z))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
        innerE(smulE(a, x), y) = a * innerE(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        innerE(x, y) = innerE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= innerE(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        innerE(x, x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) ^ 2 = innerE(x, x))

  converges(values: e_sequence, limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normE(subE(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy(values: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index
          IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(
                values(left_index),
                values(right_index))) < epsilon_value

  complete_space: bool =
    FORALL (values: e_sequence):
      cauchy(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: E):
          converges(values, limit)

  real_hilbert_space: bool =
    additive_group_laws
      AND real_module_laws
      AND norm_laws
      AND inner_product_laws
      AND complete_space

  real_linear(T: linear_map): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      T(addE(x, y)) = addE(T(x), T(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):
        T(smulE(a, x)) = smulE(a, T(x)))

  continuous_linear(T: linear_map): bool =
    real_linear(T)
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        0 <= bound
          AND FORALL (x: E):
            normE(T(x)) <= bound * normE(x)

  continuous_linear_equivalence(
      T, inverseT: linear_map): bool =
    continuous_linear(T)
      AND continuous_linear(inverseT)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        inverseT(T(x)) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        T(inverseT(x)) = x)

  bilinear(form: [E, E -> real]): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
      form(addE(x, y), z) = form(x, z) + form(y, z))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
        form(smulE(a, x), y) = a * form(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        form(x, addE(y, z)) = form(x, y) + form(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
        form(x, smulE(a, y)) = a * form(x, y))

  bounded_bilinear(form: [E, E -> real]): bool =
    bilinear(form)
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        0 <= bound
          AND FORALL (x, y: E):
            abs(form(x, y)) <=
              bound * normE(x) * normE(y)

  coercive(form: [E, E -> real]): bool =
    EXISTS (constant: real):
      0 < constant
        AND FORALL (x: E):
          constant * normE(x) * normE(x) <= form(x, x)

  lax_milgram_theorem: bool =
    (real_hilbert_space
      AND bounded_bilinear(B)
      AND coercive(B))
    IMPLIES
      EXISTS (T, inverseT: linear_map):
        continuous_linear_equivalence(T, inverseT)
          AND FORALL (v, w: E):
            innerE(T(v), w) = B(v, w)
END lax_milgram_theorem_Q9993851
